```
import { defineConfig } from "vite";
import react from "@vitejs/plugin-react";
import path from "path";
import runtimeErrorOverlay from "@replit/vite-plugin-runtime-error-modal";

export default defineConfig({
  plugins: [
    react(),
    runtimeErrorOverlay(),
    ...(process.env.NODE_ENV !== "production" &&
    process.env.REPL_ID !== undefined
      ? [
          await import("@replit/vite-plugin-cartographer").then((m) =>
            m.cartographer(),
          ),
        ]
      : []),
  ],
  resolve: {
    alias: {
      "@": path.resolve(import.meta.dirname, "client", "src"),
      "@shared": path.resolve(import.meta.dirname, "shared"),
      "@assets": path.resolve(import.meta.dirname, "attached_assets"),
    },
  },
  root: path.resolve(import.meta.dirname, "client"),
  build: {
    outDir: path.resolve(import.meta.dirname, "dist/public"),
    emptyOutDir: true,
  },
  server: {
    fs: {
      strict: true,
      deny: ["**/.*"],
    },
  },
});
```

```
import { defineConfig } from "drizzle-kit";

if (!process.env.DATABASE_URL) {
  throw new Error("DATABASE_URL, ensure the database is provisioned");
}

export default defineConfig({
  out: "./migrations",
  schema: "./shared/schema.ts",
  dialect: "postgresql",
  dbCredentials: {
    url: process.env.DATABASE_URL,
  },
});
```

## FILE: client/src/components/ActivityTable.tsx
```
import { useState } from 'react';
import { Search, Filter, Eye } from 'lucide-react';
import { Card } from '@/components/ui/card';
import { Input } from '@/components/ui/input';
import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button';
import { Avatar, AvatarFallback, AvatarImage } from '@/components/ui/avatar';
import { Badge } from '@/components/ui/badge';
import type { Activity, User } from '@shared/schema';

interface ActivityWithUser extends Activity {
  user?: User;
}

interface ActivityTableProps {
  activities: ActivityWithUser[];
  onViewActivity?: (activity: ActivityWithUser) => void;
}

export default function ActivityTable({ activities, onViewActivity }: ActivityTableProps) {
  const [searchTerm, setSearchTerm] = useState('');

  const filteredActivities = (activities || []).filter(activity =>
    activity.description.toLowerCase().includes(searchTerm.toLowerCase()) ||
    (activity.user?.firstName?.toLowerCase().includes(searchTerm.toLowerCase())) ||
    (activity.user?.lastName?.toLowerCase().includes(searchTerm.toLowerCase()))
  );

  const getStatusColor = (status: string) => {
    switch (status) {
      case 'completed':
        return 'bg-green-600/20 text-green-600';
      case 'pending':
        return 'bg-amber-600/20 text-amber-600';
      case 'failed':
        return 'bg-red-600/20 text-red-600';
      default:
        return 'bg-gray-600/20 text-gray-600';
    }
  };

  const getTypeIcon = (type: string) => {
    switch (type) {
      case 'report':
        return '📊';
      case 'alert':
        return '⚠️';
      case 'user_action':
        return '👤';
      default:
        return '📝';
    }
  };

  const formatTimeAgo = (date: Date | null) => {
    if (!date) return 'Unknown';
    const now = new Date();
    const diff = now.getTime() - new Date(date).getTime();
    const minutes = Math.floor(diff / 60000);
    
    if (minutes < 1) return 'Just now';
    if (minutes < 60) return `${minutes} min ago`;
    if (minutes < 1440) return `${Math.floor(minutes / 60)} hr ago`;
    return `${Math.floor(minutes / 1440)} days ago`;
  };

  return (
    <Card className="bg-white/15 backdrop-blur-xl border border-white/20 rounded-3xl p-8 shadow-xl transition-all duration-500 hover:shadow-2xl hover:bg-white/20 relative overflow-hidden">
      {/* Gradient top border */}
      <div className="absolute top-0 left-0 right-0 h-1 bg-gradient-to-r from-primary via-green-600 to-amber-600" />
      
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-6">
        <h3 className="text-xl font-bold bg-gradient-to-r from-gray-900 to-primary bg-clip-text text-transparent">
          Recent Activities
        </h3>
        
        <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
          <div className="relative">
            <Search className="absolute left-3 top-1/2 transform -translate-y-1/2 text-gray-500 w-4 h-4" />
            <Input
              type="text"
              placeholder="Search activities..."
              value={searchTerm}
              onChange={(e) => setSearchTerm(e.target.value)}
              className="pl-10 bg-white/15 backdrop-blur-xl border-white/20 placeholder-gray-500"
            />
          </div>
          <Button
            variant="outline"
            size="icon"
            className="bg-white/15 backdrop-blur-xl border-white/20 hover:bg-white/30"
          >
            <Filter className="w-4 h-4" />
          </Button>
        </div>
      </div>
      
      <div className="overflow-x-auto">
        <table className="w-full">
          <thead>
            <tr className="border-b border-white/20">
              <th className="text-left py-3 px-4 text-xs font-semibold text-gray-600 uppercase tracking-wider">
                Activity
              </th>
              <th className="text-left py-3 px-4 text-xs font-semibold text-gray-600 uppercase tracking-wider">
                User
              </th>
              <th className="text-left py-3 px-4 text-xs font-semibold text-gray-600 uppercase tracking-wider">
                Status
              </th>
              <th className="text-left py-3 px-4 text-xs font-semibold text-gray-600 uppercase tracking-wider">
                Time
              </th>
              <th className="text-left py-3 px-4 text-xs font-semibold text-gray-600 uppercase tracking-wider">
                Actions
              </th>
            </tr>
          </thead>
          <tbody>
            {filteredActivities.map((activity) => (
              <tr
                key={activity.id}
                className="border-b border-white/10 hover:bg-white/10 transition-all duration-300"
              >
                <td className="py-4 px-4">
                  <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
                    <div className="w-8 h-8 bg-primary/20 rounded-full flex items-center justify-center">
                      <span className="text-xs">{getTypeIcon(activity.type)}</span>
                    </div>
                    <span className="font-medium text-gray-900">
                      {activity.description}
                    </span>
                  </div>
                </td>
                <td className="py-4 px-4">
                  <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                    <Avatar className="w-6 h-6">
                      <AvatarImage src={activity.user?.profileImageUrl || undefined} />
                      <AvatarFallback className="text-xs">
                        {activity.user?.firstName?.[0] || 'S'}
                        {activity.user?.lastName?.[0] || 'U'}
                      </AvatarFallback>
                    </Avatar>
                    <span className="text-sm text-gray-900">
                      {activity.user ? 
                        `${activity.user.firstName || ''} ${activity.user.lastName || ''}`.trim() || 'User' :
                        'System'
                      }
                    </span>
                  </div>
                </td>
                <td className="py-4 px-4">
                  <Badge className={`${getStatusColor(activity.status || 'unknown')} border-0 capitalize`}>
                    {activity.status}
                  </Badge>
                </td>
                <td className="py-4 px-4 text-sm text-gray-600">
                  {formatTimeAgo(activity.createdAt)}
                </td>
                <td className="py-4 px-4">
                  <Button
                    variant="ghost"
                    size="sm"
                    onClick={() => onViewActivity?.(activity)}
                    className="text-primary hover:text-primary/80 hover:bg-primary/10"
                  >
                    <Eye className="w-4 h-4" />
                  </Button>
                </td>
              </tr>
            ))}
          </tbody>
        </table>
      </div>
    </Card>
  );
}
```

```
                      <p className="text-sm text-gray-600">{reward.description}</p>
                      <p className="text-sm font-medium text-green-600">{reward.value}</p>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                  <div className="text-right">
                    <div className="flex items-center space-x-2">
                      <span className="text-sm text-gray-500">{metrics.referrals}/{reward.threshold} referrals</span>
                      {reward.unlocked && <CheckCircle className="w-5 h-5 text-green-500" />}
                    </div>
                    <Progress 
                      value={Math.min((metrics.referrals / reward.threshold) * 100, 100)} 
                    />
                  </div>
                </div>
              </div>
            ))}
          </div>
        </CardContent>
      </Card>
    </div>
  );

  return (
    <div className="min-h-screen bg-gradient-to-br from-purple-50 to-blue-50 p-6">
      <div className="max-w-7xl mx-auto">
        {/* Header */}
        <div className="mb-8 text-center">
          <h1 className="text-4xl font-bold text-gray-900 mb-2">Viral Growth Engine</h1>
          <p className="text-gray-600 max-w-2xl mx-auto">
            Transform your success into exponential network growth. Share your transformation story and unlock exclusive rewards.
          </p>
        </div>

        {/* Tab Navigation */}
        <div className="flex justify-center mb-8">
          <div className="bg-white rounded-lg p-1 shadow-md">
            {[
              { id: 'dashboard', name: 'Viral Dashboard', icon: TrendingUp },
              { id: 'share', name: 'Share Center', icon: Share2 },
              { id: 'referrals', name: 'Referral Program', icon: Gift }
            ].map((tab) => (
              <button
                key={tab.id}
                onClick={() => setActiveTab(tab.id)}
                className={`flex items-center space-x-2 px-6 py-3 rounded-lg transition-all ${
                  activeTab === tab.id
                    ? 'bg-blue-600 text-white shadow-lg'
                    : 'text-gray-600 hover:bg-gray-100'
                }`}
              >
                <tab.icon className="w-5 h-5" />
                <span className="font-medium">{tab.name}</span>
              </button>
            ))}
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Tab Content */}
        <div className="min-h-96">
          {activeTab === 'dashboard' && renderViralDashboard()}
          {activeTab === 'share' && renderShareCenter()}
          {activeTab === 'referrals' && renderReferralProgram()}
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

export default AdvancedViralEngine;
```

```
import React, { useState } from 'react';
import { Card, CardContent, CardHeader, CardTitle } from '@/components/ui/card';
import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button';
import { Textarea } from '@/components/ui/textarea';
import { Badge } from '@/components/ui/badge';
import { Tabs, TabsContent, TabsList, TabsTrigger } from '@/components/ui/tabs';
import { Brain, Zap, Target, TrendingUp, AlertTriangle, CheckCircle } from 'lucide-react';
import { VeridiusCard, VeridiusButton } from '@/components/ui/veridius-components';

interface AIAnalysisResult {
  confidence: number;
  recommendations: string[];
  patterns: any[];
  riskAssessment: {
    level: 'low' | 'medium' | 'high' | 'critical';
    factors: string[];
  };
  historicalMatches: any[];
  executionPlan: {
    priorities: string[];
    timeline: string;
  };
}

interface ScenarioData {
  title: string;
  description: string;
  context: string;
  organizationId: string;
  userId: string;
  [key: string]: any;
}

export default function AIIntelligenceInterface() {
  const [scenarioData, setScenarioData] = useState<Partial<ScenarioData>>({
    title: '',
    description: '',
    context: '',
    organizationId: 'demo-org',
    userId: 'demo-user'
  });
  const [analysisResult, setAnalysisResult] = useState<AIAnalysisResult | null>(null);
  const [isAnalyzing, setIsAnalyzing] = useState(false);
  const [analysisType, setAnalysisType] = useState('comprehensive');

  const analyzeScenario = async () => {
    if (!scenarioData.title || !scenarioData.description) {
      return;
    }

    setIsAnalyzing(true);
    try {
      const response = await fetch('/api/ai/analyze-scenario', {
        method: 'POST',
        headers: {
          'Content-Type': 'application/json',
        },
        body: JSON.stringify({
          scenario: scenarioData,
          context: scenarioData.context || 'Strategic decision analysis',
          analysis_type: analysisType
        })
      });

      if (response.ok) {
        const result = await response.json();
        setAnalysisResult(result);
      } else {
        console.error('Analysis failed:', response.status);
      }
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Error analyzing scenario:', error);
    } finally {
      setIsAnalyzing(false);
    }
  };

  const identifyPatterns = async () => {
    try {
      const response = await fetch('/api/ai/identify-patterns', {
        method: 'POST',
        headers: {
          'Content-Type': 'application/json',
        },
        body: JSON.stringify({
          past_scenarios: [scenarioData],
          outcomes: [],
          organization_profile: { id: scenarioData.organizationId }
        })
      });

      if (response.ok) {
        const patterns = await response.json();
        console.log('Patterns identified:', patterns);
      }
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Error identifying patterns:', error);
    }
  };

  const getPredictiveAnalysis = async () => {
    try {
      const response = await fetch('/api/ai/predictive-analysis', {
        method: 'POST',
        headers: {
          'Content-Type': 'application/json',
        },
        body: JSON.stringify({
          scenario_context: scenarioData,
          organizational_factors: { maturity: 'high', resources: 'adequate' },
          external_factors: { market_volatility: 'medium', regulatory_changes: 'low' }
        })
      });

      if (response.ok) {
        const predictions = await response.json();
        console.log('Predictive analysis:', predictions);
      }
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Error getting predictive analysis:', error);
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6">
      {/* Input Section */}
      <VeridiusCard>
        <div className="p-6">
          <h2 className="text-2xl font-bold text-white mb-6 flex items-center gap-3">
            <Brain className="w-8 h-8 text-blue-400" />
            AI Intelligence Engine
          </h2>
          
          <div className="space-y-4">
            <div>
              <label className="text-white font-medium mb-2 block">Scenario Title</label>
              <input
                type="text"
                value={scenarioData.title || ''}
                onChange={(e) => setScenarioData(prev => ({ ...prev, title: e.target.value }))}
                placeholder="Enter scenario title..."
                className="w-full p-3 bg-gray-800/50 border border-gray-600 rounded-lg text-white"
              />
            </div>
            
            <div>
              <label className="text-white font-medium mb-2 block">Scenario Description</label>
              <Textarea
                value={scenarioData.description || ''}
                onChange={(e) => setScenarioData(prev => ({ ...prev, description: e.target.value }))}
                placeholder="Describe the scenario in detail..."
                className="w-full p-3 bg-gray-800/50 border border-gray-600 rounded-lg text-white resize-none"
                rows={4}
              />
            </div>
            
            <div>
              <label className="text-white font-medium mb-2 block">Additional Context</label>
              <Textarea
                value={scenarioData.context || ''}
                onChange={(e) => setScenarioData(prev => ({ ...prev, context: e.target.value }))}
                placeholder="Provide organizational context, constraints, or specific requirements..."
                className="w-full p-3 bg-gray-800/50 border border-gray-600 rounded-lg text-white resize-none"
                rows={3}
              />
            </div>
            
            <div className="flex gap-4">
              <VeridiusButton 
                variant="primary" 
                onClick={analyzeScenario}
                disabled={!scenarioData.title || !scenarioData.description || isAnalyzing}
              >
                {isAnalyzing ? 'Analyzing...' : 'Analyze Scenario'}
              </VeridiusButton>
              <VeridiusButton variant="secondary" onClick={identifyPatterns}>
                Identify Patterns
              </VeridiusButton>
              <VeridiusButton variant="outline" onClick={getPredictiveAnalysis}>
                Predictive Analysis
              </VeridiusButton>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      </VeridiusCard>

      {/* Results Section */}
      {analysisResult && (
        <Tabs defaultValue="analysis" className="space-y-6">
          <TabsList className="grid w-full grid-cols-4 bg-gray-800">
            <TabsTrigger value="analysis" className="text-white">Analysis</TabsTrigger>
            <TabsTrigger value="recommendations" className="text-white">Recommendations</TabsTrigger>
            <TabsTrigger value="execution" className="text-white">Execution Plan</TabsTrigger>
            <TabsTrigger value="patterns" className="text-white">Patterns</TabsTrigger>
          </TabsList>

          <TabsContent value="analysis">
            <VeridiusCard>
              <div className="p-6">
                <h3 className="text-xl font-semibold text-white mb-4">AI Analysis Results</h3>
                
                <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 gap-4 mb-6">
                  <div className="bg-blue-500/20 p-4 rounded-lg">
                    <div className="text-blue-400 font-medium">Confidence Score</div>
                    <div className="text-2xl font-bold text-white">
                      {Math.round(analysisResult.confidence * 100)}%
                    </div>
                  </div>
                  
                  <div className={`p-4 rounded-lg ${
                    analysisResult.riskAssessment.level === 'critical' ? 'bg-red-500/20' :
                    analysisResult.riskAssessment.level === 'high' ? 'bg-orange-500/20' :
                    analysisResult.riskAssessment.level === 'medium' ? 'bg-yellow-500/20' :
                    'bg-green-500/20'
                  }`}>
                    <div className={`font-medium ${
                      analysisResult.riskAssessment.level === 'critical' ? 'text-red-400' :
                      analysisResult.riskAssessment.level === 'high' ? 'text-orange-400' :
                      analysisResult.riskAssessment.level === 'medium' ? 'text-yellow-400' :
                      'text-green-400'
                    }`}>Risk Level</div>
                    <div className="text-2xl font-bold text-white capitalize">
                      {analysisResult.riskAssessment.level}
                    </div>
                  </div>
                  
                  <div className="bg-purple-500/20 p-4 rounded-lg">
                    <div className="text-purple-400 font-medium">Pattern Matches</div>
                    <div className="text-2xl font-bold text-white">
                      {analysisResult.historicalMatches?.length || 0}
                    </div>
                  </div>
                </div>

                {analysisResult.riskAssessment.factors.length > 0 && (
                  <div>
                    <h4 className="text-white font-medium mb-3">Risk Factors:</h4>
                    <ul className="space-y-2">
                      {analysisResult.riskAssessment.factors.map((factor, idx) => (
                        <li key={idx} className="text-gray-300 flex items-start gap-2">
                          <AlertTriangle className="w-4 h-4 text-orange-400 mt-1 flex-shrink-0" />
                          {factor}
                        </li>
                      ))}
                    </ul>
                  </div>
                )}
              </div>
            </VeridiusCard>
          </TabsContent>

          <TabsContent value="recommendations">
            <VeridiusCard>
              <div className="p-6">
                <h3 className="text-xl font-semibold text-white mb-4">Strategic Recommendations</h3>
                <div className="space-y-3">
                  {analysisResult.recommendations.map((rec, idx) => (
                    <div key={idx} className="flex items-start gap-3 p-3 bg-green-500/10 rounded-lg">
                      <CheckCircle className="w-5 h-5 text-green-400 mt-1 flex-shrink-0" />
                      <span className="text-white">{rec}</span>
                    </div>
                  ))}
                </div>
              </div>
            </VeridiusCard>
          </TabsContent>

          <TabsContent value="execution">
            <VeridiusCard>
              <div className="p-6">
                <h3 className="text-xl font-semibold text-white mb-4">Execution Plan</h3>
                
                <div className="mb-6">
                  <h4 className="text-white font-medium mb-3">Timeline: {analysisResult.executionPlan.timeline}</h4>
                </div>
                
                <div>
                  <h4 className="text-white font-medium mb-3">Priority Actions:</h4>
                  <div className="space-y-2">
                    {analysisResult.executionPlan.priorities.map((priority, idx) => (
                      <div key={idx} className="flex items-start gap-3 p-3 bg-blue-500/10 rounded-lg">
                        <Target className="w-5 h-5 text-blue-400 mt-1 flex-shrink-0" />
                        <span className="text-white">{priority}</span>
                      </div>
                    ))}
                  </div>
                </div>
              </div>
            </VeridiusCard>
          </TabsContent>

          <TabsContent value="patterns">
            <VeridiusCard>

                {analysisResult.historicalMatches.length > 0 ? (

                  </div>
                )}
              </div>
            </VeridiusCard>
          </TabsContent>
        </Tabs>
      )}
```
```
    </div>

            <div className="p-4 bg-green-50 rounded-lg">
              <h4 className="font-semibold text-green-900 mb-2">Risk Sensitivity</h4>
              <p className="text-sm text-green-700 mb-3">Adjust AI risk tolerance and alerting</p>
              <Button size="sm" variant="outline" className="w-full">
                Tune Risk Models
              </Button>
            </div>

            <div className="p-4 bg-purple-50 rounded-lg">
              <h4 className="font-semibold text-purple-900 mb-2">Decision Style</h4>
              <p className="text-sm text-purple-700 mb-3">Align AI recommendations with leadership style</p>
              <Button size="sm" variant="outline" className="w-full">
                Customize Decision AI
              </Button>
            </div>
          </div>
        </CardContent>
      </Card>
    </div>
  );

  return (
    <div className="min-h-screen bg-gradient-to-br from-purple-50 to-cyan-50 p-6">
      <div className="max-w-7xl mx-auto">
        {/* Header */}
        <div className="mb-8 text-center">
          <h1 className="text-4xl font-bold text-gray-900 mb-2">AI Integration Engine</h1>
          <p className="text-gray-600 max-w-2xl mx-auto">
            Harness the power of enterprise-grade artificial intelligence for predictive analytics, automated insights, and strategic intelligence.
          </p>
        </div>

        {/* Tab Navigation */}
        <div className="flex justify-center mb-8">
          <div className="bg-white rounded-lg p-1 shadow-md">
            {[
              { id: 'capabilities', name: 'AI Capabilities', icon: Brain },
              { id: 'insights', name: 'Predictive Insights', icon: Eye },
              { id: 'lab', name: 'AI Laboratory', icon: Sparkles }
            ].map((tab) => (
              <button
                key={tab.id}
                onClick={() => setActiveTab(tab.id)}
                className={`flex items-center space-x-2 px-6 py-3 rounded-lg transition-all ${
                  activeTab === tab.id
                    ? 'bg-purple-600 text-white shadow-lg'
                    : 'text-gray-600 hover:bg-gray-100'
                }`}
              >
                <tab.icon className="w-5 h-5" />
                <span className="font-medium">{tab.name}</span>
              </button>
            ))}
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Tab Content */}
        <div className="min-h-96">
          {activeTab === 'capabilities' && renderCapabilities()}
          {activeTab === 'insights' && renderPredictiveInsights()}
          {activeTab === 'lab' && renderAILab()}
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

export default AIIntegrationEngine;
```

## FILE: client/src/components/ai-intelligence/AIAnalysisEngine.tsx
```
import React, { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import { Card, CardContent, CardDescription, CardHeader, CardTitle } from '@/components/ui/card';
import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button';
import { Badge } from '@/components/ui/badge';
import { Progress } from '@/components/ui/progress';
import { Tabs, TabsContent, TabsList, TabsTrigger } from '@/components/ui/tabs';
import { Alert, AlertDescription } from '@/components/ui/alert';
import { 
  Brain, TrendingUp, AlertTriangle, Users, DollarSign, 
  Target, BarChart3, Clock, CheckCircle, ArrowRight,
  Lightbulb, Shield, Zap, FileText, Presentation
} from 'lucide-react';

interface AIAnalysisEngineProps {
  scenarioData: Record<string, any>;
  scenarioType: string;
  organizationContext?: {
    industry: string;
    size: string;
    geography: string;
    revenue?: string;
  };
  urgencyLevel: 'low' | 'medium' | 'high' | 'critical';
  onAnalysisComplete?: (analysis: any) => void;
}

interface ExecutiveRecommendation {
  priority: 'immediate' | 'urgent' | 'important' | 'monitor';
  action: string;
  rationale: string;
  stakeholder: string;
  timeline: string;
  resources: string;
  risks: string[];
  successMetrics: string[];
}

interface AIAnalysisResponse {
  confidenceScore: number;
  executiveSummary: string;
  criticalFindings: string[];
  recommendations: ExecutiveRecommendation[];
  financialImpact: {
    estimatedCost: string;
    potentialLoss: string;
    expectedROI: string;
    timeToBreakeven: string;
  };
  riskAssessment: {
    overallRisk: 'low' | 'medium' | 'high' | 'critical';
    primaryRisks: string[];
    mitigationStrategies: string[];
  };
  stakeholderTalkingPoints: {
    [stakeholder: string]: {
      keyMessages: string[];
      concerns: string[];
      nextSteps: string[];
    };
  };
  industryInsights: string[];
  competitiveImplications: string[];
  monitoringKPIs: string[];
  scenarioOutcomes: {
    bestCase: { description: string; probability: number };
    mostLikely: { description: string; probability: number };
    worstCase: { description: string; probability: number };
  };
}

export default function AIAnalysisEngine({ 
  scenarioData, 
  scenarioType, 
  organizationContext, 
  urgencyLevel,
  onAnalysisComplete 
}: AIAnalysisEngineProps) {
  const [analysis, setAnalysis] = useState<AIAnalysisResponse | null>(null);
  const [isAnalyzing, setIsAnalyzing] = useState(false);
  const [analysisProgress, setAnalysisProgress] = useState(0);
  const [executiveBriefing, setExecutiveBriefing] = useState<any>(null);
  const [industryInsights, setIndustryInsights] = useState<any>(null);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);

  const generateAnalysis = async () => {
    setIsAnalyzing(true);
    setAnalysisProgress(0);
    setError(null);

    try {
      // Simulate analysis progress
      const progressInterval = setInterval(() => {
        setAnalysisProgress(prev => {
          if (prev >= 90) {
            clearInterval(progressInterval);
            return prev;
          }
          return prev + Math.random() * 15;
        });
      }, 200);

      const response = await fetch('/api/ai-intelligence/analyze', {
        method: 'POST',
        headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
        body: JSON.stringify({
          scenarioType,
          scenarioData,
          organizationContext,
          urgencyLevel
        }),
      });

      if (!response.ok) {
        throw new Error(`Analysis failed: ${response.statusText}`);
      }

      const analysisResult = await response.json();
      
      clearInterval(progressInterval);
      setAnalysisProgress(100);
      setAnalysis(analysisResult);
      onAnalysisComplete?.(analysisResult);

    } catch (err) {
      setError(err instanceof Error ? err.message : 'Analysis failed');
      console.error('AI Analysis Error:', err);
    } finally {
      setIsAnalyzing(false);
    }
  };

  const generateExecutiveBriefing = async () => {
    try {
      const response = await fetch('/api/ai-intelligence/executive-briefing', {
        method: 'POST',
        headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
        body: JSON.stringify({
          scenarioType,
          scenarioData,
          organizationContext,
          urgencyLevel
        }),
      });

      if (!response.ok) {
        throw new Error(`Executive briefing generation failed: ${response.statusText}`);
      }

      const briefing = await response.json();
      setExecutiveBriefing(briefing);

    } catch (err) {
      setError(err instanceof Error ? err.message : 'Executive briefing generation failed');
      console.error('Executive Briefing Error:', err);
    }
  };

  const generateIndustryInsights = async () => {
    if (!organizationContext?.industry) return;

    try {
      const response = await fetch('/api/ai-intelligence/industry-insights', {
        method: 'POST',
        headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
        body: JSON.stringify({
          industry: organizationContext.industry,
          scenarioType
        }),
      });

      if (!response.ok) {
        throw new Error(`Industry insights generation failed: ${response.statusText}`);
      }

      const insights = await response.json();
      setIndustryInsights(insights);

    } catch (err) {
      setError(err instanceof Error ? err.message : 'Industry insights generation failed');
      console.error('Industry Insights Error:', err);
    }
  };

  const getPriorityColor = (priority: string) => {
    switch (priority) {
      case 'immediate': return 'bg-red-500';
      case 'urgent': return 'bg-orange-500';
      case 'important': return 'bg-yellow-500';
      case 'monitor': return 'bg-blue-500';
      default: return 'bg-gray-500';
    }
  };

  const getRiskColor = (risk: string) => {
    switch (risk) {
      case 'critical': return 'text-red-600 bg-red-50';
      case 'high': return 'text-orange-600 bg-orange-50';
      case 'medium': return 'text-yellow-600 bg-yellow-50';
      case 'low': return 'text-green-600 bg-green-50';
      default: return 'text-gray-600 bg-gray-50';
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6" data-testid="ai-analysis-engine">
      {/* Analysis Control Panel */}
      <Card>
        <CardHeader>
          <CardTitle className="flex items-center gap-2">
            <Brain className="w-5 h-5 text-blue-600" />
            AI Intelligence Engine (GPT-5)
          </CardTitle>
          <CardDescription>
            Transform 6-month analysis into 4-minute executive decisions with 95% confidence AI
          </CardDescription>
        </CardHeader>
        <CardContent className="space-y-4">
          <div className="flex gap-3">
            <Button 
              onClick={generateAnalysis}
              disabled={isAnalyzing}
              className="flex items-center gap-2"
              data-testid="button-generate-analysis"
            >
              {isAnalyzing ? (
                <>
                  <div className="animate-spin rounded-full h-4 w-4 border-b-2 border-white" />
                  Analyzing...
                </>
              ) : (
                <>
                  <Zap className="w-4 h-4" />
                  Generate AI Analysis
                </>
              )}
            </Button>

            {analysis && (
              <>
                <Button 
                  onClick={generateExecutiveBriefing}
                  variant="outline"
                  className="flex items-center gap-2"
                  data-testid="button-executive-briefing"
                >
                  <Presentation className="w-4 h-4" />
                  Executive Briefing
                </Button>

                {organizationContext?.industry && (
                  <Button 
                    onClick={generateIndustryInsights}
                    variant="outline"
                    className="flex items-center gap-2"
                    data-testid="button-industry-insights"
                  >
                    <Target className="w-4 h-4" />
                    Industry Insights
                  </Button>
                )}
              </>
            )}
          </div>

          {isAnalyzing && (
            <div className="space-y-2">
              <div className="flex items-center justify-between text-sm">
                <span>AI Analysis Progress</span>
                <span>{Math.round(analysisProgress)}%</span>
              </div>
              <Progress value={analysisProgress} className="w-full" />
            </div>
          )}

          {error && (
            <Alert variant="destructive">
              <AlertTriangle className="h-4 w-4" />
              <AlertDescription>{error}</AlertDescription>
            </Alert>
          )}
        </CardContent>
      </Card>

      {/* AI Analysis Results */}
      {analysis && (
        <Card>
          <CardHeader>
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
              <CardTitle className="flex items-center gap-2">
                <CheckCircle className="w-5 h-5 text-green-600" />
                AI Strategic Analysis Complete
              </CardTitle>
              <Badge variant="secondary" className="text-lg font-bold" data-testid="confidence-score">
                {analysis.confidenceScore}% Confidence
              </Badge>
            </div>
          </CardHeader>
          <CardContent>
            <Tabs defaultValue="executive" className="w-full">
              <TabsList className="grid w-full grid-cols-6">
                <TabsTrigger value="executive">Executive</TabsTrigger>
                <TabsTrigger value="recommendations">Actions</TabsTrigger>
                <TabsTrigger value="financial">Financial</TabsTrigger>
                <TabsTrigger value="risks">Risks</TabsTrigger>
                <TabsTrigger value="stakeholders">Stakeholders</TabsTrigger>
                <TabsTrigger value="outcomes">Scenarios</TabsTrigger>
              </TabsList>

              <TabsContent value="executive" className="space-y-4">
                <div className="space-y-4">
                  <div>
                    <h3 className="text-lg font-semibold mb-2">Executive Summary</h3>
                    <p className="text-gray-700" data-testid="executive-summary">
                      {analysis.executiveSummary}
                    </p>
                  </div>

                  <div>
                    <h3 className="text-lg font-semibold mb-2">Critical Findings</h3>
                    <ul className="space-y-2">
                      {analysis.criticalFindings.map((finding, index) => (
                        <li key={index} className="flex items-start gap-2" data-testid={`critical-finding-${index}`}>
                          <AlertTriangle className="w-4 h-4 text-red-500 mt-1 flex-shrink-0" />
                          <span>{finding}</span>
                        </li>
                      ))}
                    </ul>
                  </div>

                  <div>
                    <h3 className="text-lg font-semibold mb-2">Industry Intelligence</h3>
                    <ul className="space-y-1">
                      {analysis.industryInsights.map((insight, index) => (
                        <li key={index} className="flex items-start gap-2" data-testid={`industry-insight-${index}`}>
                          <Lightbulb className="w-4 h-4 text-yellow-500 mt-1 flex-shrink-0" />
                          <span className="text-sm">{insight}</span>
                        </li>
                      ))}
                    </ul>
                  </div>
                </div>
              </TabsContent>

              <TabsContent value="recommendations" className="space-y-4">
                <div className="space-y-4">
                  {analysis.recommendations.map((rec, index) => (
                    <Card key={index} className="relative">
                      <div className={`absolute left-0 top-0 bottom-0 w-1 ${getPriorityColor(rec.priority)} rounded-l`} />
                      <CardContent className="pt-4">
                        <div className="flex items-start justify-between mb-3">
                          <div>
                            <Badge variant="outline" className="mb-2">
                              {rec.priority.toUpperCase()}
                            </Badge>
                            <h4 className="font-semibold" data-testid={`recommendation-action-${index}`}>
                              {rec.action}
                            </h4>
                          </div>
                          <div className="text-right text-sm text-gray-500">
                            <div>Owner: {rec.stakeholder}</div>
                            <div>Timeline: {rec.timeline}</div>
                          </div>
                        </div>
                        
                        <p className="text-sm text-gray-600 mb-3" data-testid={`recommendation-rationale-${index}`}>
                          {rec.rationale}
                        </p>
                        
                        <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 gap-4 text-sm">
                          <div>
                            <h5 className="font-medium mb-1">Resources Needed</h5>
                            <p className="text-gray-600">{rec.resources}</p>
                          </div>
                          <div>
                            <h5 className="font-medium mb-1">Key Risks</h5>
                            <ul className="text-gray-600 space-y-1">
                              {rec.risks.map((risk, riskIndex) => (
                                <li key={riskIndex} className="text-xs">• {risk}</li>
                              ))}
                            </ul>
                          </div>
                          <div>
                            <h5 className="font-medium mb-1">Success Metrics</h5>
                            <ul className="text-gray-600 space-y-1">
                              {rec.successMetrics.map((metric, metricIndex) => (
                                <li key={metricIndex} className="text-xs">• {metric}</li>
                              ))}
                            </ul>
                          </div>
                        </div>
                      </CardContent>
                    </Card>
                  ))}
                </div>
              </TabsContent>

              <TabsContent value="financial" className="space-y-4">
                <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 gap-6">
                  <Card>
                    <CardHeader>
                      <CardTitle className="flex items-center gap-2 text-green-600">
                        <DollarSign className="w-5 h-5" />
                        Investment Analysis
                      </CardTitle>
                    </CardHeader>
                    <CardContent className="space-y-3">
                      <div>
                        <div className="text-sm text-gray-600">Implementation Cost</div>
                        <div className="text-xl font-semibold" data-testid="estimated-cost">
                          {analysis.financialImpact.estimatedCost}
                        </div>
                      </div>
                      <div>
                        <div className="text-sm text-gray-600">Expected ROI</div>
                        <div className="text-xl font-semibold text-green-600" data-testid="expected-roi">
                          {analysis.financialImpact.expectedROI}
                        </div>
                      </div>
                      <div>
                        <div className="text-sm text-gray-600">Time to Breakeven</div>
                        <div className="text-lg font-medium" data-testid="breakeven-time">
                          {analysis.financialImpact.timeToBreakeven}
                        </div>
                      </div>
                    </CardContent>
                  </Card>

                  <Card>
                    <CardHeader>
                      <CardTitle className="flex items-center gap-2 text-red-600">
                        <AlertTriangle className="w-5 h-5" />
                        Cost of Inaction
                      </CardTitle>
                    </CardHeader>
                    <CardContent className="space-y-3">
                      <div>
                        <div className="text-sm text-gray-600">Potential Loss</div>
                        <div className="text-xl font-semibold text-red-600" data-testid="potential-loss">
                          {analysis.financialImpact.potentialLoss}
                        </div>
                      </div>
                      <div className="mt-4">
                        <Alert>
                          <Clock className="h-4 w-4" />
                          <AlertDescription>
                            Delayed action increases risk exposure and potential losses
                          </AlertDescription>
                        </Alert>
                      </div>
                    </CardContent>
                  </Card>
                </div>

                    <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                      <span className="text-lg font-medium">Overall Risk Level</span>
                      <Badge className={getRiskColor(analysis.riskAssessment.overallRisk)} data-testid="overall-risk">
                        {analysis.riskAssessment.overallRisk.toUpperCase()}
                      </Badge>
                    </div>

                    <div>
                      <h4 className="font-medium mb-2">Primary Risks</h4>
                      <ul className="space-y-2">
                        {analysis.riskAssessment.primaryRisks.map((risk, index) => (
                          <li key={index} className="flex items-start gap-2" data-testid={`primary-risk-${index}`}>
                            <AlertTriangle className="w-4 h-4 text-orange-500 mt-1 flex-shrink-0" />
                            <span>{risk}</span>
                          </li>
                        ))}
                      </ul>
                    </div>

                    <div>
                      <h4 className="font-medium mb-2">Mitigation Strategies</h4>
                      <ul className="space-y-2">
                        {analysis.riskAssessment.mitigationStrategies.map((strategy, index) => (
                          <li key={index} className="flex items-start gap-2" data-testid={`mitigation-strategy-${index}`}>
                            <CheckCircle className="w-4 h-4 text-green-500 mt-1 flex-shrink-0" />
                            <span>{strategy}</span>
                          </li>

                      </ul>
                    </div>
                  </CardContent>

              </TabsContent>

              <TabsContent value="stakeholders" className="space-y-4">
                <div className="grid gap-4">
                  {Object.entries(analysis.stakeholderTalkingPoints).map(([stakeholder, points]) => (
                    <Card key={stakeholder}>
                      <CardHeader>

                          </ul>
                        </div>
                        
                        <div>
                          <h5 className="font-medium text-orange-600 mb-2">Key Concerns</h5>
                          <ul className="space-y-1">
                            {points.concerns.map((concern, index) => (
                              <li key={index} className="text-sm" data-testid={`concern-${stakeholder}-${index}`}>
                                • {concern}
                              </li>
                            ))}
                          </ul>
                        </div>
                        
                        <div>
                          <h5 className="font-medium text-blue-600 mb-2">Next Steps</h5>
                          <ul className="space-y-1">
                            {points.nextSteps.map((step, index) => (
                              <li key={index} className="text-sm flex items-center gap-2" data-testid={`next-step-${stakeholder}-${index}`}>
                                <ArrowRight className="w-3 h-3" />
                                {step}
                              </li>
                            ))}
                          </ul>
                        </div>
                      </CardContent>
                    </Card>
                  ))}
                </div>
              </TabsContent>

              <TabsContent value="outcomes" className="space-y-4">
                <div className="grid gap-4">
                  <Card className="border-green-200 bg-green-50">
                    <CardContent className="pt-4">
                      <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-2">
                        <h4 className="font-semibold text-green-800">Best Case Scenario</h4>
                        <Badge variant="secondary" data-testid="best-case-probability">
                          {analysis.scenarioOutcomes.bestCase.probability}% probability
                        </Badge>
                      </div>
                      <p className="text-green-700" data-testid="best-case-description">
                        {analysis.scenarioOutcomes.bestCase.description}
                      </p>
                    </CardContent>
                  </Card>

                  <Card className="border-blue-200 bg-blue-50">
                    <CardContent className="pt-4">
                      <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-2">
                        <h4 className="font-semibold text-blue-800">Most Likely Scenario</h4>
                        <Badge variant="secondary" data-testid="most-likely-probability">
                          {analysis.scenarioOutcomes.mostLikely.probability}% probability
                        </Badge>
                      </div>
                      <p className="text-blue-700" data-testid="most-likely-description">
                        {analysis.scenarioOutcomes.mostLikely.description}
                      </p>
                    </CardContent>
                  </Card>

                  <Card className="border-red-200 bg-red-50">
                    <CardContent className="pt-4">
                      <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-2">
                        <h4 className="font-semibold text-red-800">Worst Case Scenario</h4>
                        <Badge variant="secondary" data-testid="worst-case-probability">
                          {analysis.scenarioOutcomes.worstCase.probability}% probability
                        </Badge>
                      </div>
                      <p className="text-red-700" data-testid="worst-case-description">
                        {analysis.scenarioOutcomes.worstCase.description}
                      </p>
                    </CardContent>
                  </Card>
                </div>

                <Card>
                  <CardHeader>
                    <CardTitle className="flex items-center gap-2">
                      <BarChart3 className="w-5 h-5" />
                      Key Performance Indicators
                    </CardTitle>
                  </CardHeader>
                  <CardContent>
                    <ul className="space-y-2">
                      {analysis.monitoringKPIs.map((kpi, index) => (
                        <li key={index} className="flex items-center gap-2" data-testid={`monitoring-kpi-${index}`}>
                          <Target className="w-4 h-4 text-blue-500" />
                          <span>{kpi}</span>
                        </li>
                      ))}
                    </ul>
                  </CardContent>
                </Card>
              </TabsContent>
            </Tabs>
          </CardContent>
        </Card>
      )}

      {/* Executive Briefing */}
      {executiveBriefing && (
        <Card>
          <CardHeader>
            <CardTitle className="flex items-center gap-2">
              <Presentation className="w-5 h-5 text-purple-600" />
              Executive Briefing Package
            </CardTitle>
          </CardHeader>
          <CardContent>
            <div className="space-y-6">
              <div>
                <h3 className="text-lg font-semibold mb-3">Board Summary</h3>
                <p className="text-gray-700 bg-gray-50 p-4 rounded-lg" data-testid="board-summary">
                  {executiveBriefing.boardSummary}
                </p>
              </div>

              <div>
                <h3 className="text-lg font-semibold mb-3">Action Items</h3>
                <div className="space-y-3">
                  {executiveBriefing.actionItems?.map((item: any, index: number) => (
                    <div key={index} className="flex items-center justify-between p-3 border rounded-lg" data-testid={`action-item-${index}`}>
                      <div>
                        <div className="font-medium">{item.task}</div>
                        <div className="text-sm text-gray-600">Owner: {item.owner}</div>
                      </div>
                      <div className="text-right">
                        <Badge className={item.priority === 'critical' ? 'bg-red-500' : 
                                       item.priority === 'high' ? 'bg-orange-500' : 'bg-blue-500'}>
                          {item.priority}
                        </Badge>
                        <div className="text-sm text-gray-600 mt-1">{item.deadline}</div>
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  ))}
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>
          </CardContent>
        </Card>
      )}

      {/* Industry Insights */}
      {industryInsights && (
        <Card>
          <CardHeader>
            <CardTitle className="flex items-center gap-2">
              <Target className="w-5 h-5 text-indigo-600" />
              Industry Intelligence ({organizationContext?.industry})
            </CardTitle>
          </CardHeader>
          <CardContent>
            <Tabs defaultValue="trends" className="w-full">
              <TabsList>
                <TabsTrigger value="trends">Trends</TabsTrigger>
                <TabsTrigger value="competitive">Competitive</TabsTrigger>
                <TabsTrigger value="regulatory">Regulatory</TabsTrigger>
                <TabsTrigger value="practices">Best Practices</TabsTrigger>
              </TabsList>

                    <span className="text-sm">{trend}</span>
                  </div>
                ))}
              </TabsContent>

              <TabsContent value="competitive" className="space-y-3">
                {industryInsights.competitiveAnalysis?.map((analysis: string, index: number) => (
                  <div key={index} className="flex items-start gap-2" data-testid={`competitive-analysis-${index}`}>
                    <Shield className="w-4 h-4 text-blue-500 mt-1" />
                    <span className="text-sm">{analysis}</span>
                  </div>
                ))}
              </TabsContent>

              <TabsContent value="regulatory" className="space-y-3">
                {industryInsights.regulatoryConsiderations?.map((consideration: string, index: number) => (
                  <div key={index} className="flex items-start gap-2" data-testid={`regulatory-consideration-${index}`}>
                    <FileText className="w-4 h-4 text-orange-500 mt-1" />
                    <span className="text-sm">{consideration}</span>
                  </div>
                ))}
              </TabsContent>

              <TabsContent value="practices" className="space-y-3">
                {industryInsights.bestPractices?.map((practice: string, index: number) => (
                  <div key={index} className="flex items-start gap-2" data-testid={`best-practice-${index}`}>

                    <span className="text-sm">{practice}</span>
                  </div>
                ))}
              </TabsContent>
            </Tabs>
          </CardContent>
        </Card>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}
```
