## FILE: client/src/components/ai-intelligence/InteractiveAIDemo.tsx
```
import React, { useState } from 'react';
import { Card, CardContent, CardDescription, CardHeader, CardTitle } from '@/components/ui/card';
import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button';
import { Badge } from '@/components/ui/badge';
import { Progress } from '@/components/ui/progress';
import { Alert, AlertDescription } from '@/components/ui/alert';
import { 
  Play, CheckCircle, Clock, Brain, TrendingUp, 
  FileText, Users, DollarSign, AlertTriangle,
  ArrowRight, Zap, Target
} from 'lucide-react';

interface DemoStep {
  id: number;
  title: string;
  description: string;
  duration: number;
  status: 'pending' | 'running' | 'complete';
  results?: any;
}

export default function InteractiveAIDemo() {
  const [currentStep, setCurrentStep] = useState(0);
  const [isRunning, setIsRunning] = useState(false);
  const [progress, setProgress] = useState(0);
  
  const [demoSteps, setDemoSteps] = useState<DemoStep[]>([
    {
      id: 1,
      title: "Scenario Input Processing",
      description: "AI analyzes supply chain crisis data with organization context",
      duration: 800,
      status: 'pending'
    },
    {
      id: 2,
      title: "Strategic Analysis Engine",
      description: "GPT-5 generates comprehensive risk assessment and strategic options",
      duration: 1200,
      status: 'pending'
    },
    {
      id: 3,
      title: "Financial Impact Calculation",
      description: "AI calculates revenue risk, investment costs, and ROI projections",
      duration: 600,
      status: 'pending'
    },
    {
      id: 4,
      title: "Stakeholder Communication Plans",
      description: "Generated targeted messaging for CEO, Board, and employees",
      duration: 500,
      status: 'pending'
    },
    {
      id: 5,
      title: "Executive Briefing Creation",
      description: "Board-ready presentation with action items and timelines",
      duration: 700,
      status: 'pending'
    },
    {
      id: 6,
      title: "Competitive Intelligence",
      description: "Market positioning analysis vs McKinsey, BCG, Deloitte",
      duration: 400,
      status: 'pending'
    }
  ]);

  const runDemo = async () => {
    setIsRunning(true);
    setCurrentStep(0);
    setProgress(0);
    
    // Reset all steps
    setDemoSteps(prev => prev.map(step => ({ ...step, status: 'pending' })));
    
    for (let i = 0; i < demoSteps.length; i++) {
      setCurrentStep(i);
      
      // Mark current step as running
      setDemoSteps(prev => prev.map((step, index) => ({
        ...step,
        status: index === i ? 'running' : index < i ? 'complete' : 'pending'
      })));
      
      // Simulate processing time
      await new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, demoSteps[i].duration));
      
      // Mark step as complete
      setDemoSteps(prev => prev.map((step, index) => ({
        ...step,
        status: index <= i ? 'complete' : 'pending'
      })));
      
      setProgress(((i + 1) / demoSteps.length) * 100);
    }
    
    setIsRunning(false);
  };

  const demoResults = {
    analysisTime: "3.8 seconds",
    confidenceScore: 92,
    financialROI: "540%",
    revenueAtRisk: "$2.4M",
    investmentRequired: "$450K",
    competitiveAdvantage: "12-18 months",
    actionItems: 4,
    stakeholderPlans: 3
  };

  const getStepIcon = (status: string) => {
    switch (status) {
      case 'running': return <Clock className="w-4 h-4 text-blue-500 animate-spin" />;
      case 'complete': return <CheckCircle className="w-4 h-4 text-green-500" />;
      default: return <div className="w-4 h-4 rounded-full border-2 border-gray-300" />;
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6">
      {/* Demo Control */}
      <Card>
        <CardHeader>
          <CardTitle className="flex items-center gap-2">
            <Brain className="w-5 h-5 text-purple-600" />
            Interactive AI Intelligence Demo
          </CardTitle>
          <CardDescription>
            Watch step-by-step execution of Fortune 1000 strategic crisis analysis
          </CardDescription>
        </CardHeader>
        <CardContent>
          <div className="flex items-center gap-4">
            <Button 
              onClick={runDemo} 
              disabled={isRunning}
              className="flex items-center gap-2"
              data-testid="button-run-demo"
            >
              <Play className="w-4 h-4" />
              {isRunning ? 'Demo Running...' : 'Start AI Demo'}
            </Button>
            
            {isRunning && (
              <div className="flex-1">
                <div className="flex items-center gap-2 mb-2">
                  <span className="text-sm font-medium">Progress:</span>
                  <span className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">{Math.round(progress)}%</span>
                </div>
                <Progress value={progress} className="w-full" />
              </div>
            )}
          </div>
        </CardContent>
      </Card>

      {/* Processing Steps */}
      <Card>
        <CardHeader>
          <CardTitle>AI Processing Steps</CardTitle>
        </CardHeader>
        <CardContent>
          <div className="space-y-4">
            {demoSteps.map((step, index) => (
              <div 
                key={step.id}
                className={`flex items-start gap-3 p-3 rounded-lg transition-colors ${
                  step.status === 'running' ? 'bg-blue-50 border border-blue-200' :
                  step.status === 'complete' ? 'bg-green-50 border border-green-200' :
                  'bg-gray-50'
                }`}
              >
                <div className="mt-1">
                  {getStepIcon(step.status)}
                </div>
                <div className="flex-1">
                  <h4 className={`font-medium ${
                    step.status === 'running' ? 'text-blue-800' :
                    step.status === 'complete' ? 'text-green-800' :
                    'text-gray-700'
                  }`}>
                    {step.title}
                  </h4>
                  <p className="text-sm text-gray-600 mt-1">
                    {step.description}
                  </p>
                  {step.status === 'running' && (
                    <div className="mt-2">
                      <Badge variant="outline" className="text-xs">
                        Processing... {step.duration}ms
                      </Badge>
                    </div>
                  )}
                </div>
              </div>
            ))}
          </div>
        </CardContent>
      </Card>

      {/* Results Display */}
      {demoSteps.every(step => step.status === 'complete') && (
        <Card className="border-green-200 bg-green-50">
          <CardHeader>
            <CardTitle className="flex items-center gap-2 text-green-800">
              <CheckCircle className="w-5 h-5" />
              Demo Complete: AI Analysis Results
            </CardTitle>
          </CardHeader>
          <CardContent>
            <div className="grid grid-cols-2 md:grid-cols-4 gap-4 mb-6">
              <div className="text-center p-3 bg-white rounded-lg">
                <div className="text-2xl font-bold text-blue-600">{demoResults.analysisTime}</div>
                <div className="text-sm text-gray-600">Total Analysis Time</div>
              </div>
              <div className="text-center p-3 bg-white rounded-lg">
                <div className="text-2xl font-bold text-green-600">{demoResults.confidenceScore}%</div>
                <div className="text-sm text-gray-600">AI Confidence</div>
              </div>
              <div className="text-center p-3 bg-white rounded-lg">
                <div className="text-2xl font-bold text-purple-600">{demoResults.financialROI}</div>
                <div className="text-sm text-gray-600">Expected ROI</div>
              </div>
              <div className="text-center p-3 bg-white rounded-lg">
                <div className="text-2xl font-bold text-orange-600">{demoResults.revenueAtRisk}</div>
                <div className="text-sm text-gray-600">Revenue at Risk</div>
              </div>
            </div>

            <Alert className="bg-green-100 border-green-300">
              <Target className="h-4 w-4 text-green-600" />
              <AlertDescription className="text-green-800">
                <strong>Strategic Outcome:</strong> AI analysis completed in {demoResults.analysisTime} with {demoResults.confidenceScore}% confidence. 
                Recommended $450K crisis investment to preserve $2.4M revenue, delivering 540% ROI within 6 weeks.
                Generated {demoResults.actionItems} executive action items with {demoResults.stakeholderPlans} stakeholder communication plans.
              </AlertDescription>
            </Alert>

            <div className="mt-4 flex gap-2">
              <Button variant="outline" size="sm">
                <FileText className="w-4 h-4 mr-2" />
                View Full Results
              </Button>
              <Button variant="outline" size="sm">
                <Users className="w-4 h-4 mr-2" />
                Executive Briefing
              </Button>
            </div>
          </CardContent>
        </Card>
      )}

      {/* Competitive Comparison */}
      {demoSteps.every(step => step.status === 'complete') && (
        <Card>
          <CardHeader>
            <CardTitle className="flex items-center gap-2">
              <TrendingUp className="w-5 h-5 text-blue-600" />
              Competitive Advantage Demonstrated
            </CardTitle>
          </CardHeader>
          <CardContent>
            <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 gap-4">
              <div className="p-4 border rounded-lg">
                <h4 className="font-semibold text-sm mb-2">vs. Traditional Consulting</h4>
                <div className="space-y-2 text-sm">
                  <div className="flex justify-between">
                    <span>Analysis Time:</span>
                    <span className="text-green-600">6 months → 3.8 seconds</span>
                  </div>
                  <div className="flex justify-between">
                    <span>Investment:</span>
                    <span className="text-green-600">$2M → $450K</span>
                  </div>
                  <div className="flex justify-between">
                    <span>Accuracy:</span>
                    <span className="text-green-600">Human → 92% AI</span>
                  </div>
                </div>
              </div>
              
              <div className="p-4 border rounded-lg">
                <h4 className="font-semibold text-sm mb-2">Strategic Impact</h4>
                <div className="space-y-2 text-sm">
                  <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                    <CheckCircle className="w-3 h-3 text-green-500" />
                    <span>Board-ready presentation</span>
                  </div>
                  <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                    <CheckCircle className="w-3 h-3 text-green-500" />
                    <span>Stakeholder communication</span>
                  </div>
                  <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                    <CheckCircle className="w-3 h-3 text-green-500" />
                    <span>Financial ROI analysis</span>
                  </div>
                </div>
              </div>
              
              <div className="p-4 border rounded-lg">
                <h4 className="font-semibold text-sm mb-2">Market Position</h4>
                <div className="space-y-2 text-sm">
                  <div className="flex justify-between">
                    <span>Competitive Moat:</span>
                    <Badge className="text-xs">12-18 months</Badge>
                  </div>
                  <div className="flex justify-between">
                    <span>Market Category:</span>
                    <Badge variant="outline" className="text-xs">Leader</Badge>
                  </div>
                  <div className="flex justify-between">
                    <span>Enterprise Ready:</span>
                    <Badge className="bg-green-100 text-green-800 text-xs">Fortune 1000</Badge>
                  </div>
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>
          </CardContent>
        </Card>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}
```

## FILE: client/src/components/AIScenarioRecommender.tsx
```
import React, { useState } from 'react';
import { useQuery, useMutation } from '@tanstack/react-query';
import { apiRequest } from '@/lib/queryClient';
import { Card, CardContent, CardDescription, CardHeader, CardTitle } from '@/components/ui/card';
import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button';
import { Input } from '@/components/ui/input';
import { Label } from '@/components/ui/label';
import { Textarea } from '@/components/ui/textarea';
import { Badge } from '@/components/ui/badge';
import { Progress } from '@/components/ui/progress';
import { Tabs, TabsContent, TabsList, TabsTrigger } from '@/components/ui/tabs';
import { useToast } from '@/hooks/use-toast';
import { 
  Brain,
  Target,
  Lightbulb,
  TrendingUp,
  AlertTriangle,
  CheckCircle,
  Zap,
  Users,
  Building,
  Shield,
  Search,
  Sparkles,
  Clock,
  DollarSign
} from 'lucide-react';

interface OrganizationProfile {
  name: string;
  industry: string;
  size: number;
  type: string;
  headquarters?: string;
  adaptabilityScore?: string;
}

interface ScenarioRecommendation {
  scenarioId: string;
  relevanceScore: number;
  reasoning: string;
  urgency: 'immediate' | 'high' | 'medium' | 'low';
  customizations: {
    responseTime: string;
    keyRisks: string[];
    actionPlan: string[];
  };
}

interface OrganizationAnalysis {
  riskProfile: string;
  vulnerabilities: string[];
  strengths: string[];
  recommendedFocus: string[];
}

const urgencyColors = {
  immediate: 'bg-red-100 text-red-800 border-red-200',
  high: 'bg-orange-100 text-orange-800 border-orange-200',
  medium: 'bg-yellow-100 text-yellow-800 border-yellow-200',
  low: 'bg-green-100 text-green-800 border-green-200'
};

export default function AIScenarioRecommender() {
  const { toast } = useToast();
  const [organizationProfile, setOrganizationProfile] = useState<OrganizationProfile>({
    name: '',
    industry: '',
    size: 0,
    type: 'mid-market',
    headquarters: '',
    adaptabilityScore: 'adaptive'
  });
  const [customThreat, setCustomThreat] = useState('');
  const [activeTab, setActiveTab] = useState('profile');
  const [analysisComplete, setAnalysisComplete] = useState(false);

  // Organization analysis mutation
  const analyzeOrganizationMutation = useMutation({
    mutationFn: async (orgData: OrganizationProfile) => {
      return await apiRequest('/api/ai/analyze-organization', 'POST', { organizationData: orgData });
    },
    onSuccess: (data) => {
      setAnalysisComplete(true);
      setActiveTab('analysis');
      toast({
        title: "Analysis Complete",
        description: "AI has analyzed your organization's risk profile.",
      });
    },
    onError: (error) => {
      toast({
        title: "Analysis Failed",
        description: "Failed to analyze organization. Please check your data and try again.",
        variant: "destructive",
      });
    },
  });

  // Scenario recommendations mutation
  const getRecommendationsMutation = useMutation({
    mutationFn: async (orgData: OrganizationProfile) => {
      return await apiRequest('/api/ai/recommend-scenarios', 'POST', { organizationData: orgData, limit: 5 });
    },
    onSuccess: () => {
      setActiveTab('recommendations');
      toast({
        title: "Recommendations Ready",
        description: "AI has generated personalized scenario recommendations.",
      });
    },
    onError: (error) => {
      toast({
        title: "Recommendations Failed",
        description: "Failed to generate recommendations. Please try again.",
        variant: "destructive",
      });
    },
  });

  // Custom scenario generation mutation
  const createCustomScenarioMutation = useMutation({
    mutationFn: async ({ orgData, threat }: { orgData: OrganizationProfile; threat: string }) => {
      return await apiRequest('/api/ai/create-custom-scenario', 'POST', { 
        organizationData: orgData, 
        threatDescription: threat 
      });
    },
    onSuccess: () => {
      setActiveTab('custom');
      toast({
        title: "Custom Scenario Created",
        description: "AI has generated a tailored crisis scenario for your organization.",
      });
    },
    onError: (error) => {
      toast({
        title: "Creation Failed",
        description: "Failed to create custom scenario. Please try again.",
        variant: "destructive",
      });
    },
  });

  const handleProfileSubmit = (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (!organizationProfile.name || !organizationProfile.industry || !organizationProfile.size) {
      toast({
        title: "Missing Information",
        description: "Please fill in all required organization details.",
        variant: "destructive",
      });
      return;
    }
    analyzeOrganizationMutation.mutate(organizationProfile);
  };

  const handleGetRecommendations = () => {
    if (!analysisComplete) {
      toast({
        title: "Analysis Required",
        description: "Please complete organization analysis first.",
        variant: "destructive",
      });
      return;
    }
    getRecommendationsMutation.mutate(organizationProfile);
  };

  const handleCreateCustomScenario = () => {
    if (!customThreat.trim()) {
      toast({
        title: "Threat Description Required",
        description: "Please describe the specific threat or scenario you want to analyze.",
        variant: "destructive",
      });
      return;
    }
    createCustomScenarioMutation.mutate({ orgData: organizationProfile, threat: customThreat });
  };

  const analysis = analyzeOrganizationMutation.data as OrganizationAnalysis | undefined;
  const recommendations = (getRecommendationsMutation.data as any)?.recommendations as ScenarioRecommendation[] | undefined;
  const customScenario = createCustomScenarioMutation.data as any;

  return (
    <div className="p-6 space-y-6 max-w-6xl mx-auto">
      <div className="text-center mb-8">
        <h1 className="text-3xl font-bold gradient-text flex items-center justify-center gap-2">
          <Brain className="w-8 h-8 text-blue-600" />
          AI Scenario Recommender
        </h1>
        <p className="text-gray-600 dark:text-gray-400 mt-2">
          Intelligent crisis scenario recommendations tailored to your organization
        </p>
        <div className="mt-4 p-3 bg-blue-50 dark:bg-blue-900/20 border border-blue-200 dark:border-blue-800 rounded-lg">
          <div className="flex items-center justify-center gap-2 text-blue-700 dark:text-blue-300">
            <Sparkles className="w-4 h-4" />
            <span className="text-sm font-medium">Demo Mode Active</span>
          </div>
          <p className="text-xs text-blue-600 dark:text-blue-400 mt-1">
            Using simulated AI responses for demonstration. Results are realistic but not from OpenAI.
          </p>
        </div>
      </div>

      <Tabs value={activeTab} onValueChange={setActiveTab} className="w-full">
        <TabsList className="grid w-full grid-cols-4">
          <TabsTrigger value="profile" className="flex items-center gap-2">
            <Building className="w-4 h-4" />
            Organization Profile
          </TabsTrigger>
          <TabsTrigger value="analysis" className="flex items-center gap-2">
            <Search className="w-4 h-4" />
            Risk Analysis
          </TabsTrigger>
          <TabsTrigger value="recommendations" className="flex items-center gap-2">
            <Target className="w-4 h-4" />
            Recommendations
          </TabsTrigger>
          <TabsTrigger value="custom" className="flex items-center gap-2">
            <Lightbulb className="w-4 h-4" />
            Custom Scenario
          </TabsTrigger>
        </TabsList>

        <TabsContent value="profile" className="space-y-4">
          <Card>
            <CardHeader>
              <CardTitle className="flex items-center gap-2">
                <Building className="w-5 h-5" />
                Organization Profile
              </CardTitle>
              <CardDescription>
                Provide your organization details for personalized AI analysis
              </CardDescription>
            </CardHeader>
            <CardContent>
              <form onSubmit={handleProfileSubmit} className="space-y-4">
                <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 gap-4">
                  <div>
                    <Label htmlFor="company-name">Company Name *</Label>
                    <Input
                      id="company-name"
                      value={organizationProfile.name}
                      onChange={(e) => setOrganizationProfile(prev => ({ ...prev, name: e.target.value }))}
                      placeholder="Your company name"
                      data-testid="input-company-name"
                    />
                  </div>
                  <div>
                    <Label htmlFor="industry">Industry *</Label>
                    <Input
                      id="industry"
                      value={organizationProfile.industry}
                      onChange={(e) => setOrganizationProfile(prev => ({ ...prev, industry: e.target.value }))}
                      placeholder="e.g., Manufacturing, Technology, Healthcare"
                      data-testid="input-industry"
                    />
                  </div>
                  <div>
                    <Label htmlFor="company-size">Company Size (Employees) *</Label>
                    <Input
                      id="company-size"
                      type="number"
                      value={organizationProfile.size || ''}
                      onChange={(e) => setOrganizationProfile(prev => ({ ...prev, size: parseInt(e.target.value) || 0 }))}
                      placeholder="Number of employees"
                      data-testid="input-company-size"
                    />
                  </div>
                  <div>
                    <Label htmlFor="headquarters">Headquarters</Label>
                    <Input
                      id="headquarters"
                      value={organizationProfile.headquarters}
                      onChange={(e) => setOrganizationProfile(prev => ({ ...prev, headquarters: e.target.value }))}
                      placeholder="City, Country"
                      data-testid="input-headquarters"
                    />
                  </div>
                </div>
                
                <Button 
                  type="submit" 
                  className="w-full" 
                  disabled={analyzeOrganizationMutation.isPending}
                  data-testid="button-analyze-organization"
                >
                  {analyzeOrganizationMutation.isPending ? (
                    <>
                      <Brain className="w-4 h-4 mr-2 animate-spin" />
                      Analyzing Organization...
                    </>
                  ) : (
                    <>
                      <Brain className="w-4 h-4 mr-2" />
                      Analyze Organization
                    </>
                  )}
                </Button>
              </form>
            </CardContent>
          </Card>
        </TabsContent>

        <TabsContent value="analysis" className="space-y-4">
          {analysis ? (
            <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 gap-6">
              <Card>
                <CardHeader>
                  <CardTitle className="flex items-center gap-2">
                    <AlertTriangle className="w-5 h-5 text-orange-500" />
                    Risk Profile
                  </CardTitle>
                </CardHeader>
                <CardContent>
                  <p className="text-gray-700 dark:text-gray-300">{analysis.riskProfile}</p>
                </CardContent>
              </Card>

              <Card>
                <CardHeader>
                  <CardTitle className="flex items-center gap-2">
                    <Shield className="w-5 h-5 text-red-500" />
                    Key Vulnerabilities
                  </CardTitle>
                </CardHeader>
                <CardContent>
                  <ul className="space-y-2">
                    {analysis.vulnerabilities.map((vuln, index) => (
                      <li key={index} className="flex items-start gap-2">
                        <AlertTriangle className="w-4 h-4 text-red-500 mt-0.5 flex-shrink-0" />
                        <span className="text-sm">{vuln}</span>
                      </li>
                    ))}
                  </ul>
                </CardContent>
              </Card>

              <Card>
                <CardHeader>
                  <CardTitle className="flex items-center gap-2">
                    <CheckCircle className="w-5 h-5 text-green-500" />
                    Organizational Strengths
                  </CardTitle>
                </CardHeader>
                <CardContent>
                  <ul className="space-y-2">
                    {analysis.strengths.map((strength, index) => (
                      <li key={index} className="flex items-start gap-2">
                        <CheckCircle className="w-4 h-4 text-green-500 mt-0.5 flex-shrink-0" />
                        <span className="text-sm">{strength}</span>
                      </li>
                    ))}
                  </ul>
                </CardContent>
              </Card>

              <Card>
                <CardHeader>
                  <CardTitle className="flex items-center gap-2">
                    <Target className="w-5 h-5 text-blue-500" />
                    Recommended Focus Areas
                  </CardTitle>
                </CardHeader>
                <CardContent>
                  <ul className="space-y-2">
                    {analysis.recommendedFocus.map((focus, index) => (
                      <li key={index} className="flex items-start gap-2">
                        <Target className="w-4 h-4 text-blue-500 mt-0.5 flex-shrink-0" />
                        <span className="text-sm">{focus}</span>
                      </li>
                    ))}
                  </ul>
                </CardContent>
              </Card>
            </div>
          ) : (
            <Card>
              <CardContent className="text-center py-8">
                <Brain className="w-12 h-12 mx-auto text-gray-400 mb-4" />
                <p className="text-gray-500">Complete organization analysis to see detailed insights</p>
              </CardContent>
            </Card>
          )}

          {analysis && (
            <div className="text-center">
              <Button 
                onClick={handleGetRecommendations} 
                size="lg"
                disabled={getRecommendationsMutation.isPending}
                data-testid="button-get-recommendations"
              >
                {getRecommendationsMutation.isPending ? (
                  <>
                    <Sparkles className="w-5 h-5 mr-2 animate-spin" />
                    Generating Recommendations...
                  </>
                ) : (
                  <>
                    <Sparkles className="w-5 h-5 mr-2" />
                    Get AI Recommendations
                  </>
                )}
              </Button>
            </div>
          )}
        </TabsContent>

        <TabsContent value="recommendations" className="space-y-4">
          {recommendations ? (
            <div className="space-y-4">
              <div className="text-center mb-6">
                <h3 className="text-xl font-semibold">Personalized Scenario Recommendations</h3>
                <p className="text-gray-600">Based on your organization's profile and risk analysis</p>
              </div>
              
              {recommendations.map((rec, index) => (
                <Card key={index} className="border-l-4 border-l-blue-500">
                  <CardHeader>
                    <div className="flex items-start justify-between">
                      <CardTitle className="flex items-center gap-2">
                        <Target className="w-5 h-5" />
                        Scenario #{index + 1}
                      </CardTitle>
                      <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                        <Badge className={urgencyColors[rec.urgency]}>
                          {rec.urgency.toUpperCase()}
                        </Badge>
                        <div className="text-right">
                          <div className="text-sm text-gray-500">Relevance</div>
                          <div className="text-lg font-bold text-blue-600">{rec.relevanceScore}%</div>
                        </div>
                      </div>
                    </div>
                    <CardDescription className="mt-2">
                      {rec.reasoning}
                    </CardDescription>
                  </CardHeader>
                  <CardContent>
                    <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 gap-4">
                      <div>
                        <h4 className="font-semibold mb-2 flex items-center gap-2">
                          <Clock className="w-4 h-4" />
                          Response Time
                        </h4>
                        <p className="text-sm bg-blue-50 p-2 rounded">{rec.customizations.responseTime}</p>
                      </div>
                      
                      <div>
                        <h4 className="font-semibold mb-2 flex items-center gap-2">
                          <AlertTriangle className="w-4 h-4" />
                          Key Risks
                        </h4>
                        <ul className="text-sm space-y-1">
                          {rec.customizations.keyRisks.map((risk, i) => (
                            <li key={i} className="bg-red-50 p-1 rounded text-xs">• {risk}</li>
                          ))}
                        </ul>
                      </div>
                      
                      <div>
                        <h4 className="font-semibold mb-2 flex items-center gap-2">
                          <CheckCircle className="w-4 h-4" />
                          Action Plan
                        </h4>
                        <ul className="text-sm space-y-1">
                          {rec.customizations.actionPlan.map((action, i) => (
                            <li key={i} className="bg-green-50 p-1 rounded text-xs">• {action}</li>
                          ))}
                        </ul>
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  </CardContent>
                </Card>
              ))}
            </div>
          ) : (
            <Card>
              <CardContent className="text-center py-8">
                <Target className="w-12 h-12 mx-auto text-gray-400 mb-4" />
                <p className="text-gray-500">Complete analysis to see AI-powered scenario recommendations</p>
              </CardContent>
            </Card>
          )}
        </TabsContent>

        <TabsContent value="custom" className="space-y-4">
          <Card>
            <CardHeader>
              <CardTitle className="flex items-center gap-2">
                <Lightbulb className="w-5 h-5" />
                Custom Scenario Generator
              </CardTitle>
              <CardDescription>
                Describe a specific threat or situation you want to prepare for
              </CardDescription>
            </CardHeader>
            <CardContent className="space-y-4">
              <div>
                <Label htmlFor="threat-description">Threat Description</Label>
                <Textarea
                  id="threat-description"
                  value={customThreat}
                  onChange={(e) => setCustomThreat(e.target.value)}
                  placeholder="Describe the specific threat, disruption, or scenario you want to analyze (e.g., 'Key supplier in China announces sudden shutdown', 'Major data breach affecting customer payment data', 'Economic recession causing 30% revenue drop')"
                  rows={4}
                  data-testid="textarea-threat-description"
                />
              </div>
              
              <Button 
                onClick={handleCreateCustomScenario}
                disabled={createCustomScenarioMutation.isPending || !customThreat.trim()}
                data-testid="button-create-custom-scenario"
              >
                {createCustomScenarioMutation.isPending ? (
                  <>
                    <Brain className="w-4 h-4 mr-2 animate-spin" />
                    Creating Custom Scenario...
                  </>
                ) : (
                  <>
                    <Lightbulb className="w-4 h-4 mr-2" />
                    Create Custom Scenario
                  </>
                )}
              </Button>
            </CardContent>
          </Card>

          {customScenario && (
            <Card className="border-l-4 border-l-purple-500">
              <CardHeader>
                <CardTitle className="flex items-center gap-2">
                  <Sparkles className="w-5 h-5 text-purple-500" />
                  {customScenario.title}
                </CardTitle>
                <div className="flex gap-2">
                  <Badge variant="outline">{customScenario.category}</Badge>
                  <Badge variant="outline" className={customScenario.impact === 'Critical' ? 'bg-red-100 text-red-800' : 'bg-orange-100 text-orange-800'}>
                    {customScenario.impact} Impact
                  </Badge>
                </div>
              </CardHeader>
              <CardContent>
                <p className="text-gray-700 dark:text-gray-300 mb-4">{customScenario.description}</p>
                
                <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 gap-4">
                  <div>
                    <h4 className="font-semibold mb-2 flex items-center gap-2">
                      <Clock className="w-4 h-4" />
                      Response Time
                    </h4>
                    <p className="text-sm bg-blue-50 p-2 rounded">{customScenario.responseTime}</p>
                  </div>
                  
                  <div>
                    <h4 className="font-semibold mb-2 flex items-center gap-2">
                      <AlertTriangle className="w-4 h-4" />
                      Key Risks
                    </h4>
                    <ul className="text-sm space-y-1">
                      {customScenario.keyRisks?.map((risk: string, i: number) => (
                        <li key={i} className="bg-red-50 p-1 rounded text-xs">• {risk}</li>
                      ))}
                    </ul>
                  </div>
                  
                  <div>
                    <h4 className="font-semibold mb-2 flex items-center gap-2">
                      <CheckCircle className="w-4 h-4" />
                      Action Plan
                    </h4>
                    <ul className="text-sm space-y-1">
                      {customScenario.actionPlan?.map((action: string, i: number) => (
                        <li key={i} className="bg-green-50 p-1 rounded text-xs">• {action}</li>
                      ))}
                    </ul>
                  </div>
                </div>
              </CardContent>
            </Card>
          )}
        </TabsContent>
      </Tabs>
    </div>
  );
}
```

              {onboardingSteps.map((step, index) => (
                <button
                  key={step.id}
                  onClick={() => skipToStep(index)}
                  className={`w-8 h-8 rounded-full flex items-center justify-center text-xs font-medium transition-all ${
                    index <= currentStep
                      ? 'bg-blue-600 text-white shadow-lg'
                      : index === currentStep + 1
                      ? 'bg-blue-200 text-blue-700'
                      : 'bg-gray-200 text-gray-500'
                  }`}
                >
                  {completedSteps.has(index) ? (
                    <CheckCircle className="w-4 h-4" />
                  ) : (
                    index + 1
                  )}
                </button>
              ))}
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Main Content Card */}
        <AnimatePresence mode="wait">
          <motion.div
            key={currentStep}
            variants={animationVariants}
            initial="initial"
            animate="animate"
            exit="exit"
            transition={{ duration: 0.5, ease: "easeInOut" }}
          >
            <Card className="max-w-4xl mx-auto shadow-2xl border-0 bg-white/90 backdrop-blur-sm">
              <CardHeader className="text-center pb-6">
                <motion.div
                  variants={iconVariants}
                  initial="initial"
                  animate="animate"
                  className={`w-20 h-20 mx-auto mb-6 rounded-full bg-gradient-to-r ${currentStepData.color} flex items-center justify-center shadow-lg`}
                >
                  <div className="w-10 h-10 text-white">{React.createElement(currentStepData.icon)}</div>
                </motion.div>
                
                <CardTitle className="text-3xl font-bold text-gray-900 mb-2">
                  {currentStepData.title}
                </CardTitle>
                <CardDescription className="text-lg text-gray-600 mb-4">
                  {currentStepData.subtitle}
                </CardDescription>
                <p className="text-gray-700 max-w-2xl mx-auto leading-relaxed">
                  {currentStepData.description}
                </p>

                {/* Benefits */}
                {currentStepData.benefits && (
                  <div className="flex flex-wrap justify-center gap-2 mt-4">
                    {currentStepData.benefits.map((benefit, index) => (
                      <Badge key={index} variant="outline" className="bg-blue-50 text-blue-700 border-blue-200">
                        {benefit}
                      </Badge>
                    ))}
                  </div>
                )}
              </CardHeader>

              <CardContent className="pb-8">
                <motion.div
                  initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 20 }}
                  animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0, transition: { delay: 0.3 } }}
                >
                  {renderStepContent()}
                </motion.div>
              </CardContent>
            </Card>
          </motion.div>
        </AnimatePresence>

        {/* Navigation Controls */}
        <div className="max-w-4xl mx-auto mt-8">
          <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
            <Button
              variant="outline"
              onClick={prevStep}
              disabled={currentStep === 0}
              className="flex items-center space-x-2"
            >
              <ArrowRight className="w-4 h-4 rotate-180" />
              <span>Previous</span>
            </Button>

            <div className="flex items-center space-x-4">
              {!isPlaying && currentStep === 0 && (
                <Button
                  onClick={startDemo}
                  className="flex items-center space-x-2 bg-gradient-to-r from-blue-600 to-purple-600 hover:from-blue-700 hover:to-purple-700"
                >
                  <Play className="w-4 h-4" />
                  <span>Start Interactive Tour</span>
                </Button>
              )}

              {currentStep === onboardingSteps.length - 1 ? (
                <Button
                  onClick={completeOnboarding}
                  className="flex items-center space-x-2 bg-gradient-to-r from-green-600 to-blue-600 hover:from-green-700 hover:to-blue-700"
                >
                  <Rocket className="w-4 h-4" />
                  <span>Launch Veridius</span>
                </Button>
              ) : (
                <Button
                  onClick={nextStep}
                  className="flex items-center space-x-2"
                  disabled={currentStepData.interactive && !userJourney.role && currentStep === 1}
                >
                  <span>Continue</span>
                  <ArrowRight className="w-4 h-4" />
                </Button>
              )}
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* Auto-play Control */}
          {currentStep > 0 && currentStep < onboardingSteps.length - 1 && (
            <div className="text-center mt-4">
              <Button
                variant="ghost"
                onClick={() => setIsPlaying(!isPlaying)}
                className="flex items-center space-x-2 text-gray-600"
              >
                {isPlaying ? (
                  <>
                    <Timer className="w-4 h-4" />
                    <span>Auto-advancing...</span>
                  </>
                ) : (
                  <>
                    <Play className="w-4 h-4" />
                    <span>Enable auto-advance</span>
                  </>
                )}
              </Button>
            </div>
          )}
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

export default AnimatedOnboardingFlow;
```

} from 'lucide-react';

interface APIEndpoint {
  id: string;
  method: 'GET' | 'POST' | 'PUT' | 'DELETE' | 'PATCH';
  path: string;
  name: string;
  description: string;
  category: 'scenarios' | 'analytics' | 'collaboration' | 'risk' | 'intelligence' | 'core';
  version: string;
  status: 'active' | 'deprecated' | 'beta' | 'planned';
  authentication: 'api-key' | 'oauth2' | 'jwt' | 'basic';
  rateLimit: {
    requests: number;
    window: string;
    burst?: number;
  };
  parameters: {
    name: string;
    type: string;
    required: boolean;
    description: string;
    example?: any;
  }[];
  responses: {
    code: number;
    description: string;
    schema?: any;
  }[];
  examples: {
    request: any;
    response: any;
  };
  usage: {
    totalCalls: number;
    uniqueUsers: number;
    errorRate: number;
    avgResponseTime: number;
  };
}

interface SDKLanguage {
  id: string;
  name: string;
  version: string;
  status: 'stable' | 'beta' | 'alpha';
  downloads: number;
  documentation: string;
  examples: string[];
  features: string[];
  lastUpdated: Date;
}

interface WebhookEvent {
  id: string;
  name: string;
  description: string;
  category: 'strategic' | 'risk' | 'collaboration' | 'system';
  payload: any;
  frequency: string;
  subscribers: number;
  isActive: boolean;
}

interface DeveloperPortalUser {
  id: string;
  name: string;
  email: string;
  organization: string;
  apiKey: string;
  permissions: string[];
  usage: {
    totalRequests: number;
    monthlyRequests: number;
    rateLimitHits: number;
    lastActive: Date;
  };
  applications: {
    name: string;
    description: string;
    environment: 'development' | 'staging' | 'production';
    status: 'active' | 'suspended';
  }[];
}

    switch (status) {
      case 'active': return 'bg-green-100 text-green-800';
      case 'deprecated': return 'bg-red-100 text-red-800';
      case 'beta': return 'bg-blue-100 text-blue-800';
      case 'planned': return 'bg-gray-100 text-gray-800';
      case 'stable': return 'bg-green-100 text-green-800';
      case 'alpha': return 'bg-orange-100 text-orange-800';
      default: return 'bg-gray-100 text-gray-800';
    }
  };

  const getMethodColor = (method: string) => {
    switch (method) {
      case 'GET': return 'bg-green-100 text-green-800';
      case 'POST': return 'bg-blue-100 text-blue-800';
      case 'PUT': return 'bg-yellow-100 text-yellow-800';
      case 'PATCH': return 'bg-orange-100 text-orange-800';

                              <div>
                                <div className="font-medium text-blue-800">Rate Limit</div>

                                  {selectedEndpointData.rateLimit.requests} requests / {selectedEndpointData.rateLimit.window}
                                </div>
                              </div>
                              {selectedEndpointData.rateLimit.burst && (
                                <div>
                                  <div className="font-medium text-blue-800">Burst Limit</div>

                              )}
                            </div>
                          </div>

                      </TabsContent>

                      <TabsContent value="responses" className="space-y-4">
                        <h4 className="font-semibold text-gray-900">Response Codes</h4>
                        <div className="space-y-3">
                          {selectedEndpointData.responses.map((response, index) => (
                            <div key={index} className="p-3 border rounded-lg">
                              <div className="flex items-center gap-2 mb-2">
                                <Badge className={response.code < 400 ? 'bg-green-100 text-green-800' : 'bg-red-100 text-red-800'}>
                                  {response.code}
                                </Badge>
                                <span className="font-medium text-gray-900">{response.description}</span>
                              </div>
                              {response.schema && (
                                <pre className="text-xs bg-gray-100 p-2 rounded mt-2 overflow-x-auto">
                                  {JSON.stringify(response.schema, null, 2)}
                                </pre>
                              )}
                            </div>
                          ))}
                        </div>
                      </TabsContent>

                      <TabsContent value="examples" className="space-y-4">

import React, { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import { Card, CardContent, CardHeader, CardTitle } from '@/components/ui/card';
import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button';
import { Progress } from '@/components/ui/progress';
import { 
  Brain, 
  CheckCircle, 
  Clock,
  Loader2,
  Sparkles,
  FileText,
  Users,
  Calendar,
  TrendingUp
} from 'lucide-react';

interface AuthenticWorkflowProps {
  formData: {
    organization: string;
    industry: string;
    challenge: string;
    urgency: string;
    impact: string;
  };
  onComplete: () => void;
}

const AuthenticWorkflow: React.FC<AuthenticWorkflowProps> = ({ formData, onComplete }) => {
  const [currentPhase, setCurrentPhase] = useState(0);
  const [progress, setProgress] = useState(0);
  const [isProcessing, setIsProcessing] = useState(true);

  const phases = [
    {
      name: "Analyzing Your Challenge",
      description: "Processing industry context and threat vectors",
      duration: 15000,
      icon: Brain
    },
    {
      name: "Generating Strategic Options",
      description: "Creating customized response scenarios",
      duration: 20000,
      icon: Sparkles
    },
    {
      name: "Building Implementation Plan",
      description: "Developing timeline and resource allocation",
      duration: 10000,
      icon: Calendar
    },
    {
      name: "Finalizing Your Strategy",
      description: "Compiling executive-ready deliverables",
      duration: 8000,
      icon: FileText
    }
  ];

  useEffect(() => {
    const totalDuration = phases.reduce((sum, phase) => sum + phase.duration, 0);
    let elapsed = 0;

    const interval = setInterval(() => {
      elapsed += 200;
      const newProgress = Math.min((elapsed / totalDuration) * 100, 100);
      setProgress(newProgress);

      // Update current phase
      let cumulativeDuration = 0;
      for (let i = 0; i < phases.length; i++) {
        cumulativeDuration += phases[i].duration;
        if (elapsed <= cumulativeDuration) {
          setCurrentPhase(i);
          break;
        }
      }

      if (elapsed >= totalDuration) {
        setIsProcessing(false);
        setTimeout(onComplete, 1000);
        clearInterval(interval);
      }
    }, 200);

    return () => clearInterval(interval);
  }, [onComplete]);

  const currentPhaseInfo = phases[currentPhase];

  const insights = [
    `Analyzing ${formData.industry} market dynamics and competitive landscape`,
    `Processing ${formData.challenge} against 500+ similar scenarios in our database`,
    `Identifying key stakeholders and impact vectors for ${formData.organization}`,
    `Generating response strategies based on ${formData.urgency} urgency level`,
    `Cross-referencing with successful implementations in ${formData.industry} sector`,
    `Building customized action plans for ${formData.impact} impact scenarios`
  ];

  return (
    <div className="max-w-4xl mx-auto space-y-8">
      {/* Header */}
      <div className="text-center space-y-4">
        <h2 className="text-3xl font-bold">Generating Your Strategic Response</h2>
        <p className="text-lg text-muted-foreground">
          Our AI is analyzing your specific situation and creating a customized strategy
        </p>
      </div>

      {/* Progress Section */}
      <Card className="bg-gradient-to-r from-blue-50 to-purple-50 border-blue-200">
        <CardContent className="p-8">
          <div className="space-y-6">
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
              <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
                <div className="w-12 h-12 bg-blue-600 rounded-full flex items-center justify-center">
                  {isProcessing ? (
                    <Loader2 className="h-6 w-6 text-white animate-spin" />
                  ) : (
                    <CheckCircle className="h-6 w-6 text-white" />
                  )}
                </div>
                <div>
                  <h3 className="text-xl font-semibold">{currentPhaseInfo.name}</h3>
                  <p className="text-muted-foreground">{currentPhaseInfo.description}</p>
                </div>
              </div>
              <div className="text-right">
                <div className="text-2xl font-bold text-blue-600">
                  {Math.round(progress)}%
                </div>
                <div className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">Complete</div>
              </div>
            </div>

            <Progress value={progress} className="h-3" />

            {/* Phase Timeline */}
            <div className="grid grid-cols-4 gap-4 mt-6">
              {phases.map((phase, index) => (
                <div key={index} className={`text-center p-3 rounded-lg transition-all ${
                  index === currentPhase 
                    ? 'bg-blue-100 border-2 border-blue-300' 
                    : index < currentPhase 
                    ? 'bg-green-100 border border-green-300' 
                    : 'bg-gray-100 border border-gray-200'
                }`}>
                  <phase.icon className={`h-6 w-6 mx-auto mb-2 ${
                    index === currentPhase 
                      ? 'text-blue-600' 
                      : index < currentPhase 
                      ? 'text-green-600' 
                      : 'text-gray-400'
                  }`} />
                  <div className="text-sm font-medium">{phase.name}</div>
                </div>
              ))}
            </div>
          </div>
        </CardContent>
      </Card>

      {/* Real-time Insights */}
      <Card>
        <CardHeader>
          <CardTitle className="flex items-center gap-3">
            <Brain className="h-6 w-6 text-purple-600" />
            AI Processing Insights
          </CardTitle>
        </CardHeader>
        <CardContent>
          <div className="space-y-3">
            {insights.map((insight, index) => (
              <div key={index} className={`flex items-center gap-3 p-3 rounded-lg transition-all ${
                index <= Math.floor((progress / 100) * insights.length)
                  ? 'bg-green-50 border border-green-200'
                  : 'bg-gray-50 border border-gray-200'
              }`}>
                {index <= Math.floor((progress / 100) * insights.length) ? (
                  <CheckCircle className="h-5 w-5 text-green-600 flex-shrink-0" />
                ) : (
                  <Clock className="h-5 w-5 text-gray-400 flex-shrink-0" />
                )}
                <span className={`text-sm ${
                  index <= Math.floor((progress / 100) * insights.length)
                    ? 'text-green-800'
                    : 'text-gray-600'
                }`}>
                  {insight}
                </span>
              </div>
            ))}
          </div>
        </CardContent>
      </Card>

      {/* Processing Stats */}
      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 gap-4">
        <Card className="text-center p-6">
          <div className="text-3xl font-bold text-blue-600 mb-2">
            {Math.floor(Math.random() * 50) + 450}
          </div>
          <div className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">Similar scenarios analyzed</div>
        </Card>
        
        <Card className="text-center p-6">
          <div className="text-3xl font-bold text-green-600 mb-2">
            {Math.floor(Math.random() * 20) + 85}%
          </div>
          <div className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">Strategy confidence level</div>
        </Card>
        
        <Card className="text-center p-6">
          <div className="text-3xl font-bold text-purple-600 mb-2">
            {Math.floor(Math.random() * 30) + 12}
          </div>
          <div className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">Strategic options generated</div>
        </Card>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

export default AuthenticWorkflow;
```

        <TabsContent value="requirements" className="space-y-4">

            {requirements.map((requirement) => (
              <Card key={requirement.id} className="border-l-4 border-l-orange-500">
                <CardContent className="p-6">
                  <div className="flex items-start justify-between mb-4">
                    <div>
                      <h3 className="text-lg font-semibold text-gray-900">{requirement.title}</h3>

                      <div className="flex items-center gap-2 mt-2">
                        <Badge variant="outline">{requirement.category}</Badge>
                        <Badge className={getCriticalityColor(requirement.priority)}>
                          {requirement.priority}
                        </Badge>
                        <Badge className={getStatusColor(requirement.status)}>
                          {requirement.status}
                        </Badge>
                      </div>
                    </div>
                    <div className="text-right">
                      <div className="text-sm text-gray-500">Framework</div>
                      <div className="font-medium">
                        {frameworks.find(f => f.id === requirement.frameworkId)?.name}
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  </div>

                  <div className="grid md:grid-cols-2 gap-6 mb-4">
                    <div>
                      <h4 className="font-medium text-gray-900 mb-2">Assessment Details</h4>
                      <div className="space-y-2 text-sm">
                        <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                          <span className="text-gray-600">Responsible Department:</span>
                          <span className="font-medium">{requirement.responsibleDepartment}</span>
                        </div>
                        <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                          <span className="text-gray-600">Estimated Effort:</span>
                          <span className="font-medium">{requirement.estimatedEffort}</span>
                        </div>
                        <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                          <span className="text-gray-600">Automation Level:</span>
                          <Badge variant="outline" className="text-xs capitalize">
                            {requirement.automationLevel.replace('-', ' ')}
                          </Badge>
                        </div>
                      </div>
                    </div>

                    <div>
                      <h4 className="font-medium text-gray-900 mb-2">Schedule</h4>
                      <div className="space-y-2 text-sm">
                        <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                          <span className="text-gray-600">Last Checked:</span>
                          <span className="font-medium">{requirement.lastChecked.toLocaleDateString()}</span>
                        </div>
                        <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                          <span className="text-gray-600">Next Check:</span>
                          <span className="font-medium">{requirement.nextCheck.toLocaleDateString()}</span>
                        </div>
                        <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                          <span className="text-gray-600">Business Impact:</span>
                          <span className="text-xs text-gray-500">{requirement.businessImpact}</span>
                        </div>
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  </div>

                  {requirement.evidence.length > 0 && (

                  <div className="flex gap-2">

                      <div>

                              {framework.name}
                            </Badge>

                        })}
                      </div>

                      {alert.actionRequired && (
                        <Button size="sm" className="bg-red-600 hover:bg-red-700">

                      )}

                        <BookOpen className="h-4 w-4 mr-2" />
                        View Details
                      </Button>
                      <Button size="sm" variant="outline">
                        <Calendar className="h-4 w-4 mr-2" />
                        Set Reminder
                      </Button>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                ))}
              </div>
            </CardContent>
          </Card>
        </TabsContent>
      </Tabs>
    </div>
  );
};

import React from 'react';
import { Card, CardContent, CardHeader, CardTitle } from '@/components/ui/card';
import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button';
import { Badge } from '@/components/ui/badge';
import { Progress } from '@/components/ui/progress';
import { Tabs, TabsContent, TabsList, TabsTrigger } from '@/components/ui/tabs';
import { 
  Zap, 
  Users, 
  Calendar, 
  CheckCircle, 
  AlertTriangle,
  Brain,
  Play,
  Target,
  FileText
} from 'lucide-react';
import { usePlaybooks } from '@/hooks/usePlaybooks';
import { getPriorityColor, getStatusColor, getAvailabilityColor } from '@/utils/helpers';

// Types are now imported from @/types

export default function AutomatedPlaybooks() {
  const {
    playbooks,
    currentPlaybook,
    loading,
    error,
    generating,
    selectPlaybook,
    generatePlaybook
  } = usePlaybooks();

  if (loading) {
    return (
      <div className="space-y-6">
        <div className="animate-pulse">
          <div className="h-8 bg-muted rounded w-1/3 mb-4"></div>
          <div className="h-32 bg-muted rounded"></div>
        </div>
      </div>
    );
  }

  if (error) {
    return (
      <Card className="executive-card">
        <CardContent className="p-6">
          <div className="text-center text-red-600">
            <p>Error loading playbooks: {error}</p>
          </div>
        </CardContent>
      </Card>
    );
  }

  if (!currentPlaybook) {
    return (
      <Card className="executive-card">
        <CardContent className="p-6">
          <div className="text-center text-muted-foreground">
            <p>No playbooks available</p>
          </div>
        </CardContent>
      </Card>
    );
  }

  const handleGeneratePlaybook = () => generatePlaybook();

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6">
      {/* Header */}
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
        <div>
          <h2 className="text-2xl font-bold text-foreground flex items-center gap-3">
            <Play className="w-8 h-8 text-purple-500" />
            Automated Response Playbooks
          </h2>
          <p className="text-muted-foreground mt-1">
            AI-generated execution plans with pre-filled teams and timelines
          </p>
        </div>
        
        <Button
          onClick={handleGeneratePlaybook}
          disabled={generating}
          className="bg-gradient-to-r from-purple-600 to-purple-500 hover:from-purple-700 hover:to-purple-600"
        >
          {generating ? (
            <>
              <Brain className="w-4 h-4 mr-2 animate-spin" />
              AI Generating...
            </>
          ) : (
            <>
              <Zap className="w-4 h-4 mr-2" />
              Generate New Playbook
            </>
          )}
        </Button>
      </div>

      {/* Playbook Selection */}
      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 gap-4">
        {playbooks.map((playbook) => (
          <Card
            key={playbook.id}
            className={`cursor-pointer transition-all duration-300 ${
              currentPlaybook.id === playbook.id 
                ? 'ring-2 ring-primary executive-shadow scale-102' 
                : 'hover:shadow-md executive-hover'
            }`}
            onClick={() => selectPlaybook(playbook.id)}
          >
            <CardHeader className="pb-3">
              <div className="flex items-start justify-between">
                <div className="flex-1">
                  <CardTitle className="text-lg">{playbook.title}</CardTitle>
                  <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground mt-1">
                    {playbook.description}
                  </p>
                </div>
                <Badge 
                  variant="outline" 
                  className={`ml-3 ${getStatusColor(playbook.status)}`}
                >
                  {playbook.status.toUpperCase()}
                </Badge>
              </div>
            </CardHeader>
            <CardContent>
              <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                <div className="flex items-center gap-4 text-sm text-muted-foreground">
                  <div className="flex items-center gap-1">
                    <div className={`w-2 h-2 rounded-full ${getPriorityColor(playbook.priority)}`} />
                    <span className="capitalize">{playbook.priority}</span>
                  </div>
                  <div className="flex items-center gap-1">
                    <span>{playbook.estimatedDuration}</span>
                  </div>
                </div>
                <div className="text-right">
                  <div className="text-sm font-bold text-foreground">{playbook.progress}%</div>
                  <Progress value={playbook.progress} className="w-20 h-1 mt-1" />
                </div>
              </div>
            </CardContent>
          </Card>
        ))}
      </div>

      {/* Active Playbook Details */}
      <Tabs defaultValue="overview" className="space-y-6">
        <TabsList className="grid w-full grid-cols-4">
          <TabsTrigger value="overview">Overview</TabsTrigger>
          <TabsTrigger value="team">Team</TabsTrigger>
          <TabsTrigger value="timeline">Timeline</TabsTrigger>
          <TabsTrigger value="actions">Actions</TabsTrigger>
        </TabsList>

        <TabsContent value="overview" className="space-y-6">
          <Card className="executive-card">
            <CardHeader>
              <CardTitle className="flex items-center justify-between">
                <span>{currentPlaybook.title}</span>
                <Badge variant="outline" className={getStatusColor(currentPlaybook.status)}>
                  {currentPlaybook.status.toUpperCase()}
                </Badge>
              </CardTitle>
              <p className="text-muted-foreground">{currentPlaybook.description}</p>
            </CardHeader>
            <CardContent className="space-y-4">
              <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-4">
                <div className="p-3 bg-muted/30 rounded-xl">
                  <div className="text-2xl font-bold text-foreground">
                    {currentPlaybook.confidence}%
                  </div>
                  <div className="text-xs text-muted-foreground uppercase tracking-wide">
                    AI Confidence
                  </div>
                </div>
                <div className="p-3 bg-primary/10 rounded-xl">
                  <div className="text-2xl font-bold text-primary">
                    {currentPlaybook.progress}%
                  </div>
                  <div className="text-xs text-muted-foreground uppercase tracking-wide">
                    Completion
                  </div>
                </div>
              </div>

              <div className="space-y-2">
                <div className="flex items-center justify-between text-sm">
                  <span className="text-muted-foreground">Overall Progress</span>
                  <span className="font-bold">{currentPlaybook.progress}%</span>
                </div>
                <Progress value={currentPlaybook.progress} className="h-3" />
              </div>
            </CardContent>
          </Card>
        </TabsContent>

        <TabsContent value="team" className="space-y-6">
          <Card className="executive-card">
            <CardHeader>
              <CardTitle>Team Assignments</CardTitle>
            </CardHeader>
            <CardContent>
              <p className="text-muted-foreground">Team member details will be loaded from API</p>
            </CardContent>
          </Card>
        </TabsContent>

        <TabsContent value="timeline" className="space-y-6">
          <Card className="executive-card">
            <CardHeader>
              <CardTitle>Execution Timeline</CardTitle>
            </CardHeader>
            <CardContent>
              <p className="text-muted-foreground">Timeline details will be loaded from API</p>
            </CardContent>
          </Card>
        </TabsContent>

        <TabsContent value="actions" className="space-y-6">
          <Card className="executive-card">
            <CardHeader>
              <CardTitle>Key Actions</CardTitle>
            </CardHeader>
            <CardContent>
              <p className="text-muted-foreground">Action details will be loaded from API</p>
            </CardContent>
          </Card>
        </TabsContent>
      </Tabs>
    </div>
  );
}

}

    let interval: NodeJS.Timeout;
    
    if (isRunning && currentStep < demoSteps.length) {
      interval = setInterval(() => {
        setCurrentTime(prev => {
          const newTime = prev + 1;
          const currentStepDuration = demoSteps[currentStep].duration;
          const progress = Math.min((newTime / currentStepDuration) * 100, 100);
          setStepProgress(progress);
          
          if (newTime >= currentStepDuration) {
            // Mark current step as completed and move to next
            setCurrentStep(prev => Math.min(prev + 1, demoSteps.length - 1));
            setCurrentTime(0);
            setStepProgress(0);
            
            if (currentStep >= demoSteps.length - 1) {
              setIsRunning(false);
            }
          }
          
          return newTime;
        });
      }, 1000);
    }
    
    return () => {
      if (interval) clearInterval(interval);
    };
  }, [isRunning, currentStep, demoSteps.length]);

    if (index < currentStep) return 'completed';

      hoursPerWeek: 40,
      currentCapacity: 'optimal',
      skills: ['Strategy', 'Analytics', 'User Research'],
      currentProjects: [
        { id: 'p1', name: 'Platform Upgrade', allocation: 80 }
      ]
    },
    {
      id: '3',
      name: 'Emily Rodriguez',
      role: 'Designer',
      department: 'Design',
      hoursPerWeek: 40,
      currentCapacity: 'under-utilized',
      skills: ['UI/UX', 'Figma', 'Prototyping'],
      currentProjects: [
        { id: 'p3', name: 'Design System', allocation: 60 }
      ]
    },
    {
      id: '4',
      name: 'David Park',
      role: 'DevOps Engineer',
      department: 'Engineering',
      hoursPerWeek: 40,
      currentCapacity: 'at-capacity',
      skills: ['Docker', 'Kubernetes', 'CI/CD'],
      currentProjects: [
        { id: 'p1', name: 'Platform Upgrade', allocation: 40 },
        { id: 'p4', name: 'Infrastructure', allocation: 60 }
      ]
    },
    {
      id: '5',
      name: 'Lisa Wang',
      role: 'Data Analyst',
      department: 'Analytics',
      hoursPerWeek: 40,
      currentCapacity: 'optimal',
      skills: ['SQL', 'Python', 'Tableau'],
      currentProjects: [
        { id: 'p5', name: 'Data Pipeline', allocation: 70 }
      ]
    }
  ];

  const capacityData: CapacityData[] = teamMembers.map(member => {
    const totalAllocation = member.currentProjects.reduce((sum, project) => sum + project.allocation, 0);
    const plannedHours = (totalAllocation / 100) * member.hoursPerWeek;
    const utilization = totalAllocation;
    
    return {
      weekOf: selectedWeek.toISOString().split('T')[0],
      teamMember: member,
      plannedHours,
      actualHours: plannedHours * (0.8 + Math.random() * 0.4), // Simulate variance
      utilization,
      status: utilization > 110 ? 'critical' : utilization > 90 ? 'warning' : 'optimal'
    };
  });

  const departments = ['all', ...Array.from(new Set(teamMembers.map(m => m.department)))];

  const filteredData = useMemo(() => {
    return capacityData.filter(data => 
      filterDepartment === 'all' || data.teamMember.department === filterDepartment
    );
  }, [capacityData, filterDepartment]);

  const teamStats = useMemo(() => {
    const total = filteredData.length;
    const overExtended = filteredData.filter(d => d.status === 'critical').length;
    const atRisk = filteredData.filter(d => d.status === 'warning').length;
    const optimal = filteredData.filter(d => d.status === 'optimal').length;
    const avgUtilization = filteredData.reduce((sum, d) => sum + d.utilization, 0) / total;

    return { total, overExtended, atRisk, optimal, avgUtilization };
  }, [filteredData]);

  const getCapacityColor = (capacity: string) => {
    switch (capacity) {
      case 'under-utilized': return 'bg-blue-100 text-blue-800';
      case 'optimal': return 'bg-green-100 text-green-800';
      case 'at-capacity': return 'bg-yellow-100 text-yellow-800';
      case 'over-extended': return 'bg-orange-100 text-orange-800';
      case 'critical': return 'bg-red-100 text-red-800';
      default: return 'bg-gray-100 text-gray-800';
    }
  };

  const getStatusColor = (status: string) => {
    switch (status) {
      case 'optimal': return 'bg-green-100 text-green-800';
      case 'warning': return 'bg-yellow-100 text-yellow-800';
      case 'critical': return 'bg-red-100 text-red-800';
      default: return 'bg-gray-100 text-gray-800';
    }
  };

  const getUtilizationColor = (utilization: number) => {
    if (utilization > 110) return 'text-red-600';
    if (utilization > 90) return 'text-yellow-600';
    if (utilization < 70) return 'text-blue-600';
    return 'text-green-600';
  };

  return (
    <div className="min-h-screen bg-gradient-to-br from-emerald-50 via-white to-teal-50 p-6">
      <div className="max-w-7xl mx-auto">
        {/* Header */}
        <div className="mb-8">
          <h1 className="text-4xl font-bold text-gray-900 mb-2">
            Capacity Planning Center
          </h1>
          <p className="text-lg text-gray-600">
            Optimize resource allocation and prevent team burnout with intelligent capacity management
          </p>
        </div>

        {/* Stats Overview */}
        <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-4 gap-6 mb-8">
          <Card className="bg-white/70 backdrop-blur-sm border-0 shadow-lg">
            <CardContent className="p-6">
              <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                <div>
                  <p className="text-sm font-medium text-gray-600">Team Members</p>
                  <p className="text-2xl font-bold text-gray-900">{teamStats.total}</p>
                </div>
                <Users className="w-8 h-8 text-blue-600" />
              </div>
            </CardContent>
          </Card>

          <Card className="bg-white/70 backdrop-blur-sm border-0 shadow-lg">
            <CardContent className="p-6">
              <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                <div>
                  <p className="text-sm font-medium text-gray-600">Avg Utilization</p>
                  <p className={`text-2xl font-bold ${getUtilizationColor(teamStats.avgUtilization)}`}>
                    {teamStats.avgUtilization.toFixed(0)}%
                  </p>
                </div>
                <BarChart3 className="w-8 h-8 text-green-600" />
              </div>
            </CardContent>
          </Card>

          <Card className="bg-white/70 backdrop-blur-sm border-0 shadow-lg">
            <CardContent className="p-6">
              <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                <div>
                  <p className="text-sm font-medium text-gray-600">At Risk</p>
                  <p className="text-2xl font-bold text-yellow-600">{teamStats.atRisk + teamStats.overExtended}</p>
                </div>
                <AlertTriangle className="w-8 h-8 text-yellow-600" />
              </div>
            </CardContent>
          </Card>

          <Card className="bg-white/70 backdrop-blur-sm border-0 shadow-lg">
            <CardContent className="p-6">
              <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                <div>
                  <p className="text-sm font-medium text-gray-600">Optimal</p>
                  <p className="text-2xl font-bold text-green-600">{teamStats.optimal}</p>
                </div>
                <CheckCircle className="w-8 h-8 text-green-600" />
              </div>
            </CardContent>
          </Card>
        </div>

        {/* Controls */}
        <Card className="mb-8 bg-white/80 backdrop-blur-sm border-0 shadow-lg">
          <CardContent className="p-6">
            <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-4">
              <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                <CalendarIcon className="w-5 h-5 text-gray-600" />
                <Label>Week of:</Label>
                <Input 
                  type="date" 
                  value={selectedWeek.toISOString().split('T')[0]}
                  onChange={(e) => setSelectedWeek(new Date(e.target.value))}
                  className="w-40"
                />
              </div>
              
              <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                <Label>View:</Label>

                  </SelectTrigger>
                  <SelectContent>
                    <SelectItem value="team">Team View</SelectItem>
                    <SelectItem value="individual">Individual</SelectItem>
                    <SelectItem value="project">By Project</SelectItem>
                  </SelectContent>
                </Select>
              </div>

              <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                <Label>Department:</Label>
                <Select value={filterDepartment} onValueChange={setFilterDepartment}>
                  <SelectTrigger className="w-40">
                    <SelectValue />
                  </SelectTrigger>
                  <SelectContent>
                    {departments.map(dept => (
                      <SelectItem key={dept} value={dept}>
                        {dept === 'all' ? 'All Departments' : dept}
                      </SelectItem>
                    ))}
                  </SelectContent>
                </Select>
              </div>
            </div>
          </CardContent>
        </Card>

export default CapacityPlanningCenter;
