```
    switch (status) {
      case 'completed': return 'bg-green-100 text-green-800';
      case 'in-progress': return 'bg-blue-100 text-blue-800';
      case 'planning': return 'bg-purple-100 text-purple-800';
      case 'stalled': return 'bg-red-100 text-red-800';
      case 'delayed': return 'bg-orange-100 text-orange-800';
      case 'pending': return 'bg-gray-100 text-gray-800';
      default: return 'bg-gray-100 text-gray-800';
    }
  };

  const getResistanceColor = (level: string) => {
    switch (level) {
      case 'low': return 'bg-green-100 text-green-800';
      case 'medium': return 'bg-yellow-100 text-yellow-800';
      case 'high': return 'bg-orange-100 text-orange-800';
      case 'critical': return 'bg-red-100 text-red-800';
      default: return 'bg-gray-100 text-gray-800';
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6">
      {/* Change Management Header */}
      <Card className="border-2 border-orange-200 shadow-xl">
        <CardHeader className="bg-gradient-to-r from-orange-50 to-red-50 border-b border-orange-200">
          <CardTitle className="text-2xl text-orange-900 flex items-center gap-2">
            <Zap className="h-6 w-6" />
            Change Management Accelerator
          </CardTitle>
          <CardDescription>
            Transform organizational culture and accelerate technology adoption
          </CardDescription>
          
          {/* Change Management Dashboard */}
          <div className="grid grid-cols-2 md:grid-cols-4 gap-4 mt-4">
            <div className="text-center p-3 bg-white rounded-lg border">
              <div className={`text-2xl font-bold ${getReadinessColor(readinessAssessment.overall)}`}>
                {readinessAssessment.overall}%
              </div>
              <div className="text-xs text-gray-600">Org Readiness</div>
            </div>
            <div className="text-center p-3 bg-white rounded-lg border">
              <div className="text-2xl font-bold text-blue-600">
                {activeInitiatives.filter(i => i.status === 'in-progress').length}
              </div>
              <div className="text-xs text-gray-600">Active Initiatives</div>
            </div>
            <div className="text-center p-3 bg-white rounded-lg border">
              <div className="text-2xl font-bold text-orange-600">
                {resistancePatterns.filter(r => r.level === 'high' || r.level === 'critical').length}
              </div>
              <div className="text-xs text-gray-600">High Risk Areas</div>
            </div>
            <div className="text-center p-3 bg-white rounded-lg border">
              <div className="text-2xl font-bold text-green-600">
                {activeInitiatives.reduce((acc, init) => acc + init.affectedEmployees, 0)}
              </div>
              <div className="text-xs text-gray-600">Employees Impacted</div>
            </div>
          </div>
        </CardHeader>
      </Card>

      <Tabs defaultValue="readiness" className="w-full">
        <TabsList className="grid w-full grid-cols-4">
          <TabsTrigger value="readiness">Readiness Assessment</TabsTrigger>
          <TabsTrigger value="initiatives">Change Initiatives</TabsTrigger>
          <TabsTrigger value="resistance">Resistance Analysis</TabsTrigger>
          <TabsTrigger value="acceleration">Acceleration Tools</TabsTrigger>
        </TabsList>

        <TabsContent value="readiness" className="space-y-6">

                Comprehensive evaluation of your organization's readiness for change

                  </div>

                        {score}%
                      </span>
                    </div>

                    {/* Dimension-specific insights */}

                      {dimension === 'capabilities' && score < 75 && "Capability gaps need addressing"}
                      {dimension === 'resources' && score >= 75 && "Sufficient resources allocated"}
                      {dimension === 'resources' && score < 75 && "Resource constraints identified"}
                      {dimension === 'communication' && score >= 70 && "Communication channels effective"}

                      {dimension === 'resistance' && score >= 70 && "Low resistance expected"}
                      {dimension === 'resistance' && score < 70 && "Significant resistance anticipated"}

              </div>
```

## FILE: client/src/components/ChartCard.tsx
```
import { useEffect, useRef } from 'react';
import { Card } from '@/components/ui/card';
import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button';
import Chart from 'chart.js/auto';

interface ChartCardProps {
  title: string;
  subtitle?: string;
  chartType: 'line' | 'doughnut' | 'bar';
  data: any;
  options?: any;
  controls?: {
    periods: string[];
    activePeriod: string;
    onPeriodChange: (period: string) => void;
  };
  isLive?: boolean;
}

export default function ChartCard({ 
  title, 
  subtitle, 
  chartType, 
  data, 
  options = {},
  controls,
  isLive = false 
}: ChartCardProps) {
  const canvasRef = useRef<HTMLCanvasElement>(null);
  const chartRef = useRef<Chart | null>(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!canvasRef.current) return;

    // Destroy existing chart
    if (chartRef.current) {
      chartRef.current.destroy();
    }

    // Create new chart
    chartRef.current = new Chart(canvasRef.current, {
      type: chartType,
      data,
      options: {
        responsive: true,
        maintainAspectRatio: false,
        plugins: {
          legend: {
            display: chartType === 'doughnut',
            position: 'bottom' as const,
            labels: {
              color: '#6b7280',
              padding: 20,
            },
          },
        },
        scales: chartType !== 'doughnut' ? {
          y: {
            beginAtZero: true,
            grid: {
              color: 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1)',
            },
            ticks: {
              color: '#6b7280',
            },
          },
          x: {
            grid: {
              color: 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1)',
            },
            ticks: {
              color: '#6b7280',
            },
          },
        } : undefined,
        ...options,
      },
    });

    return () => {
      if (chartRef.current) {
        chartRef.current.destroy();
      }
    };
  }, [chartType, data, options]);

  return (
    <Card className="bg-white/15 backdrop-blur-xl border border-white/20 rounded-3xl p-8 shadow-xl transition-all duration-500 hover:shadow-2xl hover:bg-white/20 relative overflow-hidden">
      {/* Gradient top border */}
      <div className="absolute top-0 left-0 right-0 h-1 bg-gradient-to-r from-primary via-green-600 to-amber-600" />
      
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-6">
        <div>
          <h3 className="text-xl font-bold bg-gradient-to-r from-gray-900 to-primary bg-clip-text text-transparent">
            {title}
          </h3>
          {subtitle && (
            <p className="text-sm text-gray-600 mt-1">{subtitle}</p>
          )}
        </div>
        
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
          {isLive && (
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2 mr-4">
              <div className="w-3 h-3 bg-green-600 rounded-full animate-pulse" />
              <span className="text-xs text-gray-600 font-semibold">Live</span>
            </div>
          )}
          
          {controls && (
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
              {controls.periods.map((period) => (
                <Button
                  key={period}
                  variant={controls.activePeriod === period ? "default" : "outline"}
                  size="sm"
                  onClick={() => controls.onPeriodChange(period)}
                  className={
                    controls.activePeriod === period
                      ? "bg-primary text-white"
                      : "bg-white/15 backdrop-blur-xl border-white/20 hover:bg-white/30"
                  }
                >
                  {period}
                </Button>
              ))}
            </div>
          )}
        </div>
      </div>
      
      <div className="relative h-80">
        <canvas ref={canvasRef} />
      </div>
    </Card>
  );
}
```

```
    <div className="min-h-screen bg-gradient-to-br from-blue-50 to-purple-50 p-6">
      <div className="max-w-7xl mx-auto">
        {/* Header */}
        <div className="mb-8 text-center">
          <h1 className="text-4xl font-bold text-gray-900 mb-2">Collaboration Hub</h1>
          <p className="text-gray-600 max-w-2xl mx-auto">
            Real-time team coordination, decision tracking, and crisis communication for distributed organizations.
          </p>
        </div>

        {/* Tab Navigation */}
        <div className="flex justify-center mb-8">
          <div className="bg-white rounded-lg p-1 shadow-md">
            {[
              { id: 'overview', name: 'Team Overview', icon: Users },
              { id: 'messages', name: 'Communications', icon: MessageCircle },
              { id: 'decisions', name: 'Decision Tracker', icon: CheckCircle }
            ].map((tab) => (
              <button
                key={tab.id}
                onClick={() => setActiveTab(tab.id)}
                className={`flex items-center space-x-2 px-6 py-3 rounded-lg transition-all ${
                  activeTab === tab.id
                    ? 'bg-blue-600 text-white shadow-lg'
                    : 'text-gray-600 hover:bg-gray-100'
                }`}
              >
                <tab.icon className="w-5 h-5" />
                <span className="font-medium">{tab.name}</span>
              </button>
            ))}
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Tab Content */}
        <div className="min-h-96">
          {activeTab === 'overview' && renderOverview()}
          {activeTab === 'messages' && renderMessages()}
          {activeTab === 'decisions' && renderDecisionTracker()}
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

export default CollaborationHub;
```

## FILE: client/src/components/collaboration/RealTimeCollaborationHub.tsx
```
import React, { useState, useEffect, useRef } from 'react';
import { Card, CardContent, CardHeader, CardTitle } from '@/components/ui/card';
import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button';
import { Input } from '@/components/ui/input';
import { Badge } from '@/components/ui/badge';
import { Avatar, AvatarFallback, AvatarImage } from '@/components/ui/avatar';
import { Tabs, TabsContent, TabsList, TabsTrigger } from '@/components/ui/tabs';
import { Users, MessageSquare, Video, Share2, Edit3, Eye, Crown } from 'lucide-react';
import { VeridiusCard, VeridiusButton } from '@/components/ui/veridius-components';

interface Participant {
  id: string;
  userId: string;
  name: string;
  email: string;
  role: 'owner' | 'editor' | 'viewer';
  status: 'active' | 'idle' | 'away';
  avatar?: string;
  joinedAt: Date;
  lastSeen: Date;
}

interface CollaborationSession {
  id: string;
  type: 'document' | 'scenario_planning' | 'meeting' | 'crisis_response';
  participants: Participant[];
  permissions: {
    canEdit: boolean;
    canInvite: boolean;
    canRecord: boolean;
    canModerate: boolean;
  };
  createdAt: Date;
  lastActivity: Date;
}

interface ChatMessage {
  id: string;
  userId: string;
  userName: string;
  message: string;
  timestamp: Date;
  type: 'message' | 'system' | 'decision';
}

export default function RealTimeCollaborationHub() {
  const [sessions, setSessions] = useState<CollaborationSession[]>([]);
  const [activeSession, setActiveSession] = useState<CollaborationSession | null>(null);
  const [chatMessages, setChatMessages] = useState<ChatMessage[]>([]);
  const [newMessage, setNewMessage] = useState('');
  const [isConnected, setIsConnected] = useState(false);
  const wsRef = useRef<WebSocket | null>(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    // Connect to WebSocket
    const protocol = window.location.protocol === 'https:' ? 'wss:' : 'ws:';
    const wsUrl = `${protocol}//${window.location.host}/ws`;
    
    wsRef.current = new WebSocket(wsUrl);
    
    wsRef.current.onopen = () => {
      setIsConnected(true);
      console.log('Connected to collaboration hub');
    };
    
    wsRef.current.onmessage = (event) => {
      try {
        const data = JSON.parse(event.data);
        handleWebSocketMessage(data);
      } catch (error) {
        console.error('Error parsing WebSocket message:', error);
      }
    };
    
    wsRef.current.onclose = () => {
      setIsConnected(false);
      console.log('Disconnected from collaboration hub');
    };
    
    return () => {
      if (wsRef.current) {
        wsRef.current.close();
      }
    };
  }, []);

  const handleWebSocketMessage = (data: any) => {
    switch (data.type) {
      case 'participant_joined':
        if (activeSession && data.sessionId === activeSession.id) {
          setActiveSession(prev => prev ? {
            ...prev,
            participants: [...prev.participants, data.participant]
          } : null);
        }
        break;
      case 'participant_left':
        if (activeSession && data.sessionId === activeSession.id) {
          setActiveSession(prev => prev ? {
            ...prev,
            participants: prev.participants.filter(p => p.id !== data.participantId)
          } : null);
        }
        break;
      case 'chat_message':
        setChatMessages(prev => [...prev, data.message]);
        break;
      case 'document_update':
        // Handle document collaboration updates
        console.log('Document updated:', data);
        break;
    }
  };

  const createSession = async (type: CollaborationSession['type']) => {
    try {
      const response = await fetch('/api/collaboration/sessions', {
        method: 'POST',
        headers: {
          'Content-Type': 'application/json',
        },
        body: JSON.stringify({
          type,
          creatorId: 'demo-user' // In production, get from auth context
        })
      });

      if (response.ok) {
        const session = await response.json();
        setSessions(prev => [...prev, session]);
        setActiveSession(session);
      }
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Error creating session:', error);
    }
  };

  const joinSession = async (sessionId: string) => {
    try {
      const response = await fetch(`/api/collaboration/sessions/${sessionId}/join`, {
        method: 'POST',
        headers: {
          'Content-Type': 'application/json',
        },
        body: JSON.stringify({
          userId: 'demo-user'
        })
      });

      if (response.ok) {
        const participant = await response.json();
        // WebSocket will handle the participant_joined event
      }
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Error joining session:', error);
    }
  };

  const sendChatMessage = () => {
    if (!newMessage.trim() || !activeSession || !wsRef.current) return;

    const message: ChatMessage = {
      id: Date.now().toString(),
      userId: 'demo-user',
      userName: 'Demo User',
      message: newMessage,
      timestamp: new Date(),
      type: 'message'
    };

    wsRef.current.send(JSON.stringify({
      type: 'chat_message',
      sessionId: activeSession.id,
      message
    }));

    setNewMessage('');
  };

  const getStatusColor = (status: Participant['status']) => {
    switch (status) {
      case 'active': return 'bg-green-500';
      case 'idle': return 'bg-yellow-500';
      case 'away': return 'bg-gray-500';
    }
  };

  const getRoleIcon = (role: Participant['role']) => {
    switch (role) {
      case 'owner': return <Crown className="w-3 h-3" />;
      case 'editor': return <Edit3 className="w-3 h-3" />;
      case 'viewer': return <Eye className="w-3 h-3" />;
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6">
      {/* Connection Status */}
      <VeridiusCard>
        <div className="p-4">
          <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
            <h2 className="text-xl font-semibold text-white">Collaboration Hub</h2>
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
              <div className={`w-2 h-2 rounded-full ${isConnected ? 'bg-green-400' : 'bg-red-400'}`} />
              <span className="text-sm text-gray-300">
                {isConnected ? 'Connected' : 'Disconnected'}
              </span>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      </VeridiusCard>

      {/* Session Management */}
      <Tabs defaultValue="active" className="space-y-4">
        <TabsList className="grid w-full grid-cols-3 bg-gray-800">
          <TabsTrigger value="active" className="text-white">Active Sessions</TabsTrigger>
          <TabsTrigger value="create" className="text-white">Create New</TabsTrigger>
          <TabsTrigger value="join" className="text-white">Join Session</TabsTrigger>
        </TabsList>

        <TabsContent value="active">
          {activeSession ? (
            <div className="grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-6">
              {/* Main Collaboration Area */}
              <div className="lg:col-span-2 space-y-4">
                <VeridiusCard>
                  <div className="p-6">
                    <h3 className="text-lg font-semibold text-white mb-4">
                      {activeSession.type.replace('_', ' ').replace(/\b\w/g, l => l.toUpperCase())} Session
                    </h3>
                    
                    {/* Document/Scenario Editor Placeholder */}
                    <div className="bg-gray-800/50 rounded-lg p-6 min-h-[400px] border-2 border-dashed border-gray-600">
                      <p className="text-gray-400 text-center">
                        Live collaborative editor would be integrated here
                      </p>
                      <p className="text-gray-500 text-sm text-center mt-2">
                        Real-time document editing, scenario planning, or crisis response interface
                      </p>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                </VeridiusCard>
              </div>

              {/* Sidebar */}
              <div className="space-y-4">
                {/* Participants */}
                <VeridiusCard>
                  <div className="p-4">
                    <h4 className="text-white font-medium mb-4 flex items-center gap-2">
                      <Users className="w-4 h-4" />
                      Participants ({activeSession.participants.length})
                    </h4>
                    <div className="space-y-3">
                      {activeSession.participants.map((participant) => (
                        <div key={participant.id} className="flex items-center gap-3">
                          <div className="relative">
                            <Avatar className="w-8 h-8">
                              <AvatarImage src={participant.avatar} />
                              <AvatarFallback className="text-xs">
                                {participant.name.split(' ').map(n => n[0]).join('')}
                              </AvatarFallback>
                            </Avatar>
                            <div className={`absolute -bottom-0.5 -right-0.5 w-3 h-3 rounded-full border-2 border-gray-900 ${getStatusColor(participant.status)}`} />
                          </div>
                          <div className="flex-1 min-w-0">
                            <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                              <span className="text-white text-sm font-medium truncate">
                                {participant.name}
                              </span>
                              <div className="text-gray-400">
                                {getRoleIcon(participant.role)}
                              </div>
                            </div>
                            <span className="text-gray-400 text-xs">{participant.email}</span>
                          </div>
                        </div>
                      ))}
                    </div>
                  </div>
                </VeridiusCard>

                {/* Chat */}
                <VeridiusCard>
                  <div className="p-4">
                    <h4 className="text-white font-medium mb-4 flex items-center gap-2">
                      <MessageSquare className="w-4 h-4" />
                      Discussion
                    </h4>
                    
                    {/* Messages */}
                    <div className="space-y-2 mb-4 max-h-60 overflow-y-auto">
                      {chatMessages.map((msg) => (
                        <div key={msg.id} className="text-sm">
                          <span className="text-blue-400 font-medium">{msg.userName}:</span>
                          <span className="text-gray-300 ml-2">{msg.message}</span>
                        </div>
                      ))}
                    </div>
                    
                    {/* Message Input */}
                    <div className="flex gap-2">
                      <Input
                        value={newMessage}
                        onChange={(e) => setNewMessage(e.target.value)}
                        onKeyPress={(e) => e.key === 'Enter' && sendChatMessage()}
                        placeholder="Type a message..."
                        className="flex-1 bg-gray-800/50 border-gray-600 text-white"
                      />
                      <Button onClick={sendChatMessage} size="sm" className="px-3">
                        <MessageSquare className="w-4 h-4" />
                      </Button>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                </VeridiusCard>
              </div>
            </div>
          ) : (
            <VeridiusCard>
              <div className="p-8 text-center">
                <Users className="w-16 h-16 text-gray-600 mx-auto mb-4" />
                <h3 className="text-xl text-white font-semibold mb-2">No Active Session</h3>
                <p className="text-gray-400 mb-6">Create or join a collaboration session to get started</p>
                <div className="flex gap-4 justify-center">
                  <VeridiusButton variant="primary" onClick={() => createSession('scenario_planning')}>
                    Start Scenario Planning
                  </VeridiusButton>
                  <VeridiusButton variant="secondary" onClick={() => createSession('crisis_response')}>
                    Crisis Response Session
                  </VeridiusButton>
                </div>
              </div>
            </VeridiusCard>
          )}
        </TabsContent>

        <TabsContent value="create">
          <VeridiusCard>
            <div className="p-6">
              <h3 className="text-xl font-semibold text-white mb-6">Create New Session</h3>
              <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 gap-4">
                {[
                  { type: 'scenario_planning', title: 'Scenario Planning', desc: 'Collaborative strategic scenario development' },
                  { type: 'crisis_response', title: 'Crisis Response', desc: 'Real-time crisis management coordination' },
                  { type: 'document', title: 'Document Review', desc: 'Shared document editing and review' },
                  { type: 'meeting', title: 'Strategy Meeting', desc: 'Video meeting with shared workspace' }
                ].map((session) => (
                  <Card 
                    key={session.type}
                    className="cursor-pointer hover:bg-gray-800/50 bg-gray-900/50 border-gray-700 hover:border-blue-500/50"
                    onClick={() => createSession(session.type as any)}
```

```
              <p className="text-xs text-yellow-600">Requirements</p>
            </div>
            <div className="text-center p-4 bg-orange-50 rounded-lg border border-orange-200">
              <p className="text-sm font-semibold text-orange-800">High Risk</p>
              <p className="text-2xl font-bold text-orange-600">8%</p>
              <p className="text-xs text-orange-600">Requirements</p>
            </div>
            <div className="text-center p-4 bg-red-50 rounded-lg border border-red-200">
              <p className="text-sm font-semibold text-red-800">Critical Risk</p>
              <p className="text-2xl font-bold text-red-600">2%</p>
              <p className="text-xs text-red-600">Requirements</p>
            </div>
          </div>
        </CardContent>
      </Card>
    </div>
  );

  return (
    <div className="min-h-screen bg-gradient-to-br from-blue-50 to-purple-50 p-6">
      <div className="max-w-7xl mx-auto">
        {/* Header */}
        <div className="mb-8 text-center">
          <h1 className="text-4xl font-bold text-gray-900 mb-2">Compliance Center</h1>
          <p className="text-gray-600 max-w-2xl mx-auto">
            Automated compliance monitoring, regulatory intelligence, and audit trail management for enterprise-grade governance.
          </p>
        </div>

        {/* Tab Navigation */}
        <div className="flex justify-center mb-8">
          <div className="bg-white rounded-lg p-1 shadow-md">
            {[
              { id: 'overview', name: 'Compliance Overview', icon: Shield },
              { id: 'audit', name: 'Audit Trail', icon: FileCheck },
              { id: 'regulatory', name: 'Regulatory Intel', icon: Globe }
            ].map((tab) => (
              <button
                key={tab.id}
                onClick={() => setActiveTab(tab.id)}
                className={`flex items-center space-x-2 px-6 py-3 rounded-lg transition-all ${
                  activeTab === tab.id
                    ? 'bg-blue-600 text-white shadow-lg'
                    : 'text-gray-600 hover:bg-gray-100'
                }`}
              >
                <tab.icon className="w-5 h-5" />
                <span className="font-medium">{tab.name}</span>
              </button>
            ))}
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Tab Content */}
        <div className="min-h-96">
          {activeTab === 'overview' && renderOverview()}
          {activeTab === 'audit' && renderAuditTrail()}
          {activeTab === 'regulatory' && renderRegulatoryMonitoring()}
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

export default ComplianceCenter;
```

```
import React, { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import { Card, CardContent, CardHeader, CardTitle } from '@/components/ui/card';
import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button';
import { Badge } from '@/components/ui/badge';
import { Input } from '@/components/ui/input';
import { Tabs, TabsContent, TabsList, TabsTrigger } from '@/components/ui/tabs';
import { Select, SelectContent, SelectItem, SelectTrigger, SelectValue } from '@/components/ui/select';
import { 
  Shield, FileCheck, AlertTriangle, Download, Calendar, 
  Search, Filter, Eye, Settings, Lock, CheckCircle 
} from 'lucide-react';
import { VeridiusCard, VeridiusButton } from '@/components/ui/veridius-components';

interface ComplianceFramework {
  id: string;
  name: string;
  description: string;
  type: 'Privacy' | 'Security' | 'Financial' | 'Industry' | 'Operational';
  status: 'compliant' | 'partial' | 'non-compliant' | 'unknown';
  lastAudit: Date;
  nextAudit: Date;
  requirements: ComplianceRequirement[];
  certifications: string[];
}

interface ComplianceRequirement {
  id: string;
  frameworkId: string;
  title: string;
  description: string;
  status: 'met' | 'partial' | 'not-met' | 'na';
  evidence: string[];
  assignee: string;
  dueDate: Date;
  priority: 'low' | 'medium' | 'high' | 'critical';
}

interface DataExportRequest {
  id: string;
  requestType: 'gdpr' | 'ccpa' | 'custom';
  requesterInfo: {
    name: string;
    email: string;
    organization?: string;
  };
  status: 'pending' | 'processing' | 'completed' | 'rejected';
  requestDate: Date;
  completionDate?: Date;
  dataCategories: string[];
  format: 'json' | 'csv' | 'pdf';
}

const COMPLIANCE_FRAMEWORKS: ComplianceFramework[] = [
  {
    id: 'gdpr',
    name: 'GDPR (General Data Protection Regulation)',
    description: 'European Union data protection and privacy regulation',
    type: 'Privacy',
    status: 'compliant',
    lastAudit: new Date('2024-06-15'),
    nextAudit: new Date('2025-06-15'),
    requirements: [],
    certifications: ['ISO 27001', 'Privacy Shield']
  },
  {
    id: 'ccpa',
    name: 'CCPA (California Consumer Privacy Act)',
    description: 'California state privacy law for consumer data protection',
    type: 'Privacy',
    status: 'compliant',
    lastAudit: new Date('2024-08-10'),
    nextAudit: new Date('2025-02-10'),
    requirements: [],
    certifications: []
  },
  {
    id: 'sox',
    name: 'SOX (Sarbanes-Oxley Act)',
    description: 'Federal law for corporate financial reporting and governance',
    type: 'Financial',
    status: 'partial',
    lastAudit: new Date('2024-03-20'),
    nextAudit: new Date('2024-12-20'),
    requirements: [],
    certifications: []
  },
  {
    id: 'iso27001',
    name: 'ISO 27001',
    description: 'International standard for information security management',
    type: 'Security',
    status: 'compliant',
    lastAudit: new Date('2024-05-30'),
    nextAudit: new Date('2025-05-30'),
    requirements: [],
    certifications: ['ISO 27001:2013']
  }
];

export default function ComplianceManagementSystem() {
  const [frameworks, setFrameworks] = useState<ComplianceFramework[]>(COMPLIANCE_FRAMEWORKS);
  const [exportRequests, setExportRequests] = useState<DataExportRequest[]>([]);
  const [searchTerm, setSearchTerm] = useState('');
  const [selectedFramework, setSelectedFramework] = useState<ComplianceFramework | null>(null);
  const [newExportRequest, setNewExportRequest] = useState({
    requestType: 'gdpr' as const,
    requesterName: '',
    requesterEmail: '',
    dataCategories: [] as string[],
    format: 'json' as const
  });

  useEffect(() => {
    fetchComplianceStatus();
    fetchExportRequests();
  }, []);

  const fetchComplianceStatus = async () => {
    try {
      const response = await fetch('/api/compliance/frameworks');
      if (response.ok) {
        const data = await response.json();
        setFrameworks(data);
      }
    } catch (error) {
      console.log('Using sample data - API not available');
    }
  };

  const fetchExportRequests = async () => {
    try {
      const response = await fetch('/api/compliance/export-requests');
      if (response.ok) {
        const data = await response.json();
        setExportRequests(data);
      }
    } catch (error) {
      console.log('Using sample data - API not available');
    }
  };

  const createExportRequest = async () => {
    if (!newExportRequest.requesterName || !newExportRequest.requesterEmail) {
      return;
    }

    try {
      const response = await fetch('/api/compliance/export-request', {
        method: 'POST',
        headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
        body: JSON.stringify({
          ...newExportRequest,
          organizationId: 'demo-org',
          status: 'pending',
          requestDate: new Date()
        })
      });

      if (response.ok) {
        const request = await response.json();
        setExportRequests(prev => [request, ...prev]);
        setNewExportRequest({
          requestType: 'gdpr',
          requesterName: '',
          requesterEmail: '',
          dataCategories: [],
          format: 'json'
        });
      }
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Error creating export request:', error);
    }
  };

  const generateComplianceReport = async (frameworkId: string) => {
    try {
      const response = await fetch('/api/compliance/report', {
        method: 'POST',
        headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
        body: JSON.stringify({
          frameworkId,
          organizationId: 'demo-org',
          format: 'pdf'
        })
      });

      if (response.ok) {
        const result = await response.json();
        console.log('Compliance report generated:', result);
      }
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Error generating report:', error);
    }
  };

  const getStatusColor = (status: ComplianceFramework['status']) => {
    switch (status) {
      case 'compliant': return 'bg-green-500';
      case 'partial': return 'bg-yellow-500';
      case 'non-compliant': return 'bg-red-500';
      case 'unknown': return 'bg-gray-500';
    }
  };

  const getTypeColor = (type: ComplianceFramework['type']) => {
    const colors = {
      Privacy: 'bg-blue-500/20 text-blue-400',
      Security: 'bg-red-500/20 text-red-400',
      Financial: 'bg-green-500/20 text-green-400',
      Industry: 'bg-purple-500/20 text-purple-400',
      Operational: 'bg-orange-500/20 text-orange-400'
    };
    return colors[type] || 'bg-gray-500/20 text-gray-400';
  };

  const getRequestStatusColor = (status: DataExportRequest['status']) => {
    switch (status) {
      case 'completed': return 'text-green-400 bg-green-500/20';
      case 'processing': return 'text-yellow-400 bg-yellow-500/20';
      case 'pending': return 'text-blue-400 bg-blue-500/20';
      case 'rejected': return 'text-red-400 bg-red-500/20';
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6">
      {/* Header */}

            Enterprise-grade compliance management with automated auditing, data export, and regulatory reporting
          </p>
          
          <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-4 gap-4">
            <div className="bg-green-500/20 p-4 rounded-lg">
              <CheckCircle className="w-8 h-8 text-green-400 mb-2" />
              <div className="text-green-400 font-medium">Compliant</div>
              <div className="text-2xl font-bold text-white">
                {frameworks.filter(f => f.status === 'compliant').length}
              </div>
            </div>
            <div className="bg-yellow-500/20 p-4 rounded-lg">
              <AlertTriangle className="w-8 h-8 text-yellow-400 mb-2" />
              <div className="text-yellow-400 font-medium">Partial Compliance</div>
              <div className="text-2xl font-bold text-white">
                {frameworks.filter(f => f.status === 'partial').length}
              </div>
            </div>
            <div className="bg-blue-500/20 p-4 rounded-lg">
              <FileCheck className="w-8 h-8 text-blue-400 mb-2" />
              <div className="text-blue-400 font-medium">Active Audits</div>
              <div className="text-2xl font-bold text-white">3</div>
            </div>
            <div className="bg-purple-500/20 p-4 rounded-lg">
              <Download className="w-8 h-8 text-purple-400 mb-2" />
              <div className="text-purple-400 font-medium">Export Requests</div>
              <div className="text-2xl font-bold text-white">{exportRequests.length}</div>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      </VeridiusCard>

      <Tabs defaultValue="frameworks" className="space-y-6">
        <TabsList className="grid w-full grid-cols-4 bg-gray-800">
          <TabsTrigger value="frameworks" className="text-white">Compliance Frameworks</TabsTrigger>
          <TabsTrigger value="data-exports" className="text-white">Data Export Requests</TabsTrigger>
          <TabsTrigger value="audit-logs" className="text-white">Audit Logs</TabsTrigger>
          <TabsTrigger value="settings" className="text-white">Settings</TabsTrigger>
        </TabsList>

        <TabsContent value="frameworks">

                  onChange={(e) => setSearchTerm(e.target.value)}
                  className="pl-10 bg-gray-800/50 border-gray-600 text-white"

                  <SelectItem value="security" className="text-white">Security</SelectItem>

                              {request.status === 'completed' && (

                              )}
                            </div>
                          </div>
                        </CardContent>
                      </Card>
                    ))}
                  </div>
                ) : (
                  <div className="text-center py-8">
                    <FileCheck className="w-16 h-16 text-gray-600 mx-auto mb-4" />
                    <h4 className="text-xl text-white font-semibold mb-2">No Export Requests</h4>
                    <p className="text-gray-400">Create your first data export request above</p>
                  </div>
                )}
              </div>
            </VeridiusCard>
          </div>
        </TabsContent>

        <TabsContent value="audit-logs">
          <VeridiusCard>
            <div className="p-6">
              <h3 className="text-xl font-semibold text-white mb-6">Compliance Audit Logs</h3>
              
              <div className="space-y-4">
                {[
                  { date: new Date('2024-08-15'), action: 'GDPR Compliance Review', user: 'Compliance Officer', status: 'Completed' },
                  { date: new Date('2024-08-10'), action: 'Data Export Request - John Smith', user: 'System', status: 'Processed' },
                  { date: new Date('2024-08-05'), action: 'ISO 27001 Security Audit', user: 'Security Team', status: 'In Progress' },
                  { date: new Date('2024-07-30'), action: 'SOX Financial Controls Review', user: 'Finance Team', status: 'Completed' }
                ].map((log, idx) => (
                  <Card key={idx} className="bg-gray-800/50 border-gray-700">
                    <CardContent className="p-4">
                      <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                        <div className="flex items-center gap-4">
                          <Lock className="w-5 h-5 text-gray-400" />
                          <div>
                            <h4 className="text-white font-medium">{log.action}</h4>
                            <p className="text-gray-400 text-sm">
                              {log.date.toLocaleDateString()} • {log.user}
                            </p>
                          </div>
                        </div>
                        <Badge variant="outline">{log.status}</Badge>
                      </div>
                    </CardContent>

                ))}

        <TabsContent value="settings">
          <VeridiusCard>
            <div className="p-6">
              <h3 className="text-xl font-semibold text-white mb-6">Compliance Settings</h3>
              
              <div className="space-y-6">

                    {[

                    ].map((setting, idx) => (

            </div>
          </VeridiusCard>
        </TabsContent>
      </Tabs>

      {/* Framework Detail Modal */}
      {selectedFramework && (
        <div className="fixed inset-0 bg-black/50 flex items-center justify-center z-50 p-4">
          <div className="bg-gray-900 rounded-lg max-w-4xl w-full max-h-[90vh] overflow-y-auto">
            <div className="p-6">
              <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-6">
                <h3 className="text-2xl font-bold text-white">{selectedFramework.name}</h3>
                <Button variant="ghost" onClick={() => setSelectedFramework(null)}>
                  ×
                </Button>
              </div>
              
              <div className="space-y-6">
                <p className="text-gray-300">{selectedFramework.description}</p>
                
                <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-6">
                  <div>
                    <h4 className="text-white font-medium mb-3">Compliance Status</h4>
                    <div className="flex items-center gap-2 mb-2">
                      <div className={`w-3 h-3 rounded-full ${getStatusColor(selectedFramework.status)}`} />
                      <span className="text-white capitalize">{selectedFramework.status}</span>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                  
                  <div>
                    <h4 className="text-white font-medium mb-3">Audit Schedule</h4>
                    <p className="text-gray-300 text-sm">
                      Last: {selectedFramework.lastAudit.toLocaleDateString()}
                    </p>
                    <p className="text-gray-300 text-sm">
                      Next: {selectedFramework.nextAudit.toLocaleDateString()}
                    </p>
                  </div>
                </div>
                
                <div>
                  <h4 className="text-white font-medium mb-3">Actions</h4>
                  <div className="flex gap-4">
                    <VeridiusButton variant="primary" onClick={() => generateComplianceReport(selectedFramework.id)}>
                      Generate Report
                    </VeridiusButton>
                    <VeridiusButton variant="outline">
                      Schedule Audit
                    </VeridiusButton>
                    <VeridiusButton variant="outline">
                      View Requirements
                    </VeridiusButton>
                  </div>
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}
```

```
// Performance Monitoring Component
export function PerformanceMonitor({ className }: { className?: string }) {
  const systemMetrics = [
    {
      name: 'API Response Time',
      value: '245ms',
      status: 'good',
      target: '<500ms'
    },
    {
      name: 'Database Queries',
      value: '1,247/min',
      status: 'good',
      target: '<2000/min'
    },
    {
      name: 'Error Rate',
      value: '0.02%',
      status: 'excellent',
      target: '<0.1%'
    },
    {
      name: 'Memory Usage',
      value: '68%',
      status: 'warning',
      target: '<80%'
    }
  ];

  const getStatusColor = (status: string) => {
    switch (status) {
      case 'excellent': return 'text-green-600 bg-green-50';
      case 'good': return 'text-blue-600 bg-blue-50';
      case 'warning': return 'text-yellow-600 bg-yellow-50';
      case 'critical': return 'text-red-600 bg-red-50';
      default: return 'text-slate-600 bg-slate-50';
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className={`space-y-6 ${className}`}>
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
        <h2 className="text-2xl font-bold text-slate-900">Performance Monitor</h2>
        <Badge variant="outline" className="bg-green-50 text-green-700">
          All Systems Operational
        </Badge>
      </div>

      <div className="grid grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-4">
        {systemMetrics.map((metric, index) => (
          <Card key={index}>
            <CardContent className="p-4">
              <div className="space-y-2">
                <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                  <h3 className="text-sm font-medium text-slate-600">{metric.name}</h3>
                  <Badge className={getStatusColor(metric.status)} variant="secondary">
                    {metric.status}
                  </Badge>
                </div>
                <p className="text-xl font-bold text-slate-900">{metric.value}</p>
                <p className="text-xs text-slate-500">Target: {metric.target}</p>
              </div>
            </CardContent>
          </Card>
        ))}
      </div>

      <Card>
        <CardHeader>
          <CardTitle className="flex items-center gap-2">
            <Activity className="w-5 h-5" />
            System Health Overview
          </CardTitle>
        </CardHeader>
        <CardContent>
          <div className="space-y-4">
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
              <span>Overall System Health</span>
              <span className="text-green-600 font-semibold">Excellent</span>
            </div>
            <Progress value={92} className="h-2" />
            
            <div className="grid grid-cols-3 gap-4 text-center pt-4">
              <div>
                <p className="text-2xl font-bold text-green-600">99.9%</p>
                <p className="text-sm text-slate-600">Uptime</p>
              </div>
              <div>
                <p className="text-2xl font-bold text-blue-600">2.4s</p>
                <p className="text-sm text-slate-600">Avg Response</p>
              </div>
              <div>
                <p className="text-2xl font-bold text-purple-600">1.2K</p>
```

```
// Universal Data Input Component
interface DataInputProps {
  onDataSubmit?: (data: any) => void;
  className?: string;
}

export function UniversalDataInput({ onDataSubmit, className }: DataInputProps) {
  const [formData, setFormData] = useState({
    organizationName: '',
    industry: '',
    size: '',
    revenue: '',
    geography: '',
    keyMetrics: '',
    challenges: ''
  });

  const handleSubmit = (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    onDataSubmit?.(formData);
  };

  const handleChange = (field: string, value: string) => {
    setFormData(prev => ({ ...prev, [field]: value }));
  };

  return (
    <div className={`space-y-6 ${className}`}>
      <Card>
        <CardHeader>
          <CardTitle className="flex items-center gap-2">
            <Database className="w-5 h-5" />
            Organizational Data Input
          </CardTitle>
        </CardHeader>
        <CardContent>
          <form onSubmit={handleSubmit} className="space-y-4">
            <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 gap-4">
              <div>
                <Label htmlFor="orgName">Organization Name</Label>
                <Input
                  id="orgName"
                  value={formData.organizationName}
                  onChange={(e) => handleChange('organizationName', e.target.value)}
                  placeholder="Enter organization name"
                />
              </div>
              <div>
                <Label htmlFor="industry">Industry</Label>
                <Input
                  id="industry"
                  value={formData.industry}
                  onChange={(e) => handleChange('industry', e.target.value)}
                  placeholder="e.g., Manufacturing, Technology"
                />
              </div>
              <div>
                <Label htmlFor="size">Organization Size</Label>
                <Input
                  id="size"
                  value={formData.size}
                  onChange={(e) => handleChange('size', e.target.value)}
                  placeholder="Number of employees"
                />
              </div>
              <div>
                <Label htmlFor="revenue">Annual Revenue</Label>
                <Input
                  id="revenue"
                  value={formData.revenue}
                  onChange={(e) => handleChange('revenue', e.target.value)}
                  placeholder="$ USD"
                />
              </div>
            </div>
            
            <div>
              <Label htmlFor="geography">Geographic Presence</Label>
              <Input
                id="geography"
                value={formData.geography}
                onChange={(e) => handleChange('geography', e.target.value)}
                placeholder="Primary markets and regions"
              />
            </div>

            <div>
              <Label htmlFor="metrics">Key Performance Metrics</Label>
              <Textarea
                id="metrics"
                value={formData.keyMetrics}
                onChange={(e) => handleChange('keyMetrics', e.target.value)}
                placeholder="List current KPIs and success metrics"
                rows={3}
              />
            </div>

            <div>
              <Label htmlFor="challenges">Current Challenges</Label>
              <Textarea
                id="challenges"
                value={formData.challenges}
                onChange={(e) => handleChange('challenges', e.target.value)}
                placeholder="Describe primary organizational challenges"
                rows={3}
              />
            </div>

            <Button type="submit" className="w-full">
              <Upload className="w-4 h-4 mr-2" />
              Submit Data
            </Button>
          </form>
        </CardContent>
      </Card>
    </div>
  );
}
```

```
  title: string;
  value: string;
  change?: string;
  trend?: 'up' | 'down' | 'neutral';
  icon: React.ReactNode;
  className?: string;
}

export function MetricCard({ title, value, change, trend = 'neutral', icon, className }: MetricCardProps) {
  const trendColors = {
    up: 'up' as const,
    down: 'down' as const,
    neutral: 'neutral' as const
  };

  const colorMap = {
    up: 'green' as const,
    down: 'red' as const,
    neutral: 'blue' as const
  };

  return (
    <VeridiusMetricCard
      value={value}
      label={title}
      subtitle={change}
      color={colorMap[trend]}
      trend={trend === 'neutral' ? undefined : trend}
    />
  );
}
```

## FILE: client/src/components/consolidated/FormComponents.tsx
```
import React, { useState } from 'react';
import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button';
import { Input } from '@/components/ui/input';
import { Label } from '@/components/ui/label';
import { Textarea } from '@/components/ui/textarea';
import { Select, SelectContent, SelectItem, SelectTrigger, SelectValue } from '@/components/ui/select';
import { Badge } from '@/components/ui/badge';
import { Slider } from '@/components/ui/slider';
import { Switch } from '@/components/ui/switch';
import { Card, CardContent, CardHeader, CardTitle } from '@/components/ui/card';
import { Plus, X, Save } from 'lucide-react';
import { useToast } from '@/hooks/use-toast';

interface FormData {
  name: string;
  description: string;
  category: string;
  priority: string;
  tags: string[];
  budget: number;
  timeline: string;
  enabled: boolean;
}

interface BaseFormProps {
  title: string;
  onSubmit: (data: FormData) => void;
  onCancel?: () => void;
  initialData?: Partial<FormData>;
  className?: string;
}

// Reusable Form Fields
export function FormField({ 
  label, 
  children, 
  required = false,
  error 
}: { 
  label: string; 
  children: React.ReactNode; 
  required?: boolean;
  error?: string;
}) {
  return (
    <div className="space-y-2">
      <Label className="text-sm font-medium">
        {label} {required && <span className="text-red-500">*</span>}
      </Label>
      {children}
      {error && <p className="text-sm text-red-500">{error}</p>}
    </div>
  );
}

// Tag Manager Component
export function TagManager({ 
  tags, 
  onTagsChange 
}: { 
  tags: string[]; 
  onTagsChange: (tags: string[]) => void; 
}) {
  const [newTag, setNewTag] = useState('');

  const addTag = () => {
    if (newTag.trim() && !tags.includes(newTag.trim())) {
      onTagsChange([...tags, newTag.trim()]);
      setNewTag('');
    }
  };

  const removeTag = (tagToRemove: string) => {
    onTagsChange(tags.filter(tag => tag !== tagToRemove));
  };

  return (
    <div className="space-y-3">
      <div className="flex gap-2">
        <Input
          value={newTag}
          onChange={(e) => setNewTag(e.target.value)}
          placeholder="Add tag..."
          onKeyPress={(e) => e.key === 'Enter' && addTag()}
        />
        <Button type="button" onClick={addTag} size="sm">
          <Plus className="w-4 h-4" />
        </Button>
      </div>
      <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-2">
        {tags.map((tag) => (
          <Badge key={tag} variant="secondary" className="flex items-center gap-1">
            {tag}
            <X className="w-3 h-3 cursor-pointer" onClick={() => removeTag(tag)} />
          </Badge>
        ))}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

// Main Universal Form Component
export function UniversalForm({ title, onSubmit, onCancel, initialData, className }: BaseFormProps) {
  const [formData, setFormData] = useState<FormData>({
    name: initialData?.name || '',
    description: initialData?.description || '',
    category: initialData?.category || 'general',
    priority: initialData?.priority || 'medium',
    tags: initialData?.tags || [],
    budget: initialData?.budget || 50000,
    timeline: initialData?.timeline || '3-months',
    enabled: initialData?.enabled || true
  });
  
  const [errors, setErrors] = useState<Record<string, string>>({});
  const { toast } = useToast();

  const validate = () => {
    const newErrors: Record<string, string> = {};
    if (!formData.name.trim()) newErrors.name = 'Name is required';
    if (formData.name.length > 100) newErrors.name = 'Name must be less than 100 characters';
    if (formData.description.length > 500) newErrors.description = 'Description must be less than 500 characters';
    
    setErrors(newErrors);
    return Object.keys(newErrors).length === 0;
  };

  const handleSubmit = (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (!validate()) return;
    
    onSubmit(formData);
    toast({
      title: "Success",
      description: `${title} has been ${initialData ? 'updated' : 'created'} successfully`,
    });
  };

  const updateField = (field: keyof FormData, value: any) => {
    setFormData(prev => ({ ...prev, [field]: value }));
    if (errors[field]) {
      setErrors(prev => ({ ...prev, [field]: '' }));
    }
  };

  return (
    <Card className={className}>
      <CardHeader>
        <CardTitle>{title}</CardTitle>
      </CardHeader>
      <CardContent>
        <form onSubmit={handleSubmit} className="space-y-6">
          <FormField label="Name" required error={errors.name}>
            <Input
              value={formData.name}
              onChange={(e) => updateField('name', e.target.value)}
              placeholder="Enter name..."
            />
          </FormField>

          <FormField label="Description" error={errors.description}>
            <Textarea
              value={formData.description}
              onChange={(e) => updateField('description', e.target.value)}
              placeholder="Enter description..."
              rows={3}
            />
          </FormField>

          <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-4">
            <FormField label="Category">
              <Select value={formData.category} onValueChange={(value) => updateField('category', value)}>
                <SelectTrigger>
                  <SelectValue />
                </SelectTrigger>
                <SelectContent>
                  <SelectItem value="general">General</SelectItem>
                  <SelectItem value="project">Project</SelectItem>
                  <SelectItem value="scenario">Scenario</SelectItem>
                  <SelectItem value="initiative">Initiative</SelectItem>
                </SelectContent>
              </Select>
            </FormField>

            <FormField label="Priority">
              <Select value={formData.priority} onValueChange={(value) => updateField('priority', value)}>
                <SelectTrigger>
                  <SelectValue />
                </SelectTrigger>
                <SelectContent>
                  <SelectItem value="low">Low</SelectItem>
                  <SelectItem value="medium">Medium</SelectItem>
                  <SelectItem value="high">High</SelectItem>
                  <SelectItem value="critical">Critical</SelectItem>
                </SelectContent>
              </Select>
            </FormField>
          </div>

          <FormField label="Tags">
            <TagManager 
              tags={formData.tags} 
              onTagsChange={(tags) => updateField('tags', tags)} 
            />
          </FormField>

          <FormField label={`Budget: $${formData.budget.toLocaleString()}`}>
            <Slider
              value={[formData.budget]}
              onValueChange={(value) => updateField('budget', value[0])}
              max={1000000}
              min={1000}
              step={1000}
              className="w-full"
            />
          </FormField>

          <FormField label="Timeline">
            <Select value={formData.timeline} onValueChange={(value) => updateField('timeline', value)}>
              <SelectTrigger>
                <SelectValue />
              </SelectTrigger>
              <SelectContent>
                <SelectItem value="1-month">1 Month</SelectItem>
                <SelectItem value="3-months">3 Months</SelectItem>
                <SelectItem value="6-months">6 Months</SelectItem>
                <SelectItem value="1-year">1 Year</SelectItem>
              </SelectContent>
            </Select>
          </FormField>

          <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
            <FormField label="Enabled">
              <Switch 
                checked={formData.enabled} 
                onCheckedChange={(checked) => updateField('enabled', checked)} 
              />
            </FormField>
          </div>

          <div className="flex gap-3 pt-4">
            <Button type="submit" className="flex-1">
              <Save className="w-4 h-4 mr-2" />
              {initialData ? 'Update' : 'Create'}
            </Button>
            {onCancel && (
              <Button type="button" variant="outline" onClick={onCancel}>
                Cancel
              </Button>
            )}
          </div>
        </form>
      </CardContent>
    </Card>
  );
}

// Backward compatibility
export default UniversalForm;
```

## FILE: client/src/components/consolidated/QualityDashboard.tsx
```
import React from 'react';
import { Card, CardContent, CardHeader, CardTitle } from '@/components/ui/card';
import { Badge } from '@/components/ui/badge';
import { CheckCircle, AlertTriangle, XCircle, Clock } from 'lucide-react';

interface QAMetric {
  id: string;
  name: string;
  status: 'pass' | 'fail' | 'warning' | 'pending';
  value: string;
  category: string;
}

const qaMetrics: QAMetric[] = [
  { id: '1', name: 'API Response Time', status: 'pass', value: '< 2s', category: 'Performance' },
  { id: '2', name: 'Error Rate', status: 'pass', value: '< 0.1%', category: 'Reliability' },
  { id: '3', name: 'Security Headers', status: 'pass', value: 'All Active', category: 'Security' },
  { id: '4', name: 'Database Health', status: 'pass', value: 'Optimal', category: 'Infrastructure' },
  { id: '5', name: 'Memory Usage', status: 'warning', value: '78%', category: 'Performance' },
  { id: '6', name: 'Test Coverage', status: 'pass', value: '94%', category: 'Quality' },
];

function getStatusIcon(status: string) {
  switch (status) {
    case 'pass': return <CheckCircle className="w-4 h-4 text-green-600" />;
    case 'warning': return <AlertTriangle className="w-4 h-4 text-yellow-600" />;
    case 'fail': return <XCircle className="w-4 h-4 text-red-600" />;
    default: return <Clock className="w-4 h-4 text-gray-600" />;
  }
}

function getStatusColor(status: string) {
  switch (status) {
    case 'pass': return 'border-green-200 bg-green-50';
    case 'warning': return 'border-yellow-200 bg-yellow-50';
    case 'fail': return 'border-red-200 bg-red-50';
    default: return 'border-gray-200 bg-gray-50';
  }
}

export function QualityDashboard({ className }: { className?: string }) {
  const passCount = qaMetrics.filter(m => m.status === 'pass').length;
  const totalCount = qaMetrics.length;
  const healthScore = Math.round((passCount / totalCount) * 100);

  return (
    <div className={`space-y-6 ${className}`}>
      {/* Overall Health */}
      <Card>
        <CardHeader>
          <CardTitle className="flex items-center justify-between">
            System Health Score
            <Badge variant={healthScore >= 90 ? 'default' : 'secondary'}>
              {healthScore}%
            </Badge>
          </CardTitle>
        </CardHeader>
        <CardContent>
          <div className="grid grid-cols-4 gap-4 text-center">
            <div>
              <p className="text-2xl font-bold text-green-600">{passCount}</p>
              <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">Passing</p>
            </div>
            <div>
              <p className="text-2xl font-bold text-yellow-600">
                {qaMetrics.filter(m => m.status === 'warning').length}
              </p>
              <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">Warnings</p>
            </div>
            <div>
              <p className="text-2xl font-bold text-red-600">
                {qaMetrics.filter(m => m.status === 'fail').length}
              </p>
              <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">Failing</p>
            </div>
            <div>
              <p className="text-2xl font-bold text-blue-600">1.8s</p>
              <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">Avg Response</p>
            </div>
          </div>
        </CardContent>
      </Card>

      {/* Metrics Grid */}
      <div className="grid grid-cols-2 md:grid-cols-3 gap-4">
        {qaMetrics.map((metric) => (
          <Card key={metric.id} className={getStatusColor(metric.status)}>
            <CardContent className="p-4">
              <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-2">
                {getStatusIcon(metric.status)}
                <Badge variant="outline" className="text-xs">
                  {metric.category}
                </Badge>
              </div>
```

## FILE: client/src/components/consolidated/WorkflowCore.tsx

```
import React, { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import { Card, CardContent, CardHeader, CardTitle } from '@/components/ui/card';
import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button';
import { Badge } from '@/components/ui/badge';
import { Progress } from '@/components/ui/progress';
import { Input } from '@/components/ui/input';
import { Select, SelectContent, SelectItem, SelectTrigger, SelectValue } from '@/components/ui/select';
import { Play, Pause, Save, Download, BarChart3, Clock, CheckCircle } from 'lucide-react';
import { useToast } from '@/hooks/use-toast';

// Core workflow interfaces
interface WorkflowStep {
  id: string;
  name: string;
  type: 'input' | 'analysis' | 'decision' | 'output';
  status: 'pending' | 'running' | 'completed' | 'error';
  progress: number;
  data?: Record<string, any>;
}

interface Workflow {
  id: string;
  name: string;
  description: string;
  steps: WorkflowStep[];
  status: 'draft' | 'running' | 'completed' | 'paused';
  progress: number;
  createdAt: string;
  estimatedDuration: number;
}

interface WorkflowCoreProps {
  workflow?: Workflow;
  onSave?: (workflow: Workflow) => void;
  onRun?: (workflow: Workflow) => void;
  className?: string;
}

// Step Component
function WorkflowStepCard({ step, onUpdate }: { step: WorkflowStep; onUpdate: (step: WorkflowStep) => void }) {
  const getStepIcon = (type: string) => {
    switch (type) {
      case 'input': return '📝';
      case 'analysis': return '🔍';
      case 'decision': return '🎯';
      case 'output': return '📊';
      default: return '⚪';
    }
  };

  const getStatusColor = (status: string) => {
    switch (status) {
      case 'completed': return 'bg-green-100 text-green-700 border-green-200';
      case 'running': return 'bg-blue-100 text-blue-700 border-blue-200';
      case 'error': return 'bg-red-100 text-red-700 border-red-200';
      default: return 'bg-gray-100 text-gray-700 border-gray-200';
    }
  };

  return (
    <Card className={`transition-all duration-200 ${getStatusColor(step.status)}`}>
      <CardHeader className="pb-3">
        <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
          <CardTitle className="text-sm font-medium flex items-center gap-2">
            <span className="text-lg">{getStepIcon(step.type)}</span>
            {step.name}
          </CardTitle>
          <Badge variant="outline" className="text-xs">
            {step.status}
          </Badge>
        </div>
      </CardHeader>
      <CardContent className="pt-0">
        <Progress value={step.progress} className="mb-2" />
        <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">{step.progress}% complete</p>
      </CardContent>
    </Card>
  );
}

// Main Workflow Builder Component
export function WorkflowCore({ workflow: initialWorkflow, onSave, onRun, className }: WorkflowCoreProps) {
  const [workflow, setWorkflow] = useState<Workflow>(initialWorkflow || {
    id: `workflow-${Date.now()}`,
    name: 'New Workflow',
    description: '',
    steps: [],
    status: 'draft',
    progress: 0,
    createdAt: new Date().toISOString(),
    estimatedDuration: 0
  });

  const [isRunning, setIsRunning] = useState(false);
  const { toast } = useToast();

  // Default scenario steps
  const defaultSteps: WorkflowStep[] = [
    {
      id: 'step-1',
      name: 'Organization Profile',
      type: 'input',
      status: 'pending',
      progress: 0,
    },
    {
      id: 'step-2',
      name: 'Scenario Selection',
      type: 'input',
      status: 'pending',
      progress: 0,
    },
    {
      id: 'step-3',
      name: 'Impact Analysis',
      type: 'analysis',
      status: 'pending',
      progress: 0,
    },
    {
      id: 'step-4',
      name: 'Risk Assessment',
      type: 'analysis',
      status: 'pending',
      progress: 0,
    },
    {
      id: 'step-5',
      name: 'Response Planning',
      type: 'decision',
      status: 'pending',
      progress: 0,
    },
    {
      id: 'step-6',
      name: 'Generate Report',
      type: 'output',
      status: 'pending',
      progress: 0,
    }
  ];

  useEffect(() => {
    if (workflow.steps.length === 0) {
      setWorkflow(prev => ({ ...prev, steps: defaultSteps }));
    }
  }, []);

  const handleRunWorkflow = async () => {
    if (!workflow.steps.length) {
      toast({
        title: "No Steps",
        description: "Add steps to your workflow before running",
        variant: "destructive"
      });
      return;
    }

    setIsRunning(true);
    onRun?.(workflow);

    // Simulate workflow execution
    for (let i = 0; i < workflow.steps.length; i++) {
      const step = workflow.steps[i];
      
      // Update step to running
      setWorkflow(prev => ({
        ...prev,
        steps: prev.steps.map(s => 
          s.id === step.id ? { ...s, status: 'running' as const } : s
        )
      }));

      // Simulate progress
      for (let progress = 0; progress <= 100; progress += 20) {
        await new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, 200));
        setWorkflow(prev => ({
          ...prev,
          steps: prev.steps.map(s => 
            s.id === step.id ? { ...s, progress } : s
          ),
          progress: ((i * 100 + progress) / workflow.steps.length)
        }));
      }

      // Mark step as completed
      setWorkflow(prev => ({
        ...prev,
        steps: prev.steps.map(s => 
          s.id === step.id ? { ...s, status: 'completed' as const, progress: 100 } : s
        )
      }));
    }

    setWorkflow(prev => ({ ...prev, status: 'completed' }));
    setIsRunning(false);
    
    toast({
      title: "Workflow Complete",
      description: "Your workflow has been executed successfully",
    });
  };

  const handleSave = () => {
    onSave?.(workflow);
    toast({
      title: "Workflow Saved",
      description: "Your workflow has been saved successfully",
    });
  };

  return (
    <div className={`space-y-6 ${className}`}>
      {/* Header */}
      <Card>
        <CardHeader>
          <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
            <div>
              <CardTitle>{workflow.name}</CardTitle>
              <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground mt-1">
                {workflow.description || "No description provided"}
              </p>
            </div>
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
              <Badge variant={workflow.status === 'completed' ? 'default' : 'secondary'}>
                {workflow.status}
              </Badge>
              <Button onClick={handleSave} variant="outline" size="sm">
                <Save className="w-4 h-4 mr-2" />
                Save
              </Button>
              <Button 
                onClick={handleRunWorkflow} 
                disabled={isRunning}
                size="sm"
              >
                {isRunning ? (
                  <>
                    <Clock className="w-4 h-4 mr-2 animate-spin" />
                    Running...
                  </>
                ) : (
                  <>
                    <Play className="w-4 h-4 mr-2" />
                    Run
                  </>
                )}
              </Button>
            </div>
          </div>
        </CardHeader>
        <CardContent>
          <div className="space-y-2">
            <div className="flex justify-between text-sm">
              <span>Overall Progress</span>
              <span>{Math.round(workflow.progress)}%</span>
            </div>
            <Progress value={workflow.progress} />
          </div>
        </CardContent>
      </Card>

      {/* Steps */}
      <div className="grid gap-4 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3">
        {workflow.steps.map((step) => (
          <WorkflowStepCard
            key={step.id}
            step={step}
            onUpdate={(updatedStep) => {
              setWorkflow(prev => ({
                ...prev,
                steps: prev.steps.map(s => s.id === updatedStep.id ? updatedStep : s)
              }));
            }}
          />
        ))}
      </div>

      {/* Results */}
      {workflow.status === 'completed' && (
        <Card>
          <CardHeader>
            <CardTitle className="flex items-center gap-2">
              <CheckCircle className="w-5 h-5 text-green-600" />
              Workflow Results
            </CardTitle>
          </CardHeader>
          <CardContent>
            <div className="grid grid-cols-3 gap-4 text-center">
              <div>
                <p className="text-2xl font-bold text-green-600">6/6</p>
                <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">Steps Completed</p>
              </div>
              <div>
                <p className="text-2xl font-bold text-blue-600">100%</p>
                <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">Success Rate</p>
              </div>
              <div>
                <p className="text-2xl font-bold text-purple-600">2.4s</p>
                <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">Execution Time</p>
              </div>
            </div>
            <div className="flex gap-2 mt-4">
              <Button variant="outline" className="flex-1">
                <BarChart3 className="w-4 h-4 mr-2" />
                View Analytics
              </Button>
              <Button variant="outline" className="flex-1">
                <Download className="w-4 h-4 mr-2" />
                Export Results
              </Button>
            </div>
          </CardContent>
        </Card>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

export default WorkflowCore;
```

## FILE: client/src/components/ContextualAlerts.tsx
```
import React, { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import { Card, CardContent } from '@/components/ui/card';
import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button';
import { Badge } from '@/components/ui/badge';
import { AlertTriangle, CheckCircle, Info, X, Eye, Brain, TrendingUp } from 'lucide-react';
import { useLocation } from 'wouter';

interface Alert {
  id: string;
  type: 'critical' | 'warning' | 'success' | 'info';
  title: string;
  insight: string;
  timestamp: Date;
  isNew: boolean;
  actions: AlertAction[];
}

interface AlertAction {
  label: string;
  action: 'acknowledge' | 'dismiss' | 'explore' | 'custom';
  route?: string;
  variant?: 'default' | 'outline' | 'ghost';
}

export default function ContextualAlerts() {
  const [, setLocation] = useLocation();
  const [alerts, setAlerts] = useState<Alert[]>([]);
  const [dismissedAlerts, setDismissedAlerts] = useState<Set<string>>(new Set());

  useEffect(() => {
    // Simulate real-time alert generation
    const alertTemplates: Omit<Alert, 'id' | 'timestamp' | 'isNew'>[] = [
      {
        type: 'warning',
        title: 'Supply Chain Volatility Detected',
        insight: 'Impact: 3 key suppliers affected, potential for 15% margin erosion',
        actions: [
          { label: 'Acknowledge', action: 'acknowledge', variant: 'ghost' },
          { label: 'Deep Analysis', action: 'explore', route: '/strategic-intelligence', variant: 'default' },
          { label: 'Generate Plan', action: 'explore', route: '/workflow-builder', variant: 'outline' }
        ]
      },
      {
        type: 'critical',
        title: 'Competitive Threat Identified',
        insight: 'New competitor launched with 40% cost advantage in key market segment',
        actions: [
          { label: 'Dismiss', action: 'dismiss', variant: 'ghost' },
          { label: 'Strategic Response', action: 'explore', route: '/workflow-builder', variant: 'default' }
        ]
      },
      {
        type: 'success',
        title: 'Resilience Score Improved',
        insight: 'Organizational readiness increased 12% following recent initiatives',
        actions: [
          { label: 'View Details', action: 'explore', route: '/analytics', variant: 'outline' },
          { label: 'Share Report', action: 'custom', variant: 'default' }
        ]
      },
      {
        type: 'info',
        title: 'Market Opportunity Window',
        insight: 'Emerging market segment showing 25% growth rate with low competition',
        actions: [
          { label: 'Explore', action: 'explore', route: '/data-intelligence', variant: 'default' },
          { label: 'Later', action: 'acknowledge', variant: 'ghost' }
        ]
      }
    ];

    // Generate alerts with random timing
    const generateAlert = () => {
      const template = alertTemplates[Math.floor(Math.random() * alertTemplates.length)];
      const newAlert: Alert = {
        ...template,
        id: `alert-${Date.now()}-${Math.random().toString(36).substr(2, 9)}`,
        timestamp: new Date(),
        isNew: true
      };

      setAlerts(prev => {
        // Remove old alerts of same type and add new one
        const filtered = prev.filter(a => a.type !== template.type);
        return [newAlert, ...filtered].slice(0, 3); // Keep max 3 alerts
      });

      // Mark as not new after animation period
      setTimeout(() => {
        setAlerts(prev => 
          prev.map(a => 
            a.id === newAlert.id ? { ...a, isNew: false } : a
          )
        );
      }, 2000);
    };

    // Initial alert
    generateAlert();

    // Generate new alerts periodically
    const alertInterval = setInterval(generateAlert, 15000 + Math.random() * 10000);

    return () => clearInterval(alertInterval);
  }, []);

  const getAlertIcon = (type: string) => {
    switch (type) {
      case 'critical': return <AlertTriangle className="w-5 h-5" />;
      case 'warning': return <AlertTriangle className="w-5 h-5" />;
      case 'success': return <CheckCircle className="w-5 h-5" />;
      default: return <Info className="w-5 h-5" />;
    }
  };

  const getAlertColors = (type: string) => {
    switch (type) {
      case 'critical': 
        return {
          bg: 'bg-red-50 dark:bg-red-950/20',
          border: 'border-red-200 dark:border-red-800',
          icon: 'text-red-600 dark:text-red-400',
          pulse: 'ring-red-500'
        };
      case 'warning': 
        return {
          bg: 'bg-orange-50 dark:bg-orange-950/20',
          border: 'border-orange-200 dark:border-orange-800',
          icon: 'text-orange-600 dark:text-orange-400',
          pulse: 'ring-orange-500'
        };
      case 'success': 
        return {
          bg: 'bg-green-50 dark:bg-green-950/20',
          border: 'border-green-200 dark:border-green-800',
          icon: 'text-green-600 dark:text-green-400',
          pulse: 'ring-green-500'
        };
      default: 
        return {
          bg: 'bg-blue-50 dark:bg-blue-950/20',
          border: 'border-blue-200 dark:border-blue-800',
          icon: 'text-blue-600 dark:text-blue-400',
          pulse: 'ring-blue-500'
        };
    }
  };

  const handleAlertAction = (alert: Alert, action: AlertAction) => {
    switch (action.action) {
      case 'dismiss':
        setDismissedAlerts(prev => new Set([...prev, alert.id]));
        break;
      case 'acknowledge':
        setAlerts(prev => prev.filter(a => a.id !== alert.id));
        break;
      case 'explore':
        if (action.route) {
          setLocation(action.route);
        }
        break;
      case 'custom':
        // Handle custom actions
        console.log('Custom action for alert:', alert.id);
        break;
    }
  };

  const visibleAlerts = alerts.filter(alert => !Array.from(dismissedAlerts).includes(alert.id));

  if (visibleAlerts.length === 0) return null;

  return (
    <div className="space-y-4">
      {visibleAlerts.map((alert) => {
        const colors = getAlertColors(alert.type);
        return (
          <Card 
            key={alert.id} 
            className={`relative overflow-hidden transition-all duration-500 transform ${
              alert.isNew 
                ? `animate-slide-up ring-2 ${colors.pulse}/50 shadow-lg scale-102` 
                : 'hover:shadow-md'
            } ${colors.bg} ${colors.border} border-l-4`}
          >
            <CardContent className="p-6">
              <div className="flex items-start gap-4">
                {/* Alert Icon */}
                <div className={`flex items-center justify-center w-10 h-10 rounded-full bg-white/50 dark:bg-gray-800/50 ${colors.icon}`}>
                  {getAlertIcon(alert.type)}
                </div>

                {/* Content */}
                <div className="flex-1 space-y-3">
                  <div className="flex items-start justify-between">
                    <div>
                      <h4 className="font-bold text-foreground text-lg">
                        {alert.title}
                      </h4>
                      <Badge 
                        variant="secondary" 
                        className={`mt-1 ${colors.icon} font-medium`}
                      >
                        {alert.type.toUpperCase()}
                      </Badge>
                    </div>
                    
                    {/* Timestamp */}
                    <div className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">
                      {alert.timestamp.toLocaleTimeString('en-US', { 
                        hour: '2-digit', 
                        minute: '2-digit' 
                      })}
                    </div>
                  </div>

                  {/* Insight */}
                  <div className={`p-3 rounded-lg bg-white/60 dark:bg-gray-800/60 border ${colors.border}`}>
                    <div className="flex items-start gap-2">
                      <Brain className={`w-4 h-4 mt-0.5 ${colors.icon} flex-shrink-0`} />
                      <p className="text-sm text-foreground leading-relaxed">
                        <span className="font-semibold">AI Insight:</span> {alert.insight}
                      </p>
                    </div>
                  </div>

                  {/* Actions */}
                  <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-2">
                    {alert.actions.map((action, index) => (
                      <Button
                        key={index}
                        variant={action.variant || 'default'}
                        size="sm"
                        onClick={() => handleAlertAction(alert, action)}
                        className="text-xs font-medium"
                      >
                        {action.action === 'explore' && <Eye className="w-3 h-3 mr-1" />}
                        {action.action === 'acknowledge' && <CheckCircle className="w-3 h-3 mr-1" />}
                        {action.action === 'dismiss' && <X className="w-3 h-3 mr-1" />}
                        {action.label}
                      </Button>
                    ))}
                  </div>
                </div>
              </div>
            </CardContent>
          </Card>
        );
      })}
    </div>
  );
}
```
