## FILE: client/src/components/CrossScenarioDependencies.tsx
```
import { useState } from "react";
import { Card, CardContent, CardDescription, CardHeader, CardTitle } from "@/components/ui/card";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { Badge } from "@/components/ui/badge";
import { Select, SelectContent, SelectItem, SelectTrigger, SelectValue } from "@/components/ui/select";
import { Input } from "@/components/ui/input";
import { Label } from "@/components/ui/label";
import { Slider } from "@/components/ui/slider";
import { 
  ArrowRight, 
  Plus, 
  Trash2, 
  AlertTriangle, 
  Info, 
  Network,
  GitBranch,
  Clock,
  TrendingUp
} from "lucide-react";

interface ScenarioDependency {
  id: string;
  primaryScenario: string;
  dependentScenario: string;
  dependencyType: 'prerequisite' | 'parallel' | 'sequential' | 'conditional';
  impactFactor: number; // 0-100
  timeDelay: number; // in weeks
  conditions?: string;
  riskMultiplier: number;
}

interface CrossScenarioDependenciesProps {
  scenarios: Array<{id: string; title: string; category: string}>;
  onUpdateDependencies: (dependencies: ScenarioDependency[]) => void;
}

export default function CrossScenarioDependencies({ 
  scenarios, 
  onUpdateDependencies 
}: CrossScenarioDependenciesProps) {
  const [dependencies, setDependencies] = useState<ScenarioDependency[]>([
    {
      id: '1',
      primaryScenario: 'digital-transformation',
      dependentScenario: 'workforce-optimization',
      dependencyType: 'prerequisite',
      impactFactor: 75,
      timeDelay: 4,
      riskMultiplier: 1.2,
      conditions: 'Digital infrastructure must be 80% complete'
    },
    {
      id: '2',
      primaryScenario: 'operational-efficiency',
      dependentScenario: 'supply-chain-resilience',
      dependencyType: 'parallel',
      impactFactor: 60,
      timeDelay: 2,
      riskMultiplier: 0.9,
      conditions: 'Process optimization enables supply chain improvements'
    }
  ]);

  const [newDependency, setNewDependency] = useState<Partial<ScenarioDependency>>({
    dependencyType: 'sequential',
    impactFactor: 50,
    timeDelay: 2,
    riskMultiplier: 1.0
  });

  const dependencyTypeConfig = {
    prerequisite: {
      label: 'Prerequisite',
      description: 'Must complete before starting dependent scenario',
      color: 'bg-red-100 text-red-800',
      icon: Clock
    },
    parallel: {
      label: 'Parallel',
      description: 'Can run simultaneously with synergistic effects',
      color: 'bg-blue-100 text-blue-800',
      icon: GitBranch
    },
    sequential: {
      label: 'Sequential',
      description: 'One follows after the other in planned sequence',
      color: 'bg-green-100 text-green-800',
      icon: ArrowRight
    },
    conditional: {
      label: 'Conditional',
      description: 'Dependent on specific conditions or outcomes',
      color: 'bg-yellow-100 text-yellow-800',
      icon: AlertTriangle
    }
  };

  const addDependency = () => {
    if (!newDependency.primaryScenario || !newDependency.dependentScenario) {
      return;
    }

    const dependency: ScenarioDependency = {
      id: Date.now().toString(),
      primaryScenario: newDependency.primaryScenario!,
      dependentScenario: newDependency.dependentScenario!,
      dependencyType: newDependency.dependencyType!,
      impactFactor: newDependency.impactFactor!,
      timeDelay: newDependency.timeDelay!,
      riskMultiplier: newDependency.riskMultiplier!,
      conditions: newDependency.conditions
    };

    const updatedDependencies = [...dependencies, dependency];
    setDependencies(updatedDependencies);
    onUpdateDependencies(updatedDependencies);

    // Reset form
    setNewDependency({
      dependencyType: 'sequential',
      impactFactor: 50,
      timeDelay: 2,
      riskMultiplier: 1.0
    });
  };

  const removeDependency = (id: string) => {
    const updatedDependencies = dependencies.filter(dep => dep.id !== id);
    setDependencies(updatedDependencies);
    onUpdateDependencies(updatedDependencies);
  };

  const getScenarioTitle = (id: string) => {
    return scenarios.find(s => s.id === id)?.title || id;
  };

  const calculateComplexityScore = () => {
    const baseComplexity = dependencies.length * 10;
    const typeComplexity = dependencies.reduce((acc, dep) => {
      const multipliers = {
        prerequisite: 1.5,
        conditional: 1.3,
        sequential: 1.0,
        parallel: 0.8
      };
      return acc + (multipliers[dep.dependencyType] * dep.impactFactor);
    }, 0);
    
    return Math.min(100, baseComplexity + typeComplexity / 10);
  };

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6">
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
        <div>
          <h2 className="text-2xl font-bold flex items-center gap-2">
            <Network className="w-6 h-6" />
            Cross-Scenario Dependencies
          </h2>
          <p className="text-muted-foreground">
            Map and manage dependencies between scenarios for complex transformation analysis
          </p>
        </div>
        <div className="flex items-center gap-4">
          <div className="text-right">
            <div className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">Complexity Score</div>
            <div className="text-2xl font-bold text-primary">
              {calculateComplexityScore().toFixed(0)}%
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Existing Dependencies */}
      <Card>
        <CardHeader>
          <CardTitle>Active Dependencies</CardTitle>
          <CardDescription>
            Current scenario dependencies and their impact relationships
          </CardDescription>
        </CardHeader>
        <CardContent className="space-y-4">
          {dependencies.length === 0 ? (
            <div className="text-center py-8 text-muted-foreground">
              <Network className="w-12 h-12 mx-auto mb-4 opacity-50" />
              <p>No dependencies configured yet</p>
              <p className="text-sm">Add dependencies to enable complex scenario analysis</p>
            </div>
          ) : (
            dependencies.map((dependency) => {
              const config = dependencyTypeConfig[dependency.dependencyType];
              const Icon = config.icon;
              
              return (
                <Card key={dependency.id} className="border-l-4 border-l-primary">
                  <CardContent className="pt-4">
                    <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-3">
                      <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
                        <Badge className={config.color}>
                          <Icon className="w-3 h-3 mr-1" />
                          {config.label}
                        </Badge>
                        <div className="text-sm font-medium">
                          {getScenarioTitle(dependency.primaryScenario)}
                          <ArrowRight className="w-4 h-4 inline mx-2" />
                          {getScenarioTitle(dependency.dependentScenario)}
                        </div>
                      </div>
                      <Button 
                        variant="ghost" 
                        size="sm"
                        onClick={() => removeDependency(dependency.id)}
                      >
                        <Trash2 className="w-4 h-4" />
                      </Button>
                    </div>
                    
                    <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-4 gap-4 text-sm">
                      <div>
                        <span className="text-muted-foreground">Impact:</span>
                        <div className="font-medium">{dependency.impactFactor}%</div>
                      </div>
                      <div>
                        <span className="text-muted-foreground">Time Delay:</span>
                        <div className="font-medium">{dependency.timeDelay} weeks</div>
                      </div>
                      <div>
                        <span className="text-muted-foreground">Risk Multiplier:</span>
                        <div className="font-medium">{dependency.riskMultiplier}x</div>
                      </div>
                      <div>
                        <span className="text-muted-foreground">Conditions:</span>
                        <div className="font-medium truncate">
                          {dependency.conditions || 'None specified'}
                        </div>
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  </CardContent>
                </Card>
              );
            })
          )}
        </CardContent>
      </Card>

      {/* Add New Dependency */}
      <Card>
        <CardHeader>
          <CardTitle>Add New Dependency</CardTitle>
          <CardDescription>
            Define how scenarios interact and influence each other
          </CardDescription>
        </CardHeader>
        <CardContent className="space-y-4">
          <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 gap-4">
            <div className="space-y-2">
              <Label>Primary Scenario</Label>
              <Select 
                value={newDependency.primaryScenario} 
                onValueChange={(value) => setNewDependency({...newDependency, primaryScenario: value})}
              >
                <SelectTrigger>
                  <SelectValue placeholder="Select primary scenario" />
                </SelectTrigger>
                <SelectContent>
                  {scenarios.map((scenario) => (
                    <SelectItem key={scenario.id} value={scenario.id}>
                      {scenario.title}
                    </SelectItem>
                  ))}
                </SelectContent>
              </Select>
            </div>
            
            <div className="space-y-2">
              <Label>Dependent Scenario</Label>
              <Select 
                value={newDependency.dependentScenario} 
                onValueChange={(value) => setNewDependency({...newDependency, dependentScenario: value})}
              >
                <SelectTrigger>
                  <SelectValue placeholder="Select dependent scenario" />
                </SelectTrigger>
                <SelectContent>
                  {scenarios.map((scenario) => (
                    <SelectItem key={scenario.id} value={scenario.id}>
                      {scenario.title}
                    </SelectItem>
                  ))}
                </SelectContent>
              </Select>
            </div>
          </div>

          <div className="space-y-2">
            <Label>Dependency Type</Label>
            <Select 
              value={newDependency.dependencyType} 
              onValueChange={(value: any) => setNewDependency({...newDependency, dependencyType: value})}
            >
              <SelectTrigger>
                <SelectValue />
              </SelectTrigger>
              <SelectContent>
                {Object.entries(dependencyTypeConfig).map(([key, config]) => {
                  const Icon = config.icon;
                  return (
                    <SelectItem key={key} value={key}>
                      <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                        <Icon className="w-4 h-4" />
                        <div>
                          <div className="font-medium">{config.label}</div>
                          <div className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">{config.description}</div>
                        </div>
                      </div>
                    </SelectItem>
                  );
                })}
              </SelectContent>
            </Select>
          </div>

          <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 gap-4">
            <div className="space-y-2">
              <Label>Impact Factor: {newDependency.impactFactor}%</Label>
              <Slider
                value={[newDependency.impactFactor || 50]}
                onValueChange={(value) => setNewDependency({...newDependency, impactFactor: value[0]})}
                max={100}
                step={5}
                className="w-full"
              />
            </div>
            
            <div className="space-y-2">
              <Label>Time Delay (weeks)</Label>
              <Input
                type="number"
                value={newDependency.timeDelay}
                onChange={(e) => setNewDependency({...newDependency, timeDelay: parseInt(e.target.value)})}
                min={0}
                max={52}
              />
            </div>
            
            <div className="space-y-2">
              <Label>Risk Multiplier</Label>
              <Input
                type="number"
                step={0.1}
                value={newDependency.riskMultiplier}
                onChange={(e) => setNewDependency({...newDependency, riskMultiplier: parseFloat(e.target.value)})}
                min={0.1}
                max={3.0}
              />
            </div>
          </div>

          <div className="space-y-2">
            <Label>Conditions (optional)</Label>
            <Input
              placeholder="e.g., Digital infrastructure must be 80% complete"
              value={newDependency.conditions}
              onChange={(e) => setNewDependency({...newDependency, conditions: e.target.value})}
            />
          </div>

          <Button onClick={addDependency} className="w-full">
            <Plus className="w-4 h-4 mr-2" />
            Add Dependency
          </Button>
        </CardContent>
      </Card>

      {/* Analysis Impact */}
      {dependencies.length > 0 && (
        <Card>
          <CardHeader>
            <CardTitle className="flex items-center gap-2">
              <TrendingUp className="w-5 h-5" />
              Dependency Analysis Impact
            </CardTitle>
          </CardHeader>
          <CardContent>
            <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 gap-4">
              <div className="text-center p-4 bg-blue-50 rounded-lg">
                <div className="text-2xl font-bold text-blue-600">
                  {dependencies.length}
                </div>
                <div className="text-sm text-blue-800">Active Dependencies</div>
              </div>
              <div className="text-center p-4 bg-orange-50 rounded-lg">
                <div className="text-2xl font-bold text-orange-600">
                  {Math.round(dependencies.reduce((acc, dep) => acc + dep.timeDelay, 0) / dependencies.length)}
                </div>
                <div className="text-sm text-orange-800">Avg. Time Delay (weeks)</div>
              </div>
              <div className="text-center p-4 bg-green-50 rounded-lg">
                <div className="text-2xl font-bold text-green-600">
                  {Math.round(dependencies.reduce((acc, dep) => acc + dep.impactFactor, 0) / dependencies.length)}%
                </div>
                <div className="text-sm text-green-800">Avg. Impact Factor</div>
              </div>
            </div>
          </CardContent>
        </Card>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

    if (currentStep > 1) {
      setCurrentStep(currentStep - 1);
    }
  };

  const updatePreference = (key: keyof CustomizationPreferences, value: any) => {

    }));
  };

  const toggleArrayPreference = (key: keyof CustomizationPreferences, value: string) => {
    setPreferences(prev => ({
      ...prev,
      [key]: (prev[key] as string[]).includes(value)

                    }`}
                    onClick={() => updatePreference('role', role.id)}
                  >

                        <h4 className="font-medium">{role.name}</h4>
                        <p className="text-sm text-gray-600">{role.description}</p>
                      </div>
                    </CardContent>
                  </Card>

              </div>
            </div>

            <div>
              <h3 className="text-lg font-semibold mb-4">What industry are you in?</h3>
              <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 gap-4">
                {industries.map((industry) => (
                  <Card 
                    key={industry.id}
                    className={`cursor-pointer transition-all hover:shadow-md ${
                      preferences.industry === industry.id ? 'ring-2 ring-blue-500 bg-blue-50' : ''
                    }`}
                    onClick={() => updatePreference('industry', industry.id)}
                  >
                    <CardContent className="p-4">
                      <h4 className="font-medium">{industry.name}</h4>
                      <p className="text-sm text-gray-600">{industry.description}</p>
                    </CardContent>
                  </Card>
                ))}
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>
        );

      case 2:
        return (
          <div className="space-y-6">
            <div>
              <h3 className="text-lg font-semibold mb-4">Choose your preferred dashboard layout</h3>
              <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 gap-6">
                {layouts.map((layout) => (
                  <Card 
                    key={layout.id}
                    className={`cursor-pointer transition-all hover:shadow-md ${
                      preferences.dashboardLayout === layout.id ? 'ring-2 ring-blue-500 bg-blue-50' : ''
                    }`}
                    onClick={() => updatePreference('dashboardLayout', layout.id)}
                  >
                    <CardHeader className="pb-3">
                      <div className="flex items-center space-x-3">
                        <layout.icon className="w-6 h-6 text-blue-600" />
                        <CardTitle className="text-base">{layout.name}</CardTitle>
                      </div>
                      <CardDescription>{layout.description}</CardDescription>
                    </CardHeader>
                    <CardContent>
                      <div className="bg-gray-100 rounded-lg p-3 text-sm text-gray-600">
                        {layout.preview}
                      </div>
                    </CardContent>
                  </Card>
                ))}
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>
        );

      case 3:
        return (
          <div className="space-y-6">
            <div>
              <h3 className="text-lg font-semibold mb-4">Select your priority metrics</h3>
              <p className="text-gray-600 mb-6">Choose the metrics most important to your role and goals</p>
              
              {metricCategories.map((category) => (
                <Card key={category.category} className="mb-4">
                  <CardHeader>
                    <CardTitle className="text-base">{category.category}</CardTitle>
                  </CardHeader>
                  <CardContent>
                    <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 gap-3">
                      {category.metrics.map((metric) => (
                        <div 
                          key={metric.id}
                          className={`p-3 rounded-lg border cursor-pointer transition-all ${
                            preferences.priorityMetrics.includes(metric.id) 
                              ? 'border-blue-500 bg-blue-50' 
                              : 'border-gray-200 hover:border-gray-300'
                          }`}
                          onClick={() => toggleArrayPreference('priorityMetrics', metric.id)}
                        >
                          <div className="flex items-center space-x-2">
                            <CheckCircle className={`w-4 h-4 ${
                              preferences.priorityMetrics.includes(metric.id) 
                                ? 'text-blue-600' 
                                : 'text-gray-300'
                            }`} />
                            <span className="font-medium text-sm">{metric.name}</span>
                          </div>
                          <p className="text-xs text-gray-600 mt-1 ml-6">{metric.description}</p>
                        </div>
                      ))}
                    </div>
                  </CardContent>
                </Card>
              ))}
            </div>
          </div>
        );

      case 4:
        return (
          <div className="space-y-6">
            <div>
              <h3 className="text-lg font-semibold mb-4">Choose your dashboard widgets</h3>
              <p className="text-gray-600 mb-6">Select the types of information displays you want on your dashboard</p>
              
              <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 gap-4">
                {widgets.map((widget) => (
                  <Card 
                    key={widget.id}
                    className={`cursor-pointer transition-all hover:shadow-md ${
                      preferences.widgetPreferences.includes(widget.id) 
                        ? 'ring-2 ring-blue-500 bg-blue-50' 
                        : ''
                    }`}
                    onClick={() => toggleArrayPreference('widgetPreferences', widget.id)}
                  >
                    <CardContent className="p-4 flex items-start space-x-3">
                      <widget.icon className="w-6 h-6 text-blue-600 mt-1" />
                      <div className="flex-1">
                        <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                          <h4 className="font-medium">{widget.name}</h4>
                          <CheckCircle className={`w-4 h-4 ${
                            preferences.widgetPreferences.includes(widget.id) 
                              ? 'text-blue-600' 
                              : 'text-gray-300'
                          }`} />
                        </div>
                        <p className="text-sm text-gray-600">{widget.description}</p>
                      </div>
                    </CardContent>
                  </Card>
                ))}
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>
        );

      case 5:
        return (
          <div className="space-y-6">
            <div>
              <h3 className="text-lg font-semibold mb-4">Visual & Notification Preferences</h3>
              
              <Card className="mb-6">
                <CardHeader>
                  <CardTitle className="text-base flex items-center space-x-2">
                    <Palette className="w-5 h-5" />
                    <span>Color Scheme</span>
                  </CardTitle>
                </CardHeader>
                <CardContent>
                  <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-5 gap-4">
                    {colorSchemes.map((scheme) => (
                      <div 
                        key={scheme.id}
                        className={`cursor-pointer p-3 rounded-lg border transition-all ${
                          preferences.colorScheme === scheme.id 
                            ? 'border-blue-500 ring-2 ring-blue-200' 
                            : 'border-gray-200 hover:border-gray-300'
                        }`}
                        onClick={() => updatePreference('colorScheme', scheme.id)}
                      >
                        <div className="flex space-x-1 mb-2">
                          {scheme.colors.map((color, index) => (
                            <div key={index} className={`w-4 h-4 rounded-full ${color}`} />
                          ))}
                        </div>
                        <p className="text-sm font-medium">{scheme.name}</p>
                      </div>
                    ))}
                  </div>
                </CardContent>
              </Card>

              <Card>
                <CardHeader>
                  <CardTitle className="text-base flex items-center space-x-2">
                    <Bell className="w-5 h-5" />
                    <span>Notification Preferences</span>
                  </CardTitle>
                </CardHeader>
                <CardContent>
                  <div className="space-y-4">
                    {notificationTypes.map((notification) => (
                      <div key={notification.id} className="flex items-center justify-between">
                        <div>
                          <p className="font-medium">{notification.name}</p>
                          <p className="text-sm text-gray-600">{notification.description}</p>
                        </div>
                        <Switch
                          checked={preferences.notificationSettings.includes(notification.id)}
                          onCheckedChange={() => toggleArrayPreference('notificationSettings', notification.id)}
                        />
                      </div>
                    ))}
                  </div>
                </CardContent>
              </Card>
            </div>
          </div>
        );

      case 6:
        return (
          <div className="space-y-6">
            <div className="text-center">
              <Sparkles className="w-16 h-16 text-blue-600 mx-auto mb-4" />
              <h3 className="text-2xl font-bold mb-2">Your Dashboard is Ready!</h3>
              <p className="text-gray-600 mb-8">
                We've customized your Veridius dashboard based on your preferences. 
                Here's what we've configured for you:
              </p>
            </div>

            <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 gap-6">
              <Card>
                <CardHeader>
                  <CardTitle className="text-base">Profile</CardTitle>
                </CardHeader>
                <CardContent>
                  <div className="space-y-2">
                    <p><span className="font-medium">Role:</span> {roles.find(r => r.id === preferences.role)?.name}</p>
                    <p><span className="font-medium">Industry:</span> {industries.find(i => i.id === preferences.industry)?.name}</p>
                    <p><span className="font-medium">Layout:</span> {layouts.find(l => l.id === preferences.dashboardLayout)?.name}</p>
                  </div>
                </CardContent>
              </Card>

              <Card>
                <CardHeader>
                  <CardTitle className="text-base">Customizations</CardTitle>
                </CardHeader>
                <CardContent>
                  <div className="space-y-2">
                    <p><span className="font-medium">Priority Metrics:</span> {preferences.priorityMetrics.length} selected</p>
                    <p><span className="font-medium">Widgets:</span> {preferences.widgetPreferences.length} enabled</p>
                    <p><span className="font-medium">Notifications:</span> {preferences.notificationSettings.length} types</p>
                  </div>
                </CardContent>
              </Card>
            </div>

            <Card className="bg-blue-50 border-blue-200">
              <CardContent className="p-6 text-center">
                <h4 className="font-semibold text-blue-900 mb-2">Ready to launch your personalized dashboard?</h4>
                <p className="text-blue-700 mb-4">
                  Your dashboard will be optimized for your role, industry, and preferences. 
                  You can always customize it further from the settings menu.
                </p>
                <Button 
                  onClick={finishCustomization}
                  className="bg-blue-600 hover:bg-blue-700 text-white px-8"
                >
                  <PlayCircle className="w-4 h-4 mr-2" />
                  Launch My Dashboard
                </Button>
              </CardContent>
            </Card>
          </div>
        );

      default:
        return null;
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="min-h-screen bg-gradient-to-br from-blue-50 to-purple-50 p-6">
      <div className="max-w-4xl mx-auto">
        {/* Header */}
        <div className="text-center mb-8">
          <h1 className="text-3xl font-bold text-gray-900 mb-2">Dashboard Customization Wizard</h1>
          <p className="text-gray-600">Let's personalize your Veridius experience to match your role and preferences</p>
        </div>

        {/* Progress Bar */}
        <div className="mb-8">
          <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-2">
            <span className="text-sm font-medium text-gray-700">Step {currentStep} of {totalSteps}</span>
            <span className="text-sm text-gray-500">{Math.round(progress)}% Complete</span>
          </div>
          <Progress value={progress} className="h-2" />
        </div>

        {/* Step Content */}
        <Card className="mb-8">
          <CardContent className="p-8">
            {renderStepContent()}
          </CardContent>
        </Card>

        {/* Navigation */}
        <div className="flex justify-between">
          <Button
            variant="outline"
            onClick={prevStep}
            disabled={currentStep === 1}
            className="flex items-center space-x-2"
          >
            <ArrowLeft className="w-4 h-4" />
            <span>Previous</span>
          </Button>

          {currentStep < totalSteps ? (
            <Button
              onClick={nextStep}
              className="flex items-center space-x-2"
              disabled={
                (currentStep === 1 && (!preferences.role || !preferences.industry)) ||
                (currentStep === 2 && !preferences.dashboardLayout) ||
                (currentStep === 3 && preferences.priorityMetrics.length === 0) ||
                (currentStep === 4 && preferences.widgetPreferences.length === 0)
              }
            >
              <span>Next</span>
              <ArrowRight className="w-4 h-4" />
            </Button>
          ) : (
            <Button
              onClick={finishCustomization}
              className="flex items-center space-x-2 bg-green-600 hover:bg-green-700"
            >
              <CheckCircle className="w-4 h-4" />
              <span>Complete Setup</span>
            </Button>
          )}
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

export default DashboardCustomizationWizard;
```

import { useState } from 'react';
import { Card, CardContent, CardDescription, CardHeader, CardTitle } from '@/components/ui/card';
import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button';
import { Input } from '@/components/ui/input';
import { Label } from '@/components/ui/label';
import { Textarea } from '@/components/ui/textarea';
import { Select, SelectContent, SelectItem, SelectTrigger, SelectValue } from '@/components/ui/select';
import { Badge } from '@/components/ui/badge';
import { Tabs, TabsContent, TabsList, TabsTrigger } from '@/components/ui/tabs';
import { Separator } from '@/components/ui/separator';
import { Progress } from '@/components/ui/progress';
import { 
  Users, 
  FolderKanban, 
  CheckSquare, 
  Clock, 
  TrendingUp, 
  Database,
  Settings,
  Upload,
  Calendar,
  BarChart3,
  Target,
  AlertTriangle,
  ChevronRight,
  Plus
} from 'lucide-react';

interface UserProfile {
  id: string;
  name: string;
  email: string;
  role: string;
  department: string;
  team: string;
  skills: { name: string; level: string }[];
  hoursPerWeek: number;
  capacity: string;
}

interface ProjectData {
  id: string;
  name: string;
  description: string;
  status: string;
  priority: string;
  startDate: string;
  targetDate: string;
  budget: number;
  teamSize: number;
  progress: number;
}

interface TaskData {
  id: string;
  name: string;
  description: string;
  projectId: string;
  assignee: string;
  status: string;
  priority: string;
  estimatedHours: number;
  actualHours: number;
  dueDate: string;
}

export function DataCaptureCenter() {
  const [activeTab, setActiveTab] = useState('users');
  const [users, setUsers] = useState<UserProfile[]>([]);
  const [projects, setProjects] = useState<ProjectData[]>([]);
  const [tasks, setTasks] = useState<TaskData[]>([]);
  const [newUser, setNewUser] = useState<Partial<UserProfile>>({});
  const [newProject, setNewProject] = useState<Partial<ProjectData>>({});
  const [newTask, setNewTask] = useState<Partial<TaskData>>({});

  const addUser = () => {
    if (newUser.name && newUser.email) {
      const user: UserProfile = {
        id: Math.random().toString(36).substr(2, 9),
        name: newUser.name || '',
        email: newUser.email || '',
        role: newUser.role || 'user',
        department: newUser.department || '',
        team: newUser.team || '',
        skills: newUser.skills || [],
        hoursPerWeek: newUser.hoursPerWeek || 40,
        capacity: newUser.capacity || 'optimal'
      };
      setUsers([...users, user]);
      setNewUser({});
    }
  };

  const addProject = () => {
    if (newProject.name && newProject.description) {
      const project: ProjectData = {
        id: Math.random().toString(36).substr(2, 9),
        name: newProject.name || '',
        description: newProject.description || '',
        status: newProject.status || 'draft',
        priority: newProject.priority || 'medium',
        startDate: newProject.startDate || new Date().toISOString().split('T')[0],
        targetDate: newProject.targetDate || '',
        budget: newProject.budget || 0,
        teamSize: newProject.teamSize || 1,
        progress: newProject.progress || 0
      };
      setProjects([...projects, project]);
      setNewProject({});
    }
  };

  const addTask = () => {
    if (newTask.name && newTask.projectId) {
      const task: TaskData = {
        id: Math.random().toString(36).substr(2, 9),
        name: newTask.name || '',
        description: newTask.description || '',
        projectId: newTask.projectId || '',
        assignee: newTask.assignee || '',
        status: newTask.status || 'not-started',
        priority: newTask.priority || 'medium',
        estimatedHours: newTask.estimatedHours || 0,
        actualHours: newTask.actualHours || 0,
        dueDate: newTask.dueDate || ''
      };
      setTasks([...tasks, task]);
      setNewTask({});
    }
  };

  const getStatusColor = (status: string) => {
    switch (status) {
      case 'completed': return 'bg-green-100 text-green-800';
      case 'active': return 'bg-blue-100 text-blue-800';
      case 'in-progress': return 'bg-yellow-100 text-yellow-800';
      case 'blocked': return 'bg-red-100 text-red-800';
      case 'draft': return 'bg-gray-100 text-gray-800';
      default: return 'bg-gray-100 text-gray-800';
    }
  };

  const getPriorityColor = (priority: string) => {
    switch (priority) {
      case 'critical': return 'bg-red-100 text-red-800';
      case 'high': return 'bg-orange-100 text-orange-800';
      case 'medium': return 'bg-blue-100 text-blue-800';
      case 'low': return 'bg-green-100 text-green-800';
      default: return 'bg-gray-100 text-gray-800';
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="min-h-screen bg-gradient-to-br from-indigo-50 via-white to-cyan-50 p-6">
      <div className="max-w-7xl mx-auto">
        {/* Header */}
        <div className="mb-8">
          <h1 className="text-4xl font-bold text-gray-900 mb-2">
            Data Capture Center
          </h1>
          <p className="text-lg text-gray-600">
            Comprehensive organizational data collection and management platform
          </p>
        </div>

        {/* Stats Overview */}
        <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-4 gap-6 mb-8">
          <Card className="bg-white/70 backdrop-blur-sm border-0 shadow-lg">
            <CardContent className="p-6">
              <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                <div>
                  <p className="text-sm font-medium text-gray-600">Team Members</p>
                  <p className="text-2xl font-bold text-gray-900">{users.length}</p>
                </div>
                <Users className="w-8 h-8 text-blue-600" />
              </div>
            </CardContent>
          </Card>

          <Card className="bg-white/70 backdrop-blur-sm border-0 shadow-lg">
            <CardContent className="p-6">
              <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                <div>
                  <p className="text-sm font-medium text-gray-600">Active Projects</p>
                  <p className="text-2xl font-bold text-gray-900">{projects.length}</p>
                </div>
                <FolderKanban className="w-8 h-8 text-green-600" />
              </div>
            </CardContent>
          </Card>

          <Card className="bg-white/70 backdrop-blur-sm border-0 shadow-lg">
            <CardContent className="p-6">
              <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                <div>
                  <p className="text-sm font-medium text-gray-600">Total Tasks</p>
                  <p className="text-2xl font-bold text-gray-900">{tasks.length}</p>
                </div>
                <CheckSquare className="w-8 h-8 text-purple-600" />
              </div>
            </CardContent>
          </Card>

          <Card className="bg-white/70 backdrop-blur-sm border-0 shadow-lg">
            <CardContent className="p-6">
              <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                <div>
                  <p className="text-sm font-medium text-gray-600">Data Quality</p>
                  <p className="text-2xl font-bold text-gray-900">98%</p>
                </div>
                <Database className="w-8 h-8 text-indigo-600" />
              </div>
            </CardContent>
          </Card>
        </div>

        {/* Main Data Capture Interface */}
        <Card className="bg-white/80 backdrop-blur-sm border-0 shadow-xl">
          <CardHeader>
            <CardTitle className="flex items-center gap-2">
              <Database className="w-6 h-6 text-indigo-600" />
              Organizational Data Management
            </CardTitle>
            <CardDescription>
              Capture and manage comprehensive organizational data for strategic planning and capacity optimization
            </CardDescription>
          </CardHeader>

          <CardContent>
            <Tabs value={activeTab} onValueChange={setActiveTab}>
              <TabsList className="grid w-full grid-cols-3">
                <TabsTrigger value="users" className="flex items-center gap-2">
                  <Users className="w-4 h-4" />
                  User Management
                </TabsTrigger>
                <TabsTrigger value="projects" className="flex items-center gap-2">
                  <FolderKanban className="w-4 h-4" />
                  Project Management
                </TabsTrigger>
                <TabsTrigger value="tasks" className="flex items-center gap-2">
                  <CheckSquare className="w-4 h-4" />
                  Task Management
                </TabsTrigger>
              </TabsList>

              {/* User Management Tab */}
              <TabsContent value="users" className="space-y-6">
                <div className="grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-2 gap-6">
                  {/* Add New User Form */}
                  <Card>
                    <CardHeader>
                      <CardTitle className="text-lg">Add Team Member</CardTitle>
                      <CardDescription>
                        Capture detailed user profile and capacity information
                      </CardDescription>
                    </CardHeader>
                    <CardContent className="space-y-4">
                      <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-4">
                        <div>
                          <Label htmlFor="userName">Full Name</Label>
                          <Input
                            id="userName"
                            placeholder="John Doe"
                            value={newUser.name || ''}
                            onChange={(e) => setNewUser({...newUser, name: e.target.value})}
                          />
                        </div>
                        <div>
                          <Label htmlFor="userEmail">Email</Label>
                          <Input
                            id="userEmail"
                            type="email"
                            placeholder="john@company.com"
                            value={newUser.email || ''}
                            onChange={(e) => setNewUser({...newUser, email: e.target.value})}
                          />
                        </div>
                      </div>

                      <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-4">
                        <div>
                          <Label htmlFor="userRole">Role</Label>
                          <Select onValueChange={(value) => setNewUser({...newUser, role: value})}>
                            <SelectTrigger>
                              <SelectValue placeholder="Select role" />
                            </SelectTrigger>
                            <SelectContent>
                              <SelectItem value="executive">Executive</SelectItem>
                              <SelectItem value="manager">Manager</SelectItem>
                              <SelectItem value="senior">Senior</SelectItem>
                              <SelectItem value="mid-level">Mid-level</SelectItem>
                              <SelectItem value="junior">Junior</SelectItem>
                            </SelectContent>
                          </Select>
                        </div>
                        <div>
                          <Label htmlFor="userDepartment">Department</Label>
                          <Input
                            id="userDepartment"
                            placeholder="Engineering"
                            value={newUser.department || ''}
                            onChange={(e) => setNewUser({...newUser, department: e.target.value})}
                          />
                        </div>
                      </div>

                      <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-4">
                        <div>
                          <Label htmlFor="userTeam">Team</Label>
                          <Input
                            id="userTeam"
                            placeholder="Platform Team"
                            value={newUser.team || ''}
                            onChange={(e) => setNewUser({...newUser, team: e.target.value})}
                          />
                        </div>
                        <div>
                          <Label htmlFor="userHours">Hours/Week</Label>
                          <Input
                            id="userHours"
                            type="number"
                            placeholder="40"
                            value={newUser.hoursPerWeek || ''}
                            onChange={(e) => setNewUser({...newUser, hoursPerWeek: parseInt(e.target.value)})}
                          />
                        </div>
                      </div>

                      <Button onClick={addUser} className="w-full bg-indigo-600 hover:bg-indigo-700">
                        <Plus className="w-4 h-4 mr-2" />
                        Add Team Member
                      </Button>
                    </CardContent>
                  </Card>

                  {/* User List */}
                  <Card>
                    <CardHeader>
                      <CardTitle className="text-lg">Team Members ({users.length})</CardTitle>
                    </CardHeader>
                    <CardContent>
                      <div className="space-y-3 max-h-96 overflow-y-auto">
                        {users.map((user) => (
                          <div key={user.id} className="p-4 border rounded-lg bg-gray-50">
                            <div className="flex justify-between items-start mb-2">
                              <div>
                                <h4 className="font-semibold">{user.name}</h4>
                                <p className="text-sm text-gray-600">{user.email}</p>
                              </div>
                              <Badge className={getStatusColor(user.capacity)}>
                                {user.capacity}
                              </Badge>
                            </div>
                            <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-2 text-sm">
                              <span><strong>Role:</strong> {user.role}</span>
                              <span><strong>Department:</strong> {user.department}</span>
                              <span><strong>Team:</strong> {user.team}</span>
                              <span><strong>Hours/Week:</strong> {user.hoursPerWeek}</span>
                            </div>
                          </div>
                        ))}
                        {users.length === 0 && (
                          <div className="text-center py-8 text-gray-500">
                            No team members added yet. Add your first team member to get started.
                          </div>
                        )}
                      </div>
                    </CardContent>
                  </Card>
                </div>
              </TabsContent>

              {/* Project Management Tab */}
              <TabsContent value="projects" className="space-y-6">
                <div className="grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-2 gap-6">
                  {/* Add New Project Form */}
                  <Card>
                    <CardHeader>
                      <CardTitle className="text-lg">Create Project</CardTitle>
                      <CardDescription>
                        Define project scope, timeline, and resource requirements
                      </CardDescription>
                    </CardHeader>
                    <CardContent className="space-y-4">
                      <div>
                        <Label htmlFor="projectName">Project Name</Label>
                        <Input
                          id="projectName"

import React, { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import { Card, CardContent } from '@/components/ui/card';
import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button';
import { AlertTriangle, TrendingUp, Globe, Zap } from 'lucide-react';
import { useLocation } from 'wouter';

interface DisruptionEvent {
  id: string;
  title: string;
  severity: 'low' | 'medium' | 'high' | 'critical';
  description: string;
  impactSummary: string;
  recommendedPosture: string;
  affectedSuppliers?: number;
  marginImpact?: number;
  confidence: number;
  timestamp: Date;
}

export default function DisruptionNarrative() {
  const [, setLocation] = useLocation();
  const [currentDisruption, setCurrentDisruption] = useState<DisruptionEvent | null>(null);
  const [pulseActive, setPulseActive] = useState(true);

  useEffect(() => {
    // Simulate real-time disruption detection
    const disruptions: DisruptionEvent[] = [
      {
        id: 'supply-chain-001',
        title: 'Global Supply Chain Volatility',
        severity: 'high',
        description: 'Major shipping route disruptions detected across Asia-Pacific region affecting 15+ critical supply chains.',
        impactSummary: '3 key suppliers affected, potential for 15% margin erosion within 30 days',
        recommendedPosture: 'Shift to proactive, adaptive posture to mitigate risk and identify alternative sourcing opportunities',
        affectedSuppliers: 3,
        marginImpact: 15,
        confidence: 87,
        timestamp: new Date()
      },
      {
        id: 'market-shift-002',
        title: 'Emerging Market Technology Shift',
        severity: 'medium',
        description: 'Rapid adoption of AI automation in competitor products accelerating market transformation.',
        impactSummary: 'Competitive positioning at risk, 25% of current product features may become obsolete',
        recommendedPosture: 'Accelerate innovation roadmap and strategic partnerships to maintain market leadership',
        confidence: 92,
        timestamp: new Date()
      }
    ];

    // Randomly select current disruption
    const randomDisruption = disruptions[Math.floor(Math.random() * disruptions.length)];
    setCurrentDisruption(randomDisruption);

    // Animate pulse effect
    const pulseInterval = setInterval(() => {
      setPulseActive(prev => !prev);
    }, 3000);

    return () => clearInterval(pulseInterval);
  }, []);

  if (!currentDisruption) return null;

  const getSeverityColor = (severity: string) => {
    switch (severity) {
      case 'critical': return 'from-red-600 to-red-500';
      case 'high': return 'from-orange-600 to-orange-500';
      case 'medium': return 'from-yellow-600 to-yellow-500';
      default: return 'from-blue-600 to-blue-500';
    }
  };

  const getSeverityIcon = (severity: string) => {
    switch (severity) {
      case 'critical': return <AlertTriangle className="w-8 h-8 text-white" />;
      case 'high': return <Globe className="w-8 h-8 text-white" />;
      case 'medium': return <TrendingUp className="w-8 h-8 text-white" />;
      default: return <Zap className="w-8 h-8 text-white" />;
    }
  };

  return (
    <Card className={`relative executive-card overflow-hidden transition-all duration-500 ${pulseActive ? 'ring-2 ring-orange-500/50' : ''}`}>
      {/* Animated Background */}
      <div className={`absolute inset-0 bg-gradient-to-br ${getSeverityColor(currentDisruption.severity)} opacity-5`}>
        <div className="absolute inset-0 animate-pulse opacity-20"></div>
      </div>

      <CardContent className="relative z-10 p-8">
        {/* Header */}
        <div className="flex items-start gap-6 mb-6">
          <div className={`flex items-center justify-center w-16 h-16 bg-gradient-to-br ${getSeverityColor(currentDisruption.severity)} rounded-2xl shadow-xl`}>
            {getSeverityIcon(currentDisruption.severity)}
          </div>
          
          <div className="flex-1">
            <div className="flex items-center gap-3 mb-2">
              <h2 className="text-2xl font-black text-foreground">
                Current Disruption
              </h2>
              <div className={`px-3 py-1 bg-gradient-to-r ${getSeverityColor(currentDisruption.severity)} text-white text-xs font-bold rounded-full uppercase tracking-wider`}>
                {currentDisruption.severity}
              </div>
            </div>
            <h3 className="text-3xl font-bold text-foreground mb-4">
              {currentDisruption.title}
            </h3>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Description */}
        <div className="mb-6 space-y-4">
          <p className="text-lg text-muted-foreground leading-relaxed">
            {currentDisruption.description}
          </p>
          
          {/* Impact Summary */}
          <div className="executive-card bg-orange-50 dark:bg-orange-950/20 border-l-4 border-orange-500 p-4 rounded-r-xl">
            <div className="flex items-start gap-3">
              <AlertTriangle className="w-5 h-5 text-orange-600 mt-0.5 flex-shrink-0" />
              <div>
                <h4 className="font-bold text-orange-800 dark:text-orange-300 mb-1">
                  Immediate Impact
                </h4>
                <p className="text-orange-700 dark:text-orange-400 text-sm leading-relaxed">
                  {currentDisruption.impactSummary}
                </p>
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* Recommended Posture */}
          <div className="executive-card bg-blue-50 dark:bg-blue-950/20 border-l-4 border-blue-500 p-4 rounded-r-xl">
            <div className="flex items-start gap-3">
              <Zap className="w-5 h-5 text-blue-600 mt-0.5 flex-shrink-0" />
              <div>
                <h4 className="font-bold text-blue-800 dark:text-blue-300 mb-1">
                  Strategic Posture
                </h4>
                <p className="text-blue-700 dark:text-blue-400 text-sm leading-relaxed">
                  {currentDisruption.recommendedPosture}
                </p>
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Metrics Row */}
        <div className="grid grid-cols-2 md:grid-cols-3 gap-4 mb-6">
          {currentDisruption.affectedSuppliers && (
            <div className="text-center p-3 executive-card rounded-xl">
              <div className="text-2xl font-black text-orange-600">
                {currentDisruption.affectedSuppliers}
              </div>
              <div className="text-xs text-muted-foreground uppercase tracking-wide">
                Suppliers Affected
              </div>
            </div>
          )}
          
          {currentDisruption.marginImpact && (
            <div className="text-center p-3 executive-card rounded-xl">
              <div className="text-2xl font-black text-red-600">
                {currentDisruption.marginImpact}%
              </div>
              <div className="text-xs text-muted-foreground uppercase tracking-wide">
                Margin Risk
              </div>
            </div>
          )}
          
          <div className="text-center p-3 executive-card rounded-xl">
            <div className="text-2xl font-black text-green-600">
              {currentDisruption.confidence}%
            </div>
            <div className="text-xs text-muted-foreground uppercase tracking-wide">
              AI Confidence
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Action Buttons */}
        <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row gap-3">
          <Button
            onClick={() => setLocation('/workflow-builder')}
            className="bg-gradient-to-r from-orange-600 to-orange-500 hover:from-orange-700 hover:to-orange-600 text-white font-bold px-6 py-3 executive-shadow flex-1"
          >
            <Zap className="w-5 h-5 mr-2" />
            Generate Response Plan
          </Button>
          <Button
            onClick={() => setLocation('/strategic-intelligence')}
            variant="outline"
            className="border-primary text-primary hover:bg-primary/10 font-bold px-6 py-3 flex-1"
          >
            <Globe className="w-5 h-5 mr-2" />
            Deep Analysis
          </Button>
        </div>
      </CardContent>
    </Card>
  );
}

  const filteredTemplates = templates.filter(template => {
    const matchesCategory = selectedCategory === 'all' || template.category === selectedCategory;
    const matchesPhase = selectedPhase === 'all' || template.phase === selectedPhase;
    const matchesSearch = searchTerm === '' || 
      template.name.toLowerCase().includes(searchTerm.toLowerCase()) ||
      template.description.toLowerCase().includes(searchTerm.toLowerCase());
    
    return matchesCategory && matchesPhase && matchesSearch;
  });

  const getSeverityColor = (severity: string) => {
    switch (severity) {
      case 'critical': return 'bg-red-100 text-red-700 border-red-300';
      case 'high': return 'bg-orange-100 text-orange-700 border-orange-300';
      case 'medium': return 'bg-yellow-100 text-yellow-700 border-yellow-300';
      case 'low': return 'bg-green-100 text-green-700 border-green-300';
      default: return 'bg-gray-100 text-gray-700 border-gray-300';
    }
  };

  const getCategoryIcon = (category: string) => {
    const categoryData = categories.find(c => c.id === category);
    return categoryData ? categoryData.icon : FileText;
  };

  const renderFieldInput = (field: TemplateField, value: any, onChange: (value: any) => void) => {
    switch (field.type) {
      case 'textarea':
        return (
          <Textarea
            placeholder={field.placeholder}
            value={value || ''}
            onChange={(e) => onChange(e.target.value)}
            className="min-h-[80px]"
          />
        );
      case 'select':
        return (
          <select
            value={value || ''}
            onChange={(e) => onChange(e.target.value)}
            className="w-full p-2 border border-gray-300 rounded-md"
          >
            <option value="">Select an option...</option>
            {field.options?.map(option => (
              <option key={option} value={option}>{option}</option>
            ))}
          </select>
        );
      case 'multiselect':
        return (
          <div className="space-y-2">
            {field.options?.map(option => (
              <label key={option} className="flex items-center space-x-2">
                <input
                  type="checkbox"
                  checked={(value || []).includes(option)}
                  onChange={(e) => {
                    const current = value || [];
                    if (e.target.checked) {
                      onChange([...current, option]);
                    } else {
                      onChange(current.filter((v: string) => v !== option));
                    }
                  }}
                />
                <span className="text-sm">{option}</span>
              </label>
            ))}
          </div>
        );
      case 'boolean':
        return (
          <label className="flex items-center space-x-2">
            <input
              type="checkbox"
              checked={value || false}
              onChange={(e) => onChange(e.target.checked)}
            />
            <span className="text-sm">Yes</span>
          </label>
        );
      case 'number':
        return (
          <Input
            type="number"
            placeholder={field.placeholder}
            value={value || ''}
            onChange={(e) => onChange(e.target.value)}
          />
        );
      case 'currency':
        return (
          <Input
            type="number"
            placeholder={field.placeholder}
            value={value || ''}
            onChange={(e) => onChange(e.target.value)}
            className="pl-8"
          />
        );
      case 'date':
        return (
          <Input
            type="date"
            value={value || ''}
            onChange={(e) => onChange(e.target.value)}
          />
        );
      case 'time':
        return (
          <Input
            type="time"
            value={value || ''}
            onChange={(e) => onChange(e.target.value)}
          />
        );
      default:
        return (
          <Input
            placeholder={field.placeholder}
            value={value || ''}
            onChange={(e) => onChange(e.target.value)}
          />
        );
    }
  };

  if (selectedTemplate && isEditing) {
    return (
      <div className="min-h-screen bg-gradient-to-br from-blue-50 to-purple-50 p-6">
        <div className="max-w-4xl mx-auto">
          <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-6">
            <div>
              <h1 className="text-3xl font-bold text-gray-900">{selectedTemplate.name}</h1>
              <p className="text-gray-600">{selectedTemplate.description}</p>
            </div>
            <div className="flex space-x-3">
              <Button onClick={() => setIsEditing(false)} variant="outline">
                Cancel
              </Button>
              <Button>
                <Save className="w-4 h-4 mr-2" />
                Save Template
              </Button>
            </div>
          </div>

          <Card>
            <CardContent className="p-6">
              <div className="space-y-8">
                {/* Executive Decision Section */}
                <div>
                  <h3 className="text-lg font-semibold text-gray-900 mb-4 flex items-center">
                    <Target className="w-5 h-5 mr-2" />
                    Executive Decisions Required
                  </h3>
                  <div className="space-y-6">
                    {selectedTemplate.executiveDecisions.map((decision) => (
                      <div key={decision.id} className="space-y-2">
                        <label className="block text-sm font-medium text-gray-700">
                          {decision.name}
                          {decision.required && <span className="text-red-500 ml-1">*</span>}
                        </label>
                        {renderFieldInput(decision, '', () => {})}
                        {decision.helpText && (
                          <p className="text-xs text-gray-500">{decision.helpText}</p>
                        )}
                      </div>
                    ))}
                  </div>
                </div>

                {/* Execution Plan Section */}
                <div>
                  <h3 className="text-lg font-semibold text-gray-900 mb-4 flex items-center">
                    <Zap className="w-5 h-5 mr-2" />
                    Immediate Execution Plan
                  </h3>
                  <div className="space-y-4">
                    {selectedTemplate.executionPlan.map((action, index) => (
                      <Card key={action.id} className="border-l-4 border-blue-500">
                        <CardContent className="p-4">
                          <div className="flex items-start justify-between mb-2">
                            <div>
                              <h4 className="font-semibold text-gray-900">{action.title}</h4>
                              <p className="text-sm text-gray-600">{action.description}</p>
                            </div>
                            <Badge className={action.priority === 'critical' ? 'bg-red-100 text-red-700' : 
                                           action.priority === 'high' ? 'bg-orange-100 text-orange-700' : 
                                           'bg-blue-100 text-blue-700'}>
                              {action.priority.toUpperCase()}
                            </Badge>
                          </div>
                          
                          <div className="grid grid-cols-2 md:grid-cols-4 gap-4 mt-3 text-sm">
                            <div>
                              <span className="text-gray-500">Owner:</span>
                              <p className="font-medium">{action.owner}</p>
                            </div>
                            <div>
                              <span className="text-gray-500">Timeframe:</span>
                              <p className="font-medium">{action.timeframe}</p>
                            </div>
                            <div>
                              <span className="text-gray-500">Resources:</span>
                              <p className="font-medium">{action.resources.length} teams</p>
                            </div>
                            <div>
                              <span className="text-gray-500">Metrics:</span>
                              <p className="font-medium">{action.successMetrics.length} KPIs</p>
                            </div>
                          </div>
                        </CardContent>
                      </Card>
                    ))}
                  </div>
                </div>

                {/* Business Impact Analysis */}
                <div>
                  <h3 className="text-lg font-semibold text-gray-900 mb-4 flex items-center">
                    <BarChart3 className="w-5 h-5 mr-2" />
                    Business Impact Analysis
                  </h3>
                  <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 gap-4">
                    <Card>
                      <CardContent className="p-4">
                        <h4 className="font-medium text-gray-900 mb-2">Revenue Impact</h4>
                        <p className="text-sm text-gray-600">{selectedTemplate.businessImpact.revenue}</p>
                      </CardContent>
                    </Card>
                    <Card>
                      <CardContent className="p-4">
                        <h4 className="font-medium text-gray-900 mb-2">Operations Impact</h4>
                        <p className="text-sm text-gray-600">{selectedTemplate.businessImpact.operations}</p>
                      </CardContent>
                    </Card>
                    <Card>
                      <CardContent className="p-4">
                        <h4 className="font-medium text-gray-900 mb-2">Reputation Impact</h4>
                        <p className="text-sm text-gray-600">{selectedTemplate.businessImpact.reputation}</p>
                      </CardContent>
                    </Card>
                    <Card>
                      <CardContent className="p-4">
                        <h4 className="font-medium text-gray-900 mb-2">Compliance Impact</h4>
                        <p className="text-sm text-gray-600">{selectedTemplate.businessImpact.compliance}</p>
                      </CardContent>
                    </Card>
                  </div>
                </div>

                {/* Success Criteria */}
                <div>
                  <h3 className="text-lg font-semibold text-gray-900 mb-4 flex items-center">
                    <CheckCircle className="w-5 h-5 mr-2" />
                    Success Criteria
                  </h3>
                  <div className="space-y-2">
                    {selectedTemplate.successCriteria.map((criteria, index) => (
                      <div key={index} className="flex items-center space-x-2">
                        <CheckCircle className="w-4 h-4 text-green-600" />
                        <span className="text-sm text-gray-700">{criteria}</span>
                      </div>
                    ))}
                  </div>
                </div>
              </div>
            </CardContent>
          </Card>
        </div>
      </div>
    );
  }

  return (
    <div className="min-h-screen bg-gradient-to-br from-blue-50 to-purple-50 p-6">
      <div className="max-w-7xl mx-auto space-y-8">
        {/* Header */}
        <div className="text-center">
          <h1 className="text-4xl font-bold text-gray-900 mb-2">
            Disruption Template Library
          </h1>
          <p className="text-gray-600 max-w-3xl mx-auto text-lg">
            Comprehensive templates for all phases of disruption management across industries and scenarios
          </p>
        </div>

        {/* Filters and Search */}
        <Card>
          <CardContent className="p-6">
            <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 gap-6">
              {/* Search */}
              <div className="space-y-2">
                <label className="text-sm font-medium text-gray-700">Search Templates</label>
                <div className="relative">
                  <Search className="w-4 h-4 absolute left-3 top-3 text-gray-400" />
                  <Input
                    placeholder="Search by name or description..."
                    value={searchTerm}
                    onChange={(e) => setSearchTerm(e.target.value)}
                    className="pl-10"
                  />
                </div>
              </div>

              {/* Category Filter */}
              <div className="space-y-2">
                <label className="text-sm font-medium text-gray-700">Category</label>
                <select
                  value={selectedCategory}
                  onChange={(e) => setSelectedCategory(e.target.value)}
                  className="w-full p-2 border border-gray-300 rounded-md"
                >
                  {categories.map(category => (
                    <option key={category.id} value={category.id}>
                      {category.name}
                    </option>
                  ))}
                </select>
              </div>

              {/* Phase Filter */}
              <div className="space-y-2">
                <label className="text-sm font-medium text-gray-700">Phase</label>
                <select
                  value={selectedPhase}
                  onChange={(e) => setSelectedPhase(e.target.value)}
                  className="w-full p-2 border border-gray-300 rounded-md"
                >
                  {phases.map(phase => (
                    <option key={phase.id} value={phase.id}>
                      {phase.name}
                    </option>
                  ))}
                </select>
              </div>
            </div>
          </CardContent>
        </Card>

        {/* Template Grid */}
        <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-6">
          {filteredTemplates.map((template) => {
            const CategoryIcon = getCategoryIcon(template.category);
            
            return (
              <Card key={template.id} className="hover:shadow-lg transition-shadow cursor-pointer">
                <CardHeader className="pb-4">
                  <div className="flex items-start justify-between">
                    <div className="flex items-center space-x-3">
                      <div className="p-2 bg-blue-100 rounded-lg">
                        <CategoryIcon className="w-5 h-5 text-blue-600" />
                      </div>
                      <div>
                        <CardTitle className="text-lg">{template.name}</CardTitle>
                        <p className="text-sm text-gray-500 capitalize">{template.phase} Phase</p>
                      </div>
                    </div>
                    <Badge className={getSeverityColor(template.severity)}>
                      {template.severity.toUpperCase()}
                    </Badge>
                  </div>
                </CardHeader>
                <CardContent>
                  <p className="text-gray-600 text-sm mb-4">{template.description}</p>
                  
                  <div className="space-y-3">
                    <div className="flex items-center justify-between text-sm">
                      <span className="text-gray-500">Decisions:</span>
                      <span className="font-medium">{template.executiveDecisions.length}</span>
                    </div>
                    <div className="flex items-center justify-between text-sm">
                      <span className="text-gray-500">Actions:</span>
                      <span className="font-medium">{template.executionPlan.length}</span>
                    </div>
                    <div className="flex items-center justify-between text-sm">
                      <span className="text-gray-500">Est. Time:</span>
                      <span className="font-medium">{template.estimatedTime}</span>
                    </div>
                    <div className="flex items-center justify-between text-sm">
                      <span className="text-gray-500">Industries:</span>
                      <span className="font-medium">{template.industry.length}</span>
                    </div>
                  </div>

                  <div className="flex space-x-2 mt-4">
                    <Button 
                      size="sm" 
                      className="flex-1"
                      onClick={() => {
                        setSelectedTemplate(template);
                        setIsEditing(true);
                      }}
                    >
                      <Zap className="w-4 h-4 mr-1" />
                      Execute Plan
                    </Button>
                    <Button size="sm" variant="outline">
                      <Copy className="w-4 h-4" />
                    </Button>
                    <Button size="sm" variant="outline">
                      <Download className="w-4 h-4" />
                    </Button>
                  </div>
                </CardContent>
              </Card>
            );
          })}
        </div>

        {/* Summary Stats */}
        <Card className="bg-gradient-to-r from-blue-600 to-indigo-600 text-white">
          <CardContent className="p-6">
            <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-4 gap-6">
              <div className="text-center">
                <div className="text-3xl font-bold">{templates.length}</div>
                <div className="text-blue-200">Total Templates</div>
              </div>
              <div className="text-center">
                <div className="text-3xl font-bold">{categories.length - 1}</div>
                <div className="text-blue-200">Categories</div>
              </div>
              <div className="text-center">
                <div className="text-3xl font-bold">{phases.length - 1}</div>
                <div className="text-blue-200">Crisis Phases</div>
              </div>
              <div className="text-center">
                <div className="text-3xl font-bold">
                  {templates.reduce((sum, t) => sum + t.executionPlan.length, 0)}
                </div>
                <div className="text-blue-200">Action Plans</div>
              </div>
            </div>
          </CardContent>
        </Card>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

export default DisruptionTemplateLibrary;

              </button>
            ))}
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Tab Content */}
        <div className="min-h-96">
          {activeTab === 'overview' && renderOverview()}
          {activeTab === 'integrations' && renderIntegrations()}
          {activeTab === 'switching' && renderSwitchingAnalysis()}
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

export default EcosystemLockIn;

          {activeTab === 'achievements' && renderAchievements()}
          {activeTab === 'challenges' && renderChallenges()}
          {activeTab === 'leaderboard' && renderLeaderboard()}

      </div>

                        <div className="text-white font-bold">#{leader.rank}</div>
                        <div className="text-yellow-400 text-sm">{leader.points.toLocaleString()} pts</div>
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  ))}
                </div>
              </CardContent>
            </Card>
          </TabsContent>
        </Tabs>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
