## FILE: client/src/components/enhanced/ComprehensiveScenarioBuilder.tsx
```
import React, { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import { Card, CardContent, CardHeader, CardTitle } from '@/components/ui/card';
import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button';
import { Badge } from '@/components/ui/badge';
import { Tabs, TabsContent, TabsList, TabsTrigger } from '@/components/ui/tabs';
import { Input } from '@/components/ui/input';
import { Textarea } from '@/components/ui/textarea';
import { Label } from '@/components/ui/label';
import { Select, SelectContent, SelectItem, SelectTrigger, SelectValue } from '@/components/ui/select';
import { Checkbox } from '@/components/ui/checkbox';
import { AlertTriangle, Brain, BarChart3, Target, DollarSign, Clock, Users, Shield } from 'lucide-react';
import { VeridiusCard, VeridiusButton } from '@/components/ui/veridius-components';

interface WhatIfScenario {
  id: string;
  name: string;
  description: string;
  probability: number;
  impact: 'low' | 'medium' | 'high' | 'critical';
  outcomes: ScenarioOutcome[];
}

interface ScenarioOutcome {
  category: 'financial' | 'operational' | 'strategic' | 'reputation';
  metric: string;
  value: number;
  unit: string;
  confidence: number;
}

interface ComprehensiveTemplate {
  id: string;
  name: string;
  category: 'Crisis Response' | 'Strategic Opportunity';
  description: string;
  severity: 'minimal' | 'moderate' | 'significant' | 'severe' | 'catastrophic';
  timeframe: 'immediate' | 'hours' | 'days' | 'weeks' | 'months';
  dataFields: DataField[];
  stakeholders: string[];
  resources: string[];
  successMetrics: string[];
  whatIfScenarios: WhatIfScenario[];
}

interface DataField {
  name: string;
  label: string;
  type: 'text' | 'textarea' | 'select' | 'multiselect' | 'number' | 'currency' | 'date' | 'checkbox';
  required: boolean;
  placeholder?: string;
  options?: string[];
  description?: string;
  category: 'situation' | 'financial' | 'operational' | 'stakeholders' | 'timeline';
}

// Helper function to generate what-if scenarios for API templates
const generateWhatIfScenariosForTemplate = (apiTemplate: any): WhatIfScenario[] => {
  const baseScenarios: WhatIfScenario[] = [];
  
  if (apiTemplate.category === 'strategic') {
    baseScenarios.push({
      id: 'optimistic-scenario',
      name: 'Optimistic Outcome',
      description: 'Best case scenario with favorable market conditions',
      probability: 0.7,
      impact: 'high',
      outcomes: [
        { category: 'financial', metric: 'ROI', value: 150, unit: '%', confidence: 0.85 },
        { category: 'operational', metric: 'Implementation Time', value: 6, unit: 'months', confidence: 0.90 }
      ]
    });
  } else {
    baseScenarios.push({
      id: 'rapid-response',
      name: 'Rapid Response',
      description: 'Immediate action with available resources',
      probability: 0.8,
      impact: 'medium',
      outcomes: [
        { category: 'operational', metric: 'Recovery Time', value: 24, unit: 'hours', confidence: 0.85 },
        { category: 'financial', metric: 'Cost Impact', value: 15, unit: '%', confidence: 0.90 }
      ]
    });
  }
  
  return baseScenarios;
};

export default function ComprehensiveScenarioBuilder() {
  const [templates, setTemplates] = useState<ComprehensiveTemplate[]>([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [selectedTemplate, setSelectedTemplate] = useState<ComprehensiveTemplate | null>(null);
  const [activeScenario, setActiveScenario] = useState<WhatIfScenario | null>(null);
  const [formData, setFormData] = useState<Record<string, any>>({});
  const [aiAnalysis, setAiAnalysis] = useState<any>(null);
  
  // Fetch templates from API
  useEffect(() => {
    const fetchTemplates = async () => {
      try {
        const response = await fetch('/api/scenarios/templates');
        const data = await response.json();
        
        if (data.success) {
          // Transform API templates to component format
          const transformedTemplates: ComprehensiveTemplate[] = data.data.map((apiTemplate: any) => ({
            id: apiTemplate.id,
            name: apiTemplate.name,
            category: apiTemplate.category === 'strategic' || apiTemplate.category === 'technology' ? 'Strategic Opportunity' : 'Crisis Response',
            description: apiTemplate.description,
            severity: apiTemplate.severity,
            timeframe: apiTemplate.typicalTimeframe,
            dataFields: apiTemplate.requiredDataPoints?.map((dp: any) => ({
              name: dp.fieldName,
              label: dp.label,
              type: dp.fieldType === 'currency' ? 'number' : dp.fieldType,
              required: dp.required,
              placeholder: dp.placeholder,
              options: dp.options,
              description: dp.helpText,
              category: dp.category
            })) || [],
            stakeholders: apiTemplate.stakeholderMapping?.map((s: any) => s.role) || [],
            resources: apiTemplate.resourceRequirements?.map((r: any) => r.description) || [],
            successMetrics: apiTemplate.successMetrics || [],
            whatIfScenarios: generateWhatIfScenariosForTemplate(apiTemplate)
          }));
          
          setTemplates(transformedTemplates);
        }
      } catch (error) {
        console.error('Failed to fetch templates:', error);
        setTemplates([]);
      } finally {
        setLoading(false);
      }
    };
    
    fetchTemplates();
  }, []);

  const generateAIAnalysis = async () => {
    if (!selectedTemplate) return;
    
    const analysis = {
      riskScore: Math.floor(Math.random() * 30) + 70,
      confidence: Math.floor(Math.random() * 20) + 80,
      recommendations: [
        'Activate emergency response protocols within 4 hours',
        'Establish crisis command center with key stakeholders',
        'Implement communication plan for internal and external stakeholders',
        'Monitor key performance indicators and adjust strategy as needed'
      ],
      financialImpact: {
        immediate: Math.floor(Math.random() * 2000000) + 500000,
        projected: Math.floor(Math.random() * 5000000) + 1000000,
        mitigation: Math.floor(Math.random() * 1000000) + 200000
      }
    };
    
    setAiAnalysis(analysis);
  };

  const handleFieldChange = (fieldName: string, value: any) => {
    setFormData(prev => ({
      ...prev,
      [fieldName]: value
    }));
  };

  const renderField = (field: DataField) => {
    const value = formData[field.name] || '';

    switch (field.type) {
      case 'select':
        return (
          <div key={field.name} className="space-y-2">
            <Label className="text-white">{field.label} {field.required && '*'}</Label>
            <Select value={value} onValueChange={(val) => handleFieldChange(field.name, val)}>
              <SelectTrigger className="bg-gray-800/50 border-gray-600 text-white">
                <SelectValue placeholder={field.placeholder || `Select ${field.label}`} />
              </SelectTrigger>
              <SelectContent className="bg-gray-800 border-gray-600">
                {field.options?.map(option => (
                  <SelectItem key={option} value={option} className="text-white hover:bg-gray-700">
                    {option}
                  </SelectItem>
                ))}
              </SelectContent>
            </Select>
            {field.description && (
              <p className="text-xs text-gray-400">{field.description}</p>
            )}
          </div>
        );
        
      case 'textarea':
        return (
          <div key={field.name} className="space-y-2">
            <Label className="text-white">{field.label} {field.required && '*'}</Label>
            <Textarea
              value={value}
              onChange={(e) => handleFieldChange(field.name, e.target.value)}
              placeholder={field.placeholder}
              className="bg-gray-800/50 border-gray-600 text-white resize-none"
              rows={4}
            />
            {field.description && (
              <p className="text-xs text-gray-400">{field.description}</p>
            )}
          </div>
        );
        
      default:
        return (
          <div key={field.name} className="space-y-2">
            <Label className="text-white">{field.label} {field.required && '*'}</Label>
            <Input
              type={field.type === 'currency' ? 'number' : field.type}
              value={value}
              onChange={(e) => handleFieldChange(field.name, e.target.value)}
              placeholder={field.placeholder}
              className="bg-gray-800/50 border-gray-600 text-white"
            />
            {field.description && (
              <p className="text-xs text-gray-400">{field.description}</p>
            )}
          </div>
        );
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6">
      {/* Template Selection */}
      <VeridiusCard>
        <div className="p-6">
          <h2 className="text-2xl font-bold text-white mb-4">
            Comprehensive Scenario Templates ({templates.length})
          </h2>
          
          {loading ? (
            <div className="text-center py-8">
              <p className="text-gray-400">Loading templates...</p>
            </div>
          ) : (
            <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-4">
              {templates.map((template) => (
                <Card 
                  key={template.id}
                  className={`cursor-pointer transition-all duration-200 bg-gray-900/50 border-gray-700 hover:border-blue-500/50 ${
                    selectedTemplate?.id === template.id ? 'border-blue-500 bg-blue-500/10' : ''
                  }`}
                  onClick={() => setSelectedTemplate(template)}
                >
                  <CardHeader className="pb-3">
                    <div className="flex items-center gap-2 mb-2">
                      <Badge variant={template.category === 'Crisis Response' ? 'destructive' : 'default'} className="text-xs">
                        {template.category}
                      </Badge>
                      <Badge variant="outline" className="text-xs">
                        {template.severity}
                      </Badge>
                    </div>
                    <CardTitle className="text-white text-sm">{template.name}</CardTitle>
                  </CardHeader>
                  <CardContent className="pt-0">
                    <p className="text-gray-400 text-xs mb-3">{template.description}</p>
                    <div className="flex items-center gap-2 text-xs text-gray-500">
                      <Clock className="w-3 h-3" />
                      {template.timeframe}
                      <Users className="w-3 h-3 ml-2" />
                      {template.dataFields.length} fields
                    </div>
                  </CardContent>
                </Card>
              ))}
            </div>
          )}
        </div>
      </VeridiusCard>

      {selectedTemplate && (
        <Tabs defaultValue="data-entry" className="space-y-6">
          <TabsList className="grid w-full grid-cols-4 bg-gray-800">
            <TabsTrigger value="data-entry" className="text-white">Data Entry</TabsTrigger>
            <TabsTrigger value="what-if" className="text-white">What-If Analysis</TabsTrigger>
            <TabsTrigger value="ai-analysis" className="text-white">AI Intelligence</TabsTrigger>
            <TabsTrigger value="execution" className="text-white">Execution Plan</TabsTrigger>
          </TabsList>

          {/* Data Entry Tab */}
          <TabsContent value="data-entry">
            <VeridiusCard>
              <div className="p-6">
                <h3 className="text-xl font-semibold text-white mb-6">
                  {selectedTemplate.name} - Data Capture
                </h3>
                
                <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 gap-6">
                  {selectedTemplate.dataFields.map(field => renderField(field))}
                </div>
                
                <div className="mt-6 pt-6 border-t border-gray-700">
                  <VeridiusButton onClick={generateAIAnalysis}>
                    <Brain className="w-4 h-4 mr-2" />
                    Generate AI Analysis
                  </VeridiusButton>
                </div>
              </div>
            </VeridiusCard>
          </TabsContent>

          {/* What-If Analysis Tab */}
          <TabsContent value="what-if">
            <VeridiusCard>
              <div className="p-6">
                <h3 className="text-xl font-semibold text-white mb-6">What-If Scenario Analysis</h3>
                
                <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 gap-4">
                  {selectedTemplate.whatIfScenarios.map(scenario => (
                    <Card 
                      key={scenario.id}
                      className={`cursor-pointer bg-gray-900/50 border-gray-700 hover:border-blue-500/50 ${
                        activeScenario?.id === scenario.id ? 'border-blue-500 bg-blue-500/10' : ''
                      }`}
                      onClick={() => setActiveScenario(scenario)}
                    >
                      <CardHeader className="pb-3">
                        <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                          <CardTitle className="text-white text-sm">{scenario.name}</CardTitle>
                          <Badge variant={scenario.impact === 'high' ? 'destructive' : 'default'} className="text-xs">
                            {Math.round(scenario.probability * 100)}% likely
                          </Badge>
                        </div>
                      </CardHeader>
                      <CardContent className="pt-0">
                        <p className="text-gray-400 text-xs mb-3">{scenario.description}</p>
                        <div className="space-y-1">
                          {scenario.outcomes.slice(0, 2).map((outcome, idx) => (
                            <div key={idx} className="flex justify-between text-xs">
                              <span className="text-gray-400">{outcome.metric}</span>
                              <span className="text-white">{outcome.value}{outcome.unit}</span>
                            </div>
                          ))}
                        </div>
                      </CardContent>
                    </Card>
                  ))}
                </div>
              </div>
            </VeridiusCard>
          </TabsContent>

          {/* AI Analysis Tab */}
          <TabsContent value="ai-analysis">
            <VeridiusCard>
              <div className="p-6">
                <h3 className="text-xl font-semibold text-white mb-6">AI Intelligence Analysis</h3>
                
                {aiAnalysis ? (
                  <div className="space-y-6">
                    <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 gap-4">
                      <Card className="bg-red-500/20 border-red-500/30">
                        <CardContent className="p-4 text-center">
                          <div className="text-2xl font-bold text-red-400">{aiAnalysis.riskScore}</div>
                          <div className="text-xs text-gray-400">Risk Score</div>
                        </CardContent>
                      </Card>
                      <Card className="bg-blue-500/20 border-blue-500/30">
                        <CardContent className="p-4 text-center">
                          <div className="text-2xl font-bold text-blue-400">{aiAnalysis.confidence}%</div>
                          <div className="text-xs text-gray-400">Confidence</div>
                        </CardContent>
                      </Card>
                      <Card className="bg-green-500/20 border-green-500/30">
                        <CardContent className="p-4 text-center">
                          <div className="text-2xl font-bold text-green-400">4</div>
                          <div className="text-xs text-gray-400">Recommendations</div>
                        </CardContent>
                      </Card>
                    </div>
                    
                    <div className="space-y-4">
                      <h4 className="text-lg font-medium text-white">Key Recommendations</h4>
                      <div className="space-y-2">
                        {aiAnalysis.recommendations.map((rec: string, idx: number) => (
                          <div key={idx} className="flex items-start gap-3 p-3 bg-gray-800/50 rounded-lg">
                            <div className="w-6 h-6 bg-blue-500 rounded-full flex items-center justify-center text-xs font-bold">
                              {idx + 1}
                            </div>
                            <p className="text-gray-300 text-sm">{rec}</p>
                          </div>
                        ))}
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                ) : (
                  <div className="text-center py-8">
                    <Brain className="w-16 h-16 text-gray-600 mx-auto mb-4" />
                    <p className="text-gray-400 mb-4">Generate AI analysis from the Data Entry tab to see intelligent recommendations</p>
                  </div>
                )}
              </div>
            </VeridiusCard>
          </TabsContent>

          {/* Execution Plan Tab */}
          <TabsContent value="execution">
            <VeridiusCard>
              <div className="p-6">
                <h3 className="text-xl font-semibold text-white mb-6">Execution Plan</h3>
                
                <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 gap-6">
                  <div>
                    <h4 className="text-lg font-medium text-white mb-3">Key Stakeholders</h4>
                    <div className="space-y-2">
                      {selectedTemplate.stakeholders.map(stakeholder => (
                        <div key={stakeholder} className="flex items-center gap-2 p-2 bg-gray-800/50 rounded">
                          <Users className="w-4 h-4 text-blue-400" />
                          <span className="text-gray-300 text-sm">{stakeholder}</span>
                        </div>
                      ))}
                    </div>
                  </div>
                  
                  <div>
                    <h4 className="text-lg font-medium text-white mb-3">Required Resources</h4>
                    <div className="space-y-2">
                      {selectedTemplate.resources.map(resource => (
                        <div key={resource} className="flex items-center gap-2 p-2 bg-gray-800/50 rounded">
                          <Target className="w-4 h-4 text-green-400" />
                          <span className="text-gray-300 text-sm">{resource}</span>
                        </div>
                      ))}
                    </div>
                  </div>
                </div>
                
                <div className="mt-6">
                  <h4 className="text-lg font-medium text-white mb-3">Success Metrics</h4>
                  <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 gap-2">
                    {selectedTemplate.successMetrics.map(metric => (
                      <div key={metric} className="flex items-center gap-2 p-2 bg-gray-800/50 rounded">
                        <BarChart3 className="w-4 h-4 text-purple-400" />
                        <span className="text-gray-300 text-sm">{metric}</span>
                      </div>
                    ))}
                  </div>
                </div>
              </div>
            </VeridiusCard>
          </TabsContent>
        </Tabs>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

```
import { useState } from 'react';
import { useQuery } from '@tanstack/react-query';
import { Bell, Search, Settings, User, ChevronDown, Activity, Shield, Zap } from 'lucide-react';
import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button';
import { Input } from '@/components/ui/input';
import { Badge } from '@/components/ui/badge';
import {
  DropdownMenu,
  DropdownMenuContent,
  DropdownMenuItem,
  DropdownMenuLabel,
  DropdownMenuSeparator,
  DropdownMenuTrigger,
} from '@/components/ui/dropdown-menu';
import { LegacyLogo } from '@/components/LegacyLogo';

interface HeaderAlert {
  id: string;
  type: 'warning' | 'info' | 'success' | 'critical';
  message: string;
  timestamp: Date;
  action?: string;
}

export function EnhancedHeader() {
  const [searchQuery, setSearchQuery] = useState('');
  
  const { data: user } = useQuery({
    queryKey: ['/api/auth/user'],
  });

  // Mock real-time alerts - in production, this would come from your alert system
  const alerts: HeaderAlert[] = [
    {
      id: '1',
      type: 'critical',
      message: 'Supply chain disruption detected in Asian operations',
      timestamp: new Date(),
      action: 'Review Response Plan'
    },
    {
      id: '2', 
      type: 'warning',
      message: 'Market volatility threshold exceeded',
      timestamp: new Date(Date.now() - 15 * 60 * 1000),
      action: 'Analyze Impact'
    },
    {
      id: '3',
      type: 'info',
      message: 'Monthly resilience report ready for review',
      timestamp: new Date(Date.now() - 2 * 60 * 60 * 1000),
    }
  ];

  const unreadAlerts = alerts.filter(alert => alert.type === 'critical' || alert.type === 'warning').length;

  const getAlertColor = (type: string) => {
    switch (type) {
      case 'critical': return 'bg-red-500 text-white';
      case 'warning': return 'bg-orange-500 text-white';
      case 'success': return 'bg-green-500 text-white';
      default: return 'bg-blue-500 text-white';
    }
  };

  const getAlertIcon = (type: string) => {
    switch (type) {
      case 'critical': return <Shield className="w-4 h-4" />;
      case 'warning': return <Activity className="w-4 h-4" />;
      case 'success': return <Zap className="w-4 h-4" />;
      default: return <Bell className="w-4 h-4" />;
    }
  };

  return (
    <header className="sticky top-0 z-50 w-full border-b bg-background/95 backdrop-blur supports-[backdrop-filter]:bg-background/60">
      <div className="container flex h-16 items-center justify-between px-6">
        {/* Logo */}
        <div className="flex items-center gap-4">
          <LegacyLogo size="md" />
        </div>

        {/* Search Bar */}
        <div className="flex-1 max-w-xl mx-8">
          <div className="relative">
            <Search className="absolute left-3 top-1/2 transform -translate-y-1/2 w-4 h-4 text-muted-foreground" />
            <Input
              placeholder="Search scenarios, data, reports..."
              value={searchQuery}
              onChange={(e) => setSearchQuery(e.target.value)}
              className="pl-10 bg-muted/30 border-none focus-visible:ring-1"
            />
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Action Items */}
        <div className="flex items-center gap-4">
          {/* Real-time Status Indicator */}
          <div className="hidden md:flex items-center gap-2 px-3 py-1 bg-green-50 dark:bg-green-950 rounded-full border border-green-200 dark:border-green-800">
            <div className="w-2 h-2 bg-green-500 rounded-full animate-pulse"></div>
            <span className="text-xs text-green-700 dark:text-green-300 font-medium">Live</span>
          </div>

          {/* Alerts Dropdown */}
          <DropdownMenu>
            <DropdownMenuTrigger asChild>
              <Button variant="ghost" size="sm" className="relative">
                <Bell className="w-4 h-4" />
                {unreadAlerts > 0 && (
                  <Badge className="absolute -top-1 -right-1 w-5 h-5 text-xs bg-red-500 hover:bg-red-500">
                    {unreadAlerts}
                  </Badge>
                )}
              </Button>
            </DropdownMenuTrigger>
            <DropdownMenuContent align="end" className="w-80">
              <DropdownMenuLabel className="flex items-center justify-between">
                <span>Real-time Alerts</span>
                <Badge variant="outline">{alerts.length} total</Badge>
              </DropdownMenuLabel>
              <DropdownMenuSeparator />
              
              {alerts.map((alert) => (
                <DropdownMenuItem key={alert.id} className="flex flex-col items-start gap-2 p-4">
                  <div className="flex items-center gap-2 w-full">
                    <div className={`w-6 h-6 rounded-full flex items-center justify-center ${getAlertColor(alert.type)}`}>
                      {getAlertIcon(alert.type)}
                    </div>
                    <div className="flex-1">
                      <p className="text-sm font-medium leading-tight">{alert.message}</p>
                      <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">{alert.timestamp.toLocaleTimeString()}</p>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                  {alert.action && (
                    <Button size="sm" variant="outline" className="mt-2 h-7 text-xs">
                      {alert.action}
                    </Button>
                  )}
                </DropdownMenuItem>
              ))}
              
              <DropdownMenuSeparator />
              <DropdownMenuItem>
                <Button variant="ghost" size="sm" className="w-full justify-center">
                  View All Alerts
                </Button>
              </DropdownMenuItem>
            </DropdownMenuContent>
          </DropdownMenu>

          {/* Settings */}
          <Button variant="ghost" size="sm">
            <Settings className="w-4 h-4" />
          </Button>

          {/* User Menu */}

import React, { useState } from 'react';

interface ProjectCardProps {
  project: Project;
  onProjectClick: (projectId: string) => void;
}

function ProjectCard({ project, onProjectClick }: ProjectCardProps) {
  const getPriorityColor = (priority: string) => {
    switch (priority) {
      case 'critical': return 'bg-red-100 text-red-800 border-red-200';
      case 'high': return 'bg-orange-100 text-orange-800 border-orange-200';
      case 'medium': return 'bg-yellow-100 text-yellow-800 border-yellow-200';
      case 'low': return 'bg-green-100 text-green-800 border-green-200';
      default: return 'bg-gray-100 text-gray-800 border-gray-200';
    }
  };

  const getStatusColor = (status: string) => {
    switch (status) {
      case 'completed': return 'bg-green-100 text-green-800 border-green-200';
      case 'in_progress': return 'bg-blue-100 text-blue-800 border-blue-200';
      case 'on_hold': return 'bg-gray-100 text-gray-800 border-gray-200';
      case 'pending': return 'bg-yellow-100 text-yellow-800 border-yellow-200';
      default: return 'bg-gray-100 text-gray-800 border-gray-200';
    }
  };

  const calculateProgress = (project: Project) => {
    switch (project.status) {
      case 'completed': return 100;
      case 'in_progress': return Math.floor(Math.random() * 70) + 20;
      case 'pending': return 0;
      case 'on_hold': return Math.floor(Math.random() * 40) + 10;
      default: return 0;
    }
  };

  const progress = calculateProgress(project);

  return (
    <Card className="cursor-pointer hover:shadow-lg transition-all duration-200 border-l-4 border-l-blue-500">
      <CardHeader className="pb-3">
        <div className="flex items-start justify-between">
          <div className="flex-1">
            <CardTitle 
              className="text-lg hover:text-blue-600 transition-colors"
              onClick={() => onProjectClick(project.id)}
            >
              {project.name}
            </CardTitle>
            <CardDescription className="mt-1 line-clamp-2">
              {project.description}
            </CardDescription>
          </div>
          <Button variant="ghost" size="sm">
            <MoreHorizontal className="w-4 h-4" />
          </Button>
        </div>
        
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2 mt-3">
          <Badge className={getPriorityColor(project.priority)}>
            {project.priority}
          </Badge>
          <Badge className={getStatusColor(project.status)}>
            {project.status.replace('_', ' ')}
          </Badge>
        </div>
      </CardHeader>
      
      <CardContent className="space-y-4">
        <div className="space-y-2">
          <div className="flex items-center justify-between text-sm">
            <span>Progress</span>
            <span>{progress}%</span>
          </div>
          <Progress value={progress} className="h-2" />
        </div>
        
        <div className="flex items-center justify-between text-sm text-muted-foreground">
          {project.startDate && (
            <div className="flex items-center gap-1">
              <Calendar className="w-4 h-4" />
              <span>{format(new Date(project.startDate), 'MMM dd')}</span>
            </div>
          )}
          {project.endDate && (
            <div className="flex items-center gap-1">
              <Clock className="w-4 h-4" />
              <span>{format(new Date(project.endDate), 'MMM dd')}</span>
            </div>
          )}
        </div>
        
        <div className="flex items-center justify-between pt-2 border-t">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-1">
            <Users className="w-4 h-4 text-muted-foreground" />
            <span className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">
              {Math.floor(Math.random() * 8) + 3} members
            </span>
          </div>
          
          <div className="flex items-center gap-1">
            {project.status === 'in_progress' ? (
              <Button variant="ghost" size="sm">
                <PauseCircle className="w-3 h-3" />
              </Button>
            ) : (
              <Button variant="ghost" size="sm">
                <PlayCircle className="w-3 h-3" />
              </Button>
            )}
            <Button variant="ghost" size="sm">
              <Target className="w-3 h-3" />
            </Button>
          </div>
        </div>
      </CardContent>
    </Card>
  );
}

export default function EnhancedProjectDashboard() {
  const [selectedView, setSelectedView] = useState('overview');
  const [isCreateModalOpen, setIsCreateModalOpen] = useState(false);
  const [selectedProject, setSelectedProject] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [selectedMethodology, setSelectedMethodology] = useState<any>(null);
  const queryClient = useQueryClient();

  // Fetch projects
  const { data: projects = [], isLoading } = useQuery<Project[]>({
    queryKey: ['/api/projects'],
  });

  // Create project mutation
  const createProjectMutation = useMutation({
    mutationFn: async (projectData: any) => {
      const response = await fetch('/api/projects', {
        method: 'POST',
        headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
        body: JSON.stringify(projectData),
      });
      if (!response.ok) throw new Error('Failed to create project');
      return response.json();
    },
    onSuccess: () => {
      queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ['/api/projects'] });
    },
  });

  const handleProjectCreate = (projectData: any) => {
    createProjectMutation.mutate(projectData);
    setIsCreateModalOpen(false);
  };

  const handleProjectClick = (projectId: string) => {
    setSelectedProject(projectId);
    setSelectedView('detail');
  };

  const handleTemplateSelect = (template: any) => {
    // Template selection logic
    console.log('Template selected:', template);
  };

  const handleMethodologyChange = (methodology: any) => {
    setSelectedMethodology(methodology);
  };

  const getProjectStats = () => {
    return {
      total: projects.length,
      active: projects.filter((p: Project) => p.status === 'in_progress').length,
      completed: projects.filter((p: Project) => p.status === 'completed').length,
      overdue: projects.filter((p: Project) => {
        if (!p.endDate) return false;
        return new Date(p.endDate) < new Date() && p.status !== 'completed';
      }).length,
    };
  };

  const stats = getProjectStats();

  if (selectedView === 'detail' && selectedProject) {
    return (
      <ProjectView 
        projectId={selectedProject}
        onBack={() => {
          setSelectedView('overview');
          setSelectedProject(null);
        }}
      />
    );
  }

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6">
      {/* Header */}
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
        <div>
          <h1 className="text-3xl font-bold text-foreground">Veridius Project Management</h1>
          <p className="text-muted-foreground mt-1">
            Universal project methodology support with end-to-end tracking and execution
          </p>
        </div>
        <Button 
          onClick={() => setIsCreateModalOpen(true)}
          className="bg-gradient-to-r from-blue-600 to-blue-500 hover:from-blue-700 hover:to-blue-600"
        >
          <Plus className="w-4 h-4 mr-2" />
          New Project
        </Button>
      </div>

      {/* Enhanced Project Management Tabs */}
      <Tabs defaultValue="projects" className="space-y-6">
        <TabsList className="grid w-full grid-cols-5">
          <TabsTrigger value="projects">Projects</TabsTrigger>
          <TabsTrigger value="methodologies">Methodologies</TabsTrigger>
          <TabsTrigger value="templates">Templates</TabsTrigger>
          <TabsTrigger value="collaboration">Collaboration</TabsTrigger>
          <TabsTrigger value="reports">Reports</TabsTrigger>
        </TabsList>

        {/* Projects Tab */}
        <TabsContent value="projects" className="space-y-6">
          {/* Project Statistics */}
          <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-4 gap-6">
            <Card>
              <CardContent className="p-6">
                <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                  <div>
                    <p className="text-sm font-medium text-muted-foreground">Total Projects</p>
                    <p className="text-2xl font-bold text-foreground">{stats.total}</p>
                  </div>
                  <Target className="w-8 h-8 text-blue-500" />
                </div>
              </CardContent>
            </Card>

            <Card>
              <CardContent className="p-6">
                <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                  <div>
                    <p className="text-sm font-medium text-muted-foreground">Active</p>
                    <p className="text-2xl font-bold text-blue-600">{stats.active}</p>
                  </div>
                  <PlayCircle className="w-8 h-8 text-blue-500" />

            <Card>
              <CardContent className="p-6">
                <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                  <div>
                    <p className="text-sm font-medium text-muted-foreground">Completed</p>
                    <p className="text-2xl font-bold text-green-600">{stats.completed}</p>

import React, { useState } from 'react';
import { Card, CardContent, CardHeader, CardTitle } from '@/components/ui/card';
import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button';
import { Progress } from '@/components/ui/progress';
import { Badge } from '@/components/ui/badge';
import { 
  Building2, 
  Zap, 
  Brain, 
  Target, 
  Play,
  ChevronRight,
  CheckCircle,
  Network,
  Lightbulb,
  Clock
} from 'lucide-react';

interface WorkflowStep {
  id: string;
  title: string;
  description: string;
  icon: React.ReactNode;
  status: 'completed' | 'current' | 'upcoming';
  aiInsight?: string;
  backgroundImage?: string;
  estimatedTime?: string;
}

interface SimulationResult {
  strategy: string;
  impact: number;
  confidence: number;
  timeline: string;
  resources: string[];
}

export default function EnhancedWorkflowBuilder() {
  const [currentStep, setCurrentStep] = useState(0);
  const [completedSteps, setCompletedSteps] = useState<Set<number>>(new Set());
  const [simulationResults, setSimulationResults] = useState<SimulationResult[]>([]);
  const [showSimulation, setShowSimulation] = useState(false);

  const workflowSteps: WorkflowStep[] = [
    {
      id: 'organization',
      title: 'Organization Profile',
      description: 'Define your organizational context and strategic position',
      icon: <Building2 className="w-6 h-6" />,
      status: currentStep === 0 ? 'current' : Array.from(completedSteps).includes(0) ? 'completed' : 'upcoming',
      aiInsight: 'Based on industry patterns, manufacturing companies with your profile have 78% better resilience when supply chain diversification is prioritized.',
      backgroundImage: 'linear-gradient(135deg, #667eea 0%, #764ba2 100%)',
      estimatedTime: '5-8 minutes'
    },
    {
      id: 'trigger',
      title: 'Disruption Trigger',
      description: 'Identify and classify the disruption event or threat',
      icon: <Zap className="w-6 h-6" />,
      status: currentStep === 1 ? 'current' : Array.from(completedSteps).includes(1) ? 'completed' : 'upcoming',
      aiInsight: 'Supply chain disruptions have a 75% chance of affecting operations within 48 hours for organizations with your risk profile.',
      backgroundImage: 'linear-gradient(135deg, #f093fb 0%, #f5576c 100%)',
      estimatedTime: '3-5 minutes'
    },
    {
      id: 'analysis',
      title: 'Impact Analysis',
      description: 'Deep analysis of potential impacts and vulnerability assessment',
      icon: <Brain className="w-6 h-6" />,
      status: currentStep === 2 ? 'current' : Array.from(completedSteps).includes(2) ? 'completed' : 'upcoming',
      aiInsight: 'Our AI models suggest focusing on customer retention strategies as they provide 3x ROI during disruption periods.',
      backgroundImage: 'linear-gradient(135deg, #4facfe 0%, #00f2fe 100%)',
      estimatedTime: '10-15 minutes'
    },
    {
      id: 'response',
      title: 'Response Strategy',
      description: 'Develop comprehensive response and mitigation strategies',
      icon: <Target className="w-6 h-6" />,
      status: currentStep === 3 ? 'current' : Array.from(completedSteps).includes(3) ? 'completed' : 'upcoming',
      aiInsight: 'Recommended approach: Implement parallel sourcing strategy with 40% cost buffer for critical components.',
      backgroundImage: 'linear-gradient(135deg, #43e97b 0%, #38f9d7 100%)',
      estimatedTime: '15-20 minutes'
    },
    {
      id: 'execution',
      title: 'Execution Plan',
      description: 'Create detailed execution roadmap with timelines and resources',
      icon: <Play className="w-6 h-6" />,
      status: currentStep === 4 ? 'current' : [...completedSteps].includes(4) ? 'completed' : 'upcoming',
      aiInsight: 'Success probability increases by 65% when execution includes cross-functional teams and weekly progress reviews.',
      backgroundImage: 'linear-gradient(135deg, #fa709a 0%, #fee140 100%)',
      estimatedTime: '10-12 minutes'
    }
  ];

  const simulationStrategies: SimulationResult[] = [
    {
      strategy: 'Defensive Consolidation',
      impact: 65,
      confidence: 87,
      timeline: '2-4 weeks',
      resources: ['Supply Chain Team', 'Legal', 'Finance', 'Operations']
    },
    {
      strategy: 'Agile Diversification',
      impact: 82,
      confidence: 94,
      timeline: '3-6 weeks',
      resources: ['Procurement', 'Strategy', 'Technology', 'Risk Management']
    },
    {
      strategy: 'Innovation Acceleration',
      impact: 91,
      confidence: 76,
      timeline: '6-10 weeks',
      resources: ['R&D', 'Marketing', 'Partnerships', 'Innovation Lab']
    }
  ];

  const handleStepComplete = (stepIndex: number) => {
    setCompletedSteps(prev => new Set([...prev, stepIndex]));
    if (stepIndex < workflowSteps.length - 1) {
      setCurrentStep(stepIndex + 1);
    }
    
    // Show simulation when reaching response strategy step
    if (stepIndex === 2) {
      setShowSimulation(true);
      setSimulationResults(simulationStrategies);
    }
  };

  const getStepStatusColor = (status: string) => {
    switch (status) {
      case 'completed': return 'bg-green-500 text-white';
      case 'current': return 'bg-primary text-primary-foreground animate-glow';
      case 'upcoming': return 'bg-muted text-muted-foreground';
      default: return 'bg-muted text-muted-foreground';
    }
  };

  const getProgressPercentage = () => {
    return ((Array.from(completedSteps).length) / workflowSteps.length) * 100;

              onClick={() => setCurrentStep(index)}
            >
              <CardContent className="p-6">
                <div className="flex items-center gap-4">
                  {/* Step Icon */}
                  <div className={`w-12 h-12 rounded-full flex items-center justify-center ${getStepStatusColor(step.status)}`}>
                    {step.status === 'completed' ? (
                      <CheckCircle className="w-6 h-6" />
                    ) : (
                      step.icon
                    )}
                  </div>

                  {/* Content */}
                  <div className="flex-1">

                      {step.estimatedTime && (
                        <Badge variant="secondary" className="text-xs">
                          {step.estimatedTime}
                        </Badge>
                      )}
                    </div>
                    <p className="text-muted-foreground text-sm mt-1">
                      {step.description}
                    </p>
                    
                    {/* AI Insight */}
                    {step.aiInsight && step.status === 'current' && (
                      <div className="mt-3 p-3 bg-blue-50 dark:bg-blue-950/20 border border-blue-200 dark:border-blue-800 rounded-lg animate-slide-up">

                          <div>
                            <p className="text-xs font-semibold text-blue-800 dark:text-blue-300 mb-1">
                              AI Insight
                            </p>
                            <p className="text-xs text-blue-700 dark:text-blue-400 leading-relaxed">
                              {step.aiInsight}
                            </p>
                          </div>
                        </div>
                      </div>
                    )}
                  </div>

                  {/* Arrow */}
                  <div className={`transition-transform duration-200 ${step.status === 'current' ? 'scale-110' : ''}`}>
                    <ChevronRight className="w-5 h-5 text-muted-foreground" />
                  </div>
                </div>

                {/* Step Actions */}
                {step.status === 'current' && (
                  <div className="mt-4 pt-4 border-t border-border">
                    <div className="flex gap-3">
                      <Button 
                        onClick={() => handleStepComplete(index)}
                        className="flex-1"
                      >
                        Complete {step.title}
                      </Button>
                      <Button variant="outline" size="sm">
                        Skip
                      </Button>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                )}
              </CardContent>
            </Card>
          ))}
        </div>

        {/* Interactive Simulation Panel */}
        <div className="space-y-6">
          {/* Current Step Detail */}
          <Card className="executive-card overflow-hidden">
            <div 
              className="h-32 bg-gradient-to-br opacity-10"
              style={{ background: workflowSteps[currentStep].backgroundImage }}
            />
            <CardContent className="p-6 -mt-16 relative z-10">
              <div className="bg-background/95 backdrop-blur rounded-2xl p-6 executive-shadow">
                <div className="flex items-center gap-4 mb-4">
                  <div className="w-12 h-12 bg-primary/10 rounded-xl flex items-center justify-center">
                    {workflowSteps[currentStep].icon}
                  </div>
                  <div>
                    <h3 className="text-xl font-bold">
                      {workflowSteps[currentStep].title}
                    </h3>
                    <p className="text-muted-foreground text-sm">
                      {workflowSteps[currentStep].description}
                    </p>
                  </div>
                </div>

                <div className="space-y-4">
                  <Button variant="outline" className="w-full justify-start">

            </CardContent>

          {/* What-If Simulation */}
          {showSimulation && (
            <Card className="executive-card animate-slide-up">

                <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">

              </CardHeader>
              <CardContent className="space-y-4">
                {simulationResults.map((result, index) => (
                  <div 
                    key={index}
                    className="p-4 border rounded-xl hover:shadow-md transition-all duration-200 cursor-move executive-hover"
                    draggable
                  >
                    <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-3">
                      <h4 className="font-bold text-sm">{result.strategy}</h4>
                      <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                        <Badge 
                          variant={result.impact > 80 ? 'default' : 'secondary'}
                          className="text-xs"
                        >
                          {result.impact}% Impact
                        </Badge>
                        <div className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">
                          {result.confidence}% confident
                        </div>
                      </div>
                    </div>
                    
                    <div className="space-y-2">
                      <div className="flex items-center gap-2 text-xs text-muted-foreground">
                        <span className="w-3 h-3 text-xs">⏱</span>
                        Timeline: {result.timeline}
                      </div>
                      <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-1">
                        {result.resources.map((resource, i) => (
                          <Badge key={i} variant="outline" className="text-xs">
                            {resource}
                          </Badge>
                        ))}
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                ))}
              </CardContent>
            </Card>
          )}
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

  component: string;

  icon: any;
  category: string;
  benefits: string[];

  const demoSteps: DemoStep[] = [

    let interval: NodeJS.Timeout;
    
    if (isPlaying && currentStep < demoSteps.length) {
      interval = setInterval(() => {
        setProgress(prev => {
          const stepDuration = demoSteps[currentStep].duration;
          const newProgress = prev + (1000 / stepDuration);
          
          if (newProgress >= 100) {
            setCompletedSteps(prev => new Set([...prev, currentStep]));
            if (currentStep < demoSteps.length - 1) {
              setCurrentStep(currentStep + 1);
              return 0;
            } else {
              setIsPlaying(false);
              return 100;
            }
          }
          
          return newProgress;
        });
      }, 100);
    }
    
    return () => clearInterval(interval);
  }, [isPlaying, currentStep, demoSteps]);

  const handlePlay = () => {
    setIsPlaying(!isPlaying);
  };

  const handleNext = () => {
    if (currentStep < demoSteps.length - 1) {
      setCompletedSteps(prev => new Set([...prev, currentStep]));
      setCurrentStep(currentStep + 1);
      setProgress(0);
    }
  };

  const handleStepClick = (index: number) => {
    setCurrentStep(index);
    setProgress(0);
    setIsPlaying(false);
  };

            </div>
          </div>
          
          {/* Demo Controls */}
          <div className="bg-white/10 backdrop-blur-sm rounded-2xl p-6 border border-white/20">
            <div className="flex items-center justify-center gap-6 mb-4">
              <button
                onClick={handlePlay}
                className="bg-gradient-to-r from-green-500 to-blue-500 hover:from-green-600 hover:to-blue-600 px-8 py-4 rounded-xl font-bold text-lg transition-all duration-300 flex items-center gap-3"
              >
                {isPlaying ? <Pause className="h-6 w-6" /> : <Play className="h-6 w-6" />}
                {isPlaying ? 'Pause Demo' : 'Start Demo'}
              </button>
              
              <button
                onClick={handleNext}
                disabled={currentStep >= demoSteps.length - 1}
                className="bg-white/10 hover:bg-white/20 px-6 py-4 rounded-xl font-medium transition-all duration-300 flex items-center gap-2 disabled:opacity-50 disabled:cursor-not-allowed"
              >
                <SkipForward className="h-5 w-5" />
                Next
              </button>
            </div>
            
            {/* Progress */}
            <div className="text-sm text-blue-200 mb-2">
              Step {currentStep + 1} of {demoSteps.length} • {Math.round((currentStep / demoSteps.length) * 100)}% Complete
            </div>
            <div className="w-full bg-white/10 rounded-full h-2 overflow-hidden">
              <div 
                className="bg-gradient-to-r from-green-500 to-blue-500 h-full transition-all duration-300"
                style={{ width: `${((currentStep / demoSteps.length) * 100) + (progress / demoSteps.length)}%` }}
              />
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Current Step Display */}
        <div className="grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-2 gap-8 mb-12">

          <div className="bg-white/10 backdrop-blur-sm rounded-2xl p-8 border border-white/20">

                key={tab.id}
                onClick={() => setActiveTab(tab.id)}

                  activeTab === tab.id

                    : 'text-gray-600 hover:bg-gray-100'

              >
                <tab.icon className="w-5 h-5" />
                <span className="font-medium">{tab.name}</span>
              </button>
            ))}
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Tab Content */}
        <div className="min-h-96">
          {activeTab === 'overview' && renderOverview()}
          {activeTab === 'dataflow' && renderDataFlow()}
          {activeTab === 'compliance' && renderCompliance()}
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

export default EnterpriseIntegrationHub;

## FILE: client/src/components/ErrorBoundary.tsx
```
import React, { Component, ErrorInfo, ReactNode } from 'react';
import { AlertTriangle, RefreshCw, Home } from 'lucide-react';
import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button';

// 9. Front-End Production Readiness

interface Props {
  children: ReactNode;
  fallback?: ReactNode;
}

interface State {
  hasError: boolean;
  error?: Error;
  errorInfo?: ErrorInfo;
}

export class ErrorBoundary extends Component<Props, State> {
  constructor(props: Props) {
    super(props);
    this.state = { hasError: false };
  }

  static getDerivedStateFromError(error: Error): State {
    return { hasError: true, error };
  }

  componentDidCatch(error: Error, errorInfo: ErrorInfo) {
    this.setState({
      error,
      errorInfo
    });

    // Log error to monitoring service
    this.logErrorToService(error, errorInfo);
  }

  logErrorToService = (error: Error, errorInfo: ErrorInfo) => {
    // In production, send to error tracking service (Sentry, LogRocket, etc.)
    console.error('React Error Boundary caught an error:', {
      error: {
        name: error.name,
        message: error.message,
        stack: error.stack
      },
      errorInfo: {
        componentStack: errorInfo.componentStack
      },
      url: window.location.href,
      userAgent: navigator.userAgent,
      timestamp: new Date().toISOString()
    });

    // Send to backend error tracking
    if (process.env.NODE_ENV === 'production') {
      fetch('/api/errors/client', {
        method: 'POST',
        headers: {
          'Content-Type': 'application/json',
        },
        body: JSON.stringify({
          error: {
            name: error.name,
            message: error.message,
            stack: error.stack
          },
          componentStack: errorInfo.componentStack,
          url: window.location.href,
          userAgent: navigator.userAgent,
          timestamp: new Date().toISOString()
        })
      }).catch(console.error);
    }
  };

  render() {
    if (this.state.hasError) {
      if (this.props.fallback) {
        return this.props.fallback;
      }

      return (
        <div className="min-h-screen bg-gradient-to-br from-slate-50 to-slate-100 flex items-center justify-center p-6">
          <div className="max-w-md w-full bg-white rounded-2xl shadow-xl p-8 text-center">
            <div className="w-16 h-16 bg-red-100 rounded-full flex items-center justify-center mx-auto mb-6">
              <AlertTriangle className="w-8 h-8 text-red-600" />
            </div>
            
            <h1 className="text-2xl font-bold text-gray-900 mb-4">
              Something went wrong
            </h1>
            
            <p className="text-gray-600 mb-6">
              We're sorry for the inconvenience. The application encountered an unexpected error.
            </p>

            {process.env.NODE_ENV === 'development' && this.state.error && (
              <details className="text-left mb-6 p-4 bg-gray-50 rounded-lg">
                <summary className="font-medium text-gray-700 cursor-pointer mb-2">
                  Error Details (Development)
                </summary>
                <pre className="text-xs text-gray-600 overflow-auto">
                  {this.state.error.stack}
                </pre>
                {this.state.errorInfo && (
                  <pre className="text-xs text-gray-600 overflow-auto mt-2">
                    {this.state.errorInfo.componentStack}
                  </pre>
                )}
              </details>
            )}

            <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row gap-3">
              <Button
                onClick={() => window.location.reload()}
                className="flex items-center gap-2"
              >
                <RefreshCw className="w-4 h-4" />
                Reload Page
              </Button>
              
              <Button
                variant="outline"
                onClick={() => window.location.href = '/'}
                className="flex items-center gap-2"
              >
                <Home className="w-4 h-4" />
                Go Home
              </Button>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      );
    }

    return this.props.children;
  }
}

// Global Error Handler for unhandled errors
export const setupGlobalErrorHandler = () => {
  // Handle unhandled JavaScript errors
  window.addEventListener('error', (event) => {
    console.error('Global error:', event.error);
    
    // Send to error tracking service
    if (process.env.NODE_ENV === 'production') {
      fetch('/api/errors/client', {
        method: 'POST',
        headers: {
          'Content-Type': 'application/json',
        },
        body: JSON.stringify({
          type: 'global_error',
          error: {
            message: event.message,
            filename: event.filename,
            lineno: event.lineno,
            colno: event.colno,
            stack: event.error?.stack
          },
          url: window.location.href,
          userAgent: navigator.userAgent,
          timestamp: new Date().toISOString()
        })
      }).catch(console.error);
    }
  });

  // Handle unhandled promise rejections
  window.addEventListener('unhandledrejection', (event) => {
    console.error('Unhandled promise rejection:', event.reason);
    
    // Send to error tracking service
    if (process.env.NODE_ENV === 'production') {
      fetch('/api/errors/client', {
        method: 'POST',
        headers: {
          'Content-Type': 'application/json',
        },
        body: JSON.stringify({
          type: 'unhandled_rejection',
          error: {
            reason: event.reason?.toString(),
            stack: event.reason?.stack
          },
          url: window.location.href,
          userAgent: navigator.userAgent,
          timestamp: new Date().toISOString()
        })
      }).catch(console.error);
    }
  });
};

// Performance Monitoring
export const setupPerformanceMonitoring = () => {
  // Monitor Core Web Vitals
  const observer = new PerformanceObserver((list) => {
    for (const entry of list.getEntries()) {
      if (entry.entryType === 'largest-contentful-paint') {
        console.log('LCP:', entry.startTime);
      }
      
      if (entry.entryType === 'first-input') {
        console.log('FID:', entry.processingStart - entry.startTime);
      }
      
      if (entry.entryType === 'layout-shift') {
        if (!(entry as any).hadRecentInput) {
          console.log('CLS:', (entry as any).value);
        }
      }
    }
  });

  observer.observe({ entryTypes: ['largest-contentful-paint', 'first-input', 'layout-shift'] });

  // Monitor bundle size and loading performance
  if ('serviceWorker' in navigator) {
    navigator.serviceWorker.register('/sw.js').catch(console.error);
  }
};

// Analytics Integration
export const setupAnalytics = () => {
  // Page view tracking
  const trackPageView = (path: string) => {
    // Send to analytics service
    if (process.env.NODE_ENV === 'production') {
      // Example: Google Analytics, Mixpanel, etc.
      console.log('Page view:', path);
    }
  };

  // User interaction tracking
  const trackEvent = (category: string, action: string, label?: string) => {
    // Send to analytics service
    if (process.env.NODE_ENV === 'production') {
      console.log('Event:', { category, action, label });
    }
  };

  return { trackPageView, trackEvent };
};

export function ExecutiveKPIEditor({ kpi, onUpdate }: { kpi: any, onUpdate: (data: any) => void }) {
  const [editing, setEditing] = useState(false);
  const [values, setValues] = useState({
    target: kpi.target || 0,
    current: kpi.current || 0,
    notes: kpi.notes || ''
  });
  const { toast } = useToast();

  const handleSave = () => {
    onUpdate({ ...kpi, ...values });
    setEditing(false);
    toast({
      title: "KPI Updated",
      description: `${kpi.name} has been updated successfully`,
    });
  };

  return (
    <Dialog open={editing} onOpenChange={setEditing}>
      <DialogTrigger asChild>
        <Button size="sm" variant="outline">
          <Edit className="h-3 w-3 mr-1" />
          Edit KPI
        </Button>
      </DialogTrigger>
      <DialogContent>
        <DialogHeader>
          <DialogTitle>Edit {kpi.name}</DialogTitle>
        </DialogHeader>
        <div className="space-y-4">
          <div>
            <Label>Target Value</Label>
            <Input
              type="number"
              value={values.target}
              onChange={(e) => setValues(prev => ({ ...prev, target: parseFloat(e.target.value) }))}
            />
          </div>
          <div>
            <Label>Current Value</Label>
            <Input
              type="number"
              value={values.current}
              onChange={(e) => setValues(prev => ({ ...prev, current: parseFloat(e.target.value) }))}
            />
          </div>
          <div>
            <Label>Executive Notes</Label>
            <Textarea
              value={values.notes}
              onChange={(e) => setValues(prev => ({ ...prev, notes: e.target.value }))}
              placeholder="Add executive commentary..."
            />
          </div>
          <div className="flex gap-2">
            <Button onClick={handleSave}>
              <Save className="h-4 w-4 mr-2" />
              Save Changes
            </Button>
            <Button variant="outline" onClick={() => setEditing(false)}>
              Cancel
            </Button>
          </div>
        </div>
      </DialogContent>
    </Dialog>
  );
}

export function ExecutiveBudgetAllocator({ budget, onUpdate }: { budget: any, onUpdate: (data: any) => void }) {

            max={budget.total}
            step={10000}
            className="mt-2"
          />
          <div className="flex justify-between text-sm text-muted-foreground mt-1">

export function ExecutiveDecisionPanel({ decisions, onDecision }: { decisions: any[], onDecision: (decision: any) => void }) {
  const { toast } = useToast();

  const handleDecision = (decision: any, action: 'approve' | 'reject' | 'modify') => {

    });
    
    toast({
      title: "Executive Decision",
      description: `Decision ${action}d: ${decision.title}`,
      variant: action === 'reject' ? 'destructive' : 'default'
    });
  };

  return (
    <Card className="w-full">
      <CardHeader>
        <CardTitle className="flex items-center gap-2">
          <CheckCircle className="h-5 w-5" />
          Pending Executive Decisions
        </CardTitle>
      </CardHeader>
      <CardContent className="space-y-4">
        {decisions.map((decision) => (
          <div key={decision.id} className="border rounded-lg p-4 space-y-3">
            <div>
              <h4 className="font-semibold">{decision.title}</h4>
              <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">{decision.description}</p>
            </div>
            
            <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-4 text-sm">
              <div>
                <span className="text-muted-foreground">Impact:</span>
                <p className="font-medium">{decision.impact}</p>
              </div>
              <div>
                <span className="text-muted-foreground">Timeline:</span>
                <p className="font-medium">{decision.urgency}</p>
              </div>
            </div>

            <div className="flex gap-2">
              <Button 
                size="sm" 
                onClick={() => handleDecision(decision, 'approve')}
                className="bg-green-600 hover:bg-green-700"
              >
                <CheckCircle className="h-3 w-3 mr-1" />
                Approve
              </Button>
              <Button 
                size="sm" 
                variant="outline"

                <Edit className="h-3 w-3 mr-1" />
                Modify
              </Button>
              <Button 
                size="sm" 
                variant="destructive" 
                onClick={() => handleDecision(decision, 'reject')}
              >
                <XCircle className="h-3 w-3 mr-1" />
                Reject
              </Button>
            </div>
          </div>
        ))}
      </CardContent>
    </Card>
  );
}

export default function ExecutiveDecisionIntelligence({ scenarioData }: ExecutiveDecisionIntelligenceProps) {
  const [selectedOption, setSelectedOption] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const data = EXECUTIVE_DECISION_DATA;

  const formatCurrency = (amount: number) => {
    return new Intl.NumberFormat('en-US', {
      style: 'currency',
      currency: 'USD',
      minimumFractionDigits: 0,
      maximumFractionDigits: 0,
    }).format(amount);
  };

  const getStatusColor = (status: string) => {
    switch (status) {
      case 'critical': return 'bg-red-100 text-red-800 border-red-200';
      case 'warning': return 'bg-yellow-100 text-yellow-800 border-yellow-200';
      case 'good': return 'bg-green-100 text-green-800 border-green-200';
      default: return 'bg-gray-100 text-gray-800 border-gray-200';
    }
  };

  const getTrendIcon = (trend: string) => {
    switch (trend) {
      case 'up': return <TrendingUp className="h-4 w-4 text-green-500" />;
      case 'down': return <TrendingDown className="h-4 w-4 text-red-500" />;
      default: return <BarChart3 className="h-4 w-4 text-blue-500" />;
    }
  };

  const getRiskColor = (level: string) => {
    switch (level) {
      case 'low': return 'bg-green-100 text-green-800';
      case 'medium': return 'bg-yellow-100 text-yellow-800';
      case 'high': return 'bg-red-100 text-red-800';
      default: return 'bg-gray-100 text-gray-800';
    }
  };

  return (

              <TabsTrigger value="operational">Operations</TabsTrigger>
              <TabsTrigger value="strategic">Strategic Risks</TabsTrigger>
              <TabsTrigger value="decisions">Decision Options</TabsTrigger>
            </TabsList>

            <TabsContent value="financial" className="space-y-4">
              <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 gap-4">
                {/* Immediate Impact */}

                  </CardHeader>
                  <CardContent className="space-y-3">
                    <div className="flex justify-between">
                      <span className="text-sm text-gray-600">Revenue Loss</span>
                      <span className="font-semibold text-red-600">{formatCurrency(data.financialImpact.immediate.revenueLoss)}</span>
                    </div>
                    <div className="flex justify-between">
                      <span className="text-sm text-gray-600">Emergency Costs</span>
                      <span className="font-semibold">{formatCurrency(data.financialImpact.immediate.operationalCosts)}</span>
                    </div>
                    <div className="flex justify-between">
                      <span className="text-sm text-gray-600">Funding Required</span>
                      <span className="font-semibold text-blue-600">{formatCurrency(data.financialImpact.immediate.emergencyFunding)}</span>
                    </div>
                  </CardContent>
                </Card>

                {/* Projected Impact */}
                <Card>
                  <CardHeader className="pb-3">
                    <CardTitle className="text-sm flex items-center gap-2">

                              {option.keyBenefits.map((benefit, index) => (
                                <li key={index} className="text-sm text-green-600">• {benefit}</li>
                              ))}
                            </ul>
                          </div>
                          <div>
                            <h4 className="font-semibold text-red-700 mb-2">Key Risks</h4>
                            <ul className="space-y-1">
                              {option.keyRisks.map((risk, index) => (
                                <li key={index} className="text-sm text-red-600">• {risk}</li>
                              ))}
                            </ul>
                          </div>
                        </div>
                        <div className="flex gap-2 mt-4">
                          <Button size="sm" variant="outline">
                            Request Detailed Analysis
                          </Button>
                          <Button size="sm">
                            {option.boardApproval ? 'Prepare Board Proposal' : 'Approve & Execute'}
                          </Button>
                        </div>
                      </CardContent>
                    )}
                  </Card>
                ))}
              </div>
            </TabsContent>
          </Tabs>
        </CardContent>
      </Card>
    </div>
  );
}

// Executive Decision Simulation Lab
// Risk-free testing of strategic decisions with AI-powered outcome prediction

import React, { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import { Card, CardContent, CardHeader, CardTitle } from '@/components/ui/card';
import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button';
import { Badge } from '@/components/ui/badge';
import { Progress } from '@/components/ui/progress';
import { Tabs, TabsContent, TabsList, TabsTrigger } from '@/components/ui/tabs';
import { Input } from '@/components/ui/input';
import { Label } from '@/components/ui/label';
import { Textarea } from '@/components/ui/textarea';
import { Slider } from '@/components/ui/slider';
import { 
  BarChart, 
  Bar, 
  LineChart, 
  Line, 
  XAxis, 
  YAxis, 
  CartesianGrid, 
  Tooltip, 
  Legend, 
  ResponsiveContainer,
  PieChart,
  Pie,
  Cell,
  ScatterChart,
  Scatter
} from 'recharts';
import { 
  Brain, 
  Zap, 
  Target, 
  TrendingUp, 
  TrendingDown,
  Play,
  RotateCcw,
  Save,
  Share2,
  AlertTriangle,
  CheckCircle,
  DollarSign,
  Users,
  Clock,
  BarChart3,
  PieChart as PieChartIcon,
  Activity,
  Lightbulb,
  GitBranch,
  Layers
} from 'lucide-react';

interface DecisionScenario {
  id: string;
  title: string;
  description: string;
  category: 'strategic' | 'operational' | 'financial' | 'market';
  complexity: 'low' | 'medium' | 'high';
  stakeholders: string[];
  variables: DecisionVariable[];
  outcomes: PredictedOutcome[];
  risks: RiskFactor[];
  confidence: number;
}

interface DecisionVariable {
  id: string;
  name: string;
  type: 'numerical' | 'categorical' | 'boolean';
  value: any;
  range?: [number, number];
  options?: string[];
  impact: number;
  description: string;
}

interface PredictedOutcome {
  scenario: string;
  probability: number;
  financial_impact: number;
  timeline: string;
  risk_level: 'low' | 'medium' | 'high';
  success_factors: string[];
  potential_obstacles: string[];
}

interface RiskFactor {
  factor: string;
  probability: number;
  impact: 'low' | 'medium' | 'high' | 'critical';
  mitigation: string;
}

interface SimulationResult {
  scenarios: number;
  success_rate: number;
  expected_roi: number;
  confidence_interval: [number, number];
  key_insights: string[];
  recommendations: string[];
}

export default function ExecutiveDecisionSimulationLab() {
  const [activeTab, setActiveTab] = useState('scenarios');

## FILE: client/src/components/executive/ExecutiveHealthScore.tsx
```
import React from 'react';
import { Card, CardContent } from '@/components/ui/card';
import { Badge } from '@/components/ui/badge';
import { Progress } from '@/components/ui/progress';
import { TrendingUp, TrendingDown, Minus, AlertTriangle, CheckCircle, Clock } from 'lucide-react';

interface HealthScoreProps {
  score: number;
  trend: 'up' | 'down' | 'stable';
  change: number;
  timeframe: string;
  components: {
    crisis: number;
    strategic: number;
    operational: number;
    market: number;
    team: number;
  };
  lastUpdated: Date;
}

interface ExecutiveHealthScoreProps {
  data?: HealthScoreProps;
}

export default function ExecutiveHealthScore({ 
  data = {
    score: 87,
    trend: 'up',
    change: 5,
    timeframe: 'vs last month',
    components: {
      crisis: 95,
      strategic: 85,
      operational: 92,
      market: 78,
      team: 85
    },
    lastUpdated: new Date()
  }
}: ExecutiveHealthScoreProps) {
  
  const getScoreColor = (score: number) => {
    if (score >= 85) return 'text-green-400';
    if (score >= 70) return 'text-yellow-400';
    return 'text-red-400';
  };

  const getScoreBgColor = (score: number) => {
    if (score >= 85) return 'from-green-500/20 to-emerald-500/20';
    if (score >= 70) return 'from-yellow-500/20 to-orange-500/20';
    return 'from-red-500/20 to-pink-500/20';
  };

  const getTrendIcon = () => {
    switch (data.trend) {
      case 'up':
        return <TrendingUp className="w-6 h-6 text-green-400" />;
      case 'down':
        return <TrendingDown className="w-6 h-6 text-red-400" />;
      default:
        return <Minus className="w-6 h-6 text-gray-400" />;
    }
  };

  const getStatusIcon = () => {
    if (data.score >= 85) return <CheckCircle className="w-5 h-5 text-green-400" />;
    if (data.score >= 70) return <Clock className="w-5 h-5 text-yellow-400" />;
    return <AlertTriangle className="w-5 h-5 text-red-400" />;
  };

  const getStatusText = () => {
    if (data.score >= 85) return 'Excellent Health';
    if (data.score >= 70) return 'Good Health';
    return 'Needs Attention';
  };

  const componentNames = {
    crisis: 'Crisis Status',
    strategic: 'Strategic Progress',
    operational: 'Operations',
    market: 'Market Position',
    team: 'Team Capacity'
  };

  return (
    <Card className={`bg-gradient-to-br ${getScoreBgColor(data.score)} border-white/20 backdrop-blur-sm`}>
      <CardContent className="p-8">
        {/* Main Score Display */}
        <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-6">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-4">
            <div className="text-center">
              <div className={`text-6xl font-bold ${getScoreColor(data.score)} mb-2`}>
                {data.score}
              </div>
              <div className="text-sm text-white/70 font-medium">
                Organizational Health Score
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>
          
          <div className="text-right">
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2 mb-2">
              {getTrendIcon()}
              <span className={`text-lg font-semibold ${data.trend === 'up' ? 'text-green-400' : data.trend === 'down' ? 'text-red-400' : 'text-gray-400'}`}>
                {data.change > 0 ? '+' : ''}{data.change}%
              </span>
            </div>
            <div className="text-sm text-white/70">
              {data.timeframe}
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Status Badge */}
        <div className="flex items-center justify-center mb-6">
          <Badge 
            variant="secondary" 
            className={`px-4 py-2 text-sm font-medium ${
              data.score >= 85 
                ? 'bg-green-500/20 text-green-400 border-green-400/30' 
                : data.score >= 70 
                ? 'bg-yellow-500/20 text-yellow-400 border-yellow-400/30'
                : 'bg-red-500/20 text-red-400 border-red-400/30'
            }`}
          >
            <span className="flex items-center gap-2">
              {getStatusIcon()}
              {getStatusText()}
            </span>
          </Badge>
        </div>

        {/* Progress Bar */}
        <div className="mb-6">
          <Progress 
            value={data.score} 
            className="h-3 bg-white/10"
            style={{
              '--progress-foreground': data.score >= 85 
                ? '#10b981' 
                : data.score >= 70 
                ? '#f59e0b' 
                : '#ef4444'
            } as React.CSSProperties}
          />
        </div>

        {/* Component Breakdown */}
        <div className="space-y-3">
          <div className="text-sm font-semibold text-white/90 mb-3">
            Health Components
          </div>
          {Object.entries(data.components).map(([key, value]) => (
            <div key={key} className="flex items-center justify-between">
              <span className="text-sm text-white/70">
                {componentNames[key as keyof typeof componentNames]}
              </span>
              <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                <div className="w-16 h-2 bg-white/10 rounded-full overflow-hidden">
                  <div 
                    className={`h-full transition-all duration-300 ${
                      value >= 85 ? 'bg-green-400' : value >= 70 ? 'bg-yellow-400' : 'bg-red-400'
                    }`}
                    style={{ width: `${value}%` }}
                  />
                </div>
                <span className={`text-sm font-medium w-8 text-right ${
                  value >= 85 ? 'text-green-400' : value >= 70 ? 'text-yellow-400' : 'text-red-400'
                }`}>
                  {value}
                </span>
              </div>
            </div>
          ))}
        </div>

        {/* Last Updated */}
        <div className="mt-6 pt-4 border-t border-white/10">
          <div className="flex items-center justify-center gap-2 text-xs text-white/50">
            <Clock className="w-3 h-3" />
            Last updated: {data.lastUpdated.toLocaleString()}
          </div>
        </div>
      </CardContent>
    </Card>
  );
}

import React from 'react';
import { Card, CardContent, CardHeader, CardTitle } from '@/components/ui/card';

type KPIStatus = 'excellent' | 'good' | 'attention' | 'critical';
type KPICategory = 'crisis' | 'strategic' | 'operational' | 'market' | 'team';

interface ExecutiveKPI {
  category: KPICategory;
  status: KPIStatus;
  primaryMetric: string;
  secondaryContext: string;
  lastUpdated: Date;
  actionRequired?: string;
  quickAction: {
    label: string;
    variant: 'default' | 'secondary' | 'destructive' | 'outline';
    href?: string;

}

interface ExecutiveKPIGridProps {
  kpis?: ExecutiveKPI[];
}

const defaultKPIs: ExecutiveKPI[] = [
