    lastUpdated: new Date(),
    actionRequired: 'Workload balancing required',
    quickAction: {
      label: 'Rebalance',
      variant: 'secondary',
      href: '/organization'
    }
  }
];

export default function ExecutiveKPIGrid({ kpis = defaultKPIs }: ExecutiveKPIGridProps) {
  
  const getKPIIcon = (category: KPICategory) => {
    const iconProps = { className: "w-6 h-6" };
    
    switch (category) {
      case 'crisis':
        return <Shield {...iconProps} />;
      case 'strategic':
        return <Target {...iconProps} />;
      case 'operational':
        return <Activity {...iconProps} />;
      case 'market':
        return <TrendingUp {...iconProps} />;
      case 'team':
        return <Users {...iconProps} />;
      default:
        return <Activity {...iconProps} />;
    }
  };

  const getStatusColor = (status: KPIStatus) => {
    switch (status) {
      case 'excellent':
        return {
          border: 'border-l-green-400',
          bg: 'from-green-500/20 to-emerald-500/20',
          icon: 'text-green-400',
          badge: 'bg-green-500/20 text-green-400 border-green-400/30'
        };
      case 'good':
        return {
          border: 'border-l-blue-400',
          bg: 'from-blue-500/20 to-cyan-500/20', 
          icon: 'text-blue-400',
          badge: 'bg-blue-500/20 text-blue-400 border-blue-400/30'
        };
      case 'attention':
        return {
          border: 'border-l-yellow-400',
          bg: 'from-yellow-500/20 to-orange-500/20',
          icon: 'text-yellow-400', 
          badge: 'bg-yellow-500/20 text-yellow-400 border-yellow-400/30'
        };
      case 'critical':
        return {
          border: 'border-l-red-400',
          bg: 'from-red-500/20 to-pink-500/20',
          icon: 'text-red-400',
          badge: 'bg-red-500/20 text-red-400 border-red-400/30'
        };
    }
  };

  const getStatusIcon = (status: KPIStatus) => {
    const iconProps = { className: "w-4 h-4" };
    
    switch (status) {
      case 'excellent':
        return <CheckCircle {...iconProps} className="w-4 h-4 text-green-400" />;
      case 'good':
        return <CheckCircle {...iconProps} className="w-4 h-4 text-blue-400" />;
      case 'attention':
        return <Clock {...iconProps} className="w-4 h-4 text-yellow-400" />;
      case 'critical':
        return <AlertTriangle {...iconProps} className="w-4 h-4 text-red-400" />;
    }
  };

  const getCategoryTitle = (category: KPICategory) => {
    switch (category) {
      case 'crisis': return 'Crisis Status';
      case 'strategic': return 'Strategic Progress';
      case 'operational': return 'Operational Efficiency';
      case 'market': return 'Market Intelligence';
      case 'team': return 'Team Capacity';
    }
  };

  const getStatusLabel = (status: KPIStatus) => {
    switch (status) {
      case 'excellent': return 'Excellent';
      case 'good': return 'Good';
      case 'attention': return 'Attention';
      case 'critical': return 'Critical';
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 xl:grid-cols-3 2xl:grid-cols-5 gap-6">
      {kpis.map((kpi, index) => {
        const colors = getStatusColor(kpi.status);
        
        return (
          <Card 
            key={index}
            className={`bg-gradient-to-br ${colors.bg} ${colors.border} border-l-4 border-t-0 border-r-0 border-b-0 backdrop-blur-sm hover:scale-105 transition-all duration-300`}
          >
            <CardHeader className="pb-3">
              <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-2">
                <div className={`p-2 rounded-lg bg-white/10 ${colors.icon}`}>
                  {getKPIIcon(kpi.category)}
                </div>
                <Badge variant="secondary" className={`text-xs ${colors.badge}`}>
                  <span className="flex items-center gap-1">
                    {getStatusIcon(kpi.status)}
                    {getStatusLabel(kpi.status)}
                  </span>
                </Badge>
              </div>
              <CardTitle className="text-white text-lg font-semibold">
                {getCategoryTitle(kpi.category)}
              </CardTitle>
            </CardHeader>
            
            <CardContent className="pt-0">
              <div className="mb-4">
                <div className="text-2xl font-bold text-white mb-1">
                  {kpi.primaryMetric}
                </div>
                <div className="text-sm text-white/70">
                  {kpi.secondaryContext}
                </div>
              </div>

              {kpi.actionRequired && (
                <div className="mb-4 p-3 bg-white/10 rounded-lg">
                  <div className="text-xs font-medium text-white/90 mb-1">
                    Action Required
                  </div>
                  <div className="text-xs text-white/70">
                    {kpi.actionRequired}
                  </div>
                </div>
              )}

              <Button
                variant={kpi.quickAction.variant}
                size="sm"
                className="w-full group"
                onClick={() => {
                  if (kpi.quickAction.href) {
                    window.location.href = kpi.quickAction.href;
                  }
                }}
              >
                {kpi.quickAction.label}
                <ArrowRight className="w-4 h-4 ml-2 group-hover:translate-x-1 transition-transform duration-200" />
              </Button>

              <div className="mt-3 pt-3 border-t border-white/10">
                <div className="text-xs text-white/50 text-center">
                  Updated: {kpi.lastUpdated.toLocaleTimeString()}
                </div>
              </div>
            </CardContent>
          </Card>
        );
      })}
    </div>
  );
}

import React, { useState } from 'react';
import { useMutation, useQuery, useQueryClient } from '@tanstack/react-query';
import { useForm } from 'react-hook-form';
import { zodResolver } from '@hookform/resolvers/zod';
import { z } from 'zod';
import { Card, CardContent, CardHeader, CardTitle } from '@/components/ui/card';
import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button';
import { Input } from '@/components/ui/input';
import { Textarea } from '@/components/ui/textarea';
import { Label } from '@/components/ui/label';
import { Badge } from '@/components/ui/badge';
import { Tabs, TabsContent, TabsList, TabsTrigger } from '@/components/ui/tabs';
import { Progress } from '@/components/ui/progress';
import { Alert, AlertDescription } from '@/components/ui/alert';
import { useToast } from '@/hooks/use-toast';
import { 
  Form, 
  FormControl, 
  FormField, 
  FormItem, 
  FormLabel, 
  FormMessage 
} from '@/components/ui/form';
import {
  Select,
  SelectContent,
  SelectItem,
  SelectTrigger,
  SelectValue,
} from '@/components/ui/select';
import { Checkbox } from '@/components/ui/checkbox';
import { 
  Zap, 
  Brain, 
  Target, 
  CheckCircle, 
  AlertTriangle, 
  Clock,
  TrendingUp,
  Users,
  FileText,
  Play,
  Loader2
} from 'lucide-react';
import ScenarioTemplateSelector from './ScenarioTemplateSelector';
import ExecutiveDecisionIntelligence from './ExecutiveDecisionIntelligence';

// Enhanced form validation schema with critical organizational data
const scenarioExecutionSchema = z.object({
  title: z.string().min(1, "Title is required").max(200, "Title too long"),
  description: z.string().min(10, "Description must be at least 10 characters").max(2000, "Description too long"),
  context: z.string().min(10, "Context is required").max(1000, "Context too long"),
  
  // Critical business context
  industry: z.string().min(1, "Industry is required"),
  organizationSize: z.enum(['startup', 'small', 'medium', 'large', 'enterprise']),
  revenueImpact: z.enum(['none', 'minimal', 'moderate', 'significant', 'critical']),
  timeframe: z.enum(['immediate', 'hours', 'days', 'weeks', 'months']),
  
  // Stakeholder information
  affectedDepartments: z.array(z.string()).min(1, "Select at least one affected department"),
  keyStakeholders: z.string().min(5, "Identify key stakeholders"),
  externalPartners: z.string().optional(),
  
  // Resource constraints
  availableResources: z.string().min(10, "Describe available resources"),
  budgetConstraints: z.enum(['unlimited', 'high', 'moderate', 'limited', 'minimal']),
  teamCapacity: z.enum(['full', 'limited', 'stretched', 'overwhelmed']),
  
  // Historical context
  previousSimilarEvents: z.string().optional(),
  lessonsLearned: z.string().optional(),
  existingProcedures: z.string().optional(),
  
  // Success metrics
  successCriteria: z.string().min(10, "Define success criteria"),
  riskTolerance: z.enum(['very-low', 'low', 'moderate', 'high', 'very-high']),
});

type ScenarioFormData = z.infer<typeof scenarioExecutionSchema>;

interface ScenarioExecutionResult {
  success: boolean;
  scenarioId: string;
  analysisResult: {
    scenarios: Array<{
      title: string;
      description: string;
      probability: number;
      impact: string;
      timeframe: string;
      recommendations: string[];
    }>;
    riskLevel: 'minimal' | 'low' | 'moderate' | 'high' | 'severe';
    urgency: number;
    confidence: number;
    nextSteps: string[];
  };
  executionTime: number;
  recommendations: string[];
  nextActions: Array<{
    action: string;
    priority: 'low' | 'medium' | 'high' | 'critical';
    deadline: string;
  }>;
}

const FunctionalScenarioBuilder: React.FC = () => {
  const [activeTab, setActiveTab] = useState('create');
  const [executionResult, setExecutionResult] = useState<ScenarioExecutionResult | null>(null);
  const { toast } = useToast();
  const queryClient = useQueryClient();

  // Industry options with template support
  const industries = [
    { value: 'technology', label: 'Technology', hasTemplate: true },
    { value: 'financial-services', label: 'Financial Services', hasTemplate: true },
    { value: 'healthcare', label: 'Healthcare', hasTemplate: true },
    { value: 'manufacturing', label: 'Manufacturing', hasTemplate: false },
    { value: 'retail', label: 'Retail', hasTemplate: false },
    { value: 'energy', label: 'Energy', hasTemplate: false },
    { value: 'transportation', label: 'Transportation', hasTemplate: false },
    { value: 'education', label: 'Education', hasTemplate: false },
    { value: 'government', label: 'Government', hasTemplate: false },
    { value: 'real-estate', label: 'Real Estate', hasTemplate: false },
    { value: 'media', label: 'Media', hasTemplate: false },
    { value: 'telecommunications', label: 'Telecommunications', hasTemplate: false },
    { value: 'other', label: 'Other', hasTemplate: false }
  ];

  // Track selected industry for template loading
  const [selectedIndustry, setSelectedIndustry] = useState<string>('');
  const [availableTemplates, setAvailableTemplates] = useState<any[]>([]);
  const [showTemplateSelector, setShowTemplateSelector] = useState(false);

  // Department options
  const departments = [
    'Executive Leadership', 'Operations', 'Finance', 'Human Resources', 
    'Marketing', 'Sales', 'IT/Technology', 'Legal', 'Customer Service', 
    'Supply Chain', 'Research & Development', 'Quality Assurance'
  ];

  // Form setup with comprehensive defaults
  const form = useForm<ScenarioFormData>({
    resolver: zodResolver(scenarioExecutionSchema),
    defaultValues: {
      title: '',
      description: '',
      context: '',
      industry: '',
      organizationSize: 'medium',
      revenueImpact: 'moderate',
      timeframe: 'days',
      affectedDepartments: [],
      keyStakeholders: '',
      externalPartners: '',
      availableResources: '',
      budgetConstraints: 'moderate',
      teamCapacity: 'limited',
      previousSimilarEvents: '',
      lessonsLearned: '',
      existingProcedures: '',
      successCriteria: '',
      riskTolerance: 'moderate'
    }
  });

  // Get existing scenarios
  const { data: scenarios, isLoading: scenariosLoading } = useQuery({
    queryKey: ['/api/scenarios'],
    queryFn: async () => {
      const response = await fetch('/api/scenarios', {
        credentials: 'include'
      });
      if (!response.ok) throw new Error('Failed to fetch scenarios');
      const result = await response.json();
      return result.data || [];
    }
  });

  // Execute scenario mutation
  const executeScenarioMutation = useMutation({
    mutationFn: async (data: ScenarioFormData): Promise<ScenarioExecutionResult> => {
      const response = await fetch('/api/scenarios/execute', {
        method: 'POST',
        headers: {
          'Content-Type': 'application/json',
        },
        credentials: 'include',
        body: JSON.stringify(data)
      });

      if (!response.ok) {
        const errorData = await response.json();
        throw new Error(errorData.message || 'Failed to execute scenario');
      }

      const result = await response.json();
      return result.data;
    },
    onSuccess: (data) => {
      setExecutionResult(data);
      setActiveTab('results');
      queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ['/api/scenarios'] });
      toast({
        title: "Scenario Executed Successfully",
        description: `Analysis completed in ${data.executionTime}ms`,
      });
    },
    onError: (error: Error) => {
      toast({
        title: "Execution Failed",
        description: error.message,
        variant: "destructive",
      });
    }
  });

  const onSubmit = (data: ScenarioFormData) => {
    executeScenarioMutation.mutate(data);
  };

  const getRiskLevelColor = (level: string) => {
    switch (level) {
      case 'minimal': return 'bg-green-100 text-green-800 border-green-200';
      case 'low': return 'bg-blue-100 text-blue-800 border-blue-200';
      case 'moderate': return 'bg-yellow-100 text-yellow-800 border-yellow-200';
      case 'high': return 'bg-orange-100 text-orange-800 border-orange-200';
      case 'severe': return 'bg-red-100 text-red-800 border-red-200';
      default: return 'bg-gray-100 text-gray-800 border-gray-200';
    }
  };

  const getPriorityColor = (priority: string) => {
    switch (priority) {
      case 'low': return 'bg-green-100 text-green-800';
      case 'medium': return 'bg-yellow-100 text-yellow-800';
      case 'high': return 'bg-orange-100 text-orange-800';
      case 'critical': return 'bg-red-100 text-red-800';
      default: return 'bg-gray-100 text-gray-800';
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="max-w-6xl mx-auto p-6 space-y-6">
      <div className="text-center mb-8">
        <h1 className="text-3xl font-bold mb-2">Functional Scenario Builder</h1>
        <p className="text-gray-600 dark:text-gray-300">
          Create and execute real scenarios with AI-powered analysis and recommendations
        </p>
      </div>

      <Tabs value={activeTab} onValueChange={setActiveTab} className="w-full">
        <TabsList className="grid w-full grid-cols-3">
          <TabsTrigger value="create" className="flex items-center gap-2">
            <Zap className="h-4 w-4" />
            Create Scenario
          </TabsTrigger>
          <TabsTrigger value="results" className="flex items-center gap-2" disabled={!executionResult}>
            <Brain className="h-4 w-4" />
            AI Analysis
          </TabsTrigger>
          <TabsTrigger value="history" className="flex items-center gap-2">
            <FileText className="h-4 w-4" />
            History
          </TabsTrigger>

import { Moon, Download, Plus } from 'lucide-react';
import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button';

interface HeaderProps {
  title: string;
  onExport?: () => void;
  onAddWidget?: () => void;
  onToggleTheme?: () => void;
}

export default function Header({ title, onExport, onAddWidget, onToggleTheme }: HeaderProps) {
  return (
    <header className="bg-white/15 backdrop-blur-xl border-b border-white/20 p-6 shadow-sm z-10">
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
        <h1 className="text-3xl font-black bg-gradient-to-r from-gray-900 to-primary bg-clip-text text-transparent">
          {title}
        </h1>
        
        <div className="flex items-center gap-4">
          <Button
            variant="ghost"
            size="icon"
            onClick={onToggleTheme}
            className="bg-white/15 backdrop-blur-xl border border-white/20 hover:bg-white/30 transition-all duration-300 hover:scale-105"
          >
            <Moon className="w-5 h-5" />
          </Button>
          
          <Button
            onClick={onExport}
            className="bg-gradient-to-r from-primary to-primary/80 text-white shadow-lg hover:shadow-xl transition-all duration-300 hover:-translate-y-1 flex items-center gap-2"
          >
            <Download className="w-4 h-4" />
            Export Data
          </Button>

          <Button
            variant="outline"
            onClick={onAddWidget}
            className="bg-white/15 backdrop-blur-xl border-white/20 text-gray-900 hover:bg-white/30 transition-all duration-300 hover:-translate-y-1 flex items-center gap-2"
          >
            <Plus className="w-4 h-4" />
            Add Widget
          </Button>
        </div>
      </div>
    </header>
  );
}

        </div>

};

export default IndustrySolutions;

                    <p className="text-sm text-gray-600">{integration.dataFlows.join(', ')}</p>
                  </div>
                </div>
                <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                  <div className="h-2 w-2 bg-green-500 rounded-full animate-pulse"></div>
                  <span className="text-sm text-green-600">Live</span>
                </div>
              </div>
            ))}
          </div>
        </CardContent>
      </Card>
    </div>
  );

  const SecurityOverview = () => (
    <Card>
      <CardHeader>
        <CardTitle className="flex items-center gap-2">
          <Shield className="h-5 w-5" />
          Security & Compliance
        </CardTitle>
      </CardHeader>
      <CardContent>
        <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-6">
          <div>
            <h4 className="font-medium mb-4">Security Status</h4>
            <div className="space-y-3">
              <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                <span className="text-sm">Encrypted Connections</span>
                <Badge className="bg-green-100 text-green-800">100%</Badge>
              </div>
              <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                <span className="text-sm">API Key Rotation</span>
                <Badge className="bg-green-100 text-green-800">Active</Badge>
              </div>
              <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                <span className="text-sm">Access Logging</span>
                <Badge className="bg-green-100 text-green-800">Enabled</Badge>
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>
          <div>
            <h4 className="font-medium mb-4">Compliance</h4>
            <div className="space-y-3">
              <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                <span className="text-sm">GDPR Compliance</span>
                <Badge className="bg-green-100 text-green-800">Compliant</Badge>
              </div>
              <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                <span className="text-sm">SOC 2 Type II</span>
                <Badge className="bg-green-100 text-green-800">Certified</Badge>
              </div>
              <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                <span className="text-sm">Data Retention</span>
                <Badge className="bg-blue-100 text-blue-800">90 days</Badge>
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      </CardContent>
    </Card>
  );

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6 p-6">
      {/* Header */}
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
        <div>
          <h1 className="text-3xl font-bold">Integration Hub</h1>
          <p className="text-gray-600">Connect and manage third-party systems and data sources</p>
        </div>
        <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
          <Badge className="bg-green-100 text-green-800">
            {integrations.filter(i => i.status === 'connected').length} Active
          </Badge>
          <Button>
            <Plus className="h-4 w-4 mr-2" />
            Add Integration
          </Button>
        </div>
      </div>

      <Tabs value={activeTab} onValueChange={setActiveTab}>
        <TabsList className="grid w-full grid-cols-4">
          <TabsTrigger value="overview">Overview</TabsTrigger>
          <TabsTrigger value="configure">Configure</TabsTrigger>
          <TabsTrigger value="data-flows">Data Flows</TabsTrigger>
          <TabsTrigger value="security">Security</TabsTrigger>
        </TabsList>

        <TabsContent value="overview" className="space-y-6">
          <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-6">
            {integrations.map((integration) => (
              <IntegrationCard key={integration.id} integration={integration} />
            ))}
            <AddIntegrationCard />
          </div>
        </TabsContent>

        <TabsContent value="configure" className="space-y-6">
          {isConfiguring && selectedIntegration ? (
            <ConfigurationPanel />
          ) : (
            <Card>
              <CardContent className="p-12 text-center">
                <Settings className="h-12 w-12 mx-auto text-gray-400 mb-4" />
                <h3 className="text-lg font-medium mb-2">Select an Integration to Configure</h3>
                <p className="text-gray-600">
                  Choose an integration from the overview tab to configure its settings
                </p>
              </CardContent>
            </Card>
          )}
        </TabsContent>

        <TabsContent value="data-flows" className="space-y-6">
          <DataFlowsOverview />
        </TabsContent>

        <TabsContent value="security" className="space-y-6">
          <SecurityOverview />
        </TabsContent>
      </Tabs>
    </div>
  );
}

                <p className="text-sm text-green-700">Automated file processing and data extraction from any format</p>

              <div className="text-center p-6 bg-blue-50 rounded-lg">

            </div>

                  <Search className="h-16 w-16 text-blue-400 mx-auto mb-4 opacity-50" />

                  </p>
                  <Button>
                    <ExternalLink className="h-4 w-4 mr-2" />
                    Request Custom Integration
                  </Button>
                </CardContent>
              </Card>
            )}
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

  lastSync?: Date;

    totalRecords: number;
    successfulSyncs: number;
    failedSyncs: number;
  };

export default function IntegrationMarketplace() {
  const [connectors, setConnectors] = useState<IntegrationConnector[]>(SAMPLE_CONNECTORS);
  const [instances, setInstances] = useState<IntegrationInstance[]>([]);
  const [searchTerm, setSearchTerm] = useState('');
  const [selectedCategory, setSelectedCategory] = useState<string>('');
  const [selectedConnector, setSelectedConnector] = useState<IntegrationConnector | null>(null);
  const [isInstalling, setIsInstalling] = useState(false);

  useEffect(() => {
    fetchConnectors();
    fetchInstances();
  }, []);

  const fetchConnectors = async () => {
    try {
      const response = await fetch('/api/integrations/connectors');
      if (response.ok) {
        const data = await response.json();
        setConnectors(data);
      }
    } catch (error) {
      console.log('Using sample data - API not available');
    }
  };

  const fetchInstances = async () => {
    try {
      const response = await fetch('/api/integrations/instances');
      if (response.ok) {
        const data = await response.json();
        setInstances(data);
      }
    } catch (error) {
      console.log('Using sample data - API not available');
    }
  };

  const installIntegration = async (connector: IntegrationConnector) => {
    setIsInstalling(true);
    try {
      const response = await fetch('/api/integrations/install', {
        method: 'POST',
        headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
        body: JSON.stringify({
          connectorId: connector.id,
          organizationId: 'demo-org',
          configuration: {},
          credentials: {}
        })
      });

        const instance = await response.json();
        setInstances(prev => [...prev, instance]);
        setSelectedConnector(null);
      }
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Installation failed:', error);
    } finally {
      setIsInstalling(false);

                          connector.description.toLowerCase().includes(searchTerm.toLowerCase());
    const matchesCategory = !selectedCategory || connector.category === selectedCategory;
    return matchesSearch && matchesCategory;
  });

  const categories = [...new Set(connectors.map(c => c.category))];

  const getStatusColor = (status: IntegrationInstance['status']) => {
    switch (status) {
      case 'connected': return 'bg-green-500';
      case 'error': return 'bg-red-500';
      case 'configuring': return 'bg-yellow-500';
      case 'disconnected': return 'bg-gray-500';

              const IconComponent = connector.icon;
              return (
                <Card

                  className="cursor-pointer hover:bg-gray-800/50 bg-gray-900/50 border-gray-700 hover:border-blue-500/50"
                  onClick={() => setSelectedConnector(connector)}
                >
                  <CardHeader className="pb-3">
                    <div className="flex items-center gap-3 mb-2">
                      <IconComponent className="w-8 h-8 text-blue-400" />
                      <div className="flex-1">
                        <CardTitle className="text-white text-lg">{connector.name}</CardTitle>
                        <p className="text-gray-400 text-sm">by {connector.provider}</p>

                      <Badge variant={connector.pricing === 'free' ? 'default' : 'secondary'} className="text-xs">
                        {connector.pricing}

                    </div>

                    <div>

                      <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-2">
                        {selectedConnector.features.map((feature, idx) => (
                          <div key={idx} className="flex items-center gap-2">
                            <CheckCircle className="w-4 h-4 text-green-400" />
                            <span className="text-gray-300 text-sm">{feature}</span>
                          </div>
                        ))}
                      </div>
                    </div>

                    <div>
                      <h4 className="text-white font-medium mb-3">Requirements</h4>
                      <ul className="space-y-1">
                        {selectedConnector.requirements.map((req, idx) => (
                          <li key={idx} className="text-gray-300 text-sm flex items-start gap-2">
                            <Shield className="w-4 h-4 text-yellow-400 mt-0.5 flex-shrink-0" />
                            {req}
                          </li>
                        ))}
                      </ul>
                    </div>

                    <div className="flex gap-4">
                      <VeridiusButton
                        variant="primary"
                        onClick={() => installIntegration(selectedConnector)}
                        disabled={isInstalling}
                      >
                        {isInstalling ? 'Installing...' : 'Install Integration'}
                      </VeridiusButton>
                      <VeridiusButton
                        variant="outline"
                        onClick={() => setSelectedConnector(null)}
                      >
                        Cancel
                      </VeridiusButton>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>
          )}
        </TabsContent>

        <TabsContent value="installed">
          <VeridiusCard>
            <div className="p-6">
              <h3 className="text-xl font-semibold text-white mb-6">Installed Integrations</h3>
              {instances.length > 0 ? (
                <div className="space-y-4">
                  {instances.map((instance) => {
                    const connector = connectors.find(c => c.id === instance.connectorId);
                    if (!connector) return null;
                    const IconComponent = connector.icon;

                      <Card key={instance.id} className="bg-gray-900/50 border-gray-700">
                        <CardContent className="p-4">
                          <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                            <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
                              <IconComponent className="w-8 h-8 text-blue-400" />
                              <div>
                                <h4 className="text-white font-medium">{instance.name}</h4>
                                <p className="text-gray-400 text-sm">
                                  {instance.syncStats.totalRecords.toLocaleString()} records synced
                                </p>
                              </div>
                            </div>
                            <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
                              <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                                <div className={`w-2 h-2 rounded-full ${getStatusColor(instance.status)}`} />
                                <span className="text-gray-300 text-sm capitalize">{instance.status}</span>
                              </div>
                              <VeridiusButton variant="outline" size="sm">
                                <Settings className="w-4 h-4" />
                              </VeridiusButton>
                            </div>
                          </div>
                          
                          {instance.lastSync && (
                            <div className="mt-3 text-gray-400 text-xs">
                              Last sync: {instance.lastSync.toLocaleDateString()} at {instance.lastSync.toLocaleTimeString()}
                            </div>
                          )}
                        </CardContent>
                      </Card>
                    );
                  })}
                </div>
              ) : (
                <div className="text-center py-8">
                  <Zap className="w-16 h-16 text-gray-600 mx-auto mb-4" />
                  <h4 className="text-xl text-white font-semibold mb-2">No Integrations Installed</h4>
                  <p className="text-gray-400 mb-6">Start by installing your first integration from the marketplace</p>
                  <VeridiusButton variant="primary">Browse Integrations</VeridiusButton>
                </div>
              )}
            </div>
          </VeridiusCard>
        </TabsContent>

        <TabsContent value="custom">
          <VeridiusCard>
            <div className="p-6">
              <h3 className="text-xl font-semibold text-white mb-6">Custom API Integration</h3>
              <div className="space-y-6">

## FILE: client/src/components/KPICard.tsx
```
import { TrendingUp, TrendingDown, Minus } from 'lucide-react';
import { Card } from '@/components/ui/card';

interface KPICardProps {
  title: string;
  value: string;
  trend?: {
    direction: 'up' | 'down' | 'neutral';
    percentage: string;
    period: string;
  };
  icon: React.ReactNode;
  variant?: 'primary' | 'success' | 'warning' | 'danger';
  onClick?: () => void;
}

const variantStyles = {
  primary: 'border-t-primary',
  success: 'border-t-green-600',
  warning: 'border-t-amber-600',
  danger: 'border-t-red-600',
};

const trendColors = {
  up: 'text-green-600',
  down: 'text-red-600',
  neutral: 'text-gray-600',
};

export default function KPICard({ 
  title, 
  value, 
  trend, 
  icon, 
  variant = 'primary',
  onClick 
}: KPICardProps) {
  const TrendIcon = trend?.direction === 'up' ? TrendingUp : 
                   trend?.direction === 'down' ? TrendingDown : Minus;

  return (
    <Card 
      className={`
        bg-white/15 backdrop-blur-xl border border-white/20 rounded-3xl p-8 shadow-xl 
        transition-all duration-500 hover:-translate-y-3 hover:shadow-2xl hover:bg-white/25 
        cursor-pointer relative overflow-hidden border-t-4 ${variantStyles[variant]}
      `}
      onClick={onClick}
    >
      <div className="flex items-start justify-between mb-6">
        <div className="w-14 h-14 bg-white/10 backdrop-blur-xl rounded-2xl flex items-center justify-center text-3xl transition-all duration-300 hover:scale-110 hover:rotate-6">
          {icon}
        </div>
        <div className="text-right">
          <div className="text-xs text-gray-600 font-semibold uppercase tracking-wider">
            {title}
          </div>
          <div className="text-3xl font-black text-gray-900 mt-1">
            {value}
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
      
      {trend && (
        <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
            <div className={`w-2 h-2 rounded-full animate-pulse ${
              trend.direction === 'up' ? 'bg-green-600' :
              trend.direction === 'down' ? 'bg-red-600' : 'bg-gray-600'
            }`} />
            <span className={`font-semibold text-sm flex items-center gap-1 ${trendColors[trend.direction]}`}>
              <TrendIcon className="w-4 h-4" />
              {trend.percentage}
            </span>
          </div>
          <div className="text-xs text-gray-500">
            {trend.period}
          </div>
        </div>
      )}
      
      {/* Shimmer effect */}
      <div className="absolute inset-0 opacity-0 hover:opacity-100 transition-opacity duration-300 bg-gradient-to-r from-transparent via-white/20 to-transparent transform -skew-x-12 animate-pulse" />
    </Card>
  );
}

                    variant={getActiveGroup() === group.label ? "default" : "ghost"}

                      ? 'bg-gradient-to-r from-indigo-600 to-purple-600 text-white shadow-lg' 
                      : 'hover:bg-indigo-50 hover:text-indigo-700'
                    }`}
                  >
                    {group.label}
                    <ChevronDown className="w-3 h-3" />
                  </Button>
                </DropdownMenuTrigger>
                <DropdownMenuContent className="w-64 bg-white/95 backdrop-blur-md border-white/20 shadow-xl">
                  <DropdownMenuLabel className="text-indigo-600 font-semibold">
                    {group.label}
                  </DropdownMenuLabel>
                  <DropdownMenuSeparator />
                  {group.items.map((item) => (
                    <DropdownMenuItem key={item.path} asChild>
                      <Link href={item.path} className="flex items-center gap-3 p-3 hover:bg-indigo-50 rounded-lg group cursor-pointer">
                        <div className={`p-2 rounded-lg ${isActive(item.path) 
                          ? 'bg-indigo-100 text-indigo-600' 
                          : 'bg-gray-100 group-hover:bg-indigo-100 group-hover:text-indigo-600'
                        }`}>
                          {item.icon}
                        </div>
                        <div className="flex-1">
                          <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                            <span className={`font-medium ${isActive(item.path) ? 'text-indigo-600' : 'text-gray-900'}`}>
                              {item.name}
                            </span>
                            {item.badge && (
                              <Badge variant="secondary" className="text-xs bg-indigo-100 text-indigo-600">
                                {item.badge}
                              </Badge>
                            )}
                          </div>
                          {item.description && (
                            <p className="text-xs text-gray-500 mt-1">{item.description}</p>
                          )}
                        </div>
                      </Link>
                    </DropdownMenuItem>
                  ))}
                </DropdownMenuContent>
              </DropdownMenu>
            ))}
          </div>

          {/* Quick Actions */}
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
            <DropdownMenu>
              <DropdownMenuTrigger asChild>
                <Button variant="outline" size="sm" className="gap-2 border-indigo-200 hover:bg-indigo-50">
                  <Target className="w-4 h-4" />
                  Quick Actions
                </Button>
              </DropdownMenuTrigger>
              <DropdownMenuContent className="w-48 bg-white/95 backdrop-blur-md">
                {quickActions.map((action) => (
                  <DropdownMenuItem key={action.action} className="flex items-center gap-2 cursor-pointer">
                    {action.icon}
                    {action.name}
                  </DropdownMenuItem>
                ))}
              </DropdownMenuContent>
            </DropdownMenu>
            
            <Button size="sm" className="bg-gradient-to-r from-indigo-600 to-purple-600 text-white shadow-lg hover:shadow-xl">
              <Shield className="w-4 h-4 mr-2" />
              Command Center
            </Button>
          </div>
        </div>
      </nav>

      {/* Mobile Navigation */}
      <nav className="lg:hidden bg-white/95 backdrop-blur-md border-b border-white/20 shadow-lg sticky top-0 z-50">
        <div className="px-4 py-3 flex items-center justify-between">
          {/* Mobile Logo */}
          <Link href="/" className="flex items-center gap-2">
            <div className="w-8 h-8 bg-gradient-to-br from-indigo-600 to-cyan-500 rounded-lg flex items-center justify-center">
              <div className="w-4 h-4 bg-white rounded-sm"></div>
            </div>
            <span className="font-bold text-indigo-600">Veridius</span>
          </Link>

          {/* Mobile Menu Button */}
          <Button 
            variant="ghost" 
            size="sm"
            onClick={() => setMobileMenuOpen(!mobileMenuOpen)}
            className="text-gray-600"
          >
            {mobileMenuOpen ? <X className="w-5 h-5" /> : <Menu className="w-5 h-5" />}
          </Button>
        </div>

        {/* Mobile Menu Panel */}
        {mobileMenuOpen && (
          <div className="absolute top-full left-0 right-0 bg-white/98 backdrop-blur-md border-b border-white/20 shadow-xl max-h-[80vh] overflow-y-auto">
            <div className="px-4 py-6 space-y-6">
              {navigationGroups.map((group) => (
                <div key={group.label}>
                  <h3 className="text-sm font-semibold text-indigo-600 mb-3 uppercase tracking-wide">
                    {group.label}
                  </h3>
                  <div className="space-y-2">
                    {group.items.map((item) => (
                      <Link 
                        key={item.path} 
                        href={item.path}
                        onClick={() => setMobileMenuOpen(false)}
                        className={`flex items-center gap-3 p-3 rounded-lg transition-colors ${
                          isActive(item.path) 
                            ? 'bg-indigo-100 text-indigo-600' 
                            : 'hover:bg-gray-50'
                        }`}
                      >
                        <div className={`p-2 rounded-lg ${
                          isActive(item.path) ? 'bg-indigo-200' : 'bg-gray-100'
                        }`}>
                          {item.icon}
                        </div>
                        <div className="flex-1">
                          <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                            <span className="font-medium">{item.name}</span>
                            {item.badge && (
                              <Badge variant="secondary" className="text-xs">
                                {item.badge}
                              </Badge>
                            )}
                          </div>
                          {item.description && (
                            <p className="text-xs text-gray-500 mt-1">{item.description}</p>
                          )}
                        </div>
                      </Link>
                    ))}
                  </div>
                </div>
              ))}

              {/* Mobile Quick Actions */}
              <div className="pt-4 border-t border-gray-200">
                <h3 className="text-sm font-semibold text-indigo-600 mb-3 uppercase tracking-wide">
                  Quick Actions
                </h3>
                <div className="grid grid-cols-1 gap-2">
                  {quickActions.map((action) => (
                    <Button 
                      key={action.action}
                      variant="outline" 
                      className="justify-start gap-2 border-indigo-200 hover:bg-indigo-50"
                    >
                      {action.icon}
                      {action.name}
                    </Button>
                  ))}
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>
        )}
      </nav>
    </>
  );
}

import React from 'react';
import { cn } from '@/lib/utils';
import ParticleBackground from '@/components/ParticleBackground';

interface VeridiusPageLayoutProps {
  children: React.ReactNode;
  title?: string;
  subtitle?: string;
  className?: string;
  showParticles?: boolean;
  headerActions?: React.ReactNode;
}

export default function VeridiusPageLayout({
  children,
  title,
  subtitle,
  className,
  showParticles = true,
  headerActions
}: VeridiusPageLayoutProps) {
  return (
    <div className={cn("veridius-page flex-1 p-6 overflow-y-auto max-h-screen", className)}>
      {showParticles && <ParticleBackground />}
      
      <div className="relative z-10 max-w-7xl mx-auto">
        {(title || subtitle || headerActions) && (
          <div className="veridius-page-header flex justify-between items-start">
            <div>
              {title && (
                <h1 className="veridius-heading-1 veridius-fade-in">
                  {title}
                </h1>
              )}
              {subtitle && (
                <p className="veridius-body text-white/70 veridius-slide-up">
                  {subtitle}
                </p>
              )}
            </div>
            {headerActions && (
              <div className="flex gap-3 veridius-fade-in">
                {headerActions}
              </div>
            )}
          </div>
        )}
        
        <div className="veridius-slide-up">
          {children}
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

// Quick Layout Components for Common Patterns
export function VeridiusMetricsGrid({ children, columns = 4 }: { children: React.ReactNode; columns?: number }) {
  return (
    <div className={cn(
      "veridius-grid mb-8",
      columns === 2 && "veridius-grid-2",
      columns === 3 && "veridius-grid-3", 
      columns === 4 && "veridius-grid-4"
    )}>
      {children}
    </div>
  );
}

export function VeridiusMetricCard({ 
  value, 
  label, 
  subtitle, 
  color = "blue",
  trend,
  icon 
}: {
  value: string;
  label: string;
  subtitle?: string;
  color?: 'blue' | 'green' | 'orange' | 'red' | 'purple';
  trend?: 'up' | 'down';
  icon?: React.ReactNode;
}) {
  const colorClasses = {
    blue: 'from-blue-500/20 to-cyan-500/20 border-blue-500/30',
    green: 'from-green-500/20 to-emerald-500/20 border-green-500/30',
    orange: 'from-orange-500/20 to-red-500/20 border-orange-500/30',
    red: 'from-red-500/20 to-pink-500/20 border-red-500/30',
    purple: 'from-purple-500/20 to-indigo-500/20 border-purple-500/30'
  };

  return (
    <div className={cn("veridius-metric bg-gradient-to-br", colorClasses[color])}>
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-4">
        {icon && <div className="p-2 rounded-lg bg-white/10">{icon}</div>}
        {trend && (
          <div className={cn(
            "flex items-center text-sm font-medium",
            trend === 'up' ? 'text-green-400' : 'text-red-400'
          )}>
            {trend === 'up' ? '↗' : '↘'}
          </div>
        )}
      </div>
      
      <div className="veridius-metric-value">{value}</div>
      <div className="veridius-metric-label">{label}</div>
      {subtitle && <div className="veridius-metric-subtitle">{subtitle}</div>}
    </div>
  );
}

export function VeridiusSection({ 
  title, 
  subtitle, 
  children, 
  className,
  actions 
}: { 
  title?: string; 
  subtitle?: string; 
  children: React.ReactNode; 
  className?: string;
  actions?: React.ReactNode;
}) {
  return (
    <section className={cn("mb-12", className)}>
      {(title || subtitle || actions) && (
        <div className="flex justify-between items-start mb-6">
          <div>
            {title && <h2 className="veridius-heading-2 mb-2">{title}</h2>}
            {subtitle && <p className="veridius-body text-white/70">{subtitle}</p>}
          </div>
          {actions && <div className="flex gap-3">{actions}</div>}
        </div>
      )}
      {children}
    </section>
  );
}

import React, { useState } from 'react';
import { Card, CardContent, CardDescription, CardHeader, CardTitle } from '@/components/ui/card';
import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button';
import { Badge } from '@/components/ui/badge';
import { Progress } from '@/components/ui/progress';
import { 
  Smartphone,
  Wifi,
  WifiOff,
  MapPin,
  Users,
  MessageCircle,
  Bell,
  CheckCircle,
  AlertTriangle,
  Navigation,
  Camera,
  Mic,
  Send,
  Download,
  Upload,
  Battery,
  Signal
} from 'lucide-react';

interface FieldTeamMember {
  id: string;
  name: string;
  role: string;
  location: string;
  status: 'active' | 'offline' | 'busy';
  lastUpdate: string;
  battery: number;
  signal: number;
}

interface MobileAlert {
  id: string;
  title: string;
  message: string;
  priority: 'low' | 'medium' | 'high' | 'urgent';
  timestamp: string;
  acknowledged: boolean;
}

const MobileCommandCenter = () => {
  const [activeTab, setActiveTab] = useState('overview');
  const [isOfflineMode, setIsOfflineMode] = useState(false);
  
  const fieldTeam: FieldTeamMember[] = [
    {
      id: 'field-01',
      name: 'Sarah Chen',
      role: 'Regional Manager',
      location: 'Singapore Operations',
      status: 'active',
      lastUpdate: '2 minutes ago',
      battery: 85,
      signal: 92
    },
    {
      id: 'field-02',
      name: 'Miguel Rodriguez',
      role: 'Supply Chain Lead',
      location: 'Port of Los Angeles',
      status: 'busy',
      lastUpdate: '5 minutes ago',
      battery: 67,
      signal: 78
    },
    {
      id: 'field-03',
      name: 'Emma Thompson',
      role: 'Crisis Coordinator',
      location: 'London Emergency Center',
      status: 'active',
      lastUpdate: '1 minute ago',
      battery: 94,
      signal: 88
    },
    {
      id: 'field-04',
      name: 'David Kim',
      role: 'Technical Lead',
      location: 'Seoul Data Center',
      status: 'offline',
      lastUpdate: '15 minutes ago',
      battery: 23,
      signal: 0
    }
  ];

  const mobileAlerts: MobileAlert[] = [
    {
      id: 'alert-01',
      title: 'Supply Chain Disruption',
      message: 'Port congestion detected. Alternative routes recommended.',
      priority: 'urgent',
      timestamp: '5 minutes ago',
      acknowledged: false
    },
    {
      id: 'alert-02',
      title: 'Weather Advisory',
      message: 'Storm system approaching Singapore operations zone.',
      priority: 'high',
      timestamp: '12 minutes ago',
      acknowledged: true
    },
    {
      id: 'alert-03',
      title: 'System Update',
      message: 'Mobile app update available with enhanced offline features.',
      priority: 'medium',
      timestamp: '1 hour ago',
      acknowledged: false
    }
  ];

  const getStatusColor = (status: string) => {
    switch (status) {
      case 'active': return 'bg-green-100 text-green-700';
      case 'busy': return 'bg-yellow-100 text-yellow-700';
      case 'offline': return 'bg-red-100 text-red-700';
      default: return 'bg-gray-100 text-gray-700';
    }
  };

  const getPriorityColor = (priority: string) => {
    switch (priority) {
      case 'urgent': return 'bg-red-100 text-red-700 border-red-300';
      case 'high': return 'bg-orange-100 text-orange-700 border-orange-300';
      case 'medium': return 'bg-yellow-100 text-yellow-700 border-yellow-300';
      case 'low': return 'bg-green-100 text-green-700 border-green-300';
      default: return 'bg-gray-100 text-gray-700 border-gray-300';
    }
  };

  const renderOverview = () => (
    <div className="space-y-6">
      {/* Mobile Status Dashboard */}
      <Card className="bg-gradient-to-r from-blue-600 to-purple-600 text-white">
        <CardContent className="p-8">
          <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
            <div>
              <h2 className="text-3xl font-bold">Mobile Command Center</h2>
              <p className="text-blue-200 text-lg">Field operations and mobile crisis management</p>
              <div className="flex items-center space-x-6 mt-4">
                <div>
                  <p className="text-2xl font-bold">{fieldTeam.filter(m => m.status === 'active').length}</p>
                  <p className="text-blue-200 text-sm">Active Field Teams</p>
                </div>
                <div>
                  <p className="text-2xl font-bold">{isOfflineMode ? 'Offline' : 'Online'}</p>
                  <p className="text-blue-200 text-sm">Connection Mode</p>
                </div>
                <div>
                  <p className="text-2xl font-bold">
                    {mobileAlerts.filter(a => !a.acknowledged && a.priority === 'urgent').length}
                  </p>
                  <p className="text-blue-200 text-sm">Urgent Alerts</p>
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>
            <div className="text-right">
              <div className="w-24 h-24 bg-white bg-opacity-20 rounded-full flex items-center justify-center">
                <Smartphone className="w-12 h-12 text-white" />
              </div>
              <p className="text-blue-200 mt-2">Mobile Ready</p>
            </div>
          </div>
        </CardContent>
      </Card>

      {/* Offline Mode Toggle */}
      <Card>
        <CardHeader>
          <CardTitle className="flex items-center space-x-2">
            {isOfflineMode ? <WifiOff className="w-6 h-6 text-red-600" /> : <Wifi className="w-6 h-6 text-green-600" />}
            <span>Offline Capabilities</span>
          </CardTitle>
          <CardDescription>
            Seamless operation during network outages and remote locations
          </CardDescription>
        </CardHeader>
        <CardContent>
          <div className="space-y-4">
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
              <span>Offline Mode</span>
              <Button
                onClick={() => setIsOfflineMode(!isOfflineMode)}
                variant={isOfflineMode ? "destructive" : "default"}
                size="sm"
              >
                {isOfflineMode ? 'Go Online' : 'Enable Offline Mode'}
              </Button>
            </div>
            
            <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 gap-4">
              <div className="p-4 bg-gray-50 rounded-lg">
                <h4 className="font-semibold mb-2">Available Offline:</h4>
                <ul className="text-sm space-y-1">
                  <li className="flex items-center space-x-2">
                    <CheckCircle className="w-4 h-4 text-green-600" />
                    <span>Crisis response plans</span>
                  </li>
                  <li className="flex items-center space-x-2">
                    <CheckCircle className="w-4 h-4 text-green-600" />
                    <span>Contact directories</span>
                  </li>
                  <li className="flex items-center space-x-2">
                    <CheckCircle className="w-4 h-4 text-green-600" />

                  </li>
                  <li className="flex items-center space-x-2">
                    <CheckCircle className="w-4 h-4 text-green-600" />
                    <span>Offline messaging</span>
                  </li>
                </ul>
              </div>
              
              <div className="p-4 bg-blue-50 rounded-lg">
                <h4 className="font-semibold mb-2">Sync Status:</h4>
                <div className="space-y-2">
                  <div className="flex items-center justify-between text-sm">
                    <span>Last sync</span>
                    <span className="text-green-600">2 minutes ago</span>
                  </div>
                  <div className="flex items-center justify-between text-sm">

            <span>Field Team Status</span>
          </CardTitle>
        </CardHeader>
        <CardContent>
          <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 gap-4">

                    <h4 className="font-semibold">{member.name}</h4>

                    {member.status}
                  </Badge>
                </div>

                  </div>
                  
                  <div className="flex items-center justify-between">

                      Acknowledge
                    </Button>
                  )}
                </div>
              </div>
              
              {alert.priority === 'urgent' && !alert.acknowledged && (
                <div className="mt-4 p-3 bg-red-100 rounded-lg">

                      <Mic className="w-4 h-4 mr-1" />
                      Voice Update
                    </Button>
                    <Button size="sm" variant="outline">
                      <Send className="w-4 h-4 mr-1" />
                      Send Status
                    </Button>
                  </div>
                </div>

            </CardContent>

            ].map((tab) => (

                key={tab.id}
                onClick={() => setActiveTab(tab.id)}

                  activeTab === tab.id
                    ? 'bg-blue-600 text-white shadow-lg'
                    : 'text-gray-600 hover:bg-gray-100'

              >
                <tab.icon className="w-5 h-5" />
                <span className="font-medium">{tab.name}</span>
              </button>
            ))}
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Tab Content */}
        <div className="min-h-96">
          {activeTab === 'overview' && renderOverview()}
          {activeTab === 'alerts' && renderAlerts()}
          {activeTab === 'offline' && renderOffline()}
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

export default MobileCommandCenter;

import React, { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import { Card, CardContent, CardDescription, CardHeader, CardTitle } from '@/components/ui/card';
import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button';
import { Badge } from '@/components/ui/badge';
import { Progress } from '@/components/ui/progress';
import { Tabs, TabsContent, TabsList, TabsTrigger } from '@/components/ui/tabs';
import { 
  Smartphone, 
  Tablet, 
  Monitor, 
  Wifi,
  Battery,
  Signal,
  MapPin,
  Clock,
  AlertTriangle,
  CheckCircle,
  Bell,
  MessageSquare,
  Video,
  Users,
  Zap,
  Shield,
  Globe,
  Download,

} from 'lucide-react';

interface MobileMetrics {
  onlineUsers: number;
  responseTime: string;
  batteryOptimized: number;
  offlineCapability: number;
  syncStatus: 'synced' | 'syncing' | 'offline';
}

interface DeviceInfo {
  type: 'mobile' | 'tablet' | 'desktop';
  os: string;
  version: string;
  lastSync: Date;
  batteryLevel?: number;
  isOnline: boolean;
}

interface CrisisAlert {
  id: string;
  title: string;
  severity: 'low' | 'medium' | 'high' | 'critical';
  timestamp: Date;
  location: string;
  status: 'new' | 'acknowledged' | 'resolved';
  responseTime?: string;
}

export default function MobileCommandCenterV2() {
  const [metrics, setMetrics] = useState<MobileMetrics>({
    onlineUsers: 347,
    responseTime: '1.2s',
    batteryOptimized: 94,
    offlineCapability: 87,
    syncStatus: 'synced'
  });

  const [isOfflineMode, setIsOfflineMode] = useState(false);

      type: 'mobile',

    },

      type: 'tablet',
      os: 'iPadOS 17.2',

    },

    }

      status: 'new',
    },
    {
      id: 'cyber-002',
      title: 'Security Incident - North America',
      severity: 'high',
      timestamp: new Date(Date.now() - 900000), // 15 min ago
      location: 'Data Center East',
      status: 'acknowledged',
      responseTime: '2 min'
    },
    {
      id: 'market-003',
      title: 'Market Volatility Alert',

      timestamp: new Date(Date.now() - 1800000), // 30 min ago
      location: 'Global Markets',
      status: 'resolved',
      responseTime: '12 min'
    }
  ];

  const getSeverityColor = (severity: string) => {
    switch (severity) {
      case 'critical': return 'bg-red-500/20 text-red-100 border-red-500';
      case 'high': return 'bg-orange-500/20 text-orange-100 border-orange-500';
      case 'medium': return 'bg-yellow-500/20 text-yellow-100 border-yellow-500';
      case 'low': return 'bg-blue-500/20 text-blue-100 border-blue-500';
      default: return 'bg-gray-500/20 text-gray-100 border-gray-500';
    }
  };

  const getStatusIcon = (status: string) => {
    switch (status) {
      case 'new': return <AlertTriangle className="h-4 w-4" />;
      case 'acknowledged': return <Clock className="h-4 w-4" />;
      case 'resolved': return <CheckCircle className="h-4 w-4" />;
      default: return <Bell className="h-4 w-4" />;
    }

  const getDeviceIcon = (type: string) => {

      case 'mobile': return <Smartphone className="h-5 w-5" />;

      case 'desktop': return <Monitor className="h-5 w-5" />;
      default: return <Smartphone className="h-5 w-5" />;
    }

  const formatTimeAgo = (date: Date) => {
    const now = new Date();
    const diff = now.getTime() - date.getTime();
    const minutes = Math.floor(diff / 60000);
    
    if (minutes < 1) return 'Just now';
    if (minutes < 60) return `${minutes}m ago`;
    const hours = Math.floor(minutes / 60);
    if (hours < 24) return `${hours}h ago`;
    const days = Math.floor(hours / 24);
    return `${days}d ago`;

// Mobile-Optimized Executive Interface
// Responsive design for executive access anywhere, anytime

          </CardContent>
        </Card>
      </div>
    );
  }

  return (
    <div className="mobile-interface min-h-screen bg-gray-50">
      <MobileHeader />
      
      <div className="content">
        {activeView === 'dashboard' && (
          <div>
            <QuickMetrics />

              <Tabs defaultValue="scenarios" className="w-full">

                  <TabsTrigger value="opportunities">Growth</TabsTrigger>

                </TabsList>

                  <ScenarioList />
                </TabsContent>

                    <TrendingUp className="h-12 w-12 mx-auto text-green-500 mb-4" />
                    <h3 className="font-medium mb-2">Growth Opportunities</h3>
                    <p className="text-sm text-gray-600">Strategic opportunities will appear here</p>
                  </div>
                </TabsContent>
                <TabsContent value="alerts" className="mt-4">
                  <AlertsList />
                </TabsContent>
              </Tabs>
            </div>
          </div>
        )}

        {activeView === 'scenarios' && <ScenarioList />}
        {activeView === 'alerts' && <AlertsList />}
        
        {/* Other views */}
        {!['dashboard', 'scenarios', 'alerts'].includes(activeView) && (
          <div className="p-4 text-center">
            <h3 className="font-medium mb-2">{activeView.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + activeView.slice(1)}</h3>
            <p className="text-sm text-gray-600">Feature in development</p>
          </div>
        )}
      </div>

      {/* Quick Action Button */}
      <div className="fixed bottom-4 right-4">
        <Button 
          size="lg" 
          className="rounded-full h-14 w-14 shadow-lg bg-blue-600 hover:bg-blue-700"
          onClick={() => setActiveView('scenarios')}
        >
          <AlertTriangle className="h-6 w-6" />
        </Button>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

      const confidence = calculateConfidence();
      const alerts = generateAlerts();

      const newScenario: ScenarioData = {
        id: Date.now().toString(),
        templateId: activeTemplate.id,
        data: { ...currentData },
        timestamp: new Date(),
        confidence,
        impactScore,
        alerts,
      };

      setScenarios(prev => [newScenario, ...prev.slice(0, 4)]);
      setIsRunningScenario(false);
      
      toast({
        title: "Scenario Analysis Complete",
        description: `Impact Score: ${impactScore}/100, Confidence: ${confidence}%`,
      });
    }, 2000);
  };

  const calculateImpactScore = (): number => {
    if (!activeTemplate) return 0;
    
    let totalImpact = 0;
    let weightedFields = 0;
    
    activeTemplate.fields.forEach(field => {
      const value = currentData[field.id];
      if (value) {
        const weight = field.impactLevel === 'critical' ? 4 : 
                      field.impactLevel === 'high' ? 3 :
                      field.impactLevel === 'medium' ? 2 : 1;
        
        let impact = 0;
        if (field.type === 'number' && typeof value === 'number') {
          impact = Math.min(value / 100, 1) * 100;
        } else if (field.type === 'select') {
          const options = field.options || [];
          const index = options.indexOf(value);
          impact = index >= 0 ? ((index + 1) / options.length) * 100 : 50;
        } else {
          impact = value ? 70 : 30;
        }
        
        totalImpact += impact * weight;
        weightedFields += weight;
      }
    });
    
    return weightedFields > 0 ? Math.round(totalImpact / weightedFields) : 0;
  };

  const calculateConfidence = (): number => {
    if (!activeTemplate) return 0;
    
    const requiredFields = activeTemplate.fields.filter(f => f.required);
    const completedRequired = requiredFields.filter(f => currentData[f.id]).length;
    const totalFields = activeTemplate.fields.length;
    const completedTotal = activeTemplate.fields.filter(f => currentData[f.id]).length;
    
    const requiredScore = (completedRequired / requiredFields.length) * 70;
    const completenessScore = (completedTotal / totalFields) * 30;
    
    return Math.round(requiredScore + completenessScore);
  };

  const generateAlerts = (): string[] => {
    const alerts: string[] = [];
    
    if (currentData['production-impact'] > 50) {
      alerts.push('Critical: Production impact exceeds 50%');
    }
    if (currentData['inventory-levels'] < 30) {
      alerts.push('Warning: Inventory levels critically low');
    }
    if (currentData['market-share-impact'] > 10) {
      alerts.push('Alert: Significant market share risk identified');
    }
    
    return alerts;
  };

  const getImpactColor = (level: string) => {
    switch (level) {
      case 'critical': return 'bg-red-500';
      case 'high': return 'bg-orange-500';
      case 'medium': return 'bg-yellow-500';
      case 'low': return 'bg-green-500';
      default: return 'bg-gray-500';
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6 p-6">
      {/* Header */}
      <div className="text-center space-y-4">
        <h1 className="text-4xl font-black text-foreground">Strategic Data Intelligence</h1>
        <p className="text-xl text-muted-foreground max-w-4xl mx-auto">
          Dynamic data capture and real-time scenario analysis for executive decision-making
        </p>
      </div>

      {/* Real-time Data Feeds */}
      <Card className="bg-gradient-to-r from-blue-50 to-indigo-50 dark:from-blue-950/20 dark:to-indigo-950/20">
        <CardHeader>
          <CardTitle className="flex items-center gap-2">
            <Activity className="w-5 h-5" />
            Real-Time Intelligence Feeds
          </CardTitle>
        </CardHeader>
        <CardContent>
          <div className="grid grid-cols-2 md:grid-cols-4 gap-4">
            <div className="text-center p-4 bg-white/50 rounded-lg">
              <div className="text-2xl font-bold text-blue-600">{realTimeFeeds.marketVolatility?.toFixed(1) || '0'}</div>
              <div className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">Market Volatility</div>
            </div>
            <div className="text-center p-4 bg-white/50 rounded-lg">
              <div className="text-2xl font-bold text-green-600">{realTimeFeeds.supplyChainHealth?.toFixed(1) || '0'}%</div>
              <div className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">Supply Chain Health</div>
            </div>
            <div className="text-center p-4 bg-white/50 rounded-lg">
              <div className="text-2xl font-bold text-purple-600">{realTimeFeeds.customerSentiment?.toFixed(1) || '0'}%</div>
              <div className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">Customer Sentiment</div>
            </div>
            <div className="text-center p-4 bg-white/50 rounded-lg">
              <div className="text-2xl font-bold text-orange-600">{realTimeFeeds.competitiveActivity?.toFixed(1) || '0'}</div>
              <div className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">Competitive Activity</div>
            </div>
          </div>
        </CardContent>
      </Card>

      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-6">
        {/* Data Template Selection */}
        <div className="lg:col-span-1 space-y-4">
          <Card>
            <CardHeader>
              <CardTitle className="flex items-center gap-2">
                <Database className="w-5 h-5" />
                Disruption Data Templates
              </CardTitle>
              <CardDescription>
                Select a template based on your disruption type
              </CardDescription>
            </CardHeader>
            <CardContent className="space-y-3">
              {dataTemplates.map(template => (
                <div 
                  key={template.id}
                  className={`p-3 border rounded-lg cursor-pointer transition-all ${
                    activeTemplate?.id === template.id 
                      ? 'border-primary bg-primary/5' 
                      : 'border-gray-200 hover:border-primary/50'
                  }`}
                  onClick={() => handleTemplateSelect(template)}
                >
                  <div className="font-medium">{template.name}</div>
                  <div className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">{template.description}</div>
                  <div className="flex gap-2 mt-2">
                    <Badge variant="outline" className="text-xs">
                      {template.fields.length} fields
                    </Badge>
                    <Badge variant="secondary" className="text-xs">
                      {template.updateFrequency}
                    </Badge>
                  </div>
                </div>
              ))}
            </CardContent>
          </Card>

          {/* Recent Scenarios */}
          <Card>
            <CardHeader>
              <CardTitle className="flex items-center gap-2">
                <BarChart3 className="w-5 h-5" />
                Recent Analyses
              </CardTitle>
            </CardHeader>
            <CardContent className="space-y-3">
              {scenarios.map(scenario => (
                <div key={scenario.id} className="p-3 border rounded-lg">
                  <div className="flex justify-between items-center mb-2">
                    <div className="font-medium text-sm">
                      {dataTemplates.find(t => t.id === scenario.templateId)?.name}
                    </div>
                    <div className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">
                      {scenario.timestamp.toLocaleTimeString()}
                    </div>
                  </div>
                  <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-2 text-xs">
                    <div>Impact: <span className="font-medium">{scenario.impactScore}/100</span></div>
                    <div>Confidence: <span className="font-medium">{scenario.confidence}%</span></div>
                  </div>
                  {scenario.alerts.length > 0 && (
                    <div className="mt-2">
                      {scenario.alerts.slice(0, 1).map((alert, index) => (
                        <div key={index} className="text-xs text-red-600 flex items-center gap-1">
                          <AlertTriangle className="w-3 h-3" />
                          {alert}
                        </div>
                      ))}
                    </div>
                  )}
                </div>
              ))}
            </CardContent>
          </Card>
        </div>

        {/* Data Input Form */}
        <div className="lg:col-span-2">
          {activeTemplate ? (
            <Card>
              <CardHeader>
                <CardTitle className="flex items-center gap-2">
                  <Target className="w-5 h-5" />
                  {activeTemplate.name} - Data Capture
                </CardTitle>
                <CardDescription>
                  {activeTemplate.description}
                </CardDescription>
              </CardHeader>
              <CardContent className="space-y-6">
                <Tabs defaultValue="operational" className="space-y-4">
                  <TabsList className="grid w-full grid-cols-4">
                    <TabsTrigger value="operational">Operational</TabsTrigger>
                    <TabsTrigger value="financial">Financial</TabsTrigger>
                    <TabsTrigger value="market">Market</TabsTrigger>
                    <TabsTrigger value="strategic">Strategic</TabsTrigger>
                  </TabsList>

                  {['operational', 'financial', 'market', 'strategic'].map(category => (
                    <TabsContent key={category} value={category} className="space-y-4">
                      {activeTemplate.fields
                        .filter(field => field.category === category)
                        .map(field => (
                          <div key={field.id} className="space-y-2">
                            <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                              <label className="text-sm font-medium">
                                {field.name}
                                {field.required && <span className="text-red-500">*</span>}
                              </label>
                              <div className={`w-2 h-2 rounded-full ${getImpactColor(field.impactLevel)}`} />
                            </div>
                            <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">{field.description}</p>
                            
                            {field.type === 'text' && (
                              <Input
                                placeholder={`Enter ${field.name.toLowerCase()}`}
                                value={currentData[field.id] || ''}
                                onChange={(e) => handleFieldUpdate(field.id, e.target.value)}
                              />
                            )}
                            
                            {field.type === 'number' && (
                              <Input
                                type="number"
                                placeholder={`Enter ${field.name.toLowerCase()}`}
                                value={currentData[field.id] || ''}
                                onChange={(e) => handleFieldUpdate(field.id, parseFloat(e.target.value) || 0)}
                              />
                            )}
                            
                            {field.type === 'textarea' && (
                              <Textarea
                                placeholder={`Enter ${field.name.toLowerCase()}`}
                                value={currentData[field.id] || ''}
                                onChange={(e) => handleFieldUpdate(field.id, e.target.value)}
                                rows={3}
                              />
                            )}
                            
                            {field.type === 'select' && field.options && (
                              <Select 
                                value={currentData[field.id] || ''} 
                                onValueChange={(value) => handleFieldUpdate(field.id, value)}
                              >
                                <SelectTrigger>
                                  <SelectValue placeholder={`Select ${field.name.toLowerCase()}`} />
                                </SelectTrigger>
                                <SelectContent>
                                  {field.options.map(option => (
                                    <SelectItem key={option} value={option}>{option}</SelectItem>
                                  ))}
                                </SelectContent>
                              </Select>
                            )}
                            
                            {field.type === 'date' && (
                              <Input
                                type="date"
                                value={currentData[field.id] || ''}
                                onChange={(e) => handleFieldUpdate(field.id, e.target.value)}
                              />
                            )}
                            
                            {field.type === 'boolean' && (
                              <div className="flex items-center space-x-2">
                                <input
                                  type="checkbox"
                                  checked={currentData[field.id] || false}
                                  onChange={(e) => handleFieldUpdate(field.id, e.target.checked)}
                                />
                                <span className="text-sm">Yes</span>
                              </div>
                            )}
                          </div>
                        ))}
                      
                      {activeTemplate.fields.filter(f => f.category === category).length === 0 && (
                        <div className="text-center py-8 text-muted-foreground">
                          No {category} fields for this template
                        </div>
                      )}
                    </TabsContent>
                  ))}
                </Tabs>

                {/* Analysis Controls */}
                <div className="border-t pt-6">
                  <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-4">
                    <div>
                      <h4 className="font-medium">Scenario Analysis</h4>
                      <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">
                        Run real-time analysis on captured data
                      </p>
                    </div>
                    <Button 
                      onClick={runScenarioAnalysis}
                      disabled={isRunningScenario}
                      className="min-w-32"
                    >
                      {isRunningScenario ? (
                        <>
                          <RefreshCw className="w-4 h-4 mr-2 animate-spin" />
                          Analyzing...
                        </>
                      ) : (
                        <>
                          <Zap className="w-4 h-4 mr-2" />
                          Run Analysis
                        </>
                      )}
                    </Button>
                  </div>
                  
                  <div className="grid grid-cols-3 gap-4">
                    <div className="text-center p-3 bg-muted/50 rounded-lg">
                      <div className="text-lg font-bold">{calculateImpactScore()}/100</div>
                      <div className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">Impact Score</div>
                    </div>
                    <div className="text-center p-3 bg-muted/50 rounded-lg">
                      <div className="text-lg font-bold">{calculateConfidence()}%</div>
                      <div className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">Confidence</div>
                    </div>
                    <div className="text-center p-3 bg-muted/50 rounded-lg">
                      <div className="text-lg font-bold">{Object.keys(currentData).length}</div>
                      <div className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">Fields Completed</div>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                </div>
              </CardContent>
            </Card>
          ) : (
            <Card>
              <CardContent className="text-center py-12">
                <Database className="w-12 h-12 mx-auto text-muted-foreground mb-4" />
                <h3 className="text-xl font-semibold mb-2">Select a Data Template</h3>
                <p className="text-muted-foreground">
                  Choose a disruption template to begin capturing strategic data for executive decision-making
                </p>
              </CardContent>
            </Card>
          )}
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

export default MVPDataManager;
```

                </li>
              </ul>
            </div>
            <div className="space-y-3">
              <h4 className="font-semibold text-green-700">With Veridius:</h4>
              <ul className="space-y-2 text-sm">
                <li className="flex items-center gap-2">
                  <CheckCircle className="h-4 w-4 text-green-600" />
                  4 minutes from threat to complete strategy
                </li>
                <li className="flex items-center gap-2">
                  <CheckCircle className="h-4 w-4 text-green-600" />
                  Zero consultant dependency
                </li>
                <li className="flex items-center gap-2">
