```
          <TabsTrigger value="readiness">Organizational Velocity</TabsTrigger>
          <TabsTrigger value="recommendations">Strategic Acceleration</TabsTrigger>
        </TabsList>

        {/* Agility Metrics */}
        <TabsContent value="metrics" className="space-y-6">
          <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-4">
            {agilityMetrics.map((metric) => {
              const status = getMetricStatus(metric.value, metric.target);
              return (
                <Card 
                  key={metric.id} 
                  className={`cursor-pointer hover:shadow-lg transition-all ${
                    selectedMetric === metric.id ? 'border-blue-500 shadow-lg' : ''
                  }`}
                  onClick={() => setSelectedMetric(metric.id)}
                >
                  <CardHeader className="pb-3">
                    <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                      <CardTitle className="text-lg">{metric.name}</CardTitle>
                      <Badge className={categoryColors[metric.category]}>
                        {metric.category}
                      </Badge>
                    </div>
                  </CardHeader>
                  <CardContent>
                    <div className="space-y-3">
                      <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                        <span className="text-2xl font-bold">{metric.value}</span>
                        <span className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">Target: {metric.target}</span>
                      </div>
                      
                      <Progress value={(metric.value / metric.target) * 100} className="h-2" />
                      
                      <div className="flex items-center justify-between text-sm">
                        <span className={status.color}>{status.status}</span>
                        <div className="flex items-center gap-1">
                          {metric.trend === 'up' ? (
                            <TrendingUp className="h-3 w-3 text-green-500" />
                          ) : metric.trend === 'down' ? (
                            <TrendingUp className="h-3 w-3 text-red-500 rotate-180" />
                          ) : (
                            <Target className="h-3 w-3 text-gray-500" />
                          )}
                          <span className="text-muted-foreground">trending {metric.trend}</span>
                        </div>
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  </CardContent>
                </Card>
              );
            })}
          </div>

          {/* Selected Metric Details */}
          {selectedMetric && (
            <Card>
              <CardHeader>
                <CardTitle>Metric Analysis</CardTitle>
              </CardHeader>
              <CardContent>
                {(() => {
                  const metric = agilityMetrics.find(m => m.id === selectedMetric);
                  if (!metric) return null;
                  
                  return (
                    <div className="space-y-4">
                      <p className="text-muted-foreground">{metric.description}</p>
                      
                      <div className="grid grid-cols-3 gap-4">
                        <div className="text-center">
                          <div className="text-2xl font-bold text-blue-600">{metric.value}</div>
                          <div className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">Current Score</div>
                        </div>
                        <div className="text-center">
                          <div className="text-2xl font-bold text-green-600">{metric.target}</div>
                          <div className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">Target Score</div>
                        </div>
                        <div className="text-center">
                          <div className="text-2xl font-bold text-purple-600">{metric.target - metric.value}</div>
                          <div className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">Gap to Close</div>
                        </div>
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  );
                })()}
              </CardContent>
            </Card>
          )}
        </TabsContent>

        {/* Capability Assessment */}
        <TabsContent value="capabilities" className="space-y-6">
          <div className="space-y-4">
            {capabilityAssessments.map((capability, index) => (
              <Card key={index}>
                <CardHeader>
                  <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                    <CardTitle>{capability.area}</CardTitle>
                    <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                      <span className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">
                        {capability.currentLevel}/{capability.targetLevel}
                      </span>
                      <Badge variant="outline">{capability.timeToImprove}</Badge>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                </CardHeader>
                <CardContent className="space-y-4">
                  <div>
                    <div className="flex justify-between text-sm mb-2">
                      <span>Current Level</span>
                      <span>{capability.currentLevel}%</span>
                    </div>
                    <Progress value={capability.currentLevel} className="h-2 mb-1" />
                    <div className="flex justify-between text-sm">
                      <span>Target Level</span>
                      <span>{capability.targetLevel}%</span>
                    </div>
                    <Progress value={capability.targetLevel} className="h-2 bg-gray-200" />
                  </div>

                  <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 gap-4">
                    <div>
                      <h5 className="font-medium text-red-600 mb-2 flex items-center gap-2">
                        <AlertCircle className="h-4 w-4" />
                        Key Gaps
                      </h5>
                      <ul className="text-sm space-y-1">
                        {capability.gaps.map((gap, i) => (
                          <li key={i} className="flex items-start gap-2">
                            <div className="w-1 h-1 bg-red-500 rounded-full mt-2 flex-shrink-0" />
                            {gap}
                          </li>
                        ))}
                      </ul>
                    </div>
                    
                    <div>
                      <h5 className="font-medium text-green-600 mb-2 flex items-center gap-2">
                        <CheckCircle className="h-4 w-4" />
                        Recommendations
                      </h5>
                      <ul className="text-sm space-y-1">
                        {capability.recommendations.map((rec, i) => (
                          <li key={i} className="flex items-start gap-2">
                            <div className="w-1 h-1 bg-green-500 rounded-full mt-2 flex-shrink-0" />
                            {rec}
                          </li>
                        ))}
                      </ul>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                </CardContent>
              </Card>
            ))}
          </div>
        </TabsContent>

        {/* Change Readiness */}
        <TabsContent value="readiness" className="space-y-6">
          <div className="grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-2 gap-4">
            {changeReadiness.map((dept, index) => (
              <Card key={index}>
                <CardHeader>
                  <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                    <CardTitle>{dept.department}</CardTitle>
                    <div className="flex items-center gap-2">

                      <Badge className={capacityColors[dept.changeCapacity]}>
                        {dept.changeCapacity} capacity
                      </Badge>
```

```
import React, { useState, useEffect } from 'react';

interface LearningPattern {
  id: string;
  patternType: string;
  category: string;
  title: string;
  description: string;
  frequency: number;
  successRate: string;
  confidenceLevel: string;
  discoveredAt: string;
}

interface InstitutionalMemory {
  id: string;
  memoryType: string;
  domain: string;
  title: string;
  summary: string;
  effectiveness: string;
  successfulApplications: number;
  lastUsed: string;
}

interface DecisionOutcome {
  id: string;
  decisionType: string;
  decisionDescription: string;
  actualOutcome: string;
  effectiveness: string;
  createdAt: string;
}

interface AILearningSession {
  id: string;
  sessionType: string;
  dataPointsAnalyzed: number;
  patternsDiscovered: number;
  actionableInsights: number;
  executedAt: string;
}

interface OrganizationalIntelligence {
  relevantPatterns: LearningPattern[];
  applicableWisdom: InstitutionalMemory[];
  riskPredictions: any[];
  recommendations: any[];
}

export function OrganizationalIntelligenceDashboard() {
  const [selectedOrganization] = useState('demo-org-id');
  const [selectedContext, setSelectedContext] = useState<string>('');

  // Fetch organizational intelligence
  const { data: intelligence, isLoading: intelligenceLoading } = useQuery<OrganizationalIntelligence>({
    queryKey: ['/api/organizations', selectedOrganization, 'intelligence', selectedContext],
    enabled: !!selectedOrganization
  });

  // Fetch learning patterns
  const { data: patterns, isLoading: patternsLoading } = useQuery<LearningPattern[]>({
    queryKey: ['/api/organizations', selectedOrganization, 'patterns'],
    enabled: !!selectedOrganization
  });

  // Fetch institutional memory
  const { data: memories, isLoading: memoriesLoading } = useQuery<InstitutionalMemory[]>({
    queryKey: ['/api/organizations', selectedOrganization, 'memory'],
    enabled: !!selectedOrganization
  });

  // Fetch decision outcomes
  const { data: outcomes, isLoading: outcomesLoading } = useQuery<DecisionOutcome[]>({
    queryKey: ['/api/organizations', selectedOrganization, 'decisions', 'outcomes'],
    enabled: !!selectedOrganization
  });

  // Fetch AI learning sessions
  const { data: sessions, isLoading: sessionsLoading } = useQuery<AILearningSession[]>({
    queryKey: ['/api/organizations', selectedOrganization, 'learning-sessions'],
    enabled: !!selectedOrganization
  });

  // Calculate intelligence metrics
  const totalPatterns = patterns?.length || 0;
  const totalMemories = memories?.length || 0;
  const totalOutcomes = outcomes?.length || 0;
  const totalSessions = sessions?.length || 0;

  const successfulPatterns = patterns?.filter(p => parseFloat(p.successRate) > 0.7).length || 0;
  const highEffectivenessMemories = memories?.filter(m => m.effectiveness === 'high').length || 0;
  const successfulOutcomes = outcomes?.filter(o => o.actualOutcome === 'success').length || 0;

  const overallIntelligenceScore = totalPatterns > 0 ? 
    Math.round(((successfulPatterns + highEffectivenessMemories + successfulOutcomes) / 
    (totalPatterns + totalMemories + totalOutcomes)) * 100) : 0;

  const demoData = {
    patterns: [
      {
        id: 'pattern-1',
        patternType: 'success_factor',
        category: 'crisis_response',
        title: 'Rapid Stakeholder Communication Pattern',
        description: 'Early stakeholder communication within 2 hours increases success rate by 64%',
        frequency: 15,
        successRate: '0.87',
        confidenceLevel: '0.92',
        discoveredAt: new Date().toISOString()
      },
      {
        id: 'pattern-2', 
        patternType: 'failure_mode',
        category: 'operations',
        title: 'Resource Constraint Pattern',
        description: 'Delayed resource allocation leads to 340% cost increase',
        frequency: 8,
        successRate: '0.23',
        confidenceLevel: '0.78',
        discoveredAt: new Date().toISOString()
      }
    ],
    memories: [
      {
        id: 'memory-1',
        memoryType: 'best_practice',
        domain: 'crisis_management',
        title: 'Emergency Response Protocol',
        summary: 'Proven 4-step emergency response that reduces impact by 60%',
        effectiveness: 'high',
        successfulApplications: 12,
        lastUsed: new Date().toISOString()
      }
    ],
    outcomes: [
      {
        id: 'outcome-1',
        decisionType: 'strategic',
        decisionDescription: 'Supply chain diversification initiative',
        actualOutcome: 'success',
        effectiveness: 'high',
        createdAt: new Date().toISOString()
      }
    ],
    sessions: [
      {
        id: 'session-1',
        sessionType: 'pattern_discovery',
        dataPointsAnalyzed: 25,
        patternsDiscovered: 3,
        actionableInsights: 5,
        executedAt: new Date().toISOString()
      }
    ]
  };

  const displayPatterns = patterns || demoData.patterns;
  const displayMemories = memories || demoData.memories;
  const displayOutcomes = outcomes || demoData.outcomes;
  const displaySessions = sessions || demoData.sessions;

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6 p-6" data-testid="organizational-intelligence-dashboard">

          </h1>

            AI-powered learning system that captures institutional memory and improves decision-making
          </p>
        </div>
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
          <Brain className="h-6 w-6 text-blue-600" />
          <span className="text-lg font-semibold text-blue-600">
            Intelligence Score: {overallIntelligenceScore}%
          </span>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Intelligence Overview Cards */}
      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-4">
        <Card data-testid="card-learning-patterns">
          <CardHeader className="flex flex-row items-center justify-between space-y-0 pb-2">
            <CardTitle className="text-sm font-medium">Learning Patterns</CardTitle>
            <TrendingUp className="h-4 w-4 text-muted-foreground" />
          </CardHeader>
          <CardContent>
            <div className="text-2xl font-bold">{totalPatterns}</div>
            <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">
              {successfulPatterns} high-success patterns
            </p>
          </CardContent>
        </Card>

        <Card data-testid="card-institutional-memory">
          <CardHeader className="flex flex-row items-center justify-between space-y-0 pb-2">
            <CardTitle className="text-sm font-medium">Institutional Memory</CardTitle>
            <BookOpen className="h-4 w-4 text-muted-foreground" />
          </CardHeader>
          <CardContent>
            <div className="text-2xl font-bold">{totalMemories}</div>
            <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">
              {highEffectivenessMemories} high-effectiveness memories
            </p>
          </CardContent>
        </Card>

        <Card data-testid="card-decision-outcomes">
          <CardHeader className="flex flex-row items-center justify-between space-y-0 pb-2">
            <CardTitle className="text-sm font-medium">Decision Outcomes</CardTitle>

            </p>
          </CardContent>

        <TabsContent value="patterns" className="space-y-4">
          <Card>
            <CardHeader>
              <CardTitle className="flex items-center gap-2">

                Discovered Learning Patterns
              </CardTitle>
              <CardDescription>
                AI-identified patterns from organizational decision history
              </CardDescription>
            </CardHeader>
            <CardContent>
              <div className="space-y-4">
                {displayPatterns.map((pattern) => (
                  <div 
                    key={pattern.id} 
                    className="border rounded-lg p-4 bg-gradient-to-r from-blue-50 to-indigo-50 dark:from-blue-900/20 dark:to-indigo-900/20"

              data-testid="button-simulate-learning"
            >
              <Brain className="h-4 w-4 mr-2" />
              Simulate Learning Loop
            </Button>
          </div>
        </CardContent>
      </Card>
    </div>
  );
}
```

```
                                'bg-red-100 text-red-800'
                              }>
                                {factor.status}
                              </Badge>
                              <span className="text-sm font-medium">{factor.impact}</span>
                            </div>
                          </div>
                        ))}
                      </div>
                    </div>
                    
                    <div>
                      <h4 className="font-medium mb-3">Improvement Recommendations</h4>
                      <ul className="space-y-2">
                        {dimension.recommendations.map((rec, index) => (
                          <li key={index} className="flex items-start gap-2 text-sm">
                            <CheckCircle className="h-4 w-4 text-green-500 mt-0.5 flex-shrink-0" />
                            {rec}
                          </li>
                        ))}
                      </ul>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                </div>
              );
            })()}
          </CardContent>
        </Card>
      )}
    </div>
  );

  const BenchmarkComparison = () => (
    <div className="space-y-6">
      <Card>
```

## FILE: client/src/components/ParticleBackground.tsx
```
import { useEffect, useRef } from 'react';

export default function ParticleBackground() {
  const containerRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    const container = containerRef.current;
    if (!container) return;

    const particleCount = 50;
    const particles: HTMLDivElement[] = [];

    for (let i = 0; i < particleCount; i++) {
      const particle = document.createElement('div');
      particle.className = 'absolute bg-white/10 rounded-full animate-pulse';
      
      const size = Math.random() * 4 + 2;
      particle.style.width = `${size}px`;
      particle.style.height = `${size}px`;
      particle.style.left = `${Math.random() * 100}%`;
      particle.style.top = `${Math.random() * 100}%`;
      particle.style.animationDelay = `${Math.random() * 6}s`;
      particle.style.animationDuration = `${Math.random() * 3 + 3}s`;
      
      container.appendChild(particle);
      particles.push(particle);
    }

    return () => {
      particles.forEach(particle => {
        if (particle.parentNode) {
          particle.parentNode.removeChild(particle);
        }
      });
    };
  }, []);

  return (
    <div 
      ref={containerRef}
      className="fixed inset-0 pointer-events-none z-0"
      style={{ zIndex: -1 }}
    />
  );
}
```

```
export default PredictiveIntelligenceEngine;
```

```
    setInsights(sampleInsights);
    setMetrics(sampleMetrics);
  }, []);

  const generateNewInsights = async () => {
    setIsGenerating(true);
    // Simulate AI analysis
    await new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, 2000));
    setIsGenerating(false);
  };

  const getInsightColor = (type: string) => {
    switch (type) {
      case 'opportunity': return 'bg-green-100 text-green-800';
      case 'risk': return 'bg-red-100 text-red-800';
      case 'trend': return 'bg-blue-100 text-blue-800';
      case 'anomaly': return 'bg-purple-100 text-purple-800';
      default: return 'bg-gray-100 text-gray-800';
    }
  };

  const getImpactColor = (impact: string) => {
    switch (impact) {
      case 'critical': return 'bg-red-500';
      case 'high': return 'bg-orange-500';
      case 'medium': return 'bg-yellow-500';
      case 'low': return 'bg-green-500';
      default: return 'bg-gray-500';
    }
  };

  const getStatusColor = (status: string) => {
    switch (status) {
      case 'healthy': return 'text-green-600';
      case 'warning': return 'text-yellow-600';
      case 'critical': return 'text-red-600';
      default: return 'text-gray-600';
    }
  };

  const getTrendIcon = (trend: string) => {
    switch (trend) {
      case 'up': return <TrendingUp className="w-4 h-4 text-green-600" />;
      case 'down': return <TrendingDown className="w-4 h-4 text-red-600" />;
      default: return <Activity className="w-4 h-4 text-gray-600" />;
    }
  };

  const getInsightIcon = (type: string) => {
    switch (type) {
      case 'opportunity': return <Lightbulb className="w-5 h-5" />;
      case 'risk': return <AlertTriangle className="w-5 h-5" />;
      case 'trend': return <TrendingUp className="w-5 h-5" />;
      case 'anomaly': return <Radar className="w-5 h-5" />;
      default: return <Eye className="w-5 h-5" />;
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="min-h-screen bg-gradient-to-br from-indigo-50 via-white to-purple-50 p-6">
      <div className="max-w-7xl mx-auto">
        {/* Header */}
        <div className="mb-8">
          <h1 className="text-4xl font-bold text-gray-900 mb-2">
            Predictive Intelligence Hub
          </h1>
          <p className="text-lg text-gray-600">
            AI-powered insights for proactive decision making and organizational optimization
          </p>
        </div>

        {/* Stats Overview */}
        <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-4 gap-6 mb-8">
          <Card className="bg-white/70 backdrop-blur-sm border-0 shadow-lg">
            <CardContent className="p-6">
              <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                <div>
                  <p className="text-sm font-medium text-gray-600">AI Insights</p>
                  <p className="text-2xl font-bold text-gray-900">{insights.length}</p>
                </div>
                <Brain className="w-8 h-8 text-purple-600" />
              </div>
            </CardContent>
          </Card>

          <Card className="bg-white/70 backdrop-blur-sm border-0 shadow-lg">
            <CardContent className="p-6">
              <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                <div>
                  <p className="text-sm font-medium text-gray-600">High Impact</p>
                  <p className="text-2xl font-bold text-orange-600">
                    {insights.filter(i => i.impact === 'high' || i.impact === 'critical').length}
                  </p>
                </div>
                <Zap className="w-8 h-8 text-orange-600" />
              </div>
            </CardContent>
          </Card>

          <Card className="bg-white/70 backdrop-blur-sm border-0 shadow-lg">
            <CardContent className="p-6">
              <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                <div>
                  <p className="text-sm font-medium text-gray-600">Avg Confidence</p>
                  <p className="text-2xl font-bold text-green-600">
                    {Math.round(insights.reduce((sum, i) => sum + i.confidence, 0) / insights.length)}%
                  </p>
                </div>
                <Target className="w-8 h-8 text-green-600" />
              </div>
            </CardContent>
          </Card>

          <Card className="bg-white/70 backdrop-blur-sm border-0 shadow-lg">
            <CardContent className="p-6">
              <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                <div>
                  <p className="text-sm font-medium text-gray-600">Opportunities</p>
                  <p className="text-2xl font-bold text-blue-600">
                    {insights.filter(i => i.type === 'opportunity').length}
                  </p>
                </div>
                <Lightbulb className="w-8 h-8 text-blue-600" />
              </div>
            </CardContent>
          </Card>
        </div>

        {/* Main Interface */}
        <Card className="bg-white/80 backdrop-blur-sm border-0 shadow-xl">
          <CardHeader>
            <div className="flex justify-between items-center">
              <div>
                <CardTitle className="flex items-center gap-2">
                  <Brain className="w-6 h-6 text-purple-600" />
                  AI-Powered Predictive Analytics
                </CardTitle>
                <CardDescription>
                  Advanced machine learning insights for strategic decision making
                </CardDescription>
              </div>
              <Button 
                onClick={generateNewInsights} 
                disabled={isGenerating}
                className="bg-purple-600 hover:bg-purple-700"
              >
                {isGenerating ? (
                  <>
                    <Bot className="w-4 h-4 mr-2 animate-pulse" />
                    Analyzing...
                  </>
                ) : (
                  <>
                    <Sparkles className="w-4 h-4 mr-2" />
                    Generate Insights
                  </>
                )}
              </Button>
            </div>
          </CardHeader>

          <CardContent>
            <Tabs value={activeTab} onValueChange={setActiveTab}>
              <TabsList className="grid w-full grid-cols-3">
                <TabsTrigger value="dashboard" className="flex items-center gap-2">
                  <BarChart3 className="w-4 h-4" />
                  Intelligence Dashboard
                </TabsTrigger>
                <TabsTrigger value="insights" className="flex items-center gap-2">
                  <Eye className="w-4 h-4" />
                  Predictive Insights
                </TabsTrigger>
                <TabsTrigger value="monitoring" className="flex items-center gap-2">
                  <Radar className="w-4 h-4" />
                  Real-time Monitoring
                </TabsTrigger>
              </TabsList>

              {/* Intelligence Dashboard Tab */}
              <TabsContent value="dashboard" className="space-y-6">
                <div className="grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-2 gap-6">
                  {/* Key Metrics */}
                  <Card>
                    <CardHeader>
                      <CardTitle className="text-lg">Predictive Metrics Overview</CardTitle>
                      <CardDescription>
                        AI-forecasted performance indicators
                      </CardDescription>
                    </CardHeader>
                    <CardContent>
                      <div className="space-y-4">
                        {metrics.slice(0, 4).map((metric) => (
                          <div key={metric.name} className="flex items-center justify-between p-3 bg-gray-50 rounded-lg">
                            <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
                              {getTrendIcon(metric.trend)}
                              <div>
                                <p className="font-medium text-sm">{metric.name}</p>
                                <p className="text-xs text-gray-600">{metric.category}</p>

                                Forecast: {metric.prediction}
                              </p>
                            </div>
                          </div>

                                {insight.probability}% probability
                              </span>

                <Card>

                    <CardTitle className="text-lg">Predictive Trends Analysis</CardTitle>
                    <CardDescription>
                      AI-powered forecasting across key organizational metrics
                    </CardDescription>

                        <LineChart className="w-16 h-16 text-indigo-400 mx-auto mb-4" />
                        <p className="text-lg font-semibold text-indigo-700">Advanced Predictive Models</p>
                        <p className="text-indigo-600">Multi-dimensional forecasting with 85%+ accuracy</p>
                      </div>
                    </div>

                  {insights.map((insight) => (

                      <CardHeader>
                        <div className="flex items-start justify-between">
                          <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
                            <div className={`p-2 rounded-lg ${getInsightColor(insight.type)}`}>
                              {getInsightIcon(insight.type)}
                            </div>
                            <div>
                              <CardTitle className="text-lg">{insight.title}</CardTitle>
                              <CardDescription>{insight.category} • {insight.timeframe}</CardDescription>
                            </div>
                          </div>
                          <Badge className={getInsightColor(insight.type)}>
                            {insight.type}
                          </Badge>
                        </div>
                      </CardHeader>

                      <CardContent className="space-y-4">
                        <p className="text-sm text-gray-700">{insight.description}</p>

                        <div className="flex items-center gap-4">

                          </div>
                          <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                            <Target className="w-4 h-4 text-gray-500" />
                            <span className="text-sm">{insight.probability}% probability</span>
                          </div>
                        </div>

                            <span>AI Confidence</span>
                            <span>{insight.confidence}%</span>

                        </div>

                          <div className="space-y-1">
                            {insight.dataPoints.slice(0, 2).map((point, idx) => (
                              <div key={idx} className="flex justify-between text-xs">
                                <span className="text-gray-600">{point.metric}</span>
                                <span className={point.change > 0 ? 'text-green-600' : 'text-red-600'}>

                        </div>

                          <p className="text-sm font-medium mb-2">Recommendations:</p>
                          <ul className="space-y-1">
                            {insight.recommendations.slice(0, 2).map((rec, idx) => (
                              <li key={idx} className="text-xs text-gray-700 flex items-start gap-2">

                              </li>
                            ))}
                          </ul>
                        </div>
                      </CardContent>

                      <CardContent className="p-6">

                        <div className="text-left">
                          <p className="font-semibold">Alert Thresholds</p>
                          <p className="text-sm text-gray-600">Configure warning levels</p>

              </div>

            </CardContent>
          </Card>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );

export default PredictiveIntelligenceHub;
```

## FILE: client/src/components/PredictiveIntelligence.tsx
```
import React from 'react';
import { Card, CardContent, CardHeader, CardTitle } from '@/components/ui/card';
import { Badge } from '@/components/ui/badge';
import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button';
import { Progress } from '@/components/ui/progress';
import { LineChart, Line, XAxis, YAxis, ResponsiveContainer, ReferenceLine } from 'recharts';
import { Brain, TrendingDown, Target, Zap, DollarSign } from 'lucide-react';
import { usePredictiveModels } from '@/hooks/usePredictiveModels';
import { getImpactAreaColor, getChangeDirection, formatPercentage } from '@/utils/helpers';

// Types are now imported from @/types

export default function PredictiveIntelligence() {
  const {
    models,
    currentModel,
    loading,
    error,
    autoplayEnabled,
    selectModel,
    toggleAutoplay
  } = usePredictiveModels();

  if (loading) {
    return (
      <div className="space-y-6">
        <div className="animate-pulse">
          <div className="h-8 bg-muted rounded w-1/3 mb-4"></div>
          <div className="h-32 bg-muted rounded"></div>
        </div>
      </div>
    );
  }

  if (error) {
    return (
      <Card className="executive-card">
        <CardContent className="p-6">
          <div className="text-center text-red-600">
            <p>Error loading predictive models: {error}</p>
          </div>
        </CardContent>
      </Card>
    );
  }

  if (!currentModel) {
    return (
      <Card className="executive-card">
        <CardContent className="p-6">
          <div className="text-center text-muted-foreground">
            <p>No predictive models available</p>
          </div>
        </CardContent>
      </Card>
    );
  }

  const change = getChangeDirection(currentModel.currentValue, currentModel.predictedValue);

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6">
      {/* Header */}
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
        <div>
          <h2 className="text-2xl font-bold text-foreground flex items-center gap-3">
            <Brain className="w-8 h-8 text-blue-500" />
            Predictive Intelligence Engine
          </h2>
          <p className="text-muted-foreground mt-1">
            AI-powered forecasting with prescriptive action recommendations
          </p>
        </div>
        
        <div className="flex items-center gap-4">
          <Badge variant="outline" className="px-3 py-1">
            {models.length} Active Models
          </Badge>
          <Button
            variant={autoplayEnabled ? "default" : "outline"}
            size="sm"
            onClick={toggleAutoplay}
          >
            Auto-cycle {autoplayEnabled ? 'ON' : 'OFF'}
          </Button>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Model Selection */}
      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 gap-4">
        {models.map((model) => (
          <Card
            key={model.id}
            className={`cursor-pointer transition-all duration-300 ${
              currentModel.id === model.id 
                ? 'ring-2 ring-primary executive-shadow scale-105' 
                : 'hover:shadow-md executive-hover'
            }`}
            onClick={() => selectModel(model.id)}
          >
            <CardContent className="p-4">
              <div className="flex items-center gap-3 mb-3">
                <div className={`w-3 h-3 rounded-full ${getImpactAreaColor(model.impactArea)}`} />
                <span className="font-medium text-sm">{model.title}</span>
              </div>
              <div className="space-y-2">
                <div className="text-2xl font-bold text-foreground">
                  {model.confidence}%
                </div>
                <div className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">
                  Confidence Level
                </div>
              </div>
            </CardContent>
          </Card>
        ))}
      </div>

      {/* Active Model Detail */}
      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-2 gap-6">
        {/* Prediction Overview */}
        <Card className="executive-card">
          <CardHeader>
            <CardTitle className="flex items-center justify-between">
              <span>{currentModel.title}</span>
              <Badge variant="outline" className="text-xs">
                {currentModel.timeHorizon}
              </Badge>
            </CardTitle>
            <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">
              {currentModel.description}
            </p>
          </CardHeader>
          <CardContent className="space-y-6">
            {/* Current vs Predicted */}
            <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-4">
              <div className="text-center p-4 bg-muted/30 rounded-xl">
                <div className="text-2xl font-bold text-foreground">
                  {currentModel.currentValue}
                </div>
                <div className="text-xs text-muted-foreground uppercase tracking-wide">
                  Current {currentModel.unit}
                </div>
              </div>
              <div className="text-center p-4 bg-primary/10 rounded-xl">
                <div className={`text-2xl font-bold ${change.positive ? 'text-green-600' : 'text-red-600'}`}>
                  {currentModel.predictedValue}
                </div>
                <div className="text-xs text-muted-foreground uppercase tracking-wide">
                  Predicted {currentModel.unit}
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>

            {/* Change Indicator */}
            <div className="flex items-center justify-center gap-3 p-4 bg-muted/20 rounded-xl">
              {change.positive ? (
                <Target className="w-5 h-5 text-green-600" />
              ) : (
                <TrendingDown className="w-5 h-5 text-red-600" />
              )}
              <span className={`font-bold ${change.positive ? 'text-green-600' : 'text-red-600'}`}>
                {change.positive ? '+' : '-'}{formatPercentage(change.value, 1)}
              </span>
              <span className="text-muted-foreground text-sm">
                {change.positive ? 'improvement' : 'decline'} predicted
              </span>
            </div>

            {/* Confidence Meter */}
            <div className="space-y-2">
              <div className="flex items-center justify-between text-sm">
                <span className="text-muted-foreground">Model Confidence</span>
                <span className="font-bold">{currentModel.confidence}%</span>
              </div>
              <Progress value={currentModel.confidence} className="h-2" />
            </div>
          </CardContent>
        </Card>

        {/* Trend Chart */}
        <Card className="executive-card">
          <CardHeader>
            <CardTitle className="text-lg">Predictive Trend Analysis</CardTitle>
          </CardHeader>
          <CardContent>
            <div className="h-64">
              <ResponsiveContainer width="100%" height="100%">
                <LineChart data={currentModel.chartData}>
                  <XAxis dataKey="date" stroke="hsl(var(--muted-foreground))" fontSize={12} />
                  <YAxis stroke="hsl(var(--muted-foreground))" fontSize={12} />
                  <ReferenceLine x="Aug" stroke="#ef4444" strokeDasharray="2 2" />
                  <Line
                    type="monotone"
                    dataKey="actual"
                    stroke="#10b981"
                    strokeWidth={3}
                    dot={{ fill: '#10b981', strokeWidth: 2, r: 4 }}
                    connectNulls={false}
                  />
                  <Line
                    type="monotone"
                    dataKey="predicted"
                    stroke="#3b82f6"
                    strokeWidth={2}
                    strokeDasharray="5 5"
                    dot={{ fill: '#3b82f6', strokeWidth: 2, r: 3 }}
                  />
                </LineChart>
              </ResponsiveContainer>
            </div>
          </CardContent>
        </Card>
      </div>

      {/* Prescriptive Recommendations */}
      <Card className="executive-card">
        <CardHeader>
          <CardTitle className="flex items-center gap-2">
            <Zap className="w-5 h-5 text-orange-500" />
            Prescriptive Action Plan
          </CardTitle>
        </CardHeader>
        <CardContent>
          <div className="space-y-4">
            {currentModel.recommendations.map((rec, index) => (
              <div key={rec.id} className="p-4 border rounded-xl hover:shadow-md transition-all duration-200">
                <div className="flex items-start justify-between mb-3">
                  <div className="flex-1">
                    <h4 className="font-semibold text-foreground mb-2">
                      Action {index + 1}: {rec.action}
                    </h4>
                    <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground mb-3">
                      <span className="font-medium">Impact:</span> {rec.impact}
                    </p>
                    <div className="flex items-center gap-4 text-sm">
                      <div className="flex items-center gap-1 text-green-600">
                        <DollarSign className="w-3 h-3" />
                        <span className="font-bold">{rec.estimatedROI}% ROI</span>
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                  
                  <div className="flex gap-2 ml-4">
                    <Button size="sm" variant="outline">
                      Details
                    </Button>
                    <Button size="sm">
                      Execute
                    </Button>
                  </div>
                </div>
              </div>
            ))}
          </div>
        </CardContent>
      </Card>
    </div>
  );
}
```

```
      </Tabs>
    </div>
  );
}
```

```
import React, { useState } from 'react';

  Target,
```

```
  MoreHorizontal,
  Plus

import type { Project } from '../types';

interface ProjectCardProps {
  project: Project;
  onProjectClick: (projectId: string) => void;
}

function ProjectCard({ project, onProjectClick }: ProjectCardProps) {
  const getPriorityColor = (priority: string) => {
    switch (priority) {
      case 'critical': return 'bg-red-100 text-red-800 border-red-200';
      case 'high': return 'bg-orange-100 text-orange-800 border-orange-200';
      case 'medium': return 'bg-yellow-100 text-yellow-800 border-yellow-200';
      case 'low': return 'bg-green-100 text-green-800 border-green-200';
      default: return 'bg-gray-100 text-gray-800 border-gray-200';
    }
  };

  const getStatusColor = (status: string) => {
    switch (status) {
      case 'completed': return 'bg-green-100 text-green-800 border-green-200';
      case 'in_progress': return 'bg-blue-100 text-blue-800 border-blue-200';
      case 'on_hold': return 'bg-gray-100 text-gray-800 border-gray-200';
      case 'pending': return 'bg-yellow-100 text-yellow-800 border-yellow-200';
      default: return 'bg-gray-100 text-gray-800 border-gray-200';
    }
  };

  const calculateProgress = (project: Project) => {
    // Mock progress calculation based on status
    switch (project.status) {
      case 'completed': return 100;
      case 'in_progress': return Math.floor(Math.random() * 70) + 20;
      case 'pending': return 0;
      case 'on_hold': return Math.floor(Math.random() * 40) + 10;
      default: return 0;
    }
  };

  const progress = calculateProgress(project);

  return (
    <Card className="cursor-pointer hover:shadow-lg transition-all duration-200 border-l-4 border-l-blue-500">
      <CardHeader className="pb-3">
        <div className="flex items-start justify-between">
          <div className="flex-1">
            <CardTitle 
              className="text-lg hover:text-blue-600 transition-colors"
              onClick={() => onProjectClick(project.id)}
            >
              {project.name}
            </CardTitle>
            <CardDescription className="mt-1 line-clamp-2">
              {project.description}
            </CardDescription>
          </div>
          <Button variant="ghost" size="sm">
            <MoreHorizontal className="w-4 h-4" />
          </Button>
        </div>
        
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2 mt-3">
          <Badge className={getPriorityColor(project.priority)}>
            {project.priority}
          </Badge>
          <Badge className={getStatusColor(project.status)}>
            {project.status.replace('_', ' ')}
          </Badge>
        </div>
      </CardHeader>
      
      <CardContent className="pt-0">
        <div className="space-y-3">
          {/* Progress */}
          <div className="space-y-2">
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between text-sm">
              <span className="text-muted-foreground">Progress</span>
              <span className="font-medium">{progress}%</span>
            </div>
            <Progress value={progress} className="h-2" />
          </div>
          
          {/* Timeline */}
          <div className="flex items-center justify-between text-sm text-muted-foreground">
            <div className="flex items-center gap-1">
              <Calendar className="w-3 h-3" />
              {project.startDate ? format(new Date(project.startDate), 'MMM dd') : 'No start date'}
            </div>
            <div className="flex items-center gap-1">
              <Clock className="w-3 h-3" />
              {project.endDate ? format(new Date(project.endDate), 'MMM dd') : 'No due date'}
            </div>
          </div>
          
          {/* Quick Actions */}
          <div className="flex items-center justify-between pt-2 border-t">
            <div className="flex items-center gap-1 text-sm text-muted-foreground">
              <Users className="w-3 h-3" />
              <span>3 members</span>
            </div>
            <div className="flex gap-1">
              {project.status === 'in_progress' ? (
                <Button variant="ghost" size="sm">
                  <PauseCircle className="w-3 h-3" />
                </Button>
              ) : (
                <Button variant="ghost" size="sm">
                  <PlayCircle className="w-3 h-3" />
                </Button>
              )}
              <Button variant="ghost" size="sm">
                <Target className="w-3 h-3" />
              </Button>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      </CardContent>
    </Card>
  );
}

export default function ProjectDashboard() {
  const [selectedView, setSelectedView] = useState('overview');
  const [isCreateModalOpen, setIsCreateModalOpen] = useState(false);
  const [selectedProject, setSelectedProject] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const queryClient = useQueryClient();

  // Fetch projects
  const { data: projects = [], isLoading } = useQuery<Project[]>({
    queryKey: ['/api/projects'],
  });

  // Create project mutation
  const createProjectMutation = useMutation({
    mutationFn: async (projectData: any) => {
      const response = await fetch('/api/projects', {
        method: 'POST',
        headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
        body: JSON.stringify(projectData),
      });
      if (!response.ok) throw new Error('Failed to create project');
      return response.json();
    },
    onSuccess: () => {
      queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ['/api/projects'] });
    },
  });

  const handleProjectCreate = (projectData: any) => {
    createProjectMutation.mutate(projectData);
    setIsCreateModalOpen(false);
  };

  const handleProjectClick = (projectId: string) => {
    setSelectedProject(projectId);
    setSelectedView('detail');
  };

  const getProjectStats = () => {
    return {
      total: projects.length,
      active: projects.filter((p: Project) => p.status === 'in_progress').length,
      completed: projects.filter((p: Project) => p.status === 'completed').length,
      overdue: projects.filter((p: Project) => {
        if (!p.endDate) return false;
        return new Date(p.endDate) < new Date() && p.status !== 'completed';
      }).length,
    };
  };

  const stats = getProjectStats();

  if (selectedView === 'detail' && selectedProject) {
    return (
      <ProjectView 
        projectId={selectedProject}
        onBack={() => {
          setSelectedView('overview');
          setSelectedProject(null);
        }}
      />
    );
  }

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6">
      {/* Header */}
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
        <div>
          <h1 className="text-3xl font-bold text-foreground">Veridius Project Management</h1>
          <p className="text-muted-foreground mt-1">
            Universal project methodology support with end-to-end tracking and execution
          </p>
        </div>
        <Button 
          onClick={() => setIsCreateModalOpen(true)}
          className="bg-gradient-to-r from-blue-600 to-blue-500 hover:from-blue-700 hover:to-blue-600"
        >
          <Plus className="w-4 h-4 mr-2" />
          New Project
        </Button>
      </div>

      {/* Enhanced Tabs */}
      <Tabs defaultValue="projects" className="space-y-6">
        <TabsList className="grid w-full grid-cols-5">
          <TabsTrigger value="projects">Projects</TabsTrigger>
          <TabsTrigger value="methodologies">Methodologies</TabsTrigger>
          <TabsTrigger value="templates">Templates</TabsTrigger>
          <TabsTrigger value="collaboration">Collaboration</TabsTrigger>
          <TabsTrigger value="reports">Reports</TabsTrigger>
        </TabsList>

        {/* Projects Tab */}
        <TabsContent value="projects" className="space-y-6">

      {/* Stats Cards */}
      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-4 gap-6">
        <Card>
          <CardContent className="p-6">
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
              <div>
                <p className="text-sm font-medium text-muted-foreground">Total Projects</p>
                <p className="text-2xl font-bold">{stats.total}</p>
              </div>
              <Target className="w-8 h-8 text-blue-500" />
            </div>
          </CardContent>
        </Card>

        <Card>
          <CardContent className="p-6">
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
              <div>
                <p className="text-sm font-medium text-muted-foreground">Active</p>
                <p className="text-2xl font-bold text-blue-600">{stats.active}</p>
              </div>
              <PlayCircle className="w-8 h-8 text-blue-500" />
            </div>
          </CardContent>
        </Card>

        <Card>
          <CardContent className="p-6">
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
              <div>
                <p className="text-sm font-medium text-muted-foreground">Completed</p>
                <p className="text-2xl font-bold text-green-600">{stats.completed}</p>
              </div>
              <CheckCircle2 className="w-8 h-8 text-green-500" />
            </div>
          </CardContent>
        </Card>

        <Card>
          <CardContent className="p-6">
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
              <div>
                <p className="text-sm font-medium text-muted-foreground">Overdue</p>
                <p className="text-2xl font-bold text-red-600">{stats.overdue}</p>
              </div>
              <AlertTriangle className="w-8 h-8 text-red-500" />
            </div>
          </CardContent>
        </Card>
      </div>

      {/* Projects Grid */}
      <Tabs defaultValue="all" className="space-y-4">
        <TabsList>
          <TabsTrigger value="all">All Projects</TabsTrigger>
          <TabsTrigger value="active">Active</TabsTrigger>
          <TabsTrigger value="completed">Completed</TabsTrigger>
          <TabsTrigger value="overdue">Overdue</TabsTrigger>
        </TabsList>

        <TabsContent value="all" className="space-y-4">
          {isLoading ? (
            <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-6">
              {[1, 2, 3].map((i) => (
                <Card key={i} className="animate-pulse">
                  <CardContent className="p-6">
```

## FILE: client/src/components/ProjectInitializationModal.tsx

```
import React, { useState } from 'react';
import { Dialog, DialogContent, DialogDescription, DialogHeader, DialogTitle } from '@/components/ui/dialog';
import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button';
import { Input } from '@/components/ui/input';
import { Textarea } from '@/components/ui/textarea';
import { Label } from '@/components/ui/label';
import { Badge } from '@/components/ui/badge';
import { Card, CardContent, CardHeader, CardTitle } from '@/components/ui/card';
import { Select, SelectContent, SelectItem, SelectTrigger, SelectValue } from '@/components/ui/select';
import { Checkbox } from '@/components/ui/checkbox';
import { 
  Play,
  Users, 
  Calendar, 
  Target, 
  AlertTriangle,
  Plus,
  X,
  Clock,
  CheckCircle
} from 'lucide-react';

interface ProjectInitializationModalProps {
  isOpen: boolean;
  onClose: () => void;
  scenarioData?: {
    title: string;
    description: string;
    keyActions: Array<{
      id: string;
      title: string;
      description: string;
      priority: 'low' | 'medium' | 'high' | 'critical';
      estimatedHours: number;
      department: string[];
    }>;
    recommendations?: Array<{
      id: string;
      action: string;
      impact: string;
      urgency: string;
      estimatedROI: number;
      department: string[];
    }>;
  };
  onProjectCreate?: (projectData: any) => void;
}

export default function ProjectInitializationModal({
  isOpen,
  onClose,
  scenarioData,
  onProjectCreate
}: ProjectInitializationModalProps) {
  const [projectName, setProjectName] = useState(scenarioData?.title || '');
  const [projectDescription, setProjectDescription] = useState(scenarioData?.description || '');
  const [priority, setPriority] = useState<'low' | 'medium' | 'high' | 'critical'>('medium');
  const [startDate, setStartDate] = useState(new Date().toISOString().split('T')[0]);
  const [endDate, setEndDate] = useState('');
  const [selectedActions, setSelectedActions] = useState<string[]>([]);
  const [customTasks, setCustomTasks] = useState<Array<{ title: string; description: string; priority: string; estimatedHours: number }>>([]);
  const [newTaskTitle, setNewTaskTitle] = useState('');
  const [teamMembers, setTeamMembers] = useState<string[]>([]);
  const [currentStep, setCurrentStep] = useState(1);

  // Initialize selected actions on mount
  React.useEffect(() => {
    if (scenarioData?.keyActions) {
      setSelectedActions(scenarioData.keyActions.map(action => action.id));
    }
  }, [scenarioData]);

  const handleActionToggle = (actionId: string) => {
    setSelectedActions(prev => 
      prev.includes(actionId) 
        ? prev.filter(id => id !== actionId)
        : [...prev, actionId]
    );
  };

  const addCustomTask = () => {
    if (newTaskTitle.trim()) {
      setCustomTasks(prev => [...prev, {
        title: newTaskTitle,
        description: '',
        priority: 'medium',
        estimatedHours: 8
      }]);
      setNewTaskTitle('');
    }
  };

  const removeCustomTask = (index: number) => {
    setCustomTasks(prev => prev.filter((_, i) => i !== index));
  };

  const handleCreateProject = () => {
    const selectedKeyActions = scenarioData?.keyActions?.filter(action => 
      selectedActions.includes(action.id)
    ) || [];

    const projectData = {
      name: projectName,
      description: projectDescription,
      priority,
      startDate: new Date(startDate),
      endDate: endDate ? new Date(endDate) : null,
      workflowId: scenarioData ? 'scenario-derived' : null,
      tasks: [
        ...selectedKeyActions.map(action => ({
          title: action.title,
          description: action.description,
          priority: action.priority,
          estimatedHours: action.estimatedHours,
          status: 'todo' as const
        })),
        ...customTasks.map(task => ({
          ...task,
          status: 'todo' as const
        }))
      ],
      teamMembers
    };

    onProjectCreate?.(projectData);
    onClose();
  };

  const getPriorityColor = (priority: string) => {
    switch (priority) {
      case 'critical': return 'bg-red-500';
      case 'high': return 'bg-orange-500';
      case 'medium': return 'bg-yellow-500';
      case 'low': return 'bg-green-500';
      default: return 'bg-gray-400';
    }
  };

  const totalEstimatedHours = [
    ...(scenarioData?.keyActions?.filter(action => selectedActions.includes(action.id)) || []),
    ...customTasks
  ].reduce((sum, item) => sum + (item.estimatedHours || 0), 0);

  return (
    <Dialog open={isOpen} onOpenChange={onClose}>
      <DialogContent className="max-w-4xl max-h-[90vh] overflow-y-auto">
        <DialogHeader>
          <DialogTitle className="flex items-center gap-2">
            <Play className="w-5 h-5 text-purple-500" />
            Create Project from Scenario
          </DialogTitle>
          <DialogDescription>
            Transform your scenario planning into an executable project with defined tasks and team assignments.
          </DialogDescription>
        </DialogHeader>

        <div className="space-y-6">
          {/* Progress Steps */}
          <div className="flex items-center justify-between p-4 bg-muted/30 rounded-lg">
            <div className="flex items-center space-x-4">
              <div className={`flex items-center gap-2 ${currentStep === 1 ? 'text-primary font-medium' : 'text-muted-foreground'}`}>
                <div className={`w-8 h-8 rounded-full border-2 flex items-center justify-center text-sm ${
                  currentStep === 1 ? 'border-primary bg-primary text-primary-foreground' : 'border-muted-foreground'
                }`}>
                  1
                </div>
                <span>Project Details</span>
              </div>
              <div className="w-8 border-t-2 border-muted-foreground" />
              <div className={`flex items-center gap-2 ${currentStep === 2 ? 'text-primary font-medium' : 'text-muted-foreground'}`}>
                <div className={`w-8 h-8 rounded-full border-2 flex items-center justify-center text-sm ${
                  currentStep === 2 ? 'border-primary bg-primary text-primary-foreground' : 'border-muted-foreground'
                }`}>
                  2
                </div>
                <span>Tasks & Timeline</span>
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>

          {currentStep === 1 && (
            <div className="grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-2 gap-6">
              {/* Project Information */}
              <div className="space-y-4">
                <Card>
                  <CardHeader>
                    <CardTitle className="text-lg">Project Information</CardTitle>
                  </CardHeader>
                  <CardContent className="space-y-4">
                    <div>
                      <Label htmlFor="projectName">Project Name</Label>
                      <Input
                        id="projectName"
                        value={projectName}
                        onChange={(e) => setProjectName(e.target.value)}
                        placeholder="Enter project name..."
                      />
                    </div>

                    <div>
                      <Label htmlFor="projectDescription">Description</Label>
                      <Textarea
                        id="projectDescription"
                        value={projectDescription}
                        onChange={(e) => setProjectDescription(e.target.value)}
                        placeholder="Describe the project objectives..."
                        rows={3}
                      />
                    </div>

                    <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-4">
                      <div>
                        <Label htmlFor="priority">Priority</Label>
                        <Select value={priority} onValueChange={(value: any) => setPriority(value)}>
                          <SelectTrigger>
                            <SelectValue />
                          </SelectTrigger>
                          <SelectContent>
                            <SelectItem value="low">Low</SelectItem>
                            <SelectItem value="medium">Medium</SelectItem>
                            <SelectItem value="high">High</SelectItem>
                            <SelectItem value="critical">Critical</SelectItem>
                          </SelectContent>
                        </Select>
                      </div>

                      <div>
                        <Label htmlFor="startDate">Start Date</Label>
                        <Input
                          id="startDate"
                          type="date"
                          value={startDate}
                          onChange={(e) => setStartDate(e.target.value)}
                        />
                      </div>
                    </div>

                    <div>
                      <Label htmlFor="endDate">Target End Date (Optional)</Label>
                      <Input
                        id="endDate"
                        type="date"
                        value={endDate}
                        onChange={(e) => setEndDate(e.target.value)}
                      />
                    </div>
                  </CardContent>
                </Card>
              </div>

              {/* Scenario Summary */}
              <div className="space-y-4">
                <Card>
                  <CardHeader>
                    <CardTitle className="text-lg">Scenario Overview</CardTitle>
                  </CardHeader>
                  <CardContent className="space-y-4">
                    {scenarioData ? (
                      <>
                        <div className="p-3 bg-blue-50 border border-blue-200 rounded-lg">
                          <h4 className="font-medium text-blue-900 mb-2">Source Scenario</h4>
                          <p className="text-sm text-blue-800">{scenarioData.title}</p>
                        </div>

                        <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-4 text-center">
                          <div className="p-3 bg-muted/30 rounded-lg">
                            <div className="text-2xl font-bold text-foreground">
                              {scenarioData.keyActions?.length || 0}
                            </div>
                            <div className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">Available Actions</div>
                          </div>
                          <div className="p-3 bg-muted/30 rounded-lg">
                            <div className="text-2xl font-bold text-foreground">
                              {scenarioData.recommendations?.length || 0}
                            </div>
                            <div className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">Recommendations</div>
                          </div>
                        </div>

                        <div className="space-y-2">
                          <h5 className="font-medium text-sm">Key Departments Involved</h5>
                          <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-1">
                            {Array.from(new Set(
                              scenarioData.keyActions?.flatMap(action => action.department) || []
                            )).map(dept => (
                              <Badge key={dept} variant="secondary" className="text-xs">
                                {dept}
                              </Badge>
                            ))}
                          </div>
                        </div>
                      </>
                    ) : (
                      <div className="text-center text-muted-foreground py-8">
                        <Target className="w-12 h-12 mx-auto mb-2 opacity-50" />
                        <p>Creating a new project from scratch</p>
                      </div>
                    )}
                  </CardContent>
                </Card>
              </div>
            </div>
          )}

          {currentStep === 2 && (
            <div className="space-y-6">
              {/* Task Selection */}
              {scenarioData?.keyActions && scenarioData.keyActions.length > 0 && (
                <Card>
                  <CardHeader>
                    <CardTitle className="flex items-center gap-2">
                      <CheckCircle className="w-5 h-5 text-green-500" />
                      Select Actions to Include
                    </CardTitle>
                  </CardHeader>
                  <CardContent>
                    <div className="grid gap-3">
                      {scenarioData.keyActions.map(action => (
                        <div key={action.id} className="flex items-start gap-3 p-3 border rounded-lg">
                          <Checkbox
                            checked={selectedActions.includes(action.id)}
                            onCheckedChange={() => handleActionToggle(action.id)}
                            className="mt-0.5"
                          />
                          <div className="flex-1">
                            <div className="flex items-center gap-2 mb-1">
                              <div className={`w-2 h-2 rounded-full ${getPriorityColor(action.priority)}`} />
                              <h4 className="font-medium text-sm">{action.title}</h4>
                              <Badge variant="outline" className="text-xs">
                                {action.estimatedHours}h
                              </Badge>
                            </div>
                            <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground mb-2">
                              {action.description}
                            </p>
                            <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-1">
                              {action.department.map(dept => (
                                <Badge key={dept} variant="secondary" className="text-xs">
                                  {dept}
                                </Badge>
                              ))}
                            </div>
                          </div>
                        </div>
                      ))}
                    </div>
                  </CardContent>
                </Card>
              )}

              {/* Custom Tasks */}
              <Card>
                <CardHeader>
                  <CardTitle className="flex items-center gap-2">
                    <Plus className="w-5 h-5 text-purple-500" />
                    Additional Tasks
                  </CardTitle>
                </CardHeader>
                <CardContent className="space-y-4">
                  <div className="flex gap-2">
                    <Input
                      placeholder="Add a custom task..."
                      value={newTaskTitle}
                      onChange={(e) => setNewTaskTitle(e.target.value)}
                      onKeyPress={(e) => e.key === 'Enter' && addCustomTask()}
                    />
                    <Button onClick={addCustomTask} disabled={!newTaskTitle.trim()}>
                      <Plus className="w-4 h-4" />
                    </Button>
                  </div>

                  {customTasks.length > 0 && (
                    <div className="space-y-2">
                      {customTasks.map((task, index) => (
                        <div key={index} className="flex items-center gap-2 p-2 border rounded">
                          <div className="flex-1">
                            <span className="text-sm font-medium">{task.title}</span>
                          </div>
                          <Badge variant="outline" className="text-xs">
                            {task.estimatedHours}h
                          </Badge>
                          <Button
                            size="sm"
                            variant="ghost"
                            onClick={() => removeCustomTask(index)}
                          >
                            <X className="w-3 h-3" />
                          </Button>
                        </div>
                      ))}
                    </div>
                  )}
                </CardContent>
              </Card>

              {/* Project Summary */}
              <Card>
                <CardHeader>
                  <CardTitle className="flex items-center gap-2">
                    <Clock className="w-5 h-5 text-blue-500" />
                    Project Summary
                  </CardTitle>
                </CardHeader>
                <CardContent>
                  <div className="grid grid-cols-3 gap-4 text-center">
                    <div className="p-3 bg-blue-50 rounded-lg">
                      <div className="text-xl font-bold text-blue-900">
                        {selectedActions.length + customTasks.length}
                      </div>
                      <div className="text-xs text-blue-700">Total Tasks</div>
                    </div>
                    <div className="p-3 bg-green-50 rounded-lg">
                      <div className="text-xl font-bold text-green-900">
                        {totalEstimatedHours}h
                      </div>
                      <div className="text-xs text-green-700">Estimated Hours</div>
                    </div>
                    <div className="p-3 bg-purple-50 rounded-lg">
                      <div className="text-xl font-bold text-purple-900">
                        {Math.ceil(totalEstimatedHours / 40)} wks
                      </div>
                      <div className="text-xs text-purple-700">Est. Duration</div>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                </CardContent>
              </Card>
            </div>
          )}

          {/* Navigation */}
          <div className="flex items-center justify-between pt-4 border-t">
            <div className="flex gap-2">
              {currentStep === 2 && (
                <Button variant="outline" onClick={() => setCurrentStep(1)}>
                  Back
                </Button>
              )}
            </div>
            
            <div className="flex gap-2">
              <Button variant="outline" onClick={onClose}>
                Cancel
              </Button>
              {currentStep === 1 ? (
                <Button 
                  onClick={() => setCurrentStep(2)}
                  disabled={!projectName.trim() || !projectDescription.trim()}
                >
                  Next
                </Button>
              ) : (
                <Button 
                  onClick={handleCreateProject}
                  disabled={selectedActions.length === 0 && customTasks.length === 0}
                  className="bg-gradient-to-r from-purple-600 to-purple-500 hover:from-purple-700 hover:to-purple-600"
                >
                  Create Project
                </Button>
              )}
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      </DialogContent>
    </Dialog>
  );
}
```

```
import React, { useState } from 'react';
import { Route, Switch } from 'wouter';
import ProjectView from './ProjectView';
import ActiveProjectsWidget from './ActiveProjectsWidget';
import ProjectInitializationModal from './ProjectInitializationModal';

export default function ProjectManagementRoutes() {
  const [isCreateModalOpen, setIsCreateModalOpen] = useState(false);

  return (
    <>
      <Switch>
        <Route path="/projects/:id">
          {({ id }) => (
            <ProjectView 
              projectId={id} 
              onBack={() => window.history.back()}
            />
          )}
        </Route>
        
        <Route path="/projects">
          <div className="space-y-6">
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
              <h1 className="text-3xl font-bold text-foreground">All Projects</h1>
              <button
                onClick={() => setIsCreateModalOpen(true)}
                className="px-4 py-2 bg-primary text-primary-foreground rounded-lg hover:bg-primary/90"
              >
                Create Project
              </button>
            </div>
            
            {/* Projects Grid */}
            <div className="grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-2 xl:grid-cols-3 gap-6">
              <ActiveProjectsWidget 
                onProjectClick={(projectId) => {
                  window.location.href = `/projects/${projectId}`;
                }}
              />
            </div>
          </div>
        </Route>
      </Switch>

      <ProjectInitializationModal
        isOpen={isCreateModalOpen}
        onClose={() => setIsCreateModalOpen(false)}
        onProjectCreate={(projectData) => {
          console.log('Create project:', projectData);
          setIsCreateModalOpen(false);
        }}
      />
    </>
  );
}
```

```
interface ReportTemplate {
  id: string;
  name: string;
  description: string;
  type: 'executive' | 'status' | 'financial' | 'technical' | 'stakeholder';
  frequency: 'daily' | 'weekly' | 'monthly' | 'milestone' | 'on-demand';

  recipients: string[];
  lastGenerated?: Date;
}

interface ProjectMetric {
  name: string;
  current: number;
  target: number;
  unit: string;
  trend: 'up' | 'down' | 'stable';
  status: 'good' | 'warning' | 'critical';
}

interface ProjectReportingProps {
  projectId: string;
}

export default function ProjectReporting({ projectId }: ProjectReportingProps) {
  const [selectedTemplate, setSelectedTemplate] = useState<string>('');
  const [selectedPeriod, setSelectedPeriod] = useState('current-month');
  const [selectedFormat, setSelectedFormat] = useState('pdf');

  const reportTemplates: ReportTemplate[] = [
    {
      id: 'executive-summary',
      name: 'Executive Summary',
      description: 'High-level project overview for executive stakeholders',
      type: 'executive',
      frequency: 'weekly',
      sections: ['Project Status', 'Key Achievements', 'Upcoming Milestones', 'Risk Summary', 'Budget Overview'],
      recipients: ['CEO', 'CTO', 'Project Sponsor'],
      lastGenerated: new Date(Date.now() - 2 * 24 * 60 * 60000)
    },
    {
      id: 'status-report',
      name: 'Project Status Report',
      description: 'Detailed project progress and team performance metrics',
      type: 'status',
      frequency: 'weekly',

}
```

```
  actual: number;
  status: 'on_track' | 'over_budget' | 'under_budget';
}

  projectId: string;
}

        </div>
      )}

      {/* Budget Tab */}
      {activeTab === 'budget' && (
        <div className="space-y-6">
          {/* Budget Overview */}
          <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 gap-4">
            <Card>
              <CardContent className="p-4">
                <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                  <div>
                    <p className="text-sm font-medium text-muted-foreground">Total Budget</p>
                    <p className="text-2xl font-bold">${getTotalBudget().toLocaleString()}</p>
                  </div>
                  <Target className="w-6 h-6 text-blue-500" />
                </div>
              </CardContent>
            </Card>

            <Card>
              <CardContent className="p-4">
                <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                  <div>
                    <p className="text-sm font-medium text-muted-foreground">Actual Spend</p>
                    <p className="text-2xl font-bold">${getTotalActual().toLocaleString()}</p>
                  </div>
                  <DollarSign className="w-6 h-6 text-green-500" />
                </div>
              </CardContent>
            </Card>

            <Card>
              <CardContent className="p-4">
                <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                  <div>
                    <p className="text-sm font-medium text-muted-foreground">Remaining</p>
                    <p className="text-2xl font-bold text-orange-600">
                      ${(getTotalBudget() - getTotalActual()).toLocaleString()}
                    </p>
                  </div>
                  <TrendingUp className="w-6 h-6 text-orange-500" />
                </div>
              </CardContent>
            </Card>
          </div>

          {/* Budget Items */}
          <Card>
            <CardHeader>
              <CardTitle>Budget Breakdown</CardTitle>
              <CardDescription>Detailed budget allocation and spending</CardDescription>
            </CardHeader>
            <CardContent>
              <div className="space-y-4">
                {budgetItems.map((item) => {
                  const { variance, percentage } = calculateBudgetVariance(item);
                  return (
                    <div key={item.id} className="border rounded-lg p-4">
                      <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-3">
                        <div>
                          <h4 className="font-semibold">{item.item}</h4>
                          <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">{item.category}</p>
                        </div>
                        <Badge className={getStatusColor(item.status)}>
                          {getStatusIcon(item.status)}
                          <span className="ml-1">{item.status.replace('_', ' ')}</span>
                        </Badge>
                      </div>

                      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-4 gap-4 text-sm">
                        <div>
                          <Label className="text-muted-foreground">Budgeted</Label>
                          <p className="font-medium">${item.budgeted.toLocaleString()}</p>
                        </div>
                        <div>
                          <Label className="text-muted-foreground">Actual</Label>
                          <p className="font-medium">${item.actual.toLocaleString()}</p>
                        </div>
                        <div>
                          <Label className="text-muted-foreground">Variance</Label>
                          <p className={`font-medium ${variance > 0 ? 'text-red-600' : 'text-green-600'}`}>
                            {variance > 0 ? '+' : ''}${variance.toLocaleString()}
                          </p>
                        </div>
                        <div>
                          <Label className="text-muted-foreground">% Variance</Label>
                          <p className={`font-medium ${variance > 0 ? 'text-red-600' : 'text-green-600'}`}>
                            {percentage > 0 ? '+' : ''}{percentage.toFixed(1)}%
                          </p>
                        </div>
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  );
                })}
              </div>
            </CardContent>
          </Card>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Timeline Tab */}
      {activeTab === 'timeline' && (
        <Card>
          <CardHeader>
            <CardTitle>Resource Timeline</CardTitle>
            <CardDescription>Resource allocation over project timeline</CardDescription>
          </CardHeader>
          <CardContent>
            <div className="text-center py-8 text-muted-foreground">
              <Clock className="w-12 h-12 mx-auto mb-4 opacity-50" />
              <p>Resource timeline visualization coming soon</p>
              <p className="text-sm">This will show resource allocation over time</p>
            </div>
          </CardContent>
        </Card>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}
```

```
import React, { useState } from 'react';
import { Card, CardContent, CardDescription, CardHeader, CardTitle } from '@/components/ui/card';
import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button';
import { Badge } from '@/components/ui/badge';

import { Tabs, TabsContent, TabsList, TabsTrigger } from '@/components/ui/tabs';
```
