```
  XCircle,
  Clock,
  Users,
  DollarSign,
  Activity
} from 'lucide-react';

interface RiskItem {
  id: string;
  title: string;
  description: string;
  category: 'technical' | 'financial' | 'operational' | 'strategic' | 'external';
  probability: number; // 1-5 scale
  impact: number; // 1-5 scale
  riskScore: number; // probability * impact
  status: 'identified' | 'analyzing' | 'mitigating' | 'closed';
  mitigation: string;
  owner: string;
  dueDate: Date;
  estimatedCost?: number;
}

interface MitigationAction {
  id: string;
  riskId: string;
  action: string;
  owner: string;
  status: 'planned' | 'in_progress' | 'completed';
  dueDate: Date;
  cost: number;
}

interface ProjectRiskAssessmentProps {
  projectId: string;
}

export default function ProjectRiskAssessment({ projectId }: ProjectRiskAssessmentProps) {
  const [selectedTab, setSelectedTab] = useState<'overview' | 'risks' | 'mitigation'>('overview');

  // Mock risk data - in production, this would come from API
  const risks: RiskItem[] = [
    {
      id: '1',
      title: 'Supplier Dependency Risk',
      description: 'Over-reliance on single supplier for critical components',
      category: 'operational',
      probability: 4,
      impact: 5,
      riskScore: 20,
      status: 'mitigating',
      mitigation: 'Diversify supplier base and establish backup suppliers',
      owner: 'Supply Chain Team',
      dueDate: new Date('2024-09-15'),
      estimatedCost: 150000
    },
    {
      id: '2',
      title: 'Market Volatility Impact',
      description: 'Economic conditions affecting supplier pricing and availability',
      category: 'external',
      probability: 3,
      impact: 4,
      riskScore: 12,
      status: 'analyzing',
      mitigation: 'Implement dynamic pricing models and long-term contracts',
      owner: 'Finance Team',
      dueDate: new Date('2024-08-30'),
      estimatedCost: 75000
    },
    {
      id: '3',
      title: 'Technology Integration Risk',
      description: 'Challenges integrating new systems with existing infrastructure',
      category: 'technical',
      probability: 3,
      impact: 3,
      riskScore: 9,
      status: 'identified',
      mitigation: 'Comprehensive testing and phased rollout approach',
      owner: 'IT Team',
      dueDate: new Date('2024-10-01'),
      estimatedCost: 50000
    },
    {
      id: '4',
      title: 'Regulatory Compliance Gap',
      description: 'New regulations may impact supplier qualification requirements',
      category: 'strategic',
      probability: 2,
      impact: 4,
      riskScore: 8,
      status: 'mitigating',
      mitigation: 'Regular compliance audits and legal consultation',
      owner: 'Legal & Compliance',
      dueDate: new Date('2024-09-30'),
      estimatedCost: 25000
    },
    {
      id: '5',
      title: 'Team Capacity Constraint',
      description: 'Limited team bandwidth for managing multiple supplier relationships',
      category: 'operational',
      probability: 3,
      impact: 2,
      riskScore: 6,
      status: 'closed',
      mitigation: 'Additional team member training and automation tools',
      owner: 'HR Team',
      dueDate: new Date('2024-08-15'),
      estimatedCost: 30000
    }
  ];

  const getRiskSeverity = (score: number) => {
    if (score >= 15) return { level: 'critical', color: 'bg-red-500', textColor: 'text-red-700' };
    if (score >= 10) return { level: 'high', color: 'bg-orange-500', textColor: 'text-orange-700' };
    if (score >= 5) return { level: 'medium', color: 'bg-yellow-500', textColor: 'text-yellow-700' };
    return { level: 'low', color: 'bg-green-500', textColor: 'text-green-700' };
  };

  const getCategoryIcon = (category: string) => {
    switch (category) {
      case 'technical': return <Activity className="w-4 h-4" />;
      case 'financial': return <DollarSign className="w-4 h-4" />;
      case 'operational': return <Target className="w-4 h-4" />;
      case 'strategic': return <TrendingUp className="w-4 h-4" />;
      case 'external': return <Shield className="w-4 h-4" />;
      default: return <AlertTriangle className="w-4 h-4" />;
    }
  };

  const getStatusIcon = (status: string) => {
    switch (status) {
      case 'identified': return <AlertTriangle className="w-4 h-4 text-yellow-600" />;
      case 'analyzing': return <Clock className="w-4 h-4 text-blue-600" />;
      case 'mitigating': return <Shield className="w-4 h-4 text-orange-600" />;
      case 'closed': return <CheckCircle2 className="w-4 h-4 text-green-600" />;
      default: return <XCircle className="w-4 h-4 text-gray-600" />;
    }
  };

  const calculateRiskMetrics = () => {
    const totalRisks = risks.length;
    const openRisks = risks.filter(r => r.status !== 'closed').length;
    const highRisks = risks.filter(r => getRiskSeverity(r.riskScore).level === 'critical' || getRiskSeverity(r.riskScore).level === 'high').length;
    const avgRiskScore = risks.reduce((sum, r) => sum + r.riskScore, 0) / totalRisks;
    const totalMitigationCost = risks.reduce((sum, r) => sum + (r.estimatedCost || 0), 0);

    return {
      totalRisks,
      openRisks,
      highRisks,
      avgRiskScore: avgRiskScore.toFixed(1),
      totalMitigationCost
    };
  };

  const metrics = calculateRiskMetrics();

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6">
      {/* Header */}
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between">

          <h2 className="text-2xl font-bold text-foreground">Risk Assessment</h2>
          <p className="text-muted-foreground">Project risk identification and mitigation tracking</p>
        </div>
        <Button>
          <AlertTriangle className="w-4 h-4 mr-2" />
          Add Risk
        </Button>
      </div>

      {/* Tab Navigation */}
      <Tabs value={selectedTab} onValueChange={(value) => setSelectedTab(value as any)}>
        <TabsList>
          <TabsTrigger value="overview">Risk Overview</TabsTrigger>
          <TabsTrigger value="risks">Risk Registry</TabsTrigger>
          <TabsTrigger value="mitigation">Mitigation Plans</TabsTrigger>
        </TabsList>

        {/* Overview Tab */}
        <TabsContent value="overview" className="space-y-6">
          {/* Risk Metrics */}
          <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-5 gap-4">
            <Card>
              <CardContent className="p-4">
                <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                  <div>
                    <p className="text-sm font-medium text-muted-foreground">Total Risks</p>
                    <p className="text-2xl font-bold">{metrics.totalRisks}</p>
                  </div>
                  <AlertTriangle className="w-6 h-6 text-gray-500" />
                </div>
              </CardContent>
            </Card>

            <Card>
              <CardContent className="p-4">
                <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                  <div>
                    <p className="text-sm font-medium text-muted-foreground">Open Risks</p>
                    <p className="text-2xl font-bold text-orange-600">{metrics.openRisks}</p>
                  </div>
                  <XCircle className="w-6 h-6 text-orange-500" />
                </div>
              </CardContent>
            </Card>

            <Card>
              <CardContent className="p-4">
                <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                  <div>
                    <p className="text-sm font-medium text-muted-foreground">High Priority</p>
                    <p className="text-2xl font-bold text-red-600">{metrics.highRisks}</p>
                  </div>
                  <Shield className="w-6 h-6 text-red-500" />
                </div>
              </CardContent>
            </Card>

            <Card>
              <CardContent className="p-4">
                <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                  <div>
                    <p className="text-sm font-medium text-muted-foreground">Avg Risk Score</p>
                    <p className="text-2xl font-bold">{metrics.avgRiskScore}</p>
                  </div>
                  <TrendingUp className="w-6 h-6 text-blue-500" />
                </div>
              </CardContent>
            </Card>

            <Card>
              <CardContent className="p-4">
                <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                  <div>
                    <p className="text-sm font-medium text-muted-foreground">Mitigation Cost</p>
                    <p className="text-2xl font-bold">${(metrics.totalMitigationCost / 1000).toFixed(0)}K</p>
                  </div>
                  <DollarSign className="w-6 h-6 text-green-500" />
                </div>
              </CardContent>
            </Card>
          </div>

          {/* Risk Heat Map */}
          <Card>
            <CardHeader>
              <CardTitle>Risk Heat Map</CardTitle>
              <CardDescription>Risk assessment matrix showing probability vs impact</CardDescription>
            </CardHeader>
            <CardContent>
              <div className="grid grid-cols-6 gap-2 p-4">
                {/* Y-axis label */}
                <div className="col-span-1 flex items-center justify-center">
                  <span className="text-sm font-medium text-muted-foreground transform -rotate-90">Impact</span>
                </div>
                
                {/* Heat map grid */}
                <div className="col-span-5 space-y-2">
                  {[5, 4, 3, 2, 1].map((impact) => (
                    <div key={impact} className="grid grid-cols-5 gap-2">
                      {[1, 2, 3, 4, 5].map((probability) => {
                        const score = probability * impact;
                        const severity = getRiskSeverity(score);
                        const risksInCell = risks.filter(r => r.probability === probability && r.impact === impact);
                        
                        return (
                          <div
                            key={`${probability}-${impact}`}
                            className={`h-16 border-2 border-white rounded-lg flex items-center justify-center text-xs font-medium text-white relative ${severity.color}`}
                          >
                            <span className="absolute top-1 left-1 text-xs opacity-75">
                              {score}
                            </span>
                            {risksInCell.length > 0 && (
                              <div className="absolute bottom-1 right-1 bg-white bg-opacity-20 rounded-full w-5 h-5 flex items-center justify-center text-xs">
                                {risksInCell.length}
                              </div>
                            )}
                          </div>
                        );

                  ))}
                </div>
                
                {/* X-axis label */}

                            <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">{risk.description}</p>
                          </div>

                          {getStatusIcon(risk.status)}

                      </div>
                    );
                  })}
              </div>
            </CardContent>
          </Card>
        </TabsContent>

        {/* Risk Registry Tab */}
        <TabsContent value="risks" className="space-y-4">

                        <div className={`w-4 h-4 rounded-full ${severity.color} mt-1`}></div>
                        <div>
                          <h3 className="font-semibold text-lg">{risk.title}</h3>
                          <p className="text-muted-foreground">{risk.description}</p>
                        </div>
                      </div>
                      <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                        <Badge className="bg-blue-100 text-blue-800">
                          {getCategoryIcon(risk.category)}
                          <span className="ml-1">{risk.category}</span>
                        </Badge>
                        <Badge variant="outline">
                          {getStatusIcon(risk.status)}
                          <span className="ml-1">{risk.status}</span>

                        <label className="text-sm font-medium text-muted-foreground">Probability</label>

                      </div>
                      <div>
                        <label className="text-sm font-medium text-muted-foreground">Est. Cost</label>
                        <p className="text-lg font-bold">${risk.estimatedCost?.toLocaleString() || 'N/A'}</p>

                      <p className="mt-1">{risk.mitigation}</p>
                      <div className="flex items-center justify-between mt-2 text-sm text-muted-foreground">
                        <span>Owner: {risk.owner}</span>
                        <span>Due: {risk.dueDate.toLocaleDateString()}</span>
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  </CardContent>
                </Card>
              );
            })}
          </div>
        </TabsContent>

        {/* Mitigation Plans Tab */}
        <TabsContent value="mitigation">
          <Card>
            <CardHeader>
              <CardTitle>Mitigation Action Plans</CardTitle>
              <CardDescription>Detailed action plans for risk mitigation</CardDescription>
            </CardHeader>
            <CardContent>
              <div className="text-center py-8 text-muted-foreground">
                <Shield className="w-12 h-12 mx-auto mb-4 opacity-50" />
                <p>Mitigation action plans will be displayed here</p>
                <p className="text-sm">Track specific actions, owners, and progress</p>
              </div>
            </CardContent>
          </Card>
        </TabsContent>
      </Tabs>
    </div>
  );
}
```

```
  const categories = ['all', ...Array.from(new Set(templates.map(t => t.category)))];
  const methodologies = ['all', ...Array.from(new Set(templates.map(t => t.methodology)))];

  const filteredTemplates = templates.filter(template => {
    const matchesSearch = template.name.toLowerCase().includes(searchTerm.toLowerCase()) ||
                         template.description.toLowerCase().includes(searchTerm.toLowerCase()) ||
                         template.tags.some(tag => tag.toLowerCase().includes(searchTerm.toLowerCase()));
    
    const matchesCategory = selectedCategory === 'all' || template.category === selectedCategory;
    const matchesMethodology = selectedMethodology === 'all' || template.methodology === selectedMethodology;
    
    return matchesSearch && matchesCategory && matchesMethodology;
  });

  const getComplexityColor = (complexity: string) => {
    switch (complexity) {
      case 'Low': return 'bg-green-100 text-green-800';
      case 'Medium': return 'bg-yellow-100 text-yellow-800';
      case 'High': return 'bg-red-100 text-red-800';
      default: return 'bg-gray-100 text-gray-800';
    }
  };

  const renderStars = (rating: number) => {
    return Array.from({ length: 5 }, (_, i) => (

        key={i}
        className={`w-4 h-4 ${i < Math.floor(rating) ? 'text-yellow-400 fill-current' : 'text-gray-300'}`}
      />
    ));

                      <h4 className="font-medium text-sm">Key Deliverables:</h4>
                      <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-1">

                          <Badge key={index} variant="secondary" className="text-xs">
                            {deliverable}
```

## FILE: client/src/components/ProjectTimeline.tsx
```
import React, { useState } from 'react';
import { Card, CardContent, CardDescription, CardHeader, CardTitle } from '@/components/ui/card';
import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button';
import { Badge } from '@/components/ui/badge';
import { Progress } from '@/components/ui/progress';
import { Calendar, Clock, Users, Target, CheckCircle2, AlertCircle } from 'lucide-react';
import { format, differenceInDays, isAfter, isBefore } from 'date-fns';
import type { Project, Task } from '../types';

interface TimelineEvent {
  id: string;
  title: string;
  description: string;
  date: Date;
  type: 'milestone' | 'task' | 'deadline' | 'meeting';
  status: 'completed' | 'in_progress' | 'upcoming' | 'overdue';
  project?: Project;
  task?: Task;
}

interface ProjectTimelineProps {
  projectId?: string;
  showAllProjects?: boolean;
}

export default function ProjectTimeline({ projectId, showAllProjects = false }: ProjectTimelineProps) {
  const [selectedFilter, setSelectedFilter] = useState<'all' | 'milestones' | 'tasks' | 'deadlines'>('all');

  // Mock timeline data - in real implementation, this would come from API
  const generateTimelineEvents = (): TimelineEvent[] => {
    const events: TimelineEvent[] = [];
    const now = new Date();

    // Add project milestones
    events.push(
      {
        id: '1',
        title: 'Project Kickoff',
        description: 'Initial project setup and team alignment',
        date: new Date(2024, 7, 8),
        type: 'milestone',
        status: 'completed'
      },
      {
        id: '2',
        title: 'Risk Assessment Complete',
        description: 'Comprehensive risk analysis and mitigation planning',
        date: new Date(2024, 7, 15),
        type: 'milestone',
        status: 'completed'
      },
      {
        id: '3',
        title: 'Supplier Evaluation',
        description: 'Evaluate alternative suppliers and backup options',
        date: new Date(2024, 7, 20),
        type: 'task',
        status: 'in_progress'
      },
      {
        id: '4',
        title: 'Stakeholder Review',
        description: 'Present findings to executive leadership',
        date: new Date(2024, 7, 25),
        type: 'meeting',
        status: 'upcoming'
      },
      {
        id: '5',
        title: 'Implementation Plan',
        description: 'Finalize implementation strategy and timeline',
        date: new Date(2024, 8, 1),
        type: 'deadline',
        status: 'upcoming'
      },
      {
        id: '6',
        title: 'Phase 1 Rollout',
        description: 'Begin rollout of new supplier relationships',
        date: new Date(2024, 8, 15),
        type: 'milestone',
        status: 'upcoming'
      }
    );

    // Determine status based on current date
    return events.map(event => ({
      ...event,
      status: isAfter(event.date, now) ? 'upcoming' : 
              format(event.date, 'yyyy-MM-dd') === format(now, 'yyyy-MM-dd') ? 'in_progress' :
              'completed'
    }));
  };

  const events = generateTimelineEvents();
  const filteredEvents = events.filter(event => {
    if (selectedFilter === 'all') return true;
    if (selectedFilter === 'milestones') return event.type === 'milestone';
    if (selectedFilter === 'tasks') return event.type === 'task';
    if (selectedFilter === 'deadlines') return event.type === 'deadline';
    return false;
  });

  const getEventIcon = (type: string, status: string) => {
    if (status === 'completed') return <CheckCircle2 className="w-5 h-5 text-green-500" />;
    if (status === 'overdue') return <AlertCircle className="w-5 h-5 text-red-500" />;
    
    switch (type) {
      case 'milestone': return <Target className="w-5 h-5 text-blue-500" />;
      case 'task': return <CheckCircle2 className="w-5 h-5 text-orange-500" />;
      case 'deadline': return <Clock className="w-5 h-5 text-red-500" />;
      case 'meeting': return <Users className="w-5 h-5 text-purple-500" />;
      default: return <Calendar className="w-5 h-5 text-gray-500" />;
    }
  };

  const getEventColor = (type: string, status: string) => {
    if (status === 'completed') return 'border-green-200 bg-green-50';
    if (status === 'overdue') return 'border-red-200 bg-red-50';
    if (status === 'in_progress') return 'border-blue-200 bg-blue-50';
    
    switch (type) {
      case 'milestone': return 'border-blue-200 bg-blue-50';
      case 'task': return 'border-orange-200 bg-orange-50';
      case 'deadline': return 'border-red-200 bg-red-50';
      case 'meeting': return 'border-purple-200 bg-purple-50';
      default: return 'border-gray-200 bg-gray-50';
    }
  };

  const getStatusBadge = (status: string) => {
    switch (status) {
      case 'completed':
        return <Badge className="bg-green-100 text-green-800 border-green-200">Completed</Badge>;
      case 'in_progress':
        return <Badge className="bg-blue-100 text-blue-800 border-blue-200">In Progress</Badge>;
      case 'upcoming':
        return <Badge className="bg-gray-100 text-gray-800 border-gray-200">Upcoming</Badge>;
      case 'overdue':
        return <Badge className="bg-red-100 text-red-800 border-red-200">Overdue</Badge>;
      default:
        return null;
    }
  };

  const calculateDaysUntil = (date: Date) => {
    const days = differenceInDays(date, new Date());
    if (days === 0) return 'Today';
    if (days === 1) return 'Tomorrow';
    if (days > 0) return `In ${days} days`;
    if (days === -1) return 'Yesterday';
    return `${Math.abs(days)} days ago`;
  };

  return (
    <Card>
      <CardHeader>
        <CardTitle className="flex items-center gap-2">
          <Calendar className="w-5 h-5" />
          Project Timeline
        </CardTitle>
        <CardDescription>
          Track milestones, tasks, and important deadlines
        </CardDescription>
        
        {/* Filter Buttons */}
        <div className="flex gap-2 pt-2">
          <Button
            variant={selectedFilter === 'all' ? 'default' : 'outline'}
            size="sm"
            onClick={() => setSelectedFilter('all')}
          >
            All Events
          </Button>
          <Button
            variant={selectedFilter === 'milestones' ? 'default' : 'outline'}
            size="sm"
            onClick={() => setSelectedFilter('milestones')}
          >
            Milestones
          </Button>
          <Button
            variant={selectedFilter === 'tasks' ? 'default' : 'outline'}
            size="sm"
            onClick={() => setSelectedFilter('tasks')}
          >
            Tasks
          </Button>
          <Button
            variant={selectedFilter === 'deadlines' ? 'default' : 'outline'}
            size="sm"
            onClick={() => setSelectedFilter('deadlines')}
          >
            Deadlines
          </Button>
        </div>
      </CardHeader>
      
      <CardContent>
        <div className="space-y-4">
          {filteredEvents.map((event, index) => (
            <div key={event.id} className="relative">
              {/* Timeline line */}
              {index < filteredEvents.length - 1 && (
                <div className="absolute left-6 top-12 w-0.5 h-12 bg-border"></div>
              )}
              
              {/* Event card */}
              <div className={`flex items-start gap-4 p-4 rounded-lg border ${getEventColor(event.type, event.status)}`}>
                {/* Icon */}
                <div className="flex-shrink-0 mt-1">
                  {getEventIcon(event.type, event.status)}
                </div>
                
                {/* Content */}
                <div className="flex-1 min-w-0">
                  <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-1">
                    <h4 className="font-semibold text-foreground">{event.title}</h4>
                    <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                      {getStatusBadge(event.status)}
                      <Badge variant="outline" className="text-xs">
                        {event.type}
                      </Badge>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                  
                  <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground mb-2">
                    {event.description}
                  </p>
                  
                  <div className="flex items-center justify-between text-sm">
                    <span className="font-medium text-foreground">
                      {format(event.date, 'MMM dd, yyyy')}
                    </span>
                    <span className="text-muted-foreground">
                      {calculateDaysUntil(event.date)}
                    </span>
                  </div>
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>
          ))}
        </div>
        
        {filteredEvents.length === 0 && (
          <div className="text-center py-8 text-muted-foreground">
            <Calendar className="w-12 h-12 mx-auto mb-4 opacity-50" />
            <p>No events found for the selected filter.</p>
          </div>
        )}
      </CardContent>
    </Card>
  );
}
```

```
          )}
          <div>
            <h1 className="text-3xl font-bold text-foreground">{project.name}</h1>
            <p className="text-muted-foreground mt-1">{project.description}</p>
          </div>
        </div>
        
        <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
          <Badge variant="outline" className={getStatusColor(project.status)}>
            {project.status.replace('_', ' ').toUpperCase()}
          </Badge>
          <div className="flex items-center gap-1">
            <div className={`w-2 h-2 rounded-full ${getPriorityColor(project.priority)}`} />
            <span className="text-sm text-muted-foreground capitalize">{project.priority}</span>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Key Metrics */}
      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-4 gap-4">
        <Card className="executive-card">
          <CardContent className="p-4">
            <div className="flex items-center gap-3">

                <div className="text-2xl font-bold text-foreground">{progressPercentage}%</div>
                <div className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">Completion</div>
              </div>
            </div>
          </CardContent>
        </Card>

        <Card className="executive-card">
          <CardContent className="p-4">
            <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
              <Users className="w-8 h-8 text-green-500" />
              <div>
                <div className="text-2xl font-bold text-foreground">{teamMembers.length}</div>
                <div className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">Team Size</div>
              </div>
            </div>

        </Card>

        <Card className="executive-card">

              </div>
            </div>
          </CardContent>
        </Card>

        <Card className="executive-card">
          <CardContent className="p-4">
            <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
              <Clock className="w-8 h-8 text-orange-500" />
              <div>
                <div className="text-2xl font-bold text-foreground">
                  {Math.ceil((new Date(project.endDate!).getTime() - Date.now()) / (1000 * 60 * 60 * 24))}
                </div>
                <div className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">Days Left</div>
              </div>
            </div>
          </CardContent>
        </Card>
      </div>

      {/* Main Content */}
      <Tabs value={activeTab} onValueChange={setActiveTab} className="space-y-6">
        <TabsList className="grid w-full grid-cols-6">
          <TabsTrigger value="overview">Overview</TabsTrigger>
          <TabsTrigger value="timeline">Timeline</TabsTrigger>
          <TabsTrigger value="resources">Resources</TabsTrigger>
          <TabsTrigger value="risks">Risks</TabsTrigger>
          <TabsTrigger value="analytics">Analytics</TabsTrigger>
          <TabsTrigger value="team">Team</TabsTrigger>
        </TabsList>

        <TabsContent value="overview" className="space-y-6">
          <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 gap-6">
            {/* To Do Column */}
            <Card className="executive-card">
              <CardHeader className="pb-3">
```

```
              <div className="text-2xl font-bold text-orange-600">{decisionPoints.filter(d => d.status === 'pending').length}</div>
              <div className="text-xs text-gray-600">Pending Decisions</div>
            </div>

              <div className="text-2xl font-bold text-purple-600">4.2min</div>
              <div className="text-xs text-gray-600">Avg Decision Time</div>
            </div>

          <Card>
            <CardHeader>

                <span>Active Sessions</span>

                  <UserPlus className="h-4 w-4 mr-2" />

            <CardContent className="p-0">

                  >

                              <AlertCircle className="h-4 w-4 mr-2" />

                            </Button>
                            <Button size="sm" variant="outline">
                              <MessageCircle className="h-4 w-4 mr-2" />
                              Comment
                            </Button>
                          </div>
                        </CardContent>
                      </Card>
                    ))}
                  </div>

                    <h3 className="font-semibold text-gray-900">Collaborative Documents</h3>
                    <div className="grid gap-3">
                      <div className="flex items-center gap-3 p-3 border rounded-lg hover:bg-gray-50">
                        <FileText className="h-5 w-5 text-blue-600" />
                        <div className="flex-1">
                          <div className="font-medium text-sm">Supply Chain Response Plan</div>
                          <div className="text-xs text-gray-500">Last edited 5 minutes ago by Mike Rodriguez</div>
                        </div>
                        <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                          <Badge variant="outline" className="text-xs">
                            <Edit3 className="h-3 w-3 mr-1" />
                            2 editing
                          </Badge>
                          <Button size="sm" variant="outline">Open</Button>
                        </div>
                      </div>
                      
                      <div className="flex items-center gap-3 p-3 border rounded-lg hover:bg-gray-50">
                        <FileText className="h-5 w-5 text-green-600" />
                        <div className="flex-1">
                          <div className="font-medium text-sm">Risk Assessment Matrix</div>
                          <div className="text-xs text-gray-500">Last edited 12 minutes ago by David Kim</div>
                        </div>
                        <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                          <Badge variant="outline" className="text-xs">
                            <Eye className="h-3 w-3 mr-1" />
                            3 viewing
                          </Badge>
                          <Button size="sm" variant="outline">Open</Button>
                        </div>
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                </TabsContent>
              </Tabs>
            </Card>
          )}
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

export default RealTimeCollaborationHub;
```

```
          {currentIncident?.communicationChannels.map((channel, index) => (
            <div key={index} className="flex items-center justify-between p-3 bg-gray-50 rounded-lg">
              <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
                <div className={`w-3 h-3 rounded-full ${channel.active ? 'bg-green-500' : 'bg-gray-400'}`}></div>
                <div>
                  <h4 className="font-medium capitalize">{channel.type}</h4>
                  <p className="text-sm text-gray-600">{channel.participants} participants</p>
                </div>
              </div>
              <div className="text-right">
                <p className="text-sm text-gray-600">Last activity</p>
                <p className="text-sm font-medium">{channel.lastActivity}</p>
              </div>
            </div>
          ))}
        </div>
      </CardContent>
    </Card>
  );

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6 p-6">
      {/* Header */}
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
        <div>
          <h1 className="text-3xl font-bold text-red-700">Crisis Command Center</h1>
          <p className="text-gray-600">Real-time incident coordination and response management</p>
        </div>
        <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
          <Badge className="bg-red-100 text-red-800 animate-pulse">
            {activeIncidents.length} Active Incidents
          </Badge>
          <Button variant="destructive">
            <Bell className="h-4 w-4 mr-2" />
            Alert All
          </Button>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Active Incidents Bar */}
      <Card className="border-l-4 border-l-red-500">
        <CardContent className="p-4">
          <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
            <div>
              <h3 className="font-semibold text-lg">{currentIncident?.title}</h3>
              <div className="flex items-center gap-4 mt-2">
                <Badge className={getSeverityColor(currentIncident?.severity || '')}>
                  {currentIncident?.severity?.toUpperCase()}
                </Badge>
                <Badge className={getStatusColor(currentIncident?.status || '')}>
                  {currentIncident?.status?.toUpperCase()}
                </Badge>
                <div className="flex items-center gap-1 text-sm text-gray-600">
                  <MapPin className="h-4 w-4" />
                  {currentIncident?.location}
                </div>
                <div className="flex items-center gap-1 text-sm text-gray-600">
                  <Clock className="h-4 w-4" />
                  {new Date(currentIncident?.startTime || '').toLocaleString()}
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
              <Button size="sm" variant="outline">
                <FileText className="h-4 w-4 mr-2" />
                Report
              </Button>
              <Button size="sm">
                <Zap className="h-4 w-4 mr-2" />
                Escalate
              </Button>
            </div>
          </div>
        </CardContent>
      </Card>

      {/* Command Center Tabs */}
      <Tabs value={commandCenterView} onValueChange={setCommandCenterView}>
        <TabsList className="grid w-full grid-cols-4">
          <TabsTrigger value="overview">Overview</TabsTrigger>
          <TabsTrigger value="team">Response Team</TabsTrigger>
          <TabsTrigger value="timeline">Timeline</TabsTrigger>
          <TabsTrigger value="communications">Communications</TabsTrigger>
        </TabsList>

        <TabsContent value="overview" className="space-y-6">
          <IncidentOverview />
        </TabsContent>

        <TabsContent value="team" className="space-y-6">
          <ResponseTeam />
        </TabsContent>

        <TabsContent value="timeline" className="space-y-6">
          <CrisisTimeline />
        </TabsContent>

        <TabsContent value="communications" className="space-y-6">
          <CommunicationChannels />
        </TabsContent>
      </Tabs>
    </div>
  );
}
```

```
  last_update: string;
  ai_ready: boolean;
  quality_score: number;
}

  }

export function RealTimeDataDemo() {
  const [currentTab, setCurrentTab] = useState<string>('overview');
  const [dataStreams, setDataStreams] = useState<DataStreamStatus[]>(mockDataStreams);
  const [isConnecting, setIsConnecting] = useState(false);
  const [connectionProgress, setConnectionProgress] = useState(0);
  const [totalDataPoints, setTotalDataPoints] = useState(0);
  const [aiReadinessScore, setAiReadinessScore] = useState(0);

  useEffect(() => {
    // Calculate metrics
    const totalPoints = dataStreams.reduce((sum, stream) => sum + stream.data_points, 0);
    setTotalDataPoints(totalPoints);
    
    const connectedStreams = dataStreams.filter(s => s.ai_ready);
    const avgQuality = connectedStreams.reduce((sum, s) => sum + s.quality_score, 0) / connectedStreams.length;
    setAiReadinessScore(avgQuality);
  }, [dataStreams]);

  const connectDataSource = async (sourceType: string) => {
    setIsConnecting(true);
    setConnectionProgress(0);
    
    try {
      // Simulate connection progress
      const progressSteps = [
        { step: 20, message: "Authenticating with system..." },
        { step: 40, message: "Mapping data schema..." },
        { step: 60, message: "Validating data quality..." },
        { step: 80, message: "Configuring real-time sync..." },
        { step: 100, message: "Connection established!" }
      ];

      for (const { step } of progressSteps) {
        await new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, 600));
        setConnectionProgress(step);
      }

      // Simulate API call
      const result = await realTimeDataEngine.connectEnterpriseSystem({
        system_type: sourceType as any,
        connection_details: {
          endpoint: `https://api.${sourceType}.company.com`,
          credentials: { api_key: 'demo_key' },
          data_mapping: { format: 'json' }
        }
      });

      console.log('Connection result:', result);
      
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Connection failed:', error);
    } finally {
      setIsConnecting(false);
    }

      case 'connecting': return <Clock className="h-4 w-4 text-yellow-500" />;
      case 'error': return <AlertCircle className="h-4 w-4 text-red-500" />;
      case 'offline': return <AlertCircle className="h-4 w-4 text-gray-500" />;
      default: return <AlertCircle className="h-4 w-4" />;
    }
  };

    switch (status) {
      case 'connected': return 'bg-green-500';
      case 'connecting': return 'bg-yellow-500';
      case 'error': return 'bg-red-500';
      case 'offline': return 'bg-gray-500';
      default: return 'bg-gray-500';
```

```
import React, { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import { Card, CardContent, CardHeader, CardTitle } from '@/components/ui/card';
import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button';
import { Input } from '@/components/ui/input';
import { Textarea } from '@/components/ui/textarea';
import { Select, SelectContent, SelectItem, SelectTrigger, SelectValue } from '@/components/ui/select';
import { Tabs, TabsContent, TabsList, TabsTrigger } from '@/components/ui/tabs';
import { Badge } from '@/components/ui/badge';
import { 
  FileText, Download, Calendar, Eye, Settings, BarChart3, 
  PieChart, TrendingUp, Filter, Clock, Send, Bookmark 
} from 'lucide-react';
import { VeridiusCard, VeridiusButton } from '@/components/ui/veridius-components';

interface ReportTemplate {
  id: string;
  name: string;
  description: string;
  category: 'Executive' | 'Operational' | 'Strategic' | 'Compliance' | 'Analytics';
  type: 'dashboard' | 'document' | 'presentation';
  schedule?: 'daily' | 'weekly' | 'monthly' | 'quarterly';
  lastGenerated?: Date;
  recipients: string[];
  parameters: any;
}

interface CustomReport {
  id: string;
  title: string;
  description: string;
  dataSource: string[];
  visualizations: any[];
  filters: any[];
  createdBy: string;
  createdAt: Date;
  isPublic: boolean;
}

const REPORT_TEMPLATES: ReportTemplate[] = [
  {
    id: 'executive-dashboard',
    name: 'Executive Dashboard',
    description: 'High-level organizational metrics and KPIs for C-suite executives',
    category: 'Executive',
    type: 'dashboard',
    schedule: 'daily',
    recipients: ['executives@company.com'],
    parameters: {}
  },
  {
    id: 'crisis-response-summary',
    name: 'Crisis Response Summary',
    description: 'Comprehensive analysis of crisis scenarios and response effectiveness',
    category: 'Strategic',
    type: 'document',
    schedule: 'weekly',
    recipients: ['strategy@company.com', 'risk@company.com'],
    parameters: {}
  },
  {
    id: 'operational-metrics',
    name: 'Operational Performance Report',
    description: 'Detailed operational metrics including productivity, efficiency, and resource utilization',
    category: 'Operational',
    type: 'dashboard',
    schedule: 'daily',
    recipients: ['operations@company.com'],
    parameters: {}
  },
  {
    id: 'compliance-audit',
    name: 'Compliance Audit Report',
    description: 'Regulatory compliance status and audit trail documentation',
    category: 'Compliance',
    type: 'document',
    schedule: 'monthly',
    recipients: ['compliance@company.com', 'legal@company.com'],
    parameters: {}
  },
  {
    id: 'predictive-analytics',
    name: 'Predictive Intelligence Report',
    description: 'AI-powered predictive analysis with market trends and risk forecasting',
    category: 'Analytics',
    type: 'presentation',
    schedule: 'weekly',
    recipients: ['analytics@company.com', 'strategy@company.com'],
    parameters: {}
  }
];

export default function AdvancedReportingSystem() {
  const [templates, setTemplates] = useState<ReportTemplate[]>(REPORT_TEMPLATES);
  const [customReports, setCustomReports] = useState<CustomReport[]>([]);
  const [selectedTemplate, setSelectedTemplate] = useState<ReportTemplate | null>(null);
  const [isGenerating, setIsGenerating] = useState(false);
  const [reportBuilder, setReportBuilder] = useState({
    title: '',
    description: '',
    dataSources: [],
    visualizations: [],
    filters: []
  });

  const generateReport = async (template: ReportTemplate) => {
    setIsGenerating(true);
    try {
      const response = await fetch('/api/reports/generate', {
        method: 'POST',
        headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
        body: JSON.stringify({
          templateId: template.id,
          organizationId: 'demo-org',
          parameters: template.parameters || {},
          format: 'pdf'
        })
      });

      if (response.ok) {
        const result = await response.json();
        console.log('Report generated:', result);
        // Update template with last generated time
        setTemplates(prev => prev.map(t => 
          t.id === template.id 
            ? { ...t, lastGenerated: new Date() }
            : t
        ));
      }
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Error generating report:', error);
    } finally {
      setIsGenerating(false);
    }
  };

  const scheduleReport = async (templateId: string, schedule: ReportTemplate['schedule']) => {
    try {
      const response = await fetch('/api/reports/schedule', {
        method: 'POST',
        headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
        body: JSON.stringify({
          templateId,
          schedule,
          organizationId: 'demo-org'
        })
      });

      if (response.ok) {
        setTemplates(prev => prev.map(t => 
          t.id === templateId 
            ? { ...t, schedule }
            : t
        ));
      }
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Error scheduling report:', error);
    }
  };

  const createCustomReport = async () => {
    if (!reportBuilder.title) return;

    try {
      const response = await fetch('/api/reports/custom', {
        method: 'POST',
        headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
        body: JSON.stringify({
          ...reportBuilder,
          organizationId: 'demo-org',
          createdBy: 'demo-user'
        })
      });

      if (response.ok) {
        const report = await response.json();
        setCustomReports(prev => [...prev, report]);
        setReportBuilder({
          title: '',
          description: '',
          dataSources: [],
          visualizations: [],
          filters: []
        });
      }
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Error creating custom report:', error);
    }
  };

  const getCategoryColor = (category: ReportTemplate['category']) => {
    const colors = {
      Executive: 'bg-purple-500',
      Strategic: 'bg-blue-500',
      Operational: 'bg-green-500',

      Analytics: 'bg-orange-500'

    return colors[category] || 'bg-gray-500';
  };

  const getTypeIcon = (type: ReportTemplate['type']) => {
    switch (type) {
      case 'dashboard': return <BarChart3 className="w-4 h-4" />;
      case 'document': return <FileText className="w-4 h-4" />;
      case 'presentation': return <PieChart className="w-4 h-4" />;
      default: return <FileText className="w-4 h-4" />;
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6">
      {/* Header */}
      <VeridiusCard>
        <div className="p-6">
          <h2 className="text-2xl font-bold text-white mb-4">Advanced Reporting System</h2>
          <p className="text-white/70 mb-6">
            Generate comprehensive executive reports with scheduled delivery and custom analytics
          </p>
          
          <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-4 gap-4">
            <div className="bg-blue-500/20 p-4 rounded-lg">
              <FileText className="w-8 h-8 text-blue-400 mb-2" />
              <div className="text-white font-semibold">Report Templates</div>
              <div className="text-2xl font-bold text-white">{templates.length}</div>
            </div>
            <div className="bg-green-500/20 p-4 rounded-lg">
              <Clock className="w-8 h-8 text-green-400 mb-2" />
              <div className="text-white font-semibold">Scheduled Reports</div>
              <div className="text-2xl font-bold text-white">
                {templates.filter(t => t.schedule).length}
              </div>
            </div>
            <div className="bg-purple-500/20 p-4 rounded-lg">
              <Bookmark className="w-8 h-8 text-purple-400 mb-2" />
              <div className="text-white font-semibold">Custom Reports</div>
              <div className="text-2xl font-bold text-white">{customReports.length}</div>
            </div>
            <div className="bg-orange-500/20 p-4 rounded-lg">
              <TrendingUp className="w-8 h-8 text-orange-400 mb-2" />
              <div className="text-white font-semibold">Generated Today</div>
              <div className="text-2xl font-bold text-white">12</div>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      </VeridiusCard>

      <Tabs defaultValue="templates" className="space-y-6">
        <TabsList className="grid w-full grid-cols-4 bg-gray-800">
          <TabsTrigger value="templates" className="text-white">Report Templates</TabsTrigger>
          <TabsTrigger value="scheduled" className="text-white">Scheduled Reports</TabsTrigger>
          <TabsTrigger value="custom" className="text-white">Custom Builder</TabsTrigger>
          <TabsTrigger value="analytics" className="text-white">Report Analytics</TabsTrigger>
        </TabsList>

        <TabsContent value="templates">
          <div className="grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-2 xl:grid-cols-3 gap-6">

                <CardHeader className="pb-4">
                  <div className="flex items-start justify-between">
                    <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
                      {getTypeIcon(template.type)}
                      <div>
                        <CardTitle className="text-white text-lg">{template.name}</CardTitle>

                          {template.category}
                        </Badge>

                    </div>
```

```
// Comprehensive validation schema for supply chain crisis scenario
const supplyChainCrisisSchema = z.object({
  // Executive Decisions
  emergencySourcingProtocol: z.string().min(1, "Emergency sourcing decision is required"),
  customerCommunicationStrategy: z.string().min(1, "Customer communication strategy is required"),
  productionAdjustment: z.string().min(1, "Production adjustment decision is required"),
  emergencySpendingAuthorization: z.coerce.number().min(0, "Emergency spending must be non-negative"),
  teamMobilizationLevel: z.string().min(1, "Team mobilization level is required"),
  stakeholderNotificationTimeline: z.string().min(1, "Stakeholder notification timeline is required"),
  
  // Organizational Context
  organizationName: z.string().min(1, "Organization name is required"),
  industry: z.string().min(1, "Industry is required"),
  companySize: z.coerce.number().min(1, "Company size must be at least 1"),
  annualRevenue: z.coerce.number().min(0, "Annual revenue must be non-negative"),
  
  // Current Situation Assessment
  affectedSuppliers: z.string().min(10, "Please provide detailed information about affected suppliers"),
  currentInventoryLevels: z.coerce.number().min(0, "Current inventory level must be non-negative").max(100, "Percentage must be 100 or less"),
  alternativeSuppliers: z.string().min(5, "Please specify alternative suppliers"),
  productionImpactPercentage: z.coerce.number().min(0, "Production impact must be non-negative").max(100, "Impact percentage cannot exceed 100%"),
  atRiskCustomerOrders: z.coerce.number().min(0, "At-risk orders must be non-negative"),
  estimatedRevenueImpact: z.coerce.number().min(0, "Revenue impact must be non-negative"),
  
  // Timeline and Resources
  immediateActionDeadline: z.string().min(1, "Immediate action deadline is required"),
  shortTermRecoveryTimeline: z.string().min(1, "Short-term recovery timeline is required"),
  longTermStrategyTimeline: z.string().min(1, "Long-term strategy timeline is required"),
  
  // Risk Assessment
  reputationalRiskLevel: z.coerce.number().min(1, "Risk level must be between 1-10").max(10, "Risk level must be between 1-10"),
  financialRiskLevel: z.coerce.number().min(1, "Risk level must be between 1-10").max(10, "Risk level must be between 1-10"),
  operationalRiskLevel: z.coerce.number().min(1, "Risk level must be between 1-10").max(10, "Risk level must be between 1-10"),
  
  // Success Criteria
  primarySuccessMetric: z.string().min(10, "Please specify primary success metrics"),
  secondarySuccessMetrics: z.string().min(10, "Please specify secondary success metrics"),
  
  // Additional Context
  previousSimilarEvents: z.string().optional(),
  keyConstraints: z.string().optional(),
  specialConsiderations: z.string().optional()
});

type SupplyChainCrisisFormData = z.infer<typeof supplyChainCrisisSchema>;

// AI Recommendations Generator
const generateAIRecommendations = (data: Partial<SupplyChainCrisisFormData>): string[] => {
  const recommendations: string[] = [];
  
  if (data.industry === 'Manufacturing' && data.companySize && data.companySize > 1000) {
    recommendations.push("Consider implementing multi-tier supplier diversification strategy for large manufacturing operations");
    recommendations.push("Establish regional supplier hubs to reduce single-point-of-failure risks");
  }
  
  if (data.currentInventoryLevels && data.currentInventoryLevels < 20) {
    recommendations.push("Critical inventory level detected - immediate emergency procurement recommended");
    recommendations.push("Consider just-in-case inventory strategy vs just-in-time for critical components");
  }
  
  if (data.productionImpactPercentage && data.productionImpactPercentage > 50) {
    recommendations.push("High production impact detected - consider alternative production facilities");
    recommendations.push("Implement cross-training programs to increase workforce flexibility");
  }
  
  if (data.estimatedRevenueImpact && data.annualRevenue && 
      (data.estimatedRevenueImpact / data.annualRevenue) > 0.1) {
    recommendations.push("Significant revenue impact - engage executive crisis management team");
    recommendations.push("Consider customer retention programs and transparent communication strategy");
  }
  
  if (!data.alternativeSuppliers || data.alternativeSuppliers.length < 50) {
    recommendations.push("Develop comprehensive alternative supplier database before crisis escalates");
  }
  
  return recommendations;
};

// Export/Import functionality
const exportScenarioData = (data: SupplyChainCrisisFormData) => {
  const exportData = {
    scenarioType: 'supply-chain-crisis',
    version: '1.0',
    exportDate: new Date().toISOString(),
    data: data,
    metadata: {
      completionProgress: Math.round((Object.values(data).filter(v => v !== '' && v !== null && v !== undefined).length / Object.keys(data).length) * 100),
      organizationProfile: {
        name: data.organizationName,
        industry: data.industry,
        size: data.companySize,
        revenue: data.annualRevenue
      }
    }
  };
  
  const blob = new Blob([JSON.stringify(exportData, null, 2)], { type: 'application/json' });
  const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
  const link = document.createElement('a');
  link.href = url;
  link.download = `veridius-scenario-${data.organizationName?.replace(/[^a-z0-9]/gi, '_').toLowerCase() || 'export'}-${new Date().toISOString().split('T')[0]}.json`;
  document.body.appendChild(link);
  link.click();
  document.body.removeChild(link);
  URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
};

const importScenarioData = (file: File, form: any, toast: any) => {
  const reader = new FileReader();
  reader.onload = (e) => {
    try {
      const content = e.target?.result as string;
      const importedData = JSON.parse(content);
      
      if (importedData.scenarioType !== 'supply-chain-crisis') {
        toast({
          title: "Import Error",
          description: "Invalid scenario type. Please select a Supply Chain Crisis scenario file.",
          variant: "destructive"
        });
        return;
      }
      
      form.reset(importedData.data);
      toast({
        title: "Import Successful",
        description: `Scenario data imported successfully. Completion: ${importedData.metadata?.completionProgress || 0}%`,
      });
    } catch (error) {
      toast({
        title: "Import Error",
        description: "Failed to parse scenario file. Please check the file format.",
        variant: "destructive"
      });
    }
  };
  reader.readAsText(file);
};

      timeline: ['immediateActionDeadline', 'shortTermRecoveryTimeline', 'longTermStrategyTimeline', 'reputationalRiskLevel', 'financialRiskLevel', 'operationalRiskLevel'],
      success: ['primarySuccessMetric', 'secondarySuccessMetrics']
    };

    const newTabStatus: Record<string, boolean> = {};
    for (const [tab, fields] of Object.entries(tabFields)) {
      const filledFields = fields.filter(field => {
        const value = watchedFields[field];
        return value !== '' && value !== undefined && value !== null;
      }).length;
      newTabStatus[tab] = filledFields === fields.length;
    }
    return newTabStatus;
  }, []);

  // Calculate completion progress with enhanced tracking
  useEffect(() => {
    const watchedFields = form.watch();
    const totalFields = Object.keys(supplyChainCrisisSchema.shape).length;
    const filledFields = Object.values(watchedFields).filter(value => 
      value !== '' && value !== undefined && value !== null
    ).length;
    
    setCompletionProgress(Math.round((filledFields / totalFields) * 100));
    setTabCompletionStatus(calculateTabCompletion(watchedFields));
  }, [form.watch(), calculateTabCompletion]);

  // Auto-save functionality
  const autoSave = useCallback(async (data: any) => {
    setIsAutoSaving(true);
    try {
      // Simulate auto-save to localStorage
      localStorage.setItem('veridius-scenario-draft', JSON.stringify({
        ...data,
        lastSaved: new Date().toISOString(),
        scenarioType: 'supply-chain-crisis'
      }));
      setLastSaved(new Date());
      
      // Generate AI recommendations based on current data
      if (data.organizationName && data.industry) {
        const recommendations = generateAIRecommendations(data);
        setAiRecommendations(recommendations);
      }
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Auto-save failed:', error);
    } finally {
      setIsAutoSaving(false);
    }
  }, []);

  // Real-time validation feedback
  useEffect(() => {
    const subscription = form.watch(async (value, { name }) => {
      if (name) {
        // Auto-save on field change (debounced)
        const timeoutId = setTimeout(() => autoSave(value), 2000);
        
        // Update validation feedback
        try {
          const fieldSchema = supplyChainCrisisSchema.shape[name as keyof typeof supplyChainCrisisSchema.shape];
          if (fieldSchema) {
            await fieldSchema.parseAsync(value[name as keyof typeof value]);
            setValidationFeedback(prev => ({ ...prev, [name]: 'valid' }));
          }
        } catch {
          setValidationFeedback(prev => ({ ...prev, [name]: 'invalid' }));
        }

        return () => clearTimeout(timeoutId);
      }
    });
    return () => subscription.unsubscribe();
  }, [form.watch, autoSave]);

  // Load saved draft on component mount
  useEffect(() => {
    const savedDraft = localStorage.getItem('veridius-scenario-draft');
    if (savedDraft) {
      try {
        const parsedDraft = JSON.parse(savedDraft);
        if (parsedDraft.scenarioType === 'supply-chain-crisis') {
          form.reset(parsedDraft);
          setLastSaved(new Date(parsedDraft.lastSaved));
          toast({
            title: "Draft Restored",
            description: "Your previously saved work has been restored.",
          });
        }
      } catch (error) {
        console.error('Failed to load draft:', error);
      }
    }
  }, [form.reset, toast]);

  const onSubmit = async (data: SupplyChainCrisisFormData) => {
    try {
      // Simulate API submission
      console.log('Scenario Data Submitted:', data);
      
      // Prepare comprehensive scenario response
      const scenarioResponse = {
        scenarioId: `sc-${Date.now()}`,
        organizationProfile: {
          name: data.organizationName,
          industry: data.industry,
          size: data.companySize,
          revenue: data.annualRevenue
        },
        executiveDecisions: {
          emergencySourcing: data.emergencySourcingProtocol,

          teamMobilization: data.teamMobilizationLevel,

        },
        situationAssessment: {

          operational: data.operationalRiskLevel

          longTerm: data.longTermStrategyTimeline
        },
        successCriteria: {
          primary: data.primarySuccessMetric,
          secondary: data.secondarySuccessMetrics
        }
      };

      // Here would be the actual API call
      // await apiRequest('/api/scenarios/supply-chain-crisis/execute', 'POST', scenarioResponse);
      
      toast({
        title: "Scenario Successfully Configured",
        description: `Supply Chain Crisis scenario ready for execution with ${completionProgress}% completion.`,
      });

        generateScenarioResults(scenarioResponse);

    // Intelligence algorithm based on decisions and organizational context

    // Adjust based on emergency sourcing strategy
    if (data.executiveDecisions.emergencySourcing === 'Immediate - Any Cost') {
      baseImprovement += 50; // Aggressive response bonus
    } else if (data.executiveDecisions.emergencySourcing === 'Strategic - Long-term Focus') {
      baseImprovement += 100; // Strategic thinking bonus
    }
    
    // Adjust based on team mobilization
    if (data.executiveDecisions.teamMobilization === 'Full War Room - 24/7') {
      baseImprovement += 75; // Full engagement bonus
    }
    
    // Scale by organization size (larger orgs see bigger absolute gains)
    if (data.organizationProfile.size > 1000) {
      baseImprovement += 25;
    }
    
    return Math.min(baseImprovement, 500); // Cap at 500%
  };

  const calculateTimelineReduction = (data: any): number => {
    // Calculate speed improvement based on decisions
    let baseReduction = 85; // Base 85% faster (6 months to 3 weeks)
    
    if (data.executiveDecisions.stakeholderNotification === 'Immediate - Next 2 Hours') {

                      <div className="flex items-center space-x-2">
                        <Target className="h-4 w-4" />
                        <span>Decisions</span>

                          <CheckCircle2 className="h-3 w-3 text-green-500" />

                      <div className="flex items-center space-x-2">

                  {/* Tab 1: Organizational Context */}
                  <TabsContent value="context" className="space-y-6">
                    <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 gap-6">
                      <FormField

                            <FormLabel className="flex items-center space-x-2">
```
