## FILE: client/src/components/ScenarioPlanningEngine.tsx
```
import { useState, useCallback, useMemo } from 'react';
import { Card, CardContent, CardDescription, CardHeader, CardTitle } from '@/components/ui/card';
import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button';
import { Input } from '@/components/ui/input';
import { Label } from '@/components/ui/label';
import { Textarea } from '@/components/ui/textarea';
import { Select, SelectContent, SelectItem, SelectTrigger, SelectValue } from '@/components/ui/select';
import { Badge } from '@/components/ui/badge';
import { Tabs, TabsContent, TabsList, TabsTrigger } from '@/components/ui/tabs';
import { Separator } from '@/components/ui/separator';
import { Progress } from '@/components/ui/progress';
import { Slider } from '@/components/ui/slider';
import { 
  Target, 
  TrendingUp, 
  TrendingDown,
  Calculator,
  Lightbulb,
  AlertTriangle,
  CheckCircle,
  Clock,
  DollarSign,
  Users,
  Calendar,
  BarChart3,
  LineChart,
  PieChart,
  Activity,
  Zap,
  Settings,
  Play,
  RefreshCw,
  Save,
  Download,
  Share
} from 'lucide-react';

interface ScenarioVariable {
  id: string;
  name: string;
  type: 'percentage' | 'number' | 'currency' | 'time';
  currentValue: number;
  minValue: number;
  maxValue: number;
  step: number;
  unit: string;
  description: string;
}

interface ScenarioOutcome {
  metric: string;
  currentValue: number;
  projectedValue: number;
  change: number;
  changePercent: number;
  impact: 'positive' | 'negative' | 'neutral';
  confidence: number;
}

interface ScenarioModel {
  id: string;
  name: string;
  description: string;
  variables: ScenarioVariable[];
  outcomes: ScenarioOutcome[];
  recommendations: string[];
  confidenceLevel: number;
  lastCalculated: Date;
}

export function ScenarioPlanningEngine() {
  const [activeTab, setActiveTab] = useState('builder');
  const [scenarios, setScenarios] = useState<ScenarioModel[]>([]);
  const [currentScenario, setCurrentScenario] = useState<ScenarioModel | null>(null);
  const [isCalculating, setIsCalculating] = useState(false);

  // Default scenario variables for demonstration
  const defaultVariables: ScenarioVariable[] = [
    {
      id: 'team_size',
      name: 'Team Size',
      type: 'number',
      currentValue: 50,
      minValue: 30,
      maxValue: 100,
      step: 5,
      unit: 'people',
      description: 'Number of team members assigned to the project'
    },
    {
      id: 'budget_change',
      name: 'Budget Adjustment',
      type: 'percentage',
      currentValue: 0,
      minValue: -50,
      maxValue: 50,
      step: 5,
      unit: '%',
      description: 'Percentage change in project budget'
    },
    {
      id: 'timeline_compression',
      name: 'Timeline Compression',
      type: 'percentage',
      currentValue: 0,
      minValue: -30,
      maxValue: 30,
      step: 5,
      unit: '%',
      description: 'Percentage change in project timeline'
    },
    {
      id: 'efficiency_improvement',
      name: 'Process Efficiency',
      type: 'percentage',
      currentValue: 100,
      minValue: 80,
      maxValue: 150,
      step: 5,
      unit: '%',
      description: 'Team productivity and process efficiency factor'
    },
    {
      id: 'external_risks',
      name: 'External Risk Factor',
      type: 'percentage',
      currentValue: 10,
      minValue: 0,
      maxValue: 50,
      step: 5,
      unit: '%',
      description: 'Probability of external disruptions affecting the project'
    }
  ];

  const calculateScenarioOutcomes = useCallback((variables: ScenarioVariable[]): ScenarioOutcome[] => {
    const teamSize = variables.find(v => v.id === 'team_size')?.currentValue || 50;
    const budgetChange = variables.find(v => v.id === 'budget_change')?.currentValue || 0;
    const timelineChange = variables.find(v => v.id === 'timeline_compression')?.currentValue || 0;
    const efficiency = variables.find(v => v.id === 'efficiency_improvement')?.currentValue || 100;
    const riskFactor = variables.find(v => v.id === 'external_risks')?.currentValue || 10;

    // Baseline metrics
    const baselineBudget = 500000;
    const baselineTimeline = 120; // days
    const baselineProductivity = 100;
    const baselineQuality = 95;
    const baselineRisk = 15;

    // Calculate impacts
    const budgetMultiplier = 1 + (budgetChange / 100);
    const timelineMultiplier = 1 - (timelineChange / 100);
    const efficiencyMultiplier = efficiency / 100;
    const riskMultiplier = 1 + (riskFactor / 100);

    // Team size impact on productivity (diminishing returns)
    const teamSizeEffect = teamSize <= 50 ? teamSize / 50 : 1 + Math.log(teamSize / 50) * 0.2;

    const outcomes: ScenarioOutcome[] = [
      {
        metric: 'Project Budget',
        currentValue: baselineBudget,
        projectedValue: baselineBudget * budgetMultiplier * (teamSize / 50),
        change: 0,
        changePercent: 0,
        impact: 'neutral',
        confidence: 85
      },
      {
        metric: 'Timeline (Days)',
        currentValue: baselineTimeline,
        projectedValue: baselineTimeline * timelineMultiplier / teamSizeEffect / efficiencyMultiplier,
        change: 0,
        changePercent: 0,
        impact: 'neutral',
        confidence: 78
      },
      {
        metric: 'Team Productivity',
        currentValue: baselineProductivity,
        projectedValue: baselineProductivity * efficiencyMultiplier * teamSizeEffect * (1 - riskFactor / 200),
        change: 0,
        changePercent: 0,
        impact: 'neutral',
        confidence: 72
      },
      {
        metric: 'Quality Score',
        currentValue: baselineQuality,
        projectedValue: baselineQuality * (1 - Math.abs(timelineChange) / 200) * (efficiencyMultiplier * 0.5 + 0.5),
        change: 0,
        changePercent: 0,
        impact: 'neutral',
        confidence: 80
      },
      {
        metric: 'Risk Level',
        currentValue: baselineRisk,
        projectedValue: baselineRisk * riskMultiplier * (1 + Math.abs(timelineChange) / 100),
        change: 0,
        changePercent: 0,
        impact: 'neutral',
        confidence: 65
      }
    ];

    // Calculate changes and impact
    return outcomes.map(outcome => {
      const change = outcome.projectedValue - outcome.currentValue;
      const changePercent = (change / outcome.currentValue) * 100;
      let impact: 'positive' | 'negative' | 'neutral' = 'neutral';

      // Determine impact based on metric type and change direction
      if (outcome.metric === 'Risk Level') {
        impact = change < 0 ? 'positive' : change > 0 ? 'negative' : 'neutral';
      } else if (outcome.metric === 'Timeline (Days)') {
        impact = change < 0 ? 'positive' : change > 0 ? 'negative' : 'neutral';
      } else {
        impact = change > 0 ? 'positive' : change < 0 ? 'negative' : 'neutral';
      }

      return {
        ...outcome,
        change,
        changePercent,
        impact
      };
    });
  }, []);

  const generateRecommendations = useCallback((outcomes: ScenarioOutcome[]): string[] => {
    const recommendations: string[] = [];
    
    const budgetOutcome = outcomes.find(o => o.metric === 'Project Budget');
    const timelineOutcome = outcomes.find(o => o.metric === 'Timeline (Days)');
    const productivityOutcome = outcomes.find(o => o.metric === 'Team Productivity');
    const qualityOutcome = outcomes.find(o => o.metric === 'Quality Score');
    const riskOutcome = outcomes.find(o => o.metric === 'Risk Level');

    if (budgetOutcome && budgetOutcome.changePercent > 20) {
      recommendations.push("Consider budget reallocation or additional funding approval for this scenario");
    }

    if (timelineOutcome && timelineOutcome.changePercent > 15) {
      recommendations.push("Timeline extension may be necessary - communicate early with stakeholders");
    }

    if (productivityOutcome && productivityOutcome.changePercent < -10) {
      recommendations.push("Implement productivity enhancement measures: training, tools, or process optimization");
    }

    if (qualityOutcome && qualityOutcome.changePercent < -5) {
      recommendations.push("Additional QA resources and testing time should be allocated to maintain quality standards");
    }

    if (riskOutcome && riskOutcome.changePercent > 25) {
      recommendations.push("Develop comprehensive risk mitigation strategies and contingency plans");
    }

    // Positive recommendations
    if (productivityOutcome && productivityOutcome.changePercent > 15) {
      recommendations.push("High productivity scenario - consider expanding project scope or accelerating timeline");
    }

    if (recommendations.length === 0) {
      recommendations.push("Scenario appears well-balanced with manageable impacts across all metrics");
    }

    return recommendations;
  }, []);

  const createNewScenario = useCallback(() => {
    const newScenario: ScenarioModel = {
      id: Math.random().toString(36).substr(2, 9),
      name: `Scenario ${scenarios.length + 1}`,
      description: 'New scenario analysis',
      variables: [...defaultVariables],
      outcomes: [],
      recommendations: [],
      confidenceLevel: 75,
      lastCalculated: new Date()
    };
    
    const outcomes = calculateScenarioOutcomes(newScenario.variables);
    newScenario.outcomes = outcomes;
    newScenario.recommendations = generateRecommendations(outcomes);
    
    setScenarios([...scenarios, newScenario]);
    setCurrentScenario(newScenario);
  }, [scenarios, calculateScenarioOutcomes, generateRecommendations]);

  const updateVariable = useCallback((variableId: string, newValue: number) => {
    if (!currentScenario) return;

    const updatedVariables = currentScenario.variables.map(v =>
      v.id === variableId ? { ...v, currentValue: newValue } : v
    );

    const outcomes = calculateScenarioOutcomes(updatedVariables);
    const recommendations = generateRecommendations(outcomes);

    const updatedScenario = {
      ...currentScenario,
      variables: updatedVariables,
      outcomes,
      recommendations,
      lastCalculated: new Date()
    };

    setCurrentScenario(updatedScenario);
    setScenarios(scenarios.map(s => s.id === currentScenario.id ? updatedScenario : s));
  }, [currentScenario, scenarios, calculateScenarioOutcomes, generateRecommendations]);

  const runCalculation = useCallback(async () => {
    if (!currentScenario) return;

    setIsCalculating(true);
    
    // Simulate calculation delay
    await new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, 1500));
    
    const outcomes = calculateScenarioOutcomes(currentScenario.variables);
    const recommendations = generateRecommendations(outcomes);
    
    const updatedScenario = {
      ...currentScenario,
      outcomes,
      recommendations,
      lastCalculated: new Date()
    };

    setCurrentScenario(updatedScenario);
    setScenarios(scenarios.map(s => s.id === currentScenario.id ? updatedScenario : s));
    setIsCalculating(false);
  }, [currentScenario, scenarios, calculateScenarioOutcomes, generateRecommendations]);

  const getImpactColor = (impact: string) => {
    switch (impact) {
      case 'positive': return 'text-green-600 bg-green-50';
      case 'negative': return 'text-red-600 bg-red-50';
      default: return 'text-gray-600 bg-gray-50';
    }
  };

  const getChangeIcon = (impact: string) => {
    switch (impact) {
      case 'positive': return <TrendingUp className="w-4 h-4" />;
      case 'negative': return <TrendingDown className="w-4 h-4" />;
      default: return <Activity className="w-4 h-4" />;
    }
  };

  const formatValue = (value: number, type: string, unit: string) => {
    if (type === 'currency') {
      return `$${value.toLocaleString()}`;
    } else if (type === 'percentage') {
      return `${value.toFixed(1)}${unit}`;
    } else {
      return `${Math.round(value)}${unit ? ` ${unit}` : ''}`;
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="min-h-screen bg-gradient-to-br from-violet-50 via-white to-purple-50 p-6">
      <div className="max-w-7xl mx-auto">
        {/* Header */}
        <div className="mb-8">
          <h1 className="text-4xl font-bold text-gray-900 mb-2">
            Scenario Planning Engine
          </h1>
          <p className="text-lg text-gray-600">
            Advanced "what-if" modeling for strategic decision making and organizational agility
          </p>
        </div>

        {/* Stats Overview */}
        <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-4 gap-6 mb-8">
          <Card className="bg-white/70 backdrop-blur-sm border-0 shadow-lg">
            <CardContent className="p-6">
              <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                <div>
                  <p className="text-sm font-medium text-gray-600">Active Scenarios</p>
                  <p className="text-2xl font-bold text-gray-900">{scenarios.length}</p>
                </div>
                <Target className="w-8 h-8 text-purple-600" />
              </div>
            </CardContent>
          </Card>

          <Card className="bg-white/70 backdrop-blur-sm border-0 shadow-lg">
            <CardContent className="p-6">
              <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                <div>
                  <p className="text-sm font-medium text-gray-600">Variables Modeled</p>
                  <p className="text-2xl font-bold text-gray-900">{currentScenario?.variables.length || 0}</p>
                </div>
                <Settings className="w-8 h-8 text-blue-600" />
              </div>
            </CardContent>
          </Card>

          <Card className="bg-white/70 backdrop-blur-sm border-0 shadow-lg">
            <CardContent className="p-6">
              <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                <div>
                  <p className="text-sm font-medium text-gray-600">Confidence Level</p>
                  <p className="text-2xl font-bold text-gray-900">{currentScenario?.confidenceLevel || 0}%</p>
                </div>
                <Calculator className="w-8 h-8 text-green-600" />
              </div>
            </CardContent>
          </Card>

          <Card className="bg-white/70 backdrop-blur-sm border-0 shadow-lg">
            <CardContent className="p-6">
              <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                <div>
                  <p className="text-sm font-medium text-gray-600">Last Updated</p>
                  <p className="text-2xl font-bold text-gray-900">
                    {currentScenario ? 'Now' : '--'}
                  </p>
                </div>
                <Clock className="w-8 h-8 text-indigo-600" />
              </div>
            </CardContent>
          </Card>
        </div>

        {/* Main Interface */}
        <Card className="bg-white/80 backdrop-blur-sm border-0 shadow-xl">
          <CardHeader>
            <div className="flex justify-between items-start">
              <div>
                <CardTitle className="flex items-center gap-2">
                  <Calculator className="w-6 h-6 text-purple-600" />
                  What-If Scenario Modeling
                </CardTitle>
                <CardDescription>
                  Model different scenarios to understand potential outcomes and make data-driven decisions
                </CardDescription>
              </div>
              <div className="flex gap-2">
                <Button onClick={createNewScenario} className="bg-purple-600 hover:bg-purple-700">
                  <Target className="w-4 h-4 mr-2" />
                  New Scenario
                </Button>
                {currentScenario && (
                  <Button 
                    onClick={runCalculation} 
                    disabled={isCalculating}
                    className="bg-green-600 hover:bg-green-700"
                  >
                    {isCalculating ? (
                      <RefreshCw className="w-4 h-4 mr-2 animate-spin" />
                    ) : (
                      <Play className="w-4 h-4 mr-2" />
                    )}
                    {isCalculating ? 'Calculating...' : 'Run Analysis'}
                  </Button>
                )}
              </div>
            </div>
          </CardHeader>

          <CardContent>
            {!currentScenario ? (
              <div className="text-center py-12">
                <Target className="w-16 h-16 text-gray-400 mx-auto mb-4" />
                <h3 className="text-xl font-semibold text-gray-900 mb-2">No Active Scenario</h3>
                <p className="text-gray-600 mb-6">
                  Create your first scenario to start modeling different organizational outcomes
                </p>
                <Button onClick={createNewScenario} className="bg-purple-600 hover:bg-purple-700">
                  <Target className="w-4 h-4 mr-2" />
                  Create First Scenario
                </Button>
              </div>
            ) : (
              <Tabs value={activeTab} onValueChange={setActiveTab}>
                <TabsList className="grid w-full grid-cols-3">
                  <TabsTrigger value="builder" className="flex items-center gap-2">
                    <Settings className="w-4 h-4" />
                    Scenario Builder
                  </TabsTrigger>
                  <TabsTrigger value="outcomes" className="flex items-center gap-2">
                    <BarChart3 className="w-4 h-4" />
                    Outcomes Analysis
                  </TabsTrigger>
                  <TabsTrigger value="recommendations" className="flex items-center gap-2">
                    <Lightbulb className="w-4 h-4" />
                    Recommendations
                  </TabsTrigger>
                </TabsList>

                {/* Scenario Builder Tab */}
                <TabsContent value="builder" className="space-y-6">
                  <div className="grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-2 gap-6">
                    {/* Scenario Info */}
                    <Card>
                      <CardHeader>
                        <CardTitle className="text-lg">Scenario Configuration</CardTitle>
                        <CardDescription>
                          Define the parameters and variables for your scenario analysis
                        </CardDescription>
                      </CardHeader>
                      <CardContent className="space-y-4">
                        <div>
                          <Label htmlFor="scenarioName">Scenario Name</Label>
                          <Input
                            id="scenarioName"
                            value={currentScenario.name}
                            onChange={(e) => {
                              const updated = {...currentScenario, name: e.target.value};
                              setCurrentScenario(updated);
                              setScenarios(scenarios.map(s => s.id === currentScenario.id ? updated : s));
                            }}
                            placeholder="Q4 Resource Optimization"
                          />
                        </div>
                        <div>
                          <Label htmlFor="scenarioDescription">Description</Label>
                          <Textarea
                            id="scenarioDescription"
                            value={currentScenario.description}
                            onChange={(e) => {
                              const updated = {...currentScenario, description: e.target.value};
                              setCurrentScenario(updated);
                              setScenarios(scenarios.map(s => s.id === currentScenario.id ? updated : s));
                            }}
                            placeholder="Analyze the impact of different resource allocation strategies for Q4 objectives..."
                          />
                        </div>
                        <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                          <span className="text-sm font-medium">Confidence Level</span>
                          <Badge className="bg-blue-100 text-blue-800">
                            {currentScenario.confidenceLevel}%
                          </Badge>
                        </div>
                        <Progress value={currentScenario.confidenceLevel} className="h-2" />
                      </CardContent>
                    </Card>

                    {/* Variable Controls */}
                    <Card>
                      <CardHeader>
                        <CardTitle className="text-lg">Scenario Variables</CardTitle>
                        <CardDescription>
                          Adjust the variables to model different scenarios
                        </CardDescription>
                      </CardHeader>
                      <CardContent className="space-y-6">
                        {currentScenario.variables.map((variable) => (
                          <div key={variable.id} className="space-y-3">
                            <div className="flex justify-between items-center">
                              <Label className="font-medium">{variable.name}</Label>
                              <Badge variant="outline">
                                {formatValue(variable.currentValue, variable.type, variable.unit)}
                              </Badge>
                            </div>
                            <Slider
                              value={[variable.currentValue]}
                              onValueChange={(value) => updateVariable(variable.id, value[0])}
                              min={variable.minValue}
                              max={variable.maxValue}
                              step={variable.step}
                              className="w-full"
                            />
                            <p className="text-sm text-gray-600">{variable.description}</p>
                          </div>
                        ))}
                      </CardContent>
                    </Card>
                  </div>
                </TabsContent>

                {/* Outcomes Analysis Tab */}
                <TabsContent value="outcomes" className="space-y-6">
                  <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-6">
                    {currentScenario.outcomes.map((outcome) => (
                      <Card key={outcome.metric} className="relative overflow-hidden">
                        <CardContent className="p-6">
                          <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-4">
                            <h3 className="font-semibold text-gray-900">{outcome.metric}</h3>
                            <div className={`p-2 rounded-full ${getImpactColor(outcome.impact)}`}>
                              {getChangeIcon(outcome.impact)}
                            </div>
                          </div>
                          
                          <div className="space-y-3">
                            <div>
                              <p className="text-sm text-gray-600">Current</p>
                              <p className="text-lg font-bold text-gray-900">
                                {formatValue(outcome.currentValue, outcome.metric.includes('Budget') ? 'currency' : 'number', 
                                  outcome.metric.includes('Timeline') ? 'days' : 
                                  outcome.metric.includes('Score') || outcome.metric.includes('Productivity') ? '%' : 
                                  outcome.metric.includes('Risk') ? '%' : '')}
                              </p>
                            </div>
                            
                            <div>
                              <p className="text-sm text-gray-600">Projected</p>
                              <p className="text-lg font-bold text-gray-900">
                                {formatValue(outcome.projectedValue, outcome.metric.includes('Budget') ? 'currency' : 'number',
                                  outcome.metric.includes('Timeline') ? 'days' : 
                                  outcome.metric.includes('Score') || outcome.metric.includes('Productivity') ? '%' : 
                                  outcome.metric.includes('Risk') ? '%' : '')}
                              </p>
                            </div>

                            <div className={`p-3 rounded-lg ${getImpactColor(outcome.impact)}`}>
                              <p className="text-sm font-medium">
                                {outcome.changePercent > 0 ? '+' : ''}{outcome.changePercent.toFixed(1)}% change
                              </p>
                              <p className="text-xs">
                                Confidence: {outcome.confidence}%
                              </p>
                            </div>
                          </div>
                        </CardContent>
                      </Card>
                    ))}
                  </div>

                  {/* Summary Chart Placeholder */}
                  <Card>
                    <CardHeader>
                      <CardTitle className="text-lg">Impact Summary</CardTitle>
                      <CardDescription>
                        Visual representation of scenario impacts across all metrics
                      </CardDescription>
                    </CardHeader>
                    <CardContent>
                      <div className="h-64 bg-gradient-to-br from-purple-50 to-indigo-50 rounded-lg flex items-center justify-center">
                        <div className="text-center">
                          <BarChart3 className="w-16 h-16 text-purple-400 mx-auto mb-4" />
                          <p className="text-lg font-semibold text-purple-700">Interactive Chart</p>
                          <p className="text-purple-600">Comprehensive impact visualization</p>
                        </div>
                      </div>
                    </CardContent>
                  </Card>
                </TabsContent>

                {/* Recommendations Tab */}
                <TabsContent value="recommendations" className="space-y-6">
                  <div className="grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-2 gap-6">
                    <Card>
                      <CardHeader>
                        <CardTitle className="text-lg flex items-center gap-2">
                          <Lightbulb className="w-5 h-5 text-yellow-600" />
                          Strategic Recommendations
                        </CardTitle>
                        <CardDescription>
                          AI-powered insights based on scenario analysis
                        </CardDescription>
                      </CardHeader>
                      <CardContent>
                        <div className="space-y-4">
                          {currentScenario.recommendations.map((recommendation, index) => (
                            <div key={index} className="flex items-start gap-3 p-4 bg-yellow-50 rounded-lg border-l-4 border-yellow-400">
                              <CheckCircle className="w-5 h-5 text-yellow-600 mt-0.5 flex-shrink-0" />
                              <p className="text-sm text-yellow-800">{recommendation}</p>
                            </div>
                          ))}
                        </div>
                      </CardContent>
                    </Card>

                    <Card>
                      <CardHeader>
                        <CardTitle className="text-lg flex items-center gap-2">
                          <AlertTriangle className="w-5 h-5 text-orange-600" />
                          Risk Assessment
                        </CardTitle>
                        <CardDescription>
                          Potential risks and mitigation strategies
                        </CardDescription>
                      </CardHeader>
                      <CardContent>
                        <div className="space-y-4">
                          <div className="p-4 bg-orange-50 rounded-lg border-l-4 border-orange-400">
                            <h4 className="font-semibold text-orange-800 mb-2">Resource Constraints</h4>
                            <p className="text-sm text-orange-700">
                              Monitor team capacity and workload distribution to prevent burnout
                            </p>
                          </div>
                          <div className="p-4 bg-red-50 rounded-lg border-l-4 border-red-400">
                            <h4 className="font-semibold text-red-800 mb-2">Timeline Pressure</h4>
                            <p className="text-sm text-red-700">
                              Compressed timelines may impact quality - implement continuous testing
                            </p>
                          </div>
                          <div className="p-4 bg-blue-50 rounded-lg border-l-4 border-blue-400">
                            <h4 className="font-semibold text-blue-800 mb-2">External Dependencies</h4>
                            <p className="text-sm text-blue-700">
                              Monitor external factors that could impact project delivery
                            </p>
                          </div>
                        </div>
                      </CardContent>
                    </Card>
                  </div>

                  {/* Action Items */}
                  <Card>
                    <CardHeader>
                      <CardTitle className="text-lg">Next Steps</CardTitle>
                      <CardDescription>
                        Recommended actions based on scenario analysis
                      </CardDescription>
                    </CardHeader>
                    <CardContent>
                      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 gap-4">
                        <Button className="justify-start h-auto p-4" variant="outline">
                          <Save className="w-5 h-5 mr-3" />
                          <div className="text-left">
                            <p className="font-semibold">Save Scenario</p>
                            <p className="text-sm text-gray-600">Archive for future reference</p>
                          </div>
                        </Button>
                        <Button className="justify-start h-auto p-4" variant="outline">
                          <Share className="w-5 h-5 mr-3" />
                          <div className="text-left">
                            <p className="font-semibold">Share with Team</p>
                            <p className="text-sm text-gray-600">Collaborate on planning</p>
                          </div>
                        </Button>
                        <Button className="justify-start h-auto p-4" variant="outline">
                          <Download className="w-5 h-5 mr-3" />
                          <div className="text-left">
                            <p className="font-semibold">Export Report</p>
                            <p className="text-sm text-gray-600">Generate executive summary</p>
                          </div>
                        </Button>
                        <Button className="justify-start h-auto p-4" variant="outline">
                          <RefreshCw className="w-5 h-5 mr-3" />
                          <div className="text-left">
                            <p className="font-semibold">Update Model</p>
                            <p className="text-sm text-gray-600">Refine with new data</p>
                          </div>
                        </Button>
                      </div>
                    </CardContent>
                  </Card>
                </TabsContent>
              </Tabs>
            )}
          </CardContent>
        </Card>

        {/* Scenario Library */}
        {scenarios.length > 0 && (
          <Card className="mt-8 bg-white/80 backdrop-blur-sm border-0 shadow-xl">
            <CardHeader>
              <CardTitle>Scenario Library</CardTitle>
              <CardDescription>
                Previously created scenarios and analyses
              </CardDescription>
            </CardHeader>
            <CardContent>
              <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-4">
                {scenarios.map((scenario) => (
                  <Card 
                    key={scenario.id} 
                    className={`cursor-pointer transition-all hover:shadow-lg ${
                      currentScenario?.id === scenario.id ? 'ring-2 ring-purple-500' : ''
                    }`}
                    onClick={() => setCurrentScenario(scenario)}
                  >
                    <CardContent className="p-4">
                      <h3 className="font-semibold mb-2">{scenario.name}</h3>
                      <p className="text-sm text-gray-600 mb-3 line-clamp-2">{scenario.description}</p>
                      <div className="flex justify-between items-center text-xs text-gray-500">
                        <span>Confidence: {scenario.confidenceLevel}%</span>
                        <span>{scenario.lastCalculated.toLocaleDateString()}</span>
                      </div>
                    </CardContent>
                  </Card>
                ))}
              </div>
            </CardContent>
          </Card>
        )}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

export default ScenarioPlanningEngine;
```

## FILE: client/src/components/ScenarioTemplateManager.tsx
```
import { useState } from "react";
import { Card, CardContent, CardDescription, CardHeader, CardTitle } from "@/components/ui/card";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { Badge } from "@/components/ui/badge";
import { Tabs, TabsContent, TabsList, TabsTrigger } from "@/components/ui/tabs";
import { Input } from "@/components/ui/input";
import { Label } from "@/components/ui/label";
import { Textarea } from "@/components/ui/textarea";
import { Select, SelectContent, SelectItem, SelectTrigger, SelectValue } from "@/components/ui/select";
import { 
  Plus, 
  Save, 
  Copy, 
  Download, 
  Upload,
  Settings,
  Brain,
  Target,
  Zap,
  Users,
  Shield,
  TrendingUp,
  CheckCircle,
  DollarSign
} from "lucide-react";
import { useToast } from "@/hooks/use-toast";

interface ScenarioTemplate {
  id: string;
  name: string;
  description: string;
  category: string;
  difficulty: 'Beginner' | 'Intermediate' | 'Advanced';
  preset: {
    revenue: number;
    costs: number;
    growth: number;
    risk: number;
  };
  expectedOutcome: string;
  useCase: string;
  isCustom?: boolean;
  additionalMetrics?: Record<string, number>;
}

interface ScenarioTemplateManagerProps {
  onCreateTemplate: (template: ScenarioTemplate) => void;
  onUpdateTemplate: (id: string, template: ScenarioTemplate) => void;
  existingTemplates: ScenarioTemplate[];
}

export default function ScenarioTemplateManager({ 
  onCreateTemplate, 
  onUpdateTemplate, 
  existingTemplates 
}: ScenarioTemplateManagerProps) {
  const { toast } = useToast();
  const [isCreating, setIsCreating] = useState(false);
  const [editingTemplate, setEditingTemplate] = useState<ScenarioTemplate | null>(null);
  
  const [newTemplate, setNewTemplate] = useState<Partial<ScenarioTemplate>>({
    name: '',
    description: '',
    category: '',
    difficulty: 'Intermediate',
    preset: {
      revenue: 100,
      costs: 80,
      growth: 15,
      risk: 25
    },
    expectedOutcome: '',
    useCase: '',
    isCustom: true
  });

  const categoryIcons = {
    'Growth Strategy': TrendingUp,
    'Operations': Settings,
    'Technology': Zap,
    'Innovation': Brain,
    'Risk Management': Shield,
    'HR Strategy': Users,
    'ESG Strategy': CheckCircle,
    'Balanced Strategy': Target,
    'All-in-One': DollarSign
  };

  const handleCreateTemplate = () => {
    if (!newTemplate.name || !newTemplate.description) {
      toast({
        title: "Missing Information",
        description: "Please provide template name and description",
        variant: "destructive"
      });
      return;
    }

    const template: ScenarioTemplate = {
      id: `custom-${Date.now()}`,
      name: newTemplate.name!,
      description: newTemplate.description!,
      category: newTemplate.category || 'Custom',
      difficulty: newTemplate.difficulty!,
      preset: newTemplate.preset!,
      expectedOutcome: newTemplate.expectedOutcome!,
      useCase: newTemplate.useCase!,
      isCustom: true
    };

    onCreateTemplate(template);
    toast({
      title: "Template Created",
      description: `${template.name} template has been created successfully`
    });

    // Reset form
    setNewTemplate({
      name: '',
      description: '',
      category: '',
      difficulty: 'Intermediate',
      preset: {
        revenue: 100,
        costs: 80,
        growth: 15,
        risk: 25
      },
      expectedOutcome: '',
      useCase: '',
      isCustom: true
    });
    setIsCreating(false);
  };

  const handleExportTemplates = () => {
    const dataStr = JSON.stringify(existingTemplates, null, 2);
    const dataUri = 'data:application/json;charset=utf-8,'+ encodeURIComponent(dataStr);
    
    const exportFileDefaultName = `veridius-scenario-templates-${new Date().toISOString().split('T')[0]}.json`;
    
    const linkElement = document.createElement('a');
    linkElement.setAttribute('href', dataUri);
    linkElement.setAttribute('download', exportFileDefaultName);
    linkElement.click();

    toast({
      title: "Templates Exported",
      description: "Scenario templates have been downloaded successfully"
    });
  };

  const duplicateTemplate = (template: ScenarioTemplate) => {
    const duplicated: ScenarioTemplate = {
      ...template,
      id: `custom-${Date.now()}`,
      name: `${template.name} (Copy)`,
      isCustom: true
    };
    
    onCreateTemplate(duplicated);
    toast({
      title: "Template Duplicated",
      description: `${duplicated.name} has been created`
    });
  };

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6">
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
        <div>
          <h2 className="text-2xl font-bold">Scenario Template Manager</h2>
          <p className="text-muted-foreground">
            Create, customize, and manage scenario analysis templates for your organization
          </p>
        </div>
        <div className="flex gap-2">
          <Button variant="outline" onClick={handleExportTemplates}>
            <Download className="w-4 h-4 mr-2" />
            Export All
          </Button>
          <Button onClick={() => setIsCreating(true)}>
            <Plus className="w-4 h-4 mr-2" />
            New Template
          </Button>
        </div>
      </div>

      <Tabs defaultValue="existing" className="w-full">
        <TabsList>
          <TabsTrigger value="existing">Template Library</TabsTrigger>
          <TabsTrigger value="create">Create Custom</TabsTrigger>
          <TabsTrigger value="enterprise">Enterprise Integration</TabsTrigger>
        </TabsList>

        <TabsContent value="existing" className="space-y-4">
          <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-4">
            {existingTemplates.map((template) => {
              const IconComponent = categoryIcons[template.category as keyof typeof categoryIcons] || Target;
              
              return (
                <Card key={template.id} className="hover:shadow-lg transition-shadow">
                  <CardHeader className="pb-3">
                    <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                      <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                        <IconComponent className="w-5 h-5 text-primary" />
                        <div>
                          <CardTitle className="text-lg">{template.name}</CardTitle>
                          <Badge variant="secondary" className="text-xs">
                            {template.difficulty}
                          </Badge>
                        </div>
                      </div>
                      {template.isCustom && (
                        <Badge variant="outline">Custom</Badge>
                      )}
                    </div>
                  </CardHeader>
                  <CardContent className="space-y-3">
                    <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">{template.description}</p>
                    
                    <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-2 text-xs">
                      <div>Revenue: {template.preset.revenue}%</div>
                      <div>Costs: {template.preset.costs}%</div>
                      <div>Growth: {template.preset.growth}%</div>
                      <div>Risk: {template.preset.risk}%</div>
                    </div>

                    <div className="flex gap-2">
                      <Button 
                        size="sm" 
                        variant="outline" 
                        className="flex-1"
                        onClick={() => duplicateTemplate(template)}
                      >
                        <Copy className="w-3 h-3 mr-1" />
                        Duplicate
                      </Button>
                      {template.isCustom && (
                        <Button 
                          size="sm" 
                          variant="outline"
                          onClick={() => setEditingTemplate(template)}
                        >
                          <Settings className="w-3 h-3" />
                        </Button>
                      )}
                    </div>
                  </CardContent>
                </Card>
              );
            })}
          </div>
        </TabsContent>

        <TabsContent value="create" className="space-y-6">
          <Card>
            <CardHeader>
              <CardTitle>Create Custom Scenario Template</CardTitle>
              <CardDescription>
                Design specialized templates for your organization's unique analysis needs
              </CardDescription>
            </CardHeader>
            <CardContent className="space-y-4">

              </div>

              <div className="grid grid-cols-2 md:grid-cols-4 gap-4">
                <div className="space-y-2">
                  <Label>Revenue Impact (%)</Label>
                  <Input
                    type="number"
                    value={newTemplate.preset?.revenue}

                      preset: {...newTemplate.preset!, revenue: parseInt(e.target.value)}
                    })}
                  />
                </div>
                <div className="space-y-2">
                  <Label>Cost Impact (%)</Label>
                  <Input
                    type="number"
                    value={newTemplate.preset?.costs}
                    onChange={(e) => setNewTemplate({
                      ...newTemplate, 
                      preset: {...newTemplate.preset!, costs: parseInt(e.target.value)}
                    })}
                  />
                </div>
                <div className="space-y-2">
                  <Label>Growth Rate (%)</Label>
                  <Input
                    type="number"
                    value={newTemplate.preset?.growth}
                    onChange={(e) => setNewTemplate({
                      ...newTemplate, 
                      preset: {...newTemplate.preset!, growth: parseInt(e.target.value)}
                    })}
                  />
                </div>
                <div className="space-y-2">
                  <Label>Risk Level (%)</Label>
                  <Input
                    type="number"
                    value={newTemplate.preset?.risk}
                    onChange={(e) => setNewTemplate({
                      ...newTemplate, 
                      preset: {...newTemplate.preset!, risk: parseInt(e.target.value)}
                    })}
                  />
                </div>
              </div>

              <div className="space-y-2">
                <Label htmlFor="expected-outcome">Expected Outcome</Label>
                <Input
                  id="expected-outcome"
                  placeholder="e.g., 25-30% efficiency improvement with moderate risk"
                  value={newTemplate.expectedOutcome}

                />
              </div>

                <Input
                  id="use-case"
                  placeholder="e.g., Best for companies implementing agile methodologies"
                  value={newTemplate.useCase}
                  onChange={(e) => setNewTemplate({...newTemplate, useCase: e.target.value})}
                />
              </div>

              <Button onClick={handleCreateTemplate} className="w-full">
                <Save className="w-4 h-4 mr-2" />
                Create Template
              </Button>
            </CardContent>
          </Card>
        </TabsContent>

        <TabsContent value="enterprise" className="space-y-6">
          <Card>
            <CardHeader>

              <CardDescription>
                Advanced features for enterprise scenario template management
              </CardDescription>
            </CardHeader>
            <CardContent className="space-y-6">
              <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 gap-6">
                <div className="space-y-4">
                  <h3 className="font-semibold">Cross-Scenario Dependencies</h3>

                  </p>
                  <Button variant="outline" className="w-full">
                    <Settings className="w-4 h-4 mr-2" />
                    Configure Dependencies
                  </Button>
                </div>
                
                <div className="space-y-4">
                  <h3 className="font-semibold">Initiative Integration</h3>
                  <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">
                    Auto-generate initiatives from scenario analysis results
                  </p>
                  <Button variant="outline" className="w-full">

                    Setup Integration
                  </Button>
                </div>
              </div>

              <div className="border-t pt-6">
                <h3 className="font-semibold mb-4">Template Import/Export</h3>
                <div className="flex gap-4">
                  <Button variant="outline">
                    <Upload className="w-4 h-4 mr-2" />
                    Import Templates
                  </Button>
                  <Button variant="outline" onClick={handleExportTemplates}>
                    <Download className="w-4 h-4 mr-2" />
                    Export to JSON
                  </Button>
                </div>
              </div>
            </CardContent>
          </Card>
        </TabsContent>
      </Tabs>
    </div>
  );
}

  const [filteredTemplates, setFilteredTemplates] = useState<ScenarioTemplate[]>(COMPREHENSIVE_TEMPLATES);
  const [searchTerm, setSearchTerm] = useState('');
  const [selectedCategory, setSelectedCategory] = useState<string>('');
  const [selectedComplexity, setSelectedComplexity] = useState<string>('');

  useEffect(() => {
    let filtered = templates;
    
    if (searchTerm) {
      filtered = filtered.filter(template => 
        template.name.toLowerCase().includes(searchTerm.toLowerCase()) ||
        template.description.toLowerCase().includes(searchTerm.toLowerCase())
      );
    }
    
    if (selectedCategory) {
      filtered = filtered.filter(template => template.category === selectedCategory);
    }
    
    if (selectedComplexity) {
      filtered = filtered.filter(template => template.complexity === selectedComplexity);
    }
    
    setFilteredTemplates(filtered);
  }, [templates, searchTerm, selectedCategory, selectedComplexity]);

  const handleTemplateSelect = (template: ScenarioTemplate) => {
    if (template.isImplemented) {
      // Navigate to scenario builder with this template
      console.log('Launching template:', template.id);
    } else {
      // Show implementation needed message
      console.log('Template not yet implemented:', template.id);
    }

    };
    return colors[complexity] || 'bg-gray-500';

      'Strategic Opportunity': 'bg-green-500/20 text-green-400',
      'Operational Excellence': 'bg-blue-500/20 text-blue-400'

                  </VeridiusButton>
                </div>
              </CardContent>
            </Card>
          );
        })}
      </div>

      {filteredTemplates.length === 0 && (
        <VeridiusCard>
          <div className="p-8 text-center">
            <Filter className="w-16 h-16 text-gray-600 mx-auto mb-4" />
            <h3 className="text-xl text-white font-semibold mb-2">No Templates Found</h3>
            <p className="text-gray-400 mb-6">Try adjusting your search criteria or filters</p>
            <VeridiusButton variant="outline" onClick={() => {
              setSearchTerm('');
              setSelectedCategory('');
              setSelectedComplexity('');
            }}>
              Clear All Filters
            </VeridiusButton>
          </div>
        </VeridiusCard>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}
```

  // Filter by scenario type first
  let templatesBasedOnType = allTemplates;

                  {selectedTemplate.name} - Complete Feature Set

                        ✓ {metric}
                      </div>

                  </h4>
                  <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 gap-3 mb-3">

                      <div className="font-medium text-red-700 dark:text-red-400 text-sm">Worst Case Scenario</div>

                        • Maximum impact<br/>
                        • Extended recovery<br/>
                        • Cascading effects
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                  <p className="text-xs text-blue-600 dark:text-blue-400">
                    AI generates probability-weighted analysis with specific financial impacts, timelines, resource requirements, and detailed mitigation strategies for each scenario path.
                  </p>
                </div>

                {/* Template Severity & Timeframe */}
                <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-4 pt-4 border-t">
                  <div>
                    <div className="text-sm font-medium text-gray-700 dark:text-gray-300">Severity Level</div>
                    <Badge className={getSeverityColor(selectedTemplate.severity)}>
                      {selectedTemplate.severity.toUpperCase()}
                    </Badge>
                  </div>
                  <div>
                    <div className="text-sm font-medium text-gray-700 dark:text-gray-300">Response Timeframe</div>
                    <div className="flex items-center gap-1 text-sm">
                      {getTimeframeIcon(selectedTemplate.timeframe)}
                      {selectedTemplate.timeframe}
                    </div>
                  </div>
                </div>

                <div className="flex gap-4 pt-4 border-t">
                  <Button 
                    onClick={() => onTemplateSelect(selectedTemplate)}
                    className="flex-1"
                  >
                    Use Complete Template ({selectedTemplate.dataFields.length} fields + What-If Analysis)
                  </Button>
                  <Button 
                    variant="outline" 
                    onClick={() => setSelectedTemplate(null)}
                  >
                    Close Details
                  </Button>
                </div>
              </CardContent>
            </Card>
          )}
        </CardContent>
      </Card>
    </div>
  );
}

## FILE: client/src/components/scenario-templates/ScenarioTemplateBuilder.tsx
```
import React, { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import { Card, CardContent, CardDescription, CardHeader, CardTitle } from '@/components/ui/card';
import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button';
import { Input } from '@/components/ui/input';
import { Textarea } from '@/components/ui/textarea';
import { Select, SelectContent, SelectItem, SelectTrigger, SelectValue } from '@/components/ui/select';
import { Badge } from '@/components/ui/badge';
import { Tabs, TabsContent, TabsList, TabsTrigger } from '@/components/ui/tabs';
import { Form, FormControl, FormField, FormItem, FormLabel, FormMessage } from '@/components/ui/form';
import { useForm } from 'react-hook-form';
import { zodResolver } from '@hookform/resolvers/zod';
import { z } from 'zod';
import {
  COMPREHENSIVE_SCENARIO_TEMPLATES
} from '@shared/comprehensive-scenario-templates';
import AIAnalysisEngine from '@/components/ai-intelligence/AIAnalysisEngine';
import {
  AlertTriangle, Shield, DollarSign, TrendingDown, FileText, 
  MapPin, Users, Zap, Package, UserX, Globe, Lightbulb, 
  Building, Cpu, Target, BarChart3, Calculator, 
  Play, Save, Download, Upload, Brain
} from 'lucide-react';

// All 6 comprehensive templates now available
const ALL_TEMPLATES = COMPREHENSIVE_SCENARIO_TEMPLATES;

const templateIcons = {
  'supply-chain': AlertTriangle,
  'security': Shield,
  'financial': DollarSign,
  'market': TrendingDown,
  'regulatory': FileText,
  'operational': Zap,
  'human-capital': Users,
  'technology': Cpu,
  'strategic': Target
};

const scenarioFormSchema = z.object({
  templateId: z.string().min(1, "Please select a template"),
  scenarioName: z.string().min(1, "Scenario name is required"),
  context: z.string().min(10, "Please provide more context"),
  urgency: z.enum(['low', 'medium', 'high', 'critical']),
  stakeholders: z.array(z.string()),
});

type ScenarioFormData = z.infer<typeof scenarioFormSchema>;

interface WhatIfScenario {
  id: string;
  name: string;
  description: string;
  assumptions: string[];
  outcomes: { metric: string; value: string; change: string }[];
  probability: number;
  impact: 'low' | 'medium' | 'high' | 'critical';
}

export default function ScenarioTemplateBuilder() {
  const [selectedTemplate, setSelectedTemplate] = useState<any>(null);
  const [activeTab, setActiveTab] = useState('templates');
  const [organizationContext, setOrganizationContext] = useState({
    industry: 'Technology',
    size: 'Enterprise',
    geography: 'North America',
    revenue: '$100M+'
  });
  const [scenarioData, setScenarioData] = useState<Record<string, any>>({});
  const [whatIfScenarios, setWhatIfScenarios] = useState<WhatIfScenario[]>([]);
  const [isGeneratingAnalysis, setIsGeneratingAnalysis] = useState(false);
  
  const form = useForm<ScenarioFormData>({
    resolver: zodResolver(scenarioFormSchema),
    defaultValues: {
      templateId: '',
      scenarioName: '',
      context: '',
      urgency: 'medium',
      stakeholders: [],
    },
  });

  const handleTemplateSelect = (template: any) => {
    setSelectedTemplate(template);
    form.setValue('templateId', template.id);
    setActiveTab('data-entry');
    
    // Initialize scenario data with default values
    const initialData: Record<string, any> = {};
    template.requiredDataPoints.forEach((field: any) => {
      initialData[field.fieldName] = field.fieldType === 'multiselect' ? [] : '';
    });
    setScenarioData(initialData);
  };

  const handleDataFieldChange = (fieldName: string, value: any) => {
    setScenarioData(prev => ({ ...prev, [fieldName]: value }));
  };

  const generateWhatIfScenarios = () => {
    if (!selectedTemplate) return;
    
    setIsGeneratingAnalysis(true);
    
    // Simulate AI-powered what-if scenario generation
    setTimeout(() => {
      const scenarios: WhatIfScenario[] = [
        {
          id: 'best-case',
          name: 'Best Case Scenario',
          description: 'Optimal conditions with all mitigation strategies successful',
          assumptions: [
            'All response teams execute perfectly',
            'External resources available immediately',
            'No additional complications arise',
            'Stakeholder cooperation at maximum'
          ],
          outcomes: [
            { metric: 'Resolution Time', value: '2 hours', change: '-75%' },
            { metric: 'Financial Impact', value: '$50K', change: '-80%' },
            { metric: 'Stakeholder Satisfaction', value: '95%', change: '+15%' },
            { metric: 'Business Continuity', value: '98%', change: '+8%' }
          ],
          probability: 15,
          impact: 'low'
        },
        {
          id: 'most-likely',
          name: 'Most Likely Scenario',
          description: 'Realistic outcome based on historical data and current capabilities',
          assumptions: [
            'Standard response protocols followed',
            'Normal resource availability',
            'Typical execution challenges',
            'Standard stakeholder engagement'
          ],
          outcomes: [
            { metric: 'Resolution Time', value: '6 hours', change: '-25%' },
            { metric: 'Financial Impact', value: '$180K', change: '-10%' },
            { metric: 'Stakeholder Satisfaction', value: '78%', change: '-5%' },
            { metric: 'Business Continuity', value: '85%', change: '-10%' }
          ],
          probability: 65,
          impact: 'medium'
        },
        {
          id: 'worst-case',
          name: 'Worst Case Scenario',
          description: 'Multiple complications with cascading failures',
          assumptions: [
            'Multiple response failures',
            'Limited resource availability',
            'Additional complications emerge',
            'Stakeholder resistance encountered'
          ],
          outcomes: [
            { metric: 'Resolution Time', value: '48 hours', change: '+500%' },
            { metric: 'Financial Impact', value: '$2.4M', change: '+1100%' },
            { metric: 'Stakeholder Satisfaction', value: '45%', change: '-40%' },
            { metric: 'Business Continuity', value: '60%', change: '-35%' }
          ],
          probability: 20,
          impact: 'critical'
        }
      ];
      
      setWhatIfScenarios(scenarios);
      setIsGeneratingAnalysis(false);
    }, 2000);
  };

  const renderDataField = (field: any) => {
    const value = scenarioData[field.fieldName] || '';
    
    switch (field.fieldType) {
      case 'select':
        return (
          <Select value={value} onValueChange={(val) => handleDataFieldChange(field.fieldName, val)}>
            <SelectTrigger>
              <SelectValue placeholder={`Select ${field.label.toLowerCase()}`} />
            </SelectTrigger>
            <SelectContent>
              {field.options.map((option: string) => (
                <SelectItem key={option} value={option}>{option}</SelectItem>
              ))}
            </SelectContent>
          </Select>
        );
      
      case 'multiselect':
        return (
          <div className="space-y-2">
            <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-2">
              {(value as string[]).map((item: string) => (
                <Badge key={item} variant="secondary">
                  {item}
                  <button 
                    onClick={() => handleDataFieldChange(field.fieldName, value.filter((v: string) => v !== item))}
                    className="ml-2 text-xs"
                  >
                    ×
                  </button>
                </Badge>
              ))}
            </div>
            <Select onValueChange={(val) => {
              if (!value.includes(val)) {
                handleDataFieldChange(field.fieldName, [...value, val]);
              }
            }}>
              <SelectTrigger>
                <SelectValue placeholder="Add option..." />
              </SelectTrigger>
              <SelectContent>
                {field.options.filter((opt: string) => !value.includes(opt)).map((option: string) => (
                  <SelectItem key={option} value={option}>{option}</SelectItem>
                ))}
              </SelectContent>
            </Select>
          </div>
        );
      
      case 'textarea':
        return (
          <Textarea
            value={value}
            onChange={(e) => handleDataFieldChange(field.fieldName, e.target.value)}
            placeholder={field.placeholder}
            rows={4}
          />
        );
      
      case 'currency':
        return (
          <div className="relative">
            <span className="absolute left-3 top-1/2 transform -translate-y-1/2 text-muted-foreground">$</span>
            <Input
              type="number"
              value={value}
              onChange={(e) => handleDataFieldChange(field.fieldName, e.target.value)}
              placeholder={field.placeholder}
              className="pl-6"
            />
          </div>
        );
      
      default:
        return (
          <Input
            type={field.fieldType === 'number' ? 'number' : 'text'}
            value={value}
            onChange={(e) => handleDataFieldChange(field.fieldName, e.target.value)}
            placeholder={field.placeholder}
          />
        );
    }
  };

  const getCategoryColor = (category: string) => {
    const colors = {
      'supply-chain': 'bg-orange-500',
      'cybersecurity': 'bg-red-500',
      'financial': 'bg-green-500',
      'market': 'bg-blue-500',
      'regulatory': 'bg-purple-500',
      'natural-disaster': 'bg-yellow-500',
      'hr': 'bg-pink-500',
      'operational': 'bg-indigo-500',
      'product': 'bg-teal-500',
      'customer': 'bg-cyan-500',
      'expansion': 'bg-emerald-500',
      'innovation': 'bg-violet-500',
      'partnership': 'bg-amber-500',
      'digital': 'bg-slate-500',
      'acquisition': 'bg-rose-500'
    };
    return colors[category as keyof typeof colors] || 'bg-gray-500';
  };

  const getImpactColor = (impact: string) => {
    const colors = {
      low: 'text-green-600',
      medium: 'text-yellow-600', 
      high: 'text-orange-600',
      critical: 'text-red-600'
    };
    return colors[impact as keyof typeof colors] || 'text-gray-600';
  };

  return (
    <div className="p-8 max-w-7xl mx-auto">
      <div className="mb-8">
        <h1 className="text-4xl font-black text-foreground mb-2">
          Comprehensive Scenario Templates

          <TabsTrigger value="data-entry" disabled={!selectedTemplate}>Data Entry</TabsTrigger>
          <TabsTrigger value="ai-analysis" disabled={!selectedTemplate} className="flex items-center gap-2">
            <Brain className="w-4 h-4" />
            AI Intelligence
          </TabsTrigger>
          <TabsTrigger value="what-if" disabled={!selectedTemplate}>What-If Analysis</TabsTrigger>
          <TabsTrigger value="results" disabled={whatIfScenarios.length === 0}>Results</TabsTrigger>

        <TabsContent value="templates" className="space-y-6">
          <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-6">
            {ALL_TEMPLATES.map((template) => {
              const IconComponent = templateIcons[template.category as keyof typeof templateIcons] || AlertTriangle;
              return (

                                  <div className="text-right">
                                    <div className="font-mono text-lg">{outcome.value}</div>

                                    </div>
                                  </div>
                                </div>
                              ))}
                            </div>
                          </div>
                        </div>
                      </div>
                    ))}
                  </div>
                  
                  <div className="flex justify-between mt-8">

                      <Button>
                        <Save className="w-4 h-4 mr-2" />

                      </Button>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                </CardContent>
              </Card>
            </div>
          )}

      </Tabs>
    </div>
  );
}

    "Economic downturn",
    "Customer behavior shift",
    "Talent shortage",
    "Digital transformation need"
  ];

  const handleNext = () => {
    if (currentStep < steps.length) {
      setCurrentStep(currentStep + 1);
    }
  };

  const handleStart = () => {
    window.location.href = '/end-to-end-demo';
  };

  const progressPercentage = (currentStep / steps.length) * 100;

  return (
    <div className="max-w-4xl mx-auto space-y-6">
      {/* Progress Header */}
      <Card className="bg-gradient-to-r from-blue-600 to-purple-600 text-white">
        <CardContent className="p-6">
          <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-4">
            <div>
              <h2 className="text-2xl font-bold">Transform Your Challenge Into Advantage</h2>
              <p className="text-blue-100">From problem to solution in under 4 minutes</p>
            </div>
            <div className="text-right">
              <div className="text-3xl font-bold">{Math.round(progressPercentage)}%</div>
              <div className="text-blue-200">Complete</div>
            </div>
          </div>
          <Progress value={progressPercentage} className="bg-blue-500/30 h-2" />
        </CardContent>
      </Card>

      {/* Current Step */}
      <Card className="border-2 border-blue-200 shadow-lg">
        <CardHeader>
          <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
            <div className="w-12 h-12 bg-blue-600 rounded-full flex items-center justify-center">
              <span className="text-white font-bold">{currentStep}</span>
            </div>
            <div>
              <CardTitle className="text-xl">{steps[currentStep - 1]?.title}</CardTitle>
              <p className="text-muted-foreground">{steps[currentStep - 1]?.description}</p>
            </div>
            <div className="ml-auto text-right">
              <Badge variant="outline" className="text-sm">
                <Clock className="w-3 h-3 mr-1" />
                {steps[currentStep - 1]?.duration}
              </Badge>
            </div>
          </div>
        </CardHeader>
        <CardContent className="space-y-6">
          {currentStep === 1 && (
            <div className="space-y-4">
              <div>
                <label className="text-sm font-medium mb-2 block">Organization Name</label>
                <Input 
                  placeholder="e.g., Acme Corporation"
                  value={organizationName}
                  onChange={(e) => setOrganizationName(e.target.value)}
                  className="text-lg"
                />
              </div>
              <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-4">
                <div>
                  <label className="text-sm font-medium mb-2 block">Industry</label>
                  <Select>
                    <SelectTrigger>
                      <SelectValue placeholder="Select industry" />

                    <SelectContent>
                      <SelectItem value="technology">Technology</SelectItem>
                      <SelectItem value="finance">Finance</SelectItem>
                      <SelectItem value="healthcare">Healthcare</SelectItem>
                      <SelectItem value="retail">Retail</SelectItem>
                      <SelectItem value="manufacturing">Manufacturing</SelectItem>
                      <SelectItem value="other">Other</SelectItem>
                    </SelectContent>
                  </Select>
                </div>
                <div>
                  <label className="text-sm font-medium mb-2 block">Company Size</label>
                  <Select>
                    <SelectTrigger>
                      <SelectValue placeholder="Select size" />
                    </SelectTrigger>
                    <SelectContent>
                      <SelectItem value="startup">Startup (1-50)</SelectItem>
                      <SelectItem value="small">Small (51-200)</SelectItem>
                      <SelectItem value="medium">Medium (201-1000)</SelectItem>
                      <SelectItem value="large">Large (1000+)</SelectItem>
                    </SelectContent>
                  </Select>
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>
          )}

          {currentStep === 2 && (
            <div className="space-y-4">
              <div>
                <label className="text-sm font-medium mb-2 block">What challenge are you facing?</label>
                <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3">
                  {commonDisruptions.map((disruption, index) => (
                    <Button
                      key={index}
                      variant={disruptionType === disruption ? "default" : "outline"}
                      className="justify-start text-left h-auto p-3"
                      onClick={() => setDisruptionType(disruption)}
                    >
                      {disruption}
                    </Button>
                  ))}
                </div>
              </div>
              <div>
                <label className="text-sm font-medium mb-2 block">Urgency Level</label>
                <div className="grid grid-cols-3 gap-3">
                  {['Low', 'Medium', 'High'].map((level) => (
                    <Button
                      key={level}
                      variant={urgencyLevel === level ? "default" : "outline"}
                      onClick={() => setUrgencyLevel(level)}
                      className={`${
                        level === 'High' ? 'border-red-300 hover:bg-red-50' :
                        level === 'Medium' ? 'border-yellow-300 hover:bg-yellow-50' :
                        'border-green-300 hover:bg-green-50'
                      }`}
                    >
                      {level} Priority
                    </Button>
                  ))}
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>
          )}

          {currentStep === 3 && (
            <div className="space-y-4">
              <div className="bg-green-50 border border-green-200 rounded-lg p-4">
                <div className="flex items-center gap-2 mb-2">
                  <CheckCircle className="w-5 h-5 text-green-600" />
                  <span className="font-medium text-green-800">Strategy Generated!</span>
                </div>
                <p className="text-green-700 text-sm">
                  Your personalized response plan is ready with 12 specific actions, team assignments, and success metrics.
                </p>
              </div>
              
              <div className="grid grid-cols-3 gap-4">
                <Card className="text-center p-4">
                  <Target className="w-8 h-8 text-blue-600 mx-auto mb-2" />
                  <div className="text-2xl font-bold">12</div>
                  <div className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">Action Items</div>
                </Card>
                <Card className="text-center p-4">
                  <TrendingUp className="w-8 h-8 text-green-600 mx-auto mb-2" />
                  <div className="text-2xl font-bold">340%</div>
                  <div className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">ROI Potential</div>
                </Card>
                <Card className="text-center p-4">
                  <Clock className="w-8 h-8 text-purple-600 mx-auto mb-2" />
                  <div className="text-2xl font-bold">18x</div>
                  <div className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">Faster Results</div>
                </Card>
              </div>
            </div>
          )}

          {currentStep === 4 && (
            <div className="space-y-4">
              <div className="bg-blue-50 border border-blue-200 rounded-lg p-4">
                <div className="flex items-center gap-2 mb-2">
                  <Play className="w-5 h-5 text-blue-600" />
                  <span className="font-medium text-blue-800">Ready to Launch!</span>
                </div>
                <p className="text-blue-700 text-sm">
                  Your strategy is ready with team assignments, deadlines, and success tracking.
                </p>
              </div>
              
              <div className="text-center space-y-4">
                <div className="text-lg font-medium">
                  See your complete organizational transformation in action
                </div>
                <Button 
                  size="lg" 
                  className="bg-gradient-to-r from-green-600 to-blue-600 hover:from-green-700 hover:to-blue-700 text-white px-8 py-3"
                  onClick={handleStart}
                >
                  Experience Your Solution
                  <ArrowRight className="ml-2 h-5 w-5" />
                </Button>
              </div>
            </div>
          )}

          {currentStep < 4 && (
            <div className="flex justify-end pt-4">
              <Button 
                onClick={handleNext}
                disabled={
                  (currentStep === 1 && !organizationName) ||
                  (currentStep === 2 && (!disruptionType || !urgencyLevel))
                }
                className="px-8"
              >
                Continue
                <ChevronRight className="ml-2 h-4 w-4" />
              </Button>
            </div>
          )}
        </CardContent>
      </Card>

      {/* Step Overview */}
      <div className="grid grid-cols-4 gap-4">
        {steps.map((step, index) => (
          <Card key={step.id} className={`text-center ${step.status === 'active' ? 'border-blue-500 bg-blue-50' : ''}`}>
            <CardContent className="p-4">
              <div className={`w-8 h-8 rounded-full mx-auto mb-2 flex items-center justify-center ${
                step.status === 'completed' ? 'bg-green-500 text-white' :
                step.status === 'active' ? 'bg-blue-500 text-white' :
                'bg-gray-200 text-gray-500'
              }`}>
                {step.status === 'completed' ? 
                  <CheckCircle className="w-4 h-4" /> : 
                  <span className="text-sm font-bold">{step.id}</span>
                }
              </div>
              <div className="text-sm font-medium mb-1">{step.title}</div>
              <div className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">{step.impact}</div>
            </CardContent>
          </Card>
        ))}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

export default SimplifiedWorkflow;
```

              <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-4">
                <div>
                  <h3 className="font-semibold text-lg">{opportunity.partner.name}</h3>
                  <Badge className="mt-1 bg-blue-100 text-blue-800">
                    {opportunity.type.replace('_', ' ').replace(/\b\w/g, l => l.toUpperCase())}
                  </Badge>
                </div>
                <div className="text-center">
                  <div className="text-2xl font-bold text-green-600">{opportunity.matchScore}</div>
                  <div className="text-xs text-gray-600">Match Score</div>
                </div>
              </div>

              <div className="space-y-4">
                <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-4">
                  <div>
                    <span className="text-sm text-gray-600">Revenue Projection:</span>
                    <p className="font-medium text-green-600">{opportunity.revenueProjection}</p>
                  </div>
                  <div>
                    <span className="text-sm text-gray-600">Time to Value:</span>
                    <p className="font-medium">{opportunity.timeToValue}</p>
                  </div>
                </div>

                <div>
                  <div className="flex justify-between mb-2">
                    <span className="text-sm text-gray-600">Success Probability:</span>
                    <span className="font-medium">{opportunity.successProbability}%</span>
                  </div>
                  <Progress value={opportunity.successProbability} className="h-2" />
                </div>

                <div>
                  <h4 className="font-medium mb-2 text-green-700">Key Synergies:</h4>
                  <ul className="space-y-1">
                    {opportunity.synergies.slice(0, 2).map((synergy, index) => (
                      <li key={index} className="text-sm flex items-start gap-2">
                        <CheckCircle className="h-3 w-3 text-green-500 mt-1 flex-shrink-0" />
                        {synergy}
                      </li>
                    ))}
                  </ul>
                </div>

                <div>
                  <h4 className="font-medium mb-2 text-orange-700">Key Risks:</h4>
                  <ul className="space-y-1">
                    {opportunity.risks.slice(0, 2).map((risk, index) => (
                      <li key={index} className="text-sm flex items-start gap-2">
                        <AlertTriangle className="h-3 w-3 text-orange-500 mt-1 flex-shrink-0" />
                        {risk}
                      </li>
                    ))}
                  </ul>
                </div>

                <div>
                  <h4 className="font-medium mb-2">Next Steps:</h4>
                  <ul className="space-y-1">
                    {opportunity.nextSteps.slice(0, 2).map((step, index) => (
                      <li key={index} className="text-sm flex items-start gap-2">
                        <ArrowRight className="h-3 w-3 text-blue-500 mt-1 flex-shrink-0" />
                        {step}
                      </li>
                    ))}
                  </ul>
                </div>
              </div>

              <div className="flex gap-2 mt-4">
                <Button className="flex-1">

                </Button>

                  <FileText className="h-4 w-4" />
                </Button>
              </div>
            </CardContent>
          </Card>
        ))}
      </div>

      {/* Value vs Risk Matrix */}
      <Card>
        <CardHeader>
          <CardTitle className="flex items-center gap-2">

          </CardTitle>
        </CardHeader>

                </Badge>
              </div>
            ))}
          </div>
        </CardContent>
      </Card>
    </div>
  );

    <div className="space-y-6 p-6">
      {/* Header */}
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
        <div>
          <h1 className="text-3xl font-bold">Strategic Partnership Orchestrator</h1>
          <p className="text-gray-600">AI-powered partner matching and collaboration workflow automation</p>
        </div>
        <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
          <Badge className="bg-blue-100 text-blue-800">
            {partnerProfiles.length} Potential Partners
          </Badge>
          <Button>
            <Plus className="h-4 w-4 mr-2" />
            Add Partner
          </Button>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Partnership Tabs */}
      <Tabs value={activeTab} onValueChange={setActiveTab}>
        <TabsList className="grid w-full grid-cols-3">
          <TabsTrigger value="discovery">Partner Discovery</TabsTrigger>
          <TabsTrigger value="opportunities">Opportunity Analysis</TabsTrigger>
          <TabsTrigger value="workflows">Workflow Management</TabsTrigger>
        </TabsList>

        <TabsContent value="discovery" className="space-y-6">
          <PartnerDiscovery />
        </TabsContent>

        <TabsContent value="opportunities" className="space-y-6">
          <OpportunityAnalysis />
        </TabsContent>

        <TabsContent value="workflows" className="space-y-6">
          <WorkflowManagement />
        </TabsContent>
      </Tabs>
    </div>
  );
}
