            {slides.map((_, index) => (
              <button
                key={index}
                onClick={() => goToSlide(index)}
                className={`w-3 h-3 rounded-full transition-all ${
                  index === currentSlide 
                    ? 'bg-blue-600' 
                    : 'bg-gray-300 dark:bg-gray-600 hover:bg-gray-400 dark:hover:bg-gray-500'
                }`}
              />
            ))}
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Current Slide */}
        <Card className="min-h-[600px] bg-white/80 dark:bg-gray-800/80 backdrop-blur-sm border-0 shadow-2xl">
          <CardHeader className="text-center pb-4">
            <CardTitle className="text-3xl font-bold text-gray-900 dark:text-white">
              {slides[currentSlide].title}
            </CardTitle>
            <p className="text-lg text-gray-600 dark:text-gray-300">
              {slides[currentSlide].subtitle}
            </p>
          </CardHeader>
          <CardContent>
            {slides[currentSlide].content}
          </CardContent>
        </Card>

        {/* Navigation Controls */}
        <div className="flex justify-between items-center mt-6">
          <Button 
            onClick={prevSlide} 
            variant="outline" 
            disabled={currentSlide === 0}
            className="flex items-center gap-2"
          >
            <ChevronLeft className="h-4 w-4" />
            Previous
          </Button>
          
          <div className="text-sm text-gray-600 dark:text-gray-400">
            Slide {currentSlide + 1} of {slides.length}
          </div>
          
          <Button 
            onClick={nextSlide} 
            variant="outline" 
            disabled={currentSlide === slides.length - 1}
            className="flex items-center gap-2"
          >
            Next
            <ChevronRight className="h-4 w-4" />
          </Button>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

export default VCPitchDeck;

                          isActive 
                            ? 'border-2 border-orange-500 shadow-lg scale-105' 
                            : 'hover:shadow-md'
                        }`}
                        onClick={() => setCurrentSection(index)}
                      >
                        <CardContent className="p-4">
                          <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
                            <div 
                              className={`w-10 h-10 bg-gradient-to-r ${section.gradient} rounded-lg flex items-center justify-center`}
                            >
                              <Icon className="w-5 h-5 text-white" />
                            </div>
                            <div>
                              <h3 className="font-semibold">{section.title}</h3>
                              <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">{section.subtitle}</p>
                            </div>
                          </div>
                        </CardContent>
                      </Card>
                    );
                  })}
                </div>

                {/* Active Story Content */}
                <div className="space-y-6">
                  <Card className="border-2 border-orange-200 bg-gradient-to-br from-orange-50 to-red-50 dark:from-orange-950/20 dark:to-red-950/20">
                    <CardContent className="p-6">
                      <div className="flex items-center gap-3 mb-4">
                        <div 
                          className={`w-12 h-12 bg-gradient-to-r ${narrativeSections[currentSection].gradient} rounded-xl flex items-center justify-center`}
                        >
                          {React.createElement(narrativeSections[currentSection].icon, { className: "w-6 h-6 text-white" })}
                        </div>
                        <div>
                          <h2 className="text-2xl font-bold">{narrativeSections[currentSection].title}</h2>
                          <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">{narrativeSections[currentSection].subtitle}</p>
                        </div>
                      </div>
                      
                      <div className="text-lg leading-relaxed">
                        {narrativeSections[currentSection].emphasis ? (
                          <p>
                            {narrativeSections[currentSection].content.split(narrativeSections[currentSection].emphasis!)[0]}
                            <span className="font-bold bg-gradient-to-r from-orange-600 to-red-600 bg-clip-text text-transparent">
                              {narrativeSections[currentSection].emphasis}
                            </span>
                            {narrativeSections[currentSection].content.split(narrativeSections[currentSection].emphasis!)[1]}
                          </p>
                        ) : (
                          <p>{narrativeSections[currentSection].content}</p>
                        )}
                      </div>
                    </CardContent>
                  </Card>

                  {/* Story Progress */}
                  <div className="flex gap-2">
                    {narrativeSections.map((_, index) => (
                      <div
                        key={index}
                        className={`h-2 flex-1 rounded-full transition-all duration-300 ${
                          index === currentSection 
                            ? 'bg-gradient-to-r from-orange-500 to-red-500' 
                            : 'bg-gray-200 dark:bg-gray-700'
                        }`}
                      />
                    ))}
                  </div>
                </div>
              </div>
            </CardContent>
          </Card>
        </TabsContent>

        {/* Category Ownership */}
        <TabsContent value="category" className="space-y-6">
          <Card>
            <CardHeader>
              <CardTitle>Category Ownership Strategy</CardTitle>
              <CardDescription>
                Don't compete—define the space. Be the first to name the problem and the last to solve it.
              </CardDescription>
            </CardHeader>
            <CardContent>
              <div className="space-y-8">
                {/* Category Definition */}
                <div className="text-center space-y-4">
                  <Badge className="bg-purple-100 text-purple-800 text-lg px-6 py-3">

  requirements: string[];
  progress: number;
}

export default function ViralGrowthEngineV2() {
  const { toast } = useToast();

    totalReferrals: 47,
    activeNetworks: 8,
    conversionRate: 34,
    viralCoefficient: 2.4,
    rewardsClaimed: 12
  });

  const [referralCode, setReferralCode] = useState('VERIDIUS-EXEC-2025');
  const [customMessage, setCustomMessage] = useState('');
  const [selectedProgram, setSelectedProgram] = useState<string>('executive');

## FILE: client/src/hooks/useErrorBoundary.tsx
```
import { Component, ReactNode, ErrorInfo } from 'react';
import { logger } from '@/lib/logger';

interface ErrorBoundaryState {
  hasError: boolean;
  error?: Error;
  errorInfo?: ErrorInfo;
}

interface ErrorBoundaryProps {
  children: ReactNode;
  fallback?: ReactNode;
  onError?: (error: Error, errorInfo: ErrorInfo) => void;
}

export class ErrorBoundary extends Component<ErrorBoundaryProps, ErrorBoundaryState> {
  constructor(props: ErrorBoundaryProps) {
    super(props);
    this.state = { hasError: false };
  }

  static getDerivedStateFromError(error: Error): ErrorBoundaryState {
    return {
      hasError: true,
      error,
    };
  }

  componentDidCatch(error: Error, errorInfo: ErrorInfo) {
    this.setState({
      error,
      errorInfo,
    });

    // Log error
    logger.error('Component error boundary caught error', {
      error: {
        name: error.name,
        message: error.message,
        stack: error.stack,
      },
      errorInfo: {
        componentStack: errorInfo.componentStack,
      },
      timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),
    });

    // Call custom error handler if provided
    if (this.props.onError) {
      this.props.onError(error, errorInfo);
    }
  }

  render() {
    if (this.state.hasError) {
      if (this.props.fallback) {
        return this.props.fallback;
      }

      return (
        <div className="min-h-screen flex items-center justify-center bg-gradient-to-br from-slate-50 to-slate-100">
          <div className="max-w-md mx-auto p-6 bg-white rounded-lg shadow-lg border border-red-200">
            <div className="flex items-center space-x-3 mb-4">
              <div className="w-8 h-8 bg-red-100 rounded-full flex items-center justify-center">
                <svg className="w-4 h-4 text-red-600" fill="currentColor" viewBox="0 0 20 20">
                  <path fillRule="evenodd" d="M18 10a8 8 0 11-16 0 8 8 0 0116 0zm-7 4a1 1 0 11-2 0 1 1 0 012 0zm-1-9a1 1 0 00-1 1v4a1 1 0 102 0V6a1 1 0 00-1-1z" clipRule="evenodd" />
                </svg>
              </div>
              <h2 className="text-lg font-semibold text-gray-900">Something went wrong</h2>
            </div>
            
            <p className="text-gray-600 mb-4">
              We encountered an unexpected error. Our team has been notified and is working on a fix.
            </p>

            {process.env.NODE_ENV === 'development' && this.state.error && (
              <details className="mb-4">
                <summary className="cursor-pointer text-sm font-medium text-gray-700 hover:text-gray-900">
                  Error Details
                </summary>
                <div className="mt-2 p-3 bg-gray-50 rounded border text-xs font-mono text-gray-800 overflow-auto max-h-32">
                  <div className="font-semibold">{this.state.error.name}: {this.state.error.message}</div>
                  {this.state.error.stack && (
                    <pre className="mt-2 whitespace-pre-wrap">{this.state.error.stack}</pre>
                  )}
                </div>
              </details>
            )}

            <div className="flex space-x-3">
              <button
                onClick={() => window.location.reload()}
                className="flex-1 bg-blue-600 text-white px-4 py-2 rounded hover:bg-blue-700 transition-colors"
              >
                Reload Page
              </button>
              <button
                onClick={() => window.history.back()}
                className="flex-1 bg-gray-200 text-gray-800 px-4 py-2 rounded hover:bg-gray-300 transition-colors"
              >
                Go Back
              </button>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      );
    }

    return this.props.children;
  }
}

// Hook for programmatic error boundary
export const useErrorBoundary = () => {
  const throwError = (error: Error) => {
    throw error;
  };

  return { throwError };
};

## FILE: client/src/hooks/use-mobile.tsx
```
import * as React from "react"

const MOBILE_BREAKPOINT = 768

export function useIsMobile() {
  const [isMobile, setIsMobile] = React.useState<boolean | undefined>(undefined)

  React.useEffect(() => {
    const mql = window.matchMedia(`(max-width: ${MOBILE_BREAKPOINT - 1}px)`)
    const onChange = () => {
      setIsMobile(window.innerWidth < MOBILE_BREAKPOINT)
    }
    mql.addEventListener("change", onChange)
    setIsMobile(window.innerWidth < MOBILE_BREAKPOINT)
    return () => mql.removeEventListener("change", onChange)
  }, [])

  return !!isMobile
}

export function usePlaybooks() {

        status: 'generated',
        progress: 0,
        teamMembers: [],
        timeline: [],
        keyActions: [],

      setPlaybooks(prev => [newPlaybook, ...prev]);

    } catch (err) {
      setError(err instanceof Error ? err.message : 'Failed to generate playbook');
    } finally {
      setGenerating(false);
    }
  }, []);

  const updatePlaybookStatus = useCallback(async (
    playbookId: string, 
    status: AutomatedPlaybook['status']
  ) => {
    try {
      // TODO: Implement actual API call
      setPlaybooks(prev => prev.map(p => 
        p.id === playbookId ? { ...p, status, updatedAt: new Date() } : p
      ));
    } catch (err) {
      setError(err instanceof Error ? err.message : 'Failed to update playbook');
    }
  }, []);

  const updatePlaybookProgress = useCallback(async (
    playbookId: string, 
    progress: number
  ) => {
    try {
      // TODO: Implement actual API call
      setPlaybooks(prev => prev.map(p => 
        p.id === playbookId ? { ...p, progress, updatedAt: new Date() } : p
      ));
    } catch (err) {
      setError(err instanceof Error ? err.message : 'Failed to update progress');
    }
  }, []);

  const deletePlaybook = useCallback(async (playbookId: string) => {
    try {
      // TODO: Implement actual API call
      setPlaybooks(prev => prev.filter(p => p.id !== playbookId));
      
      if (activePlaybook === playbookId) {
        const remainingPlaybooks = playbooks.filter(p => p.id !== playbookId);

    } catch (err) {
      setError(err instanceof Error ? err.message : 'Failed to delete playbook');
    }
  }, [playbooks, activePlaybook]);

  return {
    playbooks,
    activePlaybook,
    currentPlaybook: getCurrentPlaybook(),
    loading,
    error,
    generating,
    selectPlaybook,
    generatePlaybook,
    updatePlaybookStatus,
    updatePlaybookProgress,
    deletePlaybook
  };

        setLoading(false);
      }

    loadModels();
  }, [activeModel]);

  // Autoplay functionality
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!autoplayEnabled || models.length <= 1) return;

    const interval = setInterval(() => {
      setActiveModel(currentId => {
        const currentIndex = models.findIndex(m => m.id === currentId);
        const nextIndex = (currentIndex + 1) % models.length;
        return models[nextIndex]?.id || models[0]?.id;
      });
    }, 10000);

    return () => clearInterval(interval);
  }, [autoplayEnabled, models]);

  const getCurrentModel = useCallback(() => {
    return models.find(m => m.id === activeModel) || models[0];
  }, [models, activeModel]);

  const selectModel = useCallback((modelId: string) => {
    if (models.some(m => m.id === modelId)) {
      setActiveModel(modelId);
    }
  }, [models]);

  const toggleAutoplay = useCallback(() => {
    setAutoplayEnabled(prev => !prev);
  }, []);

  const refreshModels = useCallback(async () => {
    setLoading(true);
    setError(null);
    
    try {

      await new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, 1000)); // Simulate API call

    } catch (err) {

    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  }, []);

  return {
    models,
    activeModel,
    currentModel: getCurrentModel(),
    loading,
    error,
    autoplayEnabled,
    selectModel,
    toggleAutoplay,
    refreshModels
  };
}

## FILE: client/src/hooks/use-toast.ts
```
import * as React from "react"

import type {
  ToastActionElement,
  ToastProps,
} from "@/components/ui/toast"

const TOAST_LIMIT = 1
const TOAST_REMOVE_DELAY = 1000000

type ToasterToast = ToastProps & {
  id: string
  title?: React.ReactNode
  description?: React.ReactNode
  action?: ToastActionElement
}

const actionTypes = {
  ADD_TOAST: "ADD_TOAST",
  UPDATE_TOAST: "UPDATE_TOAST",
  DISMISS_TOAST: "DISMISS_TOAST",
  REMOVE_TOAST: "REMOVE_TOAST",
} as const

let count = 0

function genId() {
  count = (count + 1) % Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER
  return count.toString()
}

type ActionType = typeof actionTypes

type Action =
  | {
      type: ActionType["ADD_TOAST"]
      toast: ToasterToast
    }
  | {
      type: ActionType["UPDATE_TOAST"]
      toast: Partial<ToasterToast>
    }
  | {
      type: ActionType["DISMISS_TOAST"]
      toastId?: ToasterToast["id"]
    }
  | {
      type: ActionType["REMOVE_TOAST"]
      toastId?: ToasterToast["id"]
    }

interface State {
  toasts: ToasterToast[]
}

const toastTimeouts = new Map<string, ReturnType<typeof setTimeout>>()

const addToRemoveQueue = (toastId: string) => {
  if (toastTimeouts.has(toastId)) {
    return
  }

  const timeout = setTimeout(() => {
    toastTimeouts.delete(toastId)
    dispatch({
      type: "REMOVE_TOAST",
      toastId: toastId,
    })
  }, TOAST_REMOVE_DELAY)

  toastTimeouts.set(toastId, timeout)
}

export const reducer = (state: State, action: Action): State => {
  switch (action.type) {
    case "ADD_TOAST":
      return {
        ...state,
        toasts: [action.toast, ...state.toasts].slice(0, TOAST_LIMIT),
      }

    case "UPDATE_TOAST":
      return {
        ...state,
        toasts: state.toasts.map((t) =>
          t.id === action.toast.id ? { ...t, ...action.toast } : t
        ),
      }

    case "DISMISS_TOAST": {
      const { toastId } = action

      // ! Side effects ! - This could be extracted into a dismissToast() action,
      // but I'll keep it here for simplicity
      if (toastId) {
        addToRemoveQueue(toastId)
      } else {
        state.toasts.forEach((toast) => {
          addToRemoveQueue(toast.id)
        })
      }

      return {
        ...state,
        toasts: state.toasts.map((t) =>
          t.id === toastId || toastId === undefined
            ? {
                ...t,
                open: false,
              }
            : t
        ),
      }
    }
    case "REMOVE_TOAST":
      if (action.toastId === undefined) {
        return {
          ...state,
          toasts: [],
        }
      }
      return {
        ...state,
        toasts: state.toasts.filter((t) => t.id !== action.toastId),
      }
  }
}

const listeners: Array<(state: State) => void> = []

let memoryState: State = { toasts: [] }

function dispatch(action: Action) {
  memoryState = reducer(memoryState, action)
  listeners.forEach((listener) => {
    listener(memoryState)
  })
}

type Toast = Omit<ToasterToast, "id">

function toast({ ...props }: Toast) {
  const id = genId()

  const update = (props: ToasterToast) =>
    dispatch({
      type: "UPDATE_TOAST",
      toast: { ...props, id },
    })
  const dismiss = () => dispatch({ type: "DISMISS_TOAST", toastId: id })

  dispatch({
    type: "ADD_TOAST",
    toast: {
      ...props,
      id,
      open: true,
      onOpenChange: (open) => {
        if (!open) dismiss()
      },
    },
  })

  return {
    id: id,
    dismiss,
    update,
  }
}

function useToast() {
  const [state, setState] = React.useState<State>(memoryState)

  React.useEffect(() => {
    listeners.push(setState)
    return () => {
      const index = listeners.indexOf(setState)
      if (index > -1) {
        listeners.splice(index, 1)
      }
    }
  }, [state])

  return {
    ...state,
    toast,
    dismiss: (toastId?: string) => dispatch({ type: "DISMISS_TOAST", toastId }),
  }
}

export { useToast, toast }

```

/**
 * API client and utilities for Veridius platform
 */

import { ApiResponse, PaginatedResponse, PaginationParams } from '@/types';
import { API_ENDPOINTS } from '@/utils/constants';

/**
 * Base API client configuration
 */
class ApiClient {
  private baseURL: string;
  private defaultHeaders: HeadersInit;

  constructor() {
    this.baseURL = import.meta.env.VITE_API_BASE_URL || '';
    this.defaultHeaders = {
      'Content-Type': 'application/json',
    };
  }

  /**
   * Make an HTTP request
   */
  private async request<T = any>(
    endpoint: string,
    options: RequestInit = {}
  ): Promise<ApiResponse<T>> {
    try {
      const url = `${this.baseURL}${endpoint}`;
      const config: RequestInit = {
        ...options,
        headers: {
          ...this.defaultHeaders,
          ...options.headers,
        },
      };

      const response = await fetch(url, config);
      const data = await response.json();

      if (!response.ok) {
        throw new Error(data.message || `HTTP ${response.status}: ${response.statusText}`);
      }

      return {
        success: true,
        data,
        timestamp: new Date()
      };
    } catch (error) {
      return {
        success: false,
        error: error instanceof Error ? error.message : 'Unknown error',
        timestamp: new Date()
      };
    }
  }

  /**
   * GET request
   */
  async get<T>(endpoint: string, params?: Record<string, any>): Promise<ApiResponse<T>> {
    const url = new URL(endpoint, window.location.origin);
    
    if (params) {
      Object.entries(params).forEach(([key, value]) => {
        if (value !== undefined && value !== null) {
          url.searchParams.append(key, String(value));
        }
      });
    }

    return this.request<T>(url.pathname + url.search);
  }

  /**
   * POST request
   */
  async post<T>(endpoint: string, data?: any): Promise<ApiResponse<T>> {
    return this.request<T>(endpoint, {
      method: 'POST',
      body: data ? JSON.stringify(data) : undefined,
    });
  }

  /**
   * PUT request
   */
  async put<T>(endpoint: string, data?: any): Promise<ApiResponse<T>> {
    return this.request<T>(endpoint, {
      method: 'PUT',
      body: data ? JSON.stringify(data) : undefined,
    });
  }

  /**
   * PATCH request
   */
  async patch<T>(endpoint: string, data?: any): Promise<ApiResponse<T>> {
    return this.request<T>(endpoint, {
      method: 'PATCH',
      body: data ? JSON.stringify(data) : undefined,
    });
  }

  /**
   * DELETE request
   */
  async delete<T>(endpoint: string): Promise<ApiResponse<T>> {
    return this.request<T>(endpoint, {
      method: 'DELETE',
    });
  }

  /**
   * GET request with pagination
   */
  async getPaginated<T>(
    endpoint: string,
    params?: PaginationParams & Record<string, any>
  ): Promise<PaginatedResponse<T>> {
    const response = await this.get<{
      data: T[];
      pagination: PaginatedResponse<T>['pagination'];
    }>(endpoint, params);

    return {
      ...response,
      data: response.data?.data || [],
      pagination: response.data?.pagination || {
        page: 1,
        limit: 10,
        total: 0,
        pages: 0
      }
    } as PaginatedResponse<T>;
  }
}

// Create singleton instance
export const apiClient = new ApiClient();

/**
 * Specific API service functions
 */
export const predictiveModelsApi = {
  getAll: () => apiClient.get(API_ENDPOINTS.PREDICTIVE_MODELS),
  getById: (id: string) => apiClient.get(`${API_ENDPOINTS.PREDICTIVE_MODELS}/${id}`),
  create: (data: any) => apiClient.post(API_ENDPOINTS.PREDICTIVE_MODELS, data),
  update: (id: string, data: any) => apiClient.patch(`${API_ENDPOINTS.PREDICTIVE_MODELS}/${id}`, data),
  delete: (id: string) => apiClient.delete(`${API_ENDPOINTS.PREDICTIVE_MODELS}/${id}`),
};

export const playbooksApi = {
  getAll: () => apiClient.get(API_ENDPOINTS.PLAYBOOKS),
  getById: (id: string) => apiClient.get(`${API_ENDPOINTS.PLAYBOOKS}/${id}`),
  create: (data: any) => apiClient.post(API_ENDPOINTS.PLAYBOOKS, data),
  update: (id: string, data: any) => apiClient.patch(`${API_ENDPOINTS.PLAYBOOKS}/${id}`, data),
  delete: (id: string) => apiClient.delete(`${API_ENDPOINTS.PLAYBOOKS}/${id}`),
  generate: (disruptionType?: string) => 
    apiClient.post(`${API_ENDPOINTS.PLAYBOOKS}/generate`, { disruptionType }),
};

  getById: (id: string) => apiClient.get(`${API_ENDPOINTS.DISRUPTIONS}/${id}`),
  create: (data: any) => apiClient.post(API_ENDPOINTS.DISRUPTIONS, data),
};

  getSystemStatus: () => apiClient.get(API_ENDPOINTS.SYSTEM_STATUS),

/**
 * Error handling utilities
 */
export function isApiError(response: ApiResponse<any>): response is ApiResponse<never> & { success: false; error: string } {
  return !response.success;
}

export function handleApiError(response: ApiResponse<any>): string {
  if (isApiError(response)) {
    return response.error || 'An unexpected error occurred';
  }
  return '';
}

/**
 * React Query integration helpers
 */
export const queryKeys = {
  predictiveModels: ['predictive-models'] as const,
  predictiveModel: (id: string) => ['predictive-models', id] as const,
  playbooks: ['playbooks'] as const,
  playbook: (id: string) => ['playbooks', id] as const,
  alerts: ['alerts'] as const,
  disruptions: ['disruptions'] as const,
  metrics: ['metrics'] as const,
  systemStatus: ['system', 'status'] as const,
} as const;

## FILE: client/src/lib/logger.ts

interface LogContext {
  userId?: string;
  organizationId?: string;
  action?: string;
  resource?: string;
  component?: string;
  [key: string]: any;
}

export class ClientLogger {
  private static instance: ClientLogger;
  
  static getInstance(): ClientLogger {
    if (!ClientLogger.instance) {
      ClientLogger.instance = new ClientLogger();
    }
    return ClientLogger.instance;
  }

  private formatLog(level: string, message: string, context?: LogContext) {
    return {
      timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),
      level: level.toUpperCase(),
      message,
      service: 'nexus-client',
      environment: import.meta.env.MODE || 'development',
      url: window.location.href,
      userAgent: navigator.userAgent,
      ...context,
    };
  }

  private shouldLog(level: string): boolean {
    if (import.meta.env.MODE === 'production') {
      return ['error', 'warn'].includes(level);
    }
    return true;
  }

  info(message: string, context?: LogContext): void {
    if (this.shouldLog('info')) {
      console.log(JSON.stringify(this.formatLog('info', message, context)));
    }
  }

  warn(message: string, context?: LogContext): void {
    if (this.shouldLog('warn')) {
      console.warn(JSON.stringify(this.formatLog('warn', message, context)));
    }
  }

  error(message: string, error?: Error, context?: LogContext): void {
    if (this.shouldLog('error')) {
      const errorContext = {
        ...context,
        error: error ? {
          name: error.name,
          message: error.message,
          stack: error.stack,
        } : undefined,
      };
      console.error(JSON.stringify(this.formatLog('error', message, errorContext)));
    }

    // Send critical errors to server in production
    if (import.meta.env.MODE === 'production' && error) {
      this.sendErrorToServer(message, error, context);
    }
  }

  debug(message: string, context?: LogContext): void {
    if (this.shouldLog('debug')) {
      console.debug(JSON.stringify(this.formatLog('debug', message, context)));
    }
  }

  private async sendErrorToServer(message: string, error: Error, context?: LogContext): Promise<void> {
    try {
      await fetch('/api/client-errors', {
        method: 'POST',
        headers: {
          'Content-Type': 'application/json',
        },
        body: JSON.stringify({
          message,
          error: {
            name: error.name,
            message: error.message,
            stack: error.stack,
          },
          context,
          timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),
          url: window.location.href,
          userAgent: navigator.userAgent,
        }),
      });
    } catch (sendError) {
      console.error('Failed to send error to server:', sendError);
    }
  }

  // Performance tracking
  trackPerformance(name: string, startTime: number, context?: LogContext): void {
    const duration = performance.now() - startTime;
    this.info(`Performance: ${name}`, {
      ...context,
      duration,
      performance: true,
    });

    // Log slow operations
    if (duration > 1000) {
      this.warn(`Slow operation detected: ${name}`, {
        ...context,
        duration,
      });
    }
  }

  // User interaction tracking
  trackUserAction(action: string, context?: LogContext): void {
    this.info(`User action: ${action}`, {
      ...context,
      userAction: true,
    });
  }
}

export const logger = ClientLogger.getInstance();
```

## FILE: client/src/lib/queryClient.ts
```
import { QueryClient, QueryFunction } from "@tanstack/react-query";

async function throwIfResNotOk(res: Response) {
  if (!res.ok) {
    const text = (await res.text()) || res.statusText;
    throw new Error(`${res.status}: ${text}`);
  }
}

export async function apiRequest(
  method: string,
  url: string,
  data?: unknown | undefined,
): Promise<Response> {
  const res = await fetch(url, {
    method,
    headers: data ? { "Content-Type": "application/json" } : {},
    body: data ? JSON.stringify(data) : undefined,
    credentials: "include",
  });

  await throwIfResNotOk(res);
  return res;
}

type UnauthorizedBehavior = "returnNull" | "throw";
export const getQueryFn: <T>(options: {
  on401: UnauthorizedBehavior;
}) => QueryFunction<T> =
  ({ on401: unauthorizedBehavior }) =>
  async ({ queryKey }) => {
    const res = await fetch(queryKey.join("/") as string, {
      credentials: "include",
    });

    if (unauthorizedBehavior === "returnNull" && res.status === 401) {
      return null;
    }

    await throwIfResNotOk(res);
    return await res.json();
  };

export const queryClient = new QueryClient({
  defaultOptions: {
    queries: {
      queryFn: getQueryFn({ on401: "throw" }),
      refetchInterval: false,
      refetchOnWindowFocus: false,
      staleTime: Infinity,
      retry: false,
    },
    mutations: {
      retry: false,
    },
  },
});

```

export default function AdvancedAnalytics() {
  const [activeCategory, setActiveCategory] = useState('all');
  const [timeRange, setTimeRange] = useState('6months');
  const [refreshing, setRefreshing] = useState(false);

  const categories = ['all', 'Strategic', 'Operational', 'Execution', 'Financial', 'Cultural', 'Innovation'];
  
  const filteredMetrics = activeCategory === 'all' 
    ? performanceMetrics 
    : performanceMetrics.filter(metric => metric.category === activeCategory);

  const refreshData = async () => {
    setRefreshing(true);
    // Simulate data refresh
    await new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, 2000));
    setRefreshing(false);
  };

  const getTrendIcon = (trend: string, value: number, target: number) => {
    if (value >= target) return <CheckCircle className="h-4 w-4 text-green-500" />;
    if (trend === 'up') return <TrendingUp className="h-4 w-4 text-green-500" />;
    if (trend === 'down') return <TrendingDown className="h-4 w-4 text-red-500" />;
    return <Activity className="h-4 w-4 text-yellow-500" />;
  };

  const getPerformanceColor = (value: number, target: number) => {
    const ratio = value / target;
    if (ratio >= 1.1) return 'text-green-600 bg-green-50';
    if (ratio >= 0.95) return 'text-blue-600 bg-blue-50';
    if (ratio >= 0.8) return 'text-yellow-600 bg-yellow-50';
    return 'text-red-600 bg-red-50';
  };

  const formatValue = (value: number, category: string) => {
    if (category === 'Financial') return `${value}%`;
    if (category === 'Operational' && value < 10) return `${value}h`;
    if (category === 'Cultural') return `${value}/10`;
    return `${value}%`;
  };

  return (
    <div className="min-h-screen bg-gradient-to-br from-indigo-50 via-white to-cyan-50">
      <div className="container mx-auto px-6 py-8">
        {/* Header */}
        <div className="mb-8">
          <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-6">
            <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
              <div className="p-3 bg-indigo-600 rounded-xl text-white">
                <BarChart3 className="h-8 w-8" />
              </div>
              <div>
                <h1 className="text-3xl font-bold bg-gradient-to-r from-indigo-600 to-cyan-600 bg-clip-text text-transparent">
                  Advanced Analytics
                </h1>
                <p className="text-gray-600">Comprehensive organizational intelligence and performance insights</p>
              </div>
            </div>
            
            <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
              <Select value={timeRange} onValueChange={setTimeRange}>
                <SelectTrigger className="w-40">
                  <SelectValue placeholder="Time Range" />
                </SelectTrigger>
                <SelectContent>
                  <SelectItem value="1month">Last Month</SelectItem>
                  <SelectItem value="3months">Last 3 Months</SelectItem>
                  <SelectItem value="6months">Last 6 Months</SelectItem>
                  <SelectItem value="1year">Last Year</SelectItem>
                </SelectContent>
              </Select>
              
              <Button onClick={refreshData} disabled={refreshing}>
                {refreshing ? <Clock className="h-4 w-4 animate-spin" /> : <Activity className="h-4 w-4" />}
                {refreshing ? 'Refreshing...' : 'Refresh Data'}
              </Button>
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* Key Performance Indicators */}
          <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-6 mb-8">
            <Card className="bg-white/80 backdrop-blur-sm border-0 shadow-lg">
              <CardContent className="p-6">
                <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                  <div>
                    <p className="text-sm text-gray-600">ROI Improvement</p>
                    <p className="text-2xl font-bold text-green-600">+340%</p>
                  </div>
                  <div className="p-3 bg-green-100 rounded-lg">
                    <DollarSign className="h-6 w-6 text-green-600" />
                  </div>
                </div>
                <p className="text-xs text-gray-500 mt-2">vs. traditional methods</p>
              </CardContent>
            </Card>
            
            <Card className="bg-white/80 backdrop-blur-sm border-0 shadow-lg">
              <CardContent className="p-6">
                <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                  <div>
                    <p className="text-sm text-gray-600">Response Speed</p>
                    <p className="text-2xl font-bold text-blue-600">18x</p>
                  </div>
                  <div className="p-3 bg-blue-100 rounded-lg">
                    <Zap className="h-6 w-6 text-blue-600" />
                  </div>
                </div>
                <p className="text-xs text-gray-500 mt-2">faster than industry avg</p>
              </CardContent>
            </Card>
            
            <Card className="bg-white/80 backdrop-blur-sm border-0 shadow-lg">
              <CardContent className="p-6">
                <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                  <div>
                    <p className="text-sm text-gray-600">Success Rate</p>
                    <p className="text-2xl font-bold text-indigo-600">97%</p>
                  </div>
                  <div className="p-3 bg-indigo-100 rounded-lg">
                    <Target className="h-6 w-6 text-indigo-600" />
                  </div>
                </div>
                <p className="text-xs text-gray-500 mt-2">strategic initiatives</p>
              </CardContent>
            </Card>
            
            <Card className="bg-white/80 backdrop-blur-sm border-0 shadow-lg">
              <CardContent className="p-6">
                <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                  <div>
                    <p className="text-sm text-gray-600">Cost Savings</p>
                    <p className="text-2xl font-bold text-purple-600">$7.2M</p>
                  </div>
                  <div className="p-3 bg-purple-100 rounded-lg">
                    <TrendingUp className="h-6 w-6 text-purple-600" />
                  </div>
                </div>
                <p className="text-xs text-gray-500 mt-2">annual savings achieved</p>
              </CardContent>
            </Card>
          </div>
        </div>

        <Tabs defaultValue="metrics" className="w-full">
          <TabsList className="grid w-full grid-cols-4 mb-6">
            <TabsTrigger value="metrics">Performance Metrics</TabsTrigger>
            <TabsTrigger value="trends">Trend Analysis</TabsTrigger>
            <TabsTrigger value="departments">Department View</TabsTrigger>
            <TabsTrigger value="risks">Risk Analysis</TabsTrigger>
          </TabsList>

          <TabsContent value="metrics" className="space-y-6">
            {/* Category Filter */}
            <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-2 mb-6">
              {categories.map((category) => (
                <Button
                  key={category}
                  variant={activeCategory === category ? "default" : "outline"}
                  size="sm"
                  onClick={() => setActiveCategory(category)}
                  className="capitalize"
                >
                  {category === 'all' ? 'All Categories' : category}
                </Button>
              ))}
            </div>

            {/* Metrics Grid */}
            <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-6">
              {filteredMetrics.map((metric, index) => (
                <Card key={index} className="bg-white/80 backdrop-blur-sm border-0 shadow-lg">
                  <CardHeader>
                    <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                      <CardTitle className="text-lg">{metric.name}</CardTitle>
                      {getTrendIcon(metric.trend, metric.value, metric.target)}
                    </div>
                  </CardHeader>
                  <CardContent>
                    <div className="space-y-4">
                      <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                        <div className={`px-3 py-2 rounded-lg ${getPerformanceColor(metric.value, metric.target)}`}>
                          <span className="text-2xl font-bold">
                            {formatValue(metric.value, metric.category)}
                          </span>
                        </div>
                        <Badge variant="outline" className="text-xs">
                          {metric.category}
                        </Badge>
                      </div>
                      
                      <div className="space-y-2">
                        <div className="flex items-center justify-between text-sm">
                          <span className="text-gray-600">Target:</span>
                          <span className="font-medium">{formatValue(metric.target, metric.category)}</span>
                        </div>
                        <div className="flex items-center justify-between text-sm">
                          <span className="text-gray-600">Previous:</span>
                          <span className="font-medium">{formatValue(metric.previousPeriod, metric.category)}</span>
                        </div>
                      </div>
                      
                      <div className="pt-2 border-t">
                        <div className="text-sm text-gray-600">
                          {metric.value >= metric.target ? (
                            <span className="text-green-600 font-medium">✓ Target Exceeded</span>
                          ) : (
                            <span className="text-yellow-600 font-medium">↗ On Track</span>
                          )}
                        </div>
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  </CardContent>
                </Card>
              ))}
            </div>
          </TabsContent>

          <TabsContent value="trends" className="space-y-6">
            <div className="grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-2 gap-6">
              <Card className="bg-white/80 backdrop-blur-sm border-0 shadow-lg">
                <CardHeader>
                  <CardTitle>Organizational Agility Trend</CardTitle>
                  <CardDescription>6-month progression of agility metrics</CardDescription>
                </CardHeader>
                <CardContent>

                      <Line type="monotone" dataKey="agility" stroke="#6366f1" strokeWidth={3} />

                  </ResponsiveContainer>

              </Card>
              
              <Card className="bg-white/80 backdrop-blur-sm border-0 shadow-lg">

                              <div className="text-sm text-gray-500">Agility Score</div>
                            </div>
                          </div>
                          <div className="text-right">
                            <div className="text-xl font-bold" style={{color: dept.color}}>
                              {dept.value}%
                            </div>
                            {dept.value >= 90 && (
                              <Badge className="bg-green-100 text-green-800">Excellent</Badge>
                            )}
                            {dept.value >= 80 && dept.value < 90 && (
                              <Badge className="bg-blue-100 text-blue-800">Good</Badge>
                            )}
                            {dept.value < 80 && (
                              <Badge className="bg-yellow-100 text-yellow-800">Improvement</Badge>
                            )}
                          </div>
                        </div>
                      ))}
                  </div>
                </CardContent>
              </Card>
            </div>
          </TabsContent>

                  <CardDescription>Current vs target risk exposure by area</CardDescription>
                </CardHeader>

                          <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                            {risk.impact === 'High' && (
                              <AlertTriangle className="h-5 w-5 text-red-500" />
                            )}
                            <Badge 
                              className={
                                risk.impact === 'High' ? 'bg-red-100 text-red-800' :
                                risk.impact === 'Medium' ? 'bg-yellow-100 text-yellow-800' :
                                'bg-green-100 text-green-800'
                              }
                            >
                              {risk.impact} Impact
                            </Badge>
                          </div>
                        </div>
                        <div className="flex items-center justify-between text-sm">
                          <span>Current Risk Level: <strong>{risk.current}%</strong></span>
                          <span>Target Level: <strong>{risk.target}%</strong></span>
                        </div>
                        <div className="mt-2">
                          <div className="w-full bg-gray-200 rounded-full h-2">
                            <div 
                              className={`h-2 rounded-full ${
                                risk.current <= risk.target ? 'bg-green-500' : 'bg-red-500'
                              }`}
                              style={{width: `${(risk.current / risk.target) * 100}%`}}
                            />
                          </div>
                        </div>
                      </div>
                    ))}
                  </div>
                </CardContent>
              </Card>
            </div>
          </TabsContent>
        </Tabs>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

## FILE: client/src/pages/AIIntelligence.tsx
```
import { useState } from 'react';
import { useMutation } from '@tanstack/react-query';
import { Card, CardContent, CardDescription, CardHeader, CardTitle } from '@/components/ui/card';
import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button';
import { Textarea } from '@/components/ui/textarea';
import { Select, SelectContent, SelectItem, SelectTrigger, SelectValue } from '@/components/ui/select';
import { Badge } from '@/components/ui/badge';
import { Progress } from '@/components/ui/progress';
import { Alert, AlertDescription } from '@/components/ui/alert';
import { Brain, Zap, TrendingUp, AlertTriangle, Clock, Users, DollarSign, CheckCircle } from 'lucide-react';
import { apiRequest } from '@/lib/queryClient';

interface AIAnalysis {
  confidence: number;
  timeToResolution: string;
  criticalityScore: number;
  recommendations: string[];
  riskFactors: string[];
  immediateActions: string[];
  resourceRequirements: {
    budget?: string;
    personnel?: string;
    timeline?: string;
  };
  stakeholders: string[];
  predictedOutcome: string;
  alternativeScenarios: Array<{
    name: string;
    probability: number;
    description: string;
    outcome: string;
  }>;
}

export default function AIIntelligence() {
  const [scenario, setScenario] = useState({
    title: '',
    description: '',
    context: '',
    analysisType: 'comprehensive'
  });
  const [analysis, setAnalysis] = useState<AIAnalysis | null>(null);

  const analysisMutation = useMutation({
    mutationFn: async (data: { scenario: { title: string; description: string }; context: string; analysis_type: string }) => {
      const response = await apiRequest('/api/ai/analyze-scenario', 'POST', data);
      return response as AIAnalysis;
    },
    onSuccess: (data) => {
      setAnalysis(data);
    },
    onError: (error) => {
      console.error('Analysis failed:', error);
    }
  });

  const handleAnalyze = () => {
    if (!scenario.title || !scenario.description) return;
    
    analysisMutation.mutate({
      scenario: { title: scenario.title, description: scenario.description },
      context: scenario.context,
      analysis_type: scenario.analysisType
    });
  };

  const loadSampleScenario = (type: string) => {
    const samples = {
      supply_chain: {
        title: "Supply Chain Disruption - Major Supplier Failure",
        description: "Key automotive parts supplier has filed for bankruptcy, affecting 40% of production capacity. Immediate response required to maintain customer deliveries.",
        context: "Manufacturing company with global operations facing critical supply chain disruption"
      },
      cybersecurity: {
        title: "Data Security Breach - Customer Information Compromised", 
        description: "Unauthorized access detected on customer database systems. Potential breach affecting 100,000+ customer records requiring immediate investigation and response.",
        context: "Healthcare organization handling sensitive patient data with HIPAA compliance requirements"
      },
      market_expansion: {
        title: "European Market Expansion Opportunity",
        description: "Post-Brexit regulatory changes create opportunity for financial services expansion into European markets. Estimated $500M+ revenue potential over 3 years.",
        context: "US-based financial services firm evaluating international growth opportunities"
      }
    };
    
    const sample = samples[type as keyof typeof samples];
    if (sample) {
      setScenario({ ...scenario, ...sample });
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="min-h-screen bg-gradient-to-br from-slate-50 via-blue-50 to-indigo-100">
      <div className="container mx-auto px-6 py-8">
        {/* Header */}
        <div className="mb-8">
          <div className="flex items-center space-x-3 mb-4">
            <Brain className="w-8 h-8 text-indigo-600" />
            <h1 className="text-4xl font-bold bg-gradient-to-r from-indigo-600 to-purple-600 bg-clip-text text-transparent">
              AI Intelligence Engine
            </h1>
          </div>
          <p className="text-xl text-gray-600 mb-6">
            Advanced scenario analysis powered by GPT-5 AI technology
          </p>
        </div>

        <div className="grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-2 gap-8">
          {/* Input Panel */}
          <div className="space-y-6">
            <Card className="bg-white/80 backdrop-blur-sm border-0 shadow-md">
              <CardHeader>
                <CardTitle className="flex items-center space-x-2">
                  <Zap className="w-5 h-5 text-yellow-500" />
                  <span>Scenario Input</span>
                </CardTitle>
                <CardDescription>
                  Enter your strategic scenario for AI-powered analysis
                </CardDescription>
              </CardHeader>
              <CardContent className="space-y-4">
                {/* Sample Scenarios */}
                <div>
                  <label className="text-sm font-medium mb-2 block">Quick Start Samples:</label>
                  <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-2">
                    <Button
                      size="sm"
                      variant="outline"
                      onClick={() => loadSampleScenario('supply_chain')}
                      data-testid="button-sample-supply-chain"
                    >
                      Supply Chain Crisis
                    </Button>
                    <Button
                      size="sm"
                      variant="outline" 
                      onClick={() => loadSampleScenario('cybersecurity')}
                      data-testid="button-sample-cybersecurity"
                    >
                      Cybersecurity Breach
                    </Button>
                    <Button
                      size="sm"
                      variant="outline"
                      onClick={() => loadSampleScenario('market_expansion')}
                      data-testid="button-sample-market-expansion"
                    >
                      Market Expansion
                    </Button>
                  </div>
                </div>

                <div>
                  <label className="text-sm font-medium mb-2 block">Scenario Title *</label>
                  <input
                    type="text"
                    className="w-full px-3 py-2 border border-gray-300 rounded-md focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-indigo-500"
                    placeholder="Enter scenario title..."
                    value={scenario.title}
                    onChange={(e) => setScenario({ ...scenario, title: e.target.value })}
                    data-testid="input-scenario-title"
                  />
                </div>

                <div>
                  <label className="text-sm font-medium mb-2 block">Description *</label>
                  <Textarea
                    placeholder="Describe the scenario in detail..."
                    rows={4}
                    value={scenario.description}
                    onChange={(e) => setScenario({ ...scenario, description: e.target.value })}
                    data-testid="textarea-scenario-description"
                  />
                </div>

                <div>
                  <label className="text-sm font-medium mb-2 block">Business Context</label>
                  <Textarea
                    placeholder="Additional context about your organization, industry, or specific circumstances..."
                    rows={3}
                    value={scenario.context}
                    onChange={(e) => setScenario({ ...scenario, context: e.target.value })}
                    data-testid="textarea-scenario-context"
                  />
                </div>

                <div>
                  <label className="text-sm font-medium mb-2 block">Analysis Type</label>
                  <Select value={scenario.analysisType} onValueChange={(value) => setScenario({ ...scenario, analysisType: value })}>
                    <SelectTrigger data-testid="select-analysis-type">
                      <SelectValue />
                    </SelectTrigger>
                    <SelectContent>
                      <SelectItem value="comprehensive">Comprehensive Analysis</SelectItem>
                      <SelectItem value="crisis_response">Crisis Response</SelectItem>
                      <SelectItem value="opportunity_assessment">Opportunity Assessment</SelectItem>
                      <SelectItem value="risk_analysis">Risk Analysis</SelectItem>
                    </SelectContent>
                  </Select>
                </div>

                <Button
                  onClick={handleAnalyze}
                  disabled={!scenario.title || !scenario.description || analysisMutation.isPending}
                  className="w-full"
                  data-testid="button-analyze-scenario"
                >
                  {analysisMutation.isPending ? (
                    <>
                      <Brain className="w-4 h-4 mr-2 animate-spin" />
                      Analyzing...
                    </>
                  ) : (
                    <>
                      <Brain className="w-4 h-4 mr-2" />
                      Analyze Scenario
                    </>
                  )}
                </Button>
              </CardContent>
            </Card>
          </div>

          {/* Results Panel */}
          <div className="space-y-6">
            {analysis && (
              <>
                {/* Confidence & Overview */}
                <Card className="bg-white/80 backdrop-blur-sm border-0 shadow-md">
                  <CardHeader>
                    <CardTitle className="flex items-center justify-between">
                      <span className="flex items-center space-x-2">
                        <CheckCircle className="w-5 h-5 text-green-500" />
                        <span>Analysis Complete</span>
                      </span>
                      <Badge className="bg-green-100 text-green-800">
                        {(analysis.confidence * 100).toFixed(1)}% Confidence
                      </Badge>
                    </CardTitle>
                  </CardHeader>
                  <CardContent>
                    <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-4 mb-4">
                      <div>
                        <p className="text-sm text-gray-600">Time to Resolution</p>
                        <p className="font-semibold">{analysis.timeToResolution}</p>
                      </div>
                      <div>
                        <p className="text-sm text-gray-600">Criticality Score</p>
                        <p className="font-semibold">{analysis.criticalityScore}/10</p>
                      </div>
                    </div>
                    <div>
                      <p className="text-sm text-gray-600 mb-2">Confidence Level</p>
                      <Progress value={analysis.confidence * 100} className="h-2" />
                    </div>
                  </CardContent>
                </Card>

                {/* Recommendations */}
                <Card className="bg-white/80 backdrop-blur-sm border-0 shadow-md">
                  <CardHeader>
                    <CardTitle className="flex items-center space-x-2">
                      <TrendingUp className="w-5 h-5 text-blue-500" />
                      <span>AI Recommendations</span>
                    </CardTitle>
                  </CardHeader>
                  <CardContent>
                    <ul className="space-y-2">
                      {analysis.recommendations.map((rec, index) => (
                        <li key={index} className="flex items-start space-x-2" data-testid={`recommendation-${index}`}>
                          <CheckCircle className="w-4 h-4 text-green-500 mt-0.5 flex-shrink-0" />
                          <span className="text-sm">{rec}</span>
                        </li>
                      ))}
                    </ul>
                  </CardContent>
                </Card>

                {/* Risk Factors */}
                {analysis.riskFactors.length > 0 && (
                  <Card className="bg-white/80 backdrop-blur-sm border-0 shadow-md">
                    <CardHeader>
                      <CardTitle className="flex items-center space-x-2">
                        <AlertTriangle className="w-5 h-5 text-orange-500" />
                        <span>Risk Factors</span>
                      </CardTitle>
                    </CardHeader>
                    <CardContent>
                      <ul className="space-y-2">
                        {analysis.riskFactors.map((risk, index) => (
                          <li key={index} className="flex items-start space-x-2" data-testid={`risk-factor-${index}`}>
                            <AlertTriangle className="w-4 h-4 text-orange-500 mt-0.5 flex-shrink-0" />
                            <span className="text-sm">{risk}</span>
                          </li>
                        ))}
                      </ul>
                    </CardContent>
                  </Card>
                )}

                {/* Immediate Actions */}
                {analysis.immediateActions.length > 0 && (
                  <Card className="bg-white/80 backdrop-blur-sm border-0 shadow-md">
                    <CardHeader>
                      <CardTitle className="flex items-center space-x-2">
                        <Clock className="w-5 h-5 text-red-500" />
                        <span>Immediate Actions</span>
                      </CardTitle>
                    </CardHeader>
                    <CardContent>
                      <ul className="space-y-2">
                        {analysis.immediateActions.map((action, index) => (
                          <li key={index} className="flex items-start space-x-2" data-testid={`immediate-action-${index}`}>
                            <Zap className="w-4 h-4 text-red-500 mt-0.5 flex-shrink-0" />
                            <span className="text-sm">{action}</span>
                          </li>
                        ))}
                      </ul>
                    </CardContent>
                  </Card>
                )}

                {/* Resource Requirements */}
                {Object.keys(analysis.resourceRequirements).length > 0 && (
                  <Card className="bg-white/80 backdrop-blur-sm border-0 shadow-md">
                    <CardHeader>
                      <CardTitle className="flex items-center space-x-2">
                        <DollarSign className="w-5 h-5 text-green-500" />
                        <span>Resource Requirements</span>
                      </CardTitle>
                    </CardHeader>
                    <CardContent>
                      <div className="space-y-3">
                        {analysis.resourceRequirements.budget && (
                          <div>
                            <p className="text-sm text-gray-600">Budget</p>
                            <p className="font-semibold">{analysis.resourceRequirements.budget}</p>
                          </div>
                        )}
                        {analysis.resourceRequirements.personnel && (
                          <div>
                            <p className="text-sm text-gray-600">Personnel</p>
                            <p className="font-semibold">{analysis.resourceRequirements.personnel}</p>
                          </div>
                        )}
                        {analysis.resourceRequirements.timeline && (
                          <div>
                            <p className="text-sm text-gray-600">Timeline</p>
                            <p className="font-semibold">{analysis.resourceRequirements.timeline}</p>
                          </div>
                        )}
                      </div>
                    </CardContent>
                  </Card>
                )}

                {/* Stakeholders */}
                {analysis.stakeholders.length > 0 && (
                  <Card className="bg-white/80 backdrop-blur-sm border-0 shadow-md">
                    <CardHeader>
                      <CardTitle className="flex items-center space-x-2">
                        <Users className="w-5 h-5 text-purple-500" />
                        <span>Key Stakeholders</span>
                      </CardTitle>
                    </CardHeader>
                    <CardContent>
                      <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-2">
                        {analysis.stakeholders.map((stakeholder, index) => (
                          <Badge key={index} variant="outline" data-testid={`stakeholder-${index}`}>
                            {stakeholder}
                          </Badge>
                        ))}
                      </div>
                    </CardContent>
                  </Card>
                )}

                {/* Alternative Scenarios */}
                {analysis.alternativeScenarios.length > 0 && (
                  <Card className="bg-white/80 backdrop-blur-sm border-0 shadow-md">
                    <CardHeader>
                      <CardTitle>Alternative Scenarios</CardTitle>
                    </CardHeader>
                    <CardContent>
                      <div className="space-y-4">
                        {analysis.alternativeScenarios.map((alt, index) => (
                          <div key={index} className="border rounded-lg p-4" data-testid={`alternative-scenario-${index}`}>
                            <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-2">
                              <h4 className="font-semibold">{alt.name}</h4>
                              <Badge variant="outline">
                                {(alt.probability * 100).toFixed(0)}% probability
                              </Badge>
                            </div>
                            <p className="text-sm text-gray-600 mb-2">{alt.description}</p>
                            <p className="text-sm"><strong>Outcome:</strong> {alt.outcome}</p>
                          </div>
                        ))}
                      </div>
                    </CardContent>
                  </Card>
                )}
              </>
            )}

            {/* No Analysis State */}
            {!analysis && !analysisMutation.isPending && (
              <Card className="bg-white/80 backdrop-blur-sm border-0 shadow-md text-center py-12">
                <CardContent>
                  <Brain className="w-16 h-16 text-gray-400 mx-auto mb-4" />
                  <h3 className="text-lg font-medium text-gray-600 mb-2">AI Analysis Ready</h3>
                  <p className="text-gray-500">
                    Enter a scenario to receive comprehensive AI-powered analysis and recommendations
                  </p>
                </CardContent>
              </Card>
            )}

            {/* Error State */}
            {analysisMutation.isError && (
              <Alert>
                <AlertTriangle className="w-4 h-4" />
                <AlertDescription>
                  Analysis failed. Please try again or check your scenario details.
                </AlertDescription>
              </Alert>
            )}
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

import { useState } from "react";
import { useQuery, useMutation, useQueryClient } from "@tanstack/react-query";
import { Card, CardContent, CardDescription, CardHeader, CardTitle } from "@/components/ui/card";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { Badge } from "@/components/ui/badge";
import { Tabs, TabsContent, TabsList, TabsTrigger } from "@/components/ui/tabs";
import { useToast } from "@/hooks/use-toast";
import { apiRequest } from "@/lib/queryClient";
import { 
  Database, 
  Server, 
  Zap, 
  BarChart3, 
  Users, 
  Building, 
  Target,
  TrendingUp,
  Brain,
  Activity,
  Lightbulb,
  Gauge,
  CheckCircle,
  AlertCircle,
  Clock,
  Play
} from "lucide-react";

export default function BackendDemo() {
  const [activeDemo, setActiveDemo] = useState('overview');
  const [demoResults, setDemoResults] = useState<any>(null);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
  const { toast } = useToast();

  // Seed enterprise data
  const seedDataMutation = useMutation({
    mutationFn: async () => {
      return await apiRequest('/api/dev/seed-data', { method: 'POST' });
    },
    onSuccess: (data) => {
      setDemoResults(data);
      toast({
        title: "Enterprise Data Seeded",
        description: `Created ${data.organizations.length} organizations and ${data.projects.length} projects`,
      });
    },
    onError: (error) => {
      toast({
        title: "Seeding Failed",
        description: "Failed to seed enterprise data",
        variant: "destructive",
      });
    },
  });

  // Test API endpoints
  const testEndpoint = async (endpoint: string, method: string = 'GET', title: string) => {
    setLoading(true);
    try {
      const response = await fetch(`/api${endpoint}`, {
        method,
        headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' }
      });
      const data = await response.json();
      setDemoResults(data);
      toast({
        title: `${title} Test`,
        description: `API endpoint working: ${response.status}`,
      });
    } catch (error) {
      toast({
        title: "API Test Failed",
        description: `Endpoint ${endpoint} failed`,
        variant: "destructive",
      });
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  const BackendCapabilities = () => (
    <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-6">
      <Card className="bg-gradient-to-br from-blue-50 to-indigo-100 border-indigo-200">
        <CardHeader>
          <CardTitle className="flex items-center gap-2 text-indigo-700">
            <Database className="h-5 w-5" />
            Enterprise Schema
          </CardTitle>
          <CardDescription>
            Comprehensive PostgreSQL database with 12 core tables
          </CardDescription>
        </CardHeader>
        <CardContent>
          <div className="space-y-2">
            <Badge variant="secondary">Organizations</Badge>
            <Badge variant="secondary">Projects</Badge>
            <Badge variant="secondary">Strategic Scenarios</Badge>
            <Badge variant="secondary">Pulse Metrics</Badge>
            <Badge variant="secondary">Flux Adaptations</Badge>
            <Badge variant="secondary">Prism Insights</Badge>
          </div>
        </CardContent>
      </Card>

      <Card className="bg-gradient-to-br from-green-50 to-emerald-100 border-emerald-200">
        <CardHeader>
          <CardTitle className="flex items-center gap-2 text-emerald-700">
            <Server className="h-5 w-5" />
            RESTful API
          </CardTitle>
          <CardDescription>
            50+ endpoints covering all platform functionality
          </CardDescription>
        </CardHeader>
        <CardContent>
          <div className="space-y-2">
            <Badge variant="secondary">CRUD Operations</Badge>
            <Badge variant="secondary">Real-time WebSockets</Badge>
            <Badge variant="secondary">Authentication</Badge>
            <Badge variant="secondary">Analytics</Badge>
            <Badge variant="secondary">Error Handling</Badge>
            <Badge variant="secondary">Input Validation</Badge>
          </div>
        </CardContent>
      </Card>

      <Card className="bg-gradient-to-br from-purple-50 to-violet-100 border-violet-200">
        <CardHeader>
          <CardTitle className="flex items-center gap-2 text-violet-700">
            <Brain className="h-5 w-5" />
            Intelligence Engine
          </CardTitle>
          <CardDescription>
            Advanced analytics and adaptability scoring
          </CardDescription>
        </CardHeader>
        <CardContent>
          <div className="space-y-2">
            <Badge variant="secondary">Adaptability Scores</Badge>
            <Badge variant="secondary">Usage Analytics</Badge>
            <Badge variant="secondary">Real-time Metrics</Badge>
            <Badge variant="secondary">Cultural Insights</Badge>
            <Badge variant="secondary">Innovation Tracking</Badge>
            <Badge variant="secondary">Automated Reports</Badge>
          </div>
        </CardContent>
      </Card>
    </div>
  );

  const APIEndpoints = () => (
    <div className="grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-2 gap-6">
      <Card>
        <CardHeader>
          <CardTitle className="flex items-center gap-2">
            <Building className="h-5 w-5 text-blue-600" />
            Organization Management
          </CardTitle>
        </CardHeader>
        <CardContent className="space-y-3">
          <Button 
            variant="outline" 
            className="w-full justify-start" 
            onClick={() => testEndpoint('/organizations', 'GET', 'Organizations')}
            disabled={loading}
          >
            <Target className="h-4 w-4 mr-2" />
            GET /api/organizations
          </Button>
          <Button 
            variant="outline" 
            className="w-full justify-start" 
            onClick={() => testEndpoint('/organizations/dashboard', 'GET', 'Dashboard')}
            disabled={loading}
          >
            <BarChart3 className="h-4 w-4 mr-2" />
            GET /api/organizations/:id/dashboard
          </Button>
          <Button 
            variant="outline" 
            className="w-full justify-start" 
            onClick={() => testEndpoint('/organizations/adaptability-score', 'GET', 'Adaptability')}
            disabled={loading}
          >
            <Gauge className="h-4 w-4 mr-2" />
            GET /api/organizations/:id/adaptability-score
          </Button>
        </CardContent>
      </Card>

      <Card>
        <CardHeader>
          <CardTitle className="flex items-center gap-2">
            <Activity className="h-5 w-5 text-red-600" />
            Pulse Metrics (Real-time)
          </CardTitle>
        </CardHeader>
        <CardContent className="space-y-3">

            onClick={() => testEndpoint('/pulse-metrics', 'POST', 'Record Metric')}
            disabled={loading}
          >
            <Zap className="h-4 w-4 mr-2" />
            POST /api/pulse-metrics
          </Button>
        </CardContent>
      </Card>

      <Card>
        <CardHeader>
          <CardTitle className="flex items-center gap-2">
            <Brain className="h-5 w-5 text-purple-600" />
            Prism Insights (Intelligence)
          </CardTitle>
        </CardHeader>
        <CardContent className="space-y-3">
          <Button 
            variant="outline" 
            className="w-full justify-start" 
            onClick={() => testEndpoint('/prism-insights', 'GET', 'Insights')}
            disabled={loading}
          >
            <Lightbulb className="h-4 w-4 mr-2" />
            GET /api/organizations/:id/prism-insights
          </Button>
          <Button 
            variant="outline" 
            className="w-full justify-start" 
            onClick={() => testEndpoint('/prism-insights', 'POST', 'Create Insight')}
            disabled={loading}
          >
            <Brain className="h-4 w-4 mr-2" />
            POST /api/prism-insights
          </Button>
        </CardContent>
      </Card>

      <Card>

          </CardTitle>
        </CardHeader>
        <CardContent className="space-y-3">
          <Button

          >
            <Users className="h-4 w-4 mr-2" />

export default function CompetitiveComparison() {
  const [selectedCategory, setSelectedCategory] = useState("overview");

  const getScoreColor = (score: number) => {
    if (score >= 90) return "text-green-600";
    if (score >= 75) return "text-blue-600";
    if (score >= 60) return "text-yellow-600";
    return "text-red-600";
  };

  const getScoreBadge = (score: number) => {
    if (score >= 90) return "bg-green-100 text-green-800 border-green-300";
    if (score >= 75) return "bg-blue-100 text-blue-800 border-blue-300";
    if (score >= 60) return "bg-yellow-100 text-yellow-800 border-yellow-300";
    return "bg-red-100 text-red-800 border-red-300";
  };

  return (
    <div className="p-6 space-y-6 max-w-7xl mx-auto">

          </h1>

            Market Analysis 2024
          </Badge>
        </div>

        </p>
      </div>

          <TabsTrigger value="recommendations">Recommendations</TabsTrigger>
        </TabsList>

        <TabsContent value="overview" className="space-y-6">
          {/* Platform Comparison Grid */}
          <div className="grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-2 gap-6">
            {Object.entries(competitorData).map(([name, data]) => (

export default function ConsolidatedPitch() {
  const [currentSlide, setCurrentSlide] = useState(0);
  const [isFullscreen, setIsFullscreen] = useState(false);

  const nextSlide = () => {
    setCurrentSlide((prev) => (prev + 1) % pitchSlides.length);
  };

  const prevSlide = () => {
    setCurrentSlide((prev) => (prev - 1 + pitchSlides.length) % pitchSlides.length);
  };

  const slide = pitchSlides[currentSlide];

  return (
    <div className={`${isFullscreen ? 'fixed inset-0 z-50 bg-white' : 'min-h-screen'} flex flex-col bg-gradient-to-br from-slate-50 to-blue-50`}>
      {/* Header */}
      {!isFullscreen && (
        <div className="bg-white shadow-sm border-b p-4">
          <div className="flex items-center justify-between max-w-7xl mx-auto">
            <h1 className="text-xl font-bold text-slate-900">Veridius Investor Presentation</h1>
            <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
              <Badge variant="outline">
                Slide {currentSlide + 1} of {pitchSlides.length}
              </Badge>
              <Button 
                variant="outline" 
                size="sm"
                onClick={() => setIsFullscreen(!isFullscreen)}
              >
                {isFullscreen ? 'Exit' : 'Present'}
              </Button>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Main Content */}
      <div className="flex-1 flex items-center justify-center p-8">
        <div className="w-full max-w-6xl">
          <Card className="shadow-xl border-0 bg-white/90 backdrop-blur-sm">
            <CardHeader className="text-center border-b bg-white/50">
              <CardTitle className="text-2xl font-bold text-slate-900">
                {slide.title}
              </CardTitle>
            </CardHeader>
            <CardContent className="p-12">
              {slide.content}
            </CardContent>
          </Card>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Navigation */}
      <div className="bg-white/80 backdrop-blur-sm border-t p-4">
        <div className="flex items-center justify-between max-w-6xl mx-auto">
          <Button 
            variant="outline" 
            onClick={prevSlide}
            disabled={currentSlide === 0}
          >
            <ChevronLeft className="w-4 h-4 mr-2" />
            Previous
          </Button>
          
          <div className="flex items-center gap-4">
            <Progress 
              value={(currentSlide + 1) / pitchSlides.length * 100} 
              className="w-32"
            />
            <span className="text-sm text-slate-600">
              {currentSlide + 1} / {pitchSlides.length}
            </span>
          </div>
          
          <Button 
            variant="outline" 
            onClick={nextSlide}
            disabled={currentSlide === pitchSlides.length - 1}
          >
            Next
            <ChevronRight className="w-4 h-4 ml-2" />
          </Button>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

import React, { useState } from 'react';

const CoreWorkflow = () => {
  const [currentStep, setCurrentStep] = useState(1);

    organization: '',
    industry: '',
    challenge: '',
    urgency: '',
    impact: '',
    resources: '',
    timeline: ''
  });

    { id: 1, title: 'Organization', description: 'Tell us about your company' },
    { id: 2, title: 'Challenge', description: 'Define the threat or opportunity' },
    { id: 3, title: 'Strategy', description: 'AI generates your response plan' },
    { id: 4, title: 'Execute', description: 'Get your implementation roadmap' }
  ];

  const progress = (currentStep / steps.length) * 100;

  const nextStep = () => {
    if (currentStep < steps.length) {
      setCurrentStep(currentStep + 1);
    }
  };

  const prevStep = () => {
    if (currentStep > 1) {
      setCurrentStep(currentStep - 1);
    }
  };

  const updateFormData = (field: string, value: string) => {

  };

  const renderStep = () => {
    switch (currentStep) {

                  placeholder="e.g., Acme Corporation"
                  value={formData.organization}
                  onChange={(e) => updateFormData('organization', e.target.value)}

                />
              </div>
              
              <div>
                <label className="block text-sm font-semibold mb-2">Industry</label>
                <Select value={formData.industry} onValueChange={(value) => updateFormData('industry', value)}>

                    <SelectValue placeholder="Select your industry" />
                  </SelectTrigger>

                    <SelectItem value="technology">Technology</SelectItem>

                    <SelectItem value="energy">Energy & Utilities</SelectItem>
                    <SelectItem value="consulting">Professional Services</SelectItem>
                    <SelectItem value="other">Other</SelectItem>
                  </SelectContent>
                </Select>
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>
        );

      case 2:
        return (
          <div className="space-y-6">
            <div className="text-center">
              <h3 className="text-2xl font-bold mb-2">What's the challenge or opportunity?</h3>
              <p className="text-muted-foreground">Describe the situation you need to address</p>
            </div>
            
            <div className="grid gap-6 max-w-2xl mx-auto">
              <div>
                <label className="block text-sm font-semibold mb-2">Challenge Description</label>
                <textarea 
                  placeholder="e.g., A new competitor launched a product that threatens our market share..."
                  value={formData.challenge}
                  onChange={(e) => updateFormData('challenge', e.target.value)}
