```
import { useState } from "react";
import { useMutation, useQueryClient } from "@tanstack/react-query";
import { Card, CardContent, CardDescription, CardHeader, CardTitle } from "@/components/ui/card";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { Badge } from "@/components/ui/badge";
import { useToast } from "@/hooks/use-toast";
import { apiRequest } from "@/lib/queryClient";
import { 
  Database, 
  Trash2, 
  RefreshCw, 
  CheckCircle, 
  AlertTriangle,
  Zap,
  Target,
  DollarSign,
  BarChart3,
  Play,
  Square,
  Settings
} from "lucide-react";

export default function DemoManager() {
  const [isSeeding, setIsSeeding] = useState(false);
  const { toast } = useToast();
  const queryClient = useQueryClient();

  const seedMutation = useMutation({
    mutationFn: () => apiRequest('/api/demo/seed', 'POST'),
    onMutate: () => setIsSeeding(true),
    onSuccess: (data) => {
      toast({ 
        title: "Demo data loaded successfully",
        description: `Loaded ${data.counts.kpis} KPIs, ${data.counts.initiatives} initiatives, ${data.counts.triggers} triggers, and ${data.counts.budgets} budgets`
      });
      // Invalidate all relevant queries to refresh the UI
      queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ['/api/mvp/kpis'] });
      queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ['/api/mvp/initiatives'] });
      queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ['/api/mvp/triggers'] });
      queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ['/api/mvp/budgets'] });
      setIsSeeding(false);
    },
    onError: () => {
      toast({ 
        title: "Failed to load demo data",
        description: "Please try again or check the system logs",
        variant: "destructive"
      });
      setIsSeeding(false);
    },
  });

  const clearMutation = useMutation({
    mutationFn: () => apiRequest('/api/demo/clear', 'POST'),
    onSuccess: () => {
      toast({ 
        title: "Demo data cleared successfully",
        description: "Ready for fresh data input"
      });
      // Invalidate all relevant queries to refresh the UI
      queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ['/api/mvp/kpis'] });
      queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ['/api/mvp/initiatives'] });
      queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ['/api/mvp/triggers'] });
      queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ['/api/mvp/budgets'] });
    },
    onError: () => {
      toast({ 
        title: "Failed to clear demo data",
        description: "Please try again or check the system logs",
        variant: "destructive"
      });
    },
  });

  const demoDataSets = [
    {
      title: "KPIs & Metrics",
      description: "Decision velocity, communication efficiency, change enthusiasm, course-correction speed",
      icon: BarChart3,
      count: "5 metrics",
      color: "bg-blue-100 text-blue-800 border-blue-200"
    },
    {
      title: "Strategic Initiatives",
      description: "Digital transformation, resilience framework, supply chain mitigation, customer experience",
      icon: Target,
      count: "5 projects",
      color: "bg-green-100 text-green-800 border-green-200"
    },
    {
      title: "Automated Triggers",
      description: "Market alerts, supply chain monitors, financial variance, regulatory compliance",
      icon: Zap,
      count: "5 triggers",
      color: "bg-yellow-100 text-yellow-800 border-yellow-200"
    },
    {
      title: "Budget Tracking",
      description: "Digital transformation, change management, market intelligence, crisis response",
      icon: DollarSign,
      count: "5 budgets",
      color: "bg-purple-100 text-purple-800 border-purple-200"
    }
  ];

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6 p-6">
      <div className="text-center space-y-4">
        <h1 className="text-4xl font-black text-foreground">Demo Manager</h1>
        <p className="text-muted-foreground max-w-3xl mx-auto">
          Choose between demo mode with pre-loaded organizational data for presentations, 
          or production mode for real business data input and management with Veridius by Veridius.
        </p>
      </div>

      {/* Mode Selection Cards */}
      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-2 gap-6">
        {/* Demo Mode */}
        <Card className="border-2 border-blue-200 bg-blue-50/50">
          <CardHeader>
            <CardTitle className="flex items-center gap-3">
              <div className="p-2 rounded-lg bg-blue-100">
                <Play className="w-6 h-6 text-blue-600" />
              </div>
              Demo Mode
              <Badge className="bg-blue-100 text-blue-800 border-blue-200">
                For Presentations
              </Badge>
            </CardTitle>
            <CardDescription>
              Pre-loaded with realistic organizational data showcasing Veridius capabilities. 
              Perfect for executive demos, sales presentations, and stakeholder showcases.
            </CardDescription>
          </CardHeader>
          <CardContent className="space-y-4">
            <div className="grid grid-cols-1 gap-3">
              {demoDataSets.map((dataset, index) => (
                <div key={index} className="flex items-center justify-between p-3 bg-white rounded-lg border">
                  <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
                    <dataset.icon className="w-5 h-5 text-muted-foreground" />
                    <div>
                      <h4 className="font-medium text-sm">{dataset.title}</h4>
                      <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">{dataset.description}</p>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                  <Badge className={dataset.color}>{dataset.count}</Badge>
                </div>
              ))}
            </div>
            
            <div className="pt-4 border-t">
              <Button 
                onClick={() => seedMutation.mutate()} 
                disabled={seedMutation.isPending || isSeeding}
                className="w-full bg-blue-600 hover:bg-blue-700"
              >
                {seedMutation.isPending || isSeeding ? (
                  <>
                    <RefreshCw className="w-4 h-4 mr-2 animate-spin" />
                    Loading Demo Data...
                  </>
                ) : (
                  <>
                    <Database className="w-4 h-4 mr-2" />
                    Load Demo Data
                  </>

              <Badge className="bg-green-100 text-green-800 border-green-200">
                For Real Business
              </Badge>
            </CardTitle>
            <CardDescription>
              Clean slate for inputting your actual organizational data. 
              Build your real resilience platform with authentic business information.
            </CardDescription>
          </CardHeader>
          <CardContent className="space-y-4">
            <div className="space-y-3">
              <div className="flex items-center gap-3 p-3 bg-white rounded-lg border">
                <CheckCircle className="w-5 h-5 text-green-600" />
                <div>
                  <h4 className="font-medium text-sm">Your Organizational Data</h4>
                  <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">Input real KPIs, initiatives, triggers, and budgets</p>
                </div>
              </div>
              <div className="flex items-center gap-3 p-3 bg-white rounded-lg border">
                <CheckCircle className="w-5 h-5 text-green-600" />
                <div>
                  <h4 className="font-medium text-sm">Persistent Storage</h4>
                  <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">All data saved to your database permanently</p>

                <CheckCircle className="w-5 h-5 text-green-600" />
```

```
import { useState, useEffect } from 'react';

import { Badge } from '@/components/ui/badge';
import { Progress } from '@/components/ui/progress';
import { Tabs, TabsContent, TabsList, TabsTrigger } from '@/components/ui/tabs';
import { Alert, AlertDescription, AlertTitle } from '@/components/ui/alert';
import { 
  TrendingUp, 
  TrendingDown,
  AlertTriangle,
  CheckCircle,
  Clock,
  Users,
  Target,
  Zap,
  Brain,
  Activity,
  DollarSign,
  BarChart3,
  PieChart,
  LineChart,
  Calendar,
  Play,
  Pause,
  Settings,
  RefreshCw
} from 'lucide-react';

interface ExecutiveMetric {
  name: string;
  value: string;
  change: string;
  status: 'excellent' | 'good' | 'warning' | 'critical';
  trend: 'up' | 'down' | 'stable';
}

interface OrganizationHealth {
  overallScore: number;
  trends: {
    agility: string;
    efficiency: string;
    innovation: string;
  };
}

interface ExecutiveDashboardData {
  organizationHealth: OrganizationHealth;
  keyMetrics: ExecutiveMetric[];
  activeScenarios: number;
  pendingDecisions: number;
  criticalAlerts: number;
  productSuite?: {
    mainProducts: Array<{
      name: string;
      description: string;
      features: string[];
      maturity: string;
      adoptionRate: number;
    }>;
    enterpriseCapabilities?: Array<{
      name: string;
      description: string;
      features: string[];
      maturity: string;
      roi?: string;
      savings?: string;
    }>;
    marketDominationTools?: Array<{
      name: string;
      description: string;
      features: string[];
      maturity: string;
      growthMultiplier?: string;
      integrations?: number;
    }>;
    totalProducts: number;
    totalModules: number;
    deployedModules: number;
    platformHealth: number;
  };
}

const StatusIcon = ({ status }: { status: string }) => {
  switch (status) {
    case 'excellent':
      return <CheckCircle className="h-4 w-4 text-green-500" />;
    case 'good':
      return <TrendingUp className="h-4 w-4 text-blue-500" />;
    case 'warning':
      return <Clock className="h-4 w-4 text-yellow-500" />;
    case 'critical':
      return <AlertTriangle className="h-4 w-4 text-red-500" />;
    default:
      return <Activity className="h-4 w-4 text-gray-500" />;
  }
};

const TrendIcon = ({ trend }: { trend: string }) => {
  switch (trend) {
    case 'up':
      return <TrendingUp className="h-3 w-3 text-green-500" />;
    case 'down':
      return <TrendingDown className="h-3 w-3 text-red-500" />;
    default:
      return <Activity className="h-3 w-3 text-gray-500" />;
  }
};

export function ExecutiveDashboard() {
  const [selectedTimeframe, setSelectedTimeframe] = useState('week');
  const [isLive, setIsLive] = useState(true);
  const [, navigate] = useLocation();

  // Fetch organization info first
  const { data: organization } = useQuery({
    queryKey: ['/api/organizations/by-domain/techcorp.com'],
    enabled: true,
  });

  // Fetch executive dashboard data
  const { data, isLoading, refetch } = useQuery<ExecutiveDashboardData>({
    queryKey: ['/api/executive-dashboard', organization?.id || 'fb14a163-ca77-4eb9-a5cc-579d5085abf9'],
    enabled: true,
    refetchInterval: isLive ? 30000 : false, // Refresh every 30 seconds if live
  });

  // Fetch recent scenarios
  const { data: scenarios } = useQuery({
    queryKey: ['/api/strategic-scenarios'],
    enabled: true,
  });

  // Fetch real-time metrics
  const { data: pulseMetrics } = useQuery({
    queryKey: ['/api/pulse-metrics', organization?.id || 'fb14a163-ca77-4eb9-a5cc-579d5085abf9'],
    enabled: true,
    refetchInterval: isLive ? 15000 : false,
  });

  if (isLoading) {
    return (
      <div className="min-h-screen bg-gradient-to-br from-slate-900 via-blue-900 to-indigo-900 p-6">
        <div className="container mx-auto">
          <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-6 mb-8">
            {[1, 2, 3, 4].map((i) => (
              <Card key={i} className="backdrop-blur-sm bg-white/10 border-white/20">
                <CardContent className="p-6">
                  <div className="animate-pulse">
                    <div className="h-4 bg-white/20 rounded w-3/4 mb-2"></div>
                    <div className="h-8 bg-white/20 rounded w-1/2"></div>
                  </div>
                </CardContent>
              </Card>
            ))}
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    );
  }

  const defaultData: ExecutiveDashboardData = {
    organizationHealth: {
      overallScore: 94,
      trends: {
        agility: '+12%',
        efficiency: '+8%',
        innovation: '+15%'
      }
    },
    keyMetrics: [
      { name: 'Response Speed', value: '4 minutes', change: '-85%', status: 'excellent', trend: 'up' },
      { name: 'Decision Quality', value: '96%', change: '+12%', status: 'excellent', trend: 'up' },

      { name: 'Team Efficiency', value: '92%', change: '+18%', status: 'excellent', trend: 'up' }

              {isLive ? <Pause className="h-4 w-4 mr-2" /> : <Play className="h-4 w-4 mr-2" />}
              {isLive ? 'Live' : 'Paused'}
```

```
                          <div className="text-2xl font-bold text-purple-400">{phase.target}</div>
                        </div>
                        
                        <div className="flex-1 pb-8">
                          <h3 className="text-xl font-bold text-white mb-4">{phase.title}</h3>
                          <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 gap-3">
                            {phase.objectives.map((objective, objIndex) => (
                              <div key={objIndex} className="flex items-center gap-2">
                                <CheckCircle className="h-4 w-4 text-green-400" />
                                <span className="text-blue-200 text-sm">{objective}</span>
                              </div>
                            ))}
                          </div>
                        </div>
                      </div>
                      
                      {index < 3 && (
                        <div className="absolute left-12 top-20 w-0.5 h-8 bg-gradient-to-b from-blue-500 to-purple-500" />
                      )}
                    </div>
                  ))}
                </div>
              </CardContent>
            </Card>
          </TabsContent>
        </Tabs>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
```

```
export default function ResponsePlanningCenter() {
  const [selectedPlan, setSelectedPlan] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [statusFilter, setStatusFilter] = useState('all');
  const [priorityFilter, setPriorityFilter] = useState('all');
  
  const filteredPlans = responsePlans.filter(plan => {
    const matchesStatus = statusFilter === 'all' || plan.status === statusFilter;
    const matchesPriority = priorityFilter === 'all' || plan.priority === priorityFilter;
    return matchesStatus && matchesPriority;
  });

  const getStatusColor = (status: string) => {
    switch (status) {
      case 'active': return 'bg-green-100 text-green-800';
      case 'monitoring': return 'bg-blue-100 text-blue-800';
      case 'draft': return 'bg-gray-100 text-gray-800';
      case 'completed': return 'bg-purple-100 text-purple-800';
      default: return 'bg-gray-100 text-gray-800';
    }
  };

  const getPriorityColor = (priority: string) => {
    switch (priority) {
      case 'critical': return 'bg-red-100 text-red-800';
      case 'high': return 'bg-orange-100 text-orange-800';
      case 'medium': return 'bg-yellow-100 text-yellow-800';
      case 'low': return 'bg-green-100 text-green-800';
      default: return 'bg-gray-100 text-gray-800';
    }
  };

  const getPhaseStatusIcon = (status: string) => {
    switch (status) {
      case 'completed': return <CheckCircle className="h-4 w-4 text-green-500" />;
      case 'in-progress': return <Activity className="h-4 w-4 text-blue-500" />;
      case 'blocked': return <AlertTriangle className="h-4 w-4 text-red-500" />;
      default: return <Clock className="h-4 w-4 text-gray-400" />;
    }
  };

  const formatCurrency = (amount: number) => {
    return new Intl.NumberFormat('en-US', {
      style: 'currency',
      currency: 'USD',
      minimumFractionDigits: 0,
      maximumFractionDigits: 0
    }).format(amount);
  };

  const formatDate = (dateString: string) => {
    return new Date(dateString).toLocaleDateString('en-US', {
      month: 'short',
      day: 'numeric',
      year: 'numeric'
    });
  };

  const plan = selectedPlan ? responsePlans.find(p => p.id === selectedPlan) : null;

  return (
    <div className="min-h-screen bg-gradient-to-br from-indigo-50 via-white to-cyan-50">
      <div className="container mx-auto px-6 py-8">
        {/* Header */}
        <div className="mb-8">
          <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-6">
            <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
              <div className="p-3 bg-indigo-600 rounded-xl text-white">
                <Shield className="h-8 w-8" />
              </div>
              <div>
                <h1 className="text-3xl font-bold bg-gradient-to-r from-indigo-600 to-cyan-600 bg-clip-text text-transparent">
                  Response Planning Center
                </h1>
                <p className="text-gray-600">Live budget tracking and KPI monitoring for active response plans</p>
              </div>
            </div>
            
            <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
              <Select value={statusFilter} onValueChange={setStatusFilter}>
                <SelectTrigger className="w-40">
                  <SelectValue placeholder="Filter by Status" />
                </SelectTrigger>
                <SelectContent>
                  <SelectItem value="all">All Status</SelectItem>
                  <SelectItem value="active">Active</SelectItem>
                  <SelectItem value="monitoring">Monitoring</SelectItem>
                  <SelectItem value="draft">Draft</SelectItem>
                  <SelectItem value="completed">Completed</SelectItem>
                </SelectContent>
              </Select>
              
              <Select value={priorityFilter} onValueChange={setPriorityFilter}>
                <SelectTrigger className="w-40">
                  <SelectValue placeholder="Filter by Priority" />
                </SelectTrigger>
                <SelectContent>
                  <SelectItem value="all">All Priority</SelectItem>
                  <SelectItem value="critical">Critical</SelectItem>
                  <SelectItem value="high">High</SelectItem>
                  <SelectItem value="medium">Medium</SelectItem>
                  <SelectItem value="low">Low</SelectItem>
                </SelectContent>
              </Select>
              
              <Button>
                <Plus className="h-4 w-4 mr-2" />
                New Response Plan
              </Button>
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* Quick Stats */}
          <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-4 gap-6 mb-8">
            <Card className="bg-white/80 backdrop-blur-sm border-0 shadow-lg">
              <CardContent className="p-6">
                <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                  <div>
                    <p className="text-sm text-gray-600">Active Plans</p>
                    <p className="text-2xl font-bold text-green-600">
                      {responsePlans.filter(p => p.status === 'active').length}
                    </p>
                  </div>
                  <div className="p-3 bg-green-100 rounded-lg">
                    <PlayCircle className="h-6 w-6 text-green-600" />
                  </div>
                </div>
                <p className="text-xs text-gray-500 mt-2">Currently executing</p>
              </CardContent>
            </Card>
            
            <Card className="bg-white/80 backdrop-blur-sm border-0 shadow-lg">
              <CardContent className="p-6">
                <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                  <div>
                    <p className="text-sm text-gray-600">Total Budget</p>
                    <p className="text-2xl font-bold text-blue-600">
                      {formatCurrency(responsePlans.reduce((sum, p) => sum + p.budget.allocated, 0))}
                    </p>
                  </div>
                  <div className="p-3 bg-blue-100 rounded-lg">
                    <DollarSign className="h-6 w-6 text-blue-600" />

                <p className="text-xs text-gray-500 mt-2">Across all plans</p>
              </CardContent>
            </Card>
            
            <Card className="bg-white/80 backdrop-blur-sm border-0 shadow-lg">
              <CardContent className="p-6">
                <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                  <div>
                    <p className="text-sm text-gray-600">Average Progress</p>
                    <p className="text-2xl font-bold text-indigo-600">
                      {Math.round(responsePlans.reduce((sum, p) => sum + p.progress, 0) / responsePlans.length)}%
                    </p>
                  </div>
                  <div className="p-3 bg-indigo-100 rounded-lg">
                    <Target className="h-6 w-6 text-indigo-600" />
                  </div>
                </div>
                <p className="text-xs text-gray-500 mt-2">Completion rate</p>
              </CardContent>

                    onClick={() => setSelectedPlan(plan.id)}>
                <CardHeader>
                  <div className="flex items-start justify-between">
                    <div className="flex-1">

                        {plan.name}
                      </CardTitle>
                      <CardDescription className="mt-2">
                        {plan.scenario}
                      </CardDescription>
                    </div>
                    <div className="flex flex-col items-end gap-2">
                      <Badge className={getStatusColor(plan.status)}>
                        {plan.status}
                      </Badge>
                      <Badge className={getPriorityColor(plan.priority)}>
                        {plan.priority}
                      </Badge>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                </CardHeader>
                
                <CardContent>
                  <div className="space-y-4">
                    <div>
                      <div className="flex items-center justify-between text-sm mb-2">
                        <span className="text-gray-600">Progress</span>
                        <span className="font-medium">{plan.progress}%</span>
                      </div>
                      <Progress value={plan.progress} className="h-2" />
                    </div>
                    
                    <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-4 text-sm">
                      <div>
                        <p className="text-gray-600">Budget</p>
                        <p className="font-semibold">{formatCurrency(plan.budget.allocated)}</p>
                      </div>

                      </div>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                </CardContent>
              </Card>
            ))}
          </div>
        ) : (
          /* Plan Details */
          <div className="space-y-6">
            <div className="flex items-center gap-4 mb-6">
              <Button variant="outline" onClick={() => setSelectedPlan(null)}>
                ← Back to Plans
              </Button>
              <h2 className="text-2xl font-bold">{plan!.name}</h2>
              <Badge className={getStatusColor(plan!.status)}>
                {plan!.status}
              </Badge>
              <Badge className={getPriorityColor(plan!.priority)}>
                {plan!.priority}
              </Badge>
            </div>

            <div className="grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-6">
              {/* Budget Tracking */}
```

## FILE: client/src/pages/ScalabilityDemo.tsx
```
import React, { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import { Card, CardContent, CardHeader, CardTitle } from '@/components/ui/card';
import { Badge } from '@/components/ui/badge';
import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button';
import { Progress } from '@/components/ui/progress';
import { 
  Database, 
  TrendingUp, 
  Clock, 
  CheckCircle, 
  AlertTriangle,
  Users,
  Zap,
  Activity,
  BarChart3
} from 'lucide-react';

// Simulated large-scale data for demonstration
const generateInitiatives = (count: number) => {
  const statuses = ['active', 'planning', 'on-hold', 'completed', 'at-risk'];
  const priorities = ['critical', 'high', 'medium', 'low'];
  const departments = ['Engineering', 'Marketing', 'Sales', 'Operations', 'Finance', 'HR', 'Legal', 'R&D'];
  
  return Array.from({ length: count }, (_, i) => ({
    id: `init-${i + 1}`,
    name: `Strategic Initiative ${i + 1}`,
    department: departments[i % departments.length],
    status: statuses[i % statuses.length],
    priority: priorities[i % priorities.length],
    progress: Math.floor(Math.random() * 100),
    budget: Math.floor(Math.random() * 5000000) + 100000,
    timeline: Math.floor(Math.random() * 365) + 30,
    teamSize: Math.floor(Math.random() * 50) + 5,
    riskLevel: Math.floor(Math.random() * 100),
    lastUpdated: new Date(Date.now() - Math.random() * 7 * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000)
  }));
};

export default function ScalabilityDemo() {
  const [initiativeCount, setInitiativeCount] = useState(150);
  const [initiatives, setInitiatives] = useState(generateInitiatives(150));
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
  const [filterStatus, setFilterStatus] = useState('all');

  const handleScaleTest = async (count: number) => {
    setLoading(true);
    setInitiativeCount(count);
    
    // Simulate database processing time
    await new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, 1000));
    
    setInitiatives(generateInitiatives(count));
    setLoading(false);
  };

  const filteredInitiatives = initiatives.filter(init => 
    filterStatus === 'all' || init.status === filterStatus
  );

  const stats = {
    total: initiatives.length,
    active: initiatives.filter(i => i.status === 'active').length,
    completed: initiatives.filter(i => i.status === 'completed').length,
    atRisk: initiatives.filter(i => i.status === 'at-risk').length,
    avgProgress: Math.round(initiatives.reduce((sum, i) => sum + i.progress, 0) / initiatives.length),
    totalBudget: initiatives.reduce((sum, i) => sum + i.budget, 0),
    avgTeamSize: Math.round(initiatives.reduce((sum, i) => sum + i.teamSize, 0) / initiatives.length)
  };

  return (
    <div className="p-6 space-y-6 max-w-7xl mx-auto">
      {/* Header */}
      <div className="space-y-4">
        <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
          <h1 className="text-3xl font-black text-foreground">
            Enterprise Scale Demo
          </h1>
          <Badge variant="outline" className="text-green-600 border-green-600">
            <Database className="w-4 h-4 mr-2" />
            PostgreSQL Enterprise
          </Badge>
        </div>
        
        <p className="text-lg text-muted-foreground">
          Demonstrating Veridius platform handling <strong>{initiativeCount}+ concurrent initiatives</strong> with real-time tracking and analysis.
        </p>
      </div>

      {/* Scale Testing Controls */}
      <Card className="executive-card">
        <CardHeader>
          <CardTitle className="flex items-center gap-2">
            <Zap className="w-5 h-5 text-yellow-500" />
            Scalability Testing
          </CardTitle>
        </CardHeader>
        <CardContent>
          <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-4">
            <Button 
              onClick={() => handleScaleTest(100)}
              disabled={loading}
              variant={initiativeCount === 100 ? "default" : "outline"}
            >
              100 Initiatives
            </Button>
            <Button 
              onClick={() => handleScaleTest(250)}
              disabled={loading}
              variant={initiativeCount === 250 ? "default" : "outline"}
            >
              250 Initiatives
            </Button>
            <Button 
              onClick={() => handleScaleTest(500)}
              disabled={loading}
              variant={initiativeCount === 500 ? "default" : "outline"}
            >
              500 Initiatives
            </Button>
            <Button 
              onClick={() => handleScaleTest(1000)}
              disabled={loading}
              variant={initiativeCount === 1000 ? "default" : "outline"}
            >
              1,000 Initiatives
            </Button>
          </div>
          
          {loading && (
            <div className="mt-4">
              <Progress value={60} className="w-full" />
              <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground mt-2">Processing {initiativeCount} initiatives...</p>
            </div>

        </CardContent>
      </Card>

      {/* Performance Metrics */}
      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-6">

          <CardContent className="p-6">
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
              <div>
                <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">Active Projects</p>
                <p className="text-3xl font-bold text-green-600">{stats.active}</p>

              <div>
                <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">Total Budget</p>
                <p className="text-3xl font-bold text-purple-600">${(stats.totalBudget / 1000000).toFixed(1)}M</p>
              </div>
              <Database className="w-8 h-8 text-purple-600" />
            </div>
          </CardContent>
        </Card>
      </div>

      {/* Filters */}
      <Card className="executive-card">
        <CardContent className="p-6">
          <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-2">
            <Button 
              size="sm"
              onClick={() => setFilterStatus('all')}
              variant={filterStatus === 'all' ? "default" : "outline"}
            >
              All ({stats.total})
            </Button>
            <Button 
              size="sm"
              onClick={() => setFilterStatus('active')}
              variant={filterStatus === 'active' ? "default" : "outline"}
            >
              Active ({stats.active})

            </Button>
          </div>
        </CardContent>
      </Card>

      {/* Initiative List */}

        <CardContent>
          <div className="space-y-4 max-h-96 overflow-y-auto">
            {filteredInitiatives.slice(0, 20).map((initiative) => (

                  <h3 className="font-semibold text-foreground">{initiative.name}</h3>

                      initiative.status === 'active' ? 'default' :

                      initiative.status === 'at-risk' ? 'destructive' : 'outline'
                    }>
                      {initiative.status}
                    </Badge>
                    <Badge variant="outline">{initiative.priority}</Badge>
                  </div>
                </div>
                
                <div className="grid grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-4 text-sm">

                    <span className="text-muted-foreground">Department:</span>
                    <p className="font-medium">{initiative.department}</p>

                <li>• Role-based access control</li>
                <li>• Audit trails and compliance</li>
                <li>• High availability deployment</li>
              </ul>
            </div>
          </div>
        </CardContent>
      </Card>
    </div>
  );
}
```

```
import { useState } from 'react';
import { useQuery } from '@tanstack/react-query';
import { Badge } from '@/components/ui/badge';
import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button';
import { Card, CardContent, CardDescription, CardHeader, CardTitle } from '@/components/ui/card';
import { Input } from '@/components/ui/input';
import { Select, SelectContent, SelectItem, SelectTrigger, SelectValue } from '@/components/ui/select';
import { Tabs, TabsContent, TabsList, TabsTrigger } from '@/components/ui/tabs';
import { AlertTriangle, TrendingUp, Shield, Building2, Search, Filter, Clock, Users } from 'lucide-react';

interface StrategicScenario {
  id: string;
  organization_id: string;
  name: string;
  description: string;
  type: string;
  likelihood: number;
  impact: string;
  status: string;
  created_at: string;
}

export default function ScenarioLibrary() {
  const [searchTerm, setSearchTerm] = useState('');
  const [filterType, setFilterType] = useState('all');
  const [filterImpact, setFilterImpact] = useState('all');

  const { data: scenarios = [], isLoading } = useQuery<StrategicScenario[]>({
    queryKey: ['/api/strategic-scenarios'],
  });

  const filteredScenarios = scenarios.filter((scenario: StrategicScenario) => {
    const matchesSearch = scenario.name.toLowerCase().includes(searchTerm.toLowerCase()) ||
                         scenario.description.toLowerCase().includes(searchTerm.toLowerCase());
    const matchesType = filterType === 'all' || scenario.type === filterType;
    const matchesImpact = filterImpact === 'all' || scenario.impact === filterImpact;
    return matchesSearch && matchesType && matchesImpact;
  });

  const getScenarioIcon = (type: string) => {
    switch (type) {
      case 'crisis': return <AlertTriangle className="w-5 h-5 text-red-500" />;
      case 'opportunity': return <TrendingUp className="w-5 h-5 text-green-500" />;
      default: return <Shield className="w-5 h-5 text-blue-500" />;
    }
  };

  const getImpactColor = (impact: string) => {
    switch (impact) {
      case 'critical': return 'bg-red-100 text-red-800 border-red-200';
      case 'high': return 'bg-orange-100 text-orange-800 border-orange-200';
      case 'medium': return 'bg-yellow-100 text-yellow-800 border-yellow-200';
      case 'low': return 'bg-green-100 text-green-800 border-green-200';
      default: return 'bg-gray-100 text-gray-800 border-gray-200';
    }
  };

  const getStatusColor = (status: string) => {
    switch (status) {
      case 'active': return 'bg-green-100 text-green-800';
      case 'draft': return 'bg-gray-100 text-gray-800';
      case 'archived': return 'bg-blue-100 text-blue-800';
      default: return 'bg-gray-100 text-gray-800';
    }
  };

  if (isLoading) {
    return (
      <div className="min-h-screen bg-gradient-to-br from-slate-50 via-blue-50 to-indigo-100">
        <div className="container mx-auto px-6 py-8">
          <div className="animate-pulse space-y-4">
            <div className="h-8 bg-gray-200 rounded-md w-1/3"></div>
            <div className="h-4 bg-gray-200 rounded w-2/3"></div>
            <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-6 mt-8">
              {[1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6].map((i) => (
                <div key={i} className="h-48 bg-gray-200 rounded-lg"></div>
              ))}
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    );
  }

  return (
    <div className="min-h-screen bg-gradient-to-br from-slate-50 via-blue-50 to-indigo-100">
      <div className="container mx-auto px-6 py-8">
        {/* Header */}
        <div className="mb-8">
          <div className="flex items-center space-x-3 mb-4">
            <Building2 className="w-8 h-8 text-indigo-600" />
            <h1 className="text-4xl font-bold bg-gradient-to-r from-indigo-600 to-purple-600 bg-clip-text text-transparent">
              Scenario Library
            </h1>
          </div>
          <p className="text-xl text-gray-600 mb-6">
            Comprehensive collection of strategic scenarios with AI-powered analysis
          </p>
          
          {/* Stats */}
          <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-4 gap-4 mb-6">
            <Card className="border-l-4 border-l-blue-500">
              <CardContent className="p-4">
                <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                  <div>
                    <p className="text-sm font-medium text-gray-600">Total Scenarios</p>
                    <p className="text-2xl font-bold text-blue-600">{scenarios.length}</p>
                  </div>
                  <Building2 className="w-8 h-8 text-blue-500" />
                </div>
              </CardContent>
            </Card>
            
            <Card className="border-l-4 border-l-red-500">
              <CardContent className="p-4">
                <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                  <div>
                    <p className="text-sm font-medium text-gray-600">Crisis Scenarios</p>
                    <p className="text-2xl font-bold text-red-600">
                      {scenarios.filter((s: StrategicScenario) => s.type === 'crisis').length}
                    </p>
                  </div>
                  <AlertTriangle className="w-8 h-8 text-red-500" />
                </div>
              </CardContent>
            </Card>
            
            <Card className="border-l-4 border-l-green-500">
              <CardContent className="p-4">
                <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                  <div>
                    <p className="text-sm font-medium text-gray-600">Opportunities</p>
                    <p className="text-2xl font-bold text-green-600">
                      {scenarios.filter((s: StrategicScenario) => s.type === 'opportunity').length}
                    </p>
                  </div>
                  <TrendingUp className="w-8 h-8 text-green-500" />
                </div>
              </CardContent>
            </Card>
            
            <Card className="border-l-4 border-l-purple-500">
              <CardContent className="p-4">
                <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                  <div>
                    <p className="text-sm font-medium text-gray-600">Active</p>
                    <p className="text-2xl font-bold text-purple-600">
                      {scenarios.filter((s: StrategicScenario) => s.status === 'active').length}
                    </p>
                  </div>
                  <Shield className="w-8 h-8 text-purple-500" />
                </div>
              </CardContent>
            </Card>
          </div>

          {/* Search and Filters */}
          <div className="flex flex-col md:flex-row gap-4 mb-6">
            <div className="relative flex-1">
              <Search className="absolute left-3 top-3 w-4 h-4 text-gray-400" />
              <Input
                placeholder="Search scenarios..."
                value={searchTerm}
                onChange={(e) => setSearchTerm(e.target.value)}
                className="pl-10"
                data-testid="input-search-scenarios"
              />
            </div>
            
            <Select value={filterType} onValueChange={setFilterType}>
              <SelectTrigger className="w-full md:w-48" data-testid="select-scenario-type">
                <SelectValue placeholder="Filter by type" />
              </SelectTrigger>
              <SelectContent>
                <SelectItem value="all">All Types</SelectItem>
                <SelectItem value="crisis">Crisis Response</SelectItem>
                <SelectItem value="opportunity">Strategic Opportunity</SelectItem>
              </SelectContent>
            </Select>
            
            <Select value={filterImpact} onValueChange={setFilterImpact}>
              <SelectTrigger className="w-full md:w-48" data-testid="select-impact-level">
                <SelectValue placeholder="Filter by impact" />
              </SelectTrigger>
              <SelectContent>
                <SelectItem value="all">All Impact Levels</SelectItem>
                <SelectItem value="critical">Critical</SelectItem>
                <SelectItem value="high">High</SelectItem>
                <SelectItem value="medium">Medium</SelectItem>
                <SelectItem value="low">Low</SelectItem>
              </SelectContent>
            </Select>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Scenario Cards */}
        <Tabs defaultValue="grid" className="w-full">
          <TabsList className="mb-6">
            <TabsTrigger value="grid" data-testid="tab-grid-view">Grid View</TabsTrigger>
            <TabsTrigger value="list" data-testid="tab-list-view">List View</TabsTrigger>
          </TabsList>
          
          <TabsContent value="grid">
            <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-6">
              {filteredScenarios.map((scenario: StrategicScenario) => (
                <Card key={scenario.id} className="hover:shadow-lg transition-shadow bg-white/80 backdrop-blur-sm border-0 shadow-md" data-testid={`card-scenario-${scenario.id}`}>
                  <CardHeader>
                    <div className="flex items-start justify-between mb-2">
                      <div className="flex items-center space-x-2">
                        {getScenarioIcon(scenario.type)}
                        <Badge className={getStatusColor(scenario.status)}>
                          {scenario.status}
                        </Badge>
                      </div>
                      <Badge className={getImpactColor(scenario.impact)}>
                        {scenario.impact}
                      </Badge>
                    </div>
                    <CardTitle className="text-lg line-clamp-2">{scenario.name}</CardTitle>
                    <CardDescription className="line-clamp-3">
                      {scenario.description}
                    </CardDescription>
                  </CardHeader>
                  
                  <CardContent>
                    <div className="space-y-3">
                      <div className="flex items-center justify-between text-sm">
                        <span className="text-gray-600">Likelihood:</span>
                        <span className="font-medium">
                          {(scenario.likelihood * 100).toFixed(0)}%
                        </span>
                      </div>
                      
                      <div className="flex items-center justify-between text-sm">
                        <span className="text-gray-600">Type:</span>
                        <Badge variant="outline" className="text-xs">
                          {scenario.type}
                        </Badge>
                      </div>
                      
                      <div className="flex items-center justify-between text-sm text-gray-500">
                        <div className="flex items-center space-x-1">
                          <Clock className="w-3 h-3" />
                          <span>{new Date(scenario.created_at).toLocaleDateString()}</span>
                        </div>
                        <div className="flex items-center space-x-1">
                          <Users className="w-3 h-3" />
                          <span>Enterprise</span>
                        </div>
                      </div>
                      
                      <div className="flex space-x-2 pt-2">
                        <Button size="sm" className="flex-1" data-testid={`button-analyze-${scenario.id}`}>
                          AI Analysis
                        </Button>
                        <Button size="sm" variant="outline" className="flex-1" data-testid={`button-details-${scenario.id}`}>
                          Details
                        </Button>
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  </CardContent>
                </Card>
              ))}
            </div>
          </TabsContent>
          
          <TabsContent value="list">
            <div className="space-y-4">
              {filteredScenarios.map((scenario: StrategicScenario) => (
                <Card key={scenario.id} className="hover:shadow-md transition-shadow bg-white/80 backdrop-blur-sm border-0 shadow-sm" data-testid={`list-scenario-${scenario.id}`}>
                  <CardContent className="p-6">
                    <div className="flex items-start justify-between">
                      <div className="flex-1">
                        <div className="flex items-center space-x-3 mb-2">
                          {getScenarioIcon(scenario.type)}
                          <h3 className="font-semibold text-lg">{scenario.name}</h3>
                          <Badge className={getStatusColor(scenario.status)}>
                            {scenario.status}
                          </Badge>
                          <Badge className={getImpactColor(scenario.impact)}>
                            {scenario.impact}
                          </Badge>
                        </div>
                        <p className="text-gray-600 mb-3 line-clamp-2">{scenario.description}</p>
                        <div className="flex items-center space-x-6 text-sm text-gray-500">
                          <span>Likelihood: {(scenario.likelihood * 100).toFixed(0)}%</span>
                          <span>Type: {scenario.type}</span>
                          <span>Created: {new Date(scenario.created_at).toLocaleDateString()}</span>
                        </div>
                      </div>
                      <div className="flex space-x-2 ml-4">
                        <Button size="sm" data-testid={`button-list-analyze-${scenario.id}`}>AI Analysis</Button>
                        <Button size="sm" variant="outline" data-testid={`button-list-details-${scenario.id}`}>Details</Button>
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  </CardContent>
                </Card>
              ))}
            </div>
          </TabsContent>
        </Tabs>

        {filteredScenarios.length === 0 && (
          <Card className="text-center py-12 bg-white/80 backdrop-blur-sm border-0 shadow-md">
            <CardContent>
              <Building2 className="w-12 h-12 text-gray-400 mx-auto mb-4" />
              <h3 className="text-lg font-medium text-gray-600 mb-2">No scenarios found</h3>
              <p className="text-gray-500 mb-4">Try adjusting your search criteria or filters</p>
              <Button data-testid="button-create-scenario">Create New Scenario</Button>
            </CardContent>
          </Card>
        )}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
```

## FILE: client/src/pages/ScenariosFixed.tsx
```
import React, { useState } from 'react';
import { useQuery, useMutation, useQueryClient } from '@tanstack/react-query';
import { apiRequest } from '@/lib/queryClient';
import { Card, CardContent, CardDescription, CardHeader, CardTitle } from '@/components/ui/card';
import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button';
import { Badge } from '@/components/ui/badge';
import { Tabs, TabsContent, TabsList, TabsTrigger } from '@/components/ui/tabs';
import { useToast } from '@/hooks/use-toast';
import { 
  TrendingUp, 
  TrendingDown, 
  AlertTriangle, 
  Target, 
  Zap, 
  Users, 
  DollarSign, 
  BarChart3,
  Shield,
  FileText,
  Building,
  Clock,
  Play
} from 'lucide-react';

const categoryColors = {
  Operations: "bg-orange-500",
  Security: "bg-red-500", 
  Finance: "bg-green-500",
  Compliance: "bg-blue-500",
  "Human Resources": "bg-purple-500",
  Strategy: "bg-indigo-500",
  Technology: "bg-cyan-500",
  "Customer Success": "bg-pink-500",
  Quality: "bg-yellow-500",
  "Business Continuity": "bg-gray-500",
  Innovation: "bg-emerald-500"
};

const impactColors = {
  High: "bg-red-100 text-red-800 dark:bg-red-900 dark:text-red-200",
  Critical: "bg-red-100 text-red-800 dark:bg-red-900 dark:text-red-200",
  Medium: "bg-yellow-100 text-yellow-800 dark:bg-yellow-900 dark:text-yellow-200",
  Variable: "bg-blue-100 text-blue-800 dark:bg-blue-900 dark:text-blue-200"
};

const statusColors = {
  active: "bg-green-100 text-green-800",
  monitoring: "bg-blue-100 text-blue-800", 
  prepared: "bg-gray-100 text-gray-800"
};

export default function ScenariosFixed() {
  const { toast } = useToast();
  const queryClient = useQueryClient();
  const [selectedScenario, setSelectedScenario] = useState<any>(null);

  // Fetch real scenarios from API
  const { data: scenarios = [], isLoading, error } = useQuery({
    queryKey: ['scenarios'],
    queryFn: () => fetch('/api/scenarios').then(res => {
      if (!res.ok) throw new Error('Failed to fetch scenarios');
      return res.json();
    })
  });

  // Set first scenario as selected when data loads
  React.useEffect(() => {
    if (scenarios.length > 0 && !selectedScenario) {
      setSelectedScenario(scenarios[0]);
    }
  }, [scenarios, selectedScenario]);

  // Run scenario analysis mutation
  const runAnalysisMutation = useMutation({
    mutationFn: async (scenarioId: string) => {
      return await apiRequest(`/api/scenarios/${scenarioId}/run`, 'POST', {});
    },
    onSuccess: () => {
      toast({
        title: "Scenario Executed",
        description: "Crisis response plan activated successfully.",
      });
    },
    onError: (error) => {
      toast({
        title: "Execution Failed",
        description: "Failed to activate scenario response. Please try again.",
        variant: "destructive",
      });
    },
  });

  if (error) {
    return (
      <div className="p-6">
        <div className="text-center text-red-600">
          Failed to load scenarios. Please check your connection.
        </div>
      </div>
    );
  }

  return (
    <div className="p-6 space-y-6 max-w-7xl mx-auto">
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
        <div>
          <h1 className="text-3xl font-bold gradient-text">Strategic Scenarios</h1>
          <p className="text-gray-600 dark:text-gray-400">
            Real-time crisis response and strategic planning scenarios
          </p>
        </div>
        <Badge variant="secondary" className="px-3 py-1">
          {scenarios.length} Active Scenarios
        </Badge>
      </div>

      {isLoading ? (
        <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-6">
          {[1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6].map((i) => (
            <Card key={i} className="animate-pulse">
              <CardHeader>
                <div className="h-4 bg-gray-200 rounded w-3/4"></div>
                <div className="h-3 bg-gray-200 rounded w-1/2"></div>
              </CardHeader>
              <CardContent>
                <div className="space-y-2">
                  <div className="h-3 bg-gray-200 rounded"></div>
                  <div className="h-3 bg-gray-200 rounded w-2/3"></div>
                </div>
              </CardContent>
            </Card>
          ))}
        </div>
      ) : (
        <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-6">
          {scenarios.map((scenario: any) => (
            <Card 
              key={scenario.id} 
              className={`cursor-pointer transition-all hover:shadow-lg ${
                selectedScenario?.id === scenario.id ? 'ring-2 ring-blue-500' : ''
              }`}
              onClick={() => setSelectedScenario(scenario)}
            >
              <CardHeader>
                <div className="flex items-start justify-between">
                  <CardTitle className="text-lg">{scenario.title}</CardTitle>
                  <Badge 
                    className={`${statusColors[scenario.status as keyof typeof statusColors] || statusColors.prepared} text-xs`}
                  >
                    {scenario.status}
                  </Badge>
                </div>
                <CardDescription className="text-sm">
                  {scenario.description}
                </CardDescription>
              </CardHeader>
              <CardContent className="space-y-4">
                <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-2">
                  <Badge variant="outline" className={categoryColors[scenario.category as keyof typeof categoryColors] || "bg-gray-500"}>
                    {scenario.category}
                  </Badge>
                  <Badge variant="outline" className={impactColors[scenario.impact as keyof typeof impactColors] || "bg-gray-100 text-gray-800"}>
                    {scenario.impact} Impact
                  </Badge>
                </div>
                
                <div className="space-y-2 text-sm">
                  <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                    <Clock className="w-4 h-4 text-gray-500" />
                    <span>Response: {scenario.responseTime}</span>
                  </div>
                  <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                    <DollarSign className="w-4 h-4 text-gray-500" />
                    <span>Risk: {scenario.revenueAtRisk}</span>
                  </div>
                  <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                    <BarChart3 className="w-4 h-4 text-gray-500" />
                    <span>{scenario.timeline}</span>
                  </div>
                </div>

                <Button 
                  className="w-full mt-4"
                  onClick={(e) => {
                    e.stopPropagation();
                    runAnalysisMutation.mutate(scenario.id);
                  }}
                  disabled={runAnalysisMutation.isPending}
                >
                  <Play className="w-4 h-4 mr-2" />
                  {runAnalysisMutation.isPending ? 'Activating...' : 'Activate Response'}
                </Button>
              </CardContent>
            </Card>
          ))}
        </div>
      )}

      {selectedScenario && (
        <Card className="mt-8">
          <CardHeader>
            <CardTitle className="flex items-center gap-2">
              <AlertTriangle className="w-5 h-5 text-orange-500" />
              Crisis Response Details: {selectedScenario.title}
            </CardTitle>
            <CardDescription>
              Immediate action plan for {selectedScenario.category} disruption
            </CardDescription>
          </CardHeader>
          <CardContent>
            <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 gap-6">
              <div className="space-y-4">
                <div>
                  <h4 className="font-semibold mb-2">Scenario Overview</h4>
                  <p className="text-gray-600 dark:text-gray-400">
                    {selectedScenario.description}
                  </p>
                </div>
                <div>
                  <h4 className="font-semibold mb-2">Response Modules</h4>
                  <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-2">
                    {(selectedScenario.modules || []).map((module: string) => (
                      <Badge key={module} variant="secondary">
                        {module}
                      </Badge>
                    ))}
                  </div>
                </div>
              </div>
              
              <div className="space-y-4">
                <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-4">
                  <div className="text-center p-4 bg-blue-50 dark:bg-blue-950 rounded-lg">
                    <div className="text-2xl font-bold text-blue-600">
                      {selectedScenario.responseTime}
                    </div>
                    <div className="text-sm text-gray-600">Response Time</div>
                  </div>
                  <div className="text-center p-4 bg-red-50 dark:bg-red-950 rounded-lg">
                    <div className="text-2xl font-bold text-red-600">
                      {selectedScenario.revenueAtRisk}
                    </div>
                    <div className="text-sm text-gray-600">Revenue at Risk</div>
                  </div>
                </div>
                
                <Button 
                  size="lg" 
                  className="w-full"
                  onClick={() => runAnalysisMutation.mutate(selectedScenario.id)}
                  disabled={runAnalysisMutation.isPending}
                >
                  <Zap className="w-5 h-5 mr-2" />
                  {runAnalysisMutation.isPending ? 'Executing Response...' : 'Execute Emergency Response'}
                </Button>
              </div>
            </div>
          </CardContent>
        </Card>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}
```

```
import { Label } from '@/components/ui/label';
import { Select, SelectContent, SelectItem, SelectTrigger, SelectValue } from '@/components/ui/select';
import { useToast } from '@/hooks/use-toast';
import WhatIfTemplates from '@/components/WhatIfTemplates';
import {

// Demo scenarios for testing - will be replaced by API data
const demoScenarios = [

    title: 'Organizational Intelligence Learning',
    description: 'AI system learning from organizational decisions and building institutional memory',

    impact: 'high',

    variables: {
      learningRate: 85,
      memoryCapture: 92,
      patternRecognition: 78,
      roiImprovement: 340
    },
    expectedOutcome: {

      intelligence: '+500% Year 2',
      memory: 'Permanent institutional capture'
    }
  }
];

const categoryColors = {
  Growth: "bg-green-500",
  Revenue: "bg-blue-500", 
  Operations: "bg-orange-500",
  Technology: "bg-purple-500",
  HR: "bg-pink-500",
  ESG: "bg-emerald-500",
  Marketing: "bg-red-500",
  Innovation: "bg-indigo-500",
  Risk: "bg-yellow-500",
  Analytics: "bg-cyan-500"
};

const impactColors = {
  high: "bg-red-100 text-red-800 dark:bg-red-900 dark:text-red-200",
  medium: "bg-yellow-100 text-yellow-800 dark:bg-yellow-900 dark:text-yellow-200",
  low: "bg-green-100 text-green-800 dark:bg-green-900 dark:text-green-200"
};

export default function Scenarios() {
  const { toast } = useToast();
  const queryClient = useQueryClient();
  const [selectedScenario, setSelectedScenario] = useState<any>(null);
  const [activeTab, setActiveTab] = useState("predefined");
  const [customVariables, setCustomVariables] = useState({
    revenue: [100],
    costs: [75],
    growth: [15],
    risk: [25]
  });

  // Fetch real scenarios from API
  const { data: scenarios = [], isLoading } = useQuery({
    queryKey: ['scenarios'],
    queryFn: () => fetch('/api/scenarios').then(res => res.json())
  });

  // Set first scenario as selected when data loads
  React.useEffect(() => {
    if (scenarios.length > 0 && !selectedScenario) {
      setSelectedScenario(scenarios[0]);
    }
  }, [scenarios, selectedScenario]);

  // Run scenario analysis mutation
  const runAnalysisMutation = useMutation({
    mutationFn: async ({ scenarioId, parameters }: { scenarioId: string; parameters: any }) => {
      return await apiRequest(`/api/scenarios/${scenarioId}/run`, 'POST', parameters);
    },
    onSuccess: () => {
      toast({
        title: "Analysis Complete",
        description: "Scenario analysis has been successfully executed.",
      });
      queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ['/api/scenario-results'] });
    },
    onError: (error) => {
      toast({
        title: "Analysis Failed",
        description: "Failed to run scenario analysis. Please try again.",
        variant: "destructive",
      });
    },
  });

  const runScenarioAnalysis = (scenario: any) => {
    if (!scenario?.id) return;
    
    const parameters = {
      revenue: 100 + Math.random() * 50 - 25, // Simulate input variation
      costs: 75 + Math.random() * 30 - 15,
      growth: 15 + Math.random() * 20 - 10,
      risk: 25 + Math.random() * 40 - 20,
    };

    runAnalysisMutation.mutate({ scenarioId: scenario.id, parameters });
  };

  const resetCustomAnalysis = () => {
    setCustomVariables({
      revenue: [100],
      costs: [75], 
      growth: [15],
      risk: [25]
    });
  };

  const applyTemplate = (template: any) => {
    setCustomVariables({
      revenue: [template.preset.revenue],
      costs: [template.preset.costs],
      growth: [template.preset.growth],
      risk: [template.preset.risk]
    });
    
    // Switch to custom tab to show applied template
    setActiveTab("custom");
    
    toast({
      title: "Template Applied",
      description: `${template.name} has been applied. ${template.isUniversal ? 'All parameters and metrics are now available.' : 'Parameters optimized for this strategy.'}`,
    });
  };

  if (isLoading) {
    return (
      <div className="min-h-screen bg-gradient-to-br from-slate-50 via-blue-50 to-indigo-100 dark:from-gray-900 dark:via-blue-900 dark:to-indigo-900 p-6 flex items-center justify-center">
        <div className="text-center">
          <div className="animate-spin rounded-full h-8 w-8 border-b-2 border-blue-600 mx-auto mb-4"></div>
          <p className="text-lg text-muted-foreground">Loading scenarios...</p>
        </div>
      </div>
    );
  }

  return (
    <div className="min-h-screen bg-gradient-to-br from-slate-50 via-blue-50 to-indigo-100 dark:from-gray-900 dark:via-blue-900 dark:to-indigo-900 p-6">
      <div className="max-w-7xl mx-auto space-y-6">
        {/* Header */}
        <div className="text-center space-y-4">
          <h1 className="text-4xl font-bold bg-gradient-to-r from-blue-600 to-purple-600 bg-clip-text text-transparent">
            Scenario Analysis & What-If Modeling
          </h1>
          <p className="text-lg text-muted-foreground max-w-3xl mx-auto">
            Explore business scenarios, analyze potential outcomes, and make data-driven strategic decisions with advanced predictive modeling.
          </p>
        </div>

        <Tabs value={activeTab} onValueChange={setActiveTab} className="w-full">
          <TabsList className="grid w-full grid-cols-3 lg:w-2/3 mx-auto">
            <TabsTrigger value="predefined">12 Strategic Scenarios</TabsTrigger>
            <TabsTrigger value="custom">What-If Analysis</TabsTrigger>
            <TabsTrigger value="templates">Templates & QA</TabsTrigger>
          </TabsList>

          {/* Predefined Scenarios */}
          <TabsContent value="predefined" className="space-y-6">
            <div className="grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-6">
              {/* Scenario List */}
              <div className="lg:col-span-1 space-y-4">
                <h3 className="text-xl font-semibold">Strategic Scenarios</h3>
                <div className="space-y-3 max-h-[600px] overflow-y-auto">
                  {scenarios.map((scenario: any) => (
                    <Card 
                      key={scenario.id}
                      className={`cursor-pointer transition-all duration-200 hover:shadow-lg ${
                        selectedScenario?.id === scenario.id 
                          ? 'ring-2 ring-blue-500 bg-blue-50 dark:bg-blue-950' 
                          : 'hover:bg-gray-50 dark:hover:bg-gray-800'
                      }`}
                      onClick={() => setSelectedScenario(scenario)}
                    >
                      <CardContent className="p-4">
                        <div className="flex items-start justify-between mb-2">
                          <h4 className="font-medium text-sm">{scenario.title}</h4>
                          <Badge 
                            className={`text-xs ${categoryColors[scenario.category as keyof typeof categoryColors] || 'bg-gray-500'} text-white`}
                          >
                            {scenario.category}
                          </Badge>
                        </div>
                        <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground mb-2">{scenario.description}</p>
                        <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                          <Badge variant="outline" className={impactColors[scenario.impact as keyof typeof impactColors]}>
                            {scenario.impact} impact
                          </Badge>
                          <span className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">{scenario.timeline}</span>
                        </div>
                      </CardContent>
                    </Card>
                  ))}
                </div>
              </div>

              {/* Scenario Details */}
              <div className="lg:col-span-2 space-y-6">
                {selectedScenario && (
                <Card className="backdrop-blur-lg bg-white/70 dark:bg-gray-800/70 border-white/20">
                  <CardHeader>
                    <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                      <div>
                        <CardTitle className="flex items-center gap-2">
                          <Target className="h-5 w-5" />
                          {selectedScenario.title}
                        </CardTitle>
                        <CardDescription>{selectedScenario.description}</CardDescription>
                      </div>
                      <Button 
                        onClick={() => runScenarioAnalysis(selectedScenario)}
                        disabled={runAnalysisMutation.isPending}
                      >
                        <Play className="h-4 w-4 mr-2" />
                        {runAnalysisMutation.isPending ? 'Running...' : 'Run Analysis'}
                      </Button>
                    </div>
                  </CardHeader>
                  <CardContent className="space-y-6">
                    {/* Key Variables */}
                    <div>
                      <h4 className="font-semibold mb-3 flex items-center gap-2">
                        <BarChart3 className="h-4 w-4" />
                        Key Variables
                      </h4>
                      <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-4">
                        {Object.entries(selectedScenario.variables || {}).map(([key, value]: [string, any]) => (
                          <div key={key} className="bg-gray-50 dark:bg-gray-700 p-3 rounded-lg">
                            <div className="text-sm font-medium capitalize mb-1">
                              {key.replace(/([A-Z])/g, ' $1').trim()}
                            </div>
                            <div className="text-lg font-bold">
                              {typeof value === 'number' ? 
                                (key.includes('Rate') || key.includes('Penetration') ? `${value}%` : 
                                 key.includes('Cost') || key.includes('Investment') ? `$${value.toLocaleString()}` : 
                                 value.toLocaleString()) : 
                                String(value)}
                            </div>
                          </div>
                        ))}
                      </div>
                    </div>

                    {/* Expected Outcomes */}
                    <div>
                      <h4 className="font-semibold mb-3 flex items-center gap-2">
                        <TrendingUp className="h-4 w-4" />
                        Expected Outcomes
                      </h4>
                      <div className="grid grid-cols-3 gap-4">
                        {Object.entries(selectedScenario.expectedOutcome || {}).map(([key, value]: [string, any]) => (
                          <div key={key} className="text-center p-4 bg-gradient-to-br from-blue-50 to-indigo-50 dark:from-blue-900 dark:to-indigo-900 rounded-lg">
                            <div className="text-sm text-muted-foreground capitalize mb-1">
                              {key.replace(/_/g, ' ')}
                            </div>
                            <div className={`text-xl font-bold ${
                              String(value).startsWith('+') ? 'text-green-600' : 
                              String(value).startsWith('-') ? 'text-red-600' : 
                              'text-blue-600'
                            }`}>
                              {String(value)}
                            </div>
                          </div>
                        ))}
                      </div>
                    </div>

                    {/* Timeline & Impact */}
                    <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-4">
                      <div className="bg-gray-50 dark:bg-gray-700 p-4 rounded-lg">
                        <div className="text-sm text-muted-foreground mb-1">Implementation Timeline</div>
                        <div className="text-lg font-semibold">{selectedScenario.timeline}</div>
                      </div>
                      <div className="bg-gray-50 dark:bg-gray-700 p-4 rounded-lg">
                        <div className="text-sm text-muted-foreground mb-1">Business Impact</div>
                        <Badge className={`${impactColors[selectedScenario.impact as keyof typeof impactColors]} capitalize`}>
                          {selectedScenario.impact} Impact
                        </Badge>
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  </CardContent>
                </Card>
                )}
              </div>
            </div>
          </TabsContent>

          {/* Custom What-If Analysis */}
          <TabsContent value="custom" className="space-y-6">
            {/* Templates Section */}
            <WhatIfTemplates onApplyTemplate={applyTemplate} />
            
            <Card className="backdrop-blur-lg bg-white/70 dark:bg-gray-800/70 border-white/20">
              <CardHeader>
                <CardTitle className="flex items-center gap-2">
                  <Calculator className="h-5 w-5" />
                  Interactive What-If Analysis
                </CardTitle>
                <CardDescription>
                  Adjust key business parameters and see real-time impact projections
                </CardDescription>
              </CardHeader>
              <CardContent className="space-y-6">
                <div className="grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-2 gap-8">
                  {/* Input Controls */}
                  <div className="space-y-6">
                    <h4 className="font-semibold">Adjust Parameters</h4>
                    
                    {/* Revenue Factor */}
                    <div className="space-y-3">
                      <Label className="flex items-center justify-between">
                        Revenue Factor
                        <span className="font-mono text-sm">{customVariables.revenue[0]}%</span>
                      </Label>
                      <Slider
                        value={customVariables.revenue}
                        onValueChange={(value) => setCustomVariables(prev => ({...prev, revenue: value}))}
                        min={50}
                        max={200}
                        step={5}
                        className="w-full"
                      />
                    </div>

                    {/* Cost Factor */}
                    <div className="space-y-3">
                      <Label className="flex items-center justify-between">
                        Cost Factor
                        <span className="font-mono text-sm">{customVariables.costs[0]}%</span>
                      </Label>
                      <Slider
                        value={customVariables.costs}
                        onValueChange={(value) => setCustomVariables(prev => ({...prev, costs: value}))}
                        min={25}
                        max={150}
                        step={5}
                        className="w-full"
                      />
                    </div>

                    {/* Growth Rate */}
                    <div className="space-y-3">
                      <Label className="flex items-center justify-between">
                        Growth Rate
                        <span className="font-mono text-sm">{customVariables.growth[0]}%</span>
                      </Label>
                      <Slider
                        value={customVariables.growth}
                        onValueChange={(value) => setCustomVariables(prev => ({...prev, growth: value}))}
                        min={-10}
                        max={50}
                        step={1}
                        className="w-full"
                      />
                    </div>

                    {/* Risk Level */}
                    <div className="space-y-3">
                      <Label className="flex items-center justify-between">
                        Risk Level
                        <span className="font-mono text-sm">{customVariables.risk[0]}%</span>
                      </Label>
                      <Slider
                        value={customVariables.risk}
                        onValueChange={(value) => setCustomVariables(prev => ({...prev, risk: value}))}
                        min={0}
                        max={100}
                        step={5}
                        className="w-full"
                      />
                    </div>

                    <div className="flex gap-2">
                      <Button onClick={resetCustomAnalysis} variant="outline">
                        <RotateCcw className="h-4 w-4 mr-2" />
                        Reset
                      </Button>
                      <Button>
                        <Save className="h-4 w-4 mr-2" />
                        Save Scenario
                      </Button>
                    </div>
                  </div>

                  {/* Results Display */}
                  <div className="space-y-6">
                    <h4 className="font-semibold">Projected Impact</h4>
                    
                    {/* Key Metrics */}
                    <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-4">
                      <div className="bg-gradient-to-br from-green-50 to-emerald-50 dark:from-green-900 dark:to-emerald-900 p-4 rounded-lg">
                        <div className="flex items-center gap-2 mb-2">
                          <DollarSign className="h-4 w-4 text-green-600" />
                          <span className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">Revenue Impact</span>
                        </div>
                        <div className="text-2xl font-bold text-green-600">
                          {customVariables.revenue[0] > 100 ? '+' : ''}{(customVariables.revenue[0] - 100).toFixed(1)}%
                        </div>
                      </div>

                      <div className="bg-gradient-to-br from-blue-50 to-cyan-50 dark:from-blue-900 dark:to-cyan-900 p-4 rounded-lg">
                        <div className="flex items-center gap-2 mb-2">
                          <TrendingUp className="h-4 w-4 text-blue-600" />
                          <span className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">Growth Rate</span>
                        </div>
                        <div className="text-2xl font-bold text-blue-600">
                          {customVariables.growth[0] > 0 ? '+' : ''}{customVariables.growth[0]}%
                        </div>
                      </div>

                      <div className="bg-gradient-to-br from-orange-50 to-red-50 dark:from-orange-900 dark:to-red-900 p-4 rounded-lg">
                        <div className="flex items-center gap-2 mb-2">
                          <AlertTriangle className="h-4 w-4 text-orange-600" />
                          <span className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">Risk Level</span>
                        </div>
                        <div className="text-2xl font-bold text-orange-600">
                          {customVariables.risk[0]}%
                        </div>
                      </div>

                      <div className="bg-gradient-to-br from-purple-50 to-indigo-50 dark:from-purple-900 dark:to-indigo-900 p-4 rounded-lg">
                        <div className="flex items-center gap-2 mb-2">
                          <Zap className="h-4 w-4 text-purple-600" />
                          <span className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">Efficiency</span>
                        </div>
                        <div className="text-2xl font-bold text-purple-600">
                          {(200 - customVariables.costs[0]).toFixed(0)}%
                        </div>
                      </div>
                    </div>

                    {/* Recommendation */}
                    <div className="bg-gradient-to-r from-blue-50 to-indigo-50 dark:from-blue-900 dark:to-indigo-900 p-4 rounded-lg">
                      <h5 className="font-semibold mb-2">AI Recommendation</h5>
                      <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">
                        {customVariables.risk[0] > 50 ? 
                          "High risk scenario detected. Consider risk mitigation strategies before implementation." :
                          customVariables.growth[0] > 25 ? 
                            "Aggressive growth scenario. Ensure adequate resources and monitoring systems." :
                            "Balanced scenario with moderate risk and sustainable growth potential."
                        }
                      </p>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                </div>
              </CardContent>
            </Card>
          </TabsContent>

          {/* Templates & QA Tab */}
          <TabsContent value="templates" className="space-y-6">
            <div className="grid grid-cols-1 xl:grid-cols-2 gap-6">
              {/* Templates Section */}
              <div className="space-y-6">
                <WhatIfTemplates onApplyTemplate={applyTemplate} />
              </div>
              
              {/* QA Section */}
              <div className="space-y-6">
                <Card className="backdrop-blur-lg bg-white/70 dark:bg-gray-800/70 border-white/20">
                  <CardHeader>
                    <CardTitle className="flex items-center gap-2">
                      <CheckCircle className="h-5 w-5" />
                      Quality Assurance Dashboard
                    </CardTitle>
                    <CardDescription>
                      Monitor system health and test data integrity
                    </CardDescription>
                  </CardHeader>
                  <CardContent>
                    <div className="space-y-4">
                      <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-4">
                        <div className="bg-green-50 dark:bg-green-950 p-3 rounded-lg">
                          <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">Test Coverage</p>
                          <p className="text-xl font-bold text-green-600">94%</p>
                        </div>
                        <div className="bg-blue-50 dark:bg-blue-950 p-3 rounded-lg">
                          <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">Test Data Sets</p>
                          <p className="text-xl font-bold text-blue-600">12</p>
                        </div>
                      </div>
                      <div className="text-center">
                        <Button 
                          variant="outline" 
                          onClick={() => window.location.href = '/qa'}
                          className="w-full"
                        >
                          View Full QA Dashboard
                        </Button>
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  </CardContent>
                </Card>
              </div>
            </div>
          </TabsContent>
        </Tabs>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
```
