## FILE: client/src/pages/TestWorkflow.tsx
```
import { useState } from 'react';
import { useForm } from 'react-hook-form';
import { zodResolver } from '@hookform/resolvers/zod';
import { Card, CardContent, CardDescription, CardHeader, CardTitle } from '@/components/ui/card';
import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button';
import { Input } from '@/components/ui/input';
import { Form, FormControl, FormField, FormItem, FormLabel, FormMessage } from '@/components/ui/form';
import { useToast } from '@/hooks/use-toast';
import { z } from 'zod';

const testSchema = z.object({
  name: z.string().min(1, 'Name is required'),
  email: z.string().email('Valid email required'),
});

type TestData = z.infer<typeof testSchema>;

export function TestWorkflow() {
  const [submitted, setSubmitted] = useState(false);
  const { toast } = useToast();

  const form = useForm<TestData>({
    resolver: zodResolver(testSchema),
    defaultValues: {
      name: '',
      email: '',
    },
  });

  const handleSubmit = (data: TestData) => {
    console.log("Test form submitted:", data);
    setSubmitted(true);
    toast({
      title: "Success!",
      description: "Test form submitted successfully",
    });
  };

  return (
    <div className="space-y-8 p-6">
      <div className="text-center space-y-4">
        <h1 className="text-4xl font-black text-foreground">Workflow Test Page</h1>
        <p className="text-xl text-muted-foreground max-w-3xl mx-auto">
          Testing basic form functionality
        </p>
      </div>

      <Card className="max-w-md mx-auto">
        <CardHeader>
          <CardTitle>Test Form</CardTitle>
          <CardDescription>
            Simple test to verify form functionality
          </CardDescription>
        </CardHeader>
        <CardContent>
          {!submitted ? (
            <Form {...form}>
              <form onSubmit={form.handleSubmit(handleSubmit)} className="space-y-4">
                <FormField
                  control={form.control}
                  name="name"
                  render={({ field }) => (
                    <FormItem>
                      <FormLabel>Name</FormLabel>
                      <FormControl>
                        <Input placeholder="Enter your name" {...field} />
                      </FormControl>
                      <FormMessage />
                    </FormItem>
                  )}
                />
                
                <FormField
                  control={form.control}
                  name="email"
                  render={({ field }) => (
                    <FormItem>
                      <FormLabel>Email</FormLabel>
                      <FormControl>
                        <Input type="email" placeholder="Enter your email" {...field} />
                      </FormControl>
                      <FormMessage />
                    </FormItem>
                  )}
                />

                <Button type="submit" className="w-full">
                  Submit Test
                </Button>
              </form>
            </Form>
          ) : (
            <div className="text-center space-y-4">
              <h3 className="text-lg font-semibold text-green-600">Success!</h3>
              <p className="text-muted-foreground">Form submitted successfully</p>
              <Button onClick={() => {
                setSubmitted(false);
                form.reset();
              }}>
                Reset Test
              </Button>
            </div>
          )}
        </CardContent>
      </Card>
    </div>
  );
}

export default TestWorkflow;
```

                        className="w-full"
                        onClick={() => startModule(module.id)}
                        variant={module.completed ? "outline" : "default"}
                      >
                        <Play className="h-4 w-4 mr-2" />
                        {module.completed ? 'Review Module' : module.progress > 0 ? 'Continue' : 'Start Module'}
                      </Button>
                    </div>
                  </CardContent>
                </Card>
              ))}
            </div>
          </TabsContent>

          <TabsContent value="paths" className="space-y-6">
            <div className="grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-2 gap-6">
              {learningPaths.map((path) => (
                <Card key={path.id} className="bg-white/80 backdrop-blur-sm border-0 shadow-lg">
                  <CardHeader>
                    <div className="flex items-start justify-between">
                      <div>
                        <CardTitle className="text-xl flex items-center gap-2">
                          <Award className="h-5 w-5 text-indigo-600" />
                          {path.title}
                        </CardTitle>
                        <CardDescription className="mt-2">
                          {path.description}
                        </CardDescription>
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  </CardHeader>
                  
                  <CardContent>
                    <div className="space-y-4">
                      <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                        <Badge className={getDifficultyColor(path.difficulty)}>
                          {path.difficulty}
                        </Badge>
                        <div className="text-sm text-gray-500 flex items-center gap-1">
                          <Clock className="h-4 w-4" />
                          {path.duration}
                        </div>
                      </div>
                      
                      <div>
                        <div className="flex items-center justify-between text-sm mb-2">
                          <span className="text-gray-600">Community Completion Rate</span>
                          <span className="font-medium">{path.completionRate}%</span>
                        </div>
                        <Progress value={path.completionRate} className="h-2" />
                      </div>
                      
                      <div>
                        <p className="text-sm font-medium text-gray-700 mb-2">Included Modules:</p>
                        <div className="space-y-1">
                          {path.modules.map((moduleId) => {
                            const module = tutorialModules.find(m => m.id === moduleId);
                            return module ? (
                              <div key={moduleId} className="flex items-center gap-2 text-sm text-gray-600">
                                {module.completed ? (
                                  <CheckCircle className="h-4 w-4 text-green-500" />
                                ) : (
                                  <div className="h-4 w-4 rounded-full border-2 border-gray-300" />
                                )}
                                {module.title}
                              </div>
                            ) : null;
                          })}
                        </div>
                      </div>
                      
                      <Button 
                        className="w-full"
                        onClick={() => startLearningPath(path.id)}
                      >
                        <Play className="h-4 w-4 mr-2" />
                        Start Learning Path
                      </Button>
                    </div>
                  </CardContent>
                </Card>
              ))}
            </div>
          </TabsContent>
        </Tabs>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
```

                  <div className="p-4">
                    <div className="text-3xl font-bold text-blue-400">$42.8M</div>
                    <div className="text-white/70">Revenue Protected</div>
                  </div>
                  <div className="p-4">
                    <div className="text-3xl font-bold text-purple-400">+2.3%</div>
                    <div className="text-white/70">Market Share Gained</div>
                  </div>
                  <div className="p-4">
                    <div className="text-3xl font-bold text-amber-400">16x</div>
                    <div className="text-white/70">Faster Response</div>
                  </div>
                </div>
                <p className="text-white/90 text-lg">
                  This is the power of Veridius: turning organizational disruption into competitive advantage, 
                  transforming reactive crisis management into proactive strategic orchestration.
                </p>
              </CardContent>
            </Card>
          )}
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

## FILE: client/src/services/AIIntelligenceEngine.ts

/**
 * Veridius AI Intelligence Engine
 * Transforms organizational data into actionable intelligence
 * Core AI integration points for maximum learning and adaptation
 */

import { z } from 'zod';

// AI Analysis Response Schema
export const AIAnalysisSchema = z.object({
  confidence: z.number().min(0).max(1),
  recommendations: z.array(z.string()),
  patterns: z.array(z.string()),
  risk_assessment: z.object({
    level: z.enum(['low', 'medium', 'high', 'critical']),
    factors: z.array(z.string())
  }),
  similar_scenarios: z.array(z.object({
    scenario_id: z.string(),
    similarity_score: z.number(),
    outcome: z.string(),
    lessons_learned: z.array(z.string())
  })),
  execution_plan: z.array(z.object({
    action: z.string(),
    priority: z.enum(['immediate', 'urgent', 'important', 'monitor']),
    timeline: z.string(),
    resources_needed: z.array(z.string())
  }))
});

export type AIAnalysis = z.infer<typeof AIAnalysisSchema>;

class AIIntelligenceEngine {
  private baseUrl = '/api/ai';

  /**
   * 1. REAL-TIME SCENARIO ANALYSIS
   * Analyzes incoming scenario data and provides intelligent recommendations
   */
  async analyzeScenario(scenarioData: any): Promise<AIAnalysis> {
    const response = await fetch(`${this.baseUrl}/analyze-scenario`, {
      method: 'POST',
      headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
      body: JSON.stringify({
        scenario: scenarioData,
        context: 'organizational_intelligence',
        analysis_type: 'comprehensive'
      })
    });

    if (!response.ok) {
      throw new Error('Failed to analyze scenario');
    }

    return response.json();
  }

  /**
   * 2. PATTERN RECOGNITION & LEARNING
   * Identifies patterns across historical organizational data
   */
  async identifyPatterns(organizationalData: {
    past_scenarios: any[];
    outcomes: any[];
    organization_profile: any;
  }): Promise<{
    patterns: string[];
    success_factors: string[];
    risk_indicators: string[];
    optimization_opportunities: string[];
  }> {
    const response = await fetch(`${this.baseUrl}/identify-patterns`, {
      method: 'POST',
      headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
      body: JSON.stringify(organizationalData)
    });

    if (!response.ok) {
      throw new Error('Failed to identify patterns');
    }

    return response.json();
  }

  /**
   * 3. PREDICTIVE INTELLIGENCE
   * Predicts potential outcomes and risks based on current data
   */
  async generatePredictiveIntelligence(currentState: {
    scenario_context: any;
    organizational_factors: any;
    external_factors: any;
  }): Promise<{
    likelihood_assessment: {
      success_probability: number;
      risk_probability: number;
      timeline_accuracy: number;
    };
    potential_outcomes: Array<{
      outcome: string;
      probability: number;
      impact_level: 'low' | 'medium' | 'high' | 'critical';
      mitigation_strategies: string[];
    }>;
    early_warning_indicators: string[];
  }> {
    const response = await fetch(`${this.baseUrl}/predictive-analysis`, {
      method: 'POST',
      headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
      body: JSON.stringify(currentState)
    });

    if (!response.ok) {
      throw new Error('Failed to generate predictive intelligence');
    }

    return response.json();
  }

  /**
   * 4. ADAPTIVE RECOMMENDATION ENGINE
   * Learns from outcomes and improves recommendations over time
   */
  async getAdaptiveRecommendations(context: {
    current_scenario: any;
    organization_learning_history: any[];
    performance_metrics: any;
  }): Promise<{
    immediate_actions: Array<{
      action: string;
      confidence: number;
      expected_impact: string;
      resource_requirement: string;
    }>;
    strategic_adjustments: string[];
    learning_insights: string[];
    performance_optimization: string[];
  }> {
    const response = await fetch(`${this.baseUrl}/adaptive-recommendations`, {
      method: 'POST',
      headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
      body: JSON.stringify(context)
    });

    if (!response.ok) {
      throw new Error('Failed to get adaptive recommendations');
    }

    return response.json();
  }

  /**
   * 5. CONTINUOUS LEARNING & OPTIMIZATION
   * Updates AI models based on organizational outcomes and feedback
   */
  async updateLearningModel(learningData: {
    scenario_id: string;
    implemented_actions: any[];
    actual_outcomes: any[];
    success_metrics: any;
    lessons_learned: string[];
  }): Promise<{
    model_improvement: string;
    accuracy_enhancement: number;
    new_insights: string[];
    updated_confidence_scores: any;
  }> {
    const response = await fetch(`${this.baseUrl}/update-learning`, {
      method: 'POST',
      headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
      body: JSON.stringify(learningData)
    });

    if (!response.ok) {
      throw new Error('Failed to update learning model');
    }

    return response.json();
  }

  /**
   * 6. INTELLIGENT DECISION SUPPORT
   * Provides context-aware decision guidance
   */
  async getDecisionSupport(decisionContext: {
    decision_type: string;
    available_options: any[];
    constraints: any[];
    stakeholders: any[];
    timeline: string;
  }): Promise<{
    recommended_decision: string;
    decision_rationale: string[];
    risk_mitigation: string[];
    implementation_guidance: string[];
    success_indicators: string[];
    alternative_approaches: Array<{
      approach: string;
      pros: string[];
      cons: string[];
      suitability_score: number;
    }>;
  }> {
    const response = await fetch(`${this.baseUrl}/decision-support`, {
      method: 'POST',
      headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
      body: JSON.stringify(decisionContext)
    });

    if (!response.ok) {
      throw new Error('Failed to get decision support');
    }

    return response.json();
  }
}

export const aiEngine = new AIIntelligenceEngine();

/**
 * Ecosystem Lock-in Platform Service
 * Creates switching costs and network effects for market domination
 */

import { z } from 'zod';

// Integration Marketplace Schema
export const IntegrationSchema = z.object({
  id: z.string(),
  name: z.string(),
  category: z.enum(['erp', 'crm', 'hrms', 'financial', 'operational', 'analytics']),
  provider: z.string(),
  description: z.string(),
  price_tier: z.enum(['free', 'premium', 'enterprise']),
  installation_complexity: z.enum(['plug_and_play', 'configuration_required', 'custom_development']),
  monthly_cost: z.number(),
  data_points: z.number(),
  users_count: z.number(),
  rating: z.number(),
  certification_level: z.enum(['verified', 'partner', 'premium_partner']),
  roi_improvement: z.string(),
  switching_cost_impact: z.number()
});

export type Integration = z.infer<typeof IntegrationSchema>;

// Partner Ecosystem Schema
export const PartnerSchema = z.object({
  id: z.string(),
  name: z.string(),
  type: z.enum(['implementation', 'consulting', 'technology', 'data_provider']),
  tier: z.enum(['certified', 'gold', 'platinum', 'strategic']),
  specializations: z.array(z.string()),
  revenue_share: z.number(),
  customers_delivered: z.number(),
  average_project_value: z.number(),
  customer_satisfaction: z.number(),
  exclusive_features: z.array(z.string())
});

export type Partner = z.infer<typeof PartnerSchema>;

class EcosystemPlatformService {
  private integrationMarketplace: Map<string, Integration> = new Map();
  private partnerNetwork: Map<string, Partner> = new Map();
  private customerEcosystemValue: Map<string, number> = new Map();

  /**
   * 1. INTEGRATION MARKETPLACE
   * 500+ pre-built connectors creating switching costs
   */
  async getIntegrationMarketplace(filters?: {
    category?: string;
    price_tier?: string;
    certification_level?: string;
  }): Promise<{
    integrations: Integration[];
    total_switching_cost: number;
    ecosystem_value: number;
    competitive_moat_strength: number;
  }> {
    const response = await fetch('/api/ecosystem/marketplace', {
      method: 'POST',
      headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
      body: JSON.stringify(filters || {})
    });

    if (!response.ok) {
      throw new Error('Failed to fetch integration marketplace');
    }

    return response.json();
  }

  /**
   * 2. PARTNER ECOSYSTEM MANAGEMENT
   * Revenue sharing and exclusive relationships
   */
  async getPartnerEcosystem(): Promise<{
    partners: Partner[];
    total_revenue_share: number;
    exclusive_capabilities: string[];
    market_coverage: number;
  }> {
    const response = await fetch('/api/ecosystem/partners');

    if (!response.ok) {
      throw new Error('Failed to fetch partner ecosystem');
    }

    return response.json();
  }

  /**
   * 3. WHITE-LABEL PLATFORM
   * Multi-tenant infrastructure for partners
   */
  async createWhiteLabelInstance(config: {
    partner_id: string;
    branding: {
      logo_url: string;
      primary_color: string;
      secondary_color: string;
      company_name: string;
    };
    features: string[];
    custom_modules: any[];
    revenue_share_percentage: number;
  }): Promise<{
    instance_id: string;
    deployment_url: string;
    setup_time: string;
    switching_cost_created: number;
  }> {
    const response = await fetch('/api/ecosystem/white-label', {
      method: 'POST',
      headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
      body: JSON.stringify(config)
    });

    if (!response.ok) {
      throw new Error('Failed to create white-label instance');
    }

    return response.json();
  }

  /**
   * 4. DATA STANDARDIZATION PROTOCOLS
   * Industry-wide data standards creating vendor lock-in
   */
  async implementDataStandards(industry: string): Promise<{
    standards_implemented: string[];
    industry_adoption_rate: number;
    competitive_barrier_strength: number;
    switching_cost_multiplier: number;
  }> {
    const response = await fetch('/api/ecosystem/data-standards', {
      method: 'POST',
      headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
      body: JSON.stringify({ industry })
    });

    if (!response.ok) {
      throw new Error('Failed to implement data standards');
    }

    return response.json();
  }

  /**
   * 5. CERTIFICATION & TRAINING PROGRAMS
   * Create professional dependency on platform
   */
  async getCertificationPrograms(): Promise<{
    programs: Array<{
      name: string;
      level: string;
      participants: number;
      completion_rate: number;
      job_market_value: string;
      platform_dependency: number;
    }>;
    total_certified_professionals: number;
    market_influence: number;
  }> {
    const response = await fetch('/api/ecosystem/certifications');

    if (!response.ok) {
      throw new Error('Failed to fetch certification programs');
    }

    return response.json();
  }

  /**
   * 6. ENTERPRISE COMMUNITY HUB
   * Exclusive networking and knowledge sharing
   */
  async getEnterpriseCommunity(): Promise<{
    members: number;
    fortune_500_participation: number;
    exclusive_insights_shared: number;
    cross_pollination_value: number;
    network_effects_strength: number;
  }> {
    const response = await fetch('/api/ecosystem/community');

    if (!response.ok) {
      throw new Error('Failed to fetch enterprise community');
    }

    return response.json();
  }

  /**
   * 7. SWITCHING COST CALCULATOR
   * Quantify customer lock-in value
   */
  calculateSwitchingCosts(customerId: string): {
    data_migration_cost: number;
    integration_rebuilding_cost: number;
    training_replacement_cost: number;
    workflow_disruption_cost: number;
    partner_relationship_cost: number;
    total_switching_cost: number;
    competitive_moat_strength: string;
  } {
    // Simulated calculation based on customer ecosystem engagement
    const baseIntegrationCost = 500000; // $500K base
    const trainingCost = 200000; // $200K training
    const dataMigrationCost = 800000; // $800K data migration
    const workflowDisruptionCost = 1000000; // $1M workflow disruption
    const partnerRelationshipCost = 300000; // $300K partner relationships

    const total = baseIntegrationCost + trainingCost + dataMigrationCost + 
                 workflowDisruptionCost + partnerRelationshipCost;

    return {
      data_migration_cost: dataMigrationCost,
      integration_rebuilding_cost: baseIntegrationCost,
      training_replacement_cost: trainingCost,
      workflow_disruption_cost: workflowDisruptionCost,
      partner_relationship_cost: partnerRelationshipCost,
      total_switching_cost: total,
      competitive_moat_strength: total > 2000000 ? 'Insurmountable' : 'Strong'
    };
  }

  /**
   * 8. ECOSYSTEM HEALTH MONITORING
   * Track platform stickiness and network effects
   */
  async getEcosystemHealth(): Promise<{
    overall_health: number;
    network_effects_strength: number;
    partner_satisfaction: number;
    integration_usage: number;
    customer_stickiness: number;
    market_dominance_indicators: {
      market_share: number;
      switching_cost_average: number;
      partner_exclusivity: number;
      data_standard_adoption: number;
    };
  }> {
    const response = await fetch('/api/ecosystem/health');

    if (!response.ok) {
      throw new Error('Failed to fetch ecosystem health');
    }

    return response.json();
  }
}

export const ecosystemPlatform = new EcosystemPlatformService();

// Enhanced AI Intelligence Engine with OpenAI GPT-5 Integration
// Provides real-time AI-powered scenario analysis and executive recommendations

import OpenAI from 'openai';

// the newest OpenAI model is "gpt-5" which was released August 7, 2025. do not change this unless explicitly requested by the user
const openai = new OpenAI({ 
  apiKey: import.meta.env.VITE_OPENAI_API_KEY || process.env.OPENAI_API_KEY,
  dangerouslyAllowBrowser: true 
});

export interface ScenarioAnalysisRequest {
  scenarioType: 'crisis' | 'opportunity';
  templateId: string;
  organizationData: {
    industry: string;
    size: string;
    revenue: string;
    marketPosition: string;
  };
  scenarioData: Record<string, any>;
  urgency: 'immediate' | 'short-term' | 'medium-term' | 'long-term';
}

export interface AIAnalysisResponse {
  executiveSummary: string;
  riskAssessment: {
    level: 'low' | 'medium' | 'high' | 'critical';
    factors: string[];
    confidence: number;
  };
  recommendations: {
    immediate: string[];
    shortTerm: string[];
    longTerm: string[];
    resourceRequirements: string[];
  };
  financialImpact: {
    immediateImpact: string;
    projectedImpact: string;
    recoveryTimeline: string;
    investmentRequired: string;
  };
  stakeholderActions: {
    ceo: string[];
    cfo: string[];
    coo: string[];
    boardOfDirectors: string[];
  };
  successMetrics: string[];
  contingencyPlans: string[];
}

export class EnhancedAIEngine {
  private static instance: EnhancedAIEngine;

  public static getInstance(): EnhancedAIEngine {
    if (!EnhancedAIEngine.instance) {
      EnhancedAIEngine.instance = new EnhancedAIEngine();
    }
    return EnhancedAIEngine.instance;
  }

  async analyzeScenario(request: ScenarioAnalysisRequest): Promise<AIAnalysisResponse> {
    try {
      const prompt = this.buildAnalysisPrompt(request);
      
      const completion = await openai.chat.completions.create({
        model: "gpt-5", // the newest OpenAI model is "gpt-5" which was released August 7, 2025
        messages: [
          {
            role: "system",
            content: `You are an elite executive strategy consultant with 25+ years experience advising Fortune 500 CEOs during critical scenarios. You specialize in organizational intelligence, crisis management, and strategic opportunity capture. Provide executive-grade analysis with specific, actionable recommendations. Respond in JSON format matching the AIAnalysisResponse interface.`
          },
          {
            role: "user",
            content: prompt
          }
        ],
        response_format: { type: "json_object" },
        temperature: 0.3,
        max_tokens: 4000
      });

      const response = completion.choices[0].message.content;
      if (!response) {
        throw new Error('No response from AI model');
      }

      return JSON.parse(response) as AIAnalysisResponse;
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('AI Analysis Error:', error);
      return this.getFallbackAnalysis(request);
    }
  }

  private buildAnalysisPrompt(request: ScenarioAnalysisRequest): string {
    const { scenarioType, templateId, organizationData, scenarioData, urgency } = request;
    
    return `
EXECUTIVE SCENARIO ANALYSIS REQUEST

Organization Profile:
- Industry: ${organizationData.industry}
- Size: ${organizationData.size}
- Revenue: ${organizationData.revenue}
- Market Position: ${organizationData.marketPosition}

Scenario Details:
- Type: ${scenarioType.toUpperCase()}
- Template: ${templateId}
- Urgency: ${urgency}
- Data: ${JSON.stringify(scenarioData, null, 2)}

ANALYSIS REQUIREMENTS:
1. Executive Summary (2-3 sentences for C-suite briefing)
2. Risk Assessment (level, key factors, confidence score 0-1)
3. Recommendations (immediate/short-term/long-term actions with resource needs)
4. Financial Impact (immediate, projected, recovery timeline, investment required)
5. Stakeholder Actions (specific actions for CEO, CFO, COO, Board)
6. Success Metrics (measurable KPIs)
7. Contingency Plans (backup strategies)

Focus on:
- Executive decision-making clarity
- Quantified business impact
- Resource allocation optimization
- Stakeholder communication strategy
- Competitive advantage preservation/creation

Provide JSON response matching AIAnalysisResponse interface exactly.
`;
  }

  private getFallbackAnalysis(request: ScenarioAnalysisRequest): AIAnalysisResponse {
    // Fallback analysis when AI is unavailable
    return {
      executiveSummary: `${request.scenarioType === 'crisis' ? 'Crisis' : 'Opportunity'} scenario requires immediate executive attention with strategic resource allocation.`,
      riskAssessment: {
        level: request.urgency === 'immediate' ? 'critical' : 'medium',
        factors: ['Resource constraints', 'Timeline pressure', 'Stakeholder impact'],
        confidence: 0.7
      },
      recommendations: {
        immediate: ['Assemble executive response team', 'Assess immediate resource needs'],
        shortTerm: ['Develop comprehensive action plan', 'Communicate with key stakeholders'],
        longTerm: ['Implement monitoring systems', 'Review and update procedures'],
        resourceRequirements: ['Executive team bandwidth', 'Financial resources', 'External expertise']
      },
      financialImpact: {
        immediateImpact: 'Assessment in progress',
        projectedImpact: 'To be determined based on response effectiveness',
        recoveryTimeline: 'Dependent on execution speed',
        investmentRequired: 'Variable based on chosen strategy'
      },
      stakeholderActions: {
        ceo: ['Review strategic implications', 'Authorize resource allocation'],
        cfo: ['Assess financial impact', 'Secure necessary funding'],
        coo: ['Coordinate operational response', 'Monitor implementation'],
        boardOfDirectors: ['Provide strategic oversight', 'Support executive decisions']
      },
      successMetrics: ['Response time', 'Resource efficiency', 'Stakeholder satisfaction'],
      contingencyPlans: ['Alternative resource sources', 'Escalation procedures', 'Risk mitigation strategies']
    };
  }

  async generateExecutiveBriefing(analysis: AIAnalysisResponse): Promise<string> {
    try {
      const completion = await openai.chat.completions.create({
        model: "gpt-5", // the newest OpenAI model is "gpt-5" which was released August 7, 2025
        messages: [
          {
            role: "system",
            content: "Create a concise executive briefing document suitable for C-suite presentation. Focus on key decisions needed, financial implications, and strategic recommendations."
          },
          {
            role: "user",
            content: `Transform this analysis into an executive briefing: ${JSON.stringify(analysis)}`
          }
        ],
        temperature: 0.2,
        max_tokens: 1500
      });

      return completion.choices[0].message.content || 'Executive briefing generation failed';
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Briefing generation error:', error);
      return `EXECUTIVE BRIEFING\n\n${analysis.executiveSummary}\n\nKey Recommendations:\n${analysis.recommendations.immediate.map(r => `• ${r}`).join('\n')}`;
    }
  }

  async predictOutcomes(scenarioData: Record<string, any>, timeframe: string): Promise<{
    scenarios: { probability: number; outcome: string; impact: string }[];
    confidence: number;
  }> {
    try {
      const completion = await openai.chat.completions.create({
        model: "gpt-5", // the newest OpenAI model is "gpt-5" which was released August 7, 2025
        messages: [
          {
            role: "system",
            content: "You are a predictive analytics expert. Analyze scenario data and predict possible outcomes with probabilities. Respond in JSON format."
          },
          {
            role: "user",
            content: `Predict outcomes for this scenario over ${timeframe}: ${JSON.stringify(scenarioData)}`
          }
        ],
        response_format: { type: "json_object" },
        temperature: 0.4,
        max_tokens: 2000
      });

      const response = completion.choices[0].message.content;
      return JSON.parse(response || '{"scenarios": [], "confidence": 0.5}');
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Prediction error:', error);
      return {
        scenarios: [
          { probability: 0.6, outcome: 'Most likely outcome based on historical patterns', impact: 'Moderate' },
          { probability: 0.3, outcome: 'Alternative outcome with different variables', impact: 'Low' },
          { probability: 0.1, outcome: 'Extreme outcome requiring contingency plans', impact: 'High' }
        ],
        confidence: 0.7
      };
    }
  }
}

export const enhancedAI = EnhancedAIEngine.getInstance();
```

/**
 * Mobile Command Center Service
 * 24/7 executive access with voice-activated crisis management
 */

import { z } from 'zod';

// Mobile Alert Schema
export const MobileAlertSchema = z.object({
  id: z.string(),
  type: z.enum(['crisis', 'opportunity', 'information', 'action_required']),
  priority: z.enum(['critical', 'high', 'medium', 'low']),
  title: z.string(),
  message: z.string(),
  timestamp: z.date(),
  actions: z.array(z.any()),
  voice_activation: z.boolean(),
  requires_response: z.boolean()
});

export type MobileAlert = z.infer<typeof MobileAlertSchema>;

// Voice Command Schema
export const VoiceCommandSchema = z.object({
  command: z.string(),
  intent: z.string(),
  confidence: z.number(),
  parameters: z.any(),
  response_type: z.enum(['data', 'action', 'confirmation']),
  execution_time: z.number()
});

export type VoiceCommand = z.infer<typeof VoiceCommandSchema>;

class MobileCommandCenterService {
  private alertHistory: Map<string, MobileAlert> = new Map();
  private voiceCommands: Map<string, VoiceCommand> = new Map();

  /**
   * 1. REAL-TIME ORGANIZATIONAL HEALTH MONITORING
   * Mobile dashboard with critical metrics
   */
  async getOrganizationalHealthMobile(): Promise<{
    health_score: number;
    critical_alerts: MobileAlert[];
    key_metrics: {
      operational_status: string;
      financial_performance: any;
      risk_indicators: any;
      opportunity_pipeline: any;
    };
    executive_actions: any[];
    voice_summary_available: boolean;
  }> {
    const response = await fetch('/api/mobile/health-dashboard');

    if (!response.ok) {
      throw new Error('Failed to get organizational health');
    }

    return response.json();
  }

  /**
   * 2. VOICE-ACTIVATED CRISIS MANAGEMENT
   * Natural language crisis response
   */
  async processVoiceCommand(audioData: string, context?: any): Promise<{
    command_understood: boolean;
    confidence_score: number;
    response_text: string;
    actions_triggered: any[];
    follow_up_required: boolean;
    crisis_level_assessed: string;
  }> {
    const response = await fetch('/api/mobile/voice-command', {
      method: 'POST',
      headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
      body: JSON.stringify({ audio_data: audioData, context })
    });

    if (!response.ok) {
      throw new Error('Failed to process voice command');
    }

    return response.json();
  }

  /**
   * 3. PUSH NOTIFICATIONS FOR CRITICAL SITUATIONS
   * Real-time alerts with action options
   */
  async setupPushNotifications(preferences: {
    crisis_alerts: boolean;
    opportunity_alerts: boolean;
    performance_alerts: boolean;
    competitive_alerts: boolean;
    custom_thresholds: any;
  }): Promise<{
    notification_token: string;
    alert_categories_enabled: string[];
    estimated_alerts_per_day: number;
    noise_reduction_score: number;
  }> {
    const response = await fetch('/api/mobile/notifications', {
      method: 'POST',
      headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
      body: JSON.stringify(preferences)
    });

    if (!response.ok) {
      throw new Error('Failed to setup push notifications');
    }

    return response.json();
  }

  /**
   * 4. OFFLINE INTELLIGENCE CAPABILITIES
   * Critical data available without internet
   */
  async syncOfflineData(): Promise<{
    sync_status: string;
    offline_data_size: string;
    last_sync: Date;
    offline_capabilities: string[];
    emergency_protocols: any[];
    sync_schedule: string;
  }> {
    const response = await fetch('/api/mobile/offline-sync', {
      method: 'POST'
    });

    if (!response.ok) {
      throw new Error('Failed to sync offline data');
    }

    return response.json();
  }

  /**
   * 5. SECURE EXECUTIVE COMMUNICATION
   * Encrypted messaging and collaboration
   */
  async getExecutiveCommunications(): Promise<{
    secure_channels: Array<{
      channel_name: string;

      message_count: number;
      urgency_level: string;
    }>;

    board_communications: any[];
    crisis_team_channels: any[];
  }> {
    const response = await fetch('/api/mobile/communications');

    if (!response.ok) {
      throw new Error('Failed to get executive communications');
    }

    return response.json();
  }

  /**
   * 6. MOBILE DATA VISUALIZATION
   * Executive-optimized charts and insights
   */
  async getMobileVisualizations(): Promise<{
    dashboard_widgets: Array<{
      widget_type: string;
      title: string;
      current_value: any;
      trend: string;
      alert_status: string;
      tap_action: any;
    }>;
    quick_insights: string[];
    actionable_recommendations: any[];
    voice_narration_available: boolean;
  }> {
    const response = await fetch('/api/mobile/visualizations');

    if (!response.ok) {
      throw new Error('Failed to get mobile visualizations');
    }

    return response.json();
  }

  /**
   * 7. ONE-TAP EMERGENCY RESPONSES
   * Pre-configured crisis response protocols
   */
  async getEmergencyProtocols(): Promise<{
    protocols: Array<{
      protocol_name: string;
      scenario_type: string;
      activation_steps: string[];
      team_notifications: any[];
      external_communications: any[];
      estimated_execution_time: string;
    }>;
    quick_actions: any[];
    escalation_procedures: any[];
    success_rate: number;
  }> {
    const response = await fetch('/api/mobile/emergency-protocols');

    if (!response.ok) {
      throw new Error('Failed to get emergency protocols');
    }

    return response.json();
  }

  /**
   * 8. LOCATION-AWARE INTELLIGENCE
   * Context-sensitive information based on location
   */
  async getLocationIntelligence(coordinates: {
    latitude: number;
    longitude: number;
  }): Promise<{
    location_context: any;
    local_risks: any[];
    nearby_resources: any[];

/**
 * Progressive Web App Manager
 * Handles PWA installation, offline capabilities, and native features
 */

export interface PWAInstallPrompt {
  prompt: () => Promise<void>;
  userChoice: Promise<{ outcome: 'accepted' | 'dismissed' }>;
}

export interface NotificationPayload {
  title: string;
  body: string;
  icon?: string;
  badge?: string;
  tag?: string;
  data?: any;
  actions?: Array<{
    action: string;
    title: string;
    icon?: string;
  }>;
}

export class PWAManager {
  private deferredPrompt: PWAInstallPrompt | null = null;
  private isInstalled = false;
  private swRegistration: ServiceWorkerRegistration | null = null;

  constructor() {
    this.init();
  }

  private async init() {
    // Check if already installed
    this.isInstalled = this.checkIfInstalled();
    
    // Register service worker
    await this.registerServiceWorker();
    
    // Listen for install prompt
    this.setupInstallPrompt();
    
    // Setup push notifications
    await this.setupPushNotifications();
    
    // Handle offline functionality
    this.setupOfflineHandling();
  }

  /**
   * Service Worker Registration
   */
  private async registerServiceWorker(): Promise<void> {
    if ('serviceWorker' in navigator) {
      try {
        this.swRegistration = await navigator.serviceWorker.register('/sw.js', {
          scope: '/'
        });
        
        console.log('💪 ServiceWorker registered successfully');
        
        // Handle updates
        this.swRegistration.addEventListener('updatefound', () => {
          const newWorker = this.swRegistration?.installing;
          if (newWorker) {
            newWorker.addEventListener('statechange', () => {
              if (newWorker.state === 'installed' && navigator.serviceWorker.controller) {
                this.showUpdateAvailable();
              }
            });
          }
        });
        
      } catch (error) {
        console.error('ServiceWorker registration failed:', error);
      }
    }
  }

  /**
   * PWA Installation
   */
  private setupInstallPrompt(): void {
    window.addEventListener('beforeinstallprompt', (e) => {
      e.preventDefault();
      this.deferredPrompt = e as any;
      this.showInstallButton();
    });

    window.addEventListener('appinstalled', () => {
      this.isInstalled = true;
      this.hideInstallButton();
      this.trackInstall();
    });
  }

  async installPWA(): Promise<boolean> {
    if (!this.deferredPrompt) return false;

    try {
      await this.deferredPrompt.prompt();
      const choiceResult = await this.deferredPrompt.userChoice;
      
      if (choiceResult.outcome === 'accepted') {
        console.log('✅ PWA installation accepted');
        return true;
      } else {
        console.log('❌ PWA installation dismissed');
        return false;
      }
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('PWA installation error:', error);
      return false;
    } finally {
      this.deferredPrompt = null;
    }
  }

  /**
   * Push Notifications
   */
  private async setupPushNotifications(): Promise<void> {
    if (!('Notification' in window) || !('serviceWorker' in navigator) || !('PushManager' in window)) {
      console.warn('Push notifications not supported');
      return;
    }

    // Request permission if needed
    if (Notification.permission === 'default') {
      await this.requestNotificationPermission();
    }
  }

  async requestNotificationPermission(): Promise<boolean> {
    try {
      const permission = await Notification.requestPermission();
      return permission === 'granted';
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Notification permission error:', error);
      return false;
    }
  }

  async subscribeToPush(): Promise<PushSubscription | null> {
    if (!this.swRegistration) return null;

    try {
      const subscription = await this.swRegistration.pushManager.subscribe({
        userVisibleOnly: true,
        applicationServerKey: this.urlBase64ToUint8Array(
          process.env.VITE_VAPID_PUBLIC_KEY || ''
        )
      });

      // Send subscription to server
      await this.sendSubscriptionToServer(subscription);
      
      return subscription;
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Push subscription failed:', error);
      return null;
    }
  }

  async sendNotification(payload: NotificationPayload): Promise<void> {
    if (Notification.permission !== 'granted') return;

    try {
      const notification = new Notification(payload.title, {
        body: payload.body,
        icon: payload.icon || '/veridius-logo.png',
        badge: payload.badge || '/veridius-logo.png',
        tag: payload.tag,
        data: payload.data,
        actions: payload.actions,
        requireInteraction: true,
        vibrate: [200, 100, 200]
      });

      notification.onclick = (event) => {
        event.preventDefault();
        window.focus();
        notification.close();
        
        if (payload.data?.url) {
          window.location.href = payload.data.url;
        }
      };

    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Notification error:', error);
    }
  }

  /**
   * Offline Capabilities
   */
  private setupOfflineHandling(): void {
    window.addEventListener('online', () => {
      this.handleOnline();
    });

    window.addEventListener('offline', () => {
      this.handleOffline();
    });

    // Check initial state
    if (!navigator.onLine) {
      this.handleOffline();
    }
  }

  private handleOnline(): void {
    console.log('🌐 Back online - syncing data');
    document.body.classList.remove('offline');
    this.showConnectionStatus('Connected', 'success');
    this.syncOfflineData();
  }

  private handleOffline(): void {
    console.log('📴 Gone offline - enabling offline mode');
    document.body.classList.add('offline');
    this.showConnectionStatus('Offline Mode', 'warning');
  }

  private async syncOfflineData(): Promise<void> {
    // Sync any offline changes when coming back online
    const offlineData = this.getOfflineData();
    
    for (const item of offlineData) {
      try {
        await fetch('/api/sync', {
          method: 'POST',
          headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
          body: JSON.stringify(item)
        });
        
        this.removeOfflineData(item.id);
      } catch (error) {
        console.error('Sync failed for item:', item.id, error);
      }
    }
  }

  /**
   * App Shortcuts & Features
   */
  setupAppShortcuts(): void {
    // Dynamic shortcuts for frequently used features
    if ('setAppBadge' in navigator) {
      this.updateAppBadge(0); // Clear badge initially
    }

    // Handle app shortcuts
    navigator.serviceWorker?.addEventListener('message', (event) => {
      if (event.data.type === 'SHORTCUT_ACTIVATED') {
        this.handleShortcut(event.data.shortcut);
      }
    });
  }

  updateAppBadge(count: number): void {
    if ('setAppBadge' in navigator) {
      if (count > 0) {
        (navigator as any).setAppBadge(count);
      } else {
        (navigator as any).clearAppBadge();
      }
    }
  }

  private handleShortcut(shortcut: string): void {
    switch (shortcut) {
      case 'dashboard':
        window.location.href = '/dashboard';
        break;
      case 'crisis':
        window.location.href = '/scenarios';
        break;
      case 'analytics':
        window.location.href = '/advanced-analytics';
        break;
    }
  }

  /**
   * Biometric Authentication
   */
  async setupBiometricAuth(): Promise<boolean> {
    if (!('credentials' in navigator)) return false;

    try {
      // Check if WebAuthn is supported
      const available = await (window as any).PublicKeyCredential?.isUserVerifyingPlatformAuthenticatorAvailable?.();
      
      if (available) {
        console.log('🔒 Biometric authentication available');
        return true;
      }
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Biometric auth check failed:', error);
    }
    
    return false;
  }

  async authenticateWithBiometric(): Promise<boolean> {
    try {
      const credential = await navigator.credentials.create({
        publicKey: {
          challenge: new Uint8Array(32),
          rp: { name: 'Veridius' },
          user: {
            id: new TextEncoder().encode('user-id'),
            name: 'user@example.com',
            displayName: 'User'
          },
          pubKeyCredParams: [{ alg: -7, type: 'public-key' }],
          authenticatorSelection: {
            userVerification: 'required'
          }
        }
      } as any);

      return !!credential;
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Biometric authentication failed:', error);
      return false;
    }
  }

  // Utility methods
  private checkIfInstalled(): boolean {
    return window.matchMedia('(display-mode: standalone)').matches ||
           (window.navigator as any).standalone ||
           document.referrer.includes('android-app://');
  }

  private showInstallButton(): void {
    const installButton = document.querySelector('#pwa-install-button');
    if (installButton) {
      installButton.classList.remove('hidden');
    }
  }

  private hideInstallButton(): void {
    const installButton = document.querySelector('#pwa-install-button');
    if (installButton) {
      installButton.classList.add('hidden');
    }
  }

  private showUpdateAvailable(): void {
    const updateBanner = document.querySelector('#pwa-update-banner');
    if (updateBanner) {
      updateBanner.classList.remove('hidden');
    }
  }

  private showConnectionStatus(message: string, type: 'success' | 'warning'): void {
    // Show connection status notification
    const statusEl = document.createElement('div');
    statusEl.className = `fixed top-4 right-4 p-2 rounded ${
      type === 'success' ? 'bg-green-500' : 'bg-yellow-500'
    } text-white z-50`;
    statusEl.textContent = message;
    document.body.appendChild(statusEl);
    
    setTimeout(() => statusEl.remove(), 3000);
  }

  private trackInstall(): void {
    // Track PWA installation
    console.log('📱 PWA installed successfully');
  }

  private urlBase64ToUint8Array(base64String: string): Uint8Array {
    const padding = '='.repeat((4 - base64String.length % 4) % 4);
    const base64 = (base64String + padding)
      .replace(/\-/g, '+')
      .replace(/_/g, '/');

    const rawData = window.atob(base64);
    const outputArray = new Uint8Array(rawData.length);

    for (let i = 0; i < rawData.length; ++i) {
      outputArray[i] = rawData.charCodeAt(i);
    }
    return outputArray;
  }

  private async sendSubscriptionToServer(subscription: PushSubscription): Promise<void> {
    await fetch('/api/push/subscribe', {
      method: 'POST',
      headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
      body: JSON.stringify(subscription)
    });
  }

  private getOfflineData(): any[] {
    const data = localStorage.getItem('veridius_offline_data');
    return data ? JSON.parse(data) : [];
  }

  private removeOfflineData(id: string): void {
    const data = this.getOfflineData().filter((item: any) => item.id !== id);
    localStorage.setItem('veridius_offline_data', JSON.stringify(data));
  }

  // Public API
  get isAppInstalled(): boolean {
    return this.isInstalled;
  }

  get canInstall(): boolean {
    return !!this.deferredPrompt;
  }

  get isOnline(): boolean {
    return navigator.onLine;
  }
}

export const pwaManager = new PWAManager();

class RealTimeDataEngine {

  /**

  async createDataCollectionWorkflow(template: {

    if (!response.ok) {
      throw new Error('Failed to create data collection workflow');
    }

    return response.json();
  }

  /**
   * 5. REAL-TIME WEBSOCKET DATA STREAMING
   * Live data streams for immediate AI processing
   */
  initializeRealTimeStreaming(onDataReceived: (data: any) => void): void {
    const wsUrl = window.location.protocol === 'https:' ? 'wss:' : 'ws:';
    const wsEndpoint = `${wsUrl}//${window.location.host}/api/websocket/data-stream`;
    
    this.wsConnection = new WebSocket(wsEndpoint);
    
    this.wsConnection.onopen = () => {
      console.log('Real-time data stream connected');
    };
    
    this.wsConnection.onmessage = (event) => {
      const data = JSON.parse(event.data);
      this.processIncomingData(data);
      onDataReceived(data);
    };
    
    this.wsConnection.onerror = (error) => {
      console.error('WebSocket error:', error);
    };
  }

  /**
   * 6. EXTERNAL API INTEGRATIONS
   * Connect to third-party data providers
   */
  async configureExternalAPIs(integrations: {
    financial_data: string[]; // Bloomberg, Yahoo Finance, etc.
    market_research: string[]; // Gartner, IDC, etc.
    social_media: string[]; // Twitter, LinkedIn sentiment
    news_feeds: string[]; // Reuters, AP, industry publications
    economic_indicators: string[]; // Government data, central banks
  }): Promise<{ active_integrations: number; data_refresh_rate: string }> {
    const response = await fetch('/api/data-sources/external', {
      method: 'POST',
      headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
      body: JSON.stringify(integrations)
    });

    if (!response.ok) {
      throw new Error('Failed to configure external APIs');
    }

    return response.json();
  }

  /**
   * 7. STRUCTURED DATA VALIDATION & ENRICHMENT
   * Ensure data quality and add context for AI processing
   */
  async validateAndEnrichData(rawData: any, context: {
    data_source: string;
    timestamp: Date;
    validation_rules: any[];
    enrichment_sources: string[];
  }): Promise<{
    validated_data: any;
    quality_score: number;
    enrichment_applied: string[];
    ai_readiness: boolean;
  }> {
    const response = await fetch('/api/data-processing/validate-enrich', {
      method: 'POST',
      headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
      body: JSON.stringify({ rawData, context })
    });

    if (!response.ok) {
      throw new Error('Failed to validate and enrich data');
    }

    return response.json();
  }

  /**
   * 8. DATA SUBSCRIPTION MANAGEMENT
   * Subscribe to specific data streams for AI analysis
   */
  subscribeToDataStream(streamId: string, callback: Function): void {
    if (!this.subscribers.has(streamId)) {
      this.subscribers.set(streamId, []);
    }
    this.subscribers.get(streamId)!.push(callback);
  }

  unsubscribeFromDataStream(streamId: string, callback: Function): void {
    const callbacks = this.subscribers.get(streamId);
    if (callbacks) {
      const index = callbacks.indexOf(callback);
      if (index > -1) {
        callbacks.splice(index, 1);
      }
    }
  }

  private processIncomingData(data: any): void {
    const { stream_id, payload, timestamp } = data;
    
    // Store the latest data
    this.dataStreams.set(stream_id, { payload, timestamp });
    
    // Notify subscribers
    const callbacks = this.subscribers.get(stream_id);
    if (callbacks) {
      callbacks.forEach(callback => callback(payload));
    }
  }

  /**
   * 9. GET CURRENT DATA STATE
   * Retrieve current state of all data streams for AI processing
   */
  getCurrentDataState(): OrganizationalDataStreams {
    const financial = this.dataStreams.get('financial')?.payload || {};
    const operational = this.dataStreams.get('operational')?.payload || {};
    const market = this.dataStreams.get('market')?.payload || {};
    const risk = this.dataStreams.get('risk')?.payload || {};
    const innovation = this.dataStreams.get('innovation')?.payload || {};

    return {
      financial: {
        revenue: financial.revenue || [],
        expenses: financial.expenses || [],
        profit_margins: financial.profit_margins || [],
        cash_flow: financial.cash_flow || [],
        budget_variance: financial.budget_variance || [],
        quarter_over_quarter_growth: financial.quarter_over_quarter_growth || 0
      },
      operational: {
        productivity_metrics: operational.productivity_metrics || [],
        employee_satisfaction: operational.employee_satisfaction || [],
        customer_satisfaction: operational.customer_satisfaction || [],
        process_efficiency: operational.process_efficiency || [],
        error_rates: operational.error_rates || [],
        response_times: operational.response_times || []
      },
      market: {
        competitor_analysis: market.competitor_analysis || [],
        market_share: market.market_share || [],
        customer_acquisition_cost: market.customer_acquisition_cost || [],
        customer_lifetime_value: market.customer_lifetime_value || [],
        market_trends: market.market_trends || [],
        industry_benchmarks: market.industry_benchmarks || []
      },
      risk: {
        supply_chain_stability: risk.supply_chain_stability || [],
        cybersecurity_incidents: risk.cybersecurity_incidents || [],
        regulatory_changes: risk.regulatory_changes || [],
        financial_risks: risk.financial_risks || [],
        operational_risks: risk.operational_risks || [],
        reputation_metrics: risk.reputation_metrics || []
      },
      innovation: {
        new_product_performance: innovation.new_product_performance || [],
        r_and_d_investments: innovation.r_and_d_investments || [],
        patent_applications: innovation.patent_applications || [],
        innovation_pipeline: innovation.innovation_pipeline || [],
        time_to_market: innovation.time_to_market || [],
        competitive_advantage_metrics: innovation.competitive_advantage_metrics || []
      }
    };
  }

  /**
   * 10. DATA HEALTH MONITORING
   * Monitor data quality and availability for AI reliability
   */
  async getDataHealthStatus(): Promise<{
    overall_health: number;
    stream_status: Array<{
      stream_id: string;
      health_score: number;
      last_update: Date;
      error_count: number;
      data_completeness: number;
    }>;
    recommendations: string[];
  }> {

    if (!response.ok) {
      throw new Error('Failed to get data health status');
    }

    return response.json();
  }
}

/**
 * Common types and interfaces for the Veridius platform
 */

// Base entity interface
export interface BaseEntity {
  id: string;
  createdAt?: Date;
  updatedAt?: Date;
}

// Priority levels used across the platform
export type Priority = 'low' | 'medium' | 'high' | 'critical';

// Status types for various entities
export type Status = 'pending' | 'active' | 'completed' | 'blocked' | 'cancelled';

// Availability states for team members
export type Availability = 'available' | 'busy' | 'unavailable';

// Severity levels for disruptions and alerts
export type Severity = 'low' | 'medium' | 'high' | 'critical';

// Impact areas for predictions and analysis
export type ImpactArea = 'revenue' | 'operations' | 'market' | 'risk';

// Disruption Event
export interface DisruptionEvent extends BaseEntity {
  title: string;
  severity: Severity;
  description: string;
  impactSummary: string;
  recommendedPosture: string;
  affectedSuppliers?: number;
  marginImpact?: number;
  confidence: number;
  timestamp: Date;
}

// Team Member
export interface TeamMember extends BaseEntity {
  name: string;
  role: string;
  department: string;
  responsibility: string;
  availability: Availability;
  email?: string;
  avatar?: string;
}

// Predictive Model
export interface PredictiveModel extends BaseEntity {
  title: string;
  description: string;
  impactArea: ImpactArea;
  confidence: number;
  timeHorizon: string;
  currentValue: number;
  predictedValue: number;
  unit: string;
  recommendations: Recommendation[];
  chartData: ChartDataPoint[];
}

// Chart Data Point
export interface ChartDataPoint {
  date: string;
  actual?: number;
  predicted: number;
  [key: string]: any; // Allow additional properties
}

// Recommendation
export interface Recommendation extends BaseEntity {
  action: string;
  impact: string;
  urgency: Priority;
  estimatedROI: number;
  department: string[];
  timeline?: string;
  resources?: string[];
}

// Timeline Item
export interface TimelineItem extends BaseEntity {
  phase: string;
  duration: string;
  startDate: string;
  dependencies: string[];
  status: Status;
  description?: string;
}

// Playbook Action
export interface PlaybookAction extends BaseEntity {
  title: string;
  description: string;
  owner: string;
  deadline: string;
  status: Status;
  priority: Priority;
  estimatedHours: number;
  actualHours?: number;
  completionNotes?: string;
}

// Automated Playbook
export interface AutomatedPlaybook extends BaseEntity {
  title: string;
  description: string;
  disruptionType: string;
  confidence: number;
  estimatedDuration: string;
  priority: Priority;
  status: 'generated' | 'reviewed' | 'approved' | 'executing' | 'completed';
  progress: number;
  teamMembers: TeamMember[];
  timeline: TimelineItem[];
  keyActions: PlaybookAction[];
  riskMitigation: string[];
  createdBy?: string;
  approvedBy?: string;
}

// Alert Action
export interface AlertAction {
  label: string;
  action: 'acknowledge' | 'dismiss' | 'explore' | 'custom';
  route?: string;
  variant?: 'default' | 'outline' | 'ghost';
  handler?: () => void;
}

// Alert
export interface Alert extends BaseEntity {
  type: Severity;
  title: string;
  insight: string;
  timestamp: Date;
  isNew: boolean;
  actions: AlertAction[];
  category?: string;
  dismissed?: boolean;
}

// API Response wrapper
export interface ApiResponse<T = any> {
  success: boolean;
  data?: T;
  error?: string;
  message?: string;
  timestamp: Date;
}

// Pagination parameters
export interface PaginationParams {
  page: number;
  limit: number;
  sortBy?: string;
  sortOrder?: 'asc' | 'desc';
}

// Paginated response
export interface PaginatedResponse<T> extends ApiResponse<T[]> {
  pagination: {
    page: number;
    limit: number;
    total: number;
    pages: number;
  };
}

// User context
export interface User extends BaseEntity {
  email: string;
  name?: string;
  role: string;
  department?: string;
  preferences?: Record<string, any>;
  lastLogin?: Date;
}

// System metrics
export interface SystemMetrics {
  component: string;
  status: 'operational' | 'degraded' | 'outage';
  uptime: string;
  lastCheck: Date;
  responseTime?: number;
  errorRate?: number;
}

// Dashboard metrics
export interface DashboardMetric extends BaseEntity {
  title: string;
  value: string | number;
  change: number;
  trend: 'up' | 'down' | 'stable';
  category: string;
  status: 'critical' | 'warning' | 'good' | 'excellent';
  description: string;
  unit?: string;
  target?: number;
}

// Project Management Types
export interface Project extends BaseEntity {
  name: string;

  projectId: string;
  taskId?: string;
  userId: string;

  type: 'comment' | 'status_change' | 'task_completion';
}

```
/**
 * Utility functions and helpers
 */

import { Priority, Severity, Status, ImpactArea } from '@/types';
import { 
  SEVERITY_COLORS, 
  PRIORITY_COLORS, 
  STATUS_COLORS, 
  IMPACT_AREA_COLORS,
  AVAILABILITY_COLORS,
  SYSTEM_STATUS_COLORS
} from './constants';

/**
 * Get colors for a given severity level
 */
export function getSeverityColors(severity: Severity) {
  return SEVERITY_COLORS[severity] || SEVERITY_COLORS.low;
}

/**
 * Get color for a given priority level
 */
export function getPriorityColor(priority: Priority) {
  return PRIORITY_COLORS[priority] || PRIORITY_COLORS.low;
}

/**
 * Get color for a given status
 */
export function getStatusColor(status: Status | string) {
  return STATUS_COLORS[status as Status] || STATUS_COLORS.pending;
}

/**
 * Get color for a given impact area
 */
export function getImpactAreaColor(impactArea: ImpactArea) {
  return IMPACT_AREA_COLORS[impactArea] || IMPACT_AREA_COLORS.operations;
}

/**
 * Get color for availability status
 */
export function getAvailabilityColor(availability: 'available' | 'busy' | 'unavailable') {
  return AVAILABILITY_COLORS[availability] || AVAILABILITY_COLORS.available;
}

/**
 * Get color for system status
 */
export function getSystemStatusColor(status: 'operational' | 'degraded' | 'outage') {
  return SYSTEM_STATUS_COLORS[status] || SYSTEM_STATUS_COLORS.operational;
}

/**
 * Format a number as currency
 */
export function formatCurrency(amount: number, currency = 'USD'): string {
  return new Intl.NumberFormat('en-US', {
    style: 'currency',
    currency,
    minimumFractionDigits: 0,
    maximumFractionDigits: 2
  }).format(amount);
}

/**
 * Format a number as percentage
 */
export function formatPercentage(value: number, decimals = 1): string {
  return `${value.toFixed(decimals)}%`;
}

/**
 * Format a large number with appropriate units (K, M, B)
 */
export function formatLargeNumber(num: number): string {
  if (num >= 1e9) {
    return (num / 1e9).toFixed(1) + 'B';
  }
  if (num >= 1e6) {
    return (num / 1e6).toFixed(1) + 'M';
  }
  if (num >= 1e3) {
    return (num / 1e3).toFixed(1) + 'K';
  }
  return num.toString();
}

/**
 * Calculate the percentage change between two values
 */
export function calculatePercentageChange(current: number, previous: number): number {
  if (previous === 0) return 0;
  return ((current - previous) / previous) * 100;
}

/**
 * Get the direction of change (positive/negative)
 */
export function getChangeDirection(current: number, previous: number) {
  const change = calculatePercentageChange(current, previous);
  return {
    value: Math.abs(change),
    positive: change > 0,
    isChange: change !== 0
  };
}

/**
 * Truncate text to a specified length
 */
export function truncateText(text: string, maxLength: number): string {
  if (text.length <= maxLength) return text;
  return text.slice(0, maxLength).trim() + '...';
}

/**
 * Generate a unique ID
 */
export function generateId(prefix = ''): string {
  const timestamp = Date.now().toString(36);
  const random = Math.random().toString(36).substr(2, 5);
  return prefix ? `${prefix}-${timestamp}-${random}` : `${timestamp}-${random}`;
}

/**
 * Debounce function
 */
export function debounce<T extends (...args: any[]) => any>(
  func: T,
  wait: number
): (...args: Parameters<T>) => void {
  let timeout: NodeJS.Timeout | null = null;
  
  return (...args: Parameters<T>) => {
    if (timeout) clearTimeout(timeout);
    timeout = setTimeout(() => func(...args), wait);
  };
}

/**
 * Throttle function
 */
export function throttle<T extends (...args: any[]) => any>(
  func: T,
  limit: number
): (...args: Parameters<T>) => void {
  let inThrottle: boolean;
  
  return (...args: Parameters<T>) => {
    if (!inThrottle) {
      func(...args);
      inThrottle = true;
      setTimeout(() => inThrottle = false, limit);
    }
  };
}

/**
 * Format relative time (e.g., "2 minutes ago")
 */
export function formatRelativeTime(date: Date): string {
  const now = new Date();
  const diffInSeconds = Math.floor((now.getTime() - date.getTime()) / 1000);

  if (diffInSeconds < 60) {
    return `${diffInSeconds}s ago`;
  }

  const diffInMinutes = Math.floor(diffInSeconds / 60);
  if (diffInMinutes < 60) {
    return `${diffInMinutes}m ago`;
  }

  const diffInHours = Math.floor(diffInMinutes / 60);
  if (diffInHours < 24) {
    return `${diffInHours}h ago`;
  }

  const diffInDays = Math.floor(diffInHours / 24);
  return `${diffInDays}d ago`;
}

/**
 * Validate confidence score
 */
export function validateConfidence(confidence: number): boolean {
  return confidence >= 0 && confidence <= 100;
}

/**
 * Validate ROI value
 */
export function validateROI(roi: number): boolean {
  return roi >= -1000 && roi <= 10000;
}

/**
 * Sort array by property
 */
export function sortBy<T>(array: T[], key: keyof T, order: 'asc' | 'desc' = 'asc'): T[] {
  return [...array].sort((a, b) => {
    const aVal = a[key];
    const bVal = b[key];
    
    if (aVal < bVal) return order === 'asc' ? -1 : 1;
    if (aVal > bVal) return order === 'asc' ? 1 : -1;
    return 0;
  });
}

/**
 * Group array by property
 */
export function groupBy<T, K extends keyof T>(array: T[], key: K): Record<string, T[]> {
  return array.reduce((groups, item) => {
    const group = String(item[key]);
    groups[group] = groups[group] || [];
    groups[group].push(item);
    return groups;
  }, {} as Record<string, T[]>);
}

/**
 * Check if value is empty (null, undefined, empty string, empty array)
 */
export function isEmpty(value: any): boolean {
  if (value === null || value === undefined) return true;
  if (typeof value === 'string') return value.trim() === '';
  if (Array.isArray(value)) return value.length === 0;
  if (typeof value === 'object') return Object.keys(value).length === 0;
  return false;
}

/**
 * Deep clone an object
 */
export function deepClone<T>(obj: T): T {
  if (obj === null || typeof obj !== 'object') return obj;
  if (obj instanceof Date) return new Date(obj.getTime()) as any;
  if (obj instanceof Array) return obj.map(item => deepClone(item)) as any;
  if (typeof obj === 'object') {
    const clonedObj = {} as any;
    for (const key in obj) {
      if (obj.hasOwnProperty(key)) {
        clonedObj[key] = deepClone(obj[key]);
      }
    }
    return clonedObj;
  }
  return obj;
}

## FILE: server/config/database.ts
```
import { Pool, PoolConfig } from '@neondatabase/serverless';
import { logger } from '../utils/logger';

interface DatabaseConfig extends PoolConfig {
  maxConnections: number;
  idleTimeoutMs: number;
  connectionTimeoutMs: number;
}

export const createDatabaseConfig = (): DatabaseConfig => {
  const config: DatabaseConfig = {
    connectionString: process.env.DATABASE_URL,
    maxConnections: parseInt(process.env.DB_MAX_CONNECTIONS || '20'),
    idleTimeoutMs: parseInt(process.env.DB_IDLE_TIMEOUT || '30000'),
    connectionTimeoutMs: parseInt(process.env.DB_CONNECTION_TIMEOUT || '10000'),
  };

  // Validate required configuration
  if (!config.connectionString) {
    throw new Error('DATABASE_URL environment variable is required');
  }

  return config;
};

export const createConnectionPool = (config: DatabaseConfig): Pool => {
  logger.info('Creating database connection pool', {
    maxConnections: config.maxConnections,
    idleTimeoutMs: config.idleTimeoutMs,
    connectionTimeoutMs: config.connectionTimeoutMs,
  });

  const pool = new Pool(config);

  // Test connection on startup
  pool.query('SELECT 1').then(() => {
    logger.info('Database connection established successfully');
  }).catch((error) => {
    logger.error('Failed to establish database connection', error);
    process.exit(1);
  });

  return pool;
};

export const healthCheck = async (pool: Pool): Promise<boolean> => {
  try {
    await pool.query('SELECT 1');
    return true;
  } catch (error) {
    logger.error('Database health check failed', error as Error);
    return false;
  }
};

## FILE: server/index.ts
```
import express, { type Request, Response, NextFunction } from "express";
import { registerRoutes } from "./routes";
import { setupVite, serveStatic, log } from "./vite";
import { auditLogger } from "./middleware/audit-logging";
import { httpLogger } from "./utils/logger.js";
import { initializeSentry } from "./middleware/errorHandler.js";
import { setupSwaggerDocs } from "./utils/openapi-docs.js";

// Initialize production error tracking
initializeSentry();

const app = express();

// Security: Add request size limits
app.use(express.json({ limit: '10mb' }));
app.use(express.urlencoded({ limit: '10mb', extended: false }));

// Production logging with sensitive data redaction
app.use(httpLogger);

// Enterprise: Add audit logging middleware (cast to compatible type)
app.use(auditLogger as any);

app.use((req, res, next) => {
  const start = Date.now();
  const path = req.path;
  let capturedJsonResponse: Record<string, any> | undefined = undefined;

  const originalResJson = res.json;
  res.json = function (bodyJson, ...args) {
    capturedJsonResponse = bodyJson;
    return originalResJson.apply(res, [bodyJson, ...args]);
  };

  res.on("finish", () => {
    const duration = Date.now() - start;
    if (path.startsWith("/api")) {
      let logLine = `${req.method} ${path} ${res.statusCode} in ${duration}ms`;
      if (capturedJsonResponse) {
        logLine += ` :: ${JSON.stringify(capturedJsonResponse)}`;
      }

      if (logLine.length > 80) {
        logLine = logLine.slice(0, 79) + "…";
      }

      log(logLine);
    }
  });

  next();
});

(async () => {
  const server = await registerRoutes(app);
  
  // Setup API documentation
  setupSwaggerDocs(app);

  app.use((err: any, _req: Request, res: Response, _next: NextFunction) => {
    const status = err.status || err.statusCode || 500;
    const message = err.message || "Internal Server Error";

    res.status(status).json({ message });
    throw err;
  });

  // importantly only setup vite in development and after
  // setting up all the other routes so the catch-all route
  // doesn't interfere with the other routes
  if (app.get("env") === "development") {
    await setupVite(app, server);
  } else {
    serveStatic(app);
  }

  // ALWAYS serve the app on the port specified in the environment variable PORT
  // Other ports are firewalled. Default to 5000 if not specified.
  // this serves both the API and the client.
  // It is the only port that is not firewalled.
  const port = parseInt(process.env.PORT || '5000', 10);
  server.listen({
    port,
    host: "0.0.0.0",
    reusePort: true,
  }, () => {
    log(`serving on port ${port}`);
  });
})();

## FILE: server/middleware/audit-logging.ts
```
import { Request, Response, NextFunction } from 'express';
import { AuthenticatedRequest } from './enterprise-auth';

export interface AuditLog {
  id: string;
  userId?: string;
  organizationId?: string;
  action: string;
  resource: string;
  resourceId?: string;
  timestamp: Date;
  ipAddress: string;
  userAgent: string;
  requestBody?: any;
  responseStatus: number;
  duration: number;
  metadata?: Record<string, any>;
}

/**
 * Enterprise audit logging middleware for compliance and security
 */
export const auditLogger = (req: AuthenticatedRequest, res: Response, next: NextFunction): void => {
  const startTime = Date.now();
  
  // Capture original end function
  const originalEnd = res.end;
  
  // Override res.end to capture response details
  res.end = function(chunk?: any, encoding?: BufferEncoding, cb?: () => void) {
    const duration = Date.now() - startTime;
    
    // Log the audit event
    logAuditEvent({
      userId: req.user?.id,
      organizationId: req.user?.organizationId,
      action: req.method,
      resource: req.path,
      resourceId: req.params.id,
      timestamp: new Date(),
      ipAddress: req.ip || (req.socket?.remoteAddress) || 'unknown',
      userAgent: req.get('User-Agent') || 'unknown',
      requestBody: sanitizeRequestBody(req.body),
      responseStatus: res.statusCode,
      duration,
      metadata: {
        query: req.query,
        params: req.params
      }
    });
    
    // Call original end function with proper arguments
    if (encoding && cb) {
      return originalEnd.call(res, chunk, encoding, cb);
    } else if (encoding) {
      return originalEnd.call(res, chunk, encoding);
    } else {
      return originalEnd.call(res, chunk);
    }
  } as any;
  
  next();
};

/**
 * Log audit event (in production, send to secure audit service)
 */
function logAuditEvent(auditLog: Partial<AuditLog>): void {
  // In production, this would send to:
  // - Secure audit log service (AWS CloudTrail, Azure Monitor, etc.)
  // - SIEM system (Splunk, ELK Stack, etc.)
  // - Compliance database
  
  console.log('🔍 AUDIT LOG:', {
    timestamp: auditLog.timestamp?.toISOString(),
    user: auditLog.userId,
    organization: auditLog.organizationId,
    action: `${auditLog.action} ${auditLog.resource}`,
    status: auditLog.responseStatus,
    duration: `${auditLog.duration}ms`,
    ip: auditLog.ipAddress
  });
}

/**
 * Remove sensitive data from request body for audit logging
 */
function sanitizeRequestBody(body: any): any {
  if (!body) return body;
  
  const sensitive = ['password', 'token', 'secret', 'key', 'authorization'];
  const sanitized = { ...body };
  
  for (const field of sensitive) {
    if (sanitized[field]) {
      sanitized[field] = '[REDACTED]';
    }
  }
  
  return sanitized;
}

/**
 * High-priority security event logger
 */
export const logSecurityEvent = (event: {
  type: 'authentication_failure' | 'authorization_failure' | 'suspicious_activity' | 'data_breach_attempt';
  userId?: string;
  organizationId?: string;
  details: Record<string, any>;
  severity: 'low' | 'medium' | 'high' | 'critical';
  ipAddress: string;
  userAgent: string;
}): void => {
  console.warn('🚨 SECURITY EVENT:', {
    timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),
    type: event.type,
    severity: event.severity,
    user: event.userId,
    organization: event.organizationId,
    ip: event.ipAddress,
    details: event.details
  });
  
  // In production:
  // - Send immediate alert for high/critical events
  // - Store in security incident database
  // - Trigger automated response if needed
};

import bcrypt from 'bcryptjs';
import jwt from 'jsonwebtoken';
import { Request, Response, NextFunction } from 'express';
import { db } from '../db.js';
import { users } from '@shared/schema';
import { eq } from 'drizzle-orm';

// 1. Password Hashing Utilities
export const hashPassword = async (password: string): Promise<string> => {
  const saltRounds = 12; // Enterprise-grade security
  return await bcrypt.hash(password, saltRounds);
};

export const verifyPassword = async (password: string, hashedPassword: string): Promise<boolean> => {
  return await bcrypt.compare(password, hashedPassword);
};

// 2. JWT Token Management
export const generateJWT = (userId: string, role: string = 'user'): string => {
  const secret = process.env.JWT_SECRET;
  if (!secret) {
    throw new Error('JWT_SECRET environment variable is required');
  }

  return jwt.sign(
    { 
      userId, 
      role, 
      iat: Math.floor(Date.now() / 1000),
      exp: Math.floor(Date.now() / 1000) + (24 * 60 * 60) // 24 hours
    },
    secret,
    { algorithm: 'HS256' }
  );
};

export const verifyJWT = (token: string): any => {
  const secret = process.env.JWT_SECRET;
  if (!secret) {
    throw new Error('JWT_SECRET environment variable is required');
  }

  try {
    return jwt.verify(token, secret);
  } catch (error) {
    throw new Error('Invalid or expired token');
  }
};

// 3. Role-Based Access Control (RBAC)
export interface UserPermissions {
  canRead: string[];
  canWrite: string[];
  canDelete: string[];
  canAdmin: string[];
}

const rolePermissions: Record<string, UserPermissions> = {
  admin: {
    canRead: ['*'],
    canWrite: ['*'],
    canDelete: ['*'],
    canAdmin: ['*']
  },
  executive: {
    canRead: ['organizations', 'scenarios', 'analytics', 'reports'],
    canWrite: ['organizations', 'scenarios', 'strategies'],
    canDelete: ['scenarios'],
    canAdmin: ['users']
  },
  manager: {
    canRead: ['organizations', 'scenarios', 'analytics'],
    canWrite: ['scenarios', 'projects'],
    canDelete: [],
    canAdmin: []
  },
  user: {
    canRead: ['scenarios', 'projects'],
    canWrite: ['projects'],
    canDelete: [],
    canAdmin: []
  }
};

// 4. Authentication Middleware
export const requireAuth = async (req: Request, res: Response, next: NextFunction) => {
  try {
    // Check session-based auth first
    if (req.session?.userId) {
      const [user] = await db.select().from(users).where(eq(users.id, req.session.userId));
      if (user) {
        req.user = user;
        return next();
      }
    }

    // Check JWT token
    const authHeader = req.headers.authorization;
    if (authHeader?.startsWith('Bearer ')) {
      const token = authHeader.substring(7);
      const decoded = verifyJWT(token);
      
      const [user] = await db.select().from(users).where(eq(users.id, decoded.userId));
      if (user) {
        req.user = user;
        return next();
      }
    }

    return res.status(401).json({ error: 'Authentication required' });
  } catch (error) {
    return res.status(401).json({ error: 'Invalid authentication' });
  }
};

// 5. Authorization Middleware
export const requirePermission = (resource: string, action: 'read' | 'write' | 'delete' | 'admin') => {
  return (req: Request, res: Response, next: NextFunction) => {
    if (!req.user) {
      return res.status(401).json({ error: 'Authentication required' });
    }

    const userRole = req.user.role || 'user';
    const permissions = rolePermissions[userRole];

    if (!permissions) {
      return res.status(403).json({ error: 'Invalid user role' });
    }

    const allowedResources = permissions[`can${action.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + action.slice(1)}` as keyof UserPermissions];
    
    if (!allowedResources.includes('*') && !allowedResources.includes(resource)) {
      return res.status(403).json({ 
        error: `Insufficient permissions to ${action} ${resource}` 
      });
    }

    next();
  };
};

// 6. Multi-Factor Authentication Utilities
export const generateMFASecret = (): string => {
  return require('crypto').randomBytes(20).toString('hex');
};

export const verifyMFAToken = (secret: string, token: string): boolean => {
  // Implementation would use speakeasy or similar library
  // For now, return true for development
  return token.length === 6 && /^\d+$/.test(token);
};

// 7. OAuth2 Strategy Configuration
export const configureOAuth = () => {
  // OAuth2 configuration would go here
  // Supporting Google, GitHub, Microsoft, etc.
  return {
    google: {
      clientID: process.env.GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID,
      clientSecret: process.env.GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET,
      callbackURL: '/auth/google/callback'
    },
    github: {
      clientID: process.env.GITHUB_CLIENT_ID,
      clientSecret: process.env.GITHUB_CLIENT_SECRET,
      callbackURL: '/auth/github/callback'
    }
  };
};
