// Data Encryption Utilities
export class DataEncryption {
  private static readonly ALGORITHM = 'aes-256-gcm';
  private static readonly KEY_LENGTH = 32;
  private static readonly IV_LENGTH = 16;

  static encrypt(text: string, key?: string): { encrypted: string; iv: string; tag: string } {
    const encryptionKey = key ? Buffer.from(key, 'hex') : this.getDefaultKey();
    const iv = crypto.randomBytes(this.IV_LENGTH);
    const cipher = crypto.createCipher(this.ALGORITHM, encryptionKey);
    
    let encrypted = cipher.update(text, 'utf8', 'hex');
    encrypted += cipher.final('hex');
    
    return {
      encrypted,
      iv: iv.toString('hex'),
      tag: cipher.getAuthTag?.()?.toString('hex') || ''
    };
  }

  static decrypt(encryptedData: { encrypted: string; iv: string; tag: string }, key?: string): string {
    const encryptionKey = key ? Buffer.from(key, 'hex') : this.getDefaultKey();
    const decipher = crypto.createDecipher(this.ALGORITHM, encryptionKey);
    
    if (encryptedData.tag) {
      decipher.setAuthTag?.(Buffer.from(encryptedData.tag, 'hex'));
    }
    
    let decrypted = decipher.update(encryptedData.encrypted, 'hex', 'utf8');
    decrypted += decipher.final('utf8');
    
    return decrypted;
  }

  private static getDefaultKey(): Buffer {
    const key = process.env.ENCRYPTION_KEY;
    if (!key) {
      throw new Error('ENCRYPTION_KEY environment variable is required');
    }
    return Buffer.from(key, 'hex');
  }

  static generateKey(): string {
    return crypto.randomBytes(this.KEY_LENGTH).toString('hex');
  }
}

// Secrets Management
export class SecretsManager {
  private static secrets = new Map<string, string>();

  static setSecret(name: string, value: string): void {
    this.secrets.set(name, value);
  }

  static getSecret(name: string): string | undefined {
    // In production, integrate with AWS Secrets Manager, HashiCorp Vault, etc.
    if (process.env.NODE_ENV === 'production') {
      // Return from secure secret store
      return process.env[name];
    }
    
    return this.secrets.get(name) || process.env[name];
  }

  static async rotateSecret(name: string): Promise<void> {
    const newSecret = crypto.randomBytes(32).toString('hex');
    
    // Update in secret store
    this.setSecret(name, newSecret);
    
    console.log(`✅ Secret ${name} rotated successfully`);
  }

  static validateSecrets(): boolean {
    const requiredSecrets = [
      'DATABASE_URL',
      'SESSION_SECRET',
      'JWT_SECRET',
      'ENCRYPTION_KEY'
    ];

    const missingSecrets = requiredSecrets.filter(secret => !this.getSecret(secret));
    
    if (missingSecrets.length > 0) {
      console.error('❌ Missing required secrets:', missingSecrets);
      return false;
    }

    // Validate secret strength
    const jwtSecret = this.getSecret('JWT_SECRET');
    if (jwtSecret && jwtSecret.length < 32) {
      console.error('❌ JWT_SECRET must be at least 32 characters');
      return false;
    }

    return true;
  }
}

## FILE: server/middleware/csrf.ts
```
import type { Request, Response, NextFunction } from 'express';
import crypto from 'crypto';

declare global {
  namespace Express {
    interface Request {
      csrfToken?: () => string;
    }
  }
}

// Simple CSRF token implementation
const csrfTokens = new Map<string, number>();

// Clean up expired tokens periodically
setInterval(() => {
  const now = Date.now();
  for (const [token, timestamp] of csrfTokens.entries()) {
    if (now - timestamp > 3600000) { // 1 hour
      csrfTokens.delete(token);
    }
  }
}, 300000); // Clean every 5 minutes

export const csrfProtection = (req: Request, res: Response, next: NextFunction): void => {
  // Skip CSRF protection for AI endpoints
  if (req.path.startsWith('/api/ai/')) {
    return next();
  }

  // Generate CSRF token for GET requests
  if (req.method === 'GET') {
    const token = crypto.randomBytes(32).toString('hex');
    csrfTokens.set(token, Date.now());
    
    req.csrfToken = () => token;
    res.locals.csrfToken = token;
    res.setHeader('X-CSRF-Token', token);
    return next();
  }

  // Validate CSRF token for state-changing requests
  if (['POST', 'PUT', 'DELETE', 'PATCH'].includes(req.method)) {
    const token = req.headers['x-csrf-token'] as string || 
                  req.body._csrf || 
                  req.query._csrf;

    if (!token) {
      res.status(403).json({ 
        success: false,
        error: {
          message: 'CSRF token missing',
          code: 'CSRF_TOKEN_MISSING'
        }
      });
      return;
    }

    if (!csrfTokens.has(token)) {
      res.status(403).json({ 
        success: false,
        error: {
          message: 'Invalid or expired CSRF token',
          code: 'CSRF_TOKEN_INVALID'
        }
      });
      return;
    }

    // Remove used token to prevent replay attacks
    csrfTokens.delete(token);
  }

  next();
};

export const csrfToken = (req: Request, res: Response): void => {
  if (req.csrfToken) {
    res.json({ csrfToken: req.csrfToken() });
  } else {
    res.status(500).json({ 
      success: false,
      error: {
        message: 'CSRF token not available',
        code: 'CSRF_TOKEN_UNAVAILABLE'
      }
    });
  }
};
```

// Health Check for Kubernetes/Docker
export const kubernetesHealthCheck = {
  liveness: (req: Request, res: Response) => {
    // Liveness probe - is the application running?
    res.json({
      status: 'alive',
      timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),
      pid: process.pid,
      uptime: process.uptime(),
      version: deploymentConfig.version
    });
  },

  readiness: async (req: Request, res: Response) => {
    // Readiness probe - is the application ready to serve traffic?
    const checks = await Promise.allSettled([
      checkDatabase(),
      checkRedis(),
      checkFileSystem(),
      checkMemory()
    ]);

    const results = checks.map((check, index) => ({
      name: ['database', 'redis', 'filesystem', 'memory'][index],
      status: check.status === 'fulfilled' ? 'healthy' : 'unhealthy',
      error: check.status === 'rejected' ? (check.reason as Error).message : undefined
    }));

    const allHealthy = results.every(result => result.status === 'healthy');

    res.status(allHealthy ? 200 : 503).json({
      status: allHealthy ? 'ready' : 'not ready',
      timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),
      checks: results,
      deployment: deploymentConfig
    });
  },

  startup: (req: Request, res: Response) => {
    // Startup probe - has the application finished starting up?
    res.json({
      status: 'started',
      timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),
      startupTime: deploymentConfig.deploymentTime
    });
  }
};

// Blue/Green Deployment Support
export class BlueGreenDeployment {
  private currentVersion = 'blue';
  private versions = new Map<string, boolean>();

  constructor() {
    this.versions.set('blue', true);
    this.versions.set('green', false);
  }

  getCurrentVersion(): string {
    return this.currentVersion;
  }

  switchVersion(): void {
    this.currentVersion = this.currentVersion === 'blue' ? 'green' : 'blue';
    
    // Update version states
    this.versions.set(this.currentVersion, true);
    this.versions.set(this.currentVersion === 'blue' ? 'green' : 'blue', false);
    
    console.log(`🔄 Switched to ${this.currentVersion} version`);
  }

  getVersionStatus() {
    return {
      current: this.currentVersion,
      versions: Object.fromEntries(this.versions)
    };
  }
}

// Deployment Validation
export const validateDeployment = async (): Promise<boolean> => {
  const checks = [
    checkEnvironmentVariables(),
    checkDatabaseConnection(),
    checkSecurityConfiguration(),
    checkPerformanceSettings()
  ];

  const results = await Promise.allSettled(checks);
  const failures = results.filter(result => result.status === 'rejected');

  if (failures.length > 0) {
    console.error('❌ Deployment validation failed:');
    failures.forEach((failure, index) => {
      console.error(`  ${index + 1}. ${(failure.reason as Error).message}`);
    });
    return false;
  }

  console.log('✅ Deployment validation passed');
  return true;
};

async function checkMemory(): Promise<void> {
  const usage = process.memoryUsage();
  const maxMemory = 1024 * 1024 * 1024; // 1GB
  
  if (usage.heapUsed > maxMemory) {
    throw new Error('Memory usage too high');
  }
}

function checkEnvironmentVariables(): Promise<void> {
  const required = ['DATABASE_URL', 'SESSION_SECRET'];
  const missing = required.filter(key => !process.env[key]);
  
  if (missing.length > 0) {
    throw new Error(`Missing required environment variables: ${missing.join(', ')}`);
  }
  
  return Promise.resolve();
}

function checkDatabaseConnection(): Promise<void> {
  return checkDatabase();
}

function checkSecurityConfiguration(): Promise<void> {
  if (process.env.NODE_ENV === 'production') {
    if (!process.env.JWT_SECRET || process.env.JWT_SECRET.length < 32) {
      throw new Error('JWT_SECRET must be at least 32 characters in production');
    }
  }
  
  return Promise.resolve();
}

    // Check production-specific settings
    if (!process.env.REDIS_HOST) {
      console.warn('⚠️  Redis not configured - performance may be impacted');
    }
  }
  
  return Promise.resolve();
}

import { Request, Response, NextFunction } from 'express';
import jwt from 'jsonwebtoken';

export interface User {
  id: string;
  email: string;
  role: 'admin' | 'manager' | 'user';
  organizationId: string;
  permissions: string[];
}

export interface AuthenticatedRequest extends Request {
  user?: User;
}

/**
 * Enterprise-grade authentication middleware with RBAC
 */
export const authenticateToken = (req: AuthenticatedRequest, res: Response, next: NextFunction): void => {
  const authHeader = req.headers['authorization'];
  const token = authHeader && authHeader.split(' ')[1];

  if (!token) {
    res.status(401).json({ message: 'Access token required' });
    return;
  }

  jwt.verify(token, process.env.JWT_SECRET || 'dev-secret', (err: any, user: any) => {
    if (err) {
      res.status(403).json({ message: 'Invalid or expired token' });
      return;
    }
    
    req.user = user as User;
    next();
  });
};

/**
 * Role-based access control middleware
 */
export const requireRole = (roles: string[]) => {
  return (req: AuthenticatedRequest, res: Response, next: NextFunction): void => {
    if (!req.user) {
      res.status(401).json({ message: 'Authentication required' });
      return;
    }

    if (!roles.includes(req.user.role)) {
      res.status(403).json({ 
        message: 'Insufficient permissions',
        required: roles,
        current: req.user.role
      });
      return;
    }

    next();
  };
};

/**
 * Permission-based access control middleware
 */
export const requirePermission = (permission: string) => {
  return (req: AuthenticatedRequest, res: Response, next: NextFunction): void => {
    if (!req.user) {
      res.status(401).json({ message: 'Authentication required' });
      return;
    }

    if (!req.user.permissions.includes(permission)) {
      res.status(403).json({ 
        message: 'Permission denied',
        required: permission,
        available: req.user.permissions
      });
      return;
    }

    next();
  };
};

/**
 * Organization isolation middleware - ensures users can only access their org data
 */
export const requireOrganizationAccess = (req: AuthenticatedRequest, res: Response, next: NextFunction): void => {
  if (!req.user) {
    res.status(401).json({ message: 'Authentication required' });
    return;
  }

  const orgId = req.params.organizationId || req.body.organizationId;
  
  if (orgId && req.user.organizationId !== orgId && req.user.role !== 'admin') {
    res.status(403).json({ 
      message: 'Access denied to organization data',
      organizationId: orgId
    });
    return;
  }

  next();
};

/**
 * API rate limiting by user/organization
 */
export const enterpriseRateLimit = (req: AuthenticatedRequest, res: Response, next: NextFunction): void => {
  // Simple rate limiting - in production, use Redis-backed solution
  const identifier = req.user?.id || req.ip;
  
  // For demo purposes, we'll allow all requests
  // In production, implement proper rate limiting with sliding window
  next();
};

import { Request, Response, NextFunction } from 'express';
import { logger } from '../utils/logger.js';
import * as Sentry from '@sentry/node';

// Initialize Sentry for production error tracking
export const initializeSentry = () => {
  if (process.env.NODE_ENV === 'production' && process.env.SENTRY_DSN) {
    Sentry.init({
      dsn: process.env.SENTRY_DSN,
      environment: process.env.NODE_ENV || 'development',
      tracesSampleRate: 0.1,
      beforeSend: (event) => {
        // Filter sensitive data from error reports
        if (event.exception) {
          event.exception.values?.forEach((exception) => {
            if (exception.stacktrace) {
              exception.stacktrace.frames?.forEach((frame) => {
                if (frame.vars) {
                  Object.keys(frame.vars).forEach((key) => {
                    if (key.toLowerCase().includes('password') || 
                        key.toLowerCase().includes('token') ||
                        key.toLowerCase().includes('secret') ||
                        key.toLowerCase().includes('apikey')) {
                      frame.vars![key] = '[Filtered]';
                    }
                  });
                }
              });
            }
          });
        }
        return event;
      }
    });
  }
};

// Enhanced error tracker that works with existing or Sentry
const errorTracker = {
  captureException: (error: Error, context?: any) => {
    if (process.env.NODE_ENV === 'production' && process.env.SENTRY_DSN) {
      Sentry.withScope((scope) => {
        if (context) {
          scope.setContext('additional', context);
        }
        Sentry.captureException(error);
      });
    } else {
      // Fallback logging for development
      logger.error('Exception captured', error, context);
    }
  }
};

// Centralized Error Handler
export const errorHandler = (
  error: ApiError,
  req: Request,
  res: Response,
  next: NextFunction
) => {
  const statusCode = error.statusCode || 500;
  const isOperational = error.isOperational || false;

  // Log error with context
  logger.error('Request error', error, {
    requestId: req.requestId,
    url: req.url,
    method: req.method,
    userId: req.user?.id,
    ip: req.ip,
    userAgent: req.get('User-Agent'),
    statusCode,
    isOperational
  });

  // Track non-operational errors (system errors)
  if (!isOperational) {
    errorTracker.captureException(error, {
      requestId: req.requestId,
      url: req.url,
      method: req.method,
      userId: req.user?.id
    });
  }

  // Send error response
  const errorResponse: any = {
    error: {
      code: error.code || 'UNKNOWN_ERROR',
      message: error.message
    },
    requestId: req.requestId,
    timestamp: new Date().toISOString()
  };

  // Include stack trace in development
  if (process.env.NODE_ENV === 'development') {
    errorResponse.error.stack = error.stack;
  }

  // Don't expose internal errors in production
  if (statusCode === 500 && process.env.NODE_ENV === 'production') {
    errorResponse.error.message = 'Internal server error';
  }

  res.status(statusCode).json(errorResponse);
};

// Graceful Shutdown Handler
export class GracefulShutdown {
  private server: any;
  private connections: Set<any> = new Set();
  private isShuttingDown = false;

  constructor(server: any) {
    this.server = server;
    this.setupConnectionTracking();
    this.setupShutdownHandlers();
  }

  private setupConnectionTracking() {
    this.server.on('connection', (connection: any) => {
      this.connections.add(connection);
      
      connection.on('close', () => {
        this.connections.delete(connection);
      });
    });
  }

  private setupShutdownHandlers() {
    process.on('SIGTERM', () => this.shutdown('SIGTERM'));
    process.on('SIGINT', () => this.shutdown('SIGINT'));
    process.on('uncaughtException', (error) => {
      logger.error('Uncaught exception', error);
      errorTracker.captureException(error);
      this.shutdown('uncaughtException');
    });
    process.on('unhandledRejection', (reason, promise) => {
      logger.error('Unhandled rejection', new Error(`Promise: ${promise}, Reason: ${reason}`));
      errorTracker.captureException(new Error(`Unhandled rejection: ${reason}`));
    });
  }

  private async shutdown(signal: string) {
    if (this.isShuttingDown) return;
    this.isShuttingDown = true;

    logger.info(`Received ${signal}, starting graceful shutdown`);

    // Stop accepting new connections
    this.server.close(() => {
      logger.info('HTTP server closed');
    });

    // Close existing connections
    for (const connection of this.connections) {
      connection.destroy();
    }

    // Close database connections
    try {
      const { pool } = await import('../db.js');
      await pool.end();
      logger.info('Database connections closed');
    } catch (error) {
      logger.error('Error closing database connections', error as Error);
    }

    // Exit process
    setTimeout(() => {
      logger.info('Graceful shutdown completed');
      process.exit(0);
    }, 1000);
  }
}

// Retry Logic Utility
export const retryOperation = async <T>(
  operation: () => Promise<T>,
  maxRetries = 3,
  baseDelay = 1000
): Promise<T> => {
  let lastError: Error;

  for (let attempt = 1; attempt <= maxRetries; attempt++) {
    try {
      return await operation();
    } catch (error) {
      lastError = error as Error;
      
      if (attempt === maxRetries) {
        throw lastError;
      }

      const delay = baseDelay * Math.pow(2, attempt - 1); // Exponential backoff
      logger.warn(`Operation failed, retrying in ${delay}ms`, {
        attempt,
        maxRetries,
        error: lastError.message
      });

      await new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, delay));
    }
  }

  throw lastError!;
};

// Circuit Breaker Pattern
export class CircuitBreaker {
  private failures = 0;
  private lastFailTime = 0;
  private state: 'CLOSED' | 'OPEN' | 'HALF_OPEN' = 'CLOSED';

  constructor(
    private threshold = 5,
    private timeout = 60000, // 1 minute
    private resetTimeout = 30000 // 30 seconds
  ) {}

  async execute<T>(operation: () => Promise<T>): Promise<T> {
    if (this.state === 'OPEN') {
      if (Date.now() - this.lastFailTime >= this.resetTimeout) {
        this.state = 'HALF_OPEN';
      } else {
        throw new Error('Circuit breaker is OPEN');
      }
    }

    try {
      const result = await operation();
      this.onSuccess();
      return result;
    } catch (error) {
      this.onFailure();
      throw error;
    }
  }

  private onSuccess() {
    this.failures = 0;
    this.state = 'CLOSED';
  }

  private onFailure() {
    this.failures++;
    this.lastFailTime = Date.now();

    if (this.failures >= this.threshold) {
      this.state = 'OPEN';
    }
  }

  getState() {
    return {
      state: this.state,
      failures: this.failures,
      lastFailTime: this.lastFailTime
    };
  }
}

import { Request, Response, NextFunction } from 'express';
import fs from 'fs';
import path from 'path';
import crypto from 'crypto';

// 4. Observability & Monitoring

// Structured Logging Interface
interface LogEntry {
  timestamp: string;
  level: 'info' | 'warn' | 'error' | 'debug';
  message: string;
  service: string;
  environment: string;
  requestId?: string;
  userId?: string;
  ip?: string;
  userAgent?: string;
  url?: string;
  method?: string;
  statusCode?: number;
  duration?: number;
  error?: {
    name: string;
    message: string;
    stack?: string;
  };
  metadata?: Record<string, any>;
}

class Logger {
  private serviceName: string;
  private environment: string;

  constructor(serviceName = 'veridius-api', environment = process.env.NODE_ENV || 'development') {
    this.serviceName = serviceName;
    this.environment = environment;
  }

  private createLogEntry(level: LogEntry['level'], message: string, metadata?: Record<string, any>): LogEntry {
    return {
      timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),
      level,
      message,
      service: this.serviceName,
      environment: this.environment,
      ...metadata
    };
  }

  private writeLog(entry: LogEntry) {
    if (this.environment === 'development') {
      console.log(JSON.stringify(entry, null, 2));
    } else {
      // In production, write to stdout for log aggregation
      console.log(JSON.stringify(entry));
    }
  }

  info(message: string, metadata?: Record<string, any>) {
    this.writeLog(this.createLogEntry('info', message, metadata));
  }

  warn(message: string, metadata?: Record<string, any>) {
    this.writeLog(this.createLogEntry('warn', message, metadata));
  }

  error(message: string, error?: Error, metadata?: Record<string, any>) {
    const errorMetadata = error ? {
      error: {
        name: error.name,
        message: error.message,
        stack: this.environment === 'development' ? error.stack : undefined
      }
    } : {};

    this.writeLog(this.createLogEntry('error', message, { ...metadata, ...errorMetadata }));
  }

  debug(message: string, metadata?: Record<string, any>) {
    if (this.environment === 'development') {
      this.writeLog(this.createLogEntry('debug', message, metadata));
    }
  }
}

export const logger = new Logger();

  res.setHeader('x-request-id', req.requestId);
  next();
};

// Performance Metrics
export class MetricsCollector {
  private metrics: Map<string, number[]> = new Map();
  private counters: Map<string, number> = new Map();

  recordResponse(endpoint: string, duration: number, statusCode: number) {
    const key = `${endpoint}_${statusCode}`;
    
    if (!this.metrics.has(key)) {
      this.metrics.set(key, []);
    }
    
    this.metrics.get(key)!.push(duration);
    
    // Keep only last 1000 measurements
    if (this.metrics.get(key)!.length > 1000) {
      this.metrics.get(key)!.shift();
    }
  }

  incrementCounter(name: string) {
    this.counters.set(name, (this.counters.get(name) || 0) + 1);
  }

  getP95(endpoint: string, statusCode: number): number {
    const key = `${endpoint}_${statusCode}`;
    const durations = this.metrics.get(key) || [];
    
    if (durations.length === 0) return 0;
    
    const sorted = [...durations].sort((a, b) => a - b);
    const index = Math.ceil(sorted.length * 0.95) - 1;
    return sorted[index] || 0;
  }

  getP99(endpoint: string, statusCode: number): number {
    const key = `${endpoint}_${statusCode}`;
    const durations = this.metrics.get(key) || [];
    
    if (durations.length === 0) return 0;
    
    const sorted = [...durations].sort((a, b) => a - b);
    const index = Math.ceil(sorted.length * 0.99) - 1;
    return sorted[index] || 0;
  }

  getMetrics() {
    const summary: Record<string, any> = {};
    
    for (const [key] of this.metrics) {
      const [endpoint, statusCode] = key.split('_');
      const p95 = this.getP95(endpoint, parseInt(statusCode));
      const p99 = this.getP99(endpoint, parseInt(statusCode));
      
      summary[key] = { p95, p99 };
    }
    
    return {
      responseTime: summary,
      counters: Object.fromEntries(this.counters)
    };
  }
}

export const metrics = new MetricsCollector();
export const metricsCollector = metrics;

// Metrics collection middleware

  next();

## FILE: server/middleware/pagination.ts

import type { Request, Response, NextFunction } from 'express';
import { z } from 'zod';

export interface PaginationParams {
  page: number;
  limit: number;
  offset: number;
  sort?: string;
  order?: 'asc' | 'desc';
}

export interface PaginatedResponse<T> {
  success: true;
  data: T[];
  pagination: {
    page: number;
    limit: number;
    total: number;
    totalPages: number;
    hasNext: boolean;
    hasPrev: boolean;
  };
}

const paginationSchema = z.object({
  page: z.coerce.number().min(1).default(1),
  limit: z.coerce.number().min(1).max(100).default(20),
  sort: z.string().optional(),
  order: z.enum(['asc', 'desc']).default('desc'),
});

export const parsePagination = (req: Request, res: Response, next: NextFunction): void => {
  try {
    const parsed = paginationSchema.parse(req.query);
    
    req.pagination = {
      page: parsed.page,
      limit: parsed.limit,
      offset: (parsed.page - 1) * parsed.limit,
      sort: parsed.sort,
      order: parsed.order,
    };

    next();
  } catch (error) {
    res.status(400).json({
      success: false,
      error: {
        message: 'Invalid pagination parameters',
        code: 'INVALID_PAGINATION',
        timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),
      },
    });
  }
};

export const createPaginatedResponse = <T>(
  data: T[],
  total: number,
  pagination: PaginationParams
): PaginatedResponse<T> => {
  const totalPages = Math.ceil(total / pagination.limit);
  
  return {
    success: true,
    data,
    pagination: {
      page: pagination.page,
      limit: pagination.limit,
      total,
      totalPages,
      hasNext: pagination.page < totalPages,
      hasPrev: pagination.page > 1,
    },
  };
};

// Extend Express Request interface
declare global {
  namespace Express {
    interface Request {
      pagination?: PaginationParams;
    }
  }
}

## FILE: server/middleware/productionMonitoring.ts
```
// Production Monitoring Middleware
// Comprehensive logging, metrics, and performance monitoring for production environments

import { Request, Response, NextFunction } from 'express';
import { logger } from '../utils/logger';

interface MonitoringConfig {
  enableRequestLogging: boolean;
  enableErrorTracking: boolean;
  enablePerformanceMetrics: boolean;
  enableHealthChecks: boolean;
  alertThresholds: {
    responseTime: number;
    errorRate: number;
    memoryUsage: number;
    cpuUsage: number;
  };
}

interface MetricData {
  timestamp: number;
  value: number;
  labels?: Record<string, string>;
}

interface PerformanceMetrics {
  requestCount: number;
  errorCount: number;
  responseTime: {
    min: number;
    max: number;
    avg: number;
    p95: number;
    p99: number;
  };
  throughput: number;
  activeConnections: number;
}

class ProductionMonitor {
  private static instance: ProductionMonitor;
  private config: MonitoringConfig;
  private metrics: Map<string, MetricData[]> = new Map();
  private performanceData: PerformanceMetrics = {
    requestCount: 0,
    errorCount: 0,
    responseTime: { min: 0, max: 0, avg: 0, p95: 0, p99: 0 },
    throughput: 0,
    activeConnections: 0
  };
  private responseTimes: number[] = [];
  private startTime: number = Date.now();

  constructor() {
    this.config = {
      enableRequestLogging: process.env.NODE_ENV === 'production',
      enableErrorTracking: true,
      enablePerformanceMetrics: true,
      enableHealthChecks: true,
      alertThresholds: {
        responseTime: 5000, // 5 seconds
        errorRate: 0.05, // 5%
        memoryUsage: 0.85, // 85%
        cpuUsage: 0.80 // 80%
      }
    };

    // Start health monitoring
    this.startHealthMonitoring();
  }

  public static getInstance(): ProductionMonitor {
    if (!ProductionMonitor.instance) {
      ProductionMonitor.instance = new ProductionMonitor();
    }
    return ProductionMonitor.instance;
  }

  // Request logging middleware
  public requestLogger = (req: Request, res: Response, next: NextFunction) => {
    const startTime = Date.now();
    const requestId = req.headers['x-request-id'] || this.generateRequestId();

    // Add request ID to request object
    (req as any).requestId = requestId;

    // Log request start
    if (this.config.enableRequestLogging) {
      logger.info('Request started', {
        requestId,
        method: req.method,
        url: req.url,
        userAgent: req.headers['user-agent'],
        ip: req.ip,
        timestamp: new Date().toISOString()
      });
    }

    // Override res.end to capture response metrics
    const originalEnd = res.end;
    res.end = function(chunk?: any, encoding?: any) {
      const responseTime = Date.now() - startTime;
      const statusCode = res.statusCode;

      // Update metrics
      monitor.updateMetrics(req, res, responseTime);

      // Log request completion
      if (monitor.config.enableRequestLogging) {
        logger.info('Request completed', {
          requestId,
          method: req.method,
          url: req.url,
          statusCode,
          responseTime,
          timestamp: new Date().toISOString()
        });
      }

      // Check for slow requests
      if (responseTime > monitor.config.alertThresholds.responseTime) {
        logger.warn('Slow request detected', {
          requestId,
          method: req.method,
          url: req.url,
          responseTime,
          threshold: monitor.config.alertThresholds.responseTime
        });
      }

      // Call original end method
      originalEnd.call(this, chunk, encoding);
    };

    next();
  };

  // Error tracking middleware
  public errorTracker = (error: Error, req: Request, res: Response, next: NextFunction) => {
    const requestId = (req as any).requestId;

    if (this.config.enableErrorTracking) {
      logger.error('Application error', {
        requestId,
        error: {
          name: error.name,
          message: error.message,
          stack: error.stack
        },
        request: {
          method: req.method,
          url: req.url,
          headers: req.headers,
          body: req.body
        },
        timestamp: new Date().toISOString()
      });

      // Update error metrics
      this.performanceData.errorCount++;
      this.recordMetric('errors_total', 1, {
        method: req.method,
        route: req.route?.path || req.url,
        error_type: error.name
      });
    }

    // Check error rate threshold
    const errorRate = this.performanceData.errorCount / this.performanceData.requestCount;
    if (errorRate > this.config.alertThresholds.errorRate) {
      logger.error('High error rate detected', {
        errorRate,
        threshold: this.config.alertThresholds.errorRate,
        requestCount: this.performanceData.requestCount,
        errorCount: this.performanceData.errorCount
      });
    }

    next(error);
  };

  // Performance metrics collector
  private updateMetrics(req: Request, res: Response, responseTime: number) {
    if (!this.config.enablePerformanceMetrics) return;

    // Update basic counters
    this.performanceData.requestCount++;
    
    // Track response times
    this.responseTimes.push(responseTime);
    
    // Keep only last 1000 response times for percentile calculation
    if (this.responseTimes.length > 1000) {
      this.responseTimes = this.responseTimes.slice(-1000);
    }

    // Update response time metrics
    this.updateResponseTimeMetrics();

    // Record detailed metrics
    this.recordMetric('requests_total', 1, {
      method: req.method,
      route: req.route?.path || req.url,
      status_code: res.statusCode.toString()
    });

    this.recordMetric('request_duration_ms', responseTime, {
      method: req.method,
      route: req.route?.path || req.url
    });

    // Calculate throughput (requests per second)
    const uptime = (Date.now() - this.startTime) / 1000;
    this.performanceData.throughput = this.performanceData.requestCount / uptime;
  }

  // Update response time statistics
  private updateResponseTimeMetrics() {
    if (this.responseTimes.length === 0) return;

    const sorted = [...this.responseTimes].sort((a, b) => a - b);
    
    this.performanceData.responseTime = {
      min: Math.min(...this.responseTimes),
      max: Math.max(...this.responseTimes),
      avg: this.responseTimes.reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0) / this.responseTimes.length,
      p95: sorted[Math.floor(sorted.length * 0.95)],
      p99: sorted[Math.floor(sorted.length * 0.99)]
    };
  }

  // Record custom metric
  private recordMetric(name: string, value: number, labels?: Record<string, string>) {
    if (!this.metrics.has(name)) {
      this.metrics.set(name, []);
    }

    const metricData: MetricData = {
      timestamp: Date.now(),
      value,
      labels
    };

    const metrics = this.metrics.get(name)!;
    metrics.push(metricData);

    // Keep only last 1000 data points per metric
    if (metrics.length > 1000) {
      this.metrics.set(name, metrics.slice(-1000));
    }
  }

  // Health monitoring
  private startHealthMonitoring() {
    if (!this.config.enableHealthChecks) return;

    setInterval(() => {
      this.checkSystemHealth();
    }, 30000); // Check every 30 seconds
  }

  // System health check
  private checkSystemHealth() {
    const memUsage = process.memoryUsage();
    const memUsagePercent = memUsage.heapUsed / memUsage.heapTotal;
    
    // Log system metrics
    logger.info('System health check', {
      memory: {
        heapUsed: Math.round(memUsage.heapUsed / 1024 / 1024),
        heapTotal: Math.round(memUsage.heapTotal / 1024 / 1024),
        percentage: Math.round(memUsagePercent * 100)
      },
      uptime: process.uptime(),
      requests: {
        total: this.performanceData.requestCount,
        errors: this.performanceData.errorCount,
        errorRate: this.performanceData.requestCount > 0 ? 
          this.performanceData.errorCount / this.performanceData.requestCount : 0
      },
      performance: {
        avgResponseTime: Math.round(this.performanceData.responseTime.avg),
        p95ResponseTime: Math.round(this.performanceData.responseTime.p95),
        throughput: Math.round(this.performanceData.throughput * 100) / 100
      }
    });

    // Check memory threshold
    if (memUsagePercent > this.config.alertThresholds.memoryUsage) {
      logger.warn('High memory usage detected', {
        currentUsage: Math.round(memUsagePercent * 100),
        threshold: Math.round(this.config.alertThresholds.memoryUsage * 100),
        heapUsed: Math.round(memUsage.heapUsed / 1024 / 1024),
        heapTotal: Math.round(memUsage.heapTotal / 1024 / 1024)
      });
    }

    // Record system metrics
    this.recordMetric('memory_usage_percent', memUsagePercent * 100);
    this.recordMetric('heap_used_mb', memUsage.heapUsed / 1024 / 1024);
    this.recordMetric('uptime_seconds', process.uptime());
  }

  // Generate unique request ID
  private generateRequestId(): string {
    return `req_${Date.now()}_${Math.random().toString(36).substr(2, 9)}`;
  }

  // Get current metrics
  public getMetrics(): PerformanceMetrics {
    return { ...this.performanceData };
  }

  // Get metric history
  public getMetricHistory(name: string): MetricData[] {
    return this.metrics.get(name) || [];
  }

  // Health check endpoint data
  public getHealthStatus() {
    const memUsage = process.memoryUsage();
    const uptime = process.uptime();

    return {
      status: 'healthy',
      timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),
      uptime: {
        seconds: uptime,
        human: this.formatUptime(uptime)
      },
      memory: {
        heapUsed: Math.round(memUsage.heapUsed / 1024 / 1024),
        heapTotal: Math.round(memUsage.heapTotal / 1024 / 1024),
        external: Math.round(memUsage.external / 1024 / 1024),
        rss: Math.round(memUsage.rss / 1024 / 1024)
      },
      performance: this.performanceData,
      environment: {
        nodeVersion: process.version,
        platform: process.platform,
        arch: process.arch,
        env: process.env.NODE_ENV
      }
    };
  }

  // Format uptime in human readable format
  private formatUptime(seconds: number): string {
    const days = Math.floor(seconds / (24 * 60 * 60));
    const hours = Math.floor((seconds % (24 * 60 * 60)) / (60 * 60));
    const minutes = Math.floor((seconds % (60 * 60)) / 60);
    
    return `${days}d ${hours}h ${minutes}m`;
  }
}

// Create singleton instance
const monitor = ProductionMonitor.getInstance();

// Export middleware functions
export const requestLogger = monitor.requestLogger;
export const errorTracker = monitor.errorTracker;
export const getMetrics = () => monitor.getMetrics();
export const getHealthStatus = () => monitor.getHealthStatus();
export const getMetricHistory = (name: string) => monitor.getMetricHistory(name);

export default monitor;

## FILE: server/middleware/rateLimit.ts
```
import type { Request, Response, NextFunction } from 'express';

declare global {
  namespace Express {
    interface Request {
      ip?: string;
    }
  }
}

interface RateLimitOptions {
  windowMs: number;
  maxRequests: number;
  message?: string;
  keyGenerator?: (req: Request) => string;
}

interface RateLimitData {
  count: number;
  resetTime: number;
}

// In-memory store (for production, use Redis)
const store = new Map<string, RateLimitData>();

export const createRateLimit = (options: RateLimitOptions) => {
  const {
    windowMs,
    maxRequests,
    message = 'Too many requests from this IP, please try again later.',
    keyGenerator = (req: Request) => req.ip || 'unknown'
  } = options;

  return (req: Request, res: Response, next: NextFunction): void => {
    const key = keyGenerator(req);
    const now = Date.now();
    const resetTime = now + windowMs;

    // Clean expired entries
    const entries = Array.from(store.entries());
    for (const [storeKey, data] of entries) {
      if (data.resetTime < now) {
        store.delete(storeKey);
      }
    }

    const current = store.get(key);

    if (!current) {
      store.set(key, { count: 1, resetTime });
      return next();
    }

    if (current.resetTime < now) {
      store.set(key, { count: 1, resetTime });
      return next();
    }

    if (current.count >= maxRequests) {
      res.status(429).json({
        success: false,
        error: {
          message,
          code: 'RATE_LIMIT_EXCEEDED',
          timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),
          retryAfter: Math.ceil((current.resetTime - now) / 1000),
        },
      });
      return;
    }

    current.count++;
    store.set(key, current);

    // Add rate limit headers
    res.set({
      'X-RateLimit-Limit': maxRequests.toString(),
      'X-RateLimit-Remaining': Math.max(0, maxRequests - current.count).toString(),
      'X-RateLimit-Reset': new Date(current.resetTime).toISOString(),
    });

    next();
  };
};

// Predefined rate limiters with development mode consideration
const isDevelopment = process.env.NODE_ENV === 'development';

export const generalRateLimit = createRateLimit({
  windowMs: 15 * 60 * 1000, // 15 minutes
  maxRequests: isDevelopment ? 10000 : 100, // Much higher limit for development
});

export const authRateLimit = createRateLimit({
  windowMs: 15 * 60 * 1000, // 15 minutes
  maxRequests: isDevelopment ? 100 : 5, // Higher limit for development
  message: 'Too many authentication attempts, please try again later.',
});

export const apiRateLimit = createRateLimit({
  windowMs: 1 * 60 * 1000, // 1 minute
  maxRequests: isDevelopment ? 1000 : 60, // Higher limit for development
});
```

## FILE: server/middleware/scalability.ts
```
import { Request, Response, NextFunction } from 'express';
import { createClient } from 'redis';

// 6. Scalability & Performance

// Redis Configuration for Session Store & Caching
export const redisConfig = {
  host: process.env.REDIS_HOST || 'localhost',
  port: parseInt(process.env.REDIS_PORT || '6379'),
  password: process.env.REDIS_PASSWORD,
  retryDelayOnFailover: 100,
  enableReadyCheck: false,
  maxRetriesPerRequest: null,
};

// Cache Interface
export interface CacheService {
  get(key: string): Promise<string | null>;
  set(key: string, value: string, ttl?: number): Promise<void>;
  del(key: string): Promise<void>;
  exists(key: string): Promise<boolean>;
}

// Redis Cache Implementation
export class RedisCache implements CacheService {
  private client: any;

  constructor() {
    this.client = createClient(redisConfig);
    this.client.on('error', (err: Error) => {
      console.error('Redis Client Error:', err);
    });
    this.client.connect();
  }

  async get(key: string): Promise<string | null> {
    try {
      return await this.client.get(key);
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Redis get error:', error);
      return null;
    }
  }

  async set(key: string, value: string, ttl = 3600): Promise<void> {
    try {
      await this.client.setEx(key, ttl, value);
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Redis set error:', error);
    }
  }

  async del(key: string): Promise<void> {
    try {
      await this.client.del(key);
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Redis del error:', error);
    }
  }

  async exists(key: string): Promise<boolean> {
    try {
      const result = await this.client.exists(key);
      return result === 1;
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Redis exists error:', error);
      return false;
    }
  }
}

// In-Memory Cache Fallback
export class MemoryCache implements CacheService {
  private cache = new Map<string, { value: string; expires: number }>();

  async get(key: string): Promise<string | null> {
    const item = this.cache.get(key);
    if (!item) return null;
    
    if (Date.now() > item.expires) {
      this.cache.delete(key);
      return null;
    }
    
    return item.value;
  }

  async set(key: string, value: string, ttl = 3600): Promise<void> {
    const expires = Date.now() + (ttl * 1000);
    this.cache.set(key, { value, expires });
  }

  async del(key: string): Promise<void> {
    this.cache.delete(key);
  }

  async exists(key: string): Promise<boolean> {
    const item = this.cache.get(key);
    if (!item) return false;
    
    if (Date.now() > item.expires) {
      this.cache.delete(key);
      return false;
    }
    
    return true;
  }
}

// Initialize Cache Service
export const cache: CacheService = process.env.REDIS_HOST 
  ? new RedisCache() 
  : new MemoryCache();

// Caching Middleware
export const cacheMiddleware = (ttl = 300) => {
  return async (req: Request, res: Response, next: NextFunction) => {
    // Only cache GET requests
    if (req.method !== 'GET') {
      return next();
    }

    const cacheKey = `cache:${req.url}:${req.user?.id || 'anonymous'}`;
    
    try {
      const cachedResponse = await cache.get(cacheKey);
      
      if (cachedResponse) {
        const data = JSON.parse(cachedResponse);
        res.setHeader('X-Cache', 'HIT');
        return res.json(data);
      }

      // Store original res.json to intercept response
      const originalJson = res.json;
      
      res.json = function(data: any) {
        // Cache successful responses
        if (res.statusCode === 200) {
          cache.set(cacheKey, JSON.stringify(data), ttl).catch(console.error);
        }
        
        res.setHeader('X-Cache', 'MISS');
        return originalJson.call(this, data);
      };

      next();
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Cache middleware error:', error);
      next();
    }
  };
};

// Clustering Support
export const setupClustering = () => {
  const cluster = require('cluster');
  const numCPUs = require('os').cpus().length;

  if (cluster.isMaster && process.env.NODE_ENV === 'production') {
    console.log(`Master ${process.pid} is running`);

    // Fork workers
    for (let i = 0; i < numCPUs; i++) {
      cluster.fork();
    }

    cluster.on('exit', (worker: any, code: number, signal: string) => {
      console.log(`Worker ${worker.process.pid} died`);
      console.log('Starting a new worker');
      cluster.fork();
    });

    return false; // Don't start server in master process
  }

  return true; // Start server in worker process
};

// WebSocket Scaling with Redis Pub/Sub
export class WebSocketScaler {
  private redisPublisher: any;
  private redisSubscriber: any;
  private wsConnections = new Set<any>();

  constructor() {
    if (process.env.REDIS_HOST) {
      this.redisPublisher = createClient(redisConfig);
      this.redisSubscriber = createClient(redisConfig);
      this.setupPubSub();
    }
  }

  private async setupPubSub() {
    await this.redisSubscriber.connect();
    await this.redisPublisher.connect();

    // Subscribe to WebSocket broadcast channel
    await this.redisSubscriber.subscribe('ws:broadcast', (message: string) => {
      try {
        const data = JSON.parse(message);
        this.broadcastToLocalConnections(data);
      } catch (error) {
        console.error('WebSocket pub/sub error:', error);
      }
    });
  }

  addConnection(ws: any) {
    this.wsConnections.add(ws);
    
    ws.on('close', () => {
      this.wsConnections.delete(ws);
    });
  }

  async broadcastMessage(message: any) {
    if (this.redisPublisher) {
      // Broadcast across all server instances
      await this.redisPublisher.publish('ws:broadcast', JSON.stringify(message));
    } else {
      // Local broadcast only
      this.broadcastToLocalConnections(message);
    }
  }

  private broadcastToLocalConnections(message: any) {
    const messageStr = JSON.stringify(message);
    
    this.wsConnections.forEach((ws) => {
      if (ws.readyState === 1) { // WebSocket.OPEN
        try {
          ws.send(messageStr);
        } catch (error) {
          console.error('WebSocket send error:', error);
          this.wsConnections.delete(ws);
        }
      }
    });
  }

  getConnectionCount(): number {
    return this.wsConnections.size;
  }
}

export const wsScaler = new WebSocketScaler();

// Performance Optimization Middleware
export const performanceOptimization = (req: Request, res: Response, next: NextFunction) => {
  // Enable compression
  res.setHeader('Content-Encoding', 'gzip');
  
  // Set cache headers for static assets
  if (req.url.match(/\.(css|js|png|jpg|jpeg|gif|ico|svg)$/)) {
    res.setHeader('Cache-Control', 'public, max-age=31536000'); // 1 year
  }

  // Set security headers
  res.setHeader('X-Content-Type-Options', 'nosniff');
  res.setHeader('X-Frame-Options', 'DENY');
  res.setHeader('X-XSS-Protection', '1; mode=block');

  next();
};

/**
 * Content Security Policy headers
 */
export const securityHeaders = (req: Request, res: Response, next: NextFunction): void => {
  // Security headers
  res.setHeader('X-Content-Type-Options', 'nosniff');
  res.setHeader('X-Frame-Options', 'DENY');
  res.setHeader('X-XSS-Protection', '1; mode=block');
  res.setHeader('Referrer-Policy', 'strict-origin-when-cross-origin');
  
  // CSP - adjust for your specific needs
  res.setHeader('Content-Security-Policy', 
    "default-src 'self'; " +
    "script-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline' 'unsafe-eval'; " +
    "style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; " +
    "img-src 'self' data: https:; " +
    "font-src 'self' data:; " +
    "connect-src 'self' ws: wss:; " +
    "frame-ancestors 'none';"
  );
  
  next();
};

/**
 * Input validation and sanitization
 */
export const inputSanitization = (req: Request, res: Response, next: NextFunction): void => {
  // Basic XSS protection
  if (req.body) {
    req.body = sanitizeObject(req.body);
  }
  
  if (req.query) {
    req.query = sanitizeObject(req.query);
  }
  
  next();
};

/**
 * Sanitize object to prevent XSS
 */
function sanitizeObject(obj: any): any {
  if (typeof obj !== 'object' || obj === null) {
    return sanitizeValue(obj);
  }
  
  if (Array.isArray(obj)) {
    return obj.map(sanitizeObject);
  }
  
  const sanitized: any = {};
  for (const [key, value] of Object.entries(obj)) {
    sanitized[key] = sanitizeObject(value);
  }
  
  return sanitized;
}

function sanitizeValue(value: any): any {
  if (typeof value === 'string') {
    // Basic XSS prevention - in production use a proper library like DOMPurify
    return value
      .replace(/</g, '&lt;')
      .replace(/>/g, '&gt;')
      .replace(/"/g, '&quot;')
      .replace(/'/g, '&#x27;')
      .replace(/\//g, '&#x2F;');
  }
  
  return value;
}

/**
 * Environment validation
 */
export const validateEnvironment = (): void => {
  const required = [
    'DATABASE_URL',
    'JWT_SECRET'
  ];
  
  const missing = required.filter(env => !process.env[env]);
  
  if (missing.length > 0) {
    console.error('❌ Missing required environment variables:', missing);
    process.exit(1);
  }
  
  // Validate JWT secret strength in production
  if (process.env.NODE_ENV === 'production') {
    const jwtSecret = process.env.JWT_SECRET;
    if (!jwtSecret || jwtSecret.length < 32) {
      console.error('❌ JWT_SECRET must be at least 32 characters in production');
      process.exit(1);
    }
  }
  
  console.log('✅ Environment validation passed');
};

    retryAfter: 15 * 60
  }

// 3. CSRF Protection
export const csrfProtection = (req: Request, res: Response, next: NextFunction) => {
  if (req.method === 'GET' || req.method === 'HEAD' || req.method === 'OPTIONS') {
    return next();
  }

  const token = req.headers['x-csrf-token'] as string;
  const sessionToken = req.session?.csrfToken;

  if (!token || !sessionToken || token !== sessionToken) {
    return res.status(403).json({ error: 'Invalid CSRF token' });
  }

  next();
};

// Generate CSRF token for sessions
export const generateCSRFToken = (req: Request, res: Response, next: NextFunction) => {
  if (!req.session?.csrfToken) {
    req.session.csrfToken = crypto.randomBytes(32).toString('hex');
  }
  next();
};

// 4. Input Sanitization
export const sanitizeInput = (req: Request, res: Response, next: NextFunction) => {
  const sanitize = (obj: any): any => {
    if (typeof obj === 'string') {
      return obj
        .replace(/<script\b[^<]*(?:(?!<\/script>)<[^<]*)*<\/script>/gi, '')
        .replace(/javascript:/gi, '')
        .replace(/on\w+=/gi, '');
    }
    if (typeof obj === 'object' && obj !== null) {
      const sanitized: any = Array.isArray(obj) ? [] : {};
      for (const key in obj) {
        sanitized[key] = sanitize(obj[key]);
      }
      return sanitized;
    }
    return obj;
  };

  if (req.body) {
    req.body = sanitize(req.body);
  }
  if (req.query) {
    req.query = sanitize(req.query);
  }
  if (req.params) {
    req.params = sanitize(req.params);
  }

  next();
};

// 5. Security Logger
export const securityLogger = (req: Request, res: Response, next: NextFunction) => {
  const logSecurityEvent = (event: string, details: any) => {
    console.log(JSON.stringify({
      timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),
      type: 'security',
      event,
      ip: req.ip,
      userAgent: req.get('User-Agent'),
      url: req.url,
      method: req.method,
      ...details
    }));
  };

  // Log suspicious activities
  if (req.url.includes('..') || req.url.includes('etc/passwd')) {
    logSecurityEvent('path_traversal_attempt', { url: req.url });
  }

  if (req.get('User-Agent')?.includes('bot') && !req.get('User-Agent')?.includes('Googlebot')) {
    logSecurityEvent('suspicious_user_agent', { userAgent: req.get('User-Agent') });
  }

  next();
};

// Performance Testing Utilities
export class PerformanceTestUtils {
  static async loadTest(url: string, options: {
    concurrent: number;
    duration: number;
    rampUp?: number;
  }) {
    const startTime = Date.now();
    const results: Array<{ duration: number; status: number; error?: string }> = [];
    
    const makeRequest = async (): Promise<void> => {
      const requestStart = Date.now();
      try {
        const response = await fetch(url);
        results.push({
          duration: Date.now() - requestStart,
          status: response.status
        });
      } catch (error) {
        results.push({
          duration: Date.now() - requestStart,
          status: 0,
          error: (error as Error).message
        });
      }
    };

    // Ramp up requests
    const rampUpTime = options.rampUp || 1000;
    const rampUpInterval = rampUpTime / options.concurrent;

    const promises: Promise<void>[] = [];
    
    for (let i = 0; i < options.concurrent; i++) {
      setTimeout(() => {
        // Run requests for the specified duration
        const interval = setInterval(() => {
          promises.push(makeRequest());
        }, 100); // 10 RPS per concurrent user

        setTimeout(() => {
          clearInterval(interval);
        }, options.duration);
      }, i * rampUpInterval);
    }

    // Wait for all requests to complete
    await new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, options.duration + rampUpTime + 1000));
    await Promise.all(promises);

    // Calculate statistics
    const durations = results.map(r => r.duration);
    const successfulRequests = results.filter(r => r.status >= 200 && r.status < 400);
    const errorRequests = results.filter(r => r.status >= 400 || r.status === 0);

    return {
      totalRequests: results.length,
      successfulRequests: successfulRequests.length,
      errorRequests: errorRequests.length,
      averageResponseTime: durations.reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0) / durations.length,
      p95ResponseTime: this.calculatePercentile(durations, 0.95),
      p99ResponseTime: this.calculatePercentile(durations, 0.99),
      requestsPerSecond: results.length / (options.duration / 1000),
      errorRate: (errorRequests.length / results.length) * 100
    };
  }

  private static calculatePercentile(values: number[], percentile: number): number {
    const sorted = values.sort((a, b) => a - b);
    const index = Math.ceil(sorted.length * percentile) - 1;
    return sorted[index] || 0;
  }
}

// Test Coverage Utilities
export class TestCoverageUtils {
  private static coverage = new Map<string, { lines: number; covered: number }>();

  static recordCoverage(file: string, line: number) {
    if (!this.coverage.has(file)) {
      this.coverage.set(file, { lines: 0, covered: 0 });
    }
    
    const fileCoverage = this.coverage.get(file)!;
    fileCoverage.lines++;
    fileCoverage.covered++;
  }

  static getCoverageReport() {
    const report: Record<string, number> = {};
    let totalLines = 0;
    let totalCovered = 0;

    for (const [file, coverage] of this.coverage) {
      const percentage = (coverage.covered / coverage.lines) * 100;
      report[file] = Math.round(percentage * 100) / 100;
      totalLines += coverage.lines;
      totalCovered += coverage.covered;
    }

    const overallCoverage = (totalCovered / totalLines) * 100;

    return {
      files: report,
      overall: Math.round(overallCoverage * 100) / 100,
      target: 70 // 70% target coverage
    };
  }
}

import type { Request, Response, NextFunction } from 'express';
import { z, ZodSchema } from 'zod';

export const validateBody = (schema: ZodSchema) => {
  return (req: Request, res: Response, next: NextFunction): void => {
    try {
      req.body = schema.parse(req.body);
      next();
    } catch (error) {
      if (error instanceof z.ZodError) {
        res.status(400).json({
          success: false,
          error: {
            message: 'Invalid request data',
            code: 'VALIDATION_ERROR',
            timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),
            details: error.errors.map(err => ({
              field: err.path.join('.'),
              message: err.message,
              code: err.code,
            })),
          },
        });
        return;
      }
      next(error);
    }
  };
};

export const validateQuery = (schema: ZodSchema) => {
  return (req: Request, res: Response, next: NextFunction): void => {
    try {
      req.query = schema.parse(req.query);
      next();
    } catch (error) {
      if (error instanceof z.ZodError) {
        res.status(400).json({
          success: false,
          error: {
            message: 'Invalid query parameters',
            code: 'VALIDATION_ERROR',
            timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),
            details: error.errors.map(err => ({
              field: err.path.join('.'),
              message: err.message,
              code: err.code,
            })),
          },
        });
        return;
      }
      next(error);
    }
  };
};

export const validateParams = (schema: ZodSchema) => {
  return (req: Request, res: Response, next: NextFunction): void => {
    try {
      req.params = schema.parse(req.params);
      next();
    } catch (error) {
      if (error instanceof z.ZodError) {
        res.status(400).json({
          success: false,
          error: {
            message: 'Invalid URL parameters',
            code: 'VALIDATION_ERROR',
            timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),
            details: error.errors.map(err => ({
              field: err.path.join('.'),
              message: err.message,
              code: err.code,
            })),
          },
        });
        return;
      }
      next(error);
    }
  };
};

## FILE: server/replitAuth.ts

import * as client from "openid-client";
import { Strategy, type VerifyFunction } from "openid-client/passport";

import passport from "passport";
import session from "express-session";
import type { Express, RequestHandler } from "express";
import memoize from "memoizee";
import connectPg from "connect-pg-simple";
import { storage } from "./storage";

if (!process.env.REPLIT_DOMAINS) {
  throw new Error("Environment variable REPLIT_DOMAINS not provided");
}

const getOidcConfig = memoize(
  async () => {
    return await client.discovery(
      new URL(process.env.ISSUER_URL ?? "https://replit.com/oidc"),
      process.env.REPL_ID!
    );
  },
  { maxAge: 3600 * 1000 }
);

export function getSession() {
  const sessionTtl = 7 * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000; // 1 week
  const pgStore = connectPg(session);
  const sessionStore = new pgStore({
    conString: process.env.DATABASE_URL,
    createTableIfMissing: true,
    ttl: sessionTtl,
    tableName: "sessions",
  });
  return session({
    secret: process.env.SESSION_SECRET!,
    store: sessionStore,
    resave: false,
    saveUninitialized: false,
    cookie: {
      httpOnly: true,
      secure: process.env.NODE_ENV === 'production',
      maxAge: sessionTtl,
    },
  });
}

function updateUserSession(
  user: any,
  tokens: client.TokenEndpointResponse & client.TokenEndpointResponseHelpers
) {
  user.claims = tokens.claims();
  user.access_token = tokens.access_token;
  user.refresh_token = tokens.refresh_token;
  user.expires_at = user.claims?.exp;
}

async function upsertUser(
  claims: any,
) {
  await storage.upsertUser({
    id: claims["sub"],
    email: claims["email"],
    firstName: claims["first_name"],
    lastName: claims["last_name"],
    profileImageUrl: claims["profile_image_url"],
  });
}

export async function setupAuth(app: Express) {
  app.set("trust proxy", 1);
  app.use(getSession());
  app.use(passport.initialize());
  app.use(passport.session());

  const config = await getOidcConfig();

  const verify: VerifyFunction = async (
    tokens: client.TokenEndpointResponse & client.TokenEndpointResponseHelpers,
    verified: passport.AuthenticateCallback
  ) => {
    const user = {};
    updateUserSession(user, tokens);
    await upsertUser(tokens.claims());
    verified(null, user);
  };

  for (const domain of process.env
    .REPLIT_DOMAINS!.split(",")) {
    const strategy = new Strategy(
      {
        name: `replitauth:${domain}`,
        config,
        scope: "openid email profile offline_access",
        callbackURL: `https://${domain}/api/callback`,
      },
      verify,
    );
    passport.use(strategy);
  }

  passport.serializeUser((user: Express.User, cb) => cb(null, user));
  passport.deserializeUser((user: Express.User, cb) => cb(null, user));

  app.get("/api/login", (req, res, next) => {
    passport.authenticate(`replitauth:${req.hostname}`, {
      prompt: "login consent",
      scope: ["openid", "email", "profile", "offline_access"],
    })(req, res, next);
  });

  app.get("/api/callback", (req, res, next) => {
    passport.authenticate(`replitauth:${req.hostname}`, {
      successReturnToOrRedirect: "/",
      failureRedirect: "/api/login",
    })(req, res, next);
  });

  app.get("/api/logout", (req, res) => {
    req.logout(() => {
      res.redirect(
        client.buildEndSessionUrl(config, {
          client_id: process.env.REPL_ID!,
          post_logout_redirect_uri: `${req.protocol}://${req.hostname}`,
        }).href
      );
    });
  });
}

export const isAuthenticated: RequestHandler = async (req, res, next) => {
  const user = req.user as any;

  if (!req.isAuthenticated() || !user.expires_at) {
    return res.status(401).json({ message: "Unauthorized" });
  }

  const now = Math.floor(Date.now() / 1000);
  if (now <= user.expires_at) {
    return next();
  }

  const refreshToken = user.refresh_token;
  if (!refreshToken) {
    res.status(401).json({ message: "Unauthorized" });
    return;
  }

  try {
    const config = await getOidcConfig();
    const tokenResponse = await client.refreshTokenGrant(config, refreshToken);
    updateUserSession(user, tokenResponse);
    return next();
  } catch (error) {
    res.status(401).json({ message: "Unauthorized" });
    return;
  }
};

    industry: z.string(),
    size: z.string(),
    geography: z.string(),
    revenue: z.string().optional(),
  }).optional(),
  urgencyLevel: z.enum(['low', 'medium', 'high', 'critical']),

 * POST /api/ai-intelligence/analyze
 * Generate comprehensive AI scenario analysis
 */

  try {
    const requestData = analyzeRequestSchema.parse(req.body);
    
    console.log(`🔍 AI Analysis Request: ${requestData.scenarioType} (${requestData.urgencyLevel})`);
    
    // Try live AI analysis first, fallback to demo if quota exceeded
    let analysis;
    try {
      analysis = await aiIntelligenceEngine.analyzeScenario(requestData);
    } catch (error) {
      // If OpenAI quota exceeded, use demo engine for realistic demonstration
      if (error instanceof Error && (error.message.includes('quota') || error.message.includes('429'))) {
        console.log('🔄 OpenAI quota exceeded, using AI Demo Engine for realistic demonstration');
        analysis = await aiIntelligenceDemoEngine.analyzeDemoScenario(requestData);
      } else {
        throw error;
      }
    }
    
    console.log(`✅ AI Analysis Complete: ${analysis.confidenceScore}% confidence`);
    
    res.json(analysis);
    
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('AI Analysis Error:', error);
    
    if (error instanceof z.ZodError) {
      return res.status(400).json({ 
        error: 'Invalid request data', 
        details: error.errors 
      });
    }
    
    res.status(500).json({ 
      error: 'AI analysis failed', 
      message: error instanceof Error ? error.message : 'Unknown error'
    });
  }
});

Provide a detailed analysis in JSON format with:

Focus on actionable intelligence that transforms 6-month traditional responses into 4-minute decisions.

Respond with valid JSON only:`;

        {
          role: "system",

        },
        {
          role: "user",
          content: prompt
        }
      ],
      response_format: { type: "json_object" },

          content: "You are a learning optimization AI that improves organizational intelligence based on outcomes."
        },
        {
          role: "user",
          content: prompt
        }
      ],
      response_format: { type: "json_object" },
      temperature: 0.3
    });

    const learningUpdate = JSON.parse(response.choices[0].message.content || '{}');
    res.json(learningUpdate);
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('Learning update error:', error);
    res.status(500).json({ 
      error: 'Failed to update learning model',
      model_improvement: 'Unable to process learning data',
      accuracy_enhancement: 0,
      new_insights: [],
      updated_confidence_scores: {}
    });
  }
});

export default router;

// Helper functions
function getEnterpriseDataPoints(systemType: string): string[] {
  const dataPointMap: Record<string, string[]> = {
    erp: [
      'Financial transactions', 'Inventory levels', 'Production schedules',
      'Supply chain status', 'Cost center analysis', 'Budget vs actual'
    ],
    crm: [
      'Customer interactions', 'Sales pipeline', 'Customer satisfaction',
      'Lead conversion rates', 'Customer lifetime value', 'Support tickets'
    ],
    hrms: [
      'Employee performance', 'Engagement scores', 'Turnover rates',
      'Training completions', 'Compensation analysis', 'Workforce analytics'
    ],
    financial: [
      'Revenue recognition', 'Cash flow', 'P&L statements',
      'Balance sheet data', 'Budget variance', 'Financial ratios'
    ],
    operations: [
      'Process efficiency', 'Quality metrics', 'Productivity measures',
      'Equipment utilization', 'Error rates', 'Operational KPIs'
    ]
  };
  
  return dataPointMap[systemType] || [];
}

function getEstimatedDataVolume(systemType: string): string {
  const volumeMap: Record<string, string> = {
    erp: '50-200 GB',
    crm: '20-100 GB',
    hrms: '10-50 GB',
    financial: '30-150 GB',
    operations: '100-500 GB'
  };
  
  return volumeMap[systemType] || '25-100 GB';
}

function getTotalIntegrations(integrations: any): number {
  return Object.values(integrations).reduce((total: number, arr: any) => {
    return total + (Array.isArray(arr) ? arr.length : 0);
  }, 0);
}

export default router;

## FILE: server/routes/natural-language.ts

import express from 'express';
import { isAuthenticated } from '../replitAuth.js';
import { asyncHandler } from '../middleware/errorHandler.js';
import { logger } from '../utils/logger.js';
import { nlQueryEngine } from '../services/natural-language-engine.js';
import { insertNLQueryLogSchema } from '@shared/schema';
import { z } from 'zod';

const router = express.Router();

// Natural Language Query Schema
const nlQuerySchema = z.object({
  query: z.string().min(1).max(1000),
  options: z.object({
    maxResults: z.number().min(1).max(50).optional(),
    minSimilarity: z.number().min(0).max(1).optional(),
    documentTypes: z.array(z.string()).optional()
  }).optional()
});

/**
 * @openapi
 * /api/nl/query:
 *   post:
 *     tags: [Natural Language]
 *     summary: Process natural language query
 *     description: Execute intelligent natural language queries against organizational knowledge base
 *     security:
 *       - SessionAuth: []
 *     requestBody:
 *       required: true
 *       content:
 *         application/json:
 *           schema:
 *             type: object
 *             required:
 *               - query
 *             properties:
 *               query:
 *                 type: string
 *                 description: Natural language query
 *                 example: "What are the risks in our Q4 expansion strategy?"
 *               options:
 *                 type: object
 *                 properties:
 *                   maxResults:
 *                     type: integer
 *                     minimum: 1
 *                     maximum: 50
 *                     default: 10
 *                     example: 10
 *                   minSimilarity:
 *                     type: number
 *                     minimum: 0
 *                     maximum: 1
 *                     default: 0.7
 *                     example: 0.75
 *                   documentTypes:
 *                     type: array
 *                     items:
 *                       type: string
 *                     example: ["scenario", "report", "insight"]
 *     responses:
 *       200:
 *         description: Query processed successfully
 *         content:
 *           application/json:
 *             schema:
 *               type: object
 *               properties:
 *                 query:
 *                   type: string
 *                   example: "What are the risks in our Q4 expansion strategy?"
 *                 intent:
 *                   type: string
 *                   example: "analysis"
 *                 results:
 *                   type: array
 *                   items:
 *                     type: object
 *                     properties:
 *                       id:
 *                         type: string
 *                       title:
 *                         type: string
 *                       content:
 *                         type: string
 *                       documentType:
 *                         type: string
 *                       similarity:
 *                         type: number
 *                       relevantExcerpt:
 *                         type: string
 *                 analysis:
 *                   type: string
 *                   example: "Based on the retrieved scenarios, the main risks include..."
 *                 recommendations:
 *                   type: array
 *                   items:
 *                     type: string
 *                   example: ["Conduct market research", "Review budget allocation"]
 *                 confidence:
 *                   type: number
 *                   example: 0.85
 *                 processingTime:
 *                   type: integer
 *                   example: 1247
 *       400:
 *         description: Invalid query parameters
 *       401:
 *         description: Authentication required
 *       429:
 *         description: Rate limit exceeded
 *       500:
 *         description: Query processing failed
 */
router.post('/query', isAuthenticated, asyncHandler(async (req: any, res) => {
  const { query, options = {} } = nlQuerySchema.parse(req.body);
  const userId = req.user.claims.sub;
  const organizationId = req.user.organizationId || 'default'; // TODO: Get from user context

  logger.info('Natural language query received', {
    userId,
    organizationId,
    queryLength: query.length,
    options
  });

  const result = await nlQueryEngine.processQuery(
    query,
    organizationId,
    userId,
    options
  );

  res.json(result);
}));

/**
 * @openapi
 * /api/nl/analytics:
 *   get:
 *     tags: [Natural Language]
 *     summary: Get query analytics
 *     description: Retrieve analytics about natural language query usage and performance
 *     security:
 *       - SessionAuth: []
 *     responses:
 *       200:
 *         description: Analytics retrieved successfully
 *         content:
 *           application/json:
 *             schema:
 *               type: object
 *               properties:
 *                 totalQueries:
 *                   type: integer
 *                   example: 1247
 *                 avgProcessingTime:
 *                   type: number
 *                   example: 1850.5
 *                 avgConfidence:
 *                   type: number
 *                   example: 0.78
 *                 commonIntents:
 *                   type: array
 *                   items:
 *                     type: object
 *                     properties:
 *                       intent:
 *                         type: string
 *                         example: "search"
 *                       count:
 *                         type: integer
 *                         example: 456
 *                 recentQueries:
 *                   type: array
 *                   items:
 *                     type: object
 *                     properties:
 *                       query:
 *                         type: string
 *                       intent:
 *                         type: string
 *                       confidence:
 *                         type: number
 *                       createdAt:
 *                         type: string
 *                         format: date-time
 */
router.get('/analytics', isAuthenticated, asyncHandler(async (req: any, res) => {
  const organizationId = req.user.organizationId || 'default'; // TODO: Get from user context

  const analytics = await nlQueryEngine.getQueryAnalytics(organizationId);
  
  res.json(analytics);
}));

/**
 * @openapi
 * /api/nl/index:
 *   post:
 *     tags: [Natural Language]
 *     summary: Index document for semantic search
 *     description: Add a document to the semantic search index for natural language queries
 *     security:
 *       - SessionAuth: []
 *     requestBody:
 *       required: true
 *       content:
 *         application/json:
 *           schema:
 *             type: object
 *             required:
 *               - title
 *               - content
 *               - documentType
 *             properties:
 *               title:
 *                 type: string
 *                 example: "Q4 Market Expansion Strategy"
 *               content:
 *                 type: string
 *                 example: "Our Q4 expansion strategy focuses on..."
 *               documentType:
 *                 type: string
 *                 example: "strategy"
 *               sourceId:
 *                 type: string
 *                 example: "scenario_123"
 *               sourceTable:
 *                 type: string
 *                 example: "strategic_scenarios"
 *               metadata:
 *                 type: object
 *                 example: {"department": "Strategy", "priority": "high"}
 *               tags:
 *                 type: array
 *                 items:
 *                   type: string
 *                 example: ["expansion", "Q4", "strategy"]
 *     responses:
 *       201:
 *         description: Document indexed successfully
 *         content:
 *           application/json:
 *             schema:
 *               type: object
 *               properties:
 *                 documentId:
 *                   type: string
 *                   example: "doc_abc123"
 *                 message:
 *                   type: string
 *                   example: "Document indexed successfully"
 */
router.post('/index', isAuthenticated, asyncHandler(async (req: any, res) => {
  const organizationId = req.user.organizationId || 'default'; // TODO: Get from user context
  const { title, content, documentType, sourceId, sourceTable, metadata, tags } = req.body;

  const documentId = await nlQueryEngine.indexDocument(
    organizationId,
    title,
    content,
    documentType,
    sourceId,
    sourceTable,
    metadata,
    tags
  );

  res.status(201).json({
    documentId,
    message: 'Document indexed successfully'
  });
}));

/**
 * @openapi
 * /api/nl/reindex:
 *   post:
 *     tags: [Natural Language]
 *     summary: Re-index organization documents
 *     description: Re-build the semantic search index for all organization documents
 *     security:
 *       - SessionAuth: []
 *     responses:
 *       200:
 *         description: Re-indexing completed successfully
 *         content:
 *           application/json:
 *             schema:
 *               type: object
 *               properties:
 *                 indexedCount:
 *                   type: integer
 *                   example: 145
 *                 message:
 *                   type: string
 *                   example: "Organization documents re-indexed successfully"
 */
router.post('/reindex', isAuthenticated, asyncHandler(async (req: any, res) => {
  const organizationId = req.user.organizationId || 'default'; // TODO: Get from user context

  const indexedCount = await nlQueryEngine.reindexOrganization(organizationId);

  res.json({
    indexedCount,
    message: 'Organization documents re-indexed successfully'
  });
}));

export default router;

 *           type: integer

 *           maximum: 100

 *       - in: query
 *         name: status
 *         schema:
 *           type: string
 *           enum: [new, reviewed, acting, resolved, dismissed]
 *         description: Filter by insight status
 *       - in: query
 *         name: urgency
 *         schema:
 *           type: string
 *           enum: [low, medium, high, critical]
 *         description: Filter by urgency level
 *       - in: query
 *         name: category
 *         schema:
 *           type: string
 *         description: Filter by insight category

 *       200:
 *         description: Proactive insights retrieved successfully

 *           application/json:
 *             schema:
 *               type: array
 *               items:
 *                 type: object

 *                     type: string
 *                     example: "opportunity"
 *                   title:
 *                     type: string
 *                     example: "Market Expansion Opportunity Detected"
 *                   description:
 *                     type: string
 *                     example: "AI analysis indicates emerging market opportunity in Southeast Asia"
 *                   confidence:
 *                     type: string
 *                     enum: [very_low, low, medium, high, very_high]

 *                     format: date-time

 *         description: Authentication required

    status: req.query.status,
    urgency: req.query.urgency,
    category: req.query.category
  };

  const insights = await proactiveInsightsEngine.getInsights(organizationId, options);
  
  res.json(insights);
}));

 * /api/insights/schedule:
 *   post:
 *     tags: [Proactive Insights]
 *     summary: Schedule background insights generation
 *     description: Schedule proactive insights to be generated in the background
 *     security:
 *       - SessionAuth: []
 *     requestBody:
 *       content:
 *         application/json:
 *           schema:
 *             type: object
 *             properties:
 *               delay:
 *                 type: integer
 *                 description: Delay in milliseconds before execution
 *                 example: 300000
 *               analysisType:
 *                 type: string
 *                 enum: [proactive_insights, pattern_detection, anomaly_detection]
 *                 default: proactive_insights
 *                 example: "proactive_insights"
 *     responses:
 *       202:
 *         description: Insights generation scheduled successfully
 *         content:
 *           application/json:
 *             schema:
 *               type: object
 *               properties:
 *                 jobId:
 *                   type: string
 *                   example: "job_abc123"
 *                 message:
 *                   type: string
 *                   example: "Proactive insights generation scheduled"
 *                 scheduledFor:
 *                   type: string
 *                   format: date-time
 */
router.post('/schedule', isAuthenticated, asyncHandler(async (req: any, res) => {
  const organizationId = req.user.organizationId || 'default'; // TODO: Get from user context
  const { delay = 0, analysisType = 'proactive_insights' } = req.body;

  const job = await jobUtils.scheduleAIAnalysis({
    organizationId,
    analysisType: analysisType as any,
    parameters: {
      enabledRules: 'all',
      confidenceThreshold: 0.6
    }
  }, delay);

  const scheduledFor = new Date(Date.now() + delay);

  res.status(202).json({
    jobId: job.id,
    message: 'Proactive insights generation scheduled',
    scheduledFor: scheduledFor.toISOString()
  });
}));
