## FILE: server/services/natural-language-engine.ts
```
import OpenAI from 'openai';
import { logger } from '../utils/logger.js';
import { db } from '../db.js';
import { semanticDocuments, nlQueryLog } from '@shared/schema';
import { eq, desc, and, sql } from 'drizzle-orm';

// the newest OpenAI model is "gpt-5" which was released August 7, 2025. do not change this unless explicitly requested by the user
const openai = new OpenAI({ apiKey: process.env.OPENAI_API_KEY });

interface QueryResult {
  id: string;
  title: string;
  content: string;
  documentType: string;
  sourceId?: string;
  sourceTable?: string;
  similarity: number;
  relevantExcerpt: string;
}

interface NLQueryResponse {
  query: string;
  intent: string;
  results: QueryResult[];
  analysis: string;
  recommendations?: string[];
  confidence: number;
  processingTime: number;
}

export class NaturalLanguageQueryEngine {
  private static instance: NaturalLanguageQueryEngine;
  
  public static getInstance(): NaturalLanguageQueryEngine {
    if (!this.instance) {
      this.instance = new NaturalLanguageQueryEngine();
    }
    return this.instance;
  }

  /**
   * Process a natural language query and return intelligent results
   */
  async processQuery(
    query: string, 
    organizationId: string, 
    userId: string,
    options: {
      maxResults?: number;
      minSimilarity?: number;
      documentTypes?: string[];
    } = {}
  ): Promise<NLQueryResponse> {
    const startTime = Date.now();
    
    try {
      logger.info('Processing natural language query', {
        organizationId,
        userId,
        queryLength: query.length,
        options
      });

      // Step 1: Generate embedding for the query
      const queryEmbedding = await this.generateEmbedding(query);
      
      // Step 2: Detect query intent
      const intent = await this.detectIntent(query);
      
      // Step 3: Perform semantic search
      const searchResults = await this.performSemanticSearch(
        queryEmbedding,
        organizationId,
        options
      );

      // Step 4: Generate intelligent analysis
      const analysis = await this.generateAnalysis(query, searchResults, intent);
      
      // Step 5: Generate recommendations if applicable
      const recommendations = await this.generateRecommendations(
        query, 
        searchResults, 
        intent, 
        organizationId
      );

      const processingTime = Date.now() - startTime;
      const confidence = this.calculateConfidence(searchResults, analysis);

      const response: NLQueryResponse = {
        query,
        intent,
        results: searchResults,
        analysis,
        recommendations,
        confidence,
        processingTime
      };

      // Log the query for analytics
      await this.logQuery(organizationId, userId, response);

      logger.info('Natural language query processed successfully', {
        organizationId,
        userId,
        intent,
        resultsCount: searchResults.length,
        confidence,
        processingTime
      });

      return response;
    } catch (error) {
      logger.error('Natural language query processing failed', error as Error, {
        organizationId,
        userId,
        query: query.substring(0, 100) + '...'
      });
      throw error;
    }
  }

  /**
   * Add documents to the semantic search index
   */
  async indexDocument(
    organizationId: string,
    title: string,
    content: string,
    documentType: string,
    sourceId?: string,
    sourceTable?: string,
    metadata?: Record<string, any>,
    tags?: string[]
  ): Promise<string> {
    try {
      // Generate embedding for the content
      const embedding = await this.generateEmbedding(`${title}\n\n${content}`);
      
      // Insert into semantic documents table
      const [document] = await db.insert(semanticDocuments).values({
        organizationId,
        title,
        content,
        documentType,
        sourceId,
        sourceTable,
        contentEmbedding: embedding,
        metadata: metadata || {},
        tags: tags || [],
        lastEmbedded: new Date(),
        createdBy: 'system' // TODO: Get from context
      }).returning();

      logger.info('Document indexed successfully', {
        documentId: document.id,
        organizationId,
        documentType,
        contentLength: content.length
      });

      return document.id;
    } catch (error) {
      logger.error('Document indexing failed', error as Error, {
        organizationId,
        documentType,
        title: title.substring(0, 100)
      });
      throw error;
    }
  }

  /**
   * Re-index all documents for an organization
   */
  async reindexOrganization(organizationId: string): Promise<number> {
    try {
      logger.info('Starting organization reindex', { organizationId });

      // TODO: Index scenarios, reports, insights, etc.
      // This would pull from strategicScenarios, intelligenceReports, etc.
      // and create semantic documents for each

      let indexedCount = 0;

      // Example: Index strategic scenarios
      const scenarios = await db.query.strategicScenarios.findMany({
        where: (scenarios, { eq }) => eq(scenarios.organizationId, organizationId)
      });

      for (const scenario of scenarios) {
        const content = `${scenario.title}\n\n${scenario.description}\n\nObjective: ${scenario.objective}`;
        await this.indexDocument(
          organizationId,
          scenario.title || 'Untitled Scenario',
          content,
          'scenario',
          scenario.id,
          'strategic_scenarios',
          {
            priority: scenario.priority,
            status: scenario.status,
            category: scenario.category
          },
          scenario.tags as string[] || []
        );
        indexedCount++;
      }

      logger.info('Organization reindex completed', {
        organizationId,
        indexedCount
      });

      return indexedCount;
    } catch (error) {
      logger.error('Organization reindex failed', error as Error, {
        organizationId
      });
      throw error;
    }
  }

  private async generateEmbedding(text: string): Promise<number[]> {
    const response = await openai.embeddings.create({
      model: 'text-embedding-ada-002',
      input: text.substring(0, 8000) // Limit to token constraints
    });

    return response.data[0].embedding;
  }

  private async detectIntent(query: string): Promise<string> {
    const intentResponse = await openai.chat.completions.create({
      model: "gpt-5",
      messages: [
        {
          role: "system",
          content: `You are an intent detection system for an enterprise decision intelligence platform. Classify the user's query into one of these intents: 
          
- "search" - Looking for specific information or documents
- "analysis" - Requesting analysis of data or trends  
- "prediction" - Asking about future outcomes or forecasts
- "recommendation" - Seeking advice or suggested actions
- "comparison" - Comparing options, scenarios, or alternatives
- "summary" - Requesting summaries or overviews
- "insight" - Looking for patterns, learnings, or discoveries

Respond with only the intent category.`
        },
        {
          role: "user", 
          content: query
        }
      ],
      max_tokens: 10,
      temperature: 0.1
    });

    return intentResponse.choices[0].message.content?.trim().toLowerCase() || 'search';
  }

  private async performSemanticSearch(
    queryEmbedding: number[],
    organizationId: string,
    options: {
      maxResults?: number;
      minSimilarity?: number;
      documentTypes?: string[];
    }
  ): Promise<QueryResult[]> {
    const maxResults = options.maxResults || 10;
    const minSimilarity = options.minSimilarity || 0.7;

    // Use pgvector cosine similarity search
    let searchQuery = db
      .select({
        id: semanticDocuments.id,
        title: semanticDocuments.title,
        content: semanticDocuments.content,
        documentType: semanticDocuments.documentType,
        sourceId: semanticDocuments.sourceId,
        sourceTable: semanticDocuments.sourceTable,
        similarity: sql<number>`1 - (content_embedding <=> ${JSON.stringify(queryEmbedding)}::vector)`
      })
      .from(semanticDocuments)
      .where(
        and(
          eq(semanticDocuments.organizationId, organizationId),
          sql`1 - (content_embedding <=> ${JSON.stringify(queryEmbedding)}::vector) > ${minSimilarity}`
        )
      )
      .orderBy(sql`content_embedding <=> ${JSON.stringify(queryEmbedding)}::vector`)
      .limit(maxResults);

    if (options.documentTypes && options.documentTypes.length > 0) {
      searchQuery = searchQuery.where(
        and(
          eq(semanticDocuments.organizationId, organizationId),
          sql`document_type = ANY(${options.documentTypes})`
        )
      );
    }

    const results = await searchQuery;

    // Generate relevant excerpts for each result
    return results.map(result => ({
      ...result,
      relevantExcerpt: this.generateExcerpt(result.content, 200)
    }));
  }

  private async generateAnalysis(
    query: string, 
    results: QueryResult[], 
    intent: string
  ): Promise<string> {
    if (results.length === 0) {
      return "No relevant information found for your query. Consider refining your search terms or exploring related topics.";
    }

    const contextData = results.slice(0, 5).map(r => ({
      title: r.title,
      type: r.documentType,
      excerpt: r.relevantExcerpt,
      similarity: r.similarity
    }));

    const analysisResponse = await openai.chat.completions.create({
      model: "gpt-5",
      messages: [
        {
          role: "system",
          content: `You are an AI analyst for an enterprise decision intelligence platform. Based on the user's query and retrieved documents, provide insightful analysis.

Query Intent: ${intent}

Guidelines:
- Synthesize information from multiple sources
- Identify key patterns and insights
- Provide executive-level analysis
- Be concise but comprehensive
- Focus on actionable intelligence`
        },
        {
          role: "user",
          content: `Query: "${query}"

Retrieved Information:
${JSON.stringify(contextData, null, 2)}

Please provide intelligent analysis based on this information.`
        }
      ],
      max_tokens: 500,
      temperature: 0.3
    });

    return analysisResponse.choices[0].message.content || "Analysis could not be generated.";
  }

  private async generateRecommendations(
    query: string,
    results: QueryResult[],
    intent: string,
    organizationId: string
  ): Promise<string[]> {
    if (intent === 'search' || results.length === 0) {
      return [];
    }

    const contextData = results.slice(0, 3).map(r => ({
      title: r.title,
      type: r.documentType,
      excerpt: r.relevantExcerpt
    }));

    const recommendationResponse = await openai.chat.completions.create({
      model: "gpt-5",
      messages: [
        {
          role: "system",
          content: `You are a strategic advisor for enterprise decision-making. Provide 3-5 actionable recommendations based on the query and context.

Format as a JSON array of strings. Each recommendation should be:
- Specific and actionable
- Executive-appropriate
- Based on the available data
- Include next steps where relevant

Example: ["Conduct immediate risk assessment", "Schedule stakeholder meeting", "Review budget allocation"]`
        },
        {
          role: "user",
          content: `Query: "${query}"
Intent: ${intent}

Context:
${JSON.stringify(contextData, null, 2)}`
        }
      ],
      max_tokens: 300,
      temperature: 0.4,
      response_format: { type: "json_object" }
    });

    try {
      const parsed = JSON.parse(recommendationResponse.choices[0].message.content || '{"recommendations":[]}');
      return parsed.recommendations || [];
    } catch (error) {
      logger.warn('Failed to parse recommendations JSON', { organizationId });
      return [];
    }
  }

  private calculateConfidence(results: QueryResult[], analysis: string): number {
    if (results.length === 0) return 0;

    // Base confidence on result similarity and count
    const avgSimilarity = results.reduce((sum, r) => sum + r.similarity, 0) / results.length;
    const countFactor = Math.min(results.length / 5, 1); // Max factor at 5+ results
    const contentFactor = analysis.length > 100 ? 1 : analysis.length / 100;

    return Math.round((avgSimilarity * countFactor * contentFactor) * 100) / 100;
  }

  private generateExcerpt(content: string, maxLength: number): string {
    if (content.length <= maxLength) return content;
    
    const excerpt = content.substring(0, maxLength);
    const lastSentence = excerpt.lastIndexOf('.');
    
    if (lastSentence > maxLength * 0.7) {
      return excerpt.substring(0, lastSentence + 1);
    }
    
    const lastSpace = excerpt.lastIndexOf(' ');
    return excerpt.substring(0, lastSpace) + '...';
  }

  private async logQuery(
    organizationId: string,
    userId: string,
    response: NLQueryResponse
  ): Promise<void> {
    try {
      await db.insert(nlQueryLog).values({
        organizationId,
        userId,
        query: response.query,
        intent: response.intent,
        results: {
          count: response.results.length,
          topResults: response.results.slice(0, 3).map(r => ({
            title: r.title,
            type: r.documentType,
            similarity: r.similarity
          })),
          analysis: response.analysis,
          recommendations: response.recommendations
        },
        processingTime: response.processingTime,
        confidence: response.confidence
      });
    } catch (error) {
      logger.warn('Failed to log NL query', error as Error, { organizationId, userId });
    }
  }

  /**
   * Get query analytics for an organization
   */
  async getQueryAnalytics(organizationId: string): Promise<{
    totalQueries: number;
    avgProcessingTime: number;
    avgConfidence: number;
    commonIntents: Array<{intent: string; count: number}>;
    recentQueries: Array<{query: string; intent: string; confidence: number; createdAt: Date}>;
  }> {
    try {
      const [analytics] = await db
        .select({
          totalQueries: sql<number>`count(*)`,
          avgProcessingTime: sql<number>`avg(processing_time)`,
          avgConfidence: sql<number>`avg(confidence)`
        })
        .from(nlQueryLog)
        .where(eq(nlQueryLog.organizationId, organizationId));

      const intentStats = await db
        .select({
          intent: nlQueryLog.intent,
          count: sql<number>`count(*)`
        })
        .from(nlQueryLog)
        .where(eq(nlQueryLog.organizationId, organizationId))
        .groupBy(nlQueryLog.intent)
        .orderBy(sql`count(*) desc`)
        .limit(5);

      const recentQueries = await db
        .select({
          query: nlQueryLog.query,
          intent: nlQueryLog.intent,
          confidence: nlQueryLog.confidence,
          createdAt: nlQueryLog.createdAt
        })
        .from(nlQueryLog)
        .where(eq(nlQueryLog.organizationId, organizationId))
        .orderBy(desc(nlQueryLog.createdAt))
        .limit(10);

      return {
        totalQueries: Number(analytics.totalQueries) || 0,
        avgProcessingTime: Number(analytics.avgProcessingTime) || 0,
        avgConfidence: Number(analytics.avgConfidence) || 0,
        commonIntents: intentStats.map(stat => ({
          intent: stat.intent || 'unknown',
          count: Number(stat.count)
        })),
        recentQueries: recentQueries.map(q => ({
          query: q.query,
          intent: q.intent || 'unknown',
          confidence: Number(q.confidence) || 0,
          createdAt: q.createdAt || new Date()
        }))
      };
    } catch (error) {
      logger.error('Failed to get query analytics', error as Error, { organizationId });
      throw error;
    }
  }
}

export const nlQueryEngine = NaturalLanguageQueryEngine.getInstance();
```

```
// Simple logging replacement since middleware/logging doesn't exist
const logger = {
  info: (message: string, data?: any) => console.log(`[INFO] ${message}`, data),
  error: (message: string, data?: any) => console.error(`[ERROR] ${message}`, data)
};
import type { 
  DecisionOutcome, 
  InsertDecisionOutcome,
  LearningPattern,
  InsertLearningPattern,
  InstitutionalMemory,
  InsertInstitutionalMemory,
  PredictiveTrigger,
  InsertPredictiveTrigger,
  AILearningSession,
  InsertAILearningSession,
  Organization
} from "@shared/schema";
import { DatabaseStorage } from "../storage";
import OpenAI from "openai";

const openai = new OpenAI({ 
  apiKey: process.env.OPENAI_API_KEY 
});

export interface OrganizationalPattern {
  id: string;
  type: 'success_factor' | 'failure_mode' | 'decision_pattern' | 'response_pattern';
  conditions: any;
  actions: any;
  outcomes: any;
  confidence: number;
  frequency: number;
  successRate: number;
}

export interface InstitutionalWisdom {
  id: string;
  domain: string;
  knowledge: any;
  triggerConditions: any;
  effectiveness: string;
  sourceDecisions: string[];
  validationCount: number;
}

export interface PredictiveInsight {
  scenarioId: string;
  probability: number;
  impact: string;
  triggers: any;
  recommendedActions: any[];
  confidence: number;
  timeHorizon: number;
}

export class OrganizationalIntelligenceEngine {
  private storage: DatabaseStorage;

  constructor(storage: DatabaseStorage) {
    this.storage = storage;
  }

  private isDemoMode(): boolean {
    // Use same demo detection as AI Scenario Recommender
    return true; // Force demo mode for now
  }

  /**
   * Core Learning Loop - Analyze decision outcomes and extract patterns
   */
  async learnFromDecisionOutcome(outcome: InsertDecisionOutcome): Promise<{
    patternsDiscovered: OrganizationalPattern[];
    wisdomCaptured: InstitutionalWisdom[];
    predictiveInsights: PredictiveInsight[];
  }> {
    try {
      // Record the decision outcome
      const recordedOutcome = await this.storage.recordDecisionOutcome(outcome);
      
      // Get related historical data
      const historicalOutcomes = await this.storage.getDecisionOutcomes(
        outcome.organizationId!, 
        { decisionType: outcome.decisionType, limit: 50 }
      );

      let patternsDiscovered: OrganizationalPattern[] = [];
      let wisdomCaptured: InstitutionalWisdom[] = [];
      let predictiveInsights: PredictiveInsight[] = [];

      if (this.isDemoMode()) {
        // Generate demo learning results
        patternsDiscovered = this.generateDemoPatterns(outcome);
        wisdomCaptured = this.generateDemoWisdom(outcome);
        predictiveInsights = this.generateDemoPredictions(outcome);
      } else {
        // Real AI analysis of patterns
        const aiAnalysis = await this.analyzeDecisionPatterns(historicalOutcomes);
        patternsDiscovered = aiAnalysis.patterns;
        wisdomCaptured = await this.extractInstitutionalWisdom(historicalOutcomes);
        predictiveInsights = await this.generatePredictiveInsights(outcome.organizationId!);
      }

      // Store discovered patterns
      for (const pattern of patternsDiscovered) {
        await this.storage.createLearningPattern({
          organizationId: outcome.organizationId!,
          patternType: pattern.type,
          category: this.categorizePattern(outcome.decisionType!),
          title: `${pattern.type} Pattern`,
          description: `Discovered pattern from ${outcome.decisionType} decisions`,
          conditions: pattern.conditions,
          actions: pattern.actions,
          outcomes: pattern.outcomes,
          frequency: pattern.frequency,
          successRate: pattern.successRate.toString(),
          confidenceLevel: pattern.confidence.toString(),
          supportingDecisions: [recordedOutcome.id],
          keyFactors: pattern.conditions,
          recommendations: pattern.actions
        });
      }

      // Store institutional wisdom
      for (const wisdom of wisdomCaptured) {
        await this.storage.createInstitutionalMemory({
          organizationId: outcome.organizationId!,
          memoryType: 'best_practice',
          domain: wisdom.domain,
          title: `Learned Practice: ${wisdom.domain}`,
          summary: `Institutional knowledge from ${outcome.decisionType} decisions`,
          detailedKnowledge: wisdom.knowledge,
          triggerConditions: wisdom.triggerConditions,
          sourceDecisions: wisdom.sourceDecisions,
          acquisitionMethod: 'outcome_analysis',
          validationCount: wisdom.validationCount,
          effectiveness: wisdom.effectiveness as any
        });
      }

      // Record learning session
      await this.storage.recordAILearningSession({
        organizationId: outcome.organizationId!,
        sessionType: 'pattern_discovery',
        inputDataSources: [`decision_outcome:${recordedOutcome.id}`],
        outputInsights: { patternsDiscovered, wisdomCaptured, predictiveInsights },
        confidenceScore: this.calculateAverageConfidence(patternsDiscovered).toString(),
        dataPointsAnalyzed: historicalOutcomes.length,
        patternsDiscovered: patternsDiscovered.length,
        predictionsGenerated: predictiveInsights.length,
        actionableInsights: wisdomCaptured.length
      });

      logger.info('Organizational learning completed', {
        organizationId: outcome.organizationId,
        decisionType: outcome.decisionType,
        patternsFound: patternsDiscovered.length,
        wisdomCaptured: wisdomCaptured.length,
        predictions: predictiveInsights.length
      });

      return { patternsDiscovered, wisdomCaptured, predictiveInsights };

    } catch (error) {
      logger.error('Failed to learn from decision outcome', { 
        error: String(error),
        outcome: outcome.decisionDescription
      });
      throw new Error(`Learning failed: ${error instanceof Error ? error.message : 'Unknown error'}`);
    }
  }

  /**
   * Get organizational intelligence summary for decision support
   */
  async getOrganizationalIntelligence(organizationId: string, context?: string): Promise<{
    relevantPatterns: LearningPattern[];
    applicableWisdom: InstitutionalMemory[];
    riskPredictions: PredictiveTrigger[];
    recommendations: any[];
  }> {
    try {
      const [patterns, wisdom, triggers] = await Promise.all([
        this.storage.getLearningPatterns(organizationId),
        this.storage.getInstitutionalMemory(organizationId),
        this.storage.getPredictiveTriggers(organizationId)
      ]);

      // Filter for relevance based on context
      const relevantPatterns = context ? 
        patterns.filter(p => this.isPatternRelevant(p, context)) : 
        patterns.slice(0, 10);

      const applicableWisdom = context ? 
        wisdom.filter(w => this.isWisdomApplicable(w, context)) : 
        wisdom.slice(0, 10);

      const riskPredictions = triggers.filter(t => t.isActive);

      // Generate AI recommendations based on organizational intelligence
      const recommendations = this.isDemoMode() ? 
        this.generateDemoRecommendations(organizationId, context) :
        await this.generateAIRecommendations(organizationId, relevantPatterns, applicableWisdom);

      return { relevantPatterns, applicableWisdom, riskPredictions, recommendations };

    } catch (error) {
      logger.error('Failed to get organizational intelligence', { 
        error: String(error),
        organizationId 
      });
      throw new Error(`Intelligence retrieval failed: ${error instanceof Error ? error.message : 'Unknown error'}`);
    }
  }

  /**
   * Predictive scenario triggering based on real-time data
   */
  async evaluatePredictiveTriggers(organizationId: string, currentData: any): Promise<{
    triggeredScenarios: string[];
    alertLevel: 'low' | 'medium' | 'high' | 'critical';
    recommendedActions: any[];
  }> {
    try {
      const triggers = await this.storage.getPredictiveTriggers(organizationId);
      const triggeredScenarios: string[] = [];
      let maxAlertLevel: 'low' | 'medium' | 'high' | 'critical' = 'low';

      for (const trigger of triggers) {
        if (this.evaluateTriggerConditions(trigger, currentData)) {
          triggeredScenarios.push(trigger.scenarioId);
          
          // Update alert level based on trigger impact
          const alertLevel = this.mapImpactToAlert(trigger.impact);
          if (this.isHigherAlert(alertLevel, maxAlertLevel)) {
            maxAlertLevel = alertLevel;
          }

          // Update trigger statistics
          await this.updateTriggerStats(trigger.id, true);
        }
      }

      const recommendedActions = triggeredScenarios.length > 0 ? 
        await this.generateTriggerActions(triggeredScenarios, organizationId) : [];

      return { triggeredScenarios, alertLevel: maxAlertLevel, recommendedActions };

    } catch (error) {
      logger.error('Failed to evaluate predictive triggers', { 
        error: String(error),
        organizationId 
      });
      throw new Error(`Trigger evaluation failed: ${error instanceof Error ? error.message : 'Unknown error'}`);
    }
  }

  private calculateAverageConfidence(patterns: OrganizationalPattern[]): number {
    if (patterns.length === 0) return 0;
    return patterns.reduce((sum, p) => sum + p.confidence, 0) / patterns.length;
  }
```

```
import { logger } from '../utils/logger.js';
import { db } from '../db.js';
import { 
  proactiveInsights, 
  strategicScenarios, 
  pulseMetrics,

  organizations,
  users

import { eq, desc, and, gte, lte, sql } from 'drizzle-orm';
import { jobUtils } from '../utils/background-jobs.js';
import OpenAI from 'openai';

// the newest OpenAI model is "gpt-5" which was released August 7, 2025. do not change this unless explicitly requested by the user
const openai = new OpenAI({ apiKey: process.env.OPENAI_API_KEY });

interface PatternDetectionRule {
  id: string;
  name: string;
  description: string;
  category: string;
  enabled: boolean;
  conditions: {
    tables: string[];
    metrics: string[];
    thresholds: Record<string, number>;
    timeWindows: {
      current: string;
      comparison: string;
    };
  };
  severity: 'low' | 'medium' | 'high' | 'critical';
}

interface DetectedPattern {
  ruleId: string;
  confidence: number;
  evidenceData: Record<string, any>;
  potentialImpact: {
    financial?: number;
    operational?: string;
    strategic?: string;
  };
  affectedDepartments: string[];
  recommendations: string[];
}

interface InsightGenerationResult {
  insights: Array<{
    id: string;
    title: string;
    description: string;
    category: string;
    confidence: 'very_low' | 'low' | 'medium' | 'high' | 'very_high';
    urgency: 'low' | 'medium' | 'high' | 'critical';
    recommendations: string[];
  }>;
  processingTime: number;
  patternsAnalyzed: number;
}

export class ProactiveInsightsEngine {
  private static instance: ProactiveInsightsEngine;
  private detectionRules: PatternDetectionRule[] = [];

  public static getInstance(): ProactiveInsightsEngine {
    if (!this.instance) {

    }

  }

  private initializeDetectionRules(): void {

  /**
   * Run proactive insights analysis for an organization
   */
  async generateInsights(organizationId: string): Promise<InsightGenerationResult> {
    const startTime = Date.now();
    
    try {
      logger.info('Starting proactive insights generation', { organizationId });

      // Get organization context
      const organization = await db.query.organizations.findFirst({
        where: eq(organizations.id, organizationId)
      });

      if (!organization) {
        throw new Error(`Organization ${organizationId} not found`);
      }

      const detectedPatterns: DetectedPattern[] = [];
      let patternsAnalyzed = 0;

      // Analyze each detection rule
      for (const rule of this.detectionRules.filter(r => r.enabled)) {
        try {
          const patterns = await this.analyzePattern(organizationId, rule);
          detectedPatterns.push(...patterns);
          patternsAnalyzed++;
        } catch (error) {
          logger.warn('Pattern analysis failed', error as Error, {
            organizationId,
            ruleId: rule.id
          });
        }
      }

      // Generate insights from detected patterns
      const insights = await this.generateInsightsFromPatterns(
        organizationId,
        detectedPatterns,
        organization
      );

      // Store insights in database
      const storedInsights = await this.storeInsights(organizationId, insights);

      const processingTime = Date.now() - startTime;

      logger.info('Proactive insights generation completed', {
        organizationId,
        insightsGenerated: storedInsights.length,
        patternsAnalyzed,
        processingTime
      });

      return {
        insights: storedInsights,
        processingTime,
        patternsAnalyzed
      };
    } catch (error) {
      logger.error('Proactive insights generation failed', error as Error, {
        organizationId
      });
      throw error;
    }
  }

  private async analyzePattern(
    organizationId: string,
    rule: PatternDetectionRule
  ): Promise<DetectedPattern[]> {
    const patterns: DetectedPattern[] = [];

    try {
      // Collect relevant data based on rule conditions
      const currentData = await this.collectMetricData(
        organizationId,
        rule.conditions.tables,
        rule.conditions.metrics,
        rule.conditions.timeWindows.current
      );

      const comparisonData = await this.collectMetricData(
        organizationId,
        rule.conditions.tables,
        rule.conditions.metrics,
        rule.conditions.timeWindows.comparison
      );

      // Apply pattern detection logic based on rule type
      const detectedPattern = await this.applyPatternLogic(
        rule,
        currentData,
        comparisonData
      );

      if (detectedPattern && detectedPattern.confidence > 0.6) {
        patterns.push(detectedPattern);
      }
    } catch (error) {
      logger.warn('Pattern analysis failed', error as Error, {
        organizationId,
        ruleId: rule.id
      });
    }

    return patterns;
  }

  private async collectMetricData(
    organizationId: string,
    tables: string[],
    metrics: string[],
    timeWindow: string
  ): Promise<Record<string, any[]>> {
    const data: Record<string, any[]> = {};

    // Convert time window to date range
    const endDate = new Date();
    const startDate = new Date(endDate);
    const windowDays = parseInt(timeWindow.match(/\d+/)?.[0] || '7');
    startDate.setDate(startDate.getDate() - windowDays);

    // Collect data from relevant tables
    for (const table of tables) {
      try {
        switch (table) {
          case 'performance_metrics':
            data[table] = await db.query.performanceMetrics.findMany({
              where: and(
                eq(performanceMetrics.organizationId, organizationId),
                gte(performanceMetrics.lastUpdated, startDate),
                lte(performanceMetrics.lastUpdated, endDate)
              )
            });
            break;
            
          case 'pulse_metrics':
            data[table] = await db.query.pulseMetrics.findMany({
              where: and(
                eq(pulseMetrics.organizationId, organizationId),
                gte(pulseMetrics.createdAt, startDate),
                lte(pulseMetrics.createdAt, endDate)
              )
            });
            break;
            
          case 'strategic_scenarios':
            data[table] = await db.query.strategicScenarios.findMany({
              where: and(
                eq(strategicScenarios.organizationId, organizationId),
                gte(strategicScenarios.updatedAt, startDate),
                lte(strategicScenarios.updatedAt, endDate)
              )
            });
            break;
        }
      } catch (error) {
        logger.warn('Data collection failed for table', error as Error, {
          organizationId,
          table
        });
      }
    }

    return data;
  }

  private async applyPatternLogic(
    rule: PatternDetectionRule,
    currentData: Record<string, any[]>,
    comparisonData: Record<string, any[]>
  ): Promise<DetectedPattern | null> {
    // Use AI to analyze patterns and detect anomalies
    const analysisPrompt = `
Analyze the following data for pattern detection:

Rule: ${rule.name}
Description: ${rule.description}
Category: ${rule.category}

Current Period Data:
${JSON.stringify(currentData, null, 2)}

Comparison Period Data:
${JSON.stringify(comparisonData, null, 2)}

Conditions:
${JSON.stringify(rule.conditions, null, 2)}

Analyze for:
1. Significant changes or anomalies
2. Emerging trends
3. Risk indicators
4. Opportunity signals

Return analysis as JSON with:
{
  "patternDetected": boolean,
  "confidence": number (0-1),
  "evidenceData": object,
  "potentialImpact": {
    "financial": number or null,
    "operational": "description",
    "strategic": "description"
  },
  "affectedDepartments": string[],
  "recommendations": string[]
}
`;

    try {
      const response = await openai.chat.completions.create({
        model: "gpt-5",
        messages: [
          {
            role: "system",
            content: "You are an expert business analyst specializing in pattern detection and predictive insights. Analyze the provided data for meaningful patterns."
          },
          {
            role: "user",
            content: analysisPrompt
          }
        ],
        max_tokens: 800,
        temperature: 0.2,
        response_format: { type: "json_object" }
      });

      const analysis = JSON.parse(response.choices[0].message.content || '{}');
      
      if (analysis.patternDetected && analysis.confidence > 0.6) {
        return {
          ruleId: rule.id,
          confidence: analysis.confidence,
          evidenceData: analysis.evidenceData || {},
          potentialImpact: analysis.potentialImpact || {},
          affectedDepartments: analysis.affectedDepartments || [],
          recommendations: analysis.recommendations || []
        };
      }
    } catch (error) {
      logger.warn('AI pattern analysis failed', error as Error, {
        ruleId: rule.id
      });
    }

    return null;
  }

  private async generateInsightsFromPatterns(
    organizationId: string,
    patterns: DetectedPattern[],
    organization: any
  ): Promise<Array<{
    title: string;
    description: string;
    category: string;
    confidence: 'very_low' | 'low' | 'medium' | 'high' | 'very_high';
    urgency: 'low' | 'medium' | 'high' | 'critical';
    recommendations: string[];
    evidenceData: Record<string, any>;
    potentialImpact: Record<string, any>;
    affectedDepartments: string[];
  }>> {
    const insights = [];

    for (const pattern of patterns) {
      const rule = this.detectionRules.find(r => r.id === pattern.ruleId);
      if (!rule) continue;

      // Generate executive-level insight
      const insightPrompt = `
Based on detected pattern from rule "${rule.name}", generate an executive-level strategic insight.

Organization: ${organization.name} (${organization.type}, ${organization.industry})
Pattern Confidence: ${pattern.confidence}
Evidence: ${JSON.stringify(pattern.evidenceData)}
Impact: ${JSON.stringify(pattern.potentialImpact)}

Generate:
1. Executive-appropriate title (concise, impactful)
2. Strategic description (what this means for the business)
3. Actionable recommendations (3-5 specific actions)

Format as JSON:
{
  "title": "Executive Title",
  "description": "Strategic business impact description",
  "recommendations": ["Action 1", "Action 2", "Action 3"]
}
`;

      try {
        const response = await openai.chat.completions.create({
          model: "gpt-5",
          messages: [
            {
              role: "system", 
              content: "You are a strategic business advisor providing executive-level insights for organizational decision-making."
            },
            {
              role: "user",
              content: insightPrompt
            }
          ],
          max_tokens: 400,
          temperature: 0.3,
          response_format: { type: "json_object" }
        });

        const insight = JSON.parse(response.choices[0].message.content || '{}');

        insights.push({
          title: insight.title || `${rule.name} Alert`,
          description: insight.description || `Pattern detected in ${rule.category}`,
          category: rule.category,
          confidence: this.mapConfidenceLevel(pattern.confidence),
          urgency: this.mapUrgencyLevel(rule.severity, pattern.confidence),
          recommendations: insight.recommendations || pattern.recommendations,
          evidenceData: pattern.evidenceData,
          potentialImpact: pattern.potentialImpact,
          affectedDepartments: pattern.affectedDepartments
        });
      } catch (error) {
        logger.warn('Insight generation failed', error as Error, {
          organizationId,
          ruleId: pattern.ruleId
        });
      }
    }

    return insights;
  }

  private async storeInsights(
    organizationId: string,
    insights: Array<{
      title: string;
      description: string;
      category: string;
      confidence: 'very_low' | 'low' | 'medium' | 'high' | 'very_high';
      urgency: 'low' | 'medium' | 'high' | 'critical';
      recommendations: string[];
      evidenceData: Record<string, any>;
      potentialImpact: Record<string, any>;
      affectedDepartments: string[];
    }>
  ): Promise<Array<{ id: string; title: string; description: string; category: string; confidence: 'very_low' | 'low' | 'medium' | 'high' | 'very_high'; urgency: 'low' | 'medium' | 'high' | 'critical'; recommendations: string[]; }>> {
    const storedInsights = [];

    for (const insight of insights) {
      try {
        const [stored] = await db.insert(proactiveInsights).values({
          organizationId,
          insightType: this.mapInsightType(insight.category),
          title: insight.title,
          description: insight.description,
          confidence: insight.confidence,
          urgency: insight.urgency,
          category: insight.category,
          sourcePatterns: { 
            detectionTime: new Date().toISOString(),
            confidence: insight.confidence 
          },
          evidenceData: insight.evidenceData,
          recommendations: insight.recommendations,
          potentialImpact: insight.potentialImpact,
          affectedDepartments: insight.affectedDepartments
        }).returning();

        storedInsights.push({
          id: stored.id,
          title: stored.title,
          description: stored.description,
          category: stored.category || insight.category,
          confidence: stored.confidence,
          urgency: stored.urgency,
          recommendations: insight.recommendations
        });

        // Schedule notification for high-urgency insights
        if (insight.urgency === 'high' || insight.urgency === 'critical') {
          await jobUtils.sendNotification({
            recipients: ['system'], // TODO: Get org admins
            type: 'email',
            subject: `Proactive Insight: ${insight.title}`,
            content: insight.description,
            priority: insight.urgency
          });
        }
      } catch (error) {
        logger.error('Failed to store insight', error as Error, {
          organizationId,
          insightTitle: insight.title
        });
      }
    }

    return storedInsights;
  }

  private mapConfidenceLevel(confidence: number): 'very_low' | 'low' | 'medium' | 'high' | 'very_high' {
    if (confidence >= 0.9) return 'very_high';
    if (confidence >= 0.75) return 'high';
    if (confidence >= 0.6) return 'medium';
    if (confidence >= 0.4) return 'low';
    return 'very_low';
  }

  private mapUrgencyLevel(severity: string, confidence: number): 'low' | 'medium' | 'high' | 'critical' {
    const urgencyMap = {
      critical: confidence > 0.8 ? 'critical' : 'high',
      high: confidence > 0.7 ? 'high' : 'medium',
      medium: confidence > 0.6 ? 'medium' : 'low',
      low: 'low'
    };

    return urgencyMap[severity as keyof typeof urgencyMap] as 'low' | 'medium' | 'high' | 'critical';
  }

  private mapInsightType(category: string): string {
    const typeMap: Record<string, string> = {
      financial: 'opportunity',
      operational: 'risk',
      strategic: 'opportunity', 
      risk: 'risk',
      innovation: 'trend',
      market: 'opportunity'
    };

    return typeMap[category] || 'anomaly';
  }

  /**
   * Get insights for an organization
   */
  async getInsights(
    organizationId: string,
    options: {
      limit?: number;
      status?: string;
      urgency?: string;
      category?: string;
    } = {}
  ): Promise<any[]> {
    try {
      let query = db
        .select()
        .from(proactiveInsights)
        .where(eq(proactiveInsights.organizationId, organizationId));

      if (options.status) {
        query = query.where(eq(proactiveInsights.status, options.status));
      }

      if (options.urgency) {
        query = query.where(eq(proactiveInsights.urgency, options.urgency as any));
      }

      if (options.category) {
        query = query.where(eq(proactiveInsights.category, options.category));
      }

      const insights = await query
        .orderBy(desc(proactiveInsights.createdAt))
        .limit(options.limit || 20);

      return insights;
    } catch (error) {
      logger.error('Failed to get insights', error as Error, { organizationId });
      throw error;
    }
  }

  /**
   * Schedule recurring insights generation for all organizations
   */
  static async scheduleRecurringInsights(): Promise<void> {
    try {
      const organizations = await db.query.organizations.findMany({
        columns: { id: true, name: true }
      });

      for (const org of organizations) {
        await jobUtils.scheduleAIAnalysis({
          organizationId: org.id,
          analysisType: 'proactive_insights',
          parameters: {
            enabledRules: 'all',
            confidenceThreshold: 0.6
          }
        }, Math.floor(Math.random() * 3600000)); // Random delay up to 1 hour
      }

      logger.info('Scheduled proactive insights for all organizations', {
        organizationCount: organizations.length
      });
    } catch (error) {
      logger.error('Failed to schedule recurring insights', error as Error);
    }
  }
}

export const proactiveInsightsEngine = ProactiveInsightsEngine.getInstance();
```

```
import WebSocket from 'ws';
import { v4 as uuidv4 } from 'uuid';

/**
 * Real-Time Collaboration Engine
 * Handles live editing, voice/video integration, and collaborative features
 */

export interface CollaborationSession {
  id: string;
  type: 'document' | 'scenario_planning' | 'meeting' | 'crisis_response';
  participants: Participant[];
  document?: CollaborativeDocument;
  meeting?: MeetingSession;
  permissions: SessionPermissions;
  createdAt: Date;
  lastActivity: Date;
}

export interface Participant {
  id: string;
  userId: string;
  name: string;
  email: string;
  role: 'owner' | 'editor' | 'viewer';
  status: 'active' | 'idle' | 'disconnected';
  cursor?: CursorPosition;
  avatar?: string;
  joinedAt: Date;
  lastSeen: Date;
}

export interface CollaborativeDocument {
  id: string;
  title: string;
  content: any; // Operational Transform compatible structure
  version: number;
  operations: Operation[];
  locks: DocumentLock[];
}

export interface Operation {
  id: string;
  type: 'insert' | 'delete' | 'format' | 'move';
  userId: string;
  position: number;
  content?: string;
  length?: number;
  attributes?: Record<string, any>;
  timestamp: Date;
  version: number;
}

export interface DocumentLock {
  id: string;
  userId: string;
  elementId: string;
  type: 'exclusive' | 'shared';
  acquiredAt: Date;
  expiresAt: Date;
}

export interface CursorPosition {
  documentId: string;
  position: number;
  selection?: {
    start: number;
    end: number;
  };
  color: string;
}

export interface MeetingSession {
  id: string;
  type: 'voice' | 'video' | 'screen_share';
  participants: string[];
  settings: {
    recordingEnabled: boolean;
    transcriptionEnabled: boolean;
    backgroundBlurEnabled: boolean;
    breakoutRoomsEnabled: boolean;
  };
  startTime: Date;
  endTime?: Date;
  recording?: {
    url: string;
    duration: number;
    transcript?: string;
  };
}

export interface SessionPermissions {
  canEdit: boolean;
  canInvite: boolean;
  canRecord: boolean;
  canModerate: boolean;
  maxParticipants: number;
}

export class RealTimeCollaborationEngine {
  private sessions: Map<string, CollaborationSession> = new Map();
  private connections: Map<string, WebSocket> = new Map();
  private userSessions: Map<string, Set<string>> = new Map();
  
  /**
   * WebRTC Signaling Server for Video/Voice
   */
  private webrtcSignaling = new Map<string, any>();

  /**
   * Create new collaboration session
   */
  async createSession(
    type: CollaborationSession['type'],
    creatorId: string,
    initialData?: any
  ): Promise<CollaborationSession> {
    const sessionId = uuidv4();
    
    const session: CollaborationSession = {
      id: sessionId,
      type,
      participants: [{
        id: uuidv4(),
        userId: creatorId,
        name: 'Session Creator', // In production, get from user service
        email: 'creator@example.com',
        role: 'owner',
        status: 'active',
        avatar: '/default-avatar.png',
        joinedAt: new Date(),
        lastSeen: new Date()
      }],
      permissions: {
        canEdit: true,
        canInvite: true,
        canRecord: true,
        canModerate: true,
        maxParticipants: 50
      },
      createdAt: new Date(),
      lastActivity: new Date()
    };

    // Initialize document if needed
    if (type === 'document' || type === 'scenario_planning') {
      session.document = {
        id: uuidv4(),
        title: initialData?.title || 'Untitled Document',
        content: initialData?.content || { ops: [] },
        version: 0,
        operations: [],
        locks: []
      };
    }

    // Initialize meeting session if needed
    if (type === 'meeting' || type === 'crisis_response') {
      session.meeting = {
        id: uuidv4(),
        type: 'video',
        participants: [creatorId],
        settings: {
          recordingEnabled: false,
          transcriptionEnabled: true,
          backgroundBlurEnabled: true,
          breakoutRoomsEnabled: false
        },
        startTime: new Date()
      };
    }

    this.sessions.set(sessionId, session);
    this.addUserToSession(creatorId, sessionId);
    
    return session;
  }

  /**
   * Join existing session
   */
  async joinSession(sessionId: string, userId: string): Promise<Participant | null> {
    const session = this.sessions.get(sessionId);
    if (!session) return null;

    // Check if already a participant
    const existingParticipant = session.participants.find(p => p.userId === userId);
    if (existingParticipant) {
      existingParticipant.status = 'active';
      existingParticipant.lastSeen = new Date();
      return existingParticipant;
    }

    // Check participant limit
    if (session.participants.length >= session.permissions.maxParticipants) {
      throw new Error('Session is full');
    }

    // Add new participant
    const participant: Participant = {
      id: uuidv4(),
      userId,
      name: `User ${userId.slice(0, 8)}`, // In production, get from user service
      email: `${userId}@example.com`,
      role: 'editor',
      status: 'active',
      avatar: '/default-avatar.png',
      joinedAt: new Date(),
      lastSeen: new Date()
    };

    session.participants.push(participant);
    session.lastActivity = new Date();
    
    this.addUserToSession(userId, sessionId);
    
    // Notify other participants
    this.broadcastToSession(sessionId, {
      type: 'participant_joined',
      participant,
      sessionId
    }, userId);

    return participant;
  }

  /**
   * Real-time document collaboration with Operational Transform
   */
  async applyOperation(
    sessionId: string,
    userId: string,
    operation: Omit<Operation, 'id' | 'timestamp' | 'version'>
  ): Promise<boolean> {
    const session = this.sessions.get(sessionId);
    if (!session?.document) return false;

    const participant = session.participants.find(p => p.userId === userId);
    if (!participant || participant.role === 'viewer') return false;

    // Create full operation
    const fullOperation: Operation = {
      ...operation,
      id: uuidv4(),
      timestamp: new Date(),
      version: session.document.version + 1
    };

    // Apply operational transform to resolve conflicts
    const transformedOp = this.transformOperation(fullOperation, session.document.operations);
    
    // Apply to document
    session.document.operations.push(transformedOp);
    session.document.version++;
    session.document.content = this.applyOperationToContent(
      session.document.content,
      transformedOp
    );

    session.lastActivity = new Date();

    // Broadcast to other participants
    this.broadcastToSession(sessionId, {
      type: 'operation_applied',
      operation: transformedOp,
      documentVersion: session.document.version
    }, userId);

    return true;
  }

  /**
   * Cursor and selection synchronization
   */
  updateCursor(sessionId: string, userId: string, cursor: CursorPosition): void {
    const session = this.sessions.get(sessionId);
    if (!session) return;

    const participant = session.participants.find(p => p.userId === userId);
    if (!participant) return;

    participant.cursor = cursor;
    participant.lastSeen = new Date();

    // Broadcast cursor position
    this.broadcastToSession(sessionId, {
      type: 'cursor_updated',
      userId,
      cursor
    }, userId);
  }

  /**
   * Document locking for exclusive editing
   */
  async acquireLock(
    sessionId: string,
    userId: string,
    elementId: string,
    lockType: DocumentLock['type'] = 'exclusive'
  ): Promise<DocumentLock | null> {
    const session = this.sessions.get(sessionId);
    if (!session?.document) return null;

    // Check for existing locks
    const existingLock = session.document.locks.find(l => 
      l.elementId === elementId && l.expiresAt > new Date()
    );

    if (existingLock && existingLock.type === 'exclusive') {
      return null; // Already locked exclusively
    }

    const lock: DocumentLock = {
      id: uuidv4(),
      userId,
      elementId,
      type: lockType,
      acquiredAt: new Date(),
      expiresAt: new Date(Date.now() + 30000) // 30 seconds
    };

    session.document.locks.push(lock);

    // Auto-release lock after timeout
    setTimeout(() => {
      this.releaseLock(sessionId, lock.id);
    }, 30000);

    // Broadcast lock acquisition
    this.broadcastToSession(sessionId, {
      type: 'lock_acquired',
      lock
    });

    return lock;
  }

  /**
   * WebRTC Video/Voice Integration
   */
  async startVideoCall(sessionId: string, userId: string): Promise<boolean> {
    const session = this.sessions.get(sessionId);
    if (!session?.meeting) return false;

    const participant = session.participants.find(p => p.userId === userId);
    if (!participant) return false;

    // Initialize WebRTC signaling for this session
    if (!this.webrtcSignaling.has(sessionId)) {
      this.webrtcSignaling.set(sessionId, {
        offers: new Map(),
        answers: new Map(),
        iceCandidates: new Map()
      });
    }

    session.meeting.type = 'video';
    
    // Broadcast video call start
    this.broadcastToSession(sessionId, {
      type: 'video_call_started',
      initiator: userId,
      sessionId
    });

    return true;
  }

  /**
   * WebRTC Signaling Handler
   */
  handleWebRTCSignaling(sessionId: string, userId: string, signaling: any): void {
    const session = this.sessions.get(sessionId);
    if (!session) return;

    const signalingData = this.webrtcSignaling.get(sessionId);
    if (!signalingData) return;

    switch (signaling.type) {
      case 'offer':
        signalingData.offers.set(userId, signaling.offer);
        this.broadcastToSession(sessionId, {
          type: 'webrtc_offer',
          from: userId,
          offer: signaling.offer
        }, userId);
        break;
        
      case 'answer':
        signalingData.answers.set(userId, signaling.answer);
        this.broadcastToSession(sessionId, {
          type: 'webrtc_answer',
          from: userId,
          answer: signaling.answer
        }, userId);
        break;
        
      case 'ice-candidate':
        if (!signalingData.iceCandidates.has(userId)) {
          signalingData.iceCandidates.set(userId, []);
        }
        signalingData.iceCandidates.get(userId)!.push(signaling.candidate);
        
        this.broadcastToSession(sessionId, {
          type: 'webrtc_ice_candidate',
          from: userId,
          candidate: signaling.candidate
        }, userId);
        break;
    }
  }

  /**
   * Screen sharing capabilities
   */
  async startScreenShare(sessionId: string, userId: string): Promise<boolean> {
    const session = this.sessions.get(sessionId);
    if (!session?.meeting) return false;

    this.broadcastToSession(sessionId, {
      type: 'screen_share_started',
      presenter: userId,
      sessionId
    });

    return true;
  }

  /**
   * AI-powered meeting transcription and insights
   */
  async enableTranscription(sessionId: string): Promise<boolean> {
    const session = this.sessions.get(sessionId);
    if (!session?.meeting) return false;

    session.meeting.settings.transcriptionEnabled = true;

    // In production, integrate with speech-to-text service
    this.broadcastToSession(sessionId, {
      type: 'transcription_enabled',
      sessionId
    });

    return true;
  }

  /**
   * Breakout rooms for team collaboration
   */
  async createBreakoutRoom(
    sessionId: string,
    participants: string[],
    duration: number
  ): Promise<string> {
    const breakoutSessionId = await this.createSession('meeting', participants[0]);
    
    // Move participants to breakout room
    for (const participantId of participants) {
      await this.joinSession(breakoutSessionId.id, participantId);
    }

    // Auto-return to main session after duration
    setTimeout(async () => {
      for (const participantId of participants) {
        await this.joinSession(sessionId, participantId);
      }
    }, duration);

    return breakoutSessionId.id;
  }

  // WebSocket connection management
  addConnection(userId: string, ws: WebSocket): void {
    this.connections.set(userId, ws);
    
    ws.on('close', () => {
      this.removeConnection(userId);
    });

    ws.on('message', (data) => {
      this.handleWebSocketMessage(userId, JSON.parse(data.toString()));
    });
  }

  private handleWebSocketMessage(userId: string, message: any): void {
    switch (message.type) {
      case 'join_session':
        this.joinSession(message.sessionId, userId);
        break;
      case 'apply_operation':
        this.applyOperation(message.sessionId, userId, message.operation);
        break;
      case 'update_cursor':
        this.updateCursor(message.sessionId, userId, message.cursor);
        break;
      case 'webrtc_signaling':
        this.handleWebRTCSignaling(message.sessionId, userId, message.signaling);
        break;
    }
  }

  private removeConnection(userId: string): void {
    this.connections.delete(userId);
    
    // Update user status in all sessions
    const sessionIds = this.userSessions.get(userId) || new Set();
    for (const sessionId of sessionIds) {
      const session = this.sessions.get(sessionId);
      if (session) {
        const participant = session.participants.find(p => p.userId === userId);
        if (participant) {
          participant.status = 'disconnected';
          participant.lastSeen = new Date();
        }
      }
    }
  }

  private broadcastToSession(sessionId: string, message: any, excludeUserId?: string): void {
    const session = this.sessions.get(sessionId);
    if (!session) return;

    session.participants.forEach(participant => {
      if (participant.userId !== excludeUserId) {
        const connection = this.connections.get(participant.userId);
        if (connection && connection.readyState === WebSocket.OPEN) {
          connection.send(JSON.stringify(message));
        }
      }
    });
  }

  private addUserToSession(userId: string, sessionId: string): void {
    if (!this.userSessions.has(userId)) {
      this.userSessions.set(userId, new Set());
    }
    this.userSessions.get(userId)!.add(sessionId);
  }

  private transformOperation(operation: Operation, existingOps: Operation[]): Operation {
    // Simplified operational transform - in production, use a proper OT library
    // This should handle conflict resolution between concurrent operations
    return operation;
  }

  private applyOperationToContent(content: any, operation: Operation): any {
    // Apply operation to content structure
    // This would depend on the document format (Quill Delta, etc.)
    return content;
  }

  private releaseLock(sessionId: string, lockId: string): void {
    const session = this.sessions.get(sessionId);
    if (!session?.document) return;

    const lockIndex = session.document.locks.findIndex(l => l.id === lockId);
    if (lockIndex !== -1) {
      session.document.locks.splice(lockIndex, 1);
      
      this.broadcastToSession(sessionId, {
        type: 'lock_released',
        lockId
      });
    }
  }

  // Public API methods
  getSession(sessionId: string): CollaborationSession | undefined {
    return this.sessions.get(sessionId);
  }

  getUserSessions(userId: string): CollaborationSession[] {
    const sessionIds = this.userSessions.get(userId) || new Set();
    return Array.from(sessionIds)
      .map(id => this.sessions.get(id))
      .filter(Boolean) as CollaborationSession[];
  }

  getActiveParticipants(sessionId: string): Participant[] {
    const session = this.sessions.get(sessionId);
    return session?.participants.filter(p => p.status === 'active') || [];
  }
}

export const collaborationEngine = new RealTimeCollaborationEngine();
```

```
import OpenAI from "openai";
import { storage } from "../storage";
import { logger } from "../utils/logger";
import type { InsertStrategicScenario, StrategicScenario } from "@shared/schema";

// the newest OpenAI model is "gpt-5" which was released August 7, 2025. do not change this unless explicitly requested by the user
const openai = new OpenAI({ apiKey: process.env.OPENAI_API_KEY });

export interface ScenarioAnalysisResult {
  scenarios: Array<{
    title: string;
    description: string;
    probability: number;
    impact: string;
    timeframe: string;
    recommendations: string[];
  }>;
  riskLevel: 'minimal' | 'low' | 'moderate' | 'high' | 'severe';
  urgency: number; // 1-10 scale
  confidence: number; // 0-1 scale
  nextSteps: string[];
}

export interface WorkflowExecutionResult {
  success: boolean;
  scenarioId: string;
  analysisResult: ScenarioAnalysisResult;
  executionTime: number;
  recommendations: string[];
  nextActions: Array<{
    action: string;
    priority: 'low' | 'medium' | 'high' | 'critical';
    deadline: string;
    assignee?: string;
    department?: string;
    estimatedCost?: string;
    dependencies?: string[];
  }>;
  riskMitigation: Array<{
    risk: string;
    likelihood: number;
    impact: string;
    mitigation: string;
    owner: string;
  }>;
  resourceAllocation: {
    requiredBudget: string;
    requiredStaff: string;
    timeline: string;
    criticalResources: string[];
  };
}

export class ScenarioExecutionEngine {
  
  /**
   * Execute a complete scenario workflow from input to actionable recommendations
   */
  async executeScenario(scenarioData: {
    title: string;
    description: string;
    context: string;
    organizationId: string;
    userId: string;
    triggerData?: any;
    // Enhanced organizational context
    industry?: string;
    organizationSize?: string;
    revenueImpact?: string;
    timeframe?: string;
    affectedDepartments?: string[];
    keyStakeholders?: string;
    externalPartners?: string;
    availableResources?: string;
    budgetConstraints?: string;
    teamCapacity?: string;
    previousSimilarEvents?: string;
    existingProcedures?: string;
    successCriteria?: string;
    riskTolerance?: string;
  }): Promise<WorkflowExecutionResult> {
    const startTime = Date.now();
    
    try {
      logger.info('Starting scenario execution', { 
        title: scenarioData.title,
        organizationId: scenarioData.organizationId 
      });

      // 1. Analyze the scenario using AI
      const analysisResult = await this.analyzeScenario(scenarioData);
      
      // 2. Save the scenario to database
      const scenarioRecord = await this.saveScenario(scenarioData, analysisResult);
      
      // 3. Generate actionable recommendations
      const recommendations = await this.generateRecommendations(analysisResult, scenarioData);
      
      // 4. Create next action items with enhanced context
      const nextActions = await this.createActionItems(analysisResult, recommendations, scenarioData);
      
      // 5. Generate risk mitigation strategies
      const riskMitigation = await this.generateRiskMitigation(analysisResult, scenarioData);
      
      // 6. Calculate resource allocation
      const resourceAllocation = await this.calculateResourceAllocation(analysisResult, scenarioData);
      
      // 7. Update organizational learning patterns
      await this.updateLearningPatterns(scenarioData.organizationId, analysisResult);
      
      const executionTime = Date.now() - startTime;
      
      logger.info('Scenario execution completed', {
        scenarioId: scenarioRecord.id,
        executionTime,
        riskLevel: analysisResult.riskLevel
      });

      return {
        success: true,
        scenarioId: scenarioRecord.id,
        analysisResult,
        executionTime,
        recommendations,
        nextActions,
        riskMitigation,
        resourceAllocation
      };

    } catch (error: any) {
      logger.error('Scenario execution failed', { error: error?.message || 'Unknown error', scenarioData });
      throw new Error(`Scenario execution failed: ${error?.message || 'Unknown error'}`);
    }
  }

  /**
   * AI-powered scenario analysis using GPT-5
   */
  private async analyzeScenario(scenarioData: {
    title: string;
    description: string;
    context: string;
  }): Promise<ScenarioAnalysisResult> {
    
    const systemPrompt = `You are an expert organizational intelligence analyst with deep expertise in crisis management and strategic planning. Analyze the given scenario using all available organizational context to provide a comprehensive strategic assessment.

    Focus on:
    1. Multiple potential scenarios with probabilities based on industry and organization size
    2. Risk assessment considering available resources and constraints  
    3. Urgency levels adjusted for timeframe and revenue impact
    4. Strategic recommendations tailored to organization capacity and risk tolerance
    
    Respond with JSON in this exact format:
    {
      "scenarios": [
        {
          "title": "string",
          "description": "string", 
          "probability": number (0-1),
          "impact": "minimal|low|moderate|high|severe",
          "timeframe": "string",
          "recommendations": ["string"]
        }
      ],
      "riskLevel": "minimal|low|moderate|high|severe",
      "urgency": number (1-10),
      "confidence": number (0-1),
      "nextSteps": ["string"]
    }`;

    const enhancedPrompt = this.buildEnhancedPrompt(scenarioData);

    try {
      const response = await openai.chat.completions.create({
        model: "gpt-5", // the newest OpenAI model is "gpt-5" which was released August 7, 2025. do not change this unless explicitly requested by the user
        messages: [
          { role: "system", content: systemPrompt },
          { role: "user", content: enhancedPrompt }
        ],
        response_format: { type: "json_object" },
        temperature: 0.3, // Lower temperature for more consistent analysis
        max_tokens: 2000
      });

      const analysisResult = JSON.parse(response.choices[0].message.content || '{}');
      
      // Validate the response structure
      if (!analysisResult.scenarios || !Array.isArray(analysisResult.scenarios)) {
        throw new Error('Invalid AI response format');
      }

      return analysisResult;

    } catch (error: any) {
      logger.error('AI scenario analysis failed', { error: error?.message || 'Unknown error' });
      throw new Error(`AI analysis failed: ${error?.message || 'Unknown error'}`);
    }
  }

  /**
   * Save scenario to database with analysis results
   */
  private async saveScenario(
    scenarioData: any, 
    analysis: ScenarioAnalysisResult
  ): Promise<StrategicScenario> {
    
    const scenarioToSave: InsertStrategicScenario = {
      name: scenarioData.title,
      description: scenarioData.description,
      organizationId: scenarioData.organizationId,
      createdBy: scenarioData.userId,
      status: 'active',
      impact: analysis.riskLevel,
      type: 'crisis_response'
    };

    return await storage.createStrategicScenario(scenarioToSave);
  }

  /**
   * Generate specific actionable recommendations
   */
  private async generateRecommendations(
    analysis: ScenarioAnalysisResult,
    scenarioData: any
  ): Promise<string[]> {
    
    const recommendationPrompt = `Based on this scenario analysis, generate 5-7 specific, actionable recommendations that an organization can implement immediately:

    Risk Level: ${analysis.riskLevel}
    Urgency: ${analysis.urgency}/10
    Scenarios: ${JSON.stringify(analysis.scenarios)}
    
    Format as a JSON array of strings with specific, actionable recommendations.`;

    try {
      const response = await openai.chat.completions.create({
        model: "gpt-5", // the newest OpenAI model is "gpt-5" which was released August 7, 2025. do not change this unless explicitly requested by the user
        messages: [
          { role: "user", content: recommendationPrompt }
        ],
        response_format: { type: "json_object" },
        temperature: 0.4,
        max_tokens: 1000
      });

      const result = JSON.parse(response.choices[0].message.content || '{}');
      return result.recommendations || analysis.nextSteps;

    } catch (error: any) {
      logger.error('Recommendation generation failed', { error: error?.message || 'Unknown error' });
      return analysis.nextSteps; // Fallback to basic next steps
    }
  }

  /**
   * Create specific action items with priorities and deadlines
   */
  private async createActionItems(
    analysis: ScenarioAnalysisResult,
    recommendations: string[],
    scenarioData: any
  ): Promise<Array<{
    action: string;
    priority: 'low' | 'medium' | 'high' | 'critical';
    deadline: string;
    assignee?: string;
    department?: string;
    estimatedCost?: string;
    dependencies?: string[];
  }>> {
    
    const actions = [];
    const urgencyLevel = analysis.urgency;
    
    for (let i = 0; i < recommendations.length; i++) {
      const recommendation = recommendations[i];
      
      // Determine priority based on urgency and position
      let priority: 'low' | 'medium' | 'high' | 'critical';
      if (urgencyLevel >= 8) priority = 'critical';
      else if (urgencyLevel >= 6) priority = 'high';
      else if (urgencyLevel >= 4) priority = 'medium';
      else priority = 'low';
      
      // If it's the first few recommendations, increase priority
      if (i < 2 && priority !== 'critical') {
        if (priority === 'high') priority = 'critical';
        else if (priority === 'medium') priority = 'high';
        else priority = 'medium';
      }
      
      // Calculate deadline based on priority
      const deadlineDays = priority === 'critical' ? 1 : 
                          priority === 'high' ? 3 :
                          priority === 'medium' ? 7 : 14;
      
      const deadline = new Date();
      deadline.setDate(deadline.getDate() + deadlineDays);
      
      actions.push({
        action: recommendation,
        priority,
        deadline: deadline.toISOString().split('T')[0], // YYYY-MM-DD format
      });
    }
    
    return actions;
  }

  /**
   * Build enhanced prompt with all organizational context
   */
  private buildEnhancedPrompt(scenarioData: any): string {
    return `
SCENARIO ANALYSIS REQUEST

=== Basic Information ===
Title: ${scenarioData.title}
Description: ${scenarioData.description}
Context: ${scenarioData.context}

=== Organizational Profile ===
Industry: ${scenarioData.industry || 'Not specified'}
Organization Size: ${scenarioData.organizationSize || 'Not specified'}
Revenue Impact: ${scenarioData.revenueImpact || 'Not specified'}
Response Timeframe: ${scenarioData.timeframe || 'Not specified'}

=== Affected Areas ===
Departments: ${scenarioData.affectedDepartments?.join(', ') || 'Not specified'}
Key Stakeholders: ${scenarioData.keyStakeholders || 'Not specified'}
External Partners: ${scenarioData.externalPartners || 'None specified'}

=== Resource Constraints ===
Available Resources: ${scenarioData.availableResources || 'Not specified'}
Budget Constraints: ${scenarioData.budgetConstraints || 'Not specified'}
Team Capacity: ${scenarioData.teamCapacity || 'Not specified'}

=== Historical Context ===
Previous Similar Events: ${scenarioData.previousSimilarEvents || 'None'}
Existing Procedures: ${scenarioData.existingProcedures || 'None specified'}

=== Success Criteria ===
Success Definition: ${scenarioData.successCriteria || 'Not specified'}
Risk Tolerance: ${scenarioData.riskTolerance || 'Not specified'}

Please analyze this scenario comprehensively, considering all the organizational context provided above.
    `;
  }

  /**
   * Generate risk mitigation strategies
   */
  private async generateRiskMitigation(analysis: ScenarioAnalysisResult, scenarioData: any) {
    // For MVP, return a structured risk mitigation based on the analysis
    return [
      {
        risk: "Primary scenario impact",
        likelihood: analysis.urgency / 10,
        impact: analysis.riskLevel,
        mitigation: analysis.scenarios[0]?.recommendations[0] || "Implement immediate response plan",
        owner: scenarioData.keyStakeholders?.split(',')[0] || "Executive Leadership"
      },
      {
        risk: "Secondary cascading effects",
        likelihood: 0.6,
        impact: "moderate",
        mitigation: "Monitor affected departments and implement backup procedures",
        owner: "Operations Team"
      }
    ];
  }

  /**
   * Calculate resource allocation
   */
  private async calculateResourceAllocation(analysis: ScenarioAnalysisResult, scenarioData: any) {
    const budgetMap = {
      'unlimited': '$500K+',
      'high': '$100K-500K',
      'moderate': '$50K-100K',
      'limited': '$10K-50K',
      'minimal': '<$10K'
    };

    const timeMap = {
      'immediate': '24 hours',
      'hours': '1-3 days',
      'days': '1-2 weeks',
      'weeks': '2-4 weeks',
      'months': '1-3 months'
    };

    return {
      requiredBudget: budgetMap[scenarioData.budgetConstraints] || 'To be determined',
      requiredStaff: scenarioData.affectedDepartments?.join(', ') || 'Cross-functional team',
      timeline: timeMap[scenarioData.timeframe] || 'To be determined',
      criticalResources: scenarioData.availableResources?.split(',').slice(0, 3) || ['Executive approval', 'Technical team', 'Communication channels']
    };
  }

  /**
   * Assign department based on action content
   */
  private assignDepartment(action: string, affectedDepartments?: string[]): string {
    const actionLower = action.toLowerCase();
    
    if (actionLower.includes('communication') || actionLower.includes('notify')) return 'Marketing';
    if (actionLower.includes('finance') || actionLower.includes('budget')) return 'Finance';
    if (actionLower.includes('legal') || actionLower.includes('compliance')) return 'Legal';
    if (actionLower.includes('technical') || actionLower.includes('system')) return 'IT/Technology';
    if (actionLower.includes('hr') || actionLower.includes('staff')) return 'Human Resources';
    
    return affectedDepartments?.[0] || 'Executive Leadership';
  }

  /**
   * Estimate cost based on action and budget constraints
   */
  private estimateCost(action: string, budgetConstraints?: string): string {
    const actionLower = action.toLowerCase();
    
    if (actionLower.includes('emergency') || actionLower.includes('immediate')) {
      return budgetConstraints === 'minimal' ? '$1K-5K' : '$5K-25K';
    }
    if (actionLower.includes('system') || actionLower.includes('technology')) {
      return budgetConstraints === 'minimal' ? '$2K-10K' : '$10K-50K';
    }
    if (actionLower.includes('consultant') || actionLower.includes('external')) {
      return budgetConstraints === 'minimal' ? '$5K-15K' : '$15K-75K';
    }
    
    return budgetConstraints === 'minimal' ? '<$1K' : '$1K-10K';
  }

  /**
   * Identify dependencies between actions
   */
  private identifyDependencies(action: string, allRecommendations: string[]): string[] {
    const actionLower = action.toLowerCase();
    const dependencies: string[] = [];
    
    // Look for common dependency patterns
    if (actionLower.includes('implement') || actionLower.includes('deploy')) {
      const planningAction = allRecommendations.find(r => r.toLowerCase().includes('plan') || r.toLowerCase().includes('assess'));
      if (planningAction) dependencies.push(planningAction);
    }
    
    if (actionLower.includes('communicate') || actionLower.includes('notify')) {
      const decisionAction = allRecommendations.find(r => r.toLowerCase().includes('decide') || r.toLowerCase().includes('approve'));
      if (decisionAction) dependencies.push(decisionAction);
    }
    
    return dependencies.slice(0, 2); // Max 2 dependencies for clarity
  }

  /**
   * Update organizational learning patterns based on scenario execution
   */
  private async updateLearningPatterns(
    organizationId: string,
    analysis: ScenarioAnalysisResult
  ): Promise<void> {
    try {
      // This would update the AI learning patterns for the organization
      // For now, we'll implement a basic version
      await storage.createLearningPattern({
        organizationId,
        title: 'Scenario Analysis Pattern',
        description: `Learning pattern from scenario analysis with ${analysis.riskLevel} risk level`,
        patternType: 'scenario_analysis',
        confidence: analysis.confidence
      });
    } catch (error: any) {
      logger.error('Failed to update learning patterns', { error: error?.message || 'Unknown error', organizationId });
      // Don't throw - this is a secondary operation
    }
  }

  /**
   * Helper method to map urgency to priority enum
   */
  private mapUrgencyToPriority(urgency: number): 'low' | 'medium' | 'high' | 'critical' {
    if (urgency >= 8) return 'critical';
    if (urgency >= 6) return 'high';
    if (urgency >= 4) return 'medium';
    return 'low';
  }

  /**
   * Extract adaptability factors from analysis
   */
  private extractAdaptabilityFactors(analysis: ScenarioAnalysisResult): string[] {
    const factors = [];
    
    if (analysis.urgency > 7) factors.push('high_urgency_response');
    if (analysis.confidence > 0.8) factors.push('high_confidence_analysis');
    if (analysis.scenarios.length > 3) factors.push('multiple_scenario_planning');
    if (analysis.riskLevel === 'high' || analysis.riskLevel === 'severe') {
      factors.push('high_risk_mitigation');
    }
    
    return factors;
  }
}

// Export singleton instance
export const scenarioEngine = new ScenarioExecutionEngine();
```
