/**
 * Viral Growth Engine
 * Network effects, referral systems, and addiction mechanisms for market domination
 */

export interface ViralCampaign {
  id: string;
  name: string;
  type: 'referral' | 'collaboration' | 'content_sharing' | 'achievement' | 'competition';
  status: 'active' | 'paused' | 'ended';
  startDate: Date;
  endDate?: Date;
  
  // Targeting
  targetAudience: {
    organizationSizes: string[];
    industries: string[];
    roles: string[];
    regions: string[];
  };
  
  // Mechanics
  mechanics: ViralMechanics;
  rewards: ViralReward[];
  
  // Performance
  metrics: {
    participants: number;
    referrals: number;
    conversions: number;
    viralCoefficient: number;
    cycleTime: number; // hours
  };
  
  settings: {
    maxRewards: number;
    cooldownPeriod: number; // hours
    requirementThreshold: number;
  };
}

export interface ViralMechanics {
  sharePoints: number;
  referralBonus: number;
  collaborationMultiplier: number;
  achievementUnlocks: string[];
  leaderboardEnabled: boolean;
  gamificationEnabled: boolean;
}

export interface ViralReward {
  id: string;
  type: 'credits' | 'features' | 'certification' | 'recognition' | 'merchandise';
  value: string | number;
  description: string;
  requirements: {
    referrals?: number;
    collaborations?: number;
    achievements?: string[];
    timeframe?: number; // days
  };
  rarity: 'common' | 'rare' | 'epic' | 'legendary';
  claimable: boolean;
}

export interface UserEngagement {
  userId: string;
  organizationId: string;
  
  // Viral metrics
  viralScore: number;
  referralCount: number;
  influenceRadius: number;
  networkPower: number;
  
  // Engagement patterns
  streakDays: number;
  lastActive: Date;
  sessionsThisWeek: number;
  avgSessionDuration: number;
  
  // Social behaviors
  collaborations: number;
  sharedContent: number;
  mentorships: number;
  communityContributions: number;
  
  // Achievements
  achievements: Achievement[];
  level: number;
  experiencePoints: number;
  
  // Network
  connections: string[];
  referrals: UserReferral[];
  
  // Addiction indicators
  addictionScore: number;
  habitStrength: number;
  dependencyLevel: 'low' | 'medium' | 'high' | 'critical';
}

export interface Achievement {
  id: string;
  title: string;
  description: string;
  category: 'referral' | 'collaboration' | 'usage' | 'expertise' | 'leadership';
  tier: 'bronze' | 'silver' | 'gold' | 'platinum' | 'diamond';
  unlockedAt: Date;
  shareableContent: {
    image: string;
    text: string;
    hashtags: string[];
  };
}

export interface UserReferral {
  id: string;
  referrerId: string;
  refereeId: string;
  status: 'pending' | 'converted' | 'expired';
  campaignId: string;
  referralCode: string;
  createdAt: Date;
  convertedAt?: Date;
  value: number; // Revenue generated
  rewards: {
    referrer: ViralReward[];
    referee: ViralReward[];
  };
}

export interface NetworkEffect {
  organizationId: string;
  networkSize: number;
  connectionDensity: number;
  influencers: string[];
  communityHealth: number;
  
  // Cross-organization collaboration
  partnerOrganizations: string[];
  sharedProjects: number;
  crossPollination: number;
  
  // Network value
  metcalfeValue: number; // Network value = n^2
  reedValue: number;     // Network value = 2^n for group-forming networks
}

export class ViralGrowthEngine {
  private campaigns: Map<string, ViralCampaign> = new Map();
  private userEngagements: Map<string, UserEngagement> = new Map();
  private networkEffects: Map<string, NetworkEffect> = new Map();
  
  constructor() {
    this.initializeViralCampaigns();
    this.setupAddictionMechanisms();
  }

  /**
   * Referral system with exponential rewards
   */
  async createReferralCampaign(
    name: string,
    rewards: ViralReward[],
    targetAudience: any
  ): Promise<ViralCampaign> {
    const campaign: ViralCampaign = {
      id: this.generateId(),
      name,
      type: 'referral',
      status: 'active',
      startDate: new Date(),
      targetAudience,
      mechanics: {
        sharePoints: 100,
        referralBonus: 500,
        collaborationMultiplier: 1.5,
        achievementUnlocks: ['super_referrer', 'network_builder'],
        leaderboardEnabled: true,
        gamificationEnabled: true
      },
      rewards,
      metrics: {
        participants: 0,
        referrals: 0,
        conversions: 0,
        viralCoefficient: 0,
        cycleTime: 0
      },
      settings: {
        maxRewards: 10000,
        cooldownPeriod: 24,
        requirementThreshold: 5
      }
    };

    this.campaigns.set(campaign.id, campaign);
    return campaign;
  }

  /**
   * Generate personalized referral codes and tracking
   */
  generateReferralCode(userId: string, campaignId: string): string {
    const code = `${userId.slice(0, 4).toUpperCase()}${campaignId.slice(0, 4).toUpperCase()}${Date.now().toString(36).toUpperCase()}`;
    
    // Store code mapping for tracking
    this.storeReferralCode(code, userId, campaignId);
    
    return code;
  }

  /**
   * Process referral conversion and reward distribution
   */
  async processReferral(
    referralCode: string,
    newUserId: string,
    organizationId: string
  ): Promise<{ success: boolean; rewards: any[] }> {
    const referralData = await this.getReferralData(referralCode);
    if (!referralData) {
      return { success: false, rewards: [] };
    }

    const { referrerId, campaignId } = referralData;
    const campaign = this.campaigns.get(campaignId);
    if (!campaign || campaign.status !== 'active') {
      return { success: false, rewards: [] };
    }

    // Create referral record
    const referral: UserReferral = {
      id: this.generateId(),
      referrerId,
      refereeId: newUserId,
      status: 'converted',
      campaignId,
      referralCode,
      createdAt: new Date(),
      convertedAt: new Date(),
      value: 0, // Will be updated based on subscription
      rewards: {
        referrer: [],
        referee: []
      }
    };

    // Calculate and distribute rewards
    const referrerRewards = await this.calculateReferrerRewards(referrerId, campaign);
    const refereeRewards = await this.calculateRefereeRewards(newUserId, campaign);

    referral.rewards = {
      referrer: referrerRewards,
      referee: refereeRewards
    };

    // Update user engagement metrics
    await this.updateEngagementFromReferral(referrerId, newUserId, referral);

    // Update campaign metrics
    campaign.metrics.referrals++;
    campaign.metrics.conversions++;
    campaign.metrics.viralCoefficient = this.calculateViralCoefficient(campaign);

    // Check for achievement unlocks
    await this.checkAchievements(referrerId);
    
    // Store referral
    await this.storeReferral(referral);

    return { 
      success: true, 
      rewards: [...referrerRewards, ...refereeRewards] 
    };
  }

  /**
   * Network effects engine - create value through connections
   */
  async enhanceNetworkEffects(organizationId: string): Promise<void> {
    let networkEffect = this.networkEffects.get(organizationId);
    
    if (!networkEffect) {
      networkEffect = {
        organizationId,
        networkSize: 1,
        connectionDensity: 0,
        influencers: [],
        communityHealth: 0,
        partnerOrganizations: [],
        sharedProjects: 0,
        crossPollination: 0,
        metcalfeValue: 1,
        reedValue: 2
      };
    }

    // Calculate network metrics
    const users = await this.getOrganizationUsers(organizationId);
    networkEffect.networkSize = users.length;
    networkEffect.connectionDensity = this.calculateConnectionDensity(users);
    networkEffect.communityHealth = this.calculateCommunityHealth(organizationId);
    
    // Calculate network value (Metcalfe's and Reed's laws)
    networkEffect.metcalfeValue = Math.pow(networkEffect.networkSize, 2);
    networkEffect.reedValue = Math.pow(2, networkEffect.networkSize);

    // Identify influencers
    networkEffect.influencers = this.identifyInfluencers(users);

    this.networkEffects.set(organizationId, networkEffect);

    // Trigger network effect rewards
    await this.distributeNetworkRewards(organizationId, networkEffect);
  }

  /**
   * Addiction mechanics - create habit-forming engagement
   */
  async updateAddictionMetrics(userId: string, sessionData: any): Promise<void> {
    let engagement = this.userEngagements.get(userId);
    
    if (!engagement) {
      engagement = this.createInitialEngagement(userId);
    }

    // Update engagement patterns
    engagement.lastActive = new Date();
    engagement.sessionsThisWeek++;
    engagement.avgSessionDuration = this.calculateAverageSessionDuration(
      engagement.avgSessionDuration,
      sessionData.duration
    );

    // Calculate streak
    engagement.streakDays = this.calculateStreak(engagement.lastActive);

    // Update addiction indicators
    engagement.addictionScore = this.calculateAddictionScore(engagement);
    engagement.habitStrength = this.calculateHabitStrength(engagement);
    engagement.dependencyLevel = this.calculateDependencyLevel(engagement.addictionScore);

    // Trigger addiction rewards
    if (engagement.addictionScore > 80) {
      await this.triggerAddictionRewards(userId, engagement);
    }

    this.userEngagements.set(userId, engagement);
  }

  /**
   * Social proof and FOMO mechanisms
   */
  async createSocialProofEvents(
    type: 'milestone' | 'success_story' | 'urgency' | 'popularity',
    data: any
  ): Promise<void> {
    const event = {
      id: this.generateId(),
      type,
      data,
      timestamp: new Date(),
      urgency: this.calculateUrgency(type, data),
      shareability: this.calculateShareability(data)
    };

    // Broadcast to relevant users
    await this.broadcastSocialProof(event);

    // Create urgency notifications
    if (event.urgency > 0.7) {
      await this.createUrgencyNotifications(event);
    }
  }

  /**
   * Collaborative addiction - make users dependent on each other
   */
  async createCollaborativeDependency(

  ): Promise<void> {

    };

      'referrals',

    ];

    for (const category of categories) {

  private calculateAddictionScore(engagement: UserEngagement): number {
    // Complex algorithm considering multiple addiction factors
    const streakWeight = Math.min(engagement.streakDays * 2, 40);
    const frequencyWeight = Math.min(engagement.sessionsThisWeek * 5, 30);
    const durationWeight = Math.min(engagement.avgSessionDuration / 60 * 3, 20);
    const socialWeight = Math.min(engagement.collaborations * 2, 10);
    
    return streakWeight + frequencyWeight + durationWeight + socialWeight;
  }

  private calculateDependencyLevel(score: number): 'low' | 'medium' | 'high' | 'critical' {
    if (score >= 85) return 'critical';
    if (score >= 65) return 'high';
    if (score >= 40) return 'medium';
    return 'low';
  }

export class DatabaseStorage implements IStorage {
  // User operations (required for auth)
  async getUser(id: string): Promise<User | undefined> {
    const [user] = await db.select().from(users).where(eq(users.id, id));
    return user;
  }

  async upsertUser(userData: UpsertUser): Promise<User> {
    const [user] = await db
      .insert(users)
      .values(userData)
      .onConflictDoUpdate({
        target: users.id,
        set: {
          ...userData,
          updatedAt: new Date(),
        },
      })
      .returning();
    return user;
  }

  // Organization operations
  async createOrganization(org: InsertOrganization): Promise<Organization> {
    const [organization] = await db.insert(organizations).values(org).returning();
    return organization;
  }

  async getOrganization(id: string): Promise<Organization | undefined> {
    const [org] = await db.select().from(organizations).where(eq(organizations.id, id));
    return org;
  }

  async getAllOrganizations(): Promise<Organization[]> {
    return await db.select().from(organizations).orderBy(desc(organizations.createdAt));
  }

  async getOrganizationByDomain(domain: string): Promise<Organization | undefined> {
    const [org] = await db.select().from(organizations).where(eq(organizations.domain, domain));
    return org;
  }

  async updateOrganization(id: string, updates: Partial<InsertOrganization>): Promise<Organization> {
    const [org] = await db
      .update(organizations)
      .set({ ...updates, updatedAt: new Date() })
      .where(eq(organizations.id, id))
      .returning();
    return org;
  }

  // Project operations
  async createProject(project: InsertProject): Promise<Project> {
    const [proj] = await db.insert(projects).values(project).returning();
    return proj;
  }

  async getProject(id: string): Promise<Project | undefined> {
    const [project] = await db.select().from(projects).where(eq(projects.id, id));
    return project;
  }

  async getProjectsByOrganization(orgId: string): Promise<Project[]> {
    return await db
      .select()
      .from(projects)
      .where(eq(projects.organizationId, orgId))
      .orderBy(desc(projects.createdAt));
  }

  async updateProject(id: string, updates: Partial<InsertProject>): Promise<Project> {
    const [project] = await db
      .update(projects)
      .set({ ...updates, updatedAt: new Date() })
      .where(eq(projects.id, id))
      .returning();
    return project;
  }

  async deleteProject(id: string): Promise<void> {
    await db.delete(projects).where(eq(projects.id, id));
  }

  // Strategic scenario operations
  async createStrategicScenario(scenario: InsertStrategicScenario): Promise<StrategicScenario> {
    const [scen] = await db.insert(strategicScenarios).values(scenario).returning();
    return scen;
  }

  async getStrategicScenario(id: string): Promise<StrategicScenario | undefined> {
    const [scenario] = await db.select().from(strategicScenarios).where(eq(strategicScenarios.id, id));
    return scenario;
  }

  async getStrategicScenarios(orgId: string): Promise<StrategicScenario[]> {
    return await db
      .select()
      .from(strategicScenarios)
      .where(eq(strategicScenarios.organizationId, orgId))
      .orderBy(desc(strategicScenarios.createdAt));
  }

  async updateStrategicScenario(id: string, updates: Partial<InsertStrategicScenario>): Promise<StrategicScenario | null> {
    const [scenario] = await db
      .update(strategicScenarios)
      .set({ ...updates, updatedAt: new Date() })
      .where(eq(strategicScenarios.id, id))
      .returning();
    return scenario || null;
  }

  async triggerScenario(id: string): Promise<void> {
    await db
      .update(strategicScenarios)
      .set({ 
        status: 'active',
        lastTriggered: new Date(),
        updatedAt: new Date()
      })
      .where(eq(strategicScenarios.id, id));
  }

  // Pulse metrics operations
  async recordPulseMetric(metric: InsertPulseMetric): Promise<PulseMetric> {
    const [pulseMetric] = await db.insert(pulseMetrics).values(metric).returning();
    return pulseMetric;
  }

  async getPulseMetrics(orgId: string, timeRange?: { start: Date; end: Date }): Promise<PulseMetric[]> {
    let whereConditions = eq(pulseMetrics.organizationId, orgId);
    
    if (timeRange) {
      whereConditions = and(
        whereConditions,
        gte(pulseMetrics.timestamp, timeRange.start),
        lte(pulseMetrics.timestamp, timeRange.end)
      )!;
    }
    
    return await db
      .select()
      .from(pulseMetrics)
      .where(whereConditions)
      .orderBy(desc(pulseMetrics.timestamp));
  }

  async getPulseMetricsByType(orgId: string, metricType: string): Promise<PulseMetric[]> {
    return await db
      .select()
      .from(pulseMetrics)
      .where(
        and(
          eq(pulseMetrics.organizationId, orgId),
          eq(pulseMetrics.metricType, metricType)
        )
      )
      .orderBy(desc(pulseMetrics.timestamp));
  }

  // Flux adaptation operations
  async recordFluxAdaptation(adaptation: InsertFluxAdaptation): Promise<FluxAdaptation> {
    const [fluxAdaptation] = await db.insert(fluxAdaptations).values(adaptation).returning();
    return fluxAdaptation;
  }

  async getFluxAdaptations(orgId: string): Promise<FluxAdaptation[]> {
    return await db
      .select()
      .from(fluxAdaptations)
      .where(eq(fluxAdaptations.organizationId, orgId))
      .orderBy(desc(fluxAdaptations.implementedAt));
  }

  async getFluxAdaptationsByProject(projectId: string): Promise<FluxAdaptation[]> {
    return await db
      .select()
      .from(fluxAdaptations)
      .where(eq(fluxAdaptations.projectId, projectId))
      .orderBy(desc(fluxAdaptations.implementedAt));
  }

  // Prism insight operations
  async createPrismInsight(insight: InsertPrismInsight): Promise<PrismInsight> {
    const [prismInsight] = await db.insert(prismInsights).values(insight).returning();
    return prismInsight;
  }

  async getPrismInsights(orgId: string): Promise<PrismInsight[]> {
    return await db
      .select()
      .from(prismInsights)
      .where(eq(prismInsights.organizationId, orgId))
      .orderBy(desc(prismInsights.discoveredAt));
  }

  async updatePrismInsightStatus(id: string, status: string): Promise<PrismInsight> {
    const [insight] = await db
      .update(prismInsights)
      .set({ status, reviewedAt: new Date() })
      .where(eq(prismInsights.id, id))
      .returning();
    return insight;
  }

  // Echo cultural metrics operations
  async recordEchoCulturalMetric(metric: InsertEchoCulturalMetric): Promise<EchoCulturalMetric> {
    const [echoCulturalMetric] = await db.insert(echoCulturalMetrics).values(metric).returning();
    return echoCulturalMetric;
  }

  async getEchoCulturalMetrics(orgId: string): Promise<EchoCulturalMetric[]> {
    return await db
      .select()
      .from(echoCulturalMetrics)
      .where(eq(echoCulturalMetrics.organizationId, orgId))
      .orderBy(desc(echoCulturalMetrics.measuredAt));
  }

  async getCulturalTrends(orgId: string, dimension: string): Promise<EchoCulturalMetric[]> {
    return await db
      .select()
      .from(echoCulturalMetrics)
      .where(
        and(
          eq(echoCulturalMetrics.organizationId, orgId),
          eq(echoCulturalMetrics.dimension, dimension)
        )
      )
      .orderBy(desc(echoCulturalMetrics.measuredAt))
      .limit(12); // Last 12 measurements for trends
  }

  // Nova innovation operations
  async createNovaInnovation(innovation: InsertNovaInnovation): Promise<NovaInnovation> {
    const [novaInnovation] = await db.insert(novaInnovations).values(innovation).returning();
    return novaInnovation;
  }

  async getNovaInnovations(orgId: string): Promise<NovaInnovation[]> {
    return await db
      .select()
      .from(novaInnovations)
      .where(eq(novaInnovations.organizationId, orgId))
      .orderBy(desc(novaInnovations.createdAt));
  }

  async updateNovaInnovation(id: string, updates: Partial<InsertNovaInnovation>): Promise<NovaInnovation> {
    const [innovation] = await db
      .update(novaInnovations)
      .set({ ...updates, updatedAt: new Date() })
      .where(eq(novaInnovations.id, id))
      .returning();
    return innovation;
  }

  // Intelligence report operations
  async createIntelligenceReport(report: InsertIntelligenceReport): Promise<IntelligenceReport> {
    const [intelligenceReport] = await db.insert(intelligenceReports).values(report).returning();
    return intelligenceReport;
  }

  async getIntelligenceReports(orgId: string): Promise<IntelligenceReport[]> {
    return await db
      .select()
      .from(intelligenceReports)
      .where(eq(intelligenceReports.organizationId, orgId))
      .orderBy(desc(intelligenceReports.generatedAt));
  }

  async getLatestReports(orgId: string, limit: number = 5): Promise<IntelligenceReport[]> {
    return await db

  // Analytics operations
  async recordModuleUsage(orgId: string, userId: string, module: string, feature: string, action: string): Promise<void> {
    await db.insert(moduleUsageAnalytics).values({
      organizationId: orgId,
      userId,

      feature,
      action,
      timestamp: new Date()
    });
  }

  async getOrganizationDashboard(orgId: string): Promise<any> {
    // Get organization overview
    const org = await this.getOrganization(orgId);
    
    // Get project counts by status
    const projectStats = await db
      .select({
        status: projects.status,
        count: count()
      })
      .from(projects)
      .where(eq(projects.organizationId, orgId))
      .groupBy(projects.status);

    // Get recent insights
    const recentInsights = await db
      .select()
      .from(prismInsights)
      .where(eq(prismInsights.organizationId, orgId))
      .orderBy(desc(prismInsights.discoveredAt))
      .limit(5);

    // Get latest cultural metrics
    const culturalHealth = await db
      .select()
      .from(echoCulturalMetrics)
      .where(eq(echoCulturalMetrics.organizationId, orgId))
      .orderBy(desc(echoCulturalMetrics.measuredAt))
      .limit(10);

    // Get active innovations
    const activeInnovations = await db
      .select()
      .from(novaInnovations)
      .where(
        and(
          eq(novaInnovations.organizationId, orgId),
          eq(novaInnovations.status, 'active')
        )
      );

    return {
      organization: org,
      projectStats,
      recentInsights,
      culturalHealth,
      activeInnovations,
      timestamp: new Date()
    };
  }

      return 'stable';

import { Queue, Worker, Job } from 'bullmq';
import IORedis from 'ioredis';
import { logger } from './logger.js';

// Redis connection configuration - make Redis optional for development
let redisConnection: IORedis | null = null;

try {
  const redisConfig = {
    host: process.env.REDIS_HOST || 'localhost',
    port: parseInt(process.env.REDIS_PORT || '6379'),
    password: process.env.REDIS_PASSWORD,
    retryDelayOnFailover: 100,
    enableReadyCheck: false,
    maxRetriesPerRequest: null,
    connectTimeout: 5000, // 5 second timeout
    lazyConnect: true // Don't connect immediately
  };

  redisConnection = new IORedis(redisConfig);

  redisConnection.on('error', (error) => {
    logger.warn('Redis connection failed, background jobs will be disabled', { error: error.message });
    redisConnection = null;
  });

  redisConnection.on('connect', () => {
    logger.info('Redis connection established for background jobs');
  });

} catch (error) {
  logger.warn('Redis initialization failed, running without background jobs', { error });
  redisConnection = null;
}

export { redisConnection };

// Background job queues - only create if Redis is available
export const queues = redisConnection ? {
  aiAnalysis: new Queue('ai-analysis', { connection: redisConnection }),
  dataIngestion: new Queue('data-ingestion', { connection: redisConnection }),
  notifications: new Queue('notifications', { connection: redisConnection }),
  reports: new Queue('reports', { connection: redisConnection }),
  proactiveInsights: new Queue('proactive-insights', { connection: redisConnection })
} : null;

// Job types and interfaces
export interface AIAnalysisJobData {
  organizationId: string;
  scenarioId: string;
  analysisType: 'scenario_evaluation' | 'risk_assessment' | 'recommendation_generation';
  parameters: Record<string, any>;
}

export interface DataIngestionJobData {
  organizationId: string;
  source: 'salesforce' | 'slack' | 'github' | 'custom';
  connector: string;
  config: Record<string, any>;
}

export interface NotificationJobData {

  subject: string;
  content: string;
  priority: 'low' | 'medium' | 'high' | 'critical';

// Job processing workers
export class JobProcessorService {
  private workers: Worker[] = [];

  constructor() {
    this.initializeWorkers();
  }

  private initializeWorkers() {
    if (!redisConnection || !queues) {
      logger.info('Background job workers disabled - Redis not available');
      return;
    }

    // AI Analysis Worker
    const aiAnalysisWorker = new Worker('ai-analysis', async (job: Job<AIAnalysisJobData>) => {
      logger.info('Processing AI analysis job', {
        jobId: job.id,
        organizationId: job.data.organizationId,
        analysisType: job.data.analysisType
      });

      try {
        const startTime = Date.now();
        
        // Simulate AI analysis processing
        await this.processAIAnalysis(job.data);
        
        const duration = Date.now() - startTime;
        logger.performance('AI analysis completed', duration, {
          jobId: job.id,
          organizationId: job.data.organizationId,
          analysisType: job.data.analysisType
        });

        return { status: 'completed', duration };
      } catch (error) {
        logger.error('AI analysis job failed', error as Error, {
          jobId: job.id,
          organizationId: job.data.organizationId
        });
        throw error;
      }
    }, { connection: redisConnection });

    // Data Ingestion Worker
    const dataIngestionWorker = new Worker('data-ingestion', async (job: Job<DataIngestionJobData>) => {
      logger.info('Processing data ingestion job', {
        jobId: job.id,
        organizationId: job.data.organizationId,
        source: job.data.source
      });

      try {
        const startTime = Date.now();
        
        await this.processDataIngestion(job.data);
        
        const duration = Date.now() - startTime;
        logger.performance('Data ingestion completed', duration, {
          jobId: job.id,
          organizationId: job.data.organizationId,
          source: job.data.source
        });

        return { status: 'completed', duration };
      } catch (error) {
        logger.error('Data ingestion job failed', error as Error, {
          jobId: job.id,
          organizationId: job.data.organizationId
        });
        throw error;
      }
    }, { connection: redisConnection });

    // Notifications Worker
    const notificationsWorker = new Worker('notifications', async (job: Job<NotificationJobData>) => {
      logger.info('Processing notification job', {
        jobId: job.id,
        type: job.data.type,
        priority: job.data.priority,
        recipientCount: job.data.recipients.length
      });

      try {
        await this.processNotification(job.data);
        return { status: 'sent', recipients: job.data.recipients.length };
      } catch (error) {
        logger.error('Notification job failed', error as Error, {
          jobId: job.id,
          type: job.data.type
        });
        throw error;
      }
    }, { connection: redisConnection });

    // Reports Worker  
    const reportsWorker = new Worker('reports', async (job: Job<ReportJobData>) => {
      logger.info('Processing report generation job', {
        jobId: job.id,
        organizationId: job.data.organizationId,
        reportType: job.data.reportType,
        format: job.data.format
      });

      try {
        const startTime = Date.now();
        
        const reportResult = await this.processReportGeneration(job.data);
        
        const duration = Date.now() - startTime;
        logger.performance('Report generation completed', duration, {
          jobId: job.id,
          organizationId: job.data.organizationId,
          reportType: job.data.reportType
        });

        return reportResult;
      } catch (error) {
        logger.error('Report generation job failed', error as Error, {
          jobId: job.id,
          organizationId: job.data.organizationId
        });
        throw error;
      }
    }, { connection: redisConnection });

    // Proactive Insights Worker
    const proactiveInsightsWorker = new Worker('proactive-insights', async (job: Job<ProactiveInsightsJobData>) => {
      logger.info('Processing proactive insights job', {
        jobId: job.id,
        organizationId: job.data.organizationId,
        patternCount: job.data.patterns.length
      });

      try {
        const insights = await this.processProactiveInsights(job.data);
        
        if (insights.length > 0) {
          logger.info('Proactive insights generated', {
            jobId: job.id,
            organizationId: job.data.organizationId,
            insightCount: insights.length
          });
        }

        return { insights, count: insights.length };
      } catch (error) {
        logger.error('Proactive insights job failed', error as Error, {
          jobId: job.id,
          organizationId: job.data.organizationId
        });
        throw error;
      }
    }, { connection: redisConnection });

    this.workers = [
      aiAnalysisWorker,
      dataIngestionWorker, 
      notificationsWorker,
      reportsWorker,
      proactiveInsightsWorker
    ];

    // Set up error handling for all workers
    this.workers.forEach(worker => {
      worker.on('completed', (job) => {
        logger.info('Job completed successfully', {
          queue: worker.name,
          jobId: job.id,
          processingTime: job.processedOn ? Date.now() - job.processedOn : 0
        });
      });

      worker.on('failed', (job, err) => {
        logger.error('Job failed', err, {
          queue: worker.name,
          jobId: job?.id,
          attempts: job?.attemptsMade
        });
      });

      worker.on('error', (error) => {
        logger.error('Worker error', error, { queue: worker.name });
      });
    });
  }

  private async processAIAnalysis(data: AIAnalysisJobData) {
    // Simulate AI processing with realistic delays
    await new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, 2000 + Math.random() * 3000));
    
    // Here would be actual AI analysis logic
    logger.debug('AI analysis processing completed', {
      organizationId: data.organizationId,
      analysisType: data.analysisType
    });
  }

  private async processDataIngestion(data: DataIngestionJobData) {
    // Simulate data ingestion processing
    await new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, 1000 + Math.random() * 2000));
    
    // Here would be actual connector logic
    logger.debug('Data ingestion processing completed', {
      organizationId: data.organizationId,
      source: data.source
    });
  }

  private async processNotification(data: NotificationJobData) {
    // Simulate notification sending
    await new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, 500 + Math.random() * 1000));
    
    // Here would be actual notification logic (email, Slack, webhooks)
    logger.debug('Notification processing completed', {
      type: data.type,
      recipientCount: data.recipients.length
    });
  }

  private async processReportGeneration(data: ReportJobData) {
    // Simulate report generation
    await new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, 5000 + Math.random() * 5000));
    
    // Here would be actual report generation logic
    const reportResult = {
      status: 'generated',
      filename: `report_${data.organizationId}_${Date.now()}.${data.format}`,
      size: Math.floor(Math.random() * 1000000) + 100000 // Simulate file size
    };

    logger.debug('Report generation completed', {
      organizationId: data.organizationId,
      reportType: data.reportType,
      filename: reportResult.filename
    });

    return reportResult;
  }

  private async processProactiveInsights(data: ProactiveInsightsJobData) {
    // Simulate proactive insights analysis
    await new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, 3000 + Math.random() * 4000));
    
    // Simulate generating insights based on patterns
    const insights = data.patterns.map(pattern => ({
      patternId: pattern.id,
      triggered: Math.random() > 0.7, // 30% chance of triggering
      confidence: 0.7 + Math.random() * 0.3,
      recommendation: `Action recommended for pattern ${pattern.id}`,
      urgency: Math.random() > 0.8 ? 'high' : Math.random() > 0.5 ? 'medium' : 'low'
    })).filter(insight => insight.triggered);

    return insights;
  }

  // Job scheduling utilities
  static async scheduleRecurringJobs() {
    if (!queues) {
      logger.info('Recurring jobs not scheduled - Redis not available');
      return;
    }

    // Schedule proactive insights analysis every hour
    await queues.proactiveInsights.add(
      'hourly-insights',
      { 
        organizationId: '*', // Process for all organizations
        patterns: [] // Will be populated from database
      },
      {
        repeat: { every: 60 * 60 * 1000 }, // Every hour
        removeOnComplete: 10,
        removeOnFail: 5
      }
    );

    logger.info('Recurring background jobs scheduled');
  }

  // Graceful shutdown
  async shutdown() {
    logger.info('Shutting down background job workers');
    
    await Promise.all(this.workers.map(worker => worker.close()));
    if (redisConnection) {
      await redisConnection.disconnect();
    }
    
    logger.info('Background job workers shutdown complete');
  }
}

// Job queue utilities for easy access from routes
export const jobUtils = {
  scheduleAIAnalysis: async (data: AIAnalysisJobData, delay?: number) => {
    if (!queues) {
      logger.warn('Background jobs not available - Redis not connected');
      return { id: 'mock_job_' + Date.now() };
    }
    return await queues.aiAnalysis.add('ai-analysis', data, { 
      delay,
      attempts: 3,
      backoff: { type: 'exponential', delay: 2000 }
    });
  },

  scheduleDataIngestion: async (data: DataIngestionJobData, delay?: number) => {
    if (!queues) {
      logger.warn('Background jobs not available - Redis not connected');
      return { id: 'mock_job_' + Date.now() };
    }
    return await queues.dataIngestion.add('data-ingestion', data, {
      delay,
      attempts: 5,
      backoff: { type: 'exponential', delay: 2000 }
    });
  },

  sendNotification: async (data: NotificationJobData, priority: 'low' | 'medium' | 'high' | 'critical' = 'medium') => {
    if (!queues) {
      logger.info('Notification would be sent (background jobs disabled)', { data, priority });
      return { id: 'mock_notification_' + Date.now() };
    }
    const priorityMap = { low: 10, medium: 5, high: 1, critical: 0 };
    return await queues.notifications.add('notification', data, {
      priority: priorityMap[priority],
      attempts: 2
    });
  },

  generateReport: async (data: ReportJobData, delay?: number) => {
    if (!queues) {
      logger.warn('Background jobs not available - Redis not connected');
      return { id: 'mock_job_' + Date.now() };
    }
    return await queues.reports.add('report-generation', data, {
      delay,
      attempts: 2,
      removeOnComplete: 5
    });
  },

  getQueueStats: async () => {
    if (!queues) {
      return { message: 'Background jobs disabled - Redis not available' };
    }
    const stats: Record<string, any> = {};
    for (const [name, queue] of Object.entries(queues)) {
      stats[name] = {
        waiting: await queue.getWaiting(),
        active: await queue.getActive(), 
        completed: await queue.getCompleted(),
        failed: await queue.getFailed()
      };
    }
    return stats;
  }
};

## FILE: server/utils/cache.ts

import { logger } from './logger';

interface CacheEntry<T> {
  data: T;
  timestamp: number;
  ttl: number;
}

export class MemoryCache {
  private cache = new Map<string, CacheEntry<any>>();
  private readonly defaultTTL: number;
  private cleanupInterval: NodeJS.Timeout;

  constructor(defaultTTL: number = 300000) { // 5 minutes default
    this.defaultTTL = defaultTTL;
    
    // Cleanup expired entries every minute
    this.cleanupInterval = setInterval(() => {
      this.cleanup();
    }, 60000);

    logger.info('Memory cache initialized', { defaultTTL });
  }

  set<T>(key: string, data: T, ttl?: number): void {
    const entry: CacheEntry<T> = {
      data,
      timestamp: Date.now(),
      ttl: ttl || this.defaultTTL,
    };
    
    this.cache.set(key, entry);
    logger.debug('Cache entry set', { key, ttl: entry.ttl });
  }

  get<T>(key: string): T | null {
    const entry = this.cache.get(key);
    
    if (!entry) {
      logger.debug('Cache miss', { key });
      return null;
    }

    const now = Date.now();
    const isExpired = (now - entry.timestamp) > entry.ttl;
    
    if (isExpired) {
      this.cache.delete(key);
      logger.debug('Cache entry expired', { key });
      return null;
    }

    logger.debug('Cache hit', { key });
    return entry.data as T;
  }

  delete(key: string): boolean {
    const deleted = this.cache.delete(key);
    if (deleted) {
      logger.debug('Cache entry deleted', { key });
    }
    return deleted;
  }

  clear(): void {
    const size = this.cache.size;
    this.cache.clear();
    logger.info('Cache cleared', { entriesRemoved: size });
  }

  getStats(): { size: number; keys: string[] } {
    return {
      size: this.cache.size,
      keys: Array.from(this.cache.keys()),
    };
  }

  private cleanup(): void {
    const now = Date.now();
    let expiredCount = 0;

    for (const [key, entry] of this.cache.entries()) {
      if ((now - entry.timestamp) > entry.ttl) {
        this.cache.delete(key);
        expiredCount++;
      }
    }

    if (expiredCount > 0) {
      logger.debug('Cache cleanup completed', { 
        expiredEntries: expiredCount,
        remainingEntries: this.cache.size 
      });
    }
  }

  destroy(): void {
    clearInterval(this.cleanupInterval);
    this.clear();
    logger.info('Memory cache destroyed');
  }
}

// Cache decorator for functions
export function cached<T extends (...args: any[]) => any>(
  ttl: number = 300000,
  keyGenerator?: (...args: Parameters<T>) => string
) {
  return function (target: any, propertyName: string, descriptor: PropertyDescriptor) {
    const method = descriptor.value;
    const cache = new MemoryCache(ttl);

    descriptor.value = async function (...args: Parameters<T>) {
      const key = keyGenerator ? keyGenerator(...args) : `${propertyName}_${JSON.stringify(args)}`;
      
      let result = cache.get<ReturnType<T>>(key);
      if (result !== null) {
        return result;
      }

      result = await method.apply(this, args);
      cache.set(key, result, ttl);
      return result;
    };

    return descriptor;
  };
}

// Global cache instance
export const globalCache = new MemoryCache();
```

import type { Request, Response } from 'express';

interface LogContext {

// Sensitive data redaction patterns for production security

  'req.headers.authorization',
  'req.headers.cookie',
  'body.password',
  'body.email',
  'body.apiKey',
  'body.token',
  'body.secret',
  'body.credentials',
  'context.password',
  'context.token',
  'context.apiKey',
  'context.secret',
  'error.config.headers.authorization'
];

const pinoLogger = pino({
  level: process.env.NODE_ENV === 'production' ? 'info' : 'debug',
  redact: REDACTION_PATHS,
  serializers: {
    req: (req: Request) => ({
      method: req.method,
      url: req.url,
      path: req.path,
      query: req.query,
      params: req.params,
      headers: {
        host: req.headers.host,
        'user-agent': req.headers['user-agent'],
        'content-type': req.headers['content-type'],
        'content-length': req.headers['content-length'],
        'x-forwarded-for': req.headers['x-forwarded-for']
      },
      remoteAddress: req.ip,
      remotePort: req.socket?.remotePort
    }),
    res: (res: Response) => ({
      statusCode: res.statusCode,
      headers: {
        'content-type': res.getHeader('content-type'),
        'content-length': res.getHeader('content-length')
      }
    }),
    err: pino.stdSerializers.err
  },
  formatters: {
    level: (label: string) => ({ level: label.toUpperCase() })
  },
  timestamp: pino.stdTimeFunctions.isoTime,
  base: {
    pid: process.pid,
    hostname: process.env.HOSTNAME || 'localhost',
    service: 'veridius-platform',
    version: '1.0.0'
  }
});

// HTTP request logger middleware
export const httpLogger = pinoHttp({
  logger: pinoLogger,
  redact: REDACTION_PATHS,
  customLogLevel: (req: Request, res: Response, err?: Error) => {
    if (err || res.statusCode >= 500) return 'error';
    if (res.statusCode >= 400) return 'warn';
    if (res.statusCode >= 300) return 'info';
    return 'debug';
  },
  customSuccessMessage: (req: Request, res: Response) => {
    return `${req.method} ${req.url} ${res.statusCode}`;
  },
  customErrorMessage: (req: Request, res: Response, err: Error) => {
    return `${req.method} ${req.url} ${res.statusCode} - ${err.message}`;
  }
});

export class Logger {
  private static instance: Logger;
  private pino = pinoLogger;
  
  static getInstance(): Logger {
    if (!Logger.instance) {
      Logger.instance = new Logger();
    }
    return Logger.instance;
  }

  // Secure data redaction before logging
  private redactSensitiveData(context?: LogContext): LogContext | undefined {
    if (!context) return context;
    
    const redacted = { ...context };
    const sensitiveFields = ['password', 'token', 'apiKey', 'secret', 'authorization', 'cookie'];
    
    for (const field of sensitiveFields) {
      if (redacted[field]) {
        redacted[field] = '[REDACTED]';
      }
    }
    
    return redacted;
  }

  info(message: string, context?: LogContext): void {
    this.pino.info(this.redactSensitiveData(context), message);
  }

  warn(message: string, context?: LogContext): void {
    this.pino.warn(this.redactSensitiveData(context), message);
  }

  error(message: string, error?: Error, context?: LogContext): void {
    const errorContext = {
      ...this.redactSensitiveData(context),
      error: error ? {
        name: error.name,
        message: error.message,
        stack: process.env.NODE_ENV === 'development' ? error.stack : undefined,
      } : undefined,
    };
    this.pino.error(errorContext, message);
  }

  debug(message: string, context?: LogContext): void {
    this.pino.debug(this.redactSensitiveData(context), message);
  }

  audit(action: string, resource: string, context?: LogContext): void {
    this.pino.info({
      ...this.redactSensitiveData(context),
      action,
      resource,
      audit: true,
      type: 'audit_event'
    }, `Audit: ${action} ${resource}`);
  }

  // Enhanced logging methods for different event types
  security(event: string, context?: LogContext): void {
    this.pino.warn({
      ...this.redactSensitiveData(context),
      type: 'security_event',
      event,
      severity: 'high'
    }, `Security: ${event}`);
  }

  performance(operation: string, duration: number, context?: LogContext): void {
    this.pino.info({
      ...this.redactSensitiveData(context),
      type: 'performance_metric',
      operation,
      duration,
      unit: 'ms'
    }, `Performance: ${operation} took ${duration}ms`);
  }

  userAction(userId: string, action: string, resource?: string, context?: LogContext): void {
    this.pino.info({
      ...this.redactSensitiveData(context),
      type: 'user_action',
      userId,
      action,
      resource
    }, `User ${userId} performed ${action}${resource ? ` on ${resource}` : ''}`);
  }

  // Production-grade structured logging
  child(bindings: Record<string, any>) {
    return this.pino.child(this.redactSensitiveData(bindings) || {});
  }
}

export const logger = Logger.getInstance();
```

## FILE: server/utils/performance.ts
```
import { logger } from './logger';

export class PerformanceMonitor {
  private static instance: PerformanceMonitor;
  private metrics = new Map<string, number[]>();
  private readonly maxSamples = 100;

  static getInstance(): PerformanceMonitor {
    if (!PerformanceMonitor.instance) {
      PerformanceMonitor.instance = new PerformanceMonitor();
    }
    return PerformanceMonitor.instance;
  }

  startTimer(operation: string): () => number {
    const startTime = performance.now();
    
    return () => {
      const duration = performance.now() - startTime;
      this.recordMetric(operation, duration);
      
      if (duration > 1000) {
        logger.warn('Slow operation detected', {
          operation,
          duration: Math.round(duration),
          performance: true,
        });
      }
      
      return duration;
    };
  }

  recordMetric(operation: string, duration: number): void {
    if (!this.metrics.has(operation)) {
      this.metrics.set(operation, []);
    }
    
    const samples = this.metrics.get(operation)!;
    samples.push(duration);
    
    if (samples.length > this.maxSamples) {
      samples.shift();
    }
  }

  getMetrics(operation?: string): Record<string, any> {
    if (operation) {
      const samples = this.metrics.get(operation) || [];
      return this.calculateStats(operation, samples);
    }

    const allMetrics: Record<string, any> = {};
    for (const [op, samples] of this.metrics.entries()) {
      allMetrics[op] = this.calculateStats(op, samples);
    }
    
    return allMetrics;
  }

  private calculateStats(operation: string, samples: number[]): any {
    if (samples.length === 0) {
      return { operation, count: 0 };
    }

    const sorted = [...samples].sort((a, b) => a - b);
    const sum = samples.reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0);
    
    return {
      operation,
      count: samples.length,
      avg: Math.round(sum / samples.length),
      min: Math.round(sorted[0]),
      max: Math.round(sorted[sorted.length - 1]),
      p50: Math.round(sorted[Math.floor(sorted.length * 0.5)]),
      p95: Math.round(sorted[Math.floor(sorted.length * 0.95)]),
      p99: Math.round(sorted[Math.floor(sorted.length * 0.99)]),
    };
  }

  reset(): void {
    this.metrics.clear();
    logger.info('Performance metrics reset');
  }
}

export const performanceMonitor = PerformanceMonitor.getInstance();

// Decorator for timing functions
export function timed(operation?: string) {
  return function (target: any, propertyName: string, descriptor: PropertyDescriptor) {
    const method = descriptor.value;
    const operationName = operation || `${target.constructor.name}.${propertyName}`;

    descriptor.value = async function (...args: any[]) {
      const timer = performanceMonitor.startTimer(operationName);
      
      try {
        const result = await method.apply(this, args);
        timer();
        return result;
      } catch (error) {
        timer();
        throw error;
      }
    };

    return descriptor;
  };
}

// Memory usage monitoring
export class MemoryMonitor {
  private static instance: MemoryMonitor;
  private samples: NodeJS.MemoryUsage[] = [];
  private readonly maxSamples = 100;

  static getInstance(): MemoryMonitor {
    if (!MemoryMonitor.instance) {
      MemoryMonitor.instance = new MemoryMonitor();
    }
    return MemoryMonitor.instance;
  }

  recordSample(): void {
    const usage = process.memoryUsage();
    this.samples.push(usage);

    if (this.samples.length > this.maxSamples) {
      this.samples.shift();
    }

    // Alert on high memory usage
    const heapUsedMB = usage.heapUsed / 1024 / 1024;
    const heapTotalMB = usage.heapTotal / 1024 / 1024;
    const usagePercent = heapUsedMB / heapTotalMB;

    if (usagePercent > 0.85) {
      logger.warn('High memory usage detected', {
        heapUsedMB: Math.round(heapUsedMB),
        heapTotalMB: Math.round(heapTotalMB),
        usagePercent: Math.round(usagePercent * 100),
        memory: true,
      });
    }
  }

  getStats(): any {
    if (this.samples.length === 0) {
      return null;
    }

    const latest = this.samples[this.samples.length - 1];
    const avgHeapUsed = this.samples.reduce((sum, sample) => sum + sample.heapUsed, 0) / this.samples.length;
    
    return {
      current: {
        heapUsed: Math.round(latest.heapUsed / 1024 / 1024),
        heapTotal: Math.round(latest.heapTotal / 1024 / 1024),
        external: Math.round(latest.external / 1024 / 1024),
        rss: Math.round(latest.rss / 1024 / 1024),
      },
      average: {
        heapUsed: Math.round(avgHeapUsed / 1024 / 1024),
      },
      samples: this.samples.length,
    };
  }
}

export const memoryMonitor = MemoryMonitor.getInstance();

// Start memory monitoring
setInterval(() => {
  memoryMonitor.recordSample();
}, 30000); // Every 30 seconds
```

## FILE: server/vite.ts
```
import express, { type Express } from "express";
import fs from "fs";
import path from "path";
import { createServer as createViteServer, createLogger } from "vite";
import { type Server } from "http";
import viteConfig from "../vite.config";
import { nanoid } from "nanoid";

const viteLogger = createLogger();

export function log(message: string, source = "express") {
  const formattedTime = new Date().toLocaleTimeString("en-US", {
    hour: "numeric",
    minute: "2-digit",
    second: "2-digit",
    hour12: true,
  });

  console.log(`${formattedTime} [${source}] ${message}`);
}

export async function setupVite(app: Express, server: Server) {
  const serverOptions = {
    middlewareMode: true,
    hmr: { server },
    allowedHosts: true as const,
  };

  const vite = await createViteServer({
    ...viteConfig,
    configFile: false,
    customLogger: {
      ...viteLogger,
      error: (msg, options) => {
        viteLogger.error(msg, options);
        process.exit(1);
      },
    },
    server: serverOptions,
    appType: "custom",
  });

  app.use(vite.middlewares);
  app.use("*", async (req, res, next) => {
    const url = req.originalUrl;

    try {
      const clientTemplate = path.resolve(
        import.meta.dirname,
        "..",
        "client",
        "index.html",
      );

      // always reload the index.html file from disk incase it changes
      let template = await fs.promises.readFile(clientTemplate, "utf-8");
      template = template.replace(
        `src="/src/main.tsx"`,
        `src="/src/main.tsx?v=${nanoid()}"`,
      );
      const page = await vite.transformIndexHtml(url, template);
      res.status(200).set({ "Content-Type": "text/html" }).end(page);
    } catch (e) {
      vite.ssrFixStacktrace(e as Error);
      next(e);
    }
  });
}

export function serveStatic(app: Express) {
  const distPath = path.resolve(import.meta.dirname, "public");

  if (!fs.existsSync(distPath)) {
    throw new Error(
      `Could not find the build directory: ${distPath}, make sure to build the client first`,
    );
  }

  app.use(express.static(distPath));

  // fall through to index.html if the file doesn't exist
  app.use("*", (_req, res) => {
    res.sendFile(path.resolve(distPath, "index.html"));
  });
}

/**
 * Comprehensive Scenario Template Collection
 * Ready-to-engage approach with 17 in-depth data templates
 * Based on our complete scenario coverage matrix and industry research
 */

export interface ComprehensiveScenarioTemplate {
  id: string;
  name: string;
  category: 'operational' | 'security' | 'financial' | 'regulatory' | 'human-capital' | 'market' | 'supply-chain' | 'technology' | 'strategic';
  description: string;
  likelihood: 'low' | 'medium' | 'high';
  severity: 'minimal' | 'moderate' | 'significant' | 'severe' | 'catastrophic';
  typicalTimeframe: 'immediate' | 'hours' | 'days' | 'weeks' | 'months';
  
  // Enhanced data capture fields
  requiredDataPoints: EnhancedDataPoint[];
  criticalDecisionPoints: string[];
  stakeholderMapping: StakeholderRole[];
  resourceRequirements: ResourceRequirement[];
  successMetrics: string[];
  industrySpecific: boolean;
  applicableIndustries: string[];
  
  // Crisis execution specifics
  responsePhases: ResponsePhase[];
  escalationTriggers: string[];
  communicationPlan: CommunicationStep[];
  recoveryMetrics: string[];
}

export interface EnhancedDataPoint {
  fieldName: string;
  label: string;
  fieldType: 'text' | 'number' | 'select' | 'multiselect' | 'date' | 'currency' | 'percentage' | 'textarea';
  required: boolean;
  placeholder?: string;
  options?: string[];
  validationRules?: string[];
  helpText?: string;
  category: 'situation' | 'organization' | 'resources' | 'timeline' | 'stakeholders' | 'financial' | 'regulatory';
}

export interface StakeholderRole {
  role: string;
  department: string;
  responsibility: string;
  decisionAuthority: 'low' | 'medium' | 'high' | 'critical';
  communicationPriority: 'immediate' | 'hourly' | 'daily';
}

export interface ResourceRequirement {
  resourceType: 'personnel' | 'technology' | 'financial' | 'external' | 'facilities';
  description: string;
  urgency: 'immediate' | 'hours' | 'days' | 'weeks';
  estimatedCost: string;
  alternatives: string[];
}

export interface ResponsePhase {
  phase: 'immediate' | 'short-term' | 'long-term';
  timeline: string;
  objectives: string[];
  keyActions: string[];
  successCriteria: string[];
}

export interface CommunicationStep {
  audience: string;
  timing: string;
  channel: string;
  keyMessages: string[];
  responsibleParty: string;
}

// Helper function to get templates by category
export const getTemplatesByCategory = (category: ComprehensiveScenarioTemplate['category']) => {
  return COMPREHENSIVE_SCENARIO_TEMPLATES.filter(template => template.category === category);
};

// Helper function to get crisis response templates
export const getCrisisResponseTemplates = () => {
  return COMPREHENSIVE_SCENARIO_TEMPLATES.filter(template => 
    ['operational', 'security', 'financial', 'supply-chain', 'market'].includes(template.category)
  );
};

// Helper function to get strategic opportunity templates
export const getStrategicOpportunityTemplates = () => {
  return COMPREHENSIVE_SCENARIO_TEMPLATES.filter(template => 
    ['strategic', 'technology'].includes(template.category)
  );
};
```

## FILE: shared/industry-templates.ts
```
/**
 * Industry-specific scenario templates and enhanced data capture
 * Tailored for real-world crisis preparation and execution
 */

export interface IndustryTemplate {
  industry: string;
  commonScenarios: ScenarioTemplate[];
  specificDataFields: DataField[];
  regulatoryConsiderations: string[];
  typicalStakeholders: string[];
  commonResources: string[];
  industryRisks: RiskProfile[];
}

export interface ScenarioTemplate {
  title: string;
  description: string;
  category: 'operational' | 'financial' | 'regulatory' | 'technological' | 'human-capital' | 'market' | 'supply-chain';
  likelihood: 'low' | 'medium' | 'high';
  severity: 'minimal' | 'moderate' | 'significant' | 'severe' | 'catastrophic';
  typicalTimeframe: string;
  requiredDataPoints: string[];
  criticalDecisionPoints: string[];
}

export interface DataField {
  fieldName: string;
  fieldType: 'text' | 'number' | 'select' | 'multiselect' | 'date' | 'currency';
  label: string;
  placeholder?: string;
  options?: string[];
  required: boolean;
  industrySpecific: boolean;
}

export interface RiskProfile {
  riskType: string;
  description: string;
  indicators: string[];
  mitigationStrategies: string[];
}

export const INDUSTRY_TEMPLATES = {
  'technology': TECHNOLOGY_INDUSTRY,
  'financial-services': FINANCIAL_SERVICES_INDUSTRY,
  'healthcare': HEALTHCARE_INDUSTRY
};

// Utility function to get industry template
export function getIndustryTemplate(industry: string): IndustryTemplate | null {
  return INDUSTRY_TEMPLATES[industry as keyof typeof INDUSTRY_TEMPLATES] || null;
}

// Utility function to get scenario templates for an industry
export function getScenarioTemplates(industry: string): ScenarioTemplate[] {
  const template = getIndustryTemplate(industry);
  return template?.commonScenarios || [];
}

// Utility function to get industry-specific data fields
export function getIndustryDataFields(industry: string): DataField[] {
  const template = getIndustryTemplate(industry);
  return template?.specificDataFields || [];
}

export function getOpportunityTemplatesByCategory(category?: string): OpportunityScenarioTemplate[] {
  if (!category) return OPPORTUNITY_SCENARIO_TEMPLATES;
  return OPPORTUNITY_SCENARIO_TEMPLATES.filter(template => template.category === category);
}

export function getOpportunityTemplateById(id: string): OpportunityScenarioTemplate | undefined {
  return OPPORTUNITY_SCENARIO_TEMPLATES.find(template => template.id === id);
}

## FILE: shared/schema.ts
```
import { sql } from 'drizzle-orm';
import {
  index,
  jsonb,
  pgTable,
  timestamp,
  varchar,
  text,
  integer,
  decimal,
  boolean,
  uuid,
  pgEnum,
  vector
} from "drizzle-orm/pg-core";
import { relations } from "drizzle-orm";
import { createInsertSchema, createSelectSchema } from "drizzle-zod";
import { z } from "zod";

// Enums
export const organizationTypeEnum = pgEnum('organization_type', ['enterprise', 'mid-market', 'startup', 'government', 'non-profit']);
export const priorityEnum = pgEnum('priority', ['low', 'medium', 'high', 'critical']);
export const statusEnum = pgEnum('status', ['draft', 'active', 'paused', 'completed', 'archived']);
export const riskLevelEnum = pgEnum('risk_level', ['minimal', 'low', 'moderate', 'high', 'severe']);
export const moduleEnum = pgEnum('module', ['core', 'pulse', 'flux', 'prism', 'echo', 'nova']);
export const adaptabilityScoreEnum = pgEnum('adaptability_score', ['rigid', 'stable', 'adaptive', 'agile', 'dynamic']);
export const taskStatusEnum = pgEnum('task_status', ['not-started', 'in-progress', 'blocked', 'review', 'completed', 'cancelled']);
export const skillLevelEnum = pgEnum('skill_level', ['beginner', 'intermediate', 'advanced', 'expert']);
export const roleTypeEnum = pgEnum('role_type', ['executive', 'manager', 'lead', 'senior', 'mid-level', 'junior', 'intern']);
export const capacityStatusEnum = pgEnum('capacity_status', ['under-utilized', 'optimal', 'at-capacity', 'over-extended', 'critical']);
export const integrationType = pgEnum('integration_type', ['jira', 'asana', 'salesforce', 'hubspot', 'slack', 'teams', 'github', 'custom']);
export const scenarioOutcomeEnum = pgEnum('scenario_outcome', ['success', 'partial-success', 'failure', 'cancelled', 'pending']);
export const activityTypeEnum = pgEnum('activity_type', ['report', 'alert', 'user_action', 'system', 'workflow', 'integration']);
export const outcomeTypeEnum = pgEnum('outcome_type', ['success', 'partial_success', 'failure', 'cancelled', 'ongoing']);
export const effectivenessEnum = pgEnum('effectiveness', ['very_low', 'low', 'medium', 'high', 'very_high']);
export const confidenceEnum = pgEnum('confidence', ['very_low', 'low', 'medium', 'high', 'very_high']);

// Organizations - Core entity for enterprise customers
export const organizations = pgTable("organizations", {
  id: uuid("id").primaryKey().default(sql`gen_random_uuid()`),
  name: varchar("name", { length: 255 }).notNull(),
  domain: varchar("domain", { length: 100 }),
  type: organizationTypeEnum("type").notNull(),
  size: integer("size"), // Employee count
  industry: varchar("industry", { length: 100 }),
  headquarters: varchar("headquarters", { length: 255 }),
  adaptabilityScore: adaptabilityScoreEnum("adaptability_score").default('stable'),
  onboardingCompleted: boolean("onboarding_completed").default(false),
  subscriptionTier: varchar("subscription_tier").default('basic'),
  createdAt: timestamp("created_at").defaultNow(),
  updatedAt: timestamp("updated_at").defaultNow(),
});

// Enhanced User Management
export const users = pgTable("users", {
  id: varchar("id").primaryKey().default(sql`gen_random_uuid()`),
  email: varchar("email").unique(),
  firstName: varchar("first_name"),
  lastName: varchar("last_name"),
  profileImageUrl: varchar("profile_image_url"),
  organizationId: uuid("organization_id").references(() => organizations.id),
  role: varchar("role").default("user"),
  roleType: roleTypeEnum("role_type").default('mid-level'),
  department: varchar("department", { length: 100 }),
  team: varchar("team", { length: 100 }),
  managerId: varchar("manager_id"),
  hoursPerWeek: integer("hours_per_week").default(40),
  currentCapacity: capacityStatusEnum("current_capacity").default('optimal'),
  skills: jsonb("skills"), // Array of skill objects with proficiency levels
  certifications: jsonb("certifications"),
  plannedLeave: jsonb("planned_leave"), // Array of leave periods
  lastLoginAt: timestamp("last_login_at"),
  createdAt: timestamp("created_at").defaultNow(),
  updatedAt: timestamp("updated_at").defaultNow(),
});

// Session storage table (required for auth)
export const sessions = pgTable(
  "sessions",
  {
    sid: varchar("sid").primaryKey(),
    sess: jsonb("sess").notNull(),
    expire: timestamp("expire").notNull(),
  },
  (table) => [index("IDX_session_expire").on(table.expire)],
);

// Enhanced Projects with full lifecycle management
export const projects = pgTable("projects", {
  id: uuid("id").primaryKey().default(sql`gen_random_uuid()`),
  organizationId: uuid("organization_id").references(() => organizations.id).notNull(),
  name: varchar("name", { length: 255 }).notNull(),
  description: text("description"),
  objective: text("objective"),
  methodology: varchar("methodology", { length: 50 }), // Agile, Waterfall, Lean, etc.
  priority: priorityEnum("priority").default('medium'),
  status: statusEnum("status").default('draft'),
  progress: decimal("progress", { precision: 3, scale: 2 }).default('0.00'), // 0.00 to 1.00
  budget: decimal("budget", { precision: 12, scale: 2 }),
  actualCost: decimal("actual_cost", { precision: 12, scale: 2 }).default('0.00'),
  startDate: timestamp("start_date"),
  targetDate: timestamp("target_date"),
  completedDate: timestamp("completed_date"),
  riskLevel: riskLevelEnum("risk_level").default('low'),
  teamSize: integer("team_size"),
  leadId: varchar("lead_id").references(() => users.id),
  stakeholders: jsonb("stakeholders"), // Array of user IDs and external contacts
  metrics: jsonb("metrics"), // Project-specific KPIs
  createdAt: timestamp("created_at").defaultNow(),
  updatedAt: timestamp("updated_at").defaultNow(),
});

// Comprehensive Task Management
export const tasks = pgTable("tasks", {
  id: uuid("id").primaryKey().default(sql`gen_random_uuid()`),
  projectId: uuid("project_id").references(() => projects.id).notNull(),
  parentTaskId: uuid("parent_task_id"),
  name: varchar("name", { length: 255 }).notNull(),
  description: text("description"),
  assigneeId: varchar("assignee_id").references(() => users.id),
  status: taskStatusEnum("status").default('not-started'),
  priority: priorityEnum("priority").default('medium'),
  estimatedHours: decimal("estimated_hours", { precision: 5, scale: 2 }),
  actualHours: decimal("actual_hours", { precision: 5, scale: 2 }).default('0.00'),
  complexity: integer("complexity"), // 1-10 scale
  dependencies: jsonb("dependencies"), // Array of task IDs
  tags: jsonb("tags"), // Array of tag strings
  dueDate: timestamp("due_date"),
  startDate: timestamp("start_date"),

// Relations
export const organizationsRelations = relations(organizations, ({ many }) => ({
  users: many(users),
  projects: many(projects),
  scenarios: many(strategicScenarios),
  tasks: many(tasks),
  capacityPlanning: many(capacityPlanning),
}));

export const usersRelations = relations(users, ({ one, many }) => ({
  organization: one(organizations, {
    fields: [users.organizationId],
    references: [organizations.id],
  }),
  tasks: many(tasks),
  capacityPlanning: many(capacityPlanning),
}));

export const projectsRelations = relations(projects, ({ one, many }) => ({
  organization: one(organizations, {
    fields: [projects.organizationId],
    references: [organizations.id],
  }),
  lead: one(users, {
    fields: [projects.leadId],
    references: [users.id],
  }),
  tasks: many(tasks),
  roadmapItems: many(roadmapItems),
}));

export const tasksRelations = relations(tasks, ({ one, many }) => ({
  project: one(projects, {
    fields: [tasks.projectId],
    references: [projects.id],
  }),
  assignee: one(users, {
    fields: [tasks.assigneeId],
    references: [users.id],
  }),
  creator: one(users, {
    fields: [tasks.createdBy],
    references: [users.id],
  }),
}));

// Vector Search and Semantic Intelligence Tables
export const semanticDocuments = pgTable("semantic_documents", {
  id: uuid("id").primaryKey().default(sql`gen_random_uuid()`),
  organizationId: uuid("organization_id").references(() => organizations.id).notNull(),
  title: varchar("title", { length: 500 }).notNull(),
  content: text("content").notNull(),
  documentType: varchar("document_type", { length: 100 }), // scenario, report, insight, policy, etc.
  sourceId: varchar("source_id", { length: 255 }), // Reference to original record
  sourceTable: varchar("source_table", { length: 100 }), // Which table this came from
  contentEmbedding: vector("content_embedding", { dimensions: 1536 }), // OpenAI ada-002 embeddings
  metadata: jsonb("metadata"), // Additional context for search
  tags: jsonb("tags"), // Array of searchable tags
  lastEmbedded: timestamp("last_embedded"),
  accessLevel: varchar("access_level", { length: 50 }).default('organization'), // organization, department, team, private
  createdBy: varchar("created_by").references(() => users.id),
  createdAt: timestamp("created_at").defaultNow(),
  updatedAt: timestamp("updated_at").defaultNow(),
}, (table) => [
  // Vector similarity search index
  index("semantic_documents_embedding_idx").on(table.contentEmbedding),
  // Traditional search indexes
  index("semantic_documents_org_type_idx").on(table.organizationId, table.documentType),
  index("semantic_documents_created_idx").on(table.createdAt)
]);

// Natural Language Query Log and Analytics
export const nlQueryLog = pgTable("nl_query_log", {
  id: uuid("id").primaryKey().default(sql`gen_random_uuid()`),
  organizationId: uuid("organization_id").references(() => organizations.id).notNull(),
  userId: varchar("user_id").references(() => users.id).notNull(),
  query: text("query").notNull(),
  intent: varchar("intent", { length: 100 }), // search, analysis, prediction, recommendation
  results: jsonb("results"), // Search results and analysis
  processingTime: integer("processing_time"), // Milliseconds
  confidence: decimal("confidence", { precision: 3, scale: 2 }), // AI confidence in results
  feedback: jsonb("feedback"), // User feedback on quality
  createdAt: timestamp("created_at").defaultNow(),
}, (table) => [
  index("nl_query_org_user_idx").on(table.organizationId, table.userId),
  index("nl_query_created_idx").on(table.createdAt)
]);

// Collaborative Decision Rooms
export const collaborativeRooms = pgTable("collaborative_rooms", {
  id: uuid("id").primaryKey().default(sql`gen_random_uuid()`),
  organizationId: uuid("organization_id").references(() => organizations.id).notNull(),
  name: varchar("name", { length: 255 }).notNull(),
  description: text("description"),
  roomType: varchar("room_type", { length: 50 }).default('decision'), // decision, brainstorm, review, crisis
  status: statusEnum("status").default('active'),
  scenarioId: uuid("scenario_id").references(() => strategicScenarios.id),
  participants: jsonb("participants"), // Array of user IDs with roles
  moderatorId: varchar("moderator_id").references(() => users.id).notNull(),
  sessionData: jsonb("session_data"), // Real-time collaboration state
  decisions: jsonb("decisions"), // Captured decisions and votes
  artifacts: jsonb("artifacts"), // Generated documents, diagrams, notes
  scheduledStart: timestamp("scheduled_start"),
  scheduledEnd: timestamp("scheduled_end"),
  actualStart: timestamp("actual_start"),
  actualEnd: timestamp("actual_end"),
  createdAt: timestamp("created_at").defaultNow(),
  updatedAt: timestamp("updated_at").defaultNow(),
}, (table) => [
  index("collaborative_rooms_org_status_idx").on(table.organizationId, table.status),
  index("collaborative_rooms_scenario_idx").on(table.scenarioId)
]);

// Proactive Insights Engine
export const proactiveInsights = pgTable("proactive_insights", {
  id: uuid("id").primaryKey().default(sql`gen_random_uuid()`),
  organizationId: uuid("organization_id").references(() => organizations.id).notNull(),
  insightType: varchar("insight_type", { length: 100 }).notNull(), // opportunity, risk, anomaly, trend
  title: varchar("title", { length: 255 }).notNull(),
  description: text("description").notNull(),
  confidence: confidenceEnum("confidence").notNull(),
  urgency: priorityEnum("urgency").default('medium'),
  category: varchar("category", { length: 100 }), // financial, operational, strategic, market
  sourcePatterns: jsonb("source_patterns"), // What patterns triggered this insight
  evidenceData: jsonb("evidence_data"), // Supporting data and metrics
  recommendations: jsonb("recommendations"), // Suggested actions
  potentialImpact: jsonb("potential_impact"), // Estimated business impact
  affectedDepartments: jsonb("affected_departments"), // Array of departments
  relatedScenarios: jsonb("related_scenarios"), // Connected scenario IDs
  status: varchar("status", { length: 50 }).default('new'), // new, reviewed, acting, resolved, dismissed
  reviewedBy: varchar("reviewed_by").references(() => users.id),
  reviewedAt: timestamp("reviewed_at"),
  actionTaken: text("action_taken"),
  outcome: text("outcome"),
  createdAt: timestamp("created_at").defaultNow(),
  updatedAt: timestamp("updated_at").defaultNow(),
}, (table) => [
  index("proactive_insights_org_type_idx").on(table.organizationId, table.insightType),
  index("proactive_insights_status_urgency_idx").on(table.status, table.urgency),
  index("proactive_insights_created_idx").on(table.createdAt)
]);

// Webhook and Integration Events
export const webhookEvents = pgTable("webhook_events", {
  id: uuid("id").primaryKey().default(sql`gen_random_uuid()`),
  organizationId: uuid("organization_id").references(() => organizations.id).notNull(),
  webhookUrl: varchar("webhook_url", { length: 500 }).notNull(),
  eventType: varchar("event_type", { length: 100 }).notNull(), // scenario_created, insight_generated, etc.
  payload: jsonb("payload").notNull(),
  status: varchar("status", { length: 50 }).default('pending'), // pending, sent, failed, retrying
  responseCode: integer("response_code"),
  responseBody: text("response_body"),
  attempts: integer("attempts").default(1),
  nextRetry: timestamp("next_retry"),
  createdAt: timestamp("created_at").defaultNow(),
  updatedAt: timestamp("updated_at").defaultNow(),
}, (table) => [
  index("webhook_events_org_status_idx").on(table.organizationId, table.status),
  index("webhook_events_next_retry_idx").on(table.nextRetry)
]);
